(1) dkar chagaspong 31ga grangs 1 sman rdzongs 'byug rgyal khab kyi snga rabs kyi lo rgyus dang 'brel ba'i sde srid khri rabs dang brgyud 'dzin rgyal rabs deb kyi bsdus don sngon brdzod/ nya latsa ba'i sa bcad lnga las/ dang po gna' dus kyi 'o/ rgyus bshad pa la/ 'a kyibs gnas dam pa la mched par brjod pa dang gleng ga zhi/ rda 11'i rten phyi snyed stong gsum 'jig rten chags tshul dang brten pa nang bcud kyi sems can chags tshul/ nya' 144 stong gsum 'jig rten de'i bye brag 'dzam thu'i gling gi gnas tshul/ 15 16pa 'dzam bu'i gling gi cha shas su gtogs pa'i tsan dan bkod pa'i yul rdzongs/ 17 go 196 de na gnas pa'i mi'i 'gro ba sngon gyi dus su mon pa yin pa/ 'aX 'a17 dkon masnu ga gsum gyi thugs rje'i 'od sgang thog mar 'char ba 'a' 'a38 rgyal po sin dha rā dza sdod gnas 'tshol te gyon nas thum thang lcags mkhar du bzhugs pa'i 'o/ rgyus/ 'a4 'ju9 te/ rgyan padma 'byung gnas rgyal po sin snye rā dzas gdan dungs te khyon pa'i lo rgyus/ 'khyu 31

( 2 )10 mkhan pa sbyodangs kyi lam yig nas gsungs pa'i rgyal po khyi la ra thod kyi lo rgyus/ 3'a 3611 gu ru rin po che yar lung shel brag nas gyon te khyi la ra khrod yul bton te malan pa rdzongs sbas yul du byin gyis brlabs pa/ 37 4 41nya' dog ma pa ni ru shing za ba'i lo rgyus khyad mtshar can/ 4'a 4313 gu ru rin po che ldan ma rtse mang khrid de bod nas byen tshul/ 44 4 4614 bdud blon gyi g.yo 'phrul gyis lha sras gtsang ma yul phud de snyo mon du byon pa'i lo rgyus/ 47 4 4915 lha sras gtsang ma'i mi brgyud kyis shar khyodags su rgyal mkhar mang po brtsigs pa/ paX 5516 thum thang du mi'i rje dpon 'byung tshul rgyal rigs 'byung khungs gsal ba'i byedan me las bshad pa/ 56 paṇa17 sum thang sde bzhi'i gdung dang yang lam rje'i chad khungs lugasagazhan/ 60 6318 lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje'i sprun rdo rje'i mched dug rdzongs 'dir btsan byol du gyon pa/ 64 6519 rje dpon dang gdung de nyid u da gdung nag po las gzhan du med tshul dang gdung nag po'i lo rgyus/ 66 68'a0 bum thang du khu/nga ba'i rgyal rabs 'e1 rgyus ma 'du ba gzhan yang / 69 7123

( 3 ) tsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa bstan pa snga dar la/'anya gtos lha nang pa'i bla ma rnams byon te gdan sa bcags te bla dpon 'brel mar bzhugs pa/ 7'a 75'a' gdan sa ra lung dang dpal ldan 'byug pa'i nges tshig bshad pa/ 76 4 79'a3 gtsang pa rgya ras kyis lung bstan te 'byug pa'i bstan pa thog mar 'dzugs pa po pha jo 'grag sgom zhig po byon tshul/ 80 85'a4 'byug sgom zhig po'i sprul pa'i sras lnga lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa'i 'dzin skyong du bskos pa/ 86 87'dzi gnas rnying pa'i gdung rabs skyes thu dam pa'i rnam thar rin po che'i gter mdzod ces bya ba nas btus pa/ 88 rdzoX'6 bla ma pagangs pa 'ba' ra bas gdan sa bcags tshul gyi 'o( dzo/sa/ 91 rdzonga'7 yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed dang 'jam dbyangs kun dga' seng ge'i rnam thar las gsal ba'i dung rengs kyi lo rgyus/ 96 99'a8 grub chen lcags zam pa thang sde nga rgyal nge sa gdan sa bcags tshul/ 100 — 103'a9 ka6wag pa'i sprul sku bsod nams rgyal mtshan byon te gdan sa bcags 'gril/ 104sna — 10830 bla ma lag lnga'i nang gses dge ldan shing rta pa/ 109 11031 sman rdzongs 'di nyid sngon gyi dus nas rgyal lab su'i mnga' 'og min pa'i tsu/ mtshan bapagad pa/ 111 — 115

( 4 )3'a 'byug pa'i bla ma sku nga ma rnams khyodan nas gdan sa bcags tshul/ 115 nya19tsa ba'i sa bcad ga༄/ma pa rang dbang rang btsan rgyal lab dbu brnyes tshul la/33 snyo mon 'byug par bsgyur te rang btsan rgyal khab bskrun mdzad zhabs drang ngag dbang rnam rgyal 'khrungs pa/ 〉'a0 nya'a'34 zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal lung bstan dang rgyu kyen gyis bskrul te sman rdzongs 'dir byon tshul/ )'a3 nya'adzi35 dngos can phyi'i dgra sde srid gtsang pa'i thog ma'i dmag dasung gi phyedags las rnam par rgyal ba/ ta'aju nya' 36 sde srid gtsang pa bsgral ba dang phyag tham nga bcu dug ma gnang ba/ 13༷ 13337 rang byon khar sa pa ṇi dang bla ma'i lung bstan bzhin lcags ri'i gdan sa bcags pa/ 133 13438 mkhas grub lha dbang blo spos sman rdzongs su gdan dungs te gyon tshul dang pad dkar bkra shis gdung yul bla dpon sgrags rgyal bste|sa pa/ 135 go 13939 dngos med gsang ba lha srin sde brgyad kyi dgra'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba/ 139 14sna040 lha dang bla ma'i lung bstan bzhin lugs gnyis bstan pa'i khur bzhes te gsang sngags zab don pho brang bzhengs pa/ 141 — 144

( 5 ) 41 sde srid gtsang pa'i dpung chen gnyis pa las rgyal nas spungs thang bde chen pho brang bzhengs te bstan pa'i gzhi ma dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs pa/ 145 1464'a las mgon sde bzhi'i lung bstan bzhin dbang 'dus po brang rdzong bzhengs pa/ nya47 14843 sde srid gtsang si 'i dpung dmag gsum pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba/ nya49 15444 nang gi dgra bla lag lnga'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal te rdo sngon rdzong rtsis bzhes pa/ 154 15645 dge sog 'dres ma'i dasung dmag dang po'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal te rin sprungs rdzong bzhengs pa/ 157 16446 dgo ldan pa'i dasung chen gnyis pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal te rang btsan je brtan du khu/ra pa/ 164 16747 bod dmag gis gcad mi tshugs gsungs shing bye ba phyag tshadang dar dkar rdzong bzhengs tshul/ 167 16948 shar phyogs su rmedzis rje dpal ldan 'grug pas dbang bsgyur tshul/ 170 18749 dpon lag rnams bsko sa tshul dang phyogs kyi rgyal khab dbang du 'asdokyis pa ro/gas dam bsdo/gas thegril/ 178 19nya

rnam rgyal/ rin srungs ba/zim da pon rta ma grin/ chos rtse'i gzim dpon don grub/rgyal po'i maX na gnyed phrin las sku gas kyis ༷ gas ram zhus te rgyal rabs btsams bsgrigs bgyis 'dug pa de yis spyir sngon gyi lo rgyus rnying pa mi mngon pa'i dbyings su bag pa zha bar phangs pa rnams phal cher brjod pa bka' drin che 'dug kyang sku ngas grags khyab gdal du ma gyur/'di ni spyi lo 1974la dngul rtsis rgyal tshab mi'i dbang mo a zhe bsed nams chodas sgron dbang phyug zhabs nas gnyer chen bgres pa tsho ring rdo rje nas btsams pa'i rgyal rabs kyi deb phun gyi lag pad gnang ste/ rgyal rabs 'di nyid khyod kyis nan tan zhib dpyod byas te bris shig ces pa'i bka' phebs pa dang / de bzhin du ma yum rā ni chedzes dbyings dbang mo nas kyang dge slong tshe ring rdo rje dang dge bshes rnam rgyal nas brtsa mas pa'i cheras 'khu/nga rgyal rabs/ 'byug mthu chen cesas kyi rgyal po'i bka'i khrims lugs kshi sgo/ga dril/ 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi rtogs brjod sgo ga dril/ has dung tshe/ rgyan rdo rjes gzhung dpon lag lhan rgyas la phul ba'i zhu yig 'du/spyi lo 1164 shing 'grag la dbye ba zhib dpyad bgyis pa'i yi ge spye lo nya965shing sprul 'o/'i kun gsal snga rjes bcas sul ba dang / rgyal 5/ma bskal bzang cheras sgren mtshe ga nas gong sa ma rgyan dbang phyug gis gong gzim e rgyan rdo rje dang / gong gzim bsod nam sa stobs rgyas la gnang ba'i bka' 3/ga gong sa 64 rgyan dbang phyug rang gi phyag bris ngo ma gzhan yang yig rnying dang phyag dpe mang po bcas gnang bar mdzad pa bka' drin che zhing / de nas bzung ste rnam thar dang yig cha rtsol sgrub byas nas yig cha tho zur du bkod pa rnam sa la rang blos shes tshad kyi thog nas zhib dpyad 2

nan tan byas nas/ deng sang gi srol dang bsnyun te dus rabs kyi tha snyad byas te dus rabs bdun pa nas bcu gcig pa'i bar gna' dus kyi 'e1 rgyus dang / dus rabs bcu gcig pa nas bcu bdun pa'i bar phyogs 'dir rgya la po dang sde srid med par bla dpon 'brel mar bzhugs pa las bstan pa snga dar che sa 'byung dang 'brel ba'i 'o/ rgyus dang / dus rabs bcu bdun pa 1616 nas 1651 bar dpal ldan 'byug pa zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal khyodan nas rang dbang rang btsan rgyal khab dbu brnyes sa pa'i 'i rgyus dang / dus rabs bcu bdun pa 1651nas dus rabs nyi dzes pa 1906bar bstan pa bar dar sde srid khri rabs kyi lo rgyus dang / spyi lo 1907nas bstan pa phyis dar rgyal rabs kyi lo rgyus te rtsa ba'i sa bcad don tshan lnga ru bkod de bre dgos par mthong nas de ltar bkod pa la/dang po gna' dus kyi lo rgyus ni/ ༄༄ / / sngon rgya gang rgyal po mya ngan med kyi skabs bod du'ang 'bri ming gnyug rum mchod rten dang snyo bral hu'ang mya ngan med kyi mchodad rten bzhengs yod pa dang cha mtshungs par/ dus rabs bdun pa'i nang bod kyi rgyal po se nga btsan sgam po'i skabs rdzongs 'dir yang spa spor skyer chu'i lha lang dang bum thang chodas 'khor du byams/ pa lha khang dang stang a nu lha lang dang chu smad du dge gnas lha khang ba'engs pa sogs dkon mche ga gsum gyi snang ba byung 'dug de nas dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang rgya gar ser kyi'i rgyal po srin dha rā dza'i sras bar pa kun 'joms yab dang dmag rgyab ste pham nas sin lha'i yul du spyugs/ der rgyal po sna bo che dang dmag rgyab ste pham nas bros te sdod gnas 'tshol te rbesgongs nas thum thang du slobs te lcags 3

kyi mkhar brtsigs te bsdad nas lcags mkhar rgyal nge zhes grags pa de ni rgya gar du sdod gnas gzhan gyis phyogs te 'dir kyibs bcol ba'i tshul du cadangs pa zhig yin/de dang dus mtshungs su rgyal po khyi la ra thod kyang rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis bod nas yul phud de sdod gnas 'tshol te 'ongs pa yin/ rgyal po srin lha rā dzas gdan dungs te gu ru padma 'byung gnas byon te che sa gsungs pa nas chodas dar ba'i 'go btsugs 'dug dus rabs dgu pa'i nang bdud blon gyi g.yod 'phrul gyis lha sras gtsang ma bod nas bton btang ste rdzongs 'dir byon nas rgyal phran mang du mched 'dug de dang dus mtshungs lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje'i sprun rdo rje mched dug bod nas bros te byon nas bum thang sku gas su gdung che sa rje byung 'dug pa rnams gna' snga ma'i lo rgyus yin no/ /bstan pa snga dar gyi lo rgyus ni/rsā༅༅ / / de nas dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang mar pa bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa dar kyāgo btsugs 'dug dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i nang nas bla ma lha pa'i bstan pa dar 'dug de nas mi ring bar rgyal ba 'o/ ras pa las smad 'byug grub thob spyil dkar ba las stod 'byug pha jo 'byug sgom zhig po las bar 'byug ste ceras rje dpal ldan 'grag pa'i bstan pa dar 'dug dus rabs bcu gasrasam pa'i nang gnas rnying ma'i bstan pa dar 'dug de nas rim pas rnying ma sa kyi sogs kyi bla ma rnams gyon te chodas gyi bstan pa mang du dar to/ / dus rabs bcu bdun pa spyi lo 1616bar sde srid dang rgyal po med pa bla dpon 'brel mas dbang ba bstan pa snga dar yin no/ /de nas dus rabs bcu bdun pa spyi lo 1616la 'jig rtene dbang phyug mi'i 4

gzugs su gyon pa che sa kyi rgyal po zhabs grang ngag dbang rnam rgyal rdzongs 'dir byon te phrin las rgyas skabs/ phyo nas 〈snad dmag thengs lnga dug tsam/ nang nas bla ma lag lngas yang dang yang du/ gsang ba dngos med lha srin sde brgyad kyis rta mgor brag thug ral zhing brdibs pa sku gas phyi nang gsang ba'i dgra'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bas na/ dpal ldan 'grag pa khyedags las rnam rgyal/ zhes rang dbang rang btsan ming don mthun pa'i rgyal khab dbu brnyes pa'i lo rgyus yin no/ /dus rabs bcu bdun pa 165nyanas dus rabs nyi dza/ pa 1906gi bar sde srid kyi khri rabs gyon tshul rnams ni nang 'khrugs rgyun ma chad pa'i ngang nas cerdzos srid lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa bar dar gyi lo rgyus yin la/ spu 'o/ 1907 nas brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po'i khri rabs byon tshul dang lugs gnyis kyi chab srid spyong tshul bstan pa phyos dang gyi lo rgyus rnams rim pas dgod par bya ba la/ rdzongs 'di'i nub phyogs khrod thim spar gsum gyi bongs su dus rabs bcu gnyis bcu gsum pa'i nang bla ma lha pa dang gnas rnying pa yis gdan sa mang po btab ste bla dpon 'brel mar bzhugs 'dug kyang / de gnyis gyi skor nas phyogs 'dir yig cha spro/ga ral tsam yang mi 'dug cing / 'on kyang mnga' bdag rin po che'i bka' drin las phyo rgyal du baspyod skabs pha ran si nas/ gnas rnying pa'i skyes thu dam pa'i gdung rabs bod kyi spar ma khungs dag dang / lha pa'i gdung rabs ying lan nas thungs dag rnyed cing / gzhan yang lo mang po'i bar yig cha rnams 'bad rtsol chen pos btsal te shar phyogs dang / ku re lung / thum thang 'ongs kyi rgyal po srin dha rā dza khyi la ra thod lha sras gtsang ma u ra gdu nga gi lo rgyus skor sogs bshad yam 'ol spyi tsam du 5

ma bzhag par nan tan chen rnge sa brtags dpyad kyis 'e1 rgyus gang nas gsal ba'i khungs rnams rnam thar yig cha de rnams 'dzom dka' bas de dang de'i mtshan 31ga grangs yig phreng rnams bkod de tshig ngo ma bshus te bris yod la/ de yang gzhung nas bong ba gser gzigs kyis 'di lta bu'i las 'gan shin hu 'khos dman pa bdag la bka' phebs pa na/ bka' gyen du ldog ma nus par rtsodam sgrig byed pa'i skabs/ da sngar rgyal khab 'dir snge na chad rgyal rabs kyi gzhi rten tshad thub pa zhig med pa dang rang nyid skyes sbyangs kyi shes yon dbul bar brten/ rnam thar sogs yig cha mang po la zhib 'jug byas pa'i lo rgyus rnyed pa rnams yig cha de dang de la phar la 'phangs pa'i lugasamin par/ yig tsherags la ma 'dzems par yid ches kyi dgang por lung tshur dungs pa'i lugs byas te bris don de yin no/ /deb 'di rgyal rabs yin pas bstan pa snga dar chesnas lugs serdzo skusna'i bla ma byon tshul dang mdzad rnam mdor bsdus re ma gtogs che sa 'byung paṇa chen bstan 'dzin chodas rgyal dang mkhas dbang dge 'dun rin chen gyis mdzad pa logs su yod pas 'dir bshad med do/spyor 'byug rgyal khab gī ཿtshes srid lugs gnyis bstan pa dang / 'bangs mi ser la sde srid khri rabs dang brgyud 'dzin rgyal rabs gnyis khyad par chen po mthong /sde srid khri rabs skabs spyi lo 1780 nas 1849'i bar la sprungs rdzong mes 'jig sbrengs lnga byung 'dug bsod nams dga' tshal par khang mes 'jig ba ling rin chen lang bzang mes 'jig thim rdzong mes 'jig gsum/ dbang rdzong mes 'jigarin snyungs rdzong mes 'jig sum thang bya dkar rdzong mes 'jig sngon dus mi ser 6

ma bzhag par nan tan chen rnge sa brtags dpyad kyis 'e1 rgyus gang nas gsal ba'i khungs rnams rnam thar yig cha de rnams 'dzom dka' bas de dang de'i mtshan 31ga grangs yig phreng rnams bkod de tshig ngo ma bshus te bris yod la/ de yang gzhung nas bong ba gser gzigs kyis 'di lta bu'i las 'gan shin hu 'khos dman pa bdag la bka' phebs pa na/ bka' gyen du ldog ma nus par rtsodam sgrig byed pa'i skabs/ da sngar rgyal khab 'dir snge na chad rgyal rabs kyi gzhi rten tshad thub pa zhig med pa dang rang nyid skyes sbyangs kyi shes yon dbul bar brten/ rnam thar sogs yig cha mang po la zhib 'jug byas pa'i lo rgyus rnyed pa rnams yig cha de dang de la phar la 'phangs pa'i lugasamin par/ yig tsherags la ma 'dzems par yid ches kyi dgang por lung tshur dungs pa'i lugs byas te bris don de yin no/ /deb 'di rgyal rabs yin pas bstan pa snga dar chesnas lugs serdzo skusna'i bla ma byon tshul dang mdzad rnam mdor bsdus re ma gtogs che sa 'byung paṇa chen bstan 'dzin chodas rgyal dang mkhas dbang dge 'dun rin chen gyis mdzad pa logs su yod pas 'dir bshad med do/spyor 'byug rgyal khab gī ཿtshes srid lugs gnyis bstan pa dang / 'bangs mi ser la sde srid khri rabs dang brgyud 'dzin rgyal rabs gnyis khyad par chen po mthong /sde srid khri rabs skabs spyi lo 1780 nas 1849'i bar la sprungs rdzong mes 'jig sbrengs lnga byung 'dug bsod nams dga' tshal par khang mes 'jig ba ling rin chen lang bzang mes 'jig thim rdzong mes 'jig gsum/ dbang rdzong mes 'jigarin snyungs rdzong mes 'jig sum thang bya dkar rdzong mes 'jig sngon dus mi ser 6

rnams rang bzhin gyis khral lci ba'i thog dmag khrugasarimang bas rgyu sgungs gnyis thad nas brdab gsig che ba smos ma dgos/ des na bstan pa snga dar dang bar dar gyi nang rten sku gsung thugs rten 'gang chen rnams dang / yig cha rnams kyang tshang ma 'jig cing brlag ste mi 'dug go/brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po bskos pa nas bzung gdan sa chen po'i rdzong gzhis rnams kyang nyams chag gang yang ma byung ba dang / 'bangs mi ser rnams kyang sngon gyi khral las rgyal po re re bzhin gyi sku thog la phab chag gnang ste yang ba dang / dmag 'khrug gi yo lang gang yang med pas bag phebs bde skyad dang ldan par gnas pa 'di lags so/ / zhes pa'ang rang rdzongs kyi blo gsal yongs la phan du re bas ba rdzod bya sgro skur dang bral bar rjod byed go bde ba'i tshig gis klongs rtul padma tshe dbang pas bsdus don sngon brjod kyi tshul du bris pa dpal ldan 'byug pa'i chodas srid lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa mi nyams par srid mtha'i bar du brtan pa'i rgyur gyur cig / padma cho dbang /7

tsa ba'i sa bcad lnga las/ dang po gna' dus kyi 'o/ rgyus bshad pa la /kyibs gnas dam pa la ma2de par brjod pa dang gleng gzhi/༄7 / / bskal bzang rnam 'dren stong tsa gzhan rnams las/ / lnga bdo'i gdul byar lhag par thugs brtse bas/ / zhing rdul grangs mnyam sprul pa'i rnam rol gyis/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad thub dbang zhabs la 'dud/ / mgon khyod slar yang sin rnyu'i chu gter klong / / dpal gyi mgul nas lung bstan ji bzhin du/ / 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i ston pa ru/ / padma las 'khrungs rgyal ba'i dbang por 'dud/ / gang gi sgyu 'phrul dwa ba'i zlos gar ni/ / gzhan du bsgyu ri ba 'phags yul mchetsheg gzigs gnyis/ / gangs rdzongs mar mi dwags las legs brgyud pa'i/ / dpal ldan 'byug pa ye shes rdo rjer 'dud/ / mgon de'i ring lugs gnam gyi skar ma dang / /sa yi dreg pa gdan rabs brgyad pa yi/ / bstan 'dzin spyi dang gdung dang che sa nga sa nga ga sabatsu/da kya/ / cha ba gnyas ldan bla ma rnams la 'dud/ / lhag par thabs mkhas phran las rnam pa bzhis/ /thugs rje'i gdugs dkar khyodan yangs grib bsil du/ /bde spyod dpal la la bzhi'i 'gro ba kun/ / bkod mdzad bdud 'joms rdo rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ / gzhan yang zhing 'dir 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ / lha gnas bka' rnying sa kyi'i bstan 'dzin dang / / sprul pa'i gter bton la sogs ris med kyi/ / 'a〈sna 'dren bla ma rnams la'ang gus phyag 'tshal/ / rgyal kun gsang ga༄/ma ma na tan phrin las ni/ / zhi chags khro bo'i gar gyis rnam rol pa/ / 'jigs mdzad 8

tsa ba'i sa bcad lnga las/ dang po gna' dus kyi 'o/ rgyus bshad pa la /kyibs gnas dam pa la ma2de par brjod pa dang gleng gzhi/༄7 / / bskal bzang rnam 'dren stong tsa gzhan rnams las/ / lnga bdo'i gdul byar lhag par thugs brtse bas/ / zhing rdul grangs mnyam sprul pa'i rnam rol gyis/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad thub dbang zhabs la 'dud/ / mgon khyod slar yang sin rnyu'i chu gter klong / / dpal gyi mgul nas lung bstan ji bzhin du/ / 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i ston pa ru/ / padma las 'khrungs rgyal ba'i dbang por 'dud/ / gang gi sgyu 'phrul dwa ba'i zlos gar ni/ / gzhan du bsgyu ri ba 'phags yul mchetsheg gzigs gnyis/ / gangs rdzongs mar mi dwags las legs brgyud pa'i/ / dpal ldan 'byug pa ye shes rdo rjer 'dud/ / mgon de'i ring lugs gnam gyi skar ma dang / /sa yi dreg pa gdan rabs brgyad pa yi/ / bstan 'dzin spyi dang gdung dang che sa nga sa nga ga sabatsu/da kya/ / cha ba gnyas ldan bla ma rnams la 'dud/ / lhag par thabs mkhas phran las rnam pa bzhis/ /thugs rje'i gdugs dkar khyodan yangs grib bsil du/ /bde spyod dpal la la bzhi'i 'gro ba kun/ / bkod mdzad bdud 'joms rdo rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ / gzhan yang zhing 'dir 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ / lha gnas bka' rnying sa kyi'i bstan 'dzin dang / / sprul pa'i gter bton la sogs ris med kyi/ / 'a〈sna 'dren bla ma rnams la'ang gus phyag 'tshal/ / rgyal kun gsang ga༄/ma ma na tan phrin las ni/ / zhi chags khro bo'i gar gyis rnam rol pa/ / 'jigs mdzad 8

padma badzra 'khor lo sdom/ / che mchodag rdo rje gzhon nu'i tshogs la 'dud/ / bstan dang bstan 'dzin gdul bya'i zhing rnam gsum/ / sgrib bral ye shes spyan gyis rnam kun tu/ / gzigs pa g.yel med thu bzhin spyong mdzad pa/ / lcam dul ma hā kā lad gus pas 'dud/ / khyod rnams kun gyis gzigs pa phyogs lhung gis/ / bzung ba'i min rdzongs la bzhi'i rgyal khab 'di/ / phyogs las rnam rgyal masku na skyabs sngar mdzad bzhin/ / gzod kyang rtag tu mel tshos srung spyob mdzod/ / rdzongs 'dir chos srid lugs gnyis spyong ba po/ /byung ba'i brjod bya tshad thub yig char brten/ /rjod byed mtshadag dman kun gyis go bde bar/ / bri la kun hu dge ba'i shis pa stsol/ /zhes gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi kyibs gnas dam pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes/brtse ba'i snying rje/ nus pa'i mthu stobs dang ldan pa'i dkon mchodag rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams la gus pas ma3snad par brdzod de lam dge bar byas nas gang gleng bar bya ba ni/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi byang shar bod gangs can rdzongs kyi lto phyogs/ sngon gyi dus su mon yul zhes grags pa sangs rgyas kyis dngos su 'dul ba'i dus la ma babs pas brgyud de mi'i gzugs dang dud 'gro'i gzugs gang la gang 'dul gyi gzugs kyis thar pa'i sa bon btab par mdzad de/ ji zhig na sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyi zlos gar tshib pa dang / rig 'dzin/ byang sem sa dge ba'i bshes gnyen cir yang bsgyur te/ de yang thog mar dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang sangs rgya sho gnyis pa padma 'khu/nga gnas snga phyi bar gaX/ma du byedan/ sa gnas thams cad zhabs kyis bcags/ byin gyis brlabs cesas gsungs te sangs rgyas gī bstan pa dar ba nas rim gyis chetshes lugs mang po dar na yang / ceras lugs gcig gis 9

phyogs thams cad yug gcig hu dar ba byung mi 'dug /dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i nang stod 'byug smada'agrag bar 'byug gi bstan —pa dar 'go btsugs pa nas/ dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang gu ru padma 'byung gnas kyis lung bstan pa bzhin zhabs grang ngag dbang rnam rgyal la lha mo na la bzhi dpal ye shes mgo na pos ceras gzhis su phrul ba las/ zhabs grang ngag dbang rnam rgyal rdzongs 'dir byon pa na phrin las kyi sdong spogs dpal ma hā kā la bka' sdod rnams kyis mdzad de mnyam med che sa rje dpal ldan 'byug pa'i bstan pa rdzongs 'dir phyogs kun hu dar zhing rgyas pa'i skabs bod nas gtsang sde srid yab sras kyis dmag thengs gsum/ dge se ga gi dmag bzhi lnga tsam casgongs kyang rgol bas brdzis ma nus pas rang dbang rang btsan gyi rgyal khab dbu brnyes te cerdzos srid da nga rgyal srid thung 'brel dpal ldan 'byug pa'i rgyal khab byung ba yin la/ de lta thu'i rgyal khab 'di na mchis pa'i mi'i 'gro ba rnams la ni/ dam pa'i lha chodas dang mthun pa'i che sa khrims dar gyi mdud si dang / 'jig rten skye lha'i lugs dang mthun pa'i rgyal khrims gse ra gyi gnya' shing gis mnan te gnas skabs mngon mtho la mi'i go 'phang 8)dang / mthar thug trechos par legs pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'gode pa'i lugs gnyis bzang po'i bka' khrims srol btod par mdzad cing / khrims lugs bzang po de yis mnga' 'bangs rnams byams brtses bskyangs par mdzad pa'i sde srid kyi rabs ji ltar gyon pa'i tshul dang / dbang dang stobs shugs su ches sde srid kyi khrir hab thob rgyab ste nang 'grigs rgyun ma chad par mi ser rnams za bcud nyal gnyid bral bar brdab gsig btang ste bde spyod gtan nas med par brten/ mkhan slob 10

'dus sde dpon lag 'bangs mi ser yongs kyis 'gyur med mtha' btsan gyi gan rgya thul te brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po khri mnga' gsol ba nas brgyud 'dzin rgyal po byung ba yin la de ltarathog ma so srid khri rabs dang de nas brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po / — da da / — — ji ltar gyon pa'i rgyal rabs bri bar bya ba la/ de yang lo rgyus spyir btang bshad 'gros dang bstun te brten pa nang bcud kyi skye 'gro'i lo rgyus brjod pa la/ de nyid rten sa thog mar rten phyi snod kyi 'jig rten chags tshul rags tsam bsgo par bya'o/ /11

'dus sde dpon lag 'bangs mi ser yongs kyis 'gyur med mtha' btsan gyi gan rgya thul te brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po khri mnga' gsol ba nas brgyud 'dzin rgyal po byung ba yin la de ltarathog ma so srid khri rabs dang de nas brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po / — da da / — — ji ltar gyon pa'i rgyal rabs bri bar bya ba la/ de yang lo rgyus spyir btang bshad 'gros dang bstun te brten pa nang bcud kyi skye 'gro'i lo rgyus brjod pa la/ de nyid rten sa thog mar rten phyi snod kyi 'jig rten chags tshul rags tsam bsgo par bya'o/ /11

rten phyo sgod stong gsum 'jig rten chags tshul dang brten pa nang bcud kyi sems can 65ga'/ 'gro'//༄༄ / / mdo sdud pa las/ mkha' la rlung brten de la chu yi phung po brten/ / de la sa chen 'di brten de la 'gro ba brten/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'jig rten snga ma me bdun chu gcig gis 'jig ste stong pa'i nam mkha' yug gnyig hu gnas pa la thog mar 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor chags/ de'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho chen po chags/ rgya mtsho de srub byed kyi rlung gis bsrubs pa las mtsho'i khar dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi chags/ de'i steng du stong gsum 'jig rten gyi lams chags pa yin/ de yang dang po dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab dbyibs tshi bzhi pa bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa rgyu rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa bang rim gnyis mtsho'i nang du nub pa dang / bang rim gnyis phyir thon pa bcas chags/ bang rim gyi phyo nas rol pa'i mtsho bdun dang / gser gyi ri bdun rnams spel mar chags pa yin/gser ri mtha' ma mu 'khyud 'dzin gyi phyo nas mtha' yas pa'i rgya mtsho chen pode chags so/ / de'i phyo nas lcags ri rdo sol las grub pa rta gdong rgod ma'i me 'bar ba de chags/ ba tsha can gyi rgya mtsho'i khar ri rab kyi phyogs bzhir shar du lus 'phags po'i gling dang / g.yas gasku na du lus dang / lus 'phags gling phran gnyis chags/ ltor 'dzam thu'i gling dang / g.yas g.yon du/ rnga yab dang / rnga yab gzhan gling phran gnyis chags/ nub hu ba glang spyod kyi gling dang / g.yas 12

g.yon du/ g.ye ldan dang / lam mche ga 'gro gling phran gnyis chags/ byung du sgra mi snyan gyi gling dang / g.yas g.yon du / sgra mi snyan dang / sgra mi snyan gyi zla gling phran gnyis te/ gling chen bzhi dang / gling phran brgyad chags/ de ltar gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ gser ri bdun rol mcho bdun/ nyi zla gza' skar/ ri rab lhun po 'dod lha ris drug tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bsam gtan dang po bcas stong tshang ba'i 'i nas lcags ri gcig gis bskor ba la stong dang po spyi phud kyi 'jig rten zer/de nyid stong tshang ba'i phyo nas lcags ri gnyis pas bskor ba la stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten zer/ de nyid stong tshang ba'i phyo nas lcags ri gsum pas bskor ba la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya ba yin no/ / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i gajig rten gyi khams de la/ gling bzhi nyi zla ri rab lhun po 'dod lha ris drug tshangs pa'i gnas bcas bye ba phrag brgya ye da par gsungs se / /de rnams phyi snod kyi 'jig rten chags tshul yin no/ / 'jig rten zer ba snod mi rtag pas 'jig pa'i rang bzhin bcud sems can rnams gnas pa'i rten du gyur pas na 'jig rten zhes bya ba yin no/ /brten pa nang bcud kyi sems can chags tshul/ bskal pa snga ma'i phyo snyed stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi lams de nyid/ mthar bsam gtan dang po man chad me yis 'jig bsam gtan gnyis pa man chad chu yis 'jig bsam gtan gsum pa man chad rlung gis gte ra te 'jig pa'i tshe/ nang bcud kyi sems can rnams bsam gtan bzhi par skyes te yod pa las/ slar snod kyi 'jig rten mas nas yar chags zin pa'i tshe/ bcud kyi sems can rnams yas nas mar gnas 13

pa yin te/ bsam gtan bzhi pa las mar gas/ma pa mched/ gasnge/ma pa las gnyis pa sku gas rten nam mkhar gnas pa'i lha rnams rim par mched de chags/ de nas sa gzhi la brten pa'i lha ni ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi steng du sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha dang / bang rim bzhi pa'i steng dang nyi zla gza' skar gser ri rnams su rgyal chen ris bzhi'i lha rnams chags/ de nas bsam gtan dang po las mched de 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi dang / snge/ma cu tsa gasnge/ma las mched de gling gsum du mi rnams chags sku(/ / shar gling gi mi rnams lus bdun 'ashu/ra gyis che bas lus 'phags po zhes bya ba dang / lto gling gi byung ngos su shing dzaskru brika'i yod pas gling gi ming la 'dzam bu gling / de la gnas pa'i mi rnams tshe lus longs skyed gī gdags gzhi khyad par gyi chodas med pas 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi zhes pa dang / nub gling gi mi rnams 'dod 'jo'i ba la longs spyod pas ba lang spyod dang / byang gling gi mi rnams tshe tshad lo stong thub pa yin yang 'chi ba'i zhag bdun gyi sngon nas khyod 'chi'o zhes pa'i sgra cos pas sgra mi snyan zhes bya'o/ / 14

stong gsum 'jig rten de'i bye brag 'dzam bu'i gling gi gnaza/ byuni04/༄༄ / / stong gsum 'jig rten de'i nang nas 'dzam thu'i gling ni bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong byon pa'i gnas yin zhing bzo dbyibs sog la lta thu/ ngos tshogasum la dpag tshad stong phrag gnyis gnyis dang snyo ngos la phyed dang bzhi yod par gsungs/ dbus su ma/ snya dha rdo rje gdan byang chub shing gis mtshan pa der bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong las bla'or ba 'jig dang / gser thub dang / 'od srung dang / ro/kya thub pa bzhi gzhan yang sangs rgyas sterdzong gi gras mi tshe ba sangs rgyas rnam gzigs/ btsug rtasnar can/ thams cad spyoXb ga༄/ma dang bcas sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyon zin cing / byams pa la se gas pa dgu brgya go dug phyis su 'gyon par 'gyur zhang 'tshang rgya ba'i gnas yin/ gling gzhan du sangs rgyas mi khyodan par 'dzam bu'i gling du byen pa'i rgyu mtshan yang 'dzam bu'i gling 'di'i mi rnams tshe thung ba dang /nad mang ba dang / longs spyad chung bas spyo shas skye ba dang / tshe stod du rgyu las dge ba bsags na tshe smad du 'bras thu bde ba smin pa dang / tshe stod du rgyu sdig pa mi dge ba bsags na tshe smad du 'bras bu sdug bsngal sprin te myong ba se gas dge sdig 'bras bu mngon sum mthong ཿtshes su smin pas 'dzam gling las kyi sa pa zhes bya zhing sangs rgyas gyon che sa ston pa na yid ches te 'bor ba la spyo shas dang nges 'byung skyes nas chodas sgrub pas sangs rgyas rnams gyon pa yin zhing / gling gzhan du tsho ring ba dang dpal 'byor longs spyed lha/ga par che zhing spyo shas chung bas don du mi 'gyur bas na 15

sangs rgyas rnams mi 'byon pa yin no/ /gling de'i shar phyogs su rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga dang / snyo phyogs su ston pa shākya thub pas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang bde mchog la sogs pa bla med kyi rgyud gsungs pa'i gnas dpal ldan 'bras spungs dang / nub phyogs su ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po ind+ra bo dhe 'khor bcas la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud sasungs te 'khor chom thu 'bum phrag bcas rig 'dzin gyi sar bkod pa'i ma rgyan dā ma tha la mkha' 'gro'i gling dang / byang phyogs su dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa gsang sngags bla med kyi smin grol gyi che sa kyi 'khor lo rtag khyab rgyun du bskor ba'i rigs ldan sprul pa'i che sa rgyal5 rnams bzhugs pa'i gnas sham bha la la serdzogs pa'i gnas khyad par can gyis gling gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa yin no/ /'dzam bu'i gling zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gling 'di'i byang phyogs su mcho chen po ma dros pa yod la/ mcho de'i g.yas su shing gnam 'phang dang rgya yangs pa ro mngar dang ldan pa'i 'bras thu yin pa de mtshor lhung ba'i sgu 'dzam bu zhes pa dang / 'bras bu de chu'i kyen gyis gser du 'ashu/ra pa gser gzhan zhu btul lan bcu dug byas pa lta bu'i la dog dang 'od yod pa'i 'dzam bu chu gser zhes bya ba 'byung ba'i brikaṣa'i shing gis brgyan pas na 'dzam thu dang / mtsho'i dbus na sa'i phyogs zhib ma bkram pa lta thu bar stong skam po yar 'phags te yod pa la gling zhes byu ba mi sogs sems can rnams gnas shing chags pa'i rten du gyur pa de la 'dzam bu'i gling zhes bya ba yin no/ /16

'dzam thu'i gling gi cha shas su gte gas pa'i tsan dan bkod pa'i yul rdzongs/༄༄ / / 'di ltar bskal ba bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong las rnam 'dren bzhi pa yan gyis mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan cing lnga pa man gyis rim bzhin sde na par 'khru/ra ba'i rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi byang shar phyogs su tsan dan bkod pa'i yul khyodangs 'di nyid dus nam chags pa yin nam snyam na/ rgya gar dang dus mnyam chags pa yin la/ bod dang 'du ba sngon mcho chags pa bskams te sa la'i nags se gas byung ba'i 'o/ rgyus gang du'ang med do/ / rgya gar dang dus mnyam par rdo rje gdan gyi byang shar rgya gar a sam gyi yul phyogs dang ha cang thags mi ring ba na sa 'dzin shin hu mtho ba nags tshal 'thug po 'khrigs pa jo bo dur shing zer ba'i yul lha chen po gnas pa'i ri bo dang / shar phyogs dwags po dang thag nye ba na ri bo shin hu brjid cing mtho ba jo mo re ma ti gnas pa'i sa phyogs de nas ba men zhes pa rgya bod na med pa'i 'dod 'jo'i ba rgya tsham dang rgya tsha zhes pa'i ba glang rigs 'gran zla dang bral ba 'byung ba'i ri lung dang / byang phyogs su snyo rong dang bod kyi sa mtshams su mi rgod dang gcan gzan gtum po rgyu ba'i nags tshal dang brag ri bgrod dka' ba'i gnas dge bsnyen zo ra ra skyes gnas pa'i mkhan pa rdzongs dang / des srung ba'i yul rdzongs ku re lung dang / ri bo shin tu mtho ba brjid cing lhun chags pa lha 'dre'i thu so skyes bu rlung btsan gnas pa'i sa 'dzin (bum thang ) dang / gzhan yang de dang tshul mthun pa thugs btsan gnas pa'i ri bo (mang sde ) dang / nub phyogs 17

su dge bsten chen po jag pa me len zhes btsan rgod chen po gnas pa'i ri bo nags tshal mthug po dang brag ri spyi zing ba'i gnas bde chen phyag ( thim yul ) dang / thang dkar byi snying gan sa pa'i ri bo dar dkar la zhes pa ri 'go bod du gtad cing ri mjug rgya thang du thug pa dang / lha btsan gnas pa'i ri g.ya' ri rtse mo dgung la bsnyegs pa shin hu brjid cing lhun chags pa brag skyed dang gdong dkar la zhes pa ( spra gro ) dang btsan rgod chen po khyung bdud gnas pa'i sa 'dzin mthon po dang has kyi yul rdzongs sogs gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre thu bo che sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma 'byung gnas kyi bka' dang dam la gnas pa'i dkar phyogs spyong ba'i dge bsnyen rnams gnas pa'i ri bo dang / ri bran shar lto nub byang gi phyogs thams cad du grangs kyis mi chode pa dang / mon la dkar thung gi gangs ri gcig nas babs pa'i chu bo sprun gsum ku ri chu bo dang / lcam mkhar chu bo dang / mang sde chu bo dang /gzhan yang thed thim spa khro'i yul rdzongs su dal gyis babs pa'i chu so sogs yul rdzongs re rer babs pa'i chu klung dang / tsha grang bad gan se gas nad rigs 'joms pa'i tsha chu dang / chu bran rnams ha cang tsha ba dang grang ba ma yin par bsil ba'i reg bya dang ldan pa babs pa dang / rna ba dang / dgo ba dang / 'brong dang / gim rtse/gla ba sku/gas ri dwags rnams dang / btsan dug zas su/ za ba'i 'dab chags bya mdangs dang / ri skogs skusnags bag phebs par gnas pa'i g.ya' ri dang / rdza ri rnams dang / yang tsal shin tu che ba'i spu dang sprel rnams gnas pa'i brag ri g.yang sa chen po dang / khwa ta dang sreg ma la se gas pa'i bya'i rigs rnams dang / ri skog dang / khu byug dang / 'jol mo dang / ka lan ta ka la sogs pa'i byi'u skad snyan cing yid du cadang ba rnams gnas pa'i shing gi rigs tsan dan dang / shug pa 18

su dge bsten chen po jag pa me len zhes btsan rgod chen po gnas pa'i ri bo nags tshal mthug po dang brag ri spyi zing ba'i gnas bde chen phyag ( thim yul ) dang / thang dkar byi snying gan sa pa'i ri bo dar dkar la zhes pa ri 'go bod du gtad cing ri mjug rgya thang du thug pa dang / lha btsan gnas pa'i ri g.ya' ri rtse mo dgung la bsnyegs pa shin hu brjid cing lhun chags pa brag skyed dang gdong dkar la zhes pa ( spra gro ) dang btsan rgod chen po khyung bdud gnas pa'i sa 'dzin mthon po dang has kyi yul rdzongs sogs gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre thu bo che sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma 'byung gnas kyi bka' dang dam la gnas pa'i dkar phyogs spyong ba'i dge bsnyen rnams gnas pa'i ri bo dang / ri bran shar lto nub byang gi phyogs thams cad du grangs kyis mi chode pa dang / mon la dkar thung gi gangs ri gcig nas babs pa'i chu bo sprun gsum ku ri chu bo dang / lcam mkhar chu bo dang / mang sde chu bo dang /gzhan yang thed thim spa khro'i yul rdzongs su dal gyis babs pa'i chu so sogs yul rdzongs re rer babs pa'i chu klung dang / tsha grang bad gan se gas nad rigs 'joms pa'i tsha chu dang / chu bran rnams ha cang tsha ba dang grang ba ma yin par bsil ba'i reg bya dang ldan pa babs pa dang / rna ba dang / dgo ba dang / 'brong dang / gim rtse/gla ba sku/gas ri dwags rnams dang / btsan dug zas su/ za ba'i 'dab chags bya mdangs dang / ri skogs skusnags bag phebs par gnas pa'i g.ya' ri dang / rdza ri rnams dang / yang tsal shin tu che ba'i spu dang sprel rnams gnas pa'i brag ri g.yang sa chen po dang / khwa ta dang sreg ma la se gas pa'i bya'i rigs rnams dang / ri skog dang / khu byug dang / 'jol mo dang / ka lan ta ka la sogs pa'i byi'u skad snyan cing yid du cadang ba rnams gnas pa'i shing gi rigs tsan dan dang / shug pa 18

be nga / stag pa dang / thang shing dang / gdung shing pa sogs pa shing sna tshogs pa'i nags tshal ldan pa'i sgang galha nga rnan sa dang / sa mtho zhing g.ya' ri 'od bde ba rnams su mtsho dang / mtsho 0co rnams g.yu 'i mnge ga lta thu dang / stag dang / gzig dang / ce ma la sku gas pa'i gcan gzan gnas pa'i nags 'thug nge dang / gzhan yang sha ba dang / ka sha dang / phag rgod so gas bde bar rgyu zhing gnas pa'i ri klung spang rdzongs nyams dga' ba rnams dang / bza' ba'i rigs nas bro gya red bra'u rnams dang / bca' ba'i rigs rli kham bu la phyag nyung ma ke ba sku1gas 'chaba'i sa la mtho ba bsil ba'i sa dang / bza' ba'i rigs 'bras dang khre dang phyis shom sogs 'gra sna dgu skye ba dang / bca' ba'i rigs ca ba sdong thu lo ma me tog 'bras thu'i rigs thams cad skye ba dang / a mar rnam gsamim/ 'bras thu rnam gsum/ rā sha rnam gsum sku gas sman gyi rigs gang yang skye ba'i la dang 'a ba dro ba'i sa dang / ri glang dang / bse ru dang / glang po che dang / dus sgru la ngu mas gnas pa'i seng ldeng dang a mra la sogs pa shing sna chogs pa'i nags klung chen po dang spyug ma dang chu shing 'od ma'i tshal nyam dga' ba gnas serdzo// / ji 〉 da du/ lang sa zhing sa sa yi dge / lang shing bud shing shing gi dge / 'thung chu zhing chu chu yi dge / khang rdo 'thag rdo rdo yi dge / gam 'brog rgyang 'drog rtswa yi dge / zhes/ yul la dge bcu 'drong ba 63gas/ 31/ / 19

de na gnas pa'i mi'i 'gro ba sngon gyi dus su smadan pa yin pa/༄༄ / / tsan dan bkod pa'i rdzongs 'di rnams su 'bod pa'i 'khro sto mi'i rigs ni/ bod las ches the ga mar rgya gar gyi mi rigs chags pa snga bas na phal cher gyi sems la rgya gar nas mched pa yin par 'ded kyang rgya gar gyi 5/la 'di nas/ mi'i rigs 'di mched pa yin zer ba ni sus kyang mi shes pas rgya gar gyi rigs yin par mi 'do do/ / nges pa'i don du yul rdzongs 'di byang thang spya mo min pa dang /rdza rong min pa dang / bye ma'i gling yang dzo pu yin pad bsi la dred rdi na zhing 'byu sna dgu po 'tsho ba'i sa yi na pas na/ chu yo da na nya rang bzhin gyis byung ba bzhin sngon bska wa pa bzang therdzo/ 'di chags nas rim pas mi'i 'gre rdzob rnams chags pa'i tshe/yul dbus su chags nga/ dang / de ma yin pa'i gzha sa su chags pa/ ste (su 'i na da)zhes nga/ na tha' 'khob ste yu la ska da la pon pa 'es bya ba sngo ga gyi dus nas yul dbus kyi mi zha ma sa dang dus mnyam/ nga/ra chags pa ye na yang / ngu la dbus su sangs rgyas kyi bsta na pa dar ba dang / mtha' smyod lob tu bstan pa/ ma dad ba ngang / yul dbus su bzo rig bco brgyad se gas bslab pa'i gan sa sku da pa dang / mtha' 'khob hu de med pa se gas kyi/ khyad par las/ 'jig rten na sku ngas su grags pa dang ldan pa'i rgyu'am skye dan tang gyi rme/nge na gsal cang med pa'i rgyu ma tshan gyis/ mon pa rnams dus/ rabs mu nga po'i bar du nags gseb kyi mi bzhin lus pa yin par gor myo5 chags la/ sngon bska wa ri pa zang sore dus 'dzan bu'i gling mi yis gang ste grong dang spong khyer gyi khyim 20

rnams byu gag 'thur ba'i bar thags tsam gyis chod de yod par gsungs pas kyang shes nus so/ / bce ma ldan 'das zhugs pa'i tshe 'dul ba sku(gas las ri brag pa rnams zhis gsungs pa yang / yul dbus su sa yangs shing rgya che ba dang / bod sloms pas la lung dang ri brag chen po med pa dang / yul gyi mtha' mar la lung dang ri brag g.yang sa yode pa rnams la ri brag pa zhes grags/ ri brag pa'i ༷/la las kyang mtha' mar rda/ra pa nags gseb kyi mi rnams gnas pa'i mtha' 'acerdzob kyi yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dam pa'i chodas kyi sgron me nyi ma lta thu de med pa dang /bzo rig bco brgyad sogs shes bya rig pa'i gnas kyi sgron me med par blang dor gyi yul snang grib pa la mun pa zhes dang / mun par gnas pa'i gang zag rnams la 3snan pa zhis pa ni/ dper na/ bdun cu tham pa/ bdun gcig bdun gnyis/ zer dgos rgyu la/ don gcig don gnyis sogs zer ba bzhin / mu na pa la mon pa zhes ming du chags par snang zhing rje 'bangs kyi rnam dbye med par mngon gsal ha cang chung bar dus rabs mang po'i bar du gnas pa zhig yin yang / thog ma'i dus kyi mi rigs de nyid dus kyi dbang gis sangs/ rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / bzo rigs sogs shes bya rig pa'i gnas kyi sgron me/'i 'od snang dang ldan par gyur pa deng gi dus 'dzam bu'i gling na mngon gsal can du gyur pa lags so/ / 4 nga yul rdzongs 'di'i thog ma'i mi rigs bod nas mched par 'dod pa yod na de yang mi 'thad de/ston pa'i 'das lo 100song nas mtsho sri/ de nas sa la'i nags skyes/ de nas rim pas rgod kyi mi rigs chags pa yin pa dang / mon pa'i mi rigs ston pa 'jig rten na ma gyon pa thog ma'i dus nas chags zin pa'i phyir ro/ /21

dkon mchodag gsum gyi thugs rje'i 'od snang chadag mar 'char ba/༄༄ / /de yang rgan rabs kyi lo rgyus gcig la ches thog ma lo stong phrag mang po'i snga rol du rgya gar gyi byang phyogs ri bras pa'am mtha' 'khob mon gyi yul rdzongs 'dir thed gzhung du rgyu ba'i gtsang po gangs rin chen mdzod nas babs pa'i pho chu brgyud de 'gro ba'i sa na brag ri chen po gnam du gzengs pa rong dog cing g.yang sa shin du nyam nga ba'i sa de na/ shing sna tshogs pa'i nags tshal snyug po 'khregs shing stag gzis dang gdug sprul la se gas pa gcan gzan mang po rgyu ba/ rtsa ba sde nga thu 'o/ ma me tog 'bras thu bca' ba'i rigs thams cad 'tsho ba bdud ri ha shang zer ba der/ dus rabs ches snga ba sngon gyi dus shig na rgyal thu dri med kun ldan yab kyi bang mdzod nas nor thu dgos 'dod dasung 'joms gzhan la byin pa gnang ba'i kyen las/ lcam dang sras sras smad bcas pa yul thud de spyugs pas byang chub kyi spyod pa spyad de sras dang sras mo phyin pa gnang ba'i gnas dang / gzhan yang rgyal po don grub se gas byang chub sems dpa' rgyal po'i tshul bzung ba rnams kyis byang chub kyi spyad pa spyad de 'gro ba sems can mang po'i don mdzad de sa gnas byin gyis brlabs par yang grags pa dang / der ma zad ston pa rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas te bdun phrag gnyis par snyedang gsum ring du 'chag pa'i skabs dang / bdun phrag bzhi par 'dzam gling nye bar 'chag pa'i skabs gling bzhi'i 'jig rten shar nas nub kyi bar zhab/sa kyis bcags zin pa dang / sngon chodas rgyal mya ngan med kyis 'dzam bu'i gling gi 22

phyogs kun tu mchod rten bye ba bzhengs pa'i skabs bod kha ba can dbu ru byang phyogs su dbur rsā snyug rum gyi mchod rten dang / snyo brag lha lung phyogs su yang mya ngan med kyi mchod rten bzhengs par mdzad pa da lta yang yod pa bzhin du snu sa rgyal srong btsan sgam pos ston pa'i 'das hro 15'a'akhru lo 641 6gas glang lo la lha sar ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i lor rnyo mon spa spo'i rdzongs su skyer chu'i lha khang dang / bum thang chodas 'khor lung par byams pa'i lha khang rnams rdzu 'phrul gyis sprul pa'i bzo bos dus mnyam du bzhengs par mdzad cing / gtsug lag thang de rnams la mchod pa dang / bsnyer bkur byed pa sogs rnam dkar dge ba'i las kyi srol bzang po btsugs par mdzad pas/ mon pa rnams kyis thog mar dkon mchodag gsu ma gyi mtshan the sa pa dang / daskardzon ma cesag gsum la sems dwangs pa dang dad pa bskyed pas thar pa'i sa nyon bskrun cing dkon mchodag gsum gyi thugs rje'i 'od snang gis khyab pas skal pa bzang po dang ldan par gyur to/ /1 grub thob dngos grub kyi gter ma srong btsan ma ṇi bka' 'gyam 23

rgyal po sin dha rā dza sdod gnas 'tshol te gyon nas bum thang lcags mkhar du bzhugs pa'i 'o( rgyus/༄tha / / sman rdzongs 'di'i mi rigs byings rgya ho gang nas kyang ma chad pa gong du bshad pa ltar yin pa dang / dus rabs mang po'i bar rje dpon dang 'bangs kyi tha snyad med par gnas pa la/ rgyal po se 'dar la 'am sin dha rā dza'i lo rgyus ni/ rgya gar gyi spong khyer ser kyi'i rgyal po sing ga la zhes bya ba la sras bdun byung ba'i bar pa kun 'joms zhes bya ba bsad pa dang brdungs pa dang bcom pa la se gas ༵/'i las byed pas/ blon po rnams gros byas te yab rgyal po la zhus pa/ khyod kyi sras kun 'joms 'di dbang stobs che zhing spyad pa rtsub pas rang gzhan med pa sdug la bkod par 'dug pas/ de bas che sa la brdzang pa 'thad do zhus pas rgyal pos kyang gnang ba na/ tā na chen rab snang gis sras kun 'joms la rgyal srid sras gzhan gyis bzung bas cerdzog la khyod ni chesnas byed par rigs so zhis zhus pas/ rgyal thu kun 'joms rang gis las blangs kyang btsun mo dang blon po bcas khros te dmag rgyab nas rang gi blon po'i yul sum cu bcom pas/ yab dang spun zla rnams kyis rgya gar sin lha'i yul du spyugs pas kun 'joms la sin dha rā dzar grags so/ /der yang rgyal po sna bo che dang ma 'chams par g.yul 'thobs pas sin dha rā dza pham nas bros/ blon po brgyad cu tham pa bcas sdod gnas 'tshol te le ngas nas mo/na bum thang snu sa chos 'khor lung pa 'dir slobs te lcags kyi mkhar thog dgu 'a rgyal po sin lha rā dza'i rnam thar bzhi'i rgyab gnyis nas/ 24

brtsegs byas pa brtsigs/ btsun mo lo za kun spyong dang nyi zer ldan sogs brgya phrag dang / blon po kun 'dus/ blon po kun tshe ring / blon po kun byed/ blon po kun rgyal/ blon po kun gnod sogs blon po brgyad cu tham pa bcas lha ru gnod phyin bdud 'dul/ dgra lha rdo rje grags ldan/ gzhi bdag klu bdud chen po spu bdud la la me 'bar/ nor lha dbang phyug chen po bsten nas gsol masnu da byas te mi dge ba'i las la spyod nas mon yul thams cad dbang du bsdus te 'khor 'bangs mnga' thang dgung la reg pa byas nas bzhugs pa na/ btsun mo lo bza' kun spyong la sus stag la me 'bar bya ba stobs tsal che ba zhig 'khrungs/ rgya'i rgyal po sna bo che ca dngas te dmag rgyab pas rgyal thu stag la me 'bar de 'o/ nyi shu 'o/na pa na rgya'i rgyal po sna bo ches bsad do/ / rmermi po sin dha rā dza bu'i sdug tshig zos pas pho lha la gsol mchod ma byas par slar mi gtsang ba'i mnol btsogs byas pas yul de'i steng gi lha cadag gi klu bar gyi lha 'dre thams cad 'khrugs te rgyal po la snang srid lha 'dre'i chad pa byung ste rgyal po'i bla 'phyog rgyal khams la mi bde ba gza' nad dang / thog dang /gnyan dang / khyod 'bogs brgyal nad dang / phyugs la dal yams dang / zhing la sad ser la sogs pa sna chogs byung ngo/ / rgyal po'ang nad drag pos thebs te bcos dpyad mang du byas kyang ma phan shi la nye nas sos thabs ma byung ba dang / blon po 'khor 'bangs rnams bsdus nas sde brgyad kyi gnod pa 'di las grol ba'i thabs shes mi sku da na btsun mo rgyal srid bcas spyin zer bas/ rgyal phran gcig gis gser bre gang len te rgyal po sna so che'i bla ma yang yin/ byol yul yang le 30da brag phug 3 rnam thar grag mdun bzhi nas/ 4 rta mgrin gnam lcags me 'a6snar drug rgyab dug nas/25

brtsegs byas pa brtsigs/ btsun mo lo za kun spyong dang nyi zer ldan sogs brgya phrag dang / blon po kun 'dus/ blon po kun tshe ring / blon po kun byed/ blon po kun rgyal/ blon po kun gnod sogs blon po brgyad cu tham pa bcas lha ru gnod phyin bdud 'dul/ dgra lha rdo rje grags ldan/ gzhi bdag klu bdud chen po spu bdud la la me 'bar/ nor lha dbang phyug chen po bsten nas gsol masnu da byas te mi dge ba'i las la spyod nas mon yul thams cad dbang du bsdus te 'khor 'bangs mnga' thang dgung la reg pa byas nas bzhugs pa na/ btsun mo lo bza' kun spyong la sus stag la me 'bar bya ba stobs tsal che ba zhig 'khrungs/ rgya'i rgyal po sna bo che ca dngas te dmag rgyab pas rgyal thu stag la me 'bar de 'o/ nyi shu 'o/na pa na rgya'i rgyal po sna bo ches bsad do/ / rmermi po sin dha rā dza bu'i sdug tshig zos pas pho lha la gsol mchod ma byas par slar mi gtsang ba'i mnol btsogs byas pas yul de'i steng gi lha cadag gi klu bar gyi lha 'dre thams cad 'khrugs te rgyal po la snang srid lha 'dre'i chad pa byung ste rgyal po'i bla 'phyog rgyal khams la mi bde ba gza' nad dang / thog dang /gnyan dang / khyod 'bogs brgyal nad dang / phyugs la dal yams dang / zhing la sad ser la sogs pa sna chogs byung ngo/ / rgyal po'ang nad drag pos thebs te bcos dpyad mang du byas kyang ma phan shi la nye nas sos thabs ma byung ba dang / blon po 'khor 'bangs rnams bsdus nas sde brgyad kyi gnod pa 'di las grol ba'i thabs shes mi sku da na btsun mo rgyal srid bcas spyin zer bas/ rgyal phran gcig gis gser bre gang len te rgyal po sna so che'i bla ma yang yin/ byol yul yang le 30da brag phug 3 rnam thar grag mdun bzhi nas/ 4 rta mgrin gnam lcags me 'a6snar drug rgyab dug nas/25

thug na o rgyan di/dra 'byung gnas yod de bos na phan zer/ der rkang ma gyogs gcig la gos ser chas dang ceras pa'i lugs su byas nas spyan 'dren par btang /des yang le sprodad kyi brag phyag hu gu ru rin po che dang mjal te lo rgyus zhus pas/skye/ rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyis mon yul du byon par zhal gyis bzhes sku(/ /ma/ rgyan padma 'byung gnas mon yul du dang po bal yul nas rgyal po sin haṃ rā dza'i don du gyon pa'i lo rgyus/rsā༅༅ / / sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma 'byung gnas kyis bal yul yang le sgod nas rgyal po dang yon gyi gdul bya dus la babs par mkhyen nas spyi lo 746la mon sum thang du byon pa'i lam du bdud dang lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams btul/ rdo pha bong la phyag mtshan thur pa mtho gang re tsam thug pa'i rjes deng sang mngon sum mjal rgyu yod sa der/ sngon phyar thug mon yin par snang ste deng sang ming la (phrum zur mon )zhes par grags/ brag g.yang gzar pe 'i sked pa nas rdzu 'phrul gyis lam bte na par mdzad pa la da lta yang skyersha rgyan brag ces zhabs rjes dngos su mjal rgyu yod pa se gas lha 'dre rnams btul bzhin byon te sum thang lcags mkhar du phebs/ skyod rgyan gyis rgyal po'i sngas su byon pa dang / rgya'i pos nga sos nas lta 'dre'i chad pa 'di bzlog na ci gsungs sgrub cing ci mnyes phul zer/ mardzo rgyan gyis nga la 'thul ba ci yang mi dgos/ khyod kyi yul 'dir sdig pa'i las sgongs/ dge ba'i las la 'bad/ nga'i dzi rta mgrin gnam lcags me 'alo ra bdun gnyis nas/26

bstan pa la 'jug par las 'o /ngas dang phan pa'i thabs sku da gsungs/ rgyal 'bangs go/la mi rnams kyis ci gas/ngas sgrub par las blangs pas/ skyong rgyan padma 'byung gnas thugs dgyes/ te btsun mo nyi zer ldan gyi bu mo 'thum ldan mcho mo bya ba mkha' 'aX 'i mtshan rtags nyi dza/ tsa gnyig ldan pa de gzhings mar bzhes/ brag dmar rdo rje brtsegs par sgrub pa/ mdzad dus phyag 'khar sa la btsugs pa tsan dan gyi sdong po skyes pa da lta'ang yod/ brag la sku rjes bzhag nye logs su grub chu bton/o rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyi spyan sngar shel ging dkar pos gtso byas pa'i lha srin sde brgyad rnams byung nas lha 'dre'i gtso bos gaskusgol 5/ kye sngags pa chen po lags/bsdug ni srog bdag dpon byed tshe : shel ging dkar po bya ba yin : gcad zhin dpon po byed pa'i tshe : gangs ba bzang po bya ba yin : dmu yi dpon po byed pa'i tshe : dmu rta zhur chen bya ba yin : btsan pyi dpon po byed pa'i tshe : skyes thu rlung btsan bya ba yin : gza' yi dpon po byed pa'i tshe : gza' bdud rgyal po rā hu la:bdud kyi dpon po byed pa'i tshe : 'chi bdag zo ra ra skyes yin : klu yi dpon po byed pa'i tshe : klu chen mgo dgu nga yin 'o: ma mo'i dpon po byed pa'i tshe : nga ni dam sri ma mo yin : snang srid lta 'dre nga yi 'bangs: nga bas che btsan su yang med : rgyal po sin dha rā dza'i bla srog 'di yin khyod la 'thul lo: sngar yang spyad ngan byas pas lan : da gakhrod spyod ngan ma byed mdzod : ces pa la sogs pa zhus te : srog snying phul te dam la btags: skyes rgyan dang ma gcig 'thum ldan mamadza re gnyis lcags ma bar du gyon te lcags kyi ga'ur bra ba'i rlid bu'i nang nas srog dbugs rgyal po'i 5 rnam thar drug gi grag nas/27

sna nas yar btang : bla sdom dkar po dngos por ma grub pa 'ja' 'od shigs seb gnyig 'dug pa rgyal po'i spyi gtsug hu bstims shing : rta mgrin dpa' bo gcig pa'i man ngag gnam lcags me'i 'khor lo'i dbang gnang : rgyal bsen gnad 'bebs srog gi 'khor lo btags te rgyal po nad las grol bar gyur nas rgyal po blon 'bangs rnams shin tu dad par gyur te/ mtshe rgyan rin po che gtan du bzhugs par gsol ba btab kyang skyod rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ rton cig rgyal po sin dha rā dza: nga ni rgyal lams spyi rje yin pa la: thum thang gcig tu mi sdod : snang srid nga yi gzhal yas la: pho brang yul gyis ci byed pa: 'jig rten nga yi nor gyis gang :khyod kyi nor gyis ci byed par lha 'dre mi gsum yon bdag la: phyogs ris yon bdag ci byed pa: ci yang mi dgos de bas bka' la nyon: sdig la ma dga' dam pa'i lha ཿtshes gyis: 'khrugs pa ma byed sems can spyod du chug: sdig rgyal ma byed ཿtshes kyi rgyal po gyis: zhes gsungs te ma gsan par phyis su slar 'khyodan par zhal gyis bzhes te rgya yul du rgyal po sna bo che'i pho brang du gyon te rgyal po sin dha rā dza khyod gnyis bdag gi sku na bdag yin pas 'cham par mjod cig ces bka' stsal te rgyal po sna bo che mon du gyon/ sngon chad mon gyis rgya bcom rgyas mon bcom zhes g.yul 'grags bo na byas pa 61 rgyan rin po che'i bka' bzhin rgyal po gnyis mon gyi thang yangs pa zhig hu gdan 'dzoms te phyin chad dmag 'khrugs mi byed par 'a'on pa bsdums shing sa der sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dbang bskur: rgyal po gnyis tshe 'dir mched 〈snags dang phyo ma zhing lams gcig hu mjal bar byas sku1:snye dgu'i mdun gnyis nas/28

de nas rgyal po sna bo che dang sin lha rā dza gnyis kyis zhus pa/ kye gu ru rin po che : khyod ni bod la gyon pa na: dus tshigs lo dus gang la byon don byed gang la/ gyo na pa lagasar bdag cag rnams la bstan du gasku(la: zhes zhus pas: gri ru nyid pyis bka' stsal pa: e ma ston cig rā dza gnyis: bod la gyon pa'i lo dus ni : rgya / ri yul du bcu gnyis sdod: don ni rdo rje gdan la yod: las ni zhig gso byed du 'gro: 'dul ni mu stegs 'dul du 'gro: rgya yi 'gro don rdzogs pa dang : bal po'i yul du zla gcig 'gro: 'gro don rdzogs par byed pa yin : gnam lo rgyal po stag shar nas:padma 'byung gnas bod la 'gro: dgos byed mkhan po rgyal po dang :bdag dang smon lam gcig lags pas: bstan pa sprel phyir bod la 'gre : lha 'dre 'dul phyir bod du 'gro: dam chodas bstan pa dar ba dang : gtsug lag mang po bzhengs dus yin: zhes gsungs so: de nas sa de gar rdo ring btsugs te rgyal po gnyis kyi phyag reg hu bcug ste rgya'i rgyal pos yad gnod 'tsho byed mi ཿtsheg pa dang / mon gyi rgyal pos mar gnod 'tshe byed mi chodag par mna' bgyis bcug pa'i thang de la sngon ( mna' bgyis) yin par snang yang deng sang mna' khris zer mna' tho'i rdo ring de/ de ga'i lha khang nang du da lta yang dngos su mjal rgyu yod/ rgya dang mon gyi rgyal po btsun mo blon 'bangs bcas pa rnams la tshersha rgyan rin po ches bka' stsal pa: kye rgya dang sman gyi blen 'bangs rnams: dus la 'pho 'gyur ci byung yang : rdo ring mna' rdo gdi brgal nas: su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig: gal te 'di las sus brgal do gter gaston ma rgyan bzang po'i gter ma rgyal po min lha rā dza'i rnam thar nas bris/rdzo bcu gnyis mdun lnga/29

ba: padma bdag la bsdos/ pa yin: snang srid lha 'dre thams cad kyis: 'di las brgal bar byas pa de'i: snying khrag thang la 'phos nas kyang : skad cig nyid la srog chod cig: ces dang / deng phyin chad mna' rdo 'di las brgal nas rgya dmag thum thang ma sna〈sna: bum thang gi dmag rgya la ma 'a〈sna gal te brgal na thams cad brlag par gyur cig: ces gsungs so: der rgyal blon thams cad kyis de ltar byacad sa ma ya na rakan: zhes blo na 'bangs thams cad kyis rdo ring la lag pa reg nas mna' byas pas thang de la mna' thang du grags sku / /de nas rgyal po sna bo che rgya gar du gyon/ srin lha rā dzas gu ru la ma cadangs pa na ba dag gi rgyal khab 'dir ji ltar cadang zhes zhus pa na/ gu ru rin po ches da lta khyod kyi pho brang lcags kyi mkhar be gu thog shin hu btsan zhing bkod pa mdzes pa yod kyang ma cadangs pa na lcags mkhar zer ba'i ming tsam las snyugs 'dzer gcig kyang mi lus zhes gsungs/ smadan gyi rgyal khab 'dir ma cesangs pa na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing mnga' thang longs spyod dang ldan pas rang dbang gi dpal la spyad par 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs te 61 rgyan padma 'byung gnas rgya gar du gyon/ rgyal po sin dha rā dza sum thang du byon nas gu ru rin po che'i bka' bzhin dge ba bcu'i khrims bcas te rgyal srid chodas bzhin du skyong nas mnga' thang stobs 'byor longs spyod dar zhang rgyas te yul khams rnams bde ba la bkod nas sin dha rā dza yang rgya gar du gyon no/rgyal po sin dha rā dza'i lo rgyus skor la rnam thar gter bston o rgyan bzang po'i meX rnam thar bce brgyad mdun gsum/30

gter ma zhig yod pa dang / yang gu ru rin po ches rgyal po nad las grol ba'i don du gnang ba/ mnga' bdag mon mo 'khyil gyi gter ma/ rta mgrin dpa' so gcig pa'i man ngag gnam lcags me'i 'khor lo zhes pa kyibs rje dil mgo mkhyen brtse rin po che'i gsung las rin chen gter mdzod du bzhugs pa las rnyed pa gnyis la gzhi bachol zhing / rgan rabs kyi gtam la 〈sna rgyus grags pas kyang zur brgyan te bris pa ste/ rgyal po de'i mtshan rnam thar nas sin lha rā dza dang / rta mgrin dpa' bo gcig pa'i man ngag gi 〈sna rgyus nas se 'dar la zhes snang ba'i khyad par tsam las gzhan phyogs mthun snang ngo / /

rgyal po khyi la ra khrod kyi lo rgyus mkhan pa rdzongs kyi gnas yig nas gsungs pa ni/ ༄༄/ / sngon dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang bod du rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i phyir lo tsā ba chen po bai ro tsa na rgya gar du snu sa zhu bar btang pa mthar phyin te slar 'o/ga bod du rkang mgyogs grub pas gyon te bsam yas ༄/ phyag phebs tshe/ rgya gar gyi gakhon 'phrang bas bskul te: bza' dmar rgyan gyis gtso byas bdud blon rnams gyis: sangs rgyas gnyis pa bai ro tsā na bod du chodas bsgyur ba'i dbang ma 〈snang bar chu la bskyur: mtha' la spyugs byas pas: rgyal po thugs ma dgyes so: de dus ce sa rgyal la jo mo bzhi yod pa des: zhag gsum gsum gyi bsnyen bkur byed kyi yod pa la: rgyal pos lo lnga'i bar dmar rgyan gyi sar bsnyen bkur bzhes par ma byon pas: dus gcig na dmar rgyan 'dod pa rgyas te: khyi dang ra ma thong nas: thog khar khyi/ dang spyad : 'og khang du ra dang spyad pas: zla dgu ngo bcu na dmar rgyan gyi lus la khye'u skutshed pa kun gyis tshor te: mi mang rnams gcig gleng gnyis gleng kun gyis shes so: dmang rgyan la nang blon gcig yod pa la: rgyal pos dmar rgyan gyi pho brang nang ma byon par lo mang po song : nang blon min pa gzhan su yod ces glengs pas: nang blon la rgyal po'i khrims phog gis dogs 'jigs shing sdug bsngal gyis non par gyur pa la: ra khyi 'ded pa'i rdzi bos mthong ste smras pa:rgyal po'i jo mo dmar rgyan gyis 'og khang na ra dang spyor ba byed yod zer bas yang gcig na re : ngas kyang mthong pho brang steng du khyi 'khrid de spyor ba byed kyi 'dug zer 32

ro: de nas zla dgu ngo bcu na thu gcig btsas par gyur yum gyis lo dgu'i bar gsang ste gsos so: der rgyal pos chor te phrin blon la phrin bsrings te dmar rgyan khyod la thu gcig skud zer ba bdag gis thos pas: de bdag la phyal cig rgyal srid gtad par byalnga zhes bsrings pas: der bsam yas nai sing chen por 'grul bcug pas dmar rgyan gyis phul te: ra'i marshasna la la mtshul khyi 'du ba'i mi gcig 'dug pa las: rgyal pe sa bsresan 3sna la zhe gnag byas te 'bangs rnams bsdus te: dmar rgyan gyi thu 'a di ni bod yul 'phung ba'i ltas ngan yin par 'dug gas: 'di bdag cag rje 'bangs rnams kyi glud du mtha' la spyug skusna gsungs nas:bod kyi ban snye dang : sngags pa dang : bon po rnams bsags te mdos snu ga mang po khyod du bcug cing : khyi la ra cod la bdud blon rnams dang : yum dmar rgyan gyi 'bangs mi rnams 'bangs su gtad do: gos dum rgyab na 'byu sna'i spyo mo re re thogs pa rgyan du bcub nas mtha' 9pa spyugs skusna: khyi la ra thod rje 'bangs rnams kyis snyo brag spyid ces bya bad lo gsum bsdad dusar yang rgyal pos tshor te dmag dungs nas yul phud : de nas khyi la ra thod rje 'bangs rnams men mkhan pa lung du yul thon no de dus btsun mo man de bzang mo la 'khrungs pa'i sras mu rum btsan po la rgyul srid gtad pas dmar rgyan gyis phrag dog byas te: gsol ngan gyis bkrongs pas: rgyal po mya ngan gyis non dmar rgyan la chad pa phog ste: gtsang po yar rgyab gra gzhung gi mdar yul bton to: de nas khyi la ra thod rje 'bangs rnams kyi sdod tshul ni : yang re lung du rgyal po'i pho brang bzung : bye dkar lung du bzo rig pa dang bon po'i sdod sa bzung : lung sul dang ri ldeb rnams la blon 'bangs dang :33

'bor rnams kyi sdod sa bzung ngo:der rgyal po'i pho brang yang shing las grub pa: rgya phib kyi thog dang bcas pa snye che la dpangs mtho ba: rin po che'i rtsi mang po byugs nas 'od 'phro ba bya su pa la:skar khung dang : sgo mang dang : rgya mthongs rab gsal dang bcas pa'i bkod pas mdzes par byas pa la: lcags ri gsum bskor du yod: sgo mo che gnyis de'i phyi la 'bangs 'khor dud khyim brgya drug cu re gcig gis bskor te yod pa la: de'i nang du rgyal po dpon g.yog 'khor bcas bzhugs: tswa dis khyi la ra khrod kyis bod du dmag dung rtsis byas te: 'bangs 'khor rnams bsdus nas: rgyal pos 'bangs rnams la bka' sal pa: bdag gi gas khyi la ra the da nga mtha' la spyugs: spru/ma yul bton byas pas: da res dmag dung dgos skusna byas te : rje 'bangs rnams kyis bsam yas su dmag dungs so: de'i dus chodas rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gshegs nas: lho tig btsan pos rgyal srid 'go bzung tsam skud pa las: 61 rgyan dang mu tig btsan po yar lung shel gyi brag phyag na bzhugs mde pas bsam yas su rngamag slobs yod pa ma rgyan gyis mkhyen te: gu/ rus gnam the dkar po bskul te thog ma smad bdun phab pas: dmag rnams sngangs shing 'dar nas rang yul du myur bar log go/11 pad gling gter ma mkhan pa 〈snangs kyi gnas yig bdun mdun drug nas/34

rgyal po khyi la ra thod kyi lo rgyus mkhan pa rdzongs kyi lam yig nas gas/ngas pa/༄༄/ / padma gling pa'i gter gyon klong gsal gyi cha lag mkhan pa rdzongs kyi lam yig ldeb grangs so bzhi'i rgyab 3/ga yig phreng gong ma nas/ rgyal po'i jo mo dmar rgyan maḥ rgyal song gnyis kyis 'khrig pa'i brashā mu rum btsan po zhes bya byung ཿde ni rgyal pos mtha' la bshugasaḥ rgyal thu rje 'bangs dug cu yisaḥ mon gyi mkhan pa lung du phyinaḥ mkhan pa lung du yul bzung nasaḥ rgya yi rgyal po se 'da' dang ཿ mchod yon 'brel ba zab tu byasaḥ longs spyod shin hu che ba byung ཿ lo ni dug cu re gcig bsdadaḥ de dus mu rum btsan po yisaḥ rgya dmag bsdus nas bod du khyeraḥbasam yas la sogs 'jig tshul stonaḥ de dus ces rgyan nga dang niḥ mu tig btsan po bdag cag gnyisaḥ badri rkos kyi yang rdzong bzhusas pa'i dusaḥ bdag 'du padma 'byung gnas ngasaḥ mu rum btsan 〈snas dmag dungs mkhyenaḥ tshoganam the dkar 〈sna ngas bskul nasaḥ thog kyang ma smad bdun du phabaḥ dmag rnams sngangs shing 'dar bar gyuraḥde nas rang yul ldog nas song ཿ tshe rgyan mu tig bka' bgros mdzadaḥ rgyal po mu sum btsan po deḥ mtha' la badza/ga/sa par ma byas naḥ yang yang 'di ru dmag 'dren sridaḥ de bas mtha' la badza/gas par byaḥ bdag 'du padma 'byung gnas kyisaḥmakhan pa rdzongs kyi yu la du byenaḥ mu rum btsan po mgo bskor nas: rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis yul bton nasaḥ sum thang stang zhes bya bar song ཿ skyod rgyan bdag gis slar log nasaḥ rgyal pos dkor chas nor rnams dang: thab cha dum cig gter du 35

srasaX jol song phags su gar tshang rngamasaX pya cig btsa pos bsam yas tsher da ༷ tsho sa tso / ga mo / mi mkhan pa rdzongs kyi yul phyogs rnamasaḥ rgya ni rim pa gsum du bsdamasaḥ du sa la slebs tsho ma gtogs pa sus kyang mi mthong par byas so mu rum btsan po rje ༷ ༷'bangs rnams kyisaḥ btsal kyang rnyed par ma gyur teḥ de nas khyi rtsum bya ba yi:yul tsog bzung nas ga ring bsdangaḥ dus phyis chos bskor mda' ru 'chazhes gsal/13 pad gling gter ma mkhan pa rdzongs wa lam yig so lnga mdun phreng gnyis nas/ 36

gu ru rin po che yar lung shel brag nas gyon te khyi la ra thed yul bton te mkhan pa rdzongs sbas yul du byin gyis brlabs pa/༄7/ /de'i dus su sras mu tig btsan pos zhus pa kyi slob dpon rin po che lags rgyal po khyi la ra thod yul ma bton na: yab mes kyi gtsug lag lang 'di rnams la gshod pa yang yang byed par 'dug pas: 'di mkhan pa rdzongs su yang mi bzhag par yul 'don pa'i thabs gcig zhu 'tshal: zhes zhus pas: de nas 61 rgyan padmas mkhan pa rdzongs su byon te: mi nag po 'jigs su rung ba zhig tu sprul te rgyal po'i grang du 'di skad gsungs: kyi mu rum btsan po: khyod rje 'bangs rnams kyi bla ma ngas byu yis nged rang skutshen mchode mthun par byas nas: gsang sngags 'dzin pa'i phyogs rnams pham par byed: bsam yas la sku1gas pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams 'jig cing chu la 'bo bar byacasna byas pas: rgyal po'i thugs dgongs la:'di thog po padma 'byung gnas yin pa'ang srid: yin na da res chad pa gcig bcad dgos bsam ste smras pa: mi nag po khyod zog po padma 'byung gnas kyi chod 'phrul ma yin nam yin na sngon chad kyang khyod kyi nga la gnod sems mang po byas: da rung me kyi nga la gnod pa bkal bar 'dug pas: blon po rnams kyis de bzung la sod cig byas pa dang : mi nag po na re: da lta bsam yas na yod pa'i padma 'byung gnas de dang nga gnyis mi 'cham: nga mu stegs kyi slob dpon ha ra nag po bya ba yin: 'o'i bstan pa la nga ci gshod bya ba yin: de bas rgyal po sno dang 'ong so 37

sor yod zer bsar ngas khyod kyi sto bas la brten nas lo'i bstan pa 'joms dgos snyam ste rgya gar nas cadangs pa yinar nged rang yon mchod gnyis bka' bgros mdzad nas bo'i bstan pa la ci gnod bya'o zer bas: yang rgyal pos: 'o na khyod kyis rdzu 'phrul gcig ston dang byas pas: rgyal po'i pho brang gi lto nub mtshams na rdo leb gzhong pa 'du ba gcig yod pa'i steng du gar mdzad pas zhabs rjes bco brgyad gyon no:des rgyal po thugs ches par gyur te zhus pa: kyi sle ba dpon chen po lags:bdag gi pha khri srong lde'u btsan dang : padma 'byung gnas gnyis kyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang lta thu gcig 'dir bzhengs par zhu zhus pas: 〈snab dpe na gyis gsungs pa: kyi rgyal po chen po: khri srong lde'u btsan dang padma 'byung gnas kyis bsam yas bzhengs pa de: bod du khyad par 'phags pa byed de ra nged rang gnyis kyis de bas ya mtshan pa gcig bzhings pas rgyal po rang nga'i ngag la nyon cig gsungs se : rgyal po nare: de las ya mtshan pa gcig byung na khyod kyis gang mdzad pa la nyan zer bas: slob dpon gyi zhal nas: 'o na nged rang yon mchod shing gi byu khyung nam mkha' la 'phyar thub pa bzhengs nas: de'i 'og pa'i nang du rgyal po dpon gaskutsheg lnga brgya tshud par byed cing : de la skar khung dang bar mtshams mang po bcad nas gzhal yas khang gi rnam pa byas pa'i nang du thab la mang pe bzung nas 'o/ngas spyod dang 'byor pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas nas lha mi'i 'jig rten na 'di las khyad par 'phags pa med zer ba gcig byaro zer nas: shing gi bzo rigs pa bsdus nas byu khyung che la 'phang mtho ba gcig byas so: de la rlung baspyod pa dang 38

sor yod zer bsar ngas khyod kyi sto bas la brten nas lo'i bstan pa 'joms dgos snyam ste rgya gar nas cadangs pa yinar nged rang yon mchod gnyis bka' bgros mdzad nas bo'i bstan pa la ci gnod bya'o zer bas: yang rgyal pos: 'o na khyod kyis rdzu 'phrul gcig ston dang byas pas: rgyal po'i pho brang gi lto nub mtshams na rdo leb gzhong pa 'du ba gcig yod pa'i steng du gar mdzad pas zhabs rjes bco brgyad gyon no:des rgyal po thugs ches par gyur te zhus pa: kyi sle ba dpon chen po lags:bdag gi pha khri srong lde'u btsan dang : padma 'byung gnas gnyis kyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang lta thu gcig 'dir bzhengs par zhu zhus pas: 〈snab dpe na gyis gsungs pa: kyi rgyal po chen po: khri srong lde'u btsan dang padma 'byung gnas kyis bsam yas bzhengs pa de: bod du khyad par 'phags pa byed de ra nged rang gnyis kyis de bas ya mtshan pa gcig bzhings pas rgyal po rang nga'i ngag la nyon cig gsungs se : rgyal po nare: de las ya mtshan pa gcig byung na khyod kyis gang mdzad pa la nyan zer bas: slob dpon gyi zhal nas: 'o na nged rang yon mchod shing gi byu khyung nam mkha' la 'phyar thub pa bzhengs nas: de'i 'og pa'i nang du rgyal po dpon gaskutsheg lnga brgya tshud par byed cing : de la skar khung dang bar mtshams mang po bcad nas gzhal yas khang gi rnam pa byas pa'i nang du thab la mang pe bzung nas 'o/ngas spyod dang 'byor pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas nas lha mi'i 'jig rten na 'di las khyad par 'phags pa med zer ba gcig byaro zer nas: shing gi bzo rigs pa bsdus nas byu khyung che la 'phang mtho ba gcig byas so: de la rlung baspyod pa dang 38

'dzin pa'i gzer mgo gnyis su byas nas slob dpon gyis gsungs pa rgyal po rje 'bangs rnams de ring bya khyung gi rab gnas la 'tshogs shig gsungs pas:rje 'bangs rnams bya khyung gi khog par zhugs nas bza' btung gi 'o/ngas spyad glu gar la sogs pa byed cing yod pa la: slob dpon gyis gsungs pa: rgyal po rje 'bangs rnams bdag la gaskusgon cig: ya mtshan pa'i rtags 'gul ba dang : 'phrig pa dang lha'adar ba sogs gang byung yang ma 'jigs par bde bar sdod cig gsungs nas:slob dpon gyis bya khyung gi steng du byon nas: phyag gnyis su lcags kyi dbyug tho re thogs nas mi 'dod pa'i rlu nga baspyod pa'i zer gnyis brdungs pas bya khyung nam mkha' la 'thur nas song ngor de dus rgyal pos khyi skad lhang lhang zhig thos pas: sgo ma bde bar tshigs bcad smras pa: kyi bdag gi steng gi zog po padma 'byung : sangs rgyas yin zer sems can gshod pa byed: gzhan don yin zer mig log mgo bskor mkhanar bdag gis khyod la gasnad pa ma byas kyang : byas pasar 61 rgyan gyis gsungs pa: kyi khyi lar thod bdag la gsen rdzi 'o/ga par lta ba dmar rgyan bu: bdag gi rigs brgyud khyod la med: khyod ni grol song gnyis kyi su: mu stegs rgyal po thu rgod mkhan: da lta khyi skad za ba de: rgya gar tsang lung khyi skad yin: zhes gsungs pas: yang khyi la ra thod kyis smras pa: kyi mgo bskor mkhan gyi zog po mkhan ra yab rgyal blon gyi mgo bsterdzor bas: bdag cag yum sras mtha' la spyugs: sangs rgyas yin zer thede sdug btang : snying rje mgon zer bdag nyid mtha' la spyugs spyugs pas mi tshad yul 'don byed pa 'di: sdig dpon yin yang de 'du ngas ma mthong : la yog bden na 39

zog po'i steng du thong : zer ba la: o rgyan gyis gsungs pa kyi gyol song phru gu khyi la ra cad nyon: lta 'o/ga ma smad gnyis kyi bod yul du: yab kyi bka' bcag bdud blon dbang bsgyur nas bai ro la sogs sgu sgyur lo tsā rnams mtha' la spyugs pas dam ceras nyi ma nub: dmag dungs ceras rgyal gtsug lag bshig par brtsams: thub na nga yang gsod pa'i bsam ngan yod: phyi gzhug sangs rgyas bstan pa brlag bsam nas: sems can don du sdig rgyal yul 'don no: gsungs nas mi 'dod pa'i rlung g.yos pa'i gzer rnams rim pas brdungs pas skad cig de nyid la sum thang nya dkar bya ba'i yul du slebs so: 'dod pa'i rlung 'dzin pa'i gzer brdungs pas sa la babs sku : der bzhag nas: 61 rgyan rdzu 'phrul gyis slar mkhan pa rdzongs su phebs: rje 'bangs kyi dkor nor rnams gter du sbas malan pa rdzongs kyi sa phyogs mi mthong bar phyi nang gsang ba'i rgyas bsdams nas gnas kyi gnyer gtad bka' balnga sa nas bzhag cerdzo: dus la ma babs par 46sa kyang mi mthong bar byas so: des rgyal po rje 'bangs rnams kyis btsal kyang rnyed par ma gyur to de nas khyi la ra thod rje 'bangs rnams kyis stang khyi tshum yul bzung nas yun ring du bsdad: te/ rgyan gyis thum thang lcags mkhar du rgyal po se 'da' rā dza'i bla mar gyon nas rdo rje brtsegs pa'i brag la dgongs pa la bzhugs so:rgyal po khyi la ra khrod de thog mar stang khyi tshums la yun ring bzhugs/ de nas gnas sgos te ཿtshes 'bor smad rgyal mkhar du gyon nas yul bzung ste bzhugs pa las mi brgyud kyang deng sang gi bar du yul der yod par kun gyis bshad do/ / skabs shig na rdzong mes 'jig skabs gsung rten brgyad stong pa gser rgyu glegs bam 40

zog po'i steng du thong : zer ba la: o rgyan gyis gsungs pa kyi gyol song phru gu khyi la ra cad nyon: lta 'o/ga ma smad gnyis kyi bod yul du: yab kyi bka' bcag bdud blon dbang bsgyur nas bai ro la sogs sgu sgyur lo tsā rnams mtha' la spyugs pas dam ceras nyi ma nub: dmag dungs ceras rgyal gtsug lag bshig par brtsams: thub na nga yang gsod pa'i bsam ngan yod: phyi gzhug sangs rgyas bstan pa brlag bsam nas: sems can don du sdig rgyal yul 'don no: gsungs nas mi 'dod pa'i rlung g.yos pa'i gzer rnams rim pas brdungs pas skad cig de nyid la sum thang nya dkar bya ba'i yul du slebs so: 'dod pa'i rlung 'dzin pa'i gzer brdungs pas sa la babs sku : der bzhag nas: 61 rgyan rdzu 'phrul gyis slar mkhan pa rdzongs su phebs: rje 'bangs kyi dkor nor rnams gter du sbas malan pa rdzongs kyi sa phyogs mi mthong bar phyi nang gsang ba'i rgyas bsdams nas gnas kyi gnyer gtad bka' balnga sa nas bzhag cerdzo: dus la ma babs par 46sa kyang mi mthong bar byas so: des rgyal po rje 'bangs rnams kyis btsal kyang rnyed par ma gyur to de nas khyi la ra thod rje 'bangs rnams kyis stang khyi tshum yul bzung nas yun ring du bsdad: te/ rgyan gyis thum thang lcags mkhar du rgyal po se 'da' rā dza'i bla mar gyon nas rdo rje brtsegs pa'i brag la dgongs pa la bzhugs so:rgyal po khyi la ra khrod de thog mar stang khyi tshums la yun ring bzhugs/ de nas gnas sgos te ཿtshes 'bor smad rgyal mkhar du gyon nas yul bzung ste bzhugs pa las mi brgyud kyang deng sang gi bar du yul der yod par kun gyis bshad do/ / skabs shig na rdzong mes 'jig skabs gsung rten brgyad stong pa gser rgyu glegs bam 40

'phyar te gong mkhar gyi gzhol zhing gi bar/ gcal rdo'i pha bong tshi bzhi( stegs shig gi thog babs te bzhugs pa sus kyang ma mthong ba la/ stang chal ba ཿtshes 'khor du 'gro mi 'grul ba rnams kyis mtshan mo sa gnas der me 'bar ba mthong ste ltar phyin pas brgyad stong pa gser gyi glogs bam de thob ste stang chal pa'i yul du gdan dungs pa la/ rgyal mkhar pa rnams kyis stang chal du song nas 'ong la dbang zhes zer te rgyal mkhar du gdan 'dren pa na/ sus kyang ma theg pa dang / char rlung dang ser ba shugs dug po bab pa la serdzogs pa mi shis pa'i mtshan ma ngan pa byung ba las/thams cad 'jigs shing skrag ste dus skabs lung bstan stang chal du babs pa yin 'dug zer bzhag go /de ltar dus rabs brgyad pa'i skabs kyi glogs bam me phung las rang gis 'thur te byon pa glogs shing phyi pa tu dang nang rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sku brkos rgyab pa shin tu ngo mtshar can de da lha stang chal gyi lha khang nang du/ 'du par 'di bzhin kun gyis mjal yul du bzhugs so/ /de yang mkhan pa rdzongs kshi lam yig tshigs bcad ma nas bsgrags kyi yang rdzong zhes pa dang / mkhan pa rdzongs kyi gnas yig tshig lhug ma nas sbyor lung shel brag ces snang ngo / /khyi la ra thedi mkhan pa ñdzi ngas nas yul btoni tshul gnas yig dgu nas mar gsag41

'o( tsu/sa khyad mtshar can zhig ༄༄/ / mi rigs pho mo khyad med par thams cad mgo ril yin pa dang / go has pa ni ru shing tsu ni'am/ rdog ma pa ni ru shing tsu zhe yang zer ba de za ba'i rgyu mtshan la rgan rabs rnams kyis 'o( rgyus khyad mtshar can la mthun par gleng gi skude pa ni/sngon gu ru rin po che mon du byon pa'i dus su 'dre srin dang mon gyi mi rnams mi'i sha za khrag 'thung rus pa mur klad pa 'thung / pags pa za/ pags pa gyon gyi sku da pa la/ gu ru rin po che yis 'dre srin dngos su yod pa rnams btul nas dam la btags/ mi rnams de'i spyod pa la zhugs pa rnams phan tshun ga'edi 'tshe mi byed par dam bca' bkal/ sha'i tshab hu ru shing dang rus pa'i tshab tu go has sam rdog ma pags pa'i tshab tu pa zhe klad pa'i tshab tu tsu zhe khrag gi tshab tu de rnams spyor te za ba las mchil ma dmar po mod pas go chod par byin gyis brlabs te pho mo thams cad kyi skra ral pa bcad de sdom pa gnang yod pa las/ phyin chad ma 'ongs pa na yang mon gyi yul rdzongs 'dir mi skye ba len tshad thams cad kyis sdom pa 'thob par thugs smon gnang ste byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas sam/ mi thams cad pho mo khyad par med pa la sngon gyi dus nas gu ru rin po che yis sdom pa gnang bzhag pa yin pas mgo ril dang / rdog ma pa zhe ru shing tsu zhe za ba'i rgyu mtshan de yis yin zer ba'i lo rgyus bshad srol 'dug deng sang yang rten 'brel bzang po'i mdzad sgo thams cad la bzhugs gral rdog ma pa sna dung gi yod pa dang / gsung chesgog gnang ba'i tshe gsol ja'i rjes su ldog ma pa zhe cadung gi yo da pa dang / mjal 'phrad kyi skabs rnams su'ang 42

'o( tsu/sa khyad mtshar can zhig ༄༄/ / mi rigs pho mo khyad med par thams cad mgo ril yin pa dang / go has pa ni ru shing tsu ni'am/ rdog ma pa ni ru shing tsu zhe yang zer ba de za ba'i rgyu mtshan la rgan rabs rnams kyis 'o( rgyus khyad mtshar can la mthun par gleng gi skude pa ni/sngon gu ru rin po che mon du byon pa'i dus su 'dre srin dang mon gyi mi rnams mi'i sha za khrag 'thung rus pa mur klad pa 'thung / pags pa za/ pags pa gyon gyi sku da pa la/ gu ru rin po che yis 'dre srin dngos su yod pa rnams btul nas dam la btags/ mi rnams de'i spyod pa la zhugs pa rnams phan tshun ga'edi 'tshe mi byed par dam bca' bkal/ sha'i tshab hu ru shing dang rus pa'i tshab tu go has sam rdog ma pags pa'i tshab tu pa zhe klad pa'i tshab tu tsu zhe khrag gi tshab tu de rnams spyor te za ba las mchil ma dmar po mod pas go chod par byin gyis brlabs te pho mo thams cad kyi skra ral pa bcad de sdom pa gnang yod pa las/ phyin chad ma 'ongs pa na yang mon gyi yul rdzongs 'dir mi skye ba len tshad thams cad kyis sdom pa 'thob par thugs smon gnang ste byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas sam/ mi thams cad pho mo khyad par med pa la sngon gyi dus nas gu ru rin po che yis sdom pa gnang bzhag pa yin pas mgo ril dang / rdog ma pa zhe ru shing tsu zhe za ba'i rgyu mtshan de yis yin zer ba'i lo rgyus bshad srol 'dug deng sang yang rten 'brel bzang po'i mdzad sgo thams cad la bzhugs gral rdog ma pa sna dung gi yod pa dang / gsung chesgog gnang ba'i tshe gsol ja'i rjes su ldog ma pa zhe cadung gi yo da pa dang / mjal 'phrad kyi skabs rnams su'ang 42

rdog ma pa zhe mdongs gsol du byin len byed kyi yod la/ lhag par gu ru rin po che thog mar gyon sa thum thang du yin pa dang / thum thang pa rnams rdog ma pa zhe za gi yod pa ma tshad rgyab la pags pa'ang gyon gyi yod pa da lta mngon sum tshad ma yin no/ / gu ru rin po che la mtshan gyi rnam grangs mang po yod pa las/ ye shes mkha' 'gro mas tshig bdun gaskusnal 'debs su/ padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: zhes gsungs 'dug pa dang / gu ru rin po che rang gi gsung rig 'dzin yongs 'dus las kyang / skyod rgyan padma 'byung gnas la gsetrel ba 'debs: gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi gtso bo'i mtshan la padma 'byung gnas zhes grags pa dang / rgyal po se 'dar la'i 'o/ rgyus las kyang padma 'byung gnas zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir yang padma 'byung gnas zhes gtso so'i mtshan nas hrīrshas pa lags skusna/ /43

rdog ma pa zhe mdongs gsol du byin len byed kyi yod la/ lhag par gu ru rin po che thog mar gyon sa thum thang du yin pa dang / thum thang pa rnams rdog ma pa zhe za gi yod pa ma tshad rgyab la pags pa'ang gyon gyi yod pa da lta mngon sum tshad ma yin no/ / gu ru rin po che la mtshan gyi rnam grangs mang po yod pa las/ ye shes mkha' 'gro mas tshig bdun gaskusnal 'debs su/ padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: zhes gsungs 'dug pa dang / gu ru rin po che rang gi gsung rig 'dzin yongs 'dus las kyang / skyod rgyan padma 'byung gnas la gsetrel ba 'debs: gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi gtso bo'i mtshan la padma 'byung gnas zhes grags pa dang / rgyal po se 'dar la'i 'o/ rgyus las kyang padma 'byung gnas zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir yang padma 'byung gnas zhes gtso so'i mtshan nas hrīrshas pa lags skusna/ /43

gu ru rin po che bar du ldan ma rtse mang 'khrid de bod nas byon tshul/༄༄/ / bod la ba can du srong btsan sgam po nas rgyal rabs lnga pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul chodas rgyal khri srong sde'u btsan gyis ston pa'i 'das lo 1638sa mo phag lo dang spu lo 747la gu ru padma 'byung gnas bod du spyan dungs te gyon nas bsam yas kyi ba'i ga lag khang bzhengs lha 'dre gdug pa can btul gsang sngags kyi ceras gsungs te bzhugs pa nas/ sngerdzon gyi zhal bzhes bzhin gu ru rin po che lo tsā ldan ma rtse mang bcas mon thum thang du gyon nas rgyal po sin dha rā dza dang ldan ma rtse mang gzhan yang las can gyi blon 'bangs 'khor bcas la brag rdo rje brtsegs pa'i gur khang 'dir rdzogs pa chen po gsal ba'i me long gis mtshon smin grol gdams pa'i zab snu sa mang du gsungs shing rdzogs pa chen po'i chodas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas 'dug mu ru lung zhes pa'i yul de'i phya na gu ru rin po ches dug po khamar nag me phreng can gyi skur bzhengs te srin po dga' byed gzhon nu zer ba btul nas srin po'i gzugs dang yan lag nang khrol rnams rdo bar byin gyis brlabs pa dang / rdo la zhabs zung gi rjes gsal la dod par bkod pa der deng sang zhabs rjes thang zhes grags pa dang / bar du dben gnas dza/gas pa'i brag zhes pa der yang gu ru rin po che'i sku rjes yod/ yang rdo rje brtsegs pa'i brag gi mdun chu bo gtsang po'i pha rol gyi brag la gu ru padma sam bha wa'i sku rjes gsal zhing dod pa dang / de'i g.yas g.yon du phyar pa dang phag mo rang byon gyi snang brnyan ngo mtshar ba bcas yod/ thum 44
