thang stang ri mo can gyi brag la thugs rje chen po mun sol sgron me'i ktos skor gter du sbas pa sogs mon yul 'di'i bdud dang / lha srin gdug pa can btul cing rdzogs pa chen po'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te bstan pa dar bar mdzad de slar bod du byon/yon gyi sgom pa ha mi nā tha sogs bsam yas su cheras zhu bar song ste rje 'bangs nyer lnga da nga lhan cig gsang sngags kyi chos mang po zhus/ sna rnam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi sprul sku rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem phyu can gyi gter skal byang gter bla rdzogs thugs gsum sogs kyi gter sgrom bso sgrom smug po sogs bzo mi yang ha mi nā tha de nyid yin pa ma zad/ gu ru rin po ches sngon rgyal po se 'dar la sde brgyad kyi gasnad pa las 〈snal ba'i gdams pa rta mgrin dpa' therdzo gcig pa'i man ngag gnam lcags me'i 'khor lo zhes pa de yi ru rin po ches mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan la gnang / rgyal pos yon gyi sgom pa ha mi nā tha la ཿtshes skal du gnang ba de dus phyos su ha mi nā tha'i skye ba mnga' bdag chen po mol mi 'khyil gyis gter bzhes pa de nyid da lta rin chen gter mdzod du bzhugs/ rdo rje brtsegs pa'i brag gi g.yon phyogs su sa'i dbyibs zla ba 'du ba'i thang du lto rdzongs spyi dang / khyad par yul rdzongs 'dir ma ma ngas pa na klu nad gdug pa zhig gis mi rabs bcad par gzigs te de'i gnyen por phyag rdor glu 'bum gyis gtsos sa gzhon mchod rten bcu gsum bzhengs te byin gyis brlabs par mdzad pa sogs lto mon gyi yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad 'dug bod du ཿtshes rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srol btod/ dar zhing rgyas te lha sa dang bsam yas ཿtshes tshigs kyi yul dbus su gyur pa nas bzung / mon yul 'di la rten snod sa chags tshul la ltos 45

te snyo rong zhes pa dang / tshos ma dar ba'i yul la ltos te lto mon zhes pa'i ming yongs su grags pa yin te/ o rgyan rin po ches/ nga yi rje 'jug chos rṣa rnams:lo rong sbas pa'i yul nga bros: zhes dang / lo phyogs mon kha'i brag la sa rjes 4rdo/te la ri/ 4spre/te shā /bzhag: ces gsungs pa ltar mon yul 'di la snyo rong dang snyo mon du ming chags so/rgorming phya chu mo thug stag tshang seng ge bsam grub sogs su dang / mdor na mnga' ris mdo lams ru bzhi'i dben gnas thams cad du sgrub grwa sgom grwa btsugs shing de rnams su tshes bcu : bco lnga nya mgo : tshes brgyad mar pa dus mchod la sogs pa'i srol rnams kyang gong mtshungs cud: ces gsungs pa ltar snyo mon 'dir bstan pa snga dar ni o rgyan padma 'byung gnas snga phyi bar gsum du gyon te chos gsungs nas sgrub grwa dang sgom grwa yang btsugs yod par snang zhing / rnying ma'i bstan pa dar 'dug go /13 padma thang yig gsor phreng ma nyis brgya rpā gsum gyi rgyab phreng gsum pa nas gsag 46

bdud blon gyi g.yo 'phrul gyis lha sras gtsang ma yul bton te lto mon du gyon pa'i lo rgyus/༄༄ / / sngon bod du dus rabs dgu pa'i nang bdud blon dbas rgyal to re dang /cog ro legs sgra gnyis kyis rgyal po khri ral pa can bkrongs nas chodas khrims bshig pa'i 'dun gros byas pa'i tshe/ cog ro legs sgras rgyal po bkrongs kyang lha sras gtsang ma dang / blen chen dpal gyi yon tan yod pas ceras khrims bshig mi thub zer ba la/ rgyal rno res nga la thabs yod zer nas/ bod dbus gtsang gi mo ma rtsis pa thams cad la nor rdzas kyi rngan pa byin nas/ lha sras gtsang ma da lo bod khams 'asder bzhugs na sku tshe la bar chad yod pa dang / bod khams su nad yams dang /muse/dus 'grigs la serdzogs pa sku(nga ba 'dug zer thams cad la mthun du smar bcug ste smras pa de/ rgyal to res rgyal po la zhus pas/ rgyal pos gcung gtsang ma rang da lo nged rang gi sku chags sangs pa dang / snyo mon mi sde zha mas kyi yul khams ji ltar yod gzigs pa la phebs zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ bdud blon rgyal to re'i g.yo 'phrul gyis yul phud de snyo mon du spyugs pa yin 'dug /lha sras gtsang ma snyo mon phyogs su gyon pa'i rjes/ rgyal to re dang cog ro legs sgu gnyis la mthun nas/ rgyal po'i btsun mo ngang tshul ma dang / blon chen dpal gyi yon tan gnyis gsang thabs kyis 'dod pa spyad kyi 'dug zer phra ma bcug pas/ btsun mo ngang tshul ma ha las nas rtsebs te shi/ rgyal pos phra ma gsan te blon chen dpal gyi yon tan khrims kyis bkum/ de nas sdig blon gyis glags rnyed 47

nas/ rgyal po 'bras chang gsol nas gzims pa dathu ltag par bskor te bkrongs/lha sras gtsang ma dpon g.yog lnga tsam phag ri nas spa hro phyogs su phebs te gnam mthong dkar por re zhig bzhugs/de nas rim pas thim ga zed lung / lo thang la/ mang sde/ 'khan rta li/sbu li/ snyung la sbri/ gzhong sgar mol pa lung rnams rim pas bgrod de ku re chu la bslebs pa dang / chu bo'i stod smad gang na'ang zam pa med par ci dug la thug ngas lung phyogs 'di la dbang skyur ba'i skal pa yod na zam pa tshugs par gyur cig ces dmod bor nas/ shing sdong gcig bcad de bskyel bas/ chu phan tshun sgyel ba'i zam pa lta thur gyur pa la byon te lcang sum du slebs/ rim pas snga tshang / ba gong bre mi nye long / rtseng ma'i sa cha/ byams mkhar/ mug stang mkhar thum po wang seng kung pa rnams bgrod de dpal mkhar du phebs/ bod la sdig rgyal dang / sdig blon rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig skabs yin pa thos nas/ der bod dang thag nye gshis bzhugs ma rjerdzo bar btsan mkhar la phebs/ rgyal mkhar bzung ba'i cadas gang la 'dug gzigs pas/ mi zim pa'i sa cha de chu brag gis bskor zhing lung pa'i 'dus che la sa btsan pas der byon/ der a mes don grub rgyal zer mi zhig 'dug pa de'i bu mo bsod nams dpal spyid zer ba btsun mor blangs pas/ sras khri mi lha'i dbang phyug dang / gcis gya mthong legs btsan zer ba gnyis 'khyungs nas nar son pa dang / der yod pa'i mi khyim yul spong rnams la dbang bsgyur nas rgyal mkhar brtsigs/ sras khri mi lha'i dbang phyug la 7tsheg yul gsum blon 'bangs kyis rje dpon du gdan dungs te phebs/ mthong legs btsan rgyal mkhar bzung ste 48

bzhugs de'i sras khri brtan dpal/ gong dkar rgyal dang dpal skyed dar gnyis mtsho ma 'khrungs pa'i sras bcas gsum las/ the ga mar 'khrungs pa'i khri brtan dpal rje rgyal po ltar bkur bas rus kyi ming la rje zer cig gong dkar rgyal dang dpal skyed dar gnyis mnyam por sbyar nas 'khrungs pas na rus kyi ming la byir zer cig ces gsungs/ gong dkar rgyal 'o long stod kyi rje dpon du spyan dungs te gyon/khri brtan dpal gyis rgyal sa bzung ba'i sras gnam bskosnas ldes yul phyogs phal cher mnga' 'bangs la bsdus shing dbang bsgyur/ de'i sras gung ri gung rgyal/ lha bzang dar/ gnam sa 'bangs/ dpal mthong legs bzhi 'khyungs pa las/ gung ri gung rgyal rgyal mkhar bzung / lha bzang dar nyi ma che rigs la gdan dungs/ gnam sa 'bangs nyi ma chung rigs la gdan dungs/ dpal mthong legs smad gdung bsam la gdan dungs te gyon nas gdung brgyud mang du mched 'dug go /'odzārgyus 'di yang byar gyi ban de wā gin dus bris pa las da〉sa pa lags se //49

bzhugs de'i sras khri brtan dpal/ gong dkar rgyal dang dpal skyed dar gnyis mtsho ma 'khrungs pa'i sras bcas gsum las/ the ga mar 'khrungs pa'i khri brtan dpal rje rgyal po ltar bkur bas rus kyi ming la rje zer cig gong dkar rgyal dang dpal skyed dar gnyis mnyam por sbyar nas 'khrungs pas na rus kyi ming la byir zer cig ces gsungs/ gong dkar rgyal 'o long stod kyi rje dpon du spyan dungs te gyon/khri brtan dpal gyis rgyal sa bzung ba'i sras gnam bskosnas ldes yul phyogs phal cher mnga' 'bangs la bsdus shing dbang bsgyur/ de'i sras gung ri gung rgyal/ lha bzang dar/ gnam sa 'bangs/ dpal mthong legs bzhi 'khyungs pa las/ gung ri gung rgyal rgyal mkhar bzung / lha bzang dar nyi ma che rigs la gdan dungs/ gnam sa 'bangs nyi ma chung rigs la gdan dungs/ dpal mthong legs smad gdung bsam la gdan dungs te gyon nas gdung brgyud mang du mched 'dug go /'odzārgyus 'di yang byar gyi ban de wā gin dus bris pa las da〉sa pa lags se //49

lha sras gtsang ma'i mi brgyud kyis shar phyogs su rgyal mkhar mang po brtsigs pa/༄༄/ / gnam bskos lde'i sras lha bzang dar gyi brgyud pa rgyal gdung gis thum nang mkhar la rgyal mkhar brtsigs/ de'i brgyud pa rin bzang dang / dpal bzang / grags pa bzang / bsede nams 'thum bzhis kyi sa mkhar la rgyal mkhar brtsegs/ de las so sor gyes pa la snga tshang phyi tshang zer ba de byung / de las rdor ceras dbang gis mkhar nang du rgyal mkhar brtsigs/ de'i brgyud pa las shing mkhar la rgyal mkhar bzung / de'i thu brgyud sangs rgyas rdo rjes 'dre sgong la rgyal mkhar brtsigs/ de'i thu zla'u la yis mong sgar du rgyal mkhar brtsigs/ yang me gdung stong gsum zer ba'i rgyal po spun gnyis kyi brgyud pa gser gdung gis beng mkhar bkra shis sgang la byon nas rgyal mkhar brtsigs/ de'i sprun ldan pas gcin mkhar du song nas rgyal mkhar brtsigs/ de'i bu brgyud rgya mtsho la gling mkhar la gyon nas rgyal mkhar brtsigs/ de'i thu brgyud las bstan na dang / bang tsho zer ba'i rgyal bu gnyis ma 'chams par 'khrugs pas/ bang sto pham nas yul thon skusnang ba'i brgyud pa gung gdung rgyal po/ / gzhong sgar stong phu la yod pa'i rgyal rigs rnams yin/yang mi gdung gcung po'i brgyud pa las mkhar gdung gi rgyal rigs rnams byung /yang rgyal mkhar mi zim pa las gong dkar rgyal pos 'o long bstod du rgyal mkhar brtsigs te bzhugs pa la/ btsun mo che ba dpal 'dren spyod/ rdor 'dzom pa sa thung spyid/ g.yang dpal mo bzhi khab du blangs/ dpal 'dren skyed la sras mthong 50

legs dpal dang / btsun gong rgyal gnyis 'khrungs pa dang mo nga rgyal langs nas/rgyal po la yang zlo/ btsun mo gzhan bton nas so so'i yul du log btang ba'i rtsis byas pa la/ rgyal pos ma nyan par bzhag pa dang / btsun sma gsum gyis kyang sems chung gi ngos nas btsun mo che ba'i g.yog mo'i tshul ltar bzung ste sdod pa'i zla dus 'khor ba dang / btsun mo gsum la'ang rgyal po'i sras lus la chags pa dang / gtso rgan stong 'dus dar gyis shes nas/ btsun mo gsum la gsang gtam phan tshig smras pa/ khyod gsum la rgyal po'i sras lus la yode pa btsun mo che bas shes na ngan sems phrag dog gis gnod pa bkal nyen che bas bag gzon legs par gyis shig zer bas/ btsun mo gsum gyis kyang de bzhin byas skusna/ /zla grangs tshang rim gyis sras re re btsas pa dang / btsun mo che bas tshor gyis dogs nas/ rdor 'dzom pa'i sras zo ba de yas kyi nang du gsang nas gsos/ a thung dpal gyi sras gzeb ma snyu nga gi nang du sbas te gse sa/ g.yang dpal mo'i sras sa dong thang gi nang du gab nas gse sa pas/ gsum ga byad gzugs bzang zhing skyed yang che bar byung nas 'gro 'grul shes shing gtam 'thol re smra shes pa dang /btsun mo gsum gyis btsun mo che bas gnod pa bkal gyi dogs nas/ blon 'bangs rnams kyis sbun nas thu chung gsum khrid de co/nga dkar rgyal po'i dung du phyin nas smras pa/ btsun mo che ba'i phrag dog la 'jigs nas sbas te gsang thabs kyis gsos pa'i gya gsum po 'di yin zer bas/ rgyal po thugs shin hu dgyes shing bud med shes rab kyi rang bzhin yin zer ba bden par 'dug gsungs nas/ sras gsum po rim pas pang du blangs shing mgo la 'khyil 'khyil re mdzad/ ma 'ongs pa na 51

gtam rgyud ngo mtshar zhing ya mtshan pa'i phyir sras gsum po'i mtshan ma'i ming dang rus kyi ming so sor stegs dgos gsungs nas/ rdor 'dzom pa'i su snod zo ba de yas kyi nang du gsang nas gserdzos pa yin pas na/ ming gsang lde btsan du btags/rus kyi ming la yas lde zer/ a zung rgyud kyi bu sgod snyung gi nang du sbas te gsos pa yin pas na/ ming sbas lde btsan du btags/ rus kyi ming la snyung lde zer/ g.yang dpal mo'i thu sa dong wang gi nang du gab nas gsos pa yin pas na/ ming gab lde btsan du btags/ rus kyi ming la wang ma zer cig da rung thu gsum nar ma son gyi bar du legs par skyongs shig gsungs nas/ yum gsum labaza' btung dang ma bo ba'i yo byad mang po gnang ngo /de nas sras lnga nar son lang tsho dar la babs nas stobs mnga' thang che bar song pa dang / yab co/nga dkar rgyal po yang thugs dgyes nga rgyal langs nas/ blon 'bangs rnams la khral 'dri lag gi rgyun che bar btsugs te/ lung pa'i phya las sha khral/ mda' las nya ༷rdzob/ 31nga pa lam 'tshil las lam bral tshugs len pa dang /blon 'bangs dka' las che bar byung nas thams cad la mthun gyis ngo log nas/ gong dkar rgyal yab sras rnams rgyal mkhar las bton btang ba dang / 'e1ga mtsheng nas re zhig rgyal mkhar mi zim par bzhugs pa'i skabs/ sngar rje dpon gdan 'dren ma zhus pa'i mi rnams kyis lha sras gtsang ma'i gdung / gong dkar rgyal gyi sras rnams yod par shes nas/ rgyal mkhas mi zim par yong nas gong dkar rgyal la nged kyi yul du rje dpon med par 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal yod pa sel ba'i phyir/ sras rnams nged so so'i yul phyogs kyi rje dpon la zhu dgos zhus pas/ gong dkar rgyal 52

gtam rgyud ngo mtshar zhing ya mtshan pa'i phyir sras gsum po'i mtshan ma'i ming dang rus kyi ming so sor stegs dgos gsungs nas/ rdor 'dzom pa'i su snod zo ba de yas kyi nang du gsang nas gserdzos pa yin pas na/ ming gsang lde btsan du btags/rus kyi ming la yas lde zer/ a zung rgyud kyi bu sgod snyung gi nang du sbas te gsos pa yin pas na/ ming sbas lde btsan du btags/ rus kyi ming la snyung lde zer/ g.yang dpal mo'i thu sa dong wang gi nang du gab nas gsos pa yin pas na/ ming gab lde btsan du btags/ rus kyi ming la wang ma zer cig da rung thu gsum nar ma son gyi bar du legs par skyongs shig gsungs nas/ yum gsum labaza' btung dang ma bo ba'i yo byad mang po gnang ngo /de nas sras lnga nar son lang tsho dar la babs nas stobs mnga' thang che bar song pa dang / yab co/nga dkar rgyal po yang thugs dgyes nga rgyal langs nas/ blon 'bangs rnams la khral 'dri lag gi rgyun che bar btsugs te/ lung pa'i phya las sha khral/ mda' las nya ༷rdzob/ 31nga pa lam 'tshil las lam bral tshugs len pa dang /blon 'bangs dka' las che bar byung nas thams cad la mthun gyis ngo log nas/ gong dkar rgyal yab sras rnams rgyal mkhar las bton btang ba dang / 'e1ga mtsheng nas re zhig rgyal mkhar mi zim par bzhugs pa'i skabs/ sngar rje dpon gdan 'dren ma zhus pa'i mi rnams kyis lha sras gtsang ma'i gdung / gong dkar rgyal gyi sras rnams yod par shes nas/ rgyal mkhas mi zim par yong nas gong dkar rgyal la nged kyi yul du rje dpon med par 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal yod pa sel ba'i phyir/ sras rnams nged so so'i yul phyogs kyi rje dpon la zhu dgos zhus pas/ gong dkar rgyal 52

gyis/ mthong legs dpal nga rang gar sdod kyi sa gzhi bzung ba la bzhag dgos/bu gzhan rnams khyod rang blon 'bangs so so'i blo dang byir khyer cig gsungs pas/yas ldo gsang lde btsan/ sa gling rgyan mtshams la gdan dungs te gyon/ ltung lde sgas lde btsan/ zangs lung pa la gdan dungs nas gyon/ wang ma gab lde btsan/gang zur stod la gdan dungs nas gyon no/ /de rjes mi zim pa'i rgyal mkhar 'dzin mkhan gnam bsgos lde'i thugs la ji ltar skusnad mi shes bsams nas/ gong dkar rgyal sras gsum ri gzhung thang nge sa la phebs nas gnas gzhi bcas pas/ der yeshe pa'i mi sde thams cad dang gzhan yang yul grong mang po mnga' 'bangs la bcug cing stobs mnga' thang che bar byung nas/sgo khyi yang stag la byung rdo pha bong thug pa phug nas btags pa'i dza/la da lta'ang 'dugade'i brgyud pa btsan 'dul gyis tsha se la gyon nas rgyal mkhar bzu nga / de'i gcung sku nga 3 chu.u dza rong la song nas rgyal mkhar bzung / yas lde gsang lde btsan gyis sa gling rgyan mtshams la rgyal mkhar brtsigs/ de'i thu brgyud yas lde su nas thu na la'ang rgyal mkhar brtsigs/ snyung lde sbas lde btsan bzang lung pa snyung mkhar la phebs te rgyal mkhar bzung / de'i thu brgyud la snyung lde la yas mang zer ba brtul sprad shin hu che ba grub thob kyi spyed pa lta bus/ brag g.yang sa chen po sogs la sngar med pa'i lam bton/ dwags pa'i yul grong thams cad la dbang bsgyur ba'i stobs mnga' thang che ba byung / wang ma gab lde btsan gyis sgang zur stede la rgyal mkhar wang ma mkhar brtsegs/ der blon 'bangs cher mi 'dus/ longs spyod dkon tsam byung ba las/ wang ma gab lde btsan dang sras che ba gung la rgya04 pha sbad gnyis/ la gling 53

lung pa'i mjug man chod lung par song / der rgya'i las sgo la dbang bsgyur 'dugasras chung ba dpal la dar them spang la'i rje dpon mdzad de rgya'i las sgo la dbang bsgyur bas rgya skad kyis ming them spang ba spru zer ba de nas byung / lha sras gtsang ma'i sras che ba khri mi lha'i dbang phyug la 'og yul gsum rje dpon gyi sras lha mgon/de'i sras bkra shis bsed nams/ de'i sras tsho dbang rnam rgyal/ de'i sras dpal 'byor bzang po/ /de'i sras nam ma kha' bsod nams/ de'i sras gong dkar rje/de'i sras btsun chung / de'i sras rgyal mtshan grags pa/ de'i sras lhun grub/ de'i sras jo bo sangs rgyas cung / de'i sras sangs rdo rje/ de'i sras rdzo so dar rgyas te lha sras gtsang ma nas mi rabs bcu bzhi pa 'di'i skabs grub chen thang stong rgyal po bsod stoms la gyon pa nang du gdan dungs nas bsnyen bkur mdzad/ 'bras chang tshims par dungs pa gse la ba'i rjes la 'bras chang gis kā pa li bkang nas grub therdzobu kyis nam mkha' la 'phangs pas/ chang ma 'the bar grub chen gyi phyag la babs pa jo sdo dar rgyas la gnang ste/ chang 'thung gang thub gyis dang rten 'brel gyi rtags khyad par can yong gsungs pas/ jo bo dar rgyas kyis kā pa li grag rdzogs par 'thudres/ gcig phyed ka lus pa dang / grub thob kyi zhal nas/ khyod la thu bdun ma nga ba 'dug ste gcig gis phan mi thogs/ thu dug pa las gcig sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa 'dzin cing sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa zhig 'ong ba 'dug gsungs nas/ kā pa li chang gis bkang nas/ 'o rdzo bo chen rgo kā pa li 'di ni mkha' 'bro ma 'gro ba bzang mo'i dbu thod yin pas/ shin tu 'gangs chen khyed la dad pa'i rten du bzhag go gsungs nas gnang / gzhan yang 54

rten khyad par can yang gnang ngo / /grub thob chen pos lung bstan pa bzhin sras bdun byung ba'i che ba bkra shis dar rgyas kyis rgyal sa mdzad/ sras gsum pa thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho las rab hu byung zhing mdo sngags la byings pa mdzad de mkhas pa'i thul du phyin pas/ mtshan yang blo bzang bstan pa'i sgron me gsol nas shar stag lung / me rag sag steng / spa'u gdung / byams mkhar/ shar nub/ ar rgya gdung la sogs par dgon gnas mang po btab/ sras tha chung lung bstan bzhin chung ngu nas 'das/ la 'og —yul gsum nas lhun grub kyi bu'am brgyud pa thu'u la rgya mchos ra ti la rgyal mkhar bzung ba sogs/ lha sras gtsang ma'i mi brgyud kyis ku re lung / shar phyogs la 'og yul gsum/ 'khan lung pa rnams su rje dpon nam rgyal phran mdzad de rgyal mkhar brtsigs pa dang / la casnag yul gsum du rgyal mkhar brtsigs pa ming mi gsal ba bcas nyi shu lhag pa brtsigs tshod 'dug go de yang byar gyi ban de wa gin du zhes pa zhig gis bris pa rgyal rigs 'byung khungs gsal ba'i sgron me las btus pa lags/ 55

rten khyad par can yang gnang ngo / /grub thob chen pos lung bstan pa bzhin sras bdun byung ba'i che ba bkra shis dar rgyas kyis rgyal sa mdzad/ sras gsum pa thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho las rab hu byung zhing mdo sngags la byings pa mdzad de mkhas pa'i thul du phyin pas/ mtshan yang blo bzang bstan pa'i sgron me gsol nas shar stag lung / me rag sag steng / spa'u gdung / byams mkhar/ shar nub/ ar rgya gdung la sogs par dgon gnas mang po btab/ sras tha chung lung bstan bzhin chung ngu nas 'das/ la 'og —yul gsum nas lhun grub kyi bu'am brgyud pa thu'u la rgya mchos ra ti la rgyal mkhar bzung ba sogs/ lha sras gtsang ma'i mi brgyud kyis ku re lung / shar phyogs la 'og yul gsum/ 'khan lung pa rnams su rje dpon nam rgyal phran mdzad de rgyal mkhar brtsigs pa dang / la casnag yul gsum du rgyal mkhar brtsigs pa ming mi gsal ba bcas nyi shu lhag pa brtsigs tshod 'dug go de yang byar gyi ban de wa gin du zhes pa zhig gis bris pa rgyal rigs 'byung khungs gsal ba'i sgron me las btus pa lags/ 55

bum thang du mi'i rje dpon byung tshul rgyal rigs 'byung khungs gsal ba'i rje na me las bshad pa/༄༄/ /de nas sum thang sde bzhir rgyal po sin dha rā dza dang / khyi la ra thod kyi rgyal brgyud chad de rgyal po med pa na rgya bod kyi mnga' 'og yin na rgya bod gang rung nas rgyal po zhig bskos 'ong ba la rgya bod kyi mnga' 'og min pas/ rgyal po bskos med par brten rje dpon med par phan tshun 'thab cing rtsod pa dang / yul lams mi bde ba sna tshogs byung bar brten/ rje dpon 'tshol yang rgyal rigs kyi rje dpon ma rnyed par/ gnam lha 'o de gung rgyal mchod cing gsol ba btab pas/ cad de gung rgyal gyis bka' bsgos nas/ lha'i thu gu se lang ling lha'i thu thag la 'jus nas yi/ ra la babs pa/ bud med mkha' 'gro'i mtshan dang ldan pa bsod nams dpal 'dren gyi lhums su zhugs nas rdzas skyes lta thur 'khrungs pa na/ bar snang gi sgra las/ casna thu de ni lha'i su yin pas gdung rabs mang po'i bar rje dpon byed par 'gyur re zer ba'i sgra/ yul de'i skye dman 'dzom pa sgron gyis thos pa dang / de ltar yong na mi sde la dbang sgyur nas mo la mthong bkur mi yong bsam pa'i gdug sems kyis smon lam log pa btab kyang lha'i bden mthus/ lha'i sprul pa'i gdung 'khrungs mtshan lha mgon dpal chen gsol/ mi sde'i yul khams la dbang bsgyur nas rje dpon mdzad pa'i sras lha bzang rgyal/ de'i sras gdung gragos pa dbang phyug byung / de la sras med par snyung gzhi dug pos thebs nas grongs khar thug pa dang / blon 'bangs rnams kyis smras pa/ gdung rin po che nyid mya ngan las 'das na nged rnams kyi re ltos su la 56

bum thang du mi'i rje dpon byung tshul rgyal rigs 'byung khungs gsal ba'i rje na me las bshad pa/༄༄/ /de nas sum thang sde bzhir rgyal po sin dha rā dza dang / khyi la ra thod kyi rgyal brgyud chad de rgyal po med pa na rgya bod kyi mnga' 'og yin na rgya bod gang rung nas rgyal po zhig bskos 'ong ba la rgya bod kyi mnga' 'og min pas/ rgyal po bskos med par brten rje dpon med par phan tshun 'thab cing rtsod pa dang / yul lams mi bde ba sna tshogs byung bar brten/ rje dpon 'tshol yang rgyal rigs kyi rje dpon ma rnyed par/ gnam lha 'o de gung rgyal mchod cing gsol ba btab pas/ cad de gung rgyal gyis bka' bsgos nas/ lha'i thu gu se lang ling lha'i thu thag la 'jus nas yi/ ra la babs pa/ bud med mkha' 'gro'i mtshan dang ldan pa bsod nams dpal 'dren gyi lhums su zhugs nas rdzas skyes lta thur 'khrungs pa na/ bar snang gi sgra las/ casna thu de ni lha'i su yin pas gdung rabs mang po'i bar rje dpon byed par 'gyur re zer ba'i sgra/ yul de'i skye dman 'dzom pa sgron gyis thos pa dang / de ltar yong na mi sde la dbang sgyur nas mo la mthong bkur mi yong bsam pa'i gdug sems kyis smon lam log pa btab kyang lha'i bden mthus/ lha'i sprul pa'i gdung 'khrungs mtshan lha mgon dpal chen gsol/ mi sde'i yul khams la dbang bsgyur nas rje dpon mdzad pa'i sras lha bzang rgyal/ de'i sras gdung gragos pa dbang phyug byung / de la sras med par snyung gzhi dug pos thebs nas grongs khar thug pa dang / blon 'bangs rnams kyis smras pa/ gdung rin po che nyid mya ngan las 'das na nged rnams kyi re ltos su la 56

re zhes smre ngag bton pas/ gdung grags pa dbang //ga gi zhal nas/ nga nad 'di las ma thar bar tshe'i dus byas nas khyod rang rnams nga dun pa'i dus byung na/ bod yul dgas kyi gzhung yar klung grong mo che la song nas/ mon gyi shing 'bras khyer nas gyis gamang po'i khrod du gtor cig shing 'bras gang gis zin pa de lha'i rnam 'phrul yin de gdan 'dren zhus la khyod rang rnams kyi rje dpon bstol zhig zer nas 'das so/ /de nas blon 'bangs rnams kyis kyang lo lnga tsam song ba dang / sngon nas rje dpon gdung gi la chems bzhin/ yi/ ra pa mi lnga shing 'bras khyer nas yar klung du ltar phyin pas/ lha'i rnam 'phrul gar yod ma shes par yul spong mang po bshal nas phyin pas/ spong mtshams kyi thang zhig la byis pa mang po 'tshogs nas rtsed mo rtse gi 'dug pa dang / 'tshol mkhan mi lngas gnam gyi lha mchod cing dmed sor nas/ byis pa mang po 'dzom pa'i khrod du shing 'bras la shas skyur btang bas/ byis pa gzhan rnams sngar mthong ma myong ba'i shing 'bras mthong ba dang ha las te ma 'thu par ha re lus/ de'i nang nas gyis pa mtshar zhing mdzes pa lta na sdug pa zhig gis shing 'bras thams cad bsdus pas/ 'tshol mkhan lnga pos lung bstan pa'i gyis pa de yin par 'dug bsam yid ches se / /de nas skad ma go bar mi lnga pos lag brda byas nas shing 'bras de gyis pa gzhan la byin cig da rung yod khyod la ster ro zhes brda byas bstan pari 5/ gyis pa des shing 'bras byis pa gzhan la byin nas/ lo rang la dgos zer lag pa gdeng nas lnga nga ba dang / mi lnga pos shing 'bras bstan zhing tshur tshur 'khrid 'ong nas lkog hu sleb pa dang / gsang thabs kyis rtsid phad nang du btsugs te 'thur 'ongs nas rtsid phad la phye nas bltas pas/ byis pa lha'i thu 'du ba de zhal 57

'dzum mul le ba byas thon byung / yi/ ra zhang ma la la slebs pa na rtsid phad spyug pas rtswa chun po zhig kyang tshud 'dug pa der con pa las skyes pa/ da lta'i bar du'ang go kyi rtsa sa cha gzhan na med pa zhang ma'i la la tsa sgor ba gcig yod do/ /gyis pa de u ra la gdan dungs te rje dpon du bkur nas ming lha dbang grags par btags/sku nar son nas blon 'bangs la dbang sgyur/ lha dbang grags pa rang nyid gyis pa'i dus pha ma gnyis kyi ming shes pa tsam ma gtogs rigs rus ji ltar yin ma shes nas/ pha ma'i ming ston te byis pa stor ma stor yar lung du rtsad gasto par btang bas/ de'i rigs rus khungs chod do/ /ji ltar yin zhe na/ glang dar ma'i sras mnga' bdag 'ad srung / de'i srasamanga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan myang stod du gnyags kyis bkrongs nas rgyal srid 'thor ba'i skabs/ sras bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal dang / skyed ldo nyi ma mgon gnyis kyang stod mnga' ris dang dbus gtsang du 'thor/ bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal gyi sras/ dpal sde/ casgod lde/ rgyud lde gsum byung ba las/ dpal lde'i sras brgyud yar lung du chags pa'i jo so kun dga' grags pa dang / yum dpal mo 'dzom gnyis la sras bzhi yod pa'i tha chung hur rgod la gar song cha med du stor ba de yin par nges shing / che sa rgyal gyi gdung yin pas blon 'bangs kun kyang dga' zhing mgu la yi rangs nas/ chodas 'khor nas a zhe sgron 'dzom btsun mor blangs nas phrul bas/ sras grags pa dbang khu/ga lha dbang bkra shis/ phran 31gas don grub gsum byung ba nas/ rim par gyes pa'i sras brgyud/ chu smad gdung /rgyal tsa/ sdom mkhar/ dur dang / ngang sogs sum thang la yod pa'i gdung thams 58

cad de'i brgyud pa yin no/ / 'khan ris rnam gsum dang gzhong sgar mol pa lung pa la'ang u ra gdung gis dbang bsgyur nas gdung grags pa dbang phyug 'o/ re bzhin khra'/ bsdu ba la 'ong ba dang / zur du dpon mo bkra shis dbang mo btsun mor bsten pa'i sras nyi ma dbang rgyal ༷/nga ba nas sras brgyud rim par gyes pa/ snyung la khris /go zhing / phang mkhar/ ka lam ti/ nya mkhar dang / 'khan ris rnam gasnge/ma la lko pa'i gdung thams cad dang / gzhong sgar mol ba lung pa la yod pa'i yang lam rje zer ba thams cad kyang de'i brgyud pa yin no/ / 59

cad de'i brgyud pa yin no/ / 'khan ris rnam gsum dang gzhong sgar mol pa lung pa la'ang u ra gdung gis dbang bsgyur nas gdung grags pa dbang phyug 'o/ re bzhin khra'/ bsdu ba la 'ong ba dang / zur du dpon mo bkra shis dbang mo btsun mor bsten pa'i sras nyi ma dbang rgyal ༷/nga ba nas sras brgyud rim par gyes pa/ snyung la khris /go zhing / phang mkhar/ ka lam ti/ nya mkhar dang / 'khan ris rnam gasnge/ma la lko pa'i gdung thams cad dang / gzhong sgar mol ba lung pa la yod pa'i yang lam rje zer ba thams cad kyang de'i brgyud pa yin no/ / 59

sum thang sde bzhi'i gdung dang yang lam rje'i chad tra/ngas 'u/gas gzhan/ ༄༄/ / bon thang la 'od dkar gyi yig gter dang / gzhong sgar mol pa lung phyogs dang / gdung bsam mon yul stong gsum gyi gleng gtam ngag rgyun la ni/me rags sag steng 'grog pa'i me pho rnams sde pa ya phru bzang po bsad nas/ mtsho sna se ba mkhar las yul thon nas catsheng skabs gnam gyi lha la mchod cing gsol ba btab nas cadangs pas/ sum cu tsa gsum pho brang nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis lha'i thu gu se lang ling snyo gdung mtsho skar ma thang gi lha la stongs spogs gyis zhes bka' bsgos te brdzangs pas/ thu'i yul du phebs nas re zhig der bzhugs te thu'i rje dpon mdzad pas/ ming yang thu btsan lha gnyan chen por btags/ de nas shar gangs ri dkar po rtse la phebs nas gzigs pas/ ri mtho la mdzes pa wang seng gi ri bo de mthong nas der phebs shing / gnas yangs shing rgya che la nyams dga' ba mu ku lung mtsho la pho brang gzhal yas lang bkod nas/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi sde dpon mgo nag mi'i skyabs mgon mdzad cing bzhugs pas/ shar phyogs nas thud med lang cho rgyas shing shin hu mdzos pa'i a ya gcig gdung bsam mkhar rgyal po'i bag ma la cadang ba mtsho 'gram la zhag nyal ba'i nub mo/ / mtsho de'i nang nas sprul dkar po zhig thon bag ma de bgoms nas yong ba dang gnyid sad/ de nas gdung bsam la slobs pa dang thu gnyig skyes pa la pha med par bar las ༷/nga bas ming yang bar skyes zhes btags/ nar son pe dang rgya'i las sgo la phyin pas/ bar skyes 60

de lha btsan gyi gya yin pa'i gshis kyis/ ngas gtsang long ba'i klu bdud kyis tshad 'phrul bstan nas rgya la ma thar ba dang / khyim du 'o/ga nas a ma la nga su'i su yin dis pas/ a mas lab ma nyan/ gasku1 thabs kyi lhasna nas dris pas mig mas smras pa/khyod ni mu ku lung lha btsan mi ma yin gyi bu yin pas na/ klu bdud kyi chod 'phrul bsan nas lam bkag pa yin zer bas/ gyis pa bar skyes de nyid kyis/ mu ku lung mtsho 'gram du song nas/ a pha la 'o dod 'bod pas/ mtsho'i nang nas skyes pa gzhon nu lang tsho dar la babs pa dar dkar gyi gos gyon zhing dar dkar thod bcings pa'i rtse la yid bzhin nor thus brgyan pa zhig thon 'ongs nas / khyod kyi pha yin don ci dgos nas 'ongs pa yin zer bas/ ngas gtsang long ba nas lam ma thar ba'i 'o/ rgyus zhib par smras pas/ de ltar yin na ngas khyod la dmag dasung zhig ster ro zer nas/ smyug ma'i dong pa la bcad pa zhig byin nas ngas gtsang longs pa'i mtsho'i 'gram la ma slobs par la ma phye zhig zer nas btang bas/ bar skyes kyi bsam pa la 'di ci yin nam snyam lam bar khre phya la slobs pa dang / yid ma ches par smyug dong la phye nas bltas pas dug sgrul la shas der thon sesnang / la 'u'ir la bcad nas spyug dong de khyer nas ngas gtsang longs pa'i mtsho 'gram la slebs pa dang la phye bas/ sgrul rigs mi gcig pa sa gzhi gang bar thon nas/ skad cig nyid la mtsho brtol nas khye ma'i thang la skam shar re byung / de'i dkyil na zangs chen zhig la grib nas yod pa mthong / der song nas la slog ste bltas pas/ klu bdud kyi g.yog slo gcig 'dug pa des zangs skyogs kyis bar skyes kyi dpral bar rgyab ste/ der bsad pa'i klad pa nya gcig gis zos pas/ bar skyes mi ma yin gyi thu yin pas rnam 61 —

de lha btsan gyi gya yin pa'i gshis kyis/ ngas gtsang long ba'i klu bdud kyis tshad 'phrul bstan nas rgya la ma thar ba dang / khyim du 'o/ga nas a ma la nga su'i su yin dis pas/ a mas lab ma nyan/ gasku1 thabs kyi lhasna nas dris pas mig mas smras pa/khyod ni mu ku lung lha btsan mi ma yin gyi bu yin pas na/ klu bdud kyi chod 'phrul bsan nas lam bkag pa yin zer bas/ gyis pa bar skyes de nyid kyis/ mu ku lung mtsho 'gram du song nas/ a pha la 'o dod 'bod pas/ mtsho'i nang nas skyes pa gzhon nu lang tsho dar la babs pa dar dkar gyi gos gyon zhing dar dkar thod bcings pa'i rtse la yid bzhin nor thus brgyan pa zhig thon 'ongs nas / khyod kyi pha yin don ci dgos nas 'ongs pa yin zer bas/ ngas gtsang long ba nas lam ma thar ba'i 'o/ rgyus zhib par smras pas/ de ltar yin na ngas khyod la dmag dasung zhig ster ro zer nas/ smyug ma'i dong pa la bcad pa zhig byin nas ngas gtsang longs pa'i mtsho'i 'gram la ma slobs par la ma phye zhig zer nas btang bas/ bar skyes kyi bsam pa la 'di ci yin nam snyam lam bar khre phya la slobs pa dang / yid ma ches par smyug dong la phye nas bltas pas dug sgrul la shas der thon sesnang / la 'u'ir la bcad nas spyug dong de khyer nas ngas gtsang longs pa'i mtsho 'gram la slebs pa dang la phye bas/ sgrul rigs mi gcig pa sa gzhi gang bar thon nas/ skad cig nyid la mtsho brtol nas khye ma'i thang la skam shar re byung / de'i dkyil na zangs chen zhig la grib nas yod pa mthong / der song nas la slog ste bltas pas/ klu bdud kyi g.yog slo gcig 'dug pa des zangs skyogs kyis bar skyes kyi dpral bar rgyab ste/ der bsad pa'i klad pa nya gcig gis zos pas/ bar skyes mi ma yin gyi thu yin pas rnam 61 —

pa ra shes pa nya la 'dzul nas nya la shu/ra te / /nya de grang ma'i chu dang ku re chu gzhong sgar mol ba'i chu rnams la rim pas zhugs te phyang bos kyi chu la 'dzeg pas phyang 'os kyi nya dra la tshud nas pho rengs gcig gis khyer 'ong sa/ mi'i skad khyi gtam smras pa dang za ma nus par chu bkang ba'i wa nang la bzhag pas/ nyin gcig pho rengs de zhing las la song nas log yong ba dang / khyim nang mi med pa la chu len nas bzhag 'dug yang nyin gcig thab la la me phya nas bzhag 'dug pho reng de ci yin bsam zhing las la song ba ltar byas te gsang nas paltas pas/ wa nang gi nya'i 'og pa nas byis pa dpa' zhing khyug bde ba zhig thon nas me phya chu len gyi bya ba byed kyi 'dug par/ pho rengs des bo'i thu tsha ba byed dgos bsams te nya'i gse ba de thab nang me la skyur btang bas mes tshig pas/'dzul sa med par de gar lus song bas mi la gyur to/ / mthu stobs dang dpa' tsal shin hu che bas sus kyang 'gran par mi nus pa byung bas na/ ming yang ras pa stobs can du grags/ des i tung la zer ba'i sa btsan pa zhig la mkhar brtsigs nas/ yi/ ra dang mosnal pa lung pa la skusnags pa'i yul lams mi sde thams cad la dbang bsgyur cing stobs mnga' thang che bar byung ba dang / grags chod mi zin par zhang po'i yul phya li mthong ba'i phyir/ stong su'i ri brdal dgos zer ri bcad pas/thud med gcig gis ri mthon po bcad pa las mi mthon po bcad na bla zer bas tshig de'i don blon 'bangs rnams kyis shes nas/ ras pa stobs can de g.yo thabs kyis bslus nas/ dkar khri'i thang la gser gyi mda' rtsed kyi 'dug ltad mo la 'gro dgos zer khrid yong nas/ snying gar mda' rgyab nas der bsad pa'i kha chems la /62

pa ra shes pa nya la 'dzul nas nya la shu/ra te / /nya de grang ma'i chu dang ku re chu gzhong sgar mol ba'i chu rnams la rim pas zhugs te phyang bos kyi chu la 'dzeg pas phyang 'os kyi nya dra la tshud nas pho rengs gcig gis khyer 'ong sa/ mi'i skad khyi gtam smras pa dang za ma nus par chu bkang ba'i wa nang la bzhag pas/ nyin gcig pho rengs de zhing las la song nas log yong ba dang / khyim nang mi med pa la chu len nas bzhag 'dug yang nyin gcig thab la la me phya nas bzhag 'dug pho reng de ci yin bsam zhing las la song ba ltar byas te gsang nas paltas pas/ wa nang gi nya'i 'og pa nas byis pa dpa' zhing khyug bde ba zhig thon nas me phya chu len gyi bya ba byed kyi 'dug par/ pho rengs des bo'i thu tsha ba byed dgos bsams te nya'i gse ba de thab nang me la skyur btang bas mes tshig pas/'dzul sa med par de gar lus song bas mi la gyur to/ / mthu stobs dang dpa' tsal shin hu che bas sus kyang 'gran par mi nus pa byung bas na/ ming yang ras pa stobs can du grags/ des i tung la zer ba'i sa btsan pa zhig la mkhar brtsigs nas/ yi/ ra dang mosnal pa lung pa la skusnags pa'i yul lams mi sde thams cad la dbang bsgyur cing stobs mnga' thang che bar byung ba dang / grags chod mi zin par zhang po'i yul phya li mthong ba'i phyir/ stong su'i ri brdal dgos zer ri bcad pas/thud med gcig gis ri mthon po bcad pa las mi mthon po bcad na bla zer bas tshig de'i don blon 'bangs rnams kyis shes nas/ ras pa stobs can de g.yo thabs kyis bslus nas/ dkar khri'i thang la gser gyi mda' rtsed kyi 'dug ltad mo la 'gro dgos zer khrid yong nas/ snying gar mda' rgyab nas der bsad pa'i kha chems la /62

khyod rang rnams nga sprin pa'i dus yong na nga'i skye ba bod yul gzhung yar lung grong mo che la yong rgyu yin pas khyed rang rnams maspon su khyer 31ga cig byis pa 'dzoms pa'i sgo du mgron thu gtor cig mgron thu sus khyer ba de nga'i skye ba yin no zer nas 'das so/ /de nas 'o/ la shas sku nga ba na rje 'bangs kyi rim pa med par steng nas 'phyog shā ga nas brkus pa las/ 'thab cing rtsode pas ༷/la lams thams cad bde spyid med par gyur pa las/ sngon gyi rje'i kha chems dun te/ mi lnga masan thu khyer nas/ bo da gzhung yar lung spong mo cher phyin nas byis pa mang po 'tshogs pa'i sar/ mgron gya gtor nas khrid yong ba dang / gong du bshad pa'i u ra pa mi lnga pos shing 'bras gtor nas brkus te khyor yong ba ni don gcig yin par snang / ji ltar lke na/ u ra pa dang rṣa/ ka lung pa rnams kyis yar lung du rje dponagyi skye ba 'tshol du phyin pa dang / gdan dungs te yi/ ra 'a khyodan lugs/ phyis gdung lha dbang grags par mtshan gsol ba sogs ngo bo gcis cha / na yin 'dug go/ 63

khyod rang rnams nga sprin pa'i dus yong na nga'i skye ba bod yul gzhung yar lung grong mo che la yong rgyu yin pas khyed rang rnams maspon su khyer 31ga cig byis pa 'dzoms pa'i sgo du mgron thu gtor cig mgron thu sus khyer ba de nga'i skye ba yin no zer nas 'das so/ /de nas 'o/ la shas sku nga ba na rje 'bangs kyi rim pa med par steng nas 'phyog shā ga nas brkus pa las/ 'thab cing rtsode pas ༷/la lams thams cad bde spyid med par gyur pa las/ sngon gyi rje'i kha chems dun te/ mi lnga masan thu khyer nas/ bo da gzhung yar lung spong mo cher phyin nas byis pa mang po 'tshogs pa'i sar/ mgron gya gtor nas khrid yong ba dang / gong du bshad pa'i u ra pa mi lnga pos shing 'bras gtor nas brkus te khyor yong ba ni don gcig yin par snang / ji ltar lke na/ u ra pa dang rṣa/ ka lung pa rnams kyis yar lung du rje dponagyi skye ba 'tshol du phyin pa dang / gdan dungs te yi/ ra 'a khyodan lugs/ phyis gdung lha dbang grags par mtshan gsol ba sogs ngo bo gcis cha / na yin 'dug go/ 63

lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje'i spun rdo rje mched dug rdzongs 'dir btsan gyol du byon pa/༄༄/ / lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes glang dar ma bkrongs nas lo rang lams phyogs su bros pa dang / kro mched rdo rje'i mtshan can dug yod pa las/ la tsang las kyi rdo rje/pho mtshar grags pa rdo rje/ smra mkhas spyang rig rdo rje gsum snyo brag phyogs nas yongs ba ku re lung du slebs nas sgos bsnyun byed par/ la tsang las kyi rdo rjes nged rang gsum myo/nyam po sdod nas/ pha ma'i lugs kyi sa gzhi bzung ste mi sde la dbang bsgyur ba zhig byed dgos zer bas/ pho mtshar grags pa rdo rjes nged rang spun gsum bya spyod kyi rlabs 'dir byed rin mi chog lung phyogs so sor song nas pho res stobs dza/gas kyi byed nas mnga' 'bangs btsal nas yul mkhar gzung daskutshes zer bas/spun gsum de la la 'chams nas/ la tsang las kyi rdo rje 'du rang gi smad/ stong pho zhang tshan du ye ngas nas mi sde la dbang bsgyur pas/ mi zim pa'i rgyal mkhar bzung mkhan rgyal po mardzong la phan gyi sems la therdzog nas/ 'khrugs pas skusnang la phan gyis tshugs ma thub par yul thon skusnang ba las/ de'i mi sde thams cad kyang la tsang las kyi rdo rje'i 'og tu bcug go / zhes dang / pho mtshar grags pa rdo rje ku re lung stod smad thams cad la dbang bskyur bas brgyud pa da lta'i ku re lung gi dpon chen zhal ngo zer ba rnams yin no/ / zhes dang / smra malas cang rig rdo rje gzhong sgar mol ba lung par serdzong chus thabs mkhas gamatshe 'phrul sna tshogs kyis la 'o/ bsgyur nas/ mi sde thams cad mnga' 'bangs la bcug cing / stobs dza/gas che ba byung ba'i brgyud pa'ang de 64

phyogs su mched do/ / zhes dang / stobs ldan la ba rdo rje/ mgar pa khye'u rdo rje/yang tsal spre'u rdo rje gsum ni/ phag ri phyogs nas spa spo brgyud de bum thang la slebs/ bod kyi dpon gyi rigs rus yin pas mthong bkur byed 'ong bsam yang byed mi ma byung bar/ zhi ba thabs mkhas kyi rnyed nas/ stobs ldan la ba rdo rjes stang lung pa la se nga nas yul mkhar btab cing sa gzhis bzung bas/ thu brgyud rim par je mthor song zhing dpon por gyur pa'i brgyud pa yin/ yang tsal spre'u rdo rjes thum thang chosgos 'khor du yul mkhar btab cing / sa gzhi bzung / thu brgyud rim pa pha las thu dug pa byung nas sum thang chodas 'khor dpon po zer ba/ stobs mnga' thang che ba ming yongs su grags pa de byung ba yin 'dug chos 'khor dpon po spa spo nas yin zer ba'ang gtsang phag ri phyogs nas spa gro brgyud de 'ongs pa las zer ba yin 'dug mgar ba khye'u rdo rjes sa gtsang la ri mtho ba bod yul thag nye ba mon bod gnyis kyi mtshams/ sha mar thud gsum dang 'byu sna 'jo'oms pa 'brog pa'i sar yul mkhar btab nas mtshams pa'i 'dre ga pa rigs mthe ba rnams yin 'dug zhes pa 'di yang rgya la rigs 'byung khungs gsal ba'i rje na mer bris 'dug pa las btus pa 'a/ba/theg/ 65

rje dpon dang gdung de nyid u ra gdung nag po las gzhan du med tshul u ra gdung nag po'i lo rgyus/ ༄༄/ / lo brgya phrag mang po'i sngon nas byung ba u ra gdung nag po zhes yongs su grags pa de/ stobs shugs la g.yag tso po gnya' bar bkal nas khyer ba dang /mi mang pos khyogs la btegs te khyer dgos pa'i rdo bo che 'o rang gcig gas 'khyer ba dang / me 'bar mtsho la zam pa mi dgos par phar macerangs tshur mtshe ngas byas pa'i yang rtsal dang ldan pa de lta thu zhig yod par rgan rabs kyi gtam kun la la mthun par brjod kyi 'dug pa bzhin/ da lta u ra spang mkhar sgang zhig la gdung nag po'i rdzong shul yod pa'i gzhol gyi chu bran la/ rdo leb chen po'i zam pa bskal pa'i bar du 'gyur med brtan po btsugs te bzhag yod pa sogs lag rjes mang du snang / de yang pha rabs thu rabs kyi mi brgyud la gdung nag po shes pa'i ming chags pa yin par 'dug zhib tu khungs bcad de bltas tshe rgyal rigs 'byung khungs gsal ba'i sgron me nas bshad pa'i lha'i rnam 'phrul gyi gdung gi mtshan/ lha mgon dpal chen /de'i sras lha bzang rgyal/ de'i sras grags pa dbang phyug rnams kyi lo rgyus dang /gdung nag po'i gtam rgyud ha cang mthun gyi 'dug pa dang / yang bshad lugs gcig ltar na/ mu ku lung gi mtsho lha btsan gyi thu ras pa stobs can gyi lo rgyus dang yang mthun gyi 'dug pas/ de ltar bshad lugs gnyis kur de rnams mi ma yin gyi thu yin par bshad 'dug pa dang / gdung nag po stobs tsal mi phal pa las 66

rje dpon dang gdung de nyid u ra gdung nag po las gzhan du med tshul u ra gdung nag po'i lo rgyus/ ༄༄/ / lo brgya phrag mang po'i sngon nas byung ba u ra gdung nag po zhes yongs su grags pa de/ stobs shugs la g.yag tso po gnya' bar bkal nas khyer ba dang /mi mang pos khyogs la btegs te khyer dgos pa'i rdo bo che 'o rang gcig gas 'khyer ba dang / me 'bar mtsho la zam pa mi dgos par phar macerangs tshur mtshe ngas byas pa'i yang rtsal dang ldan pa de lta thu zhig yod par rgan rabs kyi gtam kun la la mthun par brjod kyi 'dug pa bzhin/ da lta u ra spang mkhar sgang zhig la gdung nag po'i rdzong shul yod pa'i gzhol gyi chu bran la/ rdo leb chen po'i zam pa bskal pa'i bar du 'gyur med brtan po btsugs te bzhag yod pa sogs lag rjes mang du snang / de yang pha rabs thu rabs kyi mi brgyud la gdung nag po shes pa'i ming chags pa yin par 'dug zhib tu khungs bcad de bltas tshe rgyal rigs 'byung khungs gsal ba'i sgron me nas bshad pa'i lha'i rnam 'phrul gyi gdung gi mtshan/ lha mgon dpal chen /de'i sras lha bzang rgyal/ de'i sras grags pa dbang phyug rnams kyi lo rgyus dang /gdung nag po'i gtam rgyud ha cang mthun gyi 'dug pa dang / yang bshad lugs gcig ltar na/ mu ku lung gi mtsho lha btsan gyi thu ras pa stobs can gyi lo rgyus dang yang mthun gyi 'dug pas/ de ltar bshad lugs gnyis kur de rnams mi ma yin gyi thu yin par bshad 'dug pa dang / gdung nag po stobs tsal mi phal pa las 66

'das pa mi ma yin dang 'du bar yod pa sku gas 'o/ rgyus rnams phyogs thams cad nas 'du gi 'dug pas/ dpe byas na/ rgyus med kyi mi yis sde pa nag po zhes pa dang / gong sa 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi rtogs brjod bshad pa na/ de gnyis phyogs thams cad nas 'du gi yod pa bzhin gdung nag po zhes pa spyon ming dang / gdung lha mgon dpal chen/ lha bzang rgyal/ lha dbang grags pa zhes pa rnams ming ngo ma yin 'dug pa las 'o/ rgyus rnams phyogs thams cad nas 'du ba yang de dang 'du bar nges so/ /de yang bum thang u ra nas bsod nams dpal 'dren gyi bu lha mgon dpal chen zer ba dang/ mu ku lung lha btsan gyi thu bar skyes sam/ ras pa stobs can gnyis gcig yin pa dang so so yin pa kha tshon bcad de brjod dka' na yang / u ra dang mol pa lung phyogs su byung ni byung nges pa yin 'dug de yang bod la mnga' bdag dpal 'bor btsan nam de'i sras bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal dang dus mtshungs tsam dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang byung yod chod du snang ngo / / bod dang snyo 'byug gi sa mtsham sa/ la rgyab hu mtha' chu brag gis bskosnar bas shin hu btsan pa zhig la gdung nag 〈sna'i mkhar rje nga brgyab nas gnas chags te bsdad 'dug mkhar de'i rtsig ge thog tshad gnyis tsam da lta'ang 'dug go / phyis su dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang lto rdzongs 'dir zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyon nas/ dpal ldan 'byug pa'i chetshes srid lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa shar nub kyi phyogs kun hu dar zhing rgyas pa'i skabs/ snyo rdzongs 'dir sngon nas yod pa'i byung phyogs nas bla ma bde mchog mgon po dang / nub phyogs kyi bla ma lag lnga dang / shar phyogs nas rgyal phran phal cher yul thon nas se nga 'dug pa'i skabs/ gdung nag po 'byug pa la ma rangs 67

par bod du dga' ldan pho brang bar mgo gtad de song yod par snang / 'byug pa'i thog bod kyi dmag sna 'khrid pa dang / 'byug gi mnga' sde dge ldan pa'i 'ongs su 'then phyogs byas pa sku gas byas 'dug pa ni/ rgyal dbang lnga pa'i na ni/ thar du ku la pod ga pa'i ldeb grangs brgya nga brgyad kyi rgyab phreng gsum pa nas 'di ltar/ gdung nag pos gzhung sar blo gtad pa'i spyong 'os dang / lhag par dmag snga phyir 'thab 'khrug zhe rus bskyed pa'i zal thon dang / 'grag cadag tshur 'then gyi thabs blo sogs gang cir khur bsam che nges byung ba'i bdag kyen du snyo brag rdzong gzhis gang bde nasag31ra 'debs khal nyis brgya/ zhes gasnge/ngas pas gsal 'e1/ / 68

par bod du dga' ldan pho brang bar mgo gtad de song yod par snang / 'byug pa'i thog bod kyi dmag sna 'khrid pa dang / 'byug gi mnga' sde dge ldan pa'i 'ongs su 'then phyogs byas pa sku gas byas 'dug pa ni/ rgyal dbang lnga pa'i na ni/ thar du ku la pod ga pa'i ldeb grangs brgya nga brgyad kyi rgyab phreng gsum pa nas 'di ltar/ gdung nag pos gzhung sar blo gtad pa'i spyong 'os dang / lhag par dmag snga phyir 'thab 'khrug zhe rus bskyed pa'i zal thon dang / 'grag cadag tshur 'then gyi thabs blo sogs gang cir khur bsam che nges byung ba'i bdag kyen du snyo brag rdzong gzhis gang bde nasag31ra 'debs khal nyis brgya/ zhes gasnge/ngas pas gsal 'e1/ / 68

thum thang du byung ba'i rgyal rabs lo rgyus ma 'du ba gzhan yang / ༄gyi/ yang lo rgyus ma 'du ba gzhan gcig la 'di ltar/ thum thang chodas skor stod la sngon grub thob la rag lha ma chung gi sgrub gnas glu dga' ra ba'i bla ma /mi phrin las kyi rnam mgur nas gsal ba ni/ khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sras rnams rim par dar skabs la lha rong phyogs su sbas yul yi/ ra sga zhes bya bar rgyal rabs 'ga' zhig nas rgyal sras mya ngan las 'das pa'i skye ba lha yul du lha'i thu dri med dkar po zhes byu ba'i sras/ dri med 'od zer zhes byu bar 'khrungs nas lha'i bu de sngon gyi smon lam gyis re zhig thu thag la dpyang nas thum thang yi/ ra sba zhes bya bar babs pa las/ sdurdzon 'bangs rnams kyis nged rang gi rgyal po'i skye ba yin par shes nas/ thams cad kyis rgyal por mnga' gse la nas bzhag pas/ lha yul nas yar 31ga ces pa'i lung bstan byung skabs/ lta yul nas thu thag dpyang pas/ rgyal po de la mi'i thu mo ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro kun dga' bzang mo zhes bya ba zhig yod pas gya mo de'i bsam pa la rgyal po lha yul du gdan dung par rig nas lha yul nas thu thag dpyangs pa mthong ba cidang thu thag de bcad pas/ rgyal po mi yul du lus pas sku tshe mthar phyin nas mi 'o/ brgya bzhugs nas mya ngan las 'das skabs/ nga'i skye ba bod yul yar lung du/ /chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan brgyud la 'khrungs/ / smon lam mtha' btsan gdan 'dren 'byung srid na/ / sbas yul 'di ru bstan pa dar rgyas dze'agyur/ / zhes gsungs nas mya ngan las 'das par gyur to/ /de nas mi lo lnga nas bod yul yar lung du 69

rgyal po'i skye ba gdan 'dren du skyes pa bdun btang bas/ yar lung du lha sras gdung rgyud dang mjal bas/ snyo phyogs su phebs dgos pa'i lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/khyod rnams lho phyogs nas yin rigs su mi 'dug yin na snyo'i shing 'bras khyer 'ong las che zer bas/ snyo'i shing 'bras rnams shing sder zhig la bkang nas phyal bas thugs dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mang po mdzad nas/ khyod rnams dang sdongs nas 'gro zhes gas/ngas pas/ de nas yab ༷/ma la zhus pas gdan 'dren zhu cesag pa'i bka' gnang —byung bas gdan 'dren zhus nas yong bas ṭā bod kyi la la zhig la slebs pa na/bsil thu rang byung gsungs pas phad thu gcig gi nang du bcug nas gdan 'dren zhus shing sku nga bas phyo/ ra zhang ma la la ru slobs/ da bsran po khu/nga gsungs pas gdan 'dren pa rnams kyis/ phad bu'i nang nas brtasnan te sa la bzhag pas rgyal thu bzhugs pa'i rjes dang / gse la stegs bzhag pa'i rjes rnams la bode gyi rtswa skyes nas da lta'i bar du yod pa yin pas ngo mtshar che ba byung / de nas rgyal po de u ra la gdan 'dren zhus pas rgyal srid ceras srid gnyis mnyam du bskyungs pas bstan pa dar rgyas su byung bas/ thum thang u ra ru bod snu sa rgyal gyi gdung byung tshul de ltar dang /de las gdung brgyud so sor gyes pas gdan lung pa zer ba'i sdom tshang du gdung rabs 'ga' 'das nas sa mo ma sa kyi 'o/ ཿtshe 'phrul zla ba'i tshes pa brgyad la pha ma bku shis gnyis nas/ su spung po /mi phrin las byung ba'i rim pa de ltar lags/ zhes gsapa ba bzhin 'o/ rgyus ma 'du ba gsum du snang / gang ltar byung ni byung nges pa yen 'dug thog ma 'i 'byung khungs lo rgyus gsum las 'di ltar khungs btsun zhes la byuchon bcad dka' na rna nga yongs grags su u ra gdung nag po zer ba de ni sngon 70

rgyal po'i skye ba gdan 'dren du skyes pa bdun btang bas/ yar lung du lha sras gdung rgyud dang mjal bas/ snyo phyogs su phebs dgos pa'i lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/khyod rnams lho phyogs nas yin rigs su mi 'dug yin na snyo'i shing 'bras khyer 'ong las che zer bas/ snyo'i shing 'bras rnams shing sder zhig la bkang nas phyal bas thugs dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mang po mdzad nas/ khyod rnams dang sdongs nas 'gro zhes gas/ngas pas/ de nas yab ༷/ma la zhus pas gdan 'dren zhu cesag pa'i bka' gnang —byung bas gdan 'dren zhus nas yong bas ṭā bod kyi la la zhig la slebs pa na/bsil thu rang byung gsungs pas phad thu gcig gi nang du bcug nas gdan 'dren zhus shing sku nga bas phyo/ ra zhang ma la la ru slobs/ da bsran po khu/nga gsungs pas gdan 'dren pa rnams kyis/ phad bu'i nang nas brtasnan te sa la bzhag pas rgyal thu bzhugs pa'i rjes dang / gse la stegs bzhag pa'i rjes rnams la bode gyi rtswa skyes nas da lta'i bar du yod pa yin pas ngo mtshar che ba byung / de nas rgyal po de u ra la gdan 'dren zhus pas rgyal srid ceras srid gnyis mnyam du bskyungs pas bstan pa dar rgyas su byung bas/ thum thang u ra ru bod snu sa rgyal gyi gdung byung tshul de ltar dang /de las gdung brgyud so sor gyes pas gdan lung pa zer ba'i sdom tshang du gdung rabs 'ga' 'das nas sa mo ma sa kyi 'o/ ཿtshe 'phrul zla ba'i tshes pa brgyad la pha ma bku shis gnyis nas/ su spung po /mi phrin las byung ba'i rim pa de ltar lags/ zhes gsapa ba bzhin 'o/ rgyus ma 'du ba gsum du snang / gang ltar byung ni byung nges pa yen 'dug thog ma 'i 'byung khungs lo rgyus gsum las 'di ltar khungs btsun zhes la byuchon bcad dka' na rna nga yongs grags su u ra gdung nag po zer ba de ni sngon 70

gyi dus nas phyis su snyo mon la bzhi 'grug pas dbang du ma bsdus kyi bar du yod pa'i lo rgyus ni kun la gsal ba ltar yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni da lta'ang rdo leb kyi zam pa btsugs pa dang / mkhar rdzong gi rtsig pa'i dza/la se gas 'o/ rgyus dang bcas pa mang du snang ba'i phyir ro/ /dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i nang gter ston gu ru chodas kyi dbang phyug lto mon du slo pa'i skabs su snyo mon du rgyal po gzhan yod pa'i lo rgyus kyang snang ngo/ / rmin spa gro'i dpon sdu mes kyis gsol pa/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gnad cig zhu/ zhes dang / mon bum thang a ra'i rtsed pos gsol pa/ khyod slob dpon padma yin/ nga khri srong lde btsan bu brgyud yin/ rdo 'di la zhabs rjes 'jog par zhu/ yang sum thang rgyal po bkra shis rdo rjes gsol pa/ nga slob dpon las dbang thob pa des lhar spre/ dam tshig tu da phan sdig pa mi byed/ ces gsal/ de rnams lha sras gtsang ma'i brgyud pa yin nam snyam pa lags/ 85 ma mosnan ༷/la bum thang gi / rnam par snang mdzad gdan shing sgrom/ phyi zur g.yas nas gter sgo phye/ / zab chen lnga gang steng dar nag / marshags dang / dgo bshes ra sangs pas re na du gdan dungs/ thum thang lha thang thul/ de'i nub mo gter bdag lo mon du byas nas byung gter 'asdan parazhu ba phul/ gsol la byas/ de'i nyin mo rnam par snang mdzad gdan cadag gi gter kha phye/zhis gathega'//14 5 ru chos dbang gi gter byung chen mo so gnyis mdun nas/15 se dug gi mdun nas gsa'/ 16 gter byung chen mo le'u bsto lnga pa'i nga gnyis rgyab nasdo //71

tsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa bstan pa snga dar la/gtos lha nang pa'i bla ma rnams gyon te gdan sa bcags nas bla datherdzon 'brel mar bsdo/gas pa/༄༄ / / galtos lha nang pa'i gdung gi lo rgyus ni/ ṅgi du mi'i spong khyer chags nas ha cang ring po ma lon pa na/ 'ad gsal gyi lha'i thu zhig sngon las kyi mthus bskyed de spyid shod pa'i thig le shun gyi brag rtser bya khyung dkar po'i rnam pas babs/der rgyun du gnas pa'i phyag sgor sder rjes yod pa la pabang kyu/ nga tshang tri ka thung zhes da lta'i bar 'bod/ res bya rgod gyi pags pa'i thul pa zhig gyon pa'i sprul bsgyur bstan pas bya thul dkar por yang grags/ mi ring bar bya'i tshul bshig ste mi'i gzugs bzung / mi rnams kyis dris pas co bo ni lha'i rigs las 'ongs pa yin no/ /zhes smras pas kun gyis gong du bkur/ mi'i zas gos la longs spyad pa'i grib kyis re zhig skyedas par gyur pas spyos rigs zhes grags/ de'i sras rje btsan po bya ba byung / de'i sras seng nge shag bya ba byung / de'i sras rta mkhar rje sogs sprun bzhi byung / de'i sras zheng nge dang / de'i sras thugs rje gnyis byung / zheng nge des la rag 'grang sil bzung bas la rag gtos zhes grags pa byung / de'i sras 'bring ste bya ba byung / de'i sras 'bring chung bya ba byung / de'i sras dpal yon tan bya ba byung / de'i sras hre ba dpon tshul ye na bya ba byung / de'i sras 'gu ru bya ba byung / de'i sras lha 'phan bya ba khu/nga / 17 la rag gtos kyi brgyud pa byen tshul mdor bsdus kyi nang du gsal/ 72

de'i sras mthu rgyal lam spang la me sgo ra byu ba byung / de'i sras lo tsā ba ma na tan grags pa sogs sprun drug byung / de'i sras gtsang sa rdo rje bla ma se gas sprun bzhi byung / de'i sras dpal gyi seng ge se gas gsum byung / de'i sras grags pa dpal mched gnyis byung / de'i sras gzi brjid dpal sogs sprun bdun byung / de'i gcung gi sras lha rin chen rgyal po bya ba byung / de'i gcung gi sras bsod nams dar byu ba byung / de'i sras gzi brjid rgyal po sogs gtos lta nang pa'i gdung rabs rim par gyon pa rnams las gzi brjid dpal lam sangs rgyas ras chen byu ba de spyi lo 1164 rab byudwa 3pa'i shing sprel lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo nyi shu la chos rje 'bri gung pa'i spyan sngar gyon/ stog chen che sa dug sku gas gsan 'bri gung thel du sgrub pa lo bdun mdzad/ 'a7 la gtsang pa rgya ras lhan cig tsā rir gyon/ sum cu 1193chu glang lor rgyal khams su spyod pa mdzad/ 'bri gung skyob pas tshogs pa spyong bar bka' gnang bas spyi lo 1194rab byung 3 pa'i shing stag la sman rdzongs 'dir gyon nas/spa 〈sna cal kha rnams sa/ bla datherdzon 'brel mar bzhugs gnas mdzad/ cal khar bzhugs dus mkhan po gzad pa sogs ri la gyon lhag tshogs pa stong bdun brgya nyer lnga'i tshul shing bzhes/ ra li/ bde mchodag 'dus brgyud/ 'jigs byed/ phyag chen lnga ldan/nā ro chodas dug sogs bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad/ dgung lo nga gnyis shing phag lor chodas rje 'bri gung par che lngas gtso byas brgya 'thul brgya dang thur ston chen mo mdzad/ 'bri gung thang la gdan phyed gnang / chodas kyi rgyal tshab hu dbang bskur/chos rje zhal bzhugs dus dge 'dun la thur ston dang 'thul mo che lan dug dang /'das pa'i rjes la gcig ste lan bdun mdzad/ cal la la snga rting du 'i bcu gcig 73

bzhugs/ de ltar sman rdzongs 'dir gnyos lha nang pa bla dpon 'brel mar bzhugs te mi ser rnams las/ khral 'thul sdud dang / dos skyel 'u lag bkol ba'i mnar spyod kyis mi ser rnams bde skyid med par snang ste/ 'bri gung skyob pa rin po che la —brgya 'bul yang yang 'bul ba dang / dge 'dun khri tsho la thur ston chen po phyal ba'i lo rgyus 'bri gung skyob pa'i rnam thar dang / la rag gnyos kyi brgyud pa gyon tshul mdor bsdus kyi nang dang / pha jo 'byug sgom zhig po'i rnam thar dang bca sa mthun par byung / ji ltar zhi na//phu'i rjes la dge bshes gtos kyis thur ston mdzad cing bcu chodas gsum chos mdzad de dge 'dun khri tsho gsum byung ngo/ / zhes dang / tswa 9nas thur ston gnyis pa byas nas 'ordzo gcig na dge bshes gnyesnas kyis che lnga la sku/gas pa brgya tshan bcu dgu su la/ dgo 'dun la thur rtewan rgya chen 〈sna byas/ zhes gsal /rdo ༷nas dgung lo lnga bcu nga gnyis shing mo phag gi lor/ chos rje 'bri gung pa la che lngas gtso byas brgya 'thul brgya dang thur ston chen mo mdzang/ 'bri gung thang la gdan phyed gnang / cerdzos kyi rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur/ spur ceras rje zhal bzhugs dus/ dge 'dun la bur ston dang 'bul mo che lan dug dang / 'das pa'i rjes la gcig ste bdun mdzad/ ces gsal 'o// /18 'bri ming skyob pa'i rnam thar shes rab 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa rdo rje rin chen 'bar ba zhes bya ba nga bdun mdun nas/197 pa nga ldeb grangs nga brgyad rgyab nas/ —'aX gtos kyi brgyud pa byon tshul nyi stong dpe mdzod du yod pa dbu med yi ge bcu gsum gyi rgyab nas/74

lha pa gzi brjid dpal gyis rab byung bzhi pa'i shing phag spyi lo 1215 la 'bri gung du brgya 'bul dang bur ston chen mo phul ba gong du brjod pa bzhin gnyos kyi brgyud pa gyon tshul dang spyob pa'i rnam thar gnyis gar gsal/ 'thul mo che dug de'i sngon la phul bar snang / me glang spyi 'o/ 1317 la skyob pa gshegs pa'i rjes la 'thul slo che gcig bcas phul ba'i skabs rnams su/ cal la cadang / khang thu stag lung cadang /rdo sngon rdzong / 'byung bzhi bya gas rtse/ bya thal rdzong / bya dkar rdzong / si lu rdo khang /sbed smad lto khar rdzong rnams brtsigs te 'og tu gsal ba'i spyi dpon rnams bskos nas/ khral 'bul sdud dang / 'u'i lag babo la spyod serdzogs khrims sredal btsugs yod par mngon/ sa yos spyi lo 1219la pha jo snyor gyon 'dug shing sprel nya'a'athul gzi brjid dpal gshegs 'dug pa sa/ pha jo la bka' 31ga springs pa skusnags mdzad mkhan lha pa rin chen rgyal po dang dus mtshungs pas de yin par snang / gang ltar pha jos 'byug ra lung du 'bul ba lan gcig kyang phul mi 'dug lha pas 'bri gung du 'thul dos khri phrag las brgal ba yang yang phrul ba la dpag na mi ser brdab —gsig che bar mngon no/ /75

gdan sa ra lung dang dpal ldan 'byug pa'i nges tshig bshad pa/ ༄༄ / / chos kro rdo rje 'chang gis dngos su rjes su bzung ba rgya gar gyi grub chen te lo pa/ de'i slob ma paṇa chen nā ro pa/ de'i slob ma bod kyi mar pa lo tsā chos kyi blo gros/ de'i slob ma mi la ras pa bzhad pa rdo rje/ de'i slob ma mnyam med dwags po'am sgam po pa bsod nams rin chen/ de'i slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa las gtso bo 'ba' rom pa dar ma dbang phyug las 'ba' rom bka' brgyud/ phag tshi therdzo rje rgyal pe las phag gru bka' brgyud/ dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa las gar ma bka' btsu/da dang / zhang tshal pa bcesan 'alnga/sa grags pa las tshal pa bka' brgyud de che bzhir grags pa dang / phag gru'i slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab par krerdzod pa las skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po las 'bri gung bka' brgyud/ thang pa bkra shis dpal ba las stag lung bka' brgyud/ 'aX mjosnan rgyal tshab khu dpon las khro phu bka' brgyud/ gling ras padma rdo rje las gling ras bka' brgyud/ smar pa rin chen blo gros las smar tshang bka' brgyud/ yel pa rin chen brtsegs pa las yel pa bka' —brnyed/ — ste phya gyer sgom chetshes kyi seng ge las shugs gseb bka' brgyud/zar pa ye shes seng ge'i sle ba ma rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pa las g.ya' bzang bka' brgyud rnams chung brgyad du grags pa yin no/ /khyad par grub chen gling ras kyi thugs sras 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras ye shes rdo rje ni/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i skabs gyad lha dga'i brgyud pa las khri srong 76

lde'u btsan skabs sga garmel snang ye shes snying po nas rim par brgyud pa'i gdung las/ 'grangs yul gtsang myang stod khu le'i char de yang sngar sa gnas de'i ming 'brog khu le zhes pa las/ ci'asaṃ su ra lung zhes btags pa'i don ni/ yul 'di la dang po 'brog khu le/ zhes ming du chags pa la/ phyis sprul pa'i ra ma dkar mo 'i phyugs rdzis nyin gyi res brlag pa nam zhig rtsad cerd pa na/ da lta'i gtsug lag thang chen mo yod pa'i thad 'dir/ rdo zhig la 'o ma 'jor/ de drod kyis bsro yi 'dug pa mthong narmo/ der phyin pas yi ge a hūṃ rang gyon 'bur du rpā pa rnyed/ de dus grub thob gling phebs pa dang 'grigari shrī nas/ de la phul/ sgang ngos la sgrub phyag bzos nas rnal 'gyor dbang phyug chen po der bzhugs/ sprul pa'i ra mas lung bstan pas/ ra lung / zhes de nas grags shing / rang gyon 'di sna phru snu sa lung gi khyad 'phags gsum gyi rgya gcig hu da lta yang bzhugs serdzo/ / zhes gsu/ngas 'dug pa'i gdanaci sa chen po der/ yab rgya zur po tshapa pe dang / yum mar bza' dar rgyud kyi sus bdun gyi chung sgo sa su spyi lo 1161 rab byung gsum pa'i lcags mo sgrul gyi lo la sku 'khrungs/ mtshan g.yu drung dpal du btags/ dgung lo bzhi lnga la spong gi nye 'dabs pha bong snu long 'du ba gcig gi steng du bzhugs nas/ 'khor bu tsha'i tshogs rnams la chotshes gsungs/ dgung 'o/ bcu gnyis la dge bshes rta thang pa'i thad ceras sgor zhugs/ hre ba dpon mkhar lung pa skutshegs las mdo rgyud rnams mthar phyin par spyangs/tsho dgung lesna nyer gsum la gling ras mjal/ dbang dang gdams ngag rdzogs 'a1 kun 3/khyon padma dkar po'i gsung gdan sa chen po ra lung khyad par 'phags pa cung zad brjod pa ngo mtshar gyi gter zhes pa gasngo/ma ༷/ masdokyin 'a/sa/77

par zhus/ rtogs pa mthar phyin grub pa thob ste tsā ri gnas sgo phye/ der sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyis zhal gzigs te sngar med pa'i gdams pa khyad 'phags rten 'brel rabs ba//na ma sogs gnang ste 'aspo don bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / dgung lo 45 la sna phya pa grub chen gling rje ras pas lung bstan par yang bshad rikarma pa dus gsum mkhyen pas lung bstan pa zhes kyang bshad3/ri gang ltar bla mas lung bstan pa bzhin dbus su gdan sa gdab par gyon/ rtse bo la'i rtse mor gyon nas gzigs tsho snams kyi phya na 'ja' 'od sna lnga'i gur sum rim du phub pa gzigs/ der byon pa na chu mig gcig gi tsar skyed thu gsum btsugs/ shing phyag gang tsam yang 'dug nga sterdzol bzhugs tshe nam mkha' nas shin hu che ba'i 'grag sgra lan gsum du bsgrags pas/ ཿtshes rje'i zhal nas/ 'byug sgras khyab sar nga'i snyan pas khyab par 'dug gsungs/ der gdan sa btab ste 'a grag sgra'i rten 'brel gyi mtshan ma la ltos te gad na sa'i ming 'grag se ba byung chub gling zhes btags pa la 'byug dgon pa zhes chags /der bzhugs mkhan gtsang pa rgya ras kyi mtshan la cheras rje dpal ldan 'byug pa zhes chags/ gdan sa dang gang zag gi ming chodas la 'phos te chos kyi ming la de nas bzung ste 'byug pa bka' brgyud ces chags se / / mar pas mi lar gsungs pa'i mgur las/ bu slob ma bas kyang yang slob bzang / / nying slob nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin zhal hre|ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gtso bo rgyal ba rgod tshang si mgon po rdo rje las stod 'byug gnam gyi skar ma/ rgyal ba lo ras pa 'a kun mkhyen padma dkar pos mdzad pa'i gtsang pa rgya ras kyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs phreng nga drug gi rirgyab nas gsal/ cho78

grags pa dbang phyug las smad 'byug sa'i dreg pa/ bar 'grag gdan sa 'dzin pa seng ge tshar dgu/ dbon ras dar pa seng ge/ gzhon nu seng ge/ byang sems nyi ma seng ge/ rdo rje gling pa seng ge shes rab/ sgos kyi pa seng ge rin chen/ seng go rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' seng go 'jam dbyangs blo spos seng ge chodas rje shes rab seng ge ste dgu dang / 'jam dbyungs ye shes rin chen/ gsang bdag nam mkha' dpal bzang / spyan ras gzigs shes rab bzang 〈sna ste rigs gasnge/ma rnam 'phrul serdzogs gdugs the gas nyis ste/nga brgyad brgya rnams las brgyud pa'i 'byug pa'i bstan di bya rgod po'i nyin lam bco gargyad kyi bar du khyab cing / mi phyed 'byug pa/ 'byug phyed spung po/ spung phyed grub thob hu grags pa bka' brgyud che bzhi chung brgyad la// tshog pa khu/nga / mthar dgung 'o( lnga bcu nga gcig la zhing khams gzhan du gshegs ran tshe/ rmedzes rje dpal ldan 'byug pa gtsang pa rgya ras rang gi gcin lha gnyan gyi sras dnge na ras dar ma seng ge la gdan sa gtad de zlormis nas lams phrug gceg 'ong ba yod de/ de nga dang mi 'phrad par 'dug khyod kyis rjes su bzung nas nyi ma snyo rong du thong zhig bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs pa yod do zhis lung bstan de zhing lams gzhan du gshegs sku / / sku gdung bzhu ba'i tshe sgal tshigs nyi shu tsa gcig las rang gyon sku nyi shu rtsa gcig gyon pa las/ sgal tshig dang po las gyon pa'i rang gyon khar sa pa ṇi ra lung gi nang rten du bzhugs pa de zhabs dung ngas dbang rnam rgyal gyis bsnams te byon nas da lta lto rdzongs 'dir chodas rje dpal ldan 'brug pa zhes pa'i gdags gzhi dang bsod nams kyi mchod sngong du gdan sa spungs thang bde ba chen po'i po brang gi nad rten du bzhugs so/ /'a3 'drug tre ma zhig pe 'i rnam thar thugs rje'i chu rgyun ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyi gter ma bcu tham pa'i rgyab nas gsal/79

gtsang pa rgya ras kyis lung bstan te 'byug pa'i bstan pa 1rdzog mar 'dzugs pa po pha jo 'byug sgom zhig po gyon tshul/ ༄༄ / / rdzongs 'dir dpal ldan 'byug pa'i bstan pa phyog mar btsugs pa'i bka' drin che 31sa pha jo 'grug sgom zhig po ni/ 'khrungs yul mdo lams bkra shis sgang gi yang rtse 'bab chu nas yab tshong dpon zla bzang dang / yum a rtse dpal mo skyed gnyis la su ge gsum yod pa las chung ba de yin/ rnam thar nang sa pho 'byug la sku bltams zhes 'bod 'dug kyang / cadag tu dbon ras mjal dus/( khyod kyi lo du tsam 'gro gsung / sum cu so gsum 'gro le red) zhus pa ltar na/spyi 'o/ 1179rab byung 3pa'i sa phag la sku 'khrungs/ mtshan don grub rgyal mtshan zhes gsol mi thams cad kyis thugs rje chen po 'chings so zer ba'i snyan pa byung /sku chung ngu'i dus bla ma thar pa gling pa las sngags rnying ma la thos bsam sgo ma pa rgya cher mdzad/ dgung lo 3'al snu sa rje dpal ldan 'byug pa'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob te bod la gyon/ lam du lo gcig tsam song bsam yas su slebs cheras rje dgongs pa rdzogs tshul thos pas dun med du brgyal/ dun pa sos te gdan sar su yod ces dris pas dbon ras bzhugs yod zer/ dbon ras kyi byung du bskur bas mi phyed pa'i dad pa skyes/ khyod kyi lo du tsam 'gro gsungs sum cu sku gsum 'gro le red zhus/ ཿtshes rje gtsang pa rgya ras kyis lung bstan pa yin par brten bsdo bas /rjes su bzung ste lo gcig bar 'byug skor gyi dbang 3 80

chos gdams pa jo gas par gnang / bye dkar dang klong rdol gnyis su lo gsum bzhugs rtogs pa mchesgog tu gyur/ mtshan pha jo 'grag lnga ma zhig pe zhes gnang /sgo mo gter khung du lo gcig bsdad/ nying ro gar rgod du lo gsum bsdad chos rje gtsang pa rgya ras kyis lung bstan yod pa gsungs nas/ nyi ma snyo rong du song nas sgrub pa la brtson nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don gyis shig gsungs te snyo rong du btang / spyi lo 1318 rab byung 3 pa la gling bzhir gyon te ltas ngan sprul mgo bong mthug btul/ stong dpon brag skyes sri thub/ stong dpon shes sa dar/ stong dpon dar po/ stong dpon lha mo dpal lasogs mi thams cad 'dus/ ma stong phyug mos 'bri nag nyi shu rtsa gcig khro mar gyis bkang ba dang bya rgod rdzong gis thog dungs glong bzhi yul mi 'brog dang bcas pa phul/ rim gyis cad rim spa spo phyogs su gyon/gu ru'i sprul pa khye'u shel gyi rna cha dang rgod kyi ldem phru btsugs pa gnyig gyon te lung bstan pa'i sgrub gnas stag tshang seng ge bsam grub rdzong / rdzong sgo tshadas dbyings rdzong / gling bzhi bya rgod rdzong / yang rtse thu bo rdzong ste rdzong bzhi/ sgom bragathugs rje brag tsho chu brag bde chen brag ste brag chen bzhi/ rtse sdong rdo ma phyag dga' ba thug glang thang phyag seng ge phyag snye phyag chen bzhi rnams su sgrub pa mdzad de tshongag mthun gyi dngos grub brnyes/ yi dam lha yis zhal gzigs lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus/ wang seng ge phyag hu bzhugs dus chu mdor padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma a macerdzog la rgya gar dam pa sangs rgyas kyi hā/la pa sras dam pa bkri/na wang sngo/la srin slo gan rkyal nyal ba 'du ba na bro 'khrab pas ma gcig lab ༷snan gyi sprul pa bserdzod nams dpal 'dren mjal te jo smadar bzhes te sprul sku dbang phyug sprul sku gsang 81

chos gdams pa jo gas par gnang / bye dkar dang klong rdol gnyis su lo gsum bzhugs rtogs pa mchesgog tu gyur/ mtshan pha jo 'grag lnga ma zhig pe zhes gnang /sgo mo gter khung du lo gcig bsdad/ nying ro gar rgod du lo gsum bsdad chos rje gtsang pa rgya ras kyis lung bstan yod pa gsungs nas/ nyi ma snyo rong du song nas sgrub pa la brtson nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don gyis shig gsungs te snyo rong du btang / spyi lo 1318 rab byung 3 pa la gling bzhir gyon te ltas ngan sprul mgo bong mthug btul/ stong dpon brag skyes sri thub/ stong dpon shes sa dar/ stong dpon dar po/ stong dpon lha mo dpal lasogs mi thams cad 'dus/ ma stong phyug mos 'bri nag nyi shu rtsa gcig khro mar gyis bkang ba dang bya rgod rdzong gis thog dungs glong bzhi yul mi 'brog dang bcas pa phul/ rim gyis cad rim spa spo phyogs su gyon/gu ru'i sprul pa khye'u shel gyi rna cha dang rgod kyi ldem phru btsugs pa gnyig gyon te lung bstan pa'i sgrub gnas stag tshang seng ge bsam grub rdzong / rdzong sgo tshadas dbyings rdzong / gling bzhi bya rgod rdzong / yang rtse thu bo rdzong ste rdzong bzhi/ sgom bragathugs rje brag tsho chu brag bde chen brag ste brag chen bzhi/ rtse sdong rdo ma phyag dga' ba thug glang thang phyag seng ge phyag snye phyag chen bzhi rnams su sgrub pa mdzad de tshongag mthun gyi dngos grub brnyes/ yi dam lha yis zhal gzigs lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus/ wang seng ge phyag hu bzhugs dus chu mdor padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma a macerdzog la rgya gar dam pa sangs rgyas kyi hā/la pa sras dam pa bkri/na wang sngo/la srin slo gan rkyal nyal ba 'du ba na bro 'khrab pas ma gcig lab ༷snan gyi sprul pa bserdzod nams dpal 'dren mjal te jo smadar bzhes te sprul sku dbang phyug sprul sku gsang 81

bdag sprul sta/ nyi ma/ rdi/la shākyi bla ma ste sras bzhi dus gcig la 'aX/ngas pa thams cad chu la bskyur/ thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa yin pas lha srung gis bskyabs te cung zad kyang nyes skyon med pa sku nar son te sgrub pa brnyes/ dus de skabs nas gnas 'di bskal pa ma ste/nga bar nga dbang ba yin gsungs co rgyab/rim gyis phrin las dar shing rgyas pas lto mon 'dir sngon nas gyon pa'i bla ma lha pa shin hu phrag dog ste/ thog mar yi ge springs/ de rjes dmag dgang chen po lan gnyis tsam btang yang / pha jos rdzu 'phrul rta mgo'i brag ri me dathung 'bar ba'i klong na dbang chen rta mgrin gyi skur dngos su sprul pa sogs kyi gzi byin ma bakhrod par glags ma rnyed/ mnan bsregs 'phangs gasnge/ma gyi mthu rgyab pa dang / dug dungs pa sku snags gang byas kyang ma thub pas na/ 'jig rten gtam dper/ mang yang lha pa'i dmag dang 'du/ zer ba de nas byung /33na pa rta zhar nag po la zhon pa dpon g.yog gnyis byung ste/ wang tsha dpal 'dren chang drongs zer/ thel rtse dmar po rgyab pa'i yi ge nga la gtad nas/khams sprang klog shes na yi ge 'di la ltos dang zer/ rgya bshig nas bltas pas nged kyi rta mgo 'phrang na yod pa'i khams pa bya bral ba la springs pa/ nged kyi dgongs pa ma grol bar de chor sdod gzhi bca' ba ma go ba mtshang chen po yin/ grub mtha' mi gcig pa'i kyi min ser min lgo phyogs su sdod rgyu min/ yang na dgon pa bya thal dpon rgan gyis/ yang na ti'u lung du nged kyi rta rdzi gyis/ de min nged kyi grwa kyag 'di pas mig sko sredag gsum du mi 'tshams pa byed par 'dug pas go bar gyis/'a4 pha jo 'drug sgom zhig po'i rnam thar thugs rje'i chu rgyun deb grangs nyer mdun nas/82

spa hro sman rdzongs kyi phu bcas la sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i dza/la nas springs zer ba 'dug pas/ btsun pa des ci 'dug zer/ legs po 'dug yig lan gcig byed kyi gsungs nas/ gnyos lha nangapa'i dpon po la springs pa/ spyir snyo sbas yul u rgyun padma 'byung gnas kyi zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gnas/ yang 〈snas su sangs rgyas dbon pos lung bstan pa'i gnas yin pas/ khyod kyis sems can la sdug de tsam btang ba rgyu 'bras ma go ba mtshang chen po yin/ gshin rje'i che sa kyi rgyal po'i 'khor las mkhan de pas bathe'o sreg gi sdug bsngal mtshams ma mchis pa skusnang bas/thugs tshod zin pa gal che/ tshib mtha'i ko long la lab mi dgos pa 'dug ste/ tshe gcig la sangs rgyas pa sngags kyi thabs khyad par can cig daskusnas par gsu/ngas/ de yang rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags dgos la/ 'bras thu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ni rab tsho gcig bdun nam bcu dug las thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang mi 'da' bar gsungs/ de gnyis kyi khyad par ya nga / thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / / don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / / dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas nas/ / sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/zhis gsungs/ sngags la yang rgyud sde bzhir gsungs pa las/ rnal 'gyor bla na med pa'i rgyud la bslab dgos/ de'i nang nas kyang / 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras pa'i che sa skor 'di rnams ni/ gzhan las khyad par 'phags rgyud sde rnams kyi bcud phyung ba mar gyi yang zhun lta thu yin/ grub thob gling gi zhal nas/ brgyud pa'i gdams ngag zab mi zab/ / sgod ldan gyi slob ma khrid na mngon/ / grub thob byung na zab pa lags/ / rtsod pa med pa zhig rtsis su che/ / zhes gsungs 'dus83

de tsho khyod kyis e go mi shes/ byung na rnal 'gyor pa sos bde mor sdod chug de min rgyal po spyi bo skyes kyi rnam thar dun pa gal che/ thim phya gzhung gi chu 'go bla mas lung bstan pa'i gdan sa mi 'a//ra rdo rje gdan nas bris/ zhes khrol rtse yig masku( la rgyab/ yi ge yas mar dril nas la cha'i rgyas btab nas btang bas/btsun pa des lams pa rang phyag 'gyal la 'ahro na dga' zer/ nga rgod po der mi slob yi ge 'aX phrul gsungs/ zhes dang /khyen la ser dmag rnams btang rjes su spyi dpon rnams byung ste/ btsun ji/gcig na re/ ci zer la sang ni 'di 'du med/ mig 'phrul mkhan yin zer mchodangs/ pas/ dmag reng nas 'gro ma thub mai dpon rnams slobs byung ste bo de sgom chen pa khyod ma mkhas 5/ gcig 'dug nyed snyo la bzhi'i rgyal po lta pa che sa kyi rgyal po yin pa la/ khyod kyi yig 'o/ga phul te thugs ma mnyes pa 'dug pas/ khyode kyi snying bton nas bcas la'i mgon khang du khur sgog gsungs 'dug de yang 'os min nyed kyis gzu btang gis khyod kyi sprul pa ji ltar che rung mig 'phrul yin zer/ mi 'jigs pa 'dug nged kyis babs len mdzad bcug gis/ bab// rjes ra lung gi bar slob kyi lag nyed rang gis khur gyis zer/ zhes snang ngo / snyo pa rnams mthu la 'jigs nas gdung gi spyi dpon tshe brtan rgyal po/ / sgo phrug spyi dpon stobs chen/ has kyi spyi dpon bzang po/ cang gi spyi dpon don bkra shis/wang gi spyi dpon bos rgyal/ dkar sbe'i spyi dpon seng go gdong gi spyi dpon dbang 'dzi gajo 'byug sgom zhig po'i rnam thar nyer drug gi rgyab nas/'a6 pha jo 'drug sgom zhig po'i rnam thar nyer dgu'i mdun nas/84

spya la skru rī bdun po gsang thabs su byung nas/ stag gzig gung gsum gyis phyag rten byas/ nyed dbang med yin pas lha pas mna' bkal gyi dogs gsang nas rngo ngas pa yin pas/ nga cag la mthu ma btang cig zer/ da lha pas khyod mi thub par 'a dug rtsis lta bar song bas las stod mnga' ris rgyal po'i rtsis mkhan gyis/ mi de thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa yin par 'dug gnas de rta mgrin gyi skur 'dug da/sa thub pa dka'/ therdzo rang bkrerdzongs sam gnas la gasgordzod pa bkal na thub tsam rlo nga ste/ phal cher gnas gzhi 'ong la 3tsher ba 'du 'dug pas/ zon dam po bya zhig zer/ de nas pha jo'i zhal nas nga sangs rgyas min te pha ma sems can la gcad mi bkal/ khyod rnams g.yod sgyu dang jog min na mna' re bkal cig gsungs pas/pye di pro na rgan pa gcig na re/ nga cag mna' bkal gyi pha jos kyang lha pa'i sdug ltar ma btang cig zer/ sdug ji ltar gtong gi yod gsungs pas lo re re la tsho re la 'bras ltang brgya/ thur bltang brgya/ ras brgya/ srin 〈snas brgya/ lcags gosabargya 'thul daserdzos/ 'khu lag thengs gsum gsum/ de mi byed na nge da lugs pyi khrims bcad nas spyod med zer/ zhes spyi dpon gyis pha jo la zhus pa gsal lo/ /85

'byug lha ma zhig pos sprul pa'i sras lnga lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa'i 'dzin skyong du bskos pa/༄༄ / / de nas don du mnyam med dpal ldan 'byug pa'i gdul zhing du lung bstan dus la babs pa las sprul pa'i sras lnga po rang rang gi gdul zhing gdung has sdong gsum gyi bla ma dpon dang shar phyogs kyi las sgo mnan pa la sras gsang bdag gar ston btang / dgung cang gnyis bla ma dpon dang mtha'i las sgo mnan pa la sras nyi ma bskos/ thed lung dang 'o 'dus dgon sogs kyi las sgo mnan pa la sras dbang phyug bskos/ gdan sa 'di nyid du dam pas tsho bzung ste pha tshab gyis/ bla ma 'di 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin pas ceras tshugs bzung na legs bsam pa yod de las kyi 'phyo zhig 'dug pas spa gro thed thim phu rnams su tso zungs shig ces gsungs/ chu bar rgyab ri la dam pas las dpon byas nas/ spyil po nyi dza/ tsa gcig bting / mkhar las tshar nas sras rnams la/ rgyal ba'i sras macesag sprul pa'i sku / thu ga nyug ma'i don mthong rnal 'byor pa/ / 'gro ba'i don du 'jig rten tshul/ / seng ge lta bu'i thu lnga nyon/ / zhes pa la sku gas pa'i mgur gsungs te dpal ldan 'byug pa'i chodas srid lugs gnyis gī bstan pa'i srol 'go btsugs/rgya ka ma rta nas rgyal po bha nan la'i pho nya 'byor/ gser dngul gyi thum pa bzhis gtsos rma bya'i gdugs/ zhe tso smra mkhan/ rgyun 'gram gyi chang sogs slobs/ de 86

rnams la skad dang mthun pa'i cesas kyis tshims par byas/ nam mkha' nas mkha' 'gro sde barshas mchod pa dpag hu med pa bcas 'ja' dkar gyi lam la yum bsod nams dpal 'dren gdan dungs te spyi lo nya'45dgung grangs zhe dgu shing sprul hor zla dang po'i tshes lnga'i tho rangs la sku lus ma spangs par gyon/ ma 'ongs pa na 'byug pas snyo mon la bzhi hril po dbang du 'dus zhing rang dbang rang btsan gyi rgyal lab dbu brnyes par dṛṣṭar te mnyam med dpal ldan 'byug pa'i bstan pa rin po che yug gcig hu dar zhing rgyas pa'i rten 'brel legs tshogs mtha' dag bsgrigs te thugs rje brag tu byon/ dbyar thog gcig bzhugs nas/ sen/sa gdod nas dag pa'i ཿrshas sku la/ / 'gyur ba med pa'i ye shes rgyas/ / serdzogs gsungs nas rta mgor gyon te sku snyung ba'i tshul bstan/ sprul pa'i sras lnga la zhal gdams bslab bya rnams gsungs nas dgung grangs dug thu re brgyad son pa'i spyi lo1'a46rab sgyung bzhi pa me rta zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga la dgongs pa chodas kyi dbyings su gshegs so/ / sku gdung ring bsrel gdung thal rnams mkha' 'gro mas gdan dngas te cung zad kyang bzhag mi 'dug go/ 87
