gnas rnying pa'i gdung rabs skyes thu dam pa'i rnam par thar pa rin po che'i gter mdzod ces bya ba nas ba/lngas pa/༄༄ / / gnas rnying pa'i bla ma dang po dkon mchodag mkhar bya ba rab byung dang po'i me byi spyi lo 1036la 'khrungs 'dug de'i gdung rabs rim par byon pa las bka' bzhi rin chen bsam gtan dpal bzang spyi 'o/ nya'aju'arab byung 4 pa'i chu khyi lo la 'khrungs pa de nyid la/ mnal lam du spa spo rdzong brag gnas sgo 'byed dartse sa par mkha' 'aX mas lung bstan gsal po byung ba rnams/ la snyed byang stag rtse'i dgon pa na kun mkhyen mu srad pa dpal ldan seng ge bya ba'i dbon po dgon po rdo rje la gsungs te/ na bza' ber phyam gcig thub pa rin po che'i gser sku khri rgyab yol can byin rlabs can gcig rgya jo sras kyi rdo rje dril thu dang /mkha' spyod kyi ral gri dang / dung dkar gcig bcas lnga gnang ste lung bstan mdzad de/ mgon po rdo rje spa gro la byon te rdzong brag gnas sgo phye nas/ bse sgrom nang nas shel gyi mchod rten shin hu mtshar ba de'i nang nas bde bar gshegs pa'i ring bsrel phyag ron gyi sgo nga tsam pa gcig du mar gyur/ du ma gcig tu gyur zhing res mi mngon pa gcig yod pa de gter bzhes te mchodad rten dkar po 'gul shes bzhengs/ de nas rin chen bsam gtan dpal bzang snyo rdzongs su gyon nas 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad/ khyad par du 'khrugs pa mang po bsdums/ 'ong rnams kyis dgon pa mang po dang / zang zing gi dngos po bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul zhes 88

snang / lto dang 'brel pa dang po de nas byung / de'i sras 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos ma cadangs pa na/ bod du hor dmag thug nas bod yul bston pa na/ bod rnams mon yul du bros par slob dpon padmas lung bstan ge la dgongs nas/ snyo bdo ba'i sgrub chen rin chen dar po la ston pa sangs rgyas pye gse/ra sku khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa mtshar zhing sku tshad che ba dang / na bza' sa/sa/la ber gser mdog can gcig rgya'i rdo rje dril thu gcig dung dkar gcigagasol dkar gcig rten 'brel 21da gsungs g.yag shing gzer ru can ba cu sa/su ma gnang nas/ cad/ thim phu/ spa gro rnams su rang re'i dgon pa ci thob gyob sa/sung sa brdzangs nas gyon te btab pa'i dgon pa/ rta ra la/ sa dmar rdzing kha/na zhing ra ma/ phya gdugs/ skyabs khra se gas btab/ 'di red mda' pa dang tsong ba pa sogs kyi bla ma yin 'dug de'i rjes su dus rabs 14pa'i nang de'i sras snye joyi / dbyungs rin chen grub pa gyon nas sngar rin chen bsam btan dpal bzang la ci la ba'i dgon pa mtshar khang / dgon gsar la/ rdzong brag sogs rang re'i ngase/༷ / ma lag rnams kyi gzigs rtog sku na bdag mtha' rgyas dang bcas pa'i don la la na gnyis phebs/ chodas gyi 'khor lo dpag tu med pa bskor/ de dus lpu na ba'i bzhugs khri de la byin rlabs chags par grags/ khrod gzhung du cha ra ches pa rme bzhugs khri sda la mar me phul bas char chung du 'a〈sna char dkon pa'i tshe bzhugs khri de la yis gsol bas char mod la gang 'dod babs/ zhes snang / bla ma 'dis py-i shrī tshab rje/ malas grub rje/ bakhrikyil 'aci na grags rgyal rnams las dge 'u/gas khyo cheres mang po gsan 'dug de'i rjes su de'i gcung rje rgyal mtshan rin chen dgon 89

snang / lto dang 'brel pa dang po de nas byung / de'i sras 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos ma cadangs pa na/ bod du hor dmag thug nas bod yul bston pa na/ bod rnams mon yul du bros par slob dpon padmas lung bstan ge la dgongs nas/ snyo bdo ba'i sgrub chen rin chen dar po la ston pa sangs rgyas pye gse/ra sku khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa mtshar zhing sku tshad che ba dang / na bza' sa/sa/la ber gser mdog can gcig rgya'i rdo rje dril thu gcig dung dkar gcigagasol dkar gcig rten 'brel 21da gsungs g.yag shing gzer ru can ba cu sa/su ma gnang nas/ cad/ thim phu/ spa gro rnams su rang re'i dgon pa ci thob gyob sa/sung sa brdzangs nas gyon te btab pa'i dgon pa/ rta ra la/ sa dmar rdzing kha/na zhing ra ma/ phya gdugs/ skyabs khra se gas btab/ 'di red mda' pa dang tsong ba pa sogs kyi bla ma yin 'dug de'i rjes su dus rabs 14pa'i nang de'i sras snye joyi / dbyungs rin chen grub pa gyon nas sngar rin chen bsam btan dpal bzang la ci la ba'i dgon pa mtshar khang / dgon gsar la/ rdzong brag sogs rang re'i ngase/༷ / ma lag rnams kyi gzigs rtog sku na bdag mtha' rgyas dang bcas pa'i don la la na gnyis phebs/ chodas gyi 'khor lo dpag tu med pa bskor/ de dus lpu na ba'i bzhugs khri de la byin rlabs chags par grags/ khrod gzhung du cha ra ches pa rme bzhugs khri sda la mar me phul bas char chung du 'a〈sna char dkon pa'i tshe bzhugs khri de la yis gsol bas char mod la gang 'dod babs/ zhes snang / bla ma 'dis py-i shrī tshab rje/ malas grub rje/ bakhrikyil 'aci na grags rgyal rnams las dge 'u/gas khyo cheres mang po gsan 'dug de'i rjes su de'i gcung rje rgyal mtshan rin chen dgon 89

pa mtshar khang nas/ a ma sras mo dang / bla ma dpal mcherag pas gdan 'dren byung ba la rten/ phag ri nas spa spo la gyon/ skyer chu'i jo so mjal ba la gyon pas nam mkha' nas 'ja' gur thub/ jo bos gsung gyon/ de nas dgon sa khar phebs/ gad pa steng spong gsum gyi mi mang la byin rlabs tshad med pa gnang /nang 'on bsgrigs kyir ma mdzad/ de nas rdzong brag tu byon/ mchodad pa rgyas pa bshams/ phyag ma2de yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa gakhog phyal bas/ macesan rten 'gul 'gul yodam sku ma kun gyi mthun snang du byung 'dug de'i rjes su grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / de'i sras chodas kyi rgyal mtshan yab sras la snyo go phog dgon pa/ sa dmar sgang / spar gling sgang rnams bla ma dge bsnyen dang bla ma byams pa gnyis kyis dgon ma lag sa cha dbang rigs bcas phyal 'dug de'i rjes su rin chen ldo rje lto la phebs dus lto zhag shul dgon pa grang dgra bcom dpon slob kyis phyal 'dug yang seng ldeng dgon pa/ dbu ma dgon pa/ shing ldong dgon pa sa gdon dbang rigs bcas dpon po thos rgyam pas phul 'dug de nas rim pas gdan sa rnams kyi tsho 'dzin tsam las med pa 'du/ rjes su zhabs dung gyon dus gdan sa 'dzin mi yang gnas rnying rje btsun grang yin 'dug pa 'di nyid nang 'khrugs skabs bston du tshud de yod pa rnams me bya'i lor paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis sod 'grag chings bsgrigs te thar 'dug pa cadag hu gsal/

pa mtshar khang nas/ a ma sras mo dang / bla ma dpal mcherag pas gdan 'dren byung ba la rten/ phag ri nas spa spo la gyon/ skyer chu'i jo so mjal ba la gyon pas nam mkha' nas 'ja' gur thub/ jo bos gsung gyon/ de nas dgon sa khar phebs/ gad pa steng spong gsum gyi mi mang la byin rlabs tshad med pa gnang /nang 'on bsgrigs kyir ma mdzad/ de nas rdzong brag tu byon/ mchodad pa rgyas pa bshams/ phyag ma2de yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa gakhog phyal bas/ macesan rten 'gul 'gul yodam sku ma kun gyi mthun snang du byung 'dug de'i rjes su grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / de'i sras chodas kyi rgyal mtshan yab sras la snyo go phog dgon pa/ sa dmar sgang / spar gling sgang rnams bla ma dge bsnyen dang bla ma byams pa gnyis kyis dgon ma lag sa cha dbang rigs bcas phyal 'dug de'i rjes su rin chen ldo rje lto la phebs dus lto zhag shul dgon pa grang dgra bcom dpon slob kyis phyal 'dug yang seng ldeng dgon pa/ dbu ma dgon pa/ shing ldong dgon pa sa gdon dbang rigs bcas dpon po thos rgyam pas phul 'dug de nas rim pas gdan sa rnams kyi tsho 'dzin tsam las med pa 'du/ rjes su zhabs dung gyon dus gdan sa 'dzin mi yang gnas rnying rje btsun grang yin 'dug pa 'di nyid nang 'khrugs skabs bston du tshud de yod pa rnams me bya'i lor paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis sod 'grag chings bsgrigs te thar 'dug pa cadag hu gsal/

bla ma shangs pa 'ba' ra ba'i mtshe rgyus ni/༄7/ / bla ma shangs pa 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang ni/ bod yul dbus gtsang gnyis las gtsang g.yas ru gtsang gi chabs li gre nga bya ba nas yab dpon ram pa bya ba dang / yum bsod nams 'bum bya ba gnyis kyi sras su spyi 'o/ 1310lcags pho khyi'i lo la po mtshar ba'i ltas bcas 'khrungs/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i slob brgyud zur phug pa rin chen dpal bzang / drin chen byung chub bzang po/ sgro slo can pa bdag nyid chen po bzang po ba/ sgo phu ba grub chen bkra shis bzang po/shugs gseb pa sangs rgyas ri pa bcas bsten te mkhas grub chen therdzor shu/ra/ the da la dbus gtsang gi 'khrugs pas thugs byung bas/ tsa ri ba lha phyogs su dgo na pa bltar btang bas/ spa spor hre ba dpon kun dga' dang 'phrad nas lo rgyus zhib hu bshad pas/ bla ma bzang po zhig yod par 'dug gdan drongs la sprodag nged kyis yon bdag byed kyi yin zer ba'i lan khyer byung bas bod nas lto rdzongs 'dir gyon te/ spa spor phebs slob dpon kun dga' yab sras dang slob dpon sa mkhar rdo rjes dbang zhus te slob ma dang yon bdag hu gyur/ slob dpon sa mkhar rdo rjes spa gro yul gsar du gdan dungs/ dad pa dang gus pa chen pos mchod/ de nas yang tsa ri bas ma nyan par bod du khyodan/ shangs su/ skyed tshal nam mkha' dpal spyod tshal 'phrang du bsad pa la brten nas shangs pa nang zhig sku ma bsod pa chen po langs dgon par dmag 'ongs/ slob dpon kun dga'i tsha bo slob dpon sa malar rdo rje dang slob dpon khro rgyal gnyis kyis stor cig kyang 'gyon dgos zer 91

ba'i yi ge rten dang bcaspo pa khyung ba dang / bod phyogs dus ma bde rdzor dus bde ba dang yon mchod rnying pa yin pas 'gyon par thag chod/ slob dpon gnyis kyis dpe cha skusnags spyad pa rnams len pa dang jag rmedzim srung mi mang po phag ri nas spa spo'i bar btang byung ba dang / lo rang gnyis kyis kyang thags ring po nas bsus te ltor phebs/ cadan 'dul du 'phags pa rdor rgyal gyis dgon pa phyal te der bzhugs dus/ hre ba dpon khro rgyal dang sa mkhar rdo rjes bla ma mi gzhan gyi dgon par bzhugs pa nged sprun ngo tsha bar 'dug nged rang sprun gnyis kyi sa cha dgra 'jigs mi 'o/nga ba se bsod pa yod pas/ 'brang rgyas khar dgon pa btab pa dug zer 'brang rgyas lar phyin te sa brtags/ nangs par gzhi bdag las sa stso(nga ba dang lang pa byed pa'i bkod pa la phyin dus sa de'i dkyil na/ shing mi gang lhag tsam gyi rtse na dar dkar po kyi na re ba gcig btags 'dug pa slob dpon gnyis pos rten 'brel legs dgon pa bzang po zhig 'o/nga bar 'dug zer/ don du gzhi bdag gis phyal ba'i rten 'brel bzang po byung bas gdan sa btab/ wang yul steng chin la'i rgya dpon 'od zer grub 'chi khar mgyogs po gyon dgos par 'bod mi byung ba la/ rgya dpon de chodas la dkar ba bod rnams kyi pha mar yod pa dang yon bdag yin pas gyon nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa dang sems bskyed phog bde mchodag gi dbang bskur nas 'das/ mi dug pa shi ba'i dge rtsa la phyugs mang po gsad kyi yod pa de bur ston du bsgyur/ slob dpon don grub kyis rdo mchod rten du bos te gyon nas bde mchodag gi dbang gnang / slob dpon sa mkhar rdo rje dang khro rgyal gnyis phyogs gcig hu sku1nga na tshu1 phyogs su sus kyang mi thub pas thams 92

cad kyi 'ong du shor dogs pas 'ga' res long gnyis kyi bar du phra ma byas nas ngamag 'thab la lad 'dug pa la/ sha tsha'i 〈snas btab pa la khye1gas gnyis gas nyan nas 'brugs pa zhi bdang / stsodab dpon a bzangs kyi tsha bo rtsen thang gling dug gis rngo ma ses pa/ra bsad pa la/ slob dpon sa mkhar rdo rje dang khro rgyal rdo rje gnyis dril rī go —byas pa'i dmag sang rdeg gnangs rdeg 'dug pa la/ slob dpon rnams khro gres 'angeb/sa byas pas nyan nas 'khrugs pa zhi ba dang / rtsen thang smad pa dang skyer ngabang ba dril ba'i phyogs slob dpon khro rgyal gyis byas/ rtsen thang stod pa do/ba da dro da spig/ sa pa'i phyogs slobe dpon sa mkhar gyis byas nas 'khrugs par /'dug ge 4/ slob dpon rnams la sha tsha'i spos btab pa la yodan mchod kyi dam chog 5 bsams nas 'khrugs pa bzhi bar gyur to/ / mdor na lha ra 'e1 gsum bsdad pa'i bar la 'khrug mo che gas/ma zhi bar byas pas gzhan phan chen 〈sna dṛṣṭang therdzo / /bod smu gyon nas kha rag hu bzhugs skabs hre ba dpon krerdzo rgyal byung nas sngo na du sangan 'dren mang du btang ba lags na'ang ma khyodan/ da lan bdag rang rkang ba sdugs nas sku ngas pa lags pas/ ci nas kyang byon par zhu zer ba'i zhu ba nan cheri te/ ltor gyon te 'brang rgyas khar bzhugs te slob dpon la chodas gsungs/nang chen kun 'phags kyis gdan dungs te nyang stod du gyon/ nang chen pa'i gsung nar snyo dgon yul pa 'di chos rje'i yon bdag /'ang gda' zhing / nged la'ang rno ra si yin pas/ 'di'i 'khrugs pa 'di zhi ba cig byung na bsod nams che bar sa sna bas/ khrigs 'cham la 'khyodan dgosnas gsung nan cher mdzad cing / gal khri da 'ong rnams ma 'chams na 'di nas dmag 'desas pa yin gasngo/ngas pas/93

snyo bod la gnyis ka la phan par 'dug pas gnas rnying gi stong dpon dang bcas dpon slob rnams dgon la stod brag pa gong khar gyon nas dpon slob rnams la mi dang yi ge btang bas/ 'ong rnams kyis bsnyen bkur chas bzang po dang bcas slebs byung / 'ong rnams spyi ru las rgyu 'bras kyi ཿtshes bshad/ phyogs phyogs su le nyen shes pa'i ༷ sa 'debs pas/ bla ma 3tshe phyogs su bzhugs na 'khrugs ṅge gomi byed gting 'cham byed pa'i dam bca' 'bul zer/ chodas skyong sku thang mgo thog tu blangs nas dam bca' byas/ stong dpon bod la byon/ slob dpon mi nag der 'dus rnams la phyag rgya chen po'i khrid gnang / de nas spa hro nas sle ba dpon a bzang lto pa rnams kyis ltor sdod dgos zer/ bod pa rnams bod la gyon dgos zer/ slob dpon a bzang kyis zhu ba nan cher byas par brten spa gror gyon/ 'ong rnams 'khrugs pa 'dug pa khye1gas khyodags ༄/ 〈snas 'debs byas 'chigs pa rnams zhi bar byas te 'brang rgyas khar bzhugs khrid skyong dus/ nyang stod du nang chen pas dgon yul gyi slob dpon chos pa bston du bzung nas/ snyo la bod dmag sang 'dre na gnangs 'dren du 'dug pa la/ nang chen dung du zhu yig byas te dge bshes dpal seng pa btang nas bod dmag mi 'degs pa/ slob dpon cerdzos pa gtang ba'i zhu ba byas pas nang chen pas kyang gsan te dmag ba31la/ hre ba dpon bzung ba btang / gnang zhun bzang po mtshad/ slob dpon gyis kyang snyo pa rnams bde bar las blangs/ dgon yul gyi slob dpon rnams la phyogs phyogs su spos 'debs byas/ bong rnams kyis kyang 'o/ mang po 'khrugs pa mi byed par dam bcas pas kyang sems can la phan pa rgya chen byas/ de nas spa spo sgang ba/ lha khang du gyon 94

na raka bskang bshags phul/ sle ba dpon rnams kyis 'ordzo gsum 'khrugs pa mi byed pa'i dam bca' thul/ bla ma skal ldan pas gdan dungs te shar kun bzang gling du gyon gang la gang 'dod chodas gsungs/ tsha tsha sgang pa dang tog la ba lo mang 'thab pa sus kyang ma bsdums pa phyogs gnyis gar gros 'debs dang chesnas 'brel byus/ phyis mi 'thab pa'i las blangs dam bcas so/ /de nas dgon du gyon snyor gtan du bzhugs dgos/ nged rnams kyang phyis su 'khrugs pa mi byed pa'i dam bca' zer nas chodas skyong sku thang mgo rdzog hu blangs/ phreng ba la 'jus nas thams cad kyis dam bcas/ de nas spa hro 'brang rgyas dgon par gyon nas thugs dam 'phel bar bzhugs te dgung 'ordzo brgyad cu gya gsum la sna gtad tsam chu mosna lug gi sgocho 'phrul zla ba'i tshos pal sgra cad sa g.yos bcas zhi bar gshegs/ sku gdung yang da lta 'brang rgyas khar bzhugs yod pa yin no/ / 95

na raka bskang bshags phul/ sle ba dpon rnams kyis 'ordzo gsum 'khrugs pa mi byed pa'i dam bca' thul/ bla ma skal ldan pas gdan dungs te shar kun bzang gling du gyon gang la gang 'dod chodas gsungs/ tsha tsha sgang pa dang tog la ba lo mang 'thab pa sus kyang ma bsdums pa phyogs gnyis gar gros 'debs dang chesnas 'brel byus/ phyis mi 'thab pa'i las blangs dam bcas so/ /de nas dgon du gyon snyor gtan du bzhugs dgos/ nged rnams kyang phyis su 'khrugs pa mi byed pa'i dam bca' zer nas chodas skyong sku thang mgo rdzog hu blangs/ phreng ba la 'jus nas thams cad kyis dam bcas/ de nas spa hro 'brang rgyas dgon par gyon nas thugs dam 'phel bar bzhugs te dgung 'ordzo brgyad cu gya gsum la sna gtad tsam chu mosna lug gi sgocho 'phrul zla ba'i tshos pal sgra cad sa g.yos bcas zhi bar gshegs/ sku gdung yang da lta 'brang rgyas khar bzhugs yod pa yin no/ / 95

yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed las gsal ba'i dung rengs kyi lo rgyus ni/༄༄ / / de yang snyo rdzongs 'di nyid chos rje dpal ldan 'grug pa'i gdul zhing du ma gyur pa sngon gyi dus su rgyal po med par brten rgyal khrims med pa'i stabs kyis dmu rgod gnya' rengs kyi mi rigs/ shar dung snyo dung zhes pa khrims med lung med rang gar 'phyog bcom snyo mon 'dir byed kyi yod pa ma tshad/ bod du gtsang 'u yug gos sngon dang shangs lung pa rnams su'ang 'phrog bcom byed mkhan dung rengs mang po yod pa la/ dus rabs 13pa'i nang sa kyi bla ma 'go mgon chodas rgyal 'phags pas dgas gtsang lams gas/ma thams cad mnga' tshedag hu bcug kyang snyo mon mnga' 'og tu ma bsdus pas dung rengs kyi la gnon tsam bskos 'dugadus rabs 14pa'i nang sa skyu pa'i bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal gyis/phyag gam ga lams pa dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyis gcesas pa'i dpa' brtul mi bdun la bka' bkod gnang ste dung rengs rnams 'dul ba'i 'go btsams 'duga'ong bdun gyis dbus gtsang gi dmag rnams bsdus te dung rengs kyi la gnon byed pa'i bar la khams pa dge 'dun rgyal mtshan tshe las 'das pa'i skabs la chems la/ khyod rnams las bo bo'i tshab 'phags pa dpal bzang po bskos zhes/lab pa ltar bskos te 'phags pa dpal bzang po'i thabs mkhas gaskusna 'phrul gyis shangs dang 'u yug gos sngon rnams su yod pa'i dung rengs rnams/ dbus gtsang gi dmag gis 'ded de 'dul ba'i ska bas su shar dung gi dpon don grub dar rgyas 96

zer ba de yis dpon 'phags pa dpal bzang po la mgo gtad zhus te/ shar dung la 0togs pa'i mi sna dug btus rnams khrid de 'bul 'a di bzang pe khyer te dpe na 'phags pa dpal bzang perdzo'i nge bltas te mnga' zhabs ༄/ 'dzul/ btsan mkhar tha'akhu sa cad bshig sa dang mi cerdzor dbang rigs thams cad mnga' khengag hu bsdus te rig8 dung bi mi dug lngardzo bltas pa rnams las 'dzin la bcug pas gzhis chags te dung rengs kyi mi brgyud rnams/ bod du gtsang nyang stod na da lta'ang mang ra ba rsha shā da de yod par grags/ 4de rting snyo dung rnams 'dul phyir dpon 'phags pa dpal bzang po dasung dam sa rnams phag ri rin chen sgang du byon nas/ snyo spa spo ban 'phrang pa'i slob daso/ ki sta ga 'od zer bya ba de 'jam spos thabs kyis bkug zas chang dang / zhwa 7 sa la se gas pa ster spyin bzang po rim par byas pa la/ gzhan gyis kyang stag drod zer la 'gran gyi 'dug pa las/ snyo dung gi slob dpon dug tshad mang po phag ring bos te/ zas chang gis la brid nas/ dung rengs kyi mi dug btus brgya dug cu tsam bsad/ maserdzo lag gnad che ba rnams rin chen snang gi mabo|na khang dang /pyo rnams kyi them 'og na yod/ de rting bla chen bdag nyid chen po'i bka' bzhin des/ ri rnam rgyal rdzong brtsigs/ spa spo/ nyas/ khang thu stag lung sogs lto dung zi gi shā cha thams cad tshesag hu bcug phag ri'i las 〈sna che chung rnams btsugs te/rjo pa ngango/na sngan ma dpon 'phags pa dpal bzang po'i gtsung po 'phags pa rin che na bya ba de bskos/ ci de ltar shar dung gi rigs rnams snyo rdzongs 'di nas yul 'phos te rtsa med du 97

bzos 'dug pa dang / snyo dung gi rigs dug tshad phag rir bos te bsad nas snyo bod kyi mi sde rnams bde bar bkod 'dug pa'i lo rgyus/ stag tshang lo tsā bas btsams pa'i rgya nge da yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed las/ lha dbang sprul pa dpal ldan shar la ba'i byon tshul las gsal ba bzhin/ lha dung shin hu nyam dma' ba'i mi brgyud spa gro dpon gyi mnga' 'og dung gnyer pa'i mi ser spro dum pa zhe thon sa'i yul/ dung nang zer ba'i mi rnams rje dpon che chung ma shes par spa ro dpon slob kyi ti'u yod da/ dung gnyer pa'i phyag dam yod da zer mkhan gyi lung pa'i mi rnams yin no/ /dung rengs kyi lo rgyus gzhan yang / dodan sa chen po sa sku'i bka' khros pu rnams kyis cwa ce/ 'gro mgon shākya blo bros dang / dpon sangs rgyas rin chen dang / mgo yul cho bzhi'i rgyags dpon rnams kyis/ rin po che'i ('jam dbyungs kun dga' seng go) dung du zhu ba phul nas/ snyo phyogs kyi slob dpon 'di rnams grang gi thu slob tu gda' bas/ bong rnams la dung reng 'di rnams 'don par zhu zhes zhu ba nan chen phrul bas/ sang thede stag 'e1 zla ba la phyags btegs nas/phag rir spyan dungs te/ zhes dang / sdung reng rnams yul du babs nas phyis 'tshe bar mi byed pa'i dam bcas te/ grong khyer dang / 'gron po'i chogs dang /sems can rnams la mi 'jigs pa'i spyin pas lus dang sems bde bas tshims par byas so/ / zhes dang / yang de'i dus na dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po dmag 'a7 'jam dbyangs kun dga' seng ge'i rnam thar bcu dgu'i rgyab nas/'a8 nyer gcig gi mdun nas/ 'a yang sku brgyad kyi rgyab nas/98

sde dang bcas te nying rong gyon nas/ ra lung pa la dpon chen pa'i gsung gis snyo brag dang yar 'grog gi phyogs na/ khyod kyi sle ba ma dang ma na bdag tu ma gyur pa med par 'dug pas/ snyo pa'i dpon jo bo dpon brgyud dang / yar 'brog gi che btsan dang / sa 5/la gyi rgan pa rnams nge sa/ dung reng rnams 'bab pa'i khrigs chags byed dasku sa/ de ma ༷/nga na 〉treng rnams la dmag byed pa yin gas/ngas pa la/ tshul de nyid ra lung pa rnams kyis rin po che'i grang du zhus pas/ de bzhin du byed dgos gsungs/ 'byug nas nying sor gyon/ dpon chen pa mjal nas/dung rengs rnams babs shing dmag mi mdzad pa'i khrigs mdzad/ sems can mang po'i srog bskyabs shing / mi 'jigs pa'i spyin pas rgyal khams byin po bde ba la bakho do/ / zhes gsal/ ba'i lo spyo lo 1347 rab byung 6 pa'i me mo phag la dung rengs rnams babs shing / khrigs mdzad de mi ring bar 'jam dbyangs kun dga' seng ge zhi bar gshegs 'dug sku /99

grub chen lcags zam pa thang stong rgyal po gyon pa'i lo rgyus skor /༄༄ / / shangs pa bka' brgyud khyi bstan pa lto rdzongs su spel ba po grub chen lcags zam pa thang stong rgyal po ni/ la stod byang gi sa cha rgyal sa rin chen sdings bya ba na/ yab rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang yum rgya gar lha mo'i sras su spyi lo 1385shing glang lor sku 'khrungs/ yab yum gyis bla ma chodas skyong dpal can du klog yig bslab bcug pas brda bstan pa tsam gyis mkhyen/ ceras rje nyi ma seng ge'i grang du rab byung mdzad mtshan brtsodan 'grus bzang por gasku/la/ ceras rje bsam grub rgyal mtshan serdzogs las mkhas par byings/ grub chen bzang perdzo dpal ba la ni gu ceras dug dang martse na pe phyag dug pa sku gas zhus tsho zhal gzigs te bstan pa sems can gyi don g.yol ba med par gyis shig ngas kyang lus dang grib bzhin phrin las sgrub bo zhes gsungs/ spyi lo 1433 rab byung 7 pa'i chu mo glang lo dgung lo don gsun la phebs pa na phag rir byon pa dang / jo mo lha ri/ rdo rje dug skyes/ khyung bsdogad bcas kyis snyo la bzhi la byon par zhus te tshib thob dpon slo ba rnams spa spo la khyodan nas stag tshang seng ge bsam grub hu bzhugs/ phyar pa'i sgrub macerd mdzad de dpal rdo rje gzhon nus gtso so ra mdzad sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs zhal gzigs/ stag tshang gnas bdag klu bdud mgo dgu de na re/ khyod rang gi chodas skar 'o/ rgyan chen pos bzhag yod pa'i gter zab mo 'don ji/ra zhu zer ba dang /stag chang brag logs nas che sa gted shog dril 'dom bcu tham yod pa zhib/ gter 100

nas bton/ stag tshang gi ri rgyud dug sprul nag po thur du rgyug pa 'du ba spa khro lung pa gzhung gshags byed pa lta bu'i sna la mchod rten bzhengs pa'i sa 'dul mdzad de zlum narmegs lha khang mchod rten bzhengs grub pa dang / 'og gdon klu nad shin hu nyung mdzo nad sde bcas stong 'gro gsungs/ de nas rdzong brag la gyon mchod rten la rab gnas gserdzol dus byungs spyodang phyag bzhi pa zhal gzigs phrin las 'grub po zer mi snang bar song / de nas phyar rdo ru gyon 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur nas snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje chen po padma 'khu/nga gnas gsum gyis zhal gzigs/ ri therdzo ta la dang 'du gsungs/ de'i ri rgyud rta mchog sgang du zhag gsum bzhugs te sa 'dul mdzad de sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs/ mon pa bde ba bzang po la sogs pu zhal slob mang du byung / de nas brag wang steng chen du byon/ phyug po tshe/ lag byu bas sko g.yu krang ga khal bcu bdun ri ba gcig phul te chu brtasnan par zhus pas chu bton mi phyugs 'tsho ba'i lhag zhing 'ga' la 'dren rgyu yod pa byung / de nas go phog la gyon bla ma rgyal mtshan la nga byung chub kyi tsu/na lam 'dzugs pa yin pas lcags stobs che ba dbo sa gsungs/ lcags kyi rkang thu brgya tham pa phul gyi grub rtags gcig dgos zer/ tshib rtags dgos na zam ma gi na chu rdo yar longs sprodag gsungs/ rdo de sta res gshags gasnge/ngas gshags ma thub/ tshib therdzob chen nge sa phyag mdzub deng pas phyed gshags la song ba'i dkyil na sdig pa ra dza mthe bong tsam gcig la sdig phyug brgya stong tsam dbugs snyeb snyeb 'dug de'i rgyu ci yin dris/khyod kyi pha gong mas mi shi'i dge ba byas pa rnams ma dag pa'i rnam smin yin gsungs grub thob chen pos ting nge 'dzin thun gcig bsgoms pas/ de rnams 'ja' 101

khur po stong phrag gcig dang bzhi brgya/ snag tsha dang sgo ga gya la sogs pa'i dngos sgo gzhan khur bdun brgya rnams spa gro'i dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi grwa pa dang ma na bdag rnams kyis dad blangs kyis phag ri'i khar bkyil/ zhes grub chen thang lha nga rgyal po'i rnam thar lams kyi spar ma 31ga grangs gya gnyis kyi rgyab 31ga nas gsal ba las mis pa ste/ sngon spyi lo 1433 la gyon pa'i grub chen lcags zam pa thang stong rgyal po gu ru rin po che dngos dang 'du ba la phyogs ris chags sdang ga la yod/ de nyid kyi gdan sa bzung mkhan brgyud 'dzin rnams las rta mchodag sgang gi lha khang phyis su sgyi lo 1627 'do skor la thim rdzong pa a'us mes 'jig kyen byas lugs la dpag na bla lag lnga'i gras sa/ gte gas pa'i lcags zam pa rta macesag sgang i gdan 'dzin pa de nyid yin par nges so/ / chos 'byung byams mgon smon mtha'i phreng bar bla ma lag lnga zhes pa yang yang gsungs kyang 'di dang 'di zhes pa'i rkang grangs brtsis mi 'dug mod/ zhabs dung rnam thar chodas kyi spyin chen po'i dbyungs su zhabs dung rang gis lha gnas gnyis/ ka31ga pa gnyis lcags zam pa zhes lnga gsal bar gsungs 'dug pa las/ 'dir bla ma lha pa/ gnas rnying pa/ kastsodag pa/ lcags zam pa rnams kyis thog mar snyo rdzongs 'dir bstan pa ji ltar btsugs pa'i lo rgyus yig cha gzhan du mi gsal zhing yig cha rnams lag tu'ang 'byedar dka' bas na/ 'dir yig snarags la ma 'dzems par gzhan las thung zad gsal bar bsgo dgos don de yin no/ / 103

gaḥthog pa'i sprul sku bsed nams rgyal mtshan byon pa'i lo rgyus skor/༄༄ / / snyo rdzongs 'dir mtshag pa'i bstan pa spel ba po sprul sku bsod nams rgyal mtshan ni/ phur pa yang gsang bla med lung byang gsal ba'i nang nas bsod nams ming can rta sgrul khyi lo pa/ rin chen rigs can lams kyi phyogs nas 'byung / /zhes gu ru rin po ches lung bstan pa bzhin 'khrungs yul lams nyag rong gzhag gi yul zhes pa na/ yab dpon chen a dkar dang yum khyi mo sman bya ba gnyis kyi sras su spyi lo 1466 rab byu nga 8 pa me pho khyi'i lo la 'khrungs 'dug dgung lo bdun la kaskunag tu byon te rab tu byung nas ye shes 'thum dang nam mkha' dpal pa la se gas pa las shin tu mkhas par sbyangs/ ye shes 'thum bod dbus gtsang brgyud de 'bras rdzongs gnas sgo phye bar byon pa nas bsod nams rgyal mtshan la dag snang zhal gzigs byung nas yar sgo ga ces gsungs pa bzhin spyi lo 1493rab byung 8pa chu glang lo la bod dbus gtsang brgyud de sbas yul 'bras rdzongs gnas kyi byang sgo theg chen chos sdings bya bar ye shes 'bum gyi grang du phebs/ de nas spyi lo 1494 shingasngag lor dpon slob gnyis kyis 'bras rdzongs gnas sgo phye nas lo lnga hril po der bzhugari smu pa na ye shes 'thum zhi bar gshegs nas dgongs rdzogs sgrub rgyu serdzogs kyi brel bas gnas gzhis darga na sde ma chags zhes gsungs 'dugasprul sku bskusnad nams rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar rang gi zhal gsungs ma ldeb grangs skusna bdun gyi rgyab yig phreng gnyis pa nas/ de dang dus mtshungs spa gre stag tshang nas/ /104

bla ma ngang rgyud rgyal po zhes bya ba/ / rang gi thung bstan nang gi gya chen yin/ /de yis gtso byas snyo yi dad 'dus kyis/ / gdan 'dren dos dugs yang yang byung ba'i tshig /de yi ngo ma khyogs te snyo ru 'ongs/ / spa gro ༄da thing shar lung tshun chad kyi/ / 'gro phan dag kyang bsam gyis mi khyab khu/nga / / slar 'o/ga stag tshang sakanas su slebs pa'i tshe/ / bu chen grwa sle ba rnams kyis bdag la ni/ /thun mo nga ma yin zhu ba 'di ltar phul/ / dbus gtsang mdo khams khyad par saḥthog phyogs/ / dag pa'i zhing yin bstan pa nam yang dar/ / bdag cag mo na yul mtha' 'acerdzob ceras mi dar/ /dud 'gro lta bu'i blun sangs sems can la/ / brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung ba dang / / khyad par e rgyan chen po'i gnas chen te/ / stag tshang seng ge bsam grub 'di nyid du/ / sgrub sde gcig kyang rab hu 'dzugs par zhu/ /de ltar yang yang zhu ba nan gyis phrul/ / zhes dang / ldeb grangs bzhi bcu tham pa'i rgyab phreng bzhi pa nas/ de nas me mo yos kyi lo la ni/ /thog mar sa gzhi byin brlabs 'dul tsam byas/ /de dus bdag gis bzhi bcu zhe gnyis 'o/na/ / sa pho 'byug gi 'o/ la ming bting ngo / / zhes gsungs pa bzhin spyi 'o/ 1508rab byung 9pa sa pho 'byug gi lo la stag tshang ma/ rgyan rtse mor sgrub sde btsugs pa gsal/ de bzhin ldeb grangs zhi bdun nas/ thog mar stag tshang mkha' 'gro 'dus pa ru/ / nam mkha' cadad zer dbang phyug rgyal mtshan dang / / bla ma ngang rgyud rgyal skutshegs gces byas pa'i/ / las ldan lnga brgya tsam zhig 'tshogs pa la/ / rnying ma'i rgyud 'thum ye ngas su rdzogs par byas/ / dus bzang rnams su me tog char babs shing / / ngo mtshar ltas dang byin rlabs dpag med byung / / de nas shar phyogs kun bzang gling pa yi/ / bla ma rgyal 105

mtshan ye shes gtso byas pa'i/ / thu slob yon bdag rnams kyis gdan dungs te/bla ma dgongs 'dus dkyil 'bor zhal phyo nas/ / las ldan kyi ser brgyad brgya tsam zhig la/ / smin grol chotshes kyi char pa rab tu phab/ / gzhan yang shar dang sngan lung rla thang du/ / snga phyi kun la lan bdun tsam zhig phyin/ / zhes dang / tshogs pa khri phrag mang po 'dus pa byas/ / las 'brel chodas kyi dge sdig spang blang dbye/ /thams cad dkar po'i lam la rab hu bkod/ / ces dang / mdor na cad lung shar phyogs thams cad kyang / / mos shing 'dud de dgon pa sgrub sde rgyab/ / tha dad so sor 'gyal ba zhabs tog byas/ / g.yu dang khro dang dngul spyad 'gru yi rigs/ / rta 'thul grangs kyis mi chod yang yang phrul/ /de tsho lan gcig bum thang phyogs su phyin/ /bla ma tshe dbang rgyal pos gdan dungs te/ / zhes bum thang du gyon 'dug pa dang / zhi khro thur gsum la sogs dbang snu sa kyis/ / mtha' 'khob mun pa'i mig rum rab tu bsal/ / rig 'dzin chen po padma gling pa dang / / rten 'brel 'grigs nas gsang sngags bstan par phan/ / phan tshun gnyis gar legs stogs cher yode de/ / sems can bsku da nams dman pas cung ma 'grigs/ / zhes sum thang tang se sbri bar gyon te zhi khro dang thur pa la sogs pa'i dbang chodas kyi 'gro don mdzad/ gter bton padma gling pa dang mjal 'phrad byung med pa 'du/ bde bar slar blo/ ga 'khro phan rgya chen 'grub/ / khyad par sgrub gnas te/ rgyan rtse mor 'dir/ / sto bod mos pa'i dad 'dus dpag med la/ / bka' brgyad dgongs 'dus snyo gter byung gter skor/ /thos grol la sogs zab chos dpag med rnams/ / smin byed dbang dang spol byed gdams pa bcas/ / dbyar dgun ston 106

dpyid thun mtshams med pa dra/ / rim gyis smin spyodal lam la bkod par byas/ /ces dang / yang gcig glang ma lung dang ngos bzang ba'i/ / bla ma su chen grwa slob yon bdag gis/ / yang yang gdan dungs ཿtshes dbang dpag med btsugs/ ces dang / sgrub sde dgon pa phul zhing btsugs pa ste/ / ma cadangs bstan pa'i rgyun la pha ri par byas/ /de dus brag dbang phyogs su phyin pa'i dus/ / 'dren pa'i zam par mi yis 'khur ba las/ / zam pa chad pas gnyis ka chu la lhung / / dbyar gyi chu chen rab hu rgyas dus yin/ / zhes dang / shin hu gting ring dag hu song gyur kyang / / rang la skyon med 'o yang ma shi tsam/ / bdag gi gos la rlan gyis ma gos 'dug / thams cad dga' ste ya mtshan cher shu/ra nas/ / sangs rgyas dngo sa kyi 'du shes dad pa thob/ / spa spo shag pa'i yul du phyin tsam na/ / rdo sri lcags zam thog ga'i thu slob kyis/ / gus pas spyan dungs dgon pa gong cadag phul/ / ces dang / dgon pa de ru snga phyi bar dag la/ / lo zla zhag sogs mang dag bsdad pa yis/ / chodas dang dbang sogs ji snyed btsugs par gyur/ / spa hro smad phyogs gdul byu dbang du bsdus/ /de cho skabs shig bdud mi 'o/ga lta mkhan/ / 'ga' yis bdag la gya tshoms byed par bshams/ / me dgang dag tu brdzus te rdzu 'phrul bstan/ / gshed ma bred cing skyengs nas slar log go / 'on kyang ma 'ongs 'brel gas gdul byar 'gyur/ / zhes dang / stag tshang sku rgyan rtse mor rgyang rtse dpon sa bdag mo grang gis kyi ser brgyad brgya tsam la slar yang rnying ma rgyud 'bum gyi lung gnang 'dug pa'i 'bul ba la rnying ma rgyud 'thum cha tshang phyal 'dug pa gsal/deng sang snga 'gyur rnying ma'i rgyud 'thum lung / skor le than thun yod pa mang 'dug 107

kyang / / yongs rdzogs bdag tsam min pa dkon pa 'du/ /de dus bdag mo dung gis chodas yodan la/ / rgyud 'thum po ti so lnga tshang ma phul/ / zhes gsungs 'dugashes bya'i chu gter snu sa kyi rgya mtsho las/ / zab don yid bzhin nor bu rab blangs te/ /theg pa'i rnam dbye nyi cad rab gsal chodas/ / bstan la phan phyir 'o pos rab tu spyar/ / zhes pa sogs gsal/ lto rdzongs 'dir rnying ma'i chodas lugs gaḥ thog pa'i bstan pa de'i sngar ye shes 'bum gyis 'go btsugs tsam las cher dar mi 'dug bsede nams rgyal mtshan las rgya cher dar 'dug sprul sku bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang gter bton padma gling pa gnyis dus thog mnyam zhing padma gling pa'i sras ceras rje grags pa rgyal mtshan sku mched/ sprul sku bsede nams rgyal mtshan gyi sle ba ma rang las mi zhan pa'i thu chen yin zhes gsungs 'dug rnam thar dri med yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba spa gro stag tshang du sprul sku bsod nams rgyal mtshan rang gis dgung lo bdun cu don bzhi'i shing mo phag lor btsams par mdzad pa de nyid las/ snyo rdzongs kyi mdzad pa'i skor rnams tshig sna btus te bris pa lags sku(/ / phyis su zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyon te 'grag pa'i bstan pa rdzongs 'dir phyogs kun hu khyab pa na/ 'gran zla phas 〉sgol bla lag lnga zhes pa'i gras la ga:thog pa gnyis zhes gsungs pa'i ka6wag pa ni/ sngar spu lo 1508la skyod rgyan rtse mo sgrub sde btab pa'i sprul sku bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gdan sa gtso bo stag tshang dang / glang ma lung la sogs pa mang po yod pa'i gdan sa de'i brgyud 'dzin khag gnyis kyis rgol ba yin par 'dug go/108

kyang / / yongs rdzogs bdag tsam min pa dkon pa 'du/ /de dus bdag mo dung gis chodas yodan la/ / rgyud 'thum po ti so lnga tshang ma phul/ / zhes gsungs 'dugashes bya'i chu gter snu sa kyi rgya mtsho las/ / zab don yid bzhin nor bu rab blangs te/ /theg pa'i rnam dbye nyi cad rab gsal chodas/ / bstan la phan phyir 'o pos rab tu spyar/ / zhes pa sogs gsal/ lto rdzongs 'dir rnying ma'i chodas lugs gaḥ thog pa'i bstan pa de'i sngar ye shes 'bum gyis 'go btsugs tsam las cher dar mi 'dug bsede nams rgyal mtshan las rgya cher dar 'dug sprul sku bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang gter bton padma gling pa gnyis dus thog mnyam zhing padma gling pa'i sras ceras rje grags pa rgyal mtshan sku mched/ sprul sku bsede nams rgyal mtshan gyi sle ba ma rang las mi zhan pa'i thu chen yin zhes gsungs 'dug rnam thar dri med yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba spa gro stag tshang du sprul sku bsod nams rgyal mtshan rang gis dgung lo bdun cu don bzhi'i shing mo phag lor btsams par mdzad pa de nyid las/ snyo rdzongs kyi mdzad pa'i skor rnams tshig sna btus te bris pa lags sku(/ / phyis su zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyon te 'grag pa'i bstan pa rdzongs 'dir phyogs kun hu khyab pa na/ 'gran zla phas 〉sgol bla lag lnga zhes pa'i gras la ga:thog pa gnyis zhes gsungs pa'i ka6wag pa ni/ sngar spu lo 1508la skyod rgyan rtse mo sgrub sde btab pa'i sprul sku bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gdan sa gtso bo stag tshang dang / glang ma lung la sogs pa mang po yod pa'i gdan sa de'i brgyud 'dzin khag gnyis kyis rgol ba yin par 'dug go/108

bla ma lag lnga'i nang gses dge ldan shing rta pa/ ༄༄/ / da pal ldan 'brug pa'i bstan pa'i phas rgol bla lag lnga zhes pa dang / lha gnas dge gasra/ma zhes pa ni sku1ngas grags yin pa 'kham las/ dmigs bsal bla lag lnga yang mdzub mo btsugs sa 'di dang 'di zhes pa dang / de bzhin lha gnas dge gsum yang dmigs bsal badzub mo btsugs sa 'di dang 'di zhes pa da sngar lto'i chos 'byung byams mgon smon mtha'i phreng ba gong 'og gang na yang mi 'dug rmod/ lha pa dang chaganas rnying pa gong gsal ltar dang / dge ldan pa dmigs bsal ngos 'dzin lja'i chos 'byung dang / rno/sa dung rnam thar las/ dge ldan shing rta pa ni/ rab byung bdun pa'i nang rgyal ba bstong la pa'i zhal slob grub brnyes rdo rje gsum gyi nang tshan 'phan yul ba dpal ldan rdo rje zhes bya ba/ jo mo lha ri'i gangs la bzhugs pa las/ de'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i bla ma 'ga' zhig gis gling bzhir 'brog dgon pa dang / mgar sa'i phyogs su shing rta dgon sogs btab ste tshosnags pa bskyangs pa las nub khye1gas 'dir bka' gdams gsar ma dge ldan pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa byon tshul dang / de'i rjes su dus rabs nyangapa'i nang shar phyogs su thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa'i zhal hre ba sdud bzang bstan pa'i sgron me zhes pas dge ldan pa'i dgon pa la shas btab ste/ dge ldan pa'i bstan pa spel 'dug par snang yang dar rgyas cher byurngo rimed par mngon/30 mkhas dbang dge 'dun rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i chotshes 'byung bro gsar rna rgyan dang /31 rgyu mtsho'i snying po/109

shar phyogs kyi dge ldan pa'i phyogs bla ma rnam sras dang sku grang pad dkar 2snas 'phel dang dbu mdzad dam ceras rab rgyas kyis shar phyogs kyi rgyal lams dbang du bsdus skabs mi mngon par gyur pa dang / byang phyogs kyi shing rta dgon pa ni dpal ldan 'grag pa'i chodas srid bcas dus bla lag lnga'i phyogs gtogs ngo ma yin gas/ mgar sa'i phyogs nas dge ldan shing rta pa dang dgon bla ma bde mchodag mgon po mchod yon rnams kyis ngo rgol kyi dmag 'khrugs yang yang skabs/dgon phyogs dge ldan pa'i dmag dpon zhabs dung rin po che'i gzigs snang la bya rog gdong can gyis 'cham stabs dang bsres te bsgral ba bzhin dmag dpon de'i gri snying dgo ldan pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i gtam snyan dang bcas 'phral du zhabs dung rin po che la phyal mi 'byor ba dang / dge ldan shing rta pa'i grwa tshang 'thor te bros pa dang dus mtshungs/ dgon bla ma bde masnu ga mgon pos gtsos pa'i dgon mkhar stod shing rta pa'i phyin bdag rnams kyang bod du yul thon te song /khral tshab 31 chen nas bcug pa'i 'o( dzo/sa mde pa rnams grags pa tshad mas grub pa 'a/ba/0su/ 110

shar phyogs kyi dge ldan pa'i phyogs bla ma rnam sras dang sku grang pad dkar 2snas 'phel dang dbu mdzad dam ceras rab rgyas kyis shar phyogs kyi rgyal lams dbang du bsdus skabs mi mngon par gyur pa dang / byang phyogs kyi shing rta dgon pa ni dpal ldan 'grag pa'i chodas srid bcas dus bla lag lnga'i phyogs gtogs ngo ma yin gas/ mgar sa'i phyogs nas dge ldan shing rta pa dang dgon bla ma bde mchodag mgon po mchod yon rnams kyis ngo rgol kyi dmag 'khrugs yang yang skabs/dgon phyogs dge ldan pa'i dmag dpon zhabs dung rin po che'i gzigs snang la bya rog gdong can gyis 'cham stabs dang bsres te bsgral ba bzhin dmag dpon de'i gri snying dgo ldan pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i gtam snyan dang bcas 'phral du zhabs dung rin po che la phyal mi 'byor ba dang / dge ldan shing rta pa'i grwa tshang 'thor te bros pa dang dus mtshungs/ dgon bla ma bde masnu ga mgon pos gtsos pa'i dgon mkhar stod shing rta pa'i phyin bdag rnams kyang bod du yul thon te song /khral tshab 31 chen nas bcug pa'i 'o( dzo/sa mde pa rnams grags pa tshad mas grub pa 'a/ba/0su/ 110

sman rdzongs 'di nyid sngon gyi dus nas rgyal lab su'i mnga' mtsheg min pa'i rgyu mtshan/༄7/ /de yang 'di ltar sman rdzongs rgyal lab 'di nyid ches thog ma sngon gyi dus nas rgyu bod gang gis kyang bdag hu ma bzung ba'i rgyu mtshan cung zad brjod pa ni/sangs rgyas bce ma ldan 'das bzhugs pa'i skabs 'dul ba 31gas nas mtha' 'khob ri brag pa zhes byung ba/ ri bo mtho zhing ngam spog dang brag g.yang gzar po mang bas rong dog cing nags tshal snyug po 'khrigs pa na stag gzig la skusnags pa'i gcan gzan gdug pa can gnas shing / chu klung dug tu bab pa sku gas kyis bar du chod gas yul rdzongs phan tshun gcig nas gcig tu thar dka' ba sermegs la brten/ lto phyogs nas rgya gar gyi rgyal po sus kyang bdag hu ma bzung bar btang stoms su bzhag pa las rgyal po 'dis yul rdzongs 'dir chab srid 'di ltar bsgyungs zhes pa'i lo rgyus gsal po gang na'ang mi 'dug pa dang / de bzhin byang phyogs nas kyang dus rabs bdun pa'i nang bod kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos spa spor skyer chu'i lha lang dang bum thang du byams lha lang sogs bzhings par brten bod kyi mnga' 'og yin pa 'du bsams na/ de yang min te/ yul rdzongs 'dir lha khang bzhings 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas bod kyi mnga' cadag yin dgos na/ rgya gar gyi rgyal po chodas rgyal mya ngan med kyis bod yul byang 'bri gung du gnyug rum mchod rten dang / snyo brag lha lung yas man du'ang mya ngan med kyi mchod rten bzhings yod par brten bod rgya gar gyi 'og yin dgos kyang bod rgya gar gyi 111

mnga' mtsheg min pa dang 'du zhing / sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pa'i ཿtshes rgyal rnams kyis rang gi mnga' cadag tsam ma tshad pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba sems can spyir phan sems kyis lha khang mchod rten se gas sa gnas gzhan dang gzhan du yang bzhengs par mdzad pa yin la/ rgyu mtshan de ltar yin pas na bod kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos spa gror skyer chu'i lha lang dang thum thang du byams lha khang sogs bzhings yod kyang / mon gyi yul rdzongs 'di bod kyi mnga' 'og min pa'i khungs gsal po ni /sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma 'khu/nga gnas kyi rnam thar yid kyi pon sel zhes byu ba'i ldeb grangs nga gnyis kyi rgyab yig phreng gnyis pa nas/ sngon bod kyi rgyal po'i so mtshams/ shar rma ri smug po'i rgyud tshun chad/ snyo gangs ri brtsegs pa'i rgyud tshur chad/ nub stag sha dung gi sgo mo man chad/ byang chags po gangs kyi ra ba tshur chad yi na pa la/ zhes gsal pas shes nus sku / / sprul pa'i ceras rgyal de rnams kyis mnga' 'og hu bsdu ma thub pa gang yod/ yin na yang mnga' lnga ga hu bsdu bar ma mdzad pa gong du brjod pa bzhin sa'i chags tshul la brten nas btang slo mas su bzhag par mdzad pa'am/ yang na ji zhig ltar stes kyis gyi nar lus par mngon no/ / de ltar rgya bod kyi rgyal po sus kyang bdag hu ma bzung ba'i yul rdzongs yin par brten/ dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang rgya gar ser kyi'i rgyal po'i sras kun 'joms zer ba de yab dang blon po rnams dang dmag rgyab ste pham nas ser kyi nas yul phud de sin dha'i yul du spyugs/ sinadha'i yul du'ang rgyal po sna bo che dang dmag rgyab ste pham nas sdod sa med par kyibs bcol ba'i sa 'tshol te 112

'ongs pa na mon bum thang 'dir slobs te sdod gnas sa bzung ba na/ sa gnas 'di nyid rgya gar dang bod kyi rgyal po sus kyang rang gi mnga' 'og min par brten rnyogs gleng gang yang brjod mi ma byung ba dang / sinadha rā dzo mon gyi rgyal po rang gi stobs dza/gas kyis byas pa ma gtesnags rgya gar nas snge/sa kyang 'dir rgyal perdzor ma bskos pa dang / bo rang gi stobs shugs kyis rgyal po byas na yang 'o rang mi thog gcig ma gtogs sras stag la me 'bar gcig las med pa de rgyal nge sna nge ches bsad de rgyal brgyud chad de med pa na/ rgya gar gi mnga' cadag yin na sinadha rā dza'i shul du rgya gar nas rgyal nge gzhan gcig bshesas daskusnas pa la rgyal nge gzhan bskos med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rgya gar gyi mnga' cadag min pa gsal por shes nus so/ de bzhin rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis btsun mo bza' dmar rgyan gyi thu khyi la ra thod bsam yas nas mtha' la spyugs pa na/ khyi la ra ༄snad da〈snan gaskutsheg rnams lto brag spyod shod du ba/nas chags te lo bcu gsum bsdad pa na yang / spyid shod de sod kyi sa gnas yin par brten der sdod ma bcug par dmag dungs te spyid shod nas kyang yul phyad de bton btang ba na/ bod khyo so mtshams gangs ri brgal te mon mkhan pa lung du cadangs nas der gnas chags te bsdad 'dug pa la/mkhan pa lung de bod kyi mnga' 'og sa cha min par brten khri srong lde'u btsan gyis gang yang byas mi 'a dugapa dang / de'i rjes dus rabs dgu pa rdzogs mtshams su lha sras gtsang ma rdzongs 'dir byon pa ya nga bod nas mon gyi rgyal por bskos te gyon pa min la/ 'di ltar bdud blon rgyal to re dang / cog ro legs sgra gnyis kyis rgyal po khri ral pa can bkrongs te glang dar ma rgyal po bskos nas sangs rgyas

kyi bstan pa bshig rgyu'i 'char gzhi bting ba dang / lha sras gtsang ma yod pas bya stabs ma bde bar brten/ gong du brjod pa bzhin bdud blon rgyal to re'i bsam ngan gaskutshe 'phrul thabs kyis lha sras gtsang ma bod du ma bzhag par bton btang ba las mon yul 'dir gyon pa yin ma gtogs/ mon yul gyi rgyal por bskos te byon pa min no/ / dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i nang la sa skya'i bla ma 'khro mgon ceras rgyal 'phags pa rgya nag tu gdan dungs te se chen rgyal pos nu rdor kyi dbang phyal ba'i dbang yodan du bod lams ma ngas rdzogs phyal ba na/ sa kyi pas bod lams yongs rdzogs la dbang bsgyur te khri skor bcu gsum du bzo skabs/gtsang gi char gtogs khri skor dug / dngus kyi cha la khri skor grag / gtsang men dathus men khri skor gcig / gtsang men dgas men zhes bya ba/ / yar 'aX ga khri skor zhes bya yin/ / khri skor bcu gsum de ltar 'dod/ / ces sod lams khri skor bcu gsum du bzos pa'i gras su sto rdzongs 'di sod kyi mnga' 'og min par brten ma btsud pa sogs kyis bod kyi 'og min par rang dbang rang btsan yin par shes nus sku1/ /de ltar min par rgya bod gang rung gi mnga' 'og yin na/ sngon nas da lta'i bar la rgya gar dang bod sku gas phyogs gzhan nas rgyal po 'di dang 'dis/ smadan yul 'dir rgyal tshab 'di dang 'di bskos te rgyal sa 'di dang 'dir bzhugs te phyag las 'di dang 'di gnang ste phyag rjes 'di dang 'di yod zer ba'i lo rgyus khungs gsal po brjod thub mkhan ni mi 'dug go /de yang nges pa'i don du ni/sngon gyi dus nas min rdzongs 'di nyid gu ru rin po che padma 'byung gnas kyi zhabs 114

kyis ba cags shing sbas yul du byin gyis brlabs par brten/ snyo phyogs rgya gar sgyu rgyal po rnams dang / byang phyogs bod kyi rgyal po rnams kyi rnam dpyod blo mig gu ru rin po che'i thugs rje'i nus mthus grib ste ma gzigs par bar ma dor lus par nges so 'grag pa'i bla ma sku nga ma rnams khyodan nas gdan sa bcags 'thol/ ༄༄/ / dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i nang stod 'byug gi bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal ba rgod tshang pa mgon po rdo rje'i thugs sras zhe bcad rang dang mnyam pa grub thob spyil dkar ba spa gro'i phyogs su gyon nas khrul dkar mgon pa btab cing 'gro don rgyu che na po mdzad pa dang / de'i rjes su skyes macerdzog 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang byon nas 'brang rgyas dgon pa btab cing stod 'byug gi bstan pa spel nas sku gdung yang der bzhugs/ de bzhin smad 'grag gi bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal ba lo ras pa grags pa dbang phyug lha brag brgyud de sum thang chu stod du thar pa gling gi chos sde dang chu smad du gzhu ri mgon pa se gas gdan sa btab cing smad 'byug gi bstan pa dar bar mdzad/ bar 'grag gi bstan pa pha rdzo 'grag sgom zhig pos btsugs pa nas rta masku('i gdan sa sras dam pa la gtad nas sras bzhi rngo1sa 'a/nga phyogs so sor dpal ldan 'grag pa'i lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa'i srol btsugs shing gdan sa ra lung dang marme da ye na du 'brel ba las/ dam pa'i sras 'brog pa 115

kun bzang rdo rje/ de'i sras dam sprul blo ldan rgyal po 'di nyid kyis spyi lo 1333rab byung 6pa'i chu bya 'o/ra 'jam dbyangs kun dga' seng ge spyan drangs te rim yul bde chen sbug tu gyon nas dbang bka' chodas mang po gnang / rme sa 'khor rtser sgrub sde btsugs/ lcang sgang khar dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ spa spor gyon nas sgrub gnas bde chen sdings zhes pa btab (dge malha na la ) ste 'gre don rgya cher mdzad/ de'i rjes su spyi lo 1461dang rab byung 8pa'i lcags sprul lor gtsang pa rgya ras sprul sku rgyal dbang pyos rje gyon te spa spo rdo mchod rten dgon pa sogs gdan sa bcags te dbang cesas gdams pa gnang ste sgrub sde batsho gas nas 'ablo don rgya chen po mdzad 'a dug de'i rjes su rigs kyi dpon chodas kyi sras ngag dbang ཿtshes rgyal snga sti lan mang du gyon nas gdan sa btab pa spyi 'o/ 15'khya rababyung pa sa glang 'o/ra spa spo 'byug ceras sdings/ phrin las sgang / spang ring zam 'grag po brang sdings/ 'byug rab brtan sgang gi gzim khang lha khang rnams btab/'bras la bsam gtan ceras 'a6tsher/ ceras gzhis bsam gtan rtse resna/ sros smarsha rab brtan chesgos 'khor/ chodas gzhi spyi mig thang / lha mdzo theg chen snu sa 'khor/ byi la sgang dben dgon/ rnal 'byor nam mkha'i sgrub phyag rtogs ldan nyi zla'i snag tshang /cad nas khyi phyag brag spang dmar dgon pa/ spang dmar gong ma/ bya bzhag dgon pa/ rdo rgya thab/ spyi lo 1531 rab byung 9 pa lcags yos lor khu byug la 'byug chos spyong pho brang / rdo mkhar 'byug chodas 'khor sgang sogs mang du btab ste 'byug pa'i bstan pa shin hu dar rgyas btang /de dang dus mtshungs su 'byug pa kun legs kyang yar 'brog sna dkar rtser 116

bzhub/sa dus tho rangs snya mo dud sol mas 'grag pa kun legs khyod lto mon gyi phyogs su gdul bya dang 'gro don phrin las kyi rten 'brel yod pas 'gro ran pa yin/der khyod kyi gdung brgyud gcig kyang byung nas ma 'ongs pa na 'byug pa'i bstan pa la phan thogs 'ong bas/ sang nyi ma rtse shar la khyod rang gi mda' zhig snyo mon phyogs su pho nya'i tshul du thong zhig ces lung bstan pa bzhin/ sang snga dro gnam bskos las 'phyo yod pa'i gya mo zhig gi khang par song zhig gsungs nas phyag mda'azhig nam mkha' nas gnang btang ba de/ stod pa lung 'gram cadag ma'i yul gyi tshe dbang zer ba'i khang thog gi skas la thug pa de'i gnas tshang nor thu 'dzom ma'am dpal bzang bu khrid kyis blangs te ma2de khang du bzhag de nas 'byug pa kun legs phag ri spre mo la brgyud de 'o ded bdud dang shing ka rab kyi bdud mo btul/ de nas nga dgon gsar la na btsan dang klu bdud gdug pa can dam la btags/ de nas lha mdzo lung pa'i bdud btul te gyon nas stod pa'i sar phebs/mtshan ldan nor thu 'jos sa ma'am dpal bzang thu khrid phyag rgya ma bzhes gdung sras ngag dbang bstan 'dzin bskrun/ lung 'gram 'og ma'i bdud mo dang rdo kyong la'i bdud mo long rong bdud mo rnams btul/ 'o lags rgod po bstan 'dzin zer ba des 'chi khar phan pa'i ceras shig gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ shing sdong rgad po bzhin rtsa ba nas 'gyel yang bdag 'dzin blo yis mi thong ba'i a rbo rgod po'i ma je la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa se1gas 31 'ordzo ka gcig gnang ba ltar snang kyal po'i tshig dung srong bden pa'i tshig gi nus mthus rgad po 'ja' lus grub song ba'i mal du spe nga ba lus pa gzungs btsugs te ma/chod rten bzhengs te rab gnas mdzad pa 1 17

nger ngag dbang che sa rgyal gyis mchod rten gyi phyo nas lha khang bzhengs pa de khyi 'bur lha khang ngam khyi med lha khang zer ba yin/ mgon stod du ngag dbang chos rgyal gyis dbang gnang sar 'grag pa kun legs kyis sha ba bsad de sha bzhes nas sha ba slar gsos te btang pas ngag dbang chodas rgyal gyis per dang ཿwas gos nyi zer la bkal bas nyi zer cung ldem pa dang / 'byug pa kun legs kyis sha ba sha khyi mda' gzhu nyi zer la bkal bas nyi zer dung por bsdad pa'i grub rtags bstan pas/ khrom thams cad rang dbang med pa'i dad pa skyes nas/ bla ma zer ba dpal ldan 'byug pa yin/ ngag dbang ceras rgyal byin rlabs che ba'i khar/'byug pa kun legs de las kyang 'gran zla mi 'dug ces snyo rdzongs 'dir 'byug pa'i snyan grags phyogs kun tu khyab par gyur to/ /ngag dbang che sa rgyal gyi sras che ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyon te khyong seng gdong khar 'byug dar rgyas zhes pa'i sgrub sde btab/sras chung ba ngag gi dbang phyug shar phyogs su gyon te thum thang che sa 'khor du bya dkar rdzong gi gzhi bcags/ mang sde ras phel se gas zhabs kyis bcags te lha khang bzhengs/ krong gsar ram chodas 'khor rab brtan rtse'i rdzong gi gzhi bcags/ shar mchad thang khar gdan sa btab ste sgrub sde btsugs pa skusgogs bstan pa rgya cher spel 'dug / ngag gi dbang phyug gi sras mi pham chodas kyi rgyal po spyi lo 1567 rab byung 9 pa'i me stag la thed thim spa spo rnams su byon te 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ yang mardzon la dkar chung nas sum thang sde bzhi sku(gas su phebs/ pad gling gi sras grags 118

pa rgyal mtshan dang mjal te thugs snang mthun/ de skabs tsa mangs pa dang cheras skor ba'i 'dums mdzad/ ku re lung gi theg chen rtse'i gzim lang de zhig gsos gnang / ku re lung stod smad thams cad zhabs kyis bcags/ snga phyir lan lnga tsam gyon te ngag dbang ཿtshes rgyal gdan sa rnams su bzhugs te dbang chodas kyis 'gro don mdzad/de'i rjes su mi pham che sa kyi rgyal po'i sras mi pham bstan pa'i nyi ma spyi lo rab byung 10pa'i nang thum thang sde bzhi dang / gzhong sgar phyogs su byon/ sum thang chu smad mchod rten rnying por gdan sa bcags te grwa thu slob mang por 'byug pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa skutshegs mdor na/ mnyam med ཿtshes rje dpal ldan 'byug pa gtsang pa rgya ras kyis lung bstan te/ gdan rabs 'dzin pa bar 'jug gi bstan pa'i bdag po dbon ras dar ma seng gos pha jo 'grag sgom zhig po snyo mon du brdzangs te bla ma lha pa'i mthu dang nus pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal nas gtso bor bar 'grag gi lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa 'go btsugs pa nas/ snyo rdzongs 'dir chos rje 'byug pa gong ma na rim gyon te 'byug pa'i bstan pa phyogs kun tu khyab par gyur pa de thams cad kyang / dpal ldan 'byug pa bdud 'joms rdo rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal byon pa'i lnga ltas kyi rten 'brel legs tshogs rang bzhin lhun grub tu byung ba yin 'dug go/ 119

pa rgyal mtshan dang mjal te thugs snang mthun/ de skabs tsa mangs pa dang cheras skor ba'i 'dums mdzad/ ku re lung gi theg chen rtse'i gzim lang de zhig gsos gnang / ku re lung stod smad thams cad zhabs kyis bcags/ snga phyir lan lnga tsam gyon te ngag dbang ཿtshes rgyal gdan sa rnams su bzhugs te dbang chodas kyis 'gro don mdzad/de'i rjes su mi pham che sa kyi rgyal po'i sras mi pham bstan pa'i nyi ma spyi lo rab byung 10pa'i nang thum thang sde bzhi dang / gzhong sgar phyogs su byon/ sum thang chu smad mchod rten rnying por gdan sa bcags te grwa thu slob mang por 'byug pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa skutshegs mdor na/ mnyam med ཿtshes rje dpal ldan 'byug pa gtsang pa rgya ras kyis lung bstan te/ gdan rabs 'dzin pa bar 'jug gi bstan pa'i bdag po dbon ras dar ma seng gos pha jo 'grag sgom zhig po snyo mon du brdzangs te bla ma lha pa'i mthu dang nus pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal nas gtso bor bar 'grag gi lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa 'go btsugs pa nas/ snyo rdzongs 'dir chos rje 'byug pa gong ma na rim gyon te 'byug pa'i bstan pa phyogs kun tu khyab par gyur pa de thams cad kyang / dpal ldan 'byug pa bdud 'joms rdo rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal byon pa'i lnga ltas kyi rten 'brel legs tshogs rang bzhin lhun grub tu byung ba yin 'dug go/ 119

tsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa rang dbang rang btsan rgyal lab dag brnyes tshul la/lto mon 'byug par bsgyur te rang btsan rgyal khab bskrun mdzad zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal 'khrungs pa/༄༄ / / rgya gar gyi paṇa chen nā ro pa'i sprul pa mnyam med che sa rje dpal ldan 'byug pa gtsang pa rgya ras kyi gdung rigs lha 'thum gyi sras hor rgyal po rwa gan the mur gyis bla'i mchod gnas su bkur pa byang sems nyi ma seng ge de'i sras seṅge rgyal po de'i sras 'jam dbyungs kun dga' seng ge de'i sras blo spos seng ge de'i sras 'jam dbyangs ye shes rin chen/ de'i sras gsum las che ba nam mkha' dpal bzang la sras med/ bar pa shes rab bzang po'i sras gtsang pa rgya ras kyi sprul sku rgyal dbang chos rje dang / nang so lha'i dbang po gnyis/ rgyal dbang chos rje la sras med/ nang so lha'i dbang po'i sras ngag dbang chodas rgyal/ de'i sras ngag dbang grags pa dang /ngag gi dbang phyug gnyis/ ngag dbang grags pa dge sle nga / ngag gi dbang phyug gi sras/ mi pham rmedzis kyi rgyal rnge / / de'i sras mi pham bstan pa'i nyi ma/ rgyal dbang ceras rje'i sprul sku 'jam dbyangs che sa kyi grags pa/ de'i sprul sku kun mkhyen padma dkar po/ / de'i sprul sku zhabs grang ngag dbang rnam rgyal ni/ yab bstan pa'i nyi ma dang / yum sde pa spyid sgod pa'i sras mo bsod nams dpal gyi thu khrid gnyis kyi sras su spyi lo 1594 dang rab byung 10 pa'i shing rta lo zla 10 la gzhis ka mgar spong du sku 'khrungs skusgo/ / 'khrungs ma thag cesas nyid rnam dag gi sngags gsungs/ mtshan 120

mi pham bstan 'dzin rdo rje zhes gsol/gzhan yang ngag gi dbang po rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes kun mkhyen padma dkar pos lung bstan pa'i mtshan gse la zhing / sngon gyon rgyal ba rnams kyi sprul pa'i gzhi/ /ma gyon rgyal ba rnams kyi 'byung khungs pa/ / da lta'i spyob pa dag dang dbyer med ge'i/ / ceras kyi rgyal po'i zhabs pad brtan gyur cig / ces lung bstan brtan bzhugs phul/ ye shes mgon po dang dpal ldan lha mos srung skyob me la tshe 'bral tshed mdzad/ mgon po dngos grub byung ba'i rgyud las/ / 'khor ba'i bdud rnams 'joms pa po/ / rdo rje sems dpa' mnyam gyur pa'i/ / rdo rje slob dpon bdag nyid che/ / zhes dang / le'u tha ma las/ skal ldan lam 'di 'dzin pa dang / / nga yis lung bstan gyur pa yin/ / zhes pa dang / skye/ rgyan chen pos/ bdud 'joms rdo rje zhes bya ba/ gsang sngags bstan pa'i bdag po 'byung / / zhes lung gis legs par bstan pa'i mtshan ngag dbang bdud 'joms rdo rje de nyid/ sku chung ngu'i dus rang gi yab mi pham bstan pa'i nyi ma las/ ka kha nas btsams dag yig hra/ma rtags sogs gzigs/ dgung 'o/ bzhi nas rgyun gyi thugs dam gtor bsngo sku gas gnang /dgung lo lnga las lha mo dud sol ma'i gtor 'thul bzlas brjod gnang ba na rgyun gtor las me 'bar/ mi pham ཿtshes kyi rgyal pos 'di nged rang rnams thams cad las lhag pa sku nga zhes gsungs/dgung lo brgyad la mi pham tshe sa kyi rgyal po las dge bsten gyi sdom pa bzhes/'grag dgon par lha mi che dgu'i dbus su seng ge'i khri la 'grag pa'i bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gse la/ dgung 'ordzo dgu nas bcu gsum par yab bstan pa'i nyi ma 121

las dbang khrid man ngag rdzogs rim thams cad dang snyan ngag me long se gas legs par byings/ / bcu bzhi nas bcu dgu'i bar mkhas grub lha dbang sdurdzo gros las dus 'khor lag rtsis dang / sgra ka la pa yi gzhung 'grel ri re / / latsi wartu skusnags yig sna khyad par nang don rig pa mdo rgyud man ngag rnams dang gar thig dbyangs se gas rgyud kyi phyag len thams cad la byings pa mthar phyin par mdzad/ ban tshang dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs te bca' yig chen po'ang de dus mdzad 'dug ga tshang de'i dbu mdzad dgon yul gsar pa bstan 'dzin 'grug rgyas bskos/ dus tshod 'di dag gi sngon dang phyis su kun mkhyen pad dkar gyi sprul sku ngos 'dzin sgor nas 'byug pa phan tshun rtsod gzhi byung ba ni rnam thar chen mo'i nang du gsal ba bzhin no/ /122

zhabs grang ngag dbang rnam rgyal lung bstan dang rgyu kyen gyis bskul te sman rdzongs su gyon tshul/༄༄/ / de nas chos kyi rgyal po zhabs grang rin po che ngag dbang bdud 'joms rdo rje sman rdzongs su gyon dgos pa de nges pa'i don du ni/ gu ru rin po ches/ lams pa rigal rgyu yi rigs su grags pa de/ / mnga' ris stod kyi phyogs su glog tsam 'khyug /dbus gtsang lto yi phyogs su 'byug ltar sgrog / zhes lung bstan pa bzhin kha bzhi tsan dan bkod pa'i gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la babs pa yin/ ltar snang 'jig rten pa'i mthong snang rgyu kyen ni/ thog ma nas kun mkhyen padma dkar po'i sprul sku ngos 'dzin skabs sde srid gtsang pa phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis dpag bsam dbang po'i phyogs bzung ba ma zad/ stag tshi kha'i brel ba'i skor nas kyang snyo brag dpa' bo'i phyogs bzung ba dang / yang de'i thog gdan sa ra lung gi nang rten chodas rje gtsang pa rgya ras kyi sku'i sgal tshigs dang po las rang byon khar sa pa ṇi sogs kyang 'ong la ma phul na bde mor mi yong ba'i yi ge 'byor ba'i lan du/ rang gyon khar sa pa ṇi 'di che ste nam mkha' dang 'du/ chung ste yungs 'byu bas phra/ da lta yod med nges pa yang med/ yod kyang phyal mi tshugs pa 'dug khyod rgyal srid la ma chags na/ nga dgon chung gcig la chags rgyu med/ sngar yang khyod rang gang dgyes mdzad song da rung gang dgyed mdzod ces yi ge springs pas thugs snang mi mthun pa 'gal 'tshab chen por gyur/ de ltar sde srid gtsang pa phun tshogs rnam rgyal dang thugs snang ma mthun par 123

bzhugs pa na/ gu ru'i lung bstan yod pa'i thog ye shes mgon pos sman rdzongs tsan dan bkod pa'i rgyal lab 'di phyag mthil hu bkram ste mchode gzhis su phul bas rgyu byas/ las kyi mgon po bya rog gdong can gyis sman rdzongs su gdan 'dren pa'i snga ltas su thugs dam 'od gsal gyi gzigs snang la bya rog chen po zhig 'ongs te snyo phyogs su 'phur ba'i rjes su rje nyid kyang 'phyar te gyon pas yul ngo ma shes pa zhig hu slobs/ (phyos su spang ring zam pa yin 'dug gsungs ) dgon mgar sa'i yul dpon bla ma cadabs mtsho pas kyang bla ma rin po che sde srid gtsang pa phun chogs rnam rgyal dang thugs snang ma gshin na 'dir snyo phyogs su 'gyon par zhu mchod gzhis ldang pa yod ces zhu yig phul bas kyen byas/ dgon mgar sa'i yul dpon bla ma cadabs mtsho pa la zhabs bsur carshang dasku sa pa'i bka' sgo ga gnang ba bzhin dmag dpung bcas chibs drel zhabs sur se nga ba'i mtshams spyor la brten nas/ spyi le 1616rab byung 10 pa'i me 'byug lor chos kyi rgyal po zhabs byung bdud 'joms rdo rje dgung lo 'a3 pa'i thog gdan sa ra lung nas rang byung khar sa pa ṇi sogs rten khyad 'phags bcas bsnams te chibs kyi la 'o/ bsgyur nas sman rdzongs su gyon/ la yag lung mo cher chodas rje yon rdzong pa sogs 'brog pa rnams kyis zhabs tog bsnyen bkur legs par zhus te rim bzhin byon te dgon cadabs mtshor phebs/ phyug po lha dbang tshe ring zer ba des kyang spyin bdag zhus/ dgon phyogs su 'aspo don phrin las mdzad de gyon te thed yul nas yab mes ngag dbang che sa rgyal gyi gdan sa dgon gnas 'byug 'phrin las sgang du phebs te dpal ye shes mgon po sku gas ཿtshes srung dam can rnams la gasku la ma2de phyal te gyon nas spang ring zam pa'i gnas su phyags 124

phebs/ pha jo'i rnam 'phrul tshe dbang bstan 'dzin gyis thog ma'i sna len bzang po yang dag par mdzad/ sku tshab tu byon nas dbang bsod snyoms kyi 'byu la sogs pa 'thul sdud gnyer tshang gi zhabs 'degs su gang 'a//ra mdzad de phyag phyo rnam dag zhus/ de nas bde chen phyag tu gyon nas ye shes mgon po dang las mgon sde brgyad chogs la bskang gso bsangs mchodad rgyas par gnang zhing / btsan rgod dge bsnyen chen po jag pa me len la mi dang mi lab pa bzhin phrin las thogs med du sgrub dgos pa'i bka' stsal/ de'i g.yon phyogs kyi ri'i sgang brgyud de byon lam nas thim yul gzigs rtog mdzad de sku ngal gnang sar bzhugs khri dang chibs mdzo'i mig rjes gsal po yod par grags/ de nas slus mo la dang 'bras la brgyud de gong ma'i gdan sa spa spo chong 'dus 'byug chodas sdings su phyag phebs te bzhug su sgar phab ste bsdo/ba/theg/ 125

phebs/ pha jo'i rnam 'phrul tshe dbang bstan 'dzin gyis thog ma'i sna len bzang po yang dag par mdzad/ sku tshab tu byon nas dbang bsod snyoms kyi 'byu la sogs pa 'thul sdud gnyer tshang gi zhabs 'degs su gang 'a//ra mdzad de phyag phyo rnam dag zhus/ de nas bde chen phyag tu gyon nas ye shes mgon po dang las mgon sde brgyad chogs la bskang gso bsangs mchodad rgyas par gnang zhing / btsan rgod dge bsnyen chen po jag pa me len la mi dang mi lab pa bzhin phrin las thogs med du sgrub dgos pa'i bka' stsal/ de'i g.yon phyogs kyi ri'i sgang brgyud de byon lam nas thim yul gzigs rtog mdzad de sku ngal gnang sar bzhugs khri dang chibs mdzo'i mig rjes gsal po yod par grags/ de nas slus mo la dang 'bras la brgyud de gong ma'i gdan sa spa spo chong 'dus 'byug chodas sdings su phyag phebs te bzhug su sgar phab ste bsdo/ba/theg/ 125

dngos can phyi'i dgra sde srid gtsang pa'i thog ma'i dmag dpung gi khye1gas las rnam par rgyal ba/༄ṭha༅ / / de nas dpal ldan 'grag pa'i gdung brgyud zhabs grang ngag dbang rnam rgyal tsan dan bkod pa'i rdzongs su phyag phebs te/ cad thim spa spo lung pa'i mi ser mchodag dman thams cad kyis rgyu nor dngos po'i 'bul ba kun bzang mchodad sprin bzhin bshams nas zhabs grang ngag dbang rnam rgyal la mi phyed pa'i dad pa skyes te kyibs kyi mace ga tu bzung nas ci gsungs kyi bka' nos par byas pas/ snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs kun tu du ngas su grags pa na/ bod du sde srid gtsang pa phran tshogs rnam rgyal phrag lnga ga gis ma bag da par gdan sa 'byug dasku na pa dang gzhis ka mgar spong bcas rtsis len grub pa ma zad/ de las lams che ba sku da pa'i tshul gyi yi ge springs pa 'dir 'gyor ba'i lan du/ zhabs spying rin po che nas sngar yang mi mdzad dgu mdzad khyod rang mdzad song / da rung khyod rang gang dgyes pa mdzad nga la khyad par spru rtse tsam med/ bka' bkyon gyi bab gnang bar 'dir gyon rung gyon/ de min mdzad dgos pa gang yang mdzad gnang tshar song / da sgos kyi char sde srid gtsang pa ming med du btang ma tshugs na/ spyir 'byug pa la chodas skyong med pa dang / nged rang yang 'grag pa'i mi ngo min thag chodad/ da lam gtsang pa la yi ge 'di bzhin byas yod pas khyod kyis spyod lugs byed pa gal che/ zhes gzug po par bka' sprodag gnang ngo / /de las gtsang sde srid phran tshogs rnam rgyal lhag par du yang ma bzod par zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal zhes pa'i mtshan tsam las med par bzos te/ sman rdzongs 126

nde bzhi'i rgyal lams dbang du bsdu ba'i brnabs sems dza/gas dug pos/ snying stobs lhag par che zhing brtul phod pa/ g.yul 'khrugs kyi sgyu tsal la shin hu dzadams ge / phas kyi dgra bo rings par cham la phab pa'i gasku1 'phrul gyi thabs sna ce'ogs la ma bas pa'i dmag dpon chen po la gu nas zhes pa'i dpa' bo chen po 'di nyid kyis gtsos pa'i dasung gi tshogs chen po lto mon gyi phyogs su g.yos par gyur to/ /de dang dus mtshungs par rigs sngags kyi nus pa grub cing mngon spyad kyi las spyor la mkhas pa'i sngags pa mang perdzos mnan pa dang / bsregs pa dang / bskrad ge dang / 'phangs pa dang / dbyung ba dang / bsad pa la sogs pa'i dug po'i phrin las sgrub pa la yang zhugs se / / de nas pha rol pa'i mi nor rgyu rdzas la lhag par ri mas pa'i dpung tshogs rnams phag ri brgyud de lto mon gyi rdzongs su rings par brtol to/ / gang gi tshe 'jig rten dbang phyug mi'i rdzu la bzhugs pa zhabs drang ngag dbang rnam rgyal ni/ rang gi yab mes 'byug chen ngag dbang cerdzos rgyal gyi gdan sa sga spo 'byug chodas sdings zhes pa'i btsug lag khang du gsung cerag gnang grabs mdzad de bzhugs pa'i skabs su glo thur du ki swo dang / rgyob gsod kyi sgra/ mtshon cha sna tshogs pa char du 'bebs pa bcas sku skusnag la btsan thabs su 3snal ba na/ re zhig ma chod cha sa dang / nyer spyad pyi ka ca yang 'tshags su bya 'o/nga bral te rings par sems can mang por phan bde sgrub pa'i rten lang tsho rgyas pa'i gzugs kyi sku de nyid/ hūṃ/ ral rdzong zhes pa sngon pha dung dung gis bzhengs pa'i btsan rdzong du 'khor bcas bskungs se / /der yang dmag gis bskor te sredag la hur thum du rgol ba na/ mthu tsal nus pa 127

tshe dbang bstan 'dzin gyis gdan dungs te rta mgor gyon/ rang gi bla brang longs byed thab gdan chas bcas ma 'a/sa pa rtsis phul te gasku la gzim macesad gas/ma gyi sku bcad de phyag phyi zhus/ de nas ma hā kā lar thugs gtad mdzad pas/ swābye— thur gyi mi ga gis ma mthong yang che sa spyodang dam can rgya mtshe 'i dmag dpung sde brgyad kyi che 'phrul chen po ga21sa pa'i rtags nges can te/ bo da kyi dmag thams cad 'jigs skrag ste rtab rtab por se nga / dmag mang po'i khrod nas/ /rmig da pon chen po la gu nas zhes byu ba dpal ye )phos masku na rngo('i dmar rgyan du bzhes/ zhes gas/ngas pa bzhin/rmi sa kyi mgon po bya rog gdong can khog par zhugs pa'i dpa' bos sde srid gtsang pa'i dmag dpon chen po de sngar dmag gang du rgyab kyang rgyal kha thob pa'i dpa' bo chen po dmag darngo na la ku nas zhes pa de nyid btsan thabs su dmar gasku da btang ste lnga pa'i lam du btang rngo/ / de'i mod la dpung chogs thams cad chodas spyong srung ma'i rngo 'phrul gyi gzi khyin ma bzod 5ra sran tshang la rdo rgyab 5 ltar bros so/ / da mag da pon la gu nas pyi gri dang mgo lag snying gsum dar 'phyar bzhin khyer te zhabs grang ngag dbang rna ma rgyal gyi sku mdun du phrul/ dpal ldan 'byug pa sde srid gtsang pa'i dmag dpung chen po'i phyogs las rjodag mar rna ma par rgyal ba'i dga' khyodan gyi dar 'phyar/ dung 'bud kto ma hā kā la lcam dul 'bor dang bcas pa rnam sa la gtang rag gi dga' ston mace da pa rgyas par 'bul bar mdzad do/ / dmag dpon la gu nas kshi lag dzā / g.yab dang ngang / gri snyi nga gsang rten du lcags ri'i mgon khang chen no thog mar bzhings pa'i rten rja sa su phul snyedo 3 sna 'bas dung rnam thar chos kto spyi/na che na ngo 'i dbyangs ldeb bcu ba'i ma dun nas sas la 33 7ba'i dung rnam thar chos/ pyi sdi na chen du 'i dbyangs nā lto skor ldeb bco brgyad pyi ma sdon nas /

sde srid gtsang pa bsgral ba dang phyag tham nga —bcu ngas rim ga'ang ba/kyi༄7 / / de nas ngag dbang rnam rgyal dkar brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar dran te lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i thugs khur ba31la ba'i tshe mnal lam du mkha' 'gro sde bzhis/ rgya chen chodas kshi spyan ldan 'jig rten dbang / / snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'gro ba 'dul shingad du/ / gdung 'dir sprul pa dgu ru khung bstan pa'i/ / snying po'i gsal byed gnyis par gse la ba 'debs/ / zhes gasku(la ba 'debs pas thugs dam slar bzhes nas/ sde srid gtsang pa gami phran cedzags rnam rgyal gyis 'byug pa'i bstan pa dang ngag dbang rnam rgyal la sdang pa cher byas par brten/ gdan sa ra lung nas thod nag 'grub khung bcas len te/ brag rta mgrin rang byon gyi phug par dpal ye shes mgon po'i thod nag la brten pa'i mngon spyod kyi phrin las sgrub pa'i bcad rgyar zhugs pas/ sde srid phran tshogs rnam rgyal yul yar stod kyi phyogs su dmag la 'aspo ba'i lam du ltas ngan 'ug pas mdun bsus te chod 'phrul sna chogs ston pa dang /dmag sar 'gram nas shin tu thu ba glo bur du byung nas zla ba gcig gi nang sde srid btsun mo dang bcas pa bsgral te ming gi lhag mar btang nas ceras srung la gtang rag dga' khyodan mdzad pa gsal/tpa 4rta'i lo sde gzar chen po langs te gtsang dgang lum par 'byor/ sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal dang mjal 'phrad mdzad/ ces dang / sdi 5pa phun tshogs rnam 34 byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bkod pa rgyu mtsho rgyal ba lnga pas mdzad pa zhebazhi'i rgyab nas 35 ldeb grangs zhe bdun gyi rgyab phreng bzhi pa nas/130

pa gdong du sgar thog hu sku gshegs gda'/ zhes gsal ba bzhin/ gtsang sdo srid phran tshogs rnam rgyal rang nas dngos dzardugs gnyis kyi sgo nas gdan sa ra lung dang (sprubyug dgon pa bcas la shin hu sdang ba la brten nas zhabs dung rin po ches 'di nas mngon spyod kyi las spyor mtshad pas dngos gnas spu lo 1631 rab byung 10 pa'i lcags bya zla 1 pa'i nang gtsang du btsun mo dang dbus su sde srid phran tshogs rnam rgyal grongs 'dug hā ra na tha'i rnam thar du gsal/ de'i tshe/ lugs gnyis 'khor 'o/sa bsgyur ba nga / / nga ni kun gyi kyibs su bzang / / dpal ldan 'byug pa'i bstan 'dzin nga / / nga ni 'byug par brdzus rnams bcom/ / rtsodam pa'i dbyangs can grub pa nga / / nga ni legs bshad 'byungs khungs btsun/ / mtha' bral lta ba'i bdag po nga / /nga ni lta log mkhan sran 'byin/ / rtsod pa'i mthu stobs bdag po nga / / nga mdun mi 'dar rgol ba su/ / bdud dasung 'joms pa'i dpa' bo nga / / nga nus zlog pa'i mthu chen su/ / 'chad pa'i ngag gi dbang khu/ga nga / / nga ni rig gnas kun la mkhas/ / gong mas lung bstan sprul pa nga / / nga ni 'du min sprul pa'i gshed/ /gangs can 'dul cadas 'jig rten dbang / / sprul pa'i phrin las cher 'gyings pa'i/ /rgyu mtshan bsnyad lnga sa padma dkar/ / da lta sa la gnyis pa snge// / khyetshogs las rnam rgya ngag gi dbang / / de yang dbus na yin se la/ / phyogs mtshams nga ro bcu dug ste/ /pyi rol don mthun bshad pas bskor/ / dbus zlum zhi ba phyo tshi bzhi/ / dung bzhi phrin las rgyas pa dang / / lams gsum dbang sdud nga ro'i sgra/ / mngon spyad dug po'i 'a'or 'o/ bste/ra/ / mtha' bzhi dag las rnam rgyal dang / / phrin las bzhi grub rten 'brel du/ / ngag dbang smra ba'i seng ge bris / / phyogs dus kun tā grags gyur cig/132

ces bka' tham nga bcu dug ma seng ge'i sgra sgrags shing / ma rungs pa'i klad pa 'gems pa'i sa/ /thim yul bdud 'dul gyi phyag pa ru/ / ngag dbang bdud 'joms rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes gnang bar mdzad do/ /rang byung lar sa pa ṇi dang bla ma'i lung bstan bzhin lcags ri'i gdan sa bcags pa/༄gyi/ / spyi lo 1619 rab byung nya0 pa'i sa thug lo dgung grangs 'chu bzhes pa na yab mi pham bstan pa'i nyi ma bod du zhing ga/zhan du gshegs pa'i sku spur gsang ltabs kyis gdan dungs te sngar zhabs grang rang nyid sku mtshams bzhugs pa'i phyag 5 der sprur byings byas nas dgongs rdzogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgrubs/ gdung rten gtsug lag khang zhig bzhengs rgyu'i sa gnas gang na dug ces rang khu/nga khar sa pa ṇimathugs dam brtag pa zhus pas lan gasnge/ma du lcags rir babs pa dang / gu ru rin po che dang chos srung gi lung bstan yang der yin pa bzhin spyo lo 1620 dang rab bang lags sol lor zle tshos la lags ri rdo rje gdan gyi rmang bting nas das1 90 ༄5 ༷༷/ pa 90 doralo phyed dang thul gtsug lag khang chen po legs par bzhengs grub/ kyibs khra'i spyin bdag gis phrul ba'i dngul gyis yab bstan pa'i nyi ma'i sku gdung mchodad rten bal po'i bzo bo ma ṇi dang ma yang / dza ti pha la/ a mi pha la/ maṅga la bcas kyis leng/sa par bzhings te rab gnas mdzad de bstan pa'i gzhi ma mkhan chen pad dkar 'byung gzha sa kyis gtsos pa'i dge 'dun sum cu tsam gyi sde btsugs/ sgrig rnam gzhag sngar 133

mkhas grub lha dbang blo gros sman rdzongs su gyon tshul/༄༄/ /de yang chodas kyi rgyal po zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal sman rdzongs su spyi lo 1616 rab byung 10 pa'i me 'byug dgung grangs nyer gsum la byon pa yin par yongs su grags rmod kyang / mkhas grub lha dbang blo gros kyi hre ba ma rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug pad dkar bkra shis kyi rnam thar skal bzang yid kyi /drod rtsi zhes pa nas/ nyin gcig rin po che'i skru zhabs na/ btsun pa gzi brjid can paṇa zhwa rna ring gyon pa gcig gis lha sa chen gyi rten bcas phul zhing 'dug pas/ thugs serdzos pa zhig la rin po che la bsrergan pa 'di ga nas yin lags zhus pas/ gasnge/nga nas batsho na pa 'di bla ma nu bo zer ba yin/ snyo nas zhabs dung rin po che'i zhabs nas yin pa 'dugang la snyor shog gsungs pa'i bka' sgo ga rten bcas gnang ba yin par 'dug gcings/ de nas nga la khyod rang bla sgrub cig ri 'di la btang na/ bla ma 'ong ba yod gsungs/ de nas 'bul chas rnams bsgrigs nas/ zhib 'aspyodas kyis 'dre ga gling bzhi nas gyon pa da lam tshig khar sleb rgyu yin zer bas/ spang gdeng gcig 'dug pa der slebs/ sang bzhengs nas gyon pas/ lca 'phrang dog la bzur ba zhig 'dug pas thugs chad pa'i rnam pa mdzad na sa/ rin po che'i gsung nas/ nga ni tshig la zer nas yul zhig yod pa 'du bsam byung ba la/ lca 'phrang 'di 'dra'i dog pa zhig 'dugabla ma nu bos 'di 'du zhig la bkyil ba ga༄/ngas nas spyan batsho mas nas bzhugs 'asdoXg 38 rang gi slob ma ngag dbang blo gsal byang chub rdo rje bya ba zhig gis sgyur ba pad dkar bkra shis da'ongs pa chorshas kyi dbyings su gshegs sa rnam rgyal rtse nas cu/nga ba'i phyag dpe ldeb lnga pa'i mdun nas/ 135

gdung yul gyi bla dpon sgrags ma dang po yin par snang ngo / / dngos med gsang ba lha srin sde brgyad kyi dgra'i phyogs 'a4sa/ rnam par sbyo/'a/ ba/ bcu3 / / de nas zhabs drung rin po che brag rta mgrin rang byon gyi phyag pa der sku mtshams bcad rgya dam par bzhugs pa na/ de nas yang therdzod nas sngags pa mang nge sa mthu sgrub sto rbad bskul byas pas lha srin sde brgyad kyis brag ral pas thug ceram dang 'ur sgu chen po grags shing / sa rdo'i rdul 'tshub 'khrigs pas brag phyag kyang mi mthong bar gyur/ mthar zhabs 'bring ba rnams sems tshab tshub hu //ra te rings stabs kyis sa rdo rnams bsal ba na/ nang du zhabs byung rin po che'i sku gzugs la gnod pa lta ci sku mdun gyi dkar yol yang ma bcag par ting nge 'dzin las ma g.yos par bzhugs 'dug pa dang / dbu'i thog tu rdo pha bong g.yag tsam zhig bla bres thogs te dbu la ma lhung bar 'dug pa de de gar bzhag na phyis su bskal pa'i bar du rjes 'jug rnams kyi dad pa dang mos gus kyi rten hu 'ong rgyu yin 'dug rung zhabs dung rin po che nyid la snu sa brgyad mi mnga' ba dang / sku mtshams yin pa'i khyad kyis bsal ba dang / sa rdo gzhan thams cad kyang bsal te sngar bzhin bzos/de ltar dngos can mi yi dmag dasung gī ga la thub/ dngos med lha srin sde brgyad kyis brag ral bas kyang ma thub par dgra'i khyodags thams cad las rnam par rgyal/ de nas sku mtshams 〈snal te bzhugs pa na/ kyibs khra'i spyin bdag dar dṛṣṭag rgyal mtshan 139

serdzogs kyis gdan drangs te kyibs khrar gyon/ dar phyug rgyal mtshan gyis skru che bi har du rā dza pra ma ṇa ran la sngar gyon pa'i gu ru bstan pa'i nyi ma'i sras zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal nga'i 'dir gyon te bzhugs yod ces yi ge phul te rā dzas/ dngul gyi 'khar ba/ dngul gyi dung chen cha/ gser ṭam/ dngul ṭam mang po dang / glang chen mche ba/ chibs dur spyid/ ras zong gi 'bul chen zhu yig bcas 'gyor ba'i lan du/zho sa dung nas phyag mdud byin rlabs gos chen chibs sga 'khor bcas dang / tshe sngon smon bzang btab pa'i spogs po khyod/ khrikṣis gnas yul gyis bskal kyang thugs yid 'dres/ / 'bul bzang gsung phrin 'byor bas bdag kyang spyo/ / bsngo smon dpag med btab pas 'di phyir bde/ / zhes bskur gnang bar mdzad do/ / yul phyogs der dbang chos kyi 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad de mar gyi ltang tse dang / dngul ṭam sngerdzor chen serdzog sa 'thul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul/ de nas rta mgo ra byedan nas thugs dam dang chodas spyad kyi mdzad pa gong du 'phel bar bzhugs pa nas/ dus gzhan zhig la zhabs dung rin po che nas rā dza pra ma ṇa ran la spogs po khyod lha dbang phyug chen po bsten pa bas/ dkon macerdzog gsum la bsten pa bzang zhes chab 31ga gnang ba la/ lan du/ shin hu bden bdag kyang dkon mchodag gsum bsten gyi yod ces pa'i brdar ta la'i lo mar bris pa'i brgyad stong pa'i glebs bam phyal ba de phyis sprungs rdzong mes 'jig skabs tshig pa yin par nges deng sang mjal yul du mi snang ngo / /4'a rdzo'i chos 'byung 'jam mgon smon mtha'i phreng ba bstan 'dzin chorshas rgyal gyis mdzad pa nyer brgyad rgyab gcig140

lha dang bla ma'i lung bstan bzhin lugs gnyis bstan pa'i khur bzhes te gsang sngags zab don pho brang bzhengs pa/ ༄༄ / / de nas bla ma thugs mnyes pa'i bya ba rab sgrub pa'i mchod pa rje btsun mi la ras pa dang / rgyal ba 'o( ras pa las mi zhan pa bya dasku ngas te na bza' ras kyang dang / 'tsho ba bcud len la brten nas spyi lo 1633 rab byung 10 chu phag dgung spangs 30pa la lcags rir bdud 'dul yang dben gyi bsam gtan khang thur dka' thub kyis ting nge 'dzin las skad cig kyang g.yel ba med par skru mtshams 'dag byir du bzhugs so/ / lo gsum snying po'i sgrub pa las bzhings te ri rbad dben rlud 'o nar thugs gtad kyang / yab bstan pa'i nyi ma'i kri 'dus lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong mdzad dgos par gsung byon pa ma zad/ mnal lam du yang dngos su gyon nas de ltar lung bstan pa bzhin/ rang byung khar sa pa ṇi'i drung thugs dam brtag pa gnang bas kyang de 'o nar babs/ ye shes mgon po lcam dul tshogs kyis kyang lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa skyong dgos par bskul zhing / phrin las ci bcol ba sgrub par las blangs pa ma zad ma ngas 'dzin mkhas grub lha dbang blo gros kyis 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen chen gnang bar bskul te 'jigs byed kyi bsten chen gnang bas lha 'dre mi gsum gyis bka' nyan pa'i mtshan ma gzigs pas/ lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa'i khur bzhes par thugs thag bcad nas/ lha mon gyi yul lha gzhi bdag lta srin sde brgyad rnams la dpal ldan 'byug pa'i bka' dang dam la gnas dgo sa par 141

bka' sgo ga pho nya ched du mngags te/ ri gnyan/ nags tshal/ mtsho dang / chu bo rnams la dar cog bcas btang bar mdzad/ chodas rje 'byug pas lha srin sde brgyud la bka' sgo ga springs 'dug ces phyogs thams cad du grags so/ /gtsang rgyal blon chos bskrul te bod nas bsngags pa mang pos mngon spyad kyi las la zhugs pas/ lcags ri'i phyag par thugs dam gnang ste bzhugs pa'i skabs shig zhabs dung gi mnal lam du khang bzang shin hu mdzos pa zhig gzigs nas gyon grabs mdzad pas/ thud med mdzes ma zhig byung nas/ khyod gyon sa der min zer skul lcag phul bas mnal sad pa dang zhabs gcig thug sgo g.yang sa chen po nas mar brkyangs 'dug de ma thag thugs daserdzongs la gzhan gyis ngan byas par mkhyen nas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim gsal nas ngan byed de rwa rtse g.yas pas blangs te rgya mtsho'i mthar 'phangs pas/ bod kyi sngags pa de la nas khrag skyugs te tom khung du kha thub byas shi bas/ sngags pa gzhan rnams shin hu 'jigs shing skrag te 'grag pa gdung brgyud mkhyen zhes smre ngag sgo ra bar grags/ lha mo dud sol ma 'di gzhan las bka' gnyan zhing phrin las myur bas dge 'dun sde'i srung skyob gnyer gtad kyang 'di la bcol ba yin gsungs/ da lta'i bar du lha mo sgor gsol zhes thugs dam du mdzad pa 'di yin no/ /de nas snyo rong dmu rgod kyi rgyud zhabs kyis bcags phyor phrin las sgang brgyud de ma'o thang kha/ rgya la sogs su gyon/ slar wa can/ phang ye/ khyung seng dom la sogs shar yul dang / dga' seng / nags snying / khu byug la chos spyong pho brang brgyud lcags rir phebs/ dus skabs de nas la bzhi snyo'i lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad kyis 142
