zhabs la 'dud pa dang / bla ma lha pa dang / gnas rnying pa de'i phyogs gtogs rnams ni phrag dog gis tshig ngan brjod cing dug mda' 'phen pa sogs kyang byung 'dugaspyi lo 1627 rab byung 11 me yos lor phyo gling por cu gal zhes pa'i yul nas gling de'i rgyal po'i pho nya rgya mtshor gru zing btang nas rim pas za hor dang rgya lha ḍi la brgyud de 'o/ngas pa zhabs dung du 'byor te/ me mda' me phyogs rdzas rgyang shel bcas phul nas bla ma khyod la dgra yod na nged kyi rgyal po'i yul nas dmag 'bod thub/ zer yang zhal gyis ma bzhes gsungs/ de nas mnga' thang ste/bas 'byedar phrin las nyin bzhin gong du 'phel zhing rgyas sku / /de nas spyi lo 16'kho rab byung 1nya sa sgrul lo rje nyid dgung grangs 36 bzhes pa na thed rim gyi dbus srin mo rdo lar gsang sngags zab don pho brang ming bting / phyo rol na bla ska lha pa dang gnas rnying pa se gas kyi brgyud 'dzin bla slob grwa btsun yodan bdag rnams phrag dog me ltar 'bar te dmag dasung gis bskor te sredag la bsdoba'i ngan gasgormems ji ltar byas kyang / ya nga bag tsha bral bar las byed grwa bsresan rnams la mtshan mo phyag chen ཿtshes dug sku gas che sa gsungs/ de skabs pha jo tshe dbang bstan 'dzin gyis phyogs phyogs su dbang chodas bsed sloms mdzad cing 'gru mang po sogs mthun rkyen phrul/ sku dgra gces so wang glang ma lung gi bla ma dpal ldan zer ba de la chos srung gi 'phrul gyis me mda' phog pas 'o shi ma thag dgang rnams 'thor pho brang zur bcu gnyis khyams bcas legs par grub sto krerdzongs 'dzin mkhas grub lha dbang blo khros bcas rab gnas kyi dga' rnyasnan rgyas par mdzod/ mi ring bar rje nyid dgung grangs so brgyad spu lo 1631 rab byung 11 lcags mo lug lor pho brang 143

der rgyal sras ngag dbang 'jam dpal rdo rje 'khrungs/ yum ni 'khrungs sa 'di nas yin zhes mi snang / durla ba'i yum chen mo khri lcam gos dkar sgrol ma 'di nyid sngon zhabs dung gdung brgyud rin po che dgung lo brgyad tsam bzhes skabs nas bod du phebs pa lo yun ring po'i bar bcesan lugs su skru cad brgyal la bzhugs pa zhes gsungs 'dugade nas zhabs dung rin po che dgung grangs bzhi bcu bzhes pa spyi 'o/ 1633 rab byung 11 chu byu lor yongs 'dzin mkhas tshib lha dbang blo gros dgung grangs 84 lon pa las gdan sa lcags rir rang byon lar sa pa ṇi dung du bsnyen par rdzogs te don dam pa'i dge slong grub par mdzad do/ /43 mtshan ni rje mkhan khri grag pa ngag dbang lhun tshib kyis mdzad pa rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyi rnam thar brgya nga dgu'i rgyab nas/ 144

sde srid gtsang pa'i dpung chen gnyis pa las rgyal nas sprungs thang bde chen pho brang bzhengs te bstan pa'i gzhi ma dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs pa/༄ / / de nas rje nyid dgung lo 41spyi lo 1634rab byung 11pa'i shing khyi lor bla bag gzhan rnams 'dir rang dgang gis ma thub par bod du sde srid gtsang pa la dmag rgyab zhus por bod nas dmag dpung chen po spa ༷ phyogs nas gnyis/ khag gcig dgon mgar sa stong ser la dang bde chu'i so la nas lcags ri phyogs dang /ngam ga 'ga' zhig rnying la phyogs nas nags rnying yul gsar dang / shar phyedags bum thang du yang dmag dathung cher gaskyorshas pas thams cad sngangs skrag chen por gyur te/ dbu mdzad bstan 'dzin 'byug rgyas kyis bod la gte'u 'du btang na zhes zhus pas/ de'i gral du nga dang ye shes mgon po ma bcug sa/zhan khyod rang shes gsungs/thugs 'byug pa'i bstan pa dar nges kyang dus 'grigs 'tshub cha ha cang che bas 'phral kyen gyis cir dṛṣṭatsho ma ma mchis pas rang khu/nga khar sa pa ṇis gcesas rten khyad 'phags 'ga' wa can rjirshang du gtams/ gzhan phal cher bya ra sgang la gdan dungs ge da lta dbang rdzong bla ma lha lang du bzhugs/ mi ring bar bla ma dang chodas spyong bi mthus 'go dpon 'ga' bsad/ phal cher btson du tshud/ ngan pa kha gcig gis gsang dmag bcug ste gsang zab rdzong re zhig dgra'i lag par sgo ra yang chodas skyong gi 'phrul gyis me mda' rdzas la 〈sna bur du mes zin nas dza/gas dug hu 'bar bas thog brdibs nas ming med du btang / rdzong slar zhabs dung gi phyag tu thob/145

de nas dgon tshe phyag ma ra ti gar byon/ de ga'i bla ma shangs pa sngar zhabs dung la thugs sran zhus par brten yul thon se nga ba'i bla brang der bzhugs/ de 'phral 'ong gi mthu rtags gnam lcags babs te der tsan dan sdong po yod pa phyed tshal du bkas/ zhabs dung khrel dgod gnang nas shangs chung bo rang yang dga' rab 'dug gsungs/ shar tshe brgyad la sku gas yul phyogs thams cad la sgar bste/ra du byon nas/ ji skad du/ ri bo glang chen 'gying 'du'i sna steng na/ / skyes thu rnam rgyal zhes bya'i mtshan can khyodan/ / zhes pa ltar/ cad yul gzhung gis sa cha ri therdzo glang chen 'gying du'i sna steng gangs rin chen mdzod kyi chu po dang gangs mo bzang zhes bya ba'i mo chu ste chu bo gnyis 'dus kyi 'dzom du bzhugs sgar phab/ spyi lo 1637 rab byung 11 pa'i me glang zla 8 tshos 8 la srongs thang bde chen rdzong gi rmang bti nga / yul de'i gzhi bdag dgon brag pas ci bsgo'i phrin las sgrub/ chu 'dzom gyi mtsho sman mos shing dang / dgon brag pa'i sring mo dang ri btsan gyis rdo'i phrin las sgrub par las blangs pa bzhin rdzing can ri phyogs nas rdo gter chadan pa char rud chen pos bkyil te 'du khang rgya khyon dge 'dun dug brgya lhag tsam sgo nga ba'i gtsug lag khang lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis bgegs med bde blag hu tshib ste 'byug sprungs thang bde ba chen po'i pho brang zhes ming btags/lugs gnyis phrin las kyi la 'o( sgyur bzhin bar re zhig thugs phebs par bzhugs/ /146

las mgon sde bzhi'i lung bstan bzhin dbang 'dus pho brang bzhengs pa/༄༄/ / cheras kyi rgyal po zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi gdan sa yas man zhes pa spungs thang rdzong dang dbang 'dus pho brang gnyis las/44 dbang 'dus pho brang rgyab rgyu'i lung bstan 'byung sa gnyis las dang po ni/ che sa skyong pho brang ngam khu byug wa dgon du grags pa'i gnas de'i/ zhes pa dang / sngon ngag dbang chodas kyi rgyal po yab sras rim par phebs nas zhabs kyis bcags shing sa gzhi sku(ngas su/ bzung ba dang / lhag par yang zhabs dung rin po che yun ring por bzhugs nas rdzon shing sgu ma'i stong po rab rgyas kyi dung du dpal ye shes kyi mgon po lcam dul la sog su pa chos skyong srung mas zhal gzigs te gdan sa dbang 'dus pho brang gi lung bstan byung ba sogs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar na/ khu khu/ga la cheras spyotshong 〈sna brang nas gdan sa dbang 'dus pho brang rgyab rgyu'i lung bstan byung 4༷dug pa dang /lung bstan byung sa gnyis pa ni/ snyo rong gi mi rnams chags sdang phyogs ris sna tshogs su song 'dug pa thabs kyis mnan pa la da lta dbang rdzong gi thad 'di sa'i 'gag dam pas der rdzong btsan po zhig cis kyang dgos 'dug dgongs/ da lta'i 44 ma na khri grag pa ngag dbang lhun grub kyis mdzad pa rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyi rnam thar dpag bsam ma rshangs 'du'i snye ma brgya brgyad cu tham pa'i mdun gnyis pa nas/45 ma khan khri bcu pa bstan 'dzin chodas rgyal gyis mdzad pa lto'i chodas 'byung 'jam mgon smon mtha'i phreng ba so drug gi ma dun nas/ 147

mgon khang gi thad 'thur du rtsogs su mdzad nas dbang gi sgrub pa gnang ste bsnyen grangs tshang ba dang bsnyun/ ram pa'i rta mgrin mgo legs kyis bar spong dwangs sang gi lcags zam bcad de phul ba'i rten 'brel gyis lto'i rgyal khab 'di dpal ldan 'byug pa'i chab 'bangs su nges par 'a//ra ba'i thugs thag bcad de/ ྅tshen ngag dbang che sa rgyal yang / led pa'i khyi 'thur lha lang du ye shes mgon po'i mchog mthun gyi dngos grub thob pa yin 'dug pa'i rten 'brel gyi che bar dgongs nas/khyi 'bud lha khang du byon nas thugs dam la bzhugs pas mi nag po zhig gis ri glang po nyal/ 'du'i sna la sgrub pa mdzad na rgyal/ lams dbang du 'dus so zer nas mi snang bar khu/ra/snga dro phyag g.yodag 'ga' la/ ri ma gi'i sna la ci 'dug ltos 3snag gsungs/ bltar pyin pas/ bya rog bzhi la phyogs bzhir bltas nas 'dug pa 'ong slobs pa dang lding bsgor byas nas phyogs bzhir 'phur song ba'i tshul snyan du zhus pas/ cad de ka rten 'brel bzang nga'i las mgon sde bzhi yin/ phyogs bzhir la lta ba nga nga 'thur song ba de bstan pa phyogs mthar rgyas pa'i rten 'brel yin pas der 'aspo gsungs te byon nas gdan sa bcags 'dug pa gang ltar yang / snu sa spyodang srung ma las mgon sde bzhis lung bstan pa ltar spye lo 1638 rab byung 11 sa stag lor cad chu dang dwangs chu 'dzoms sa'i ma do sa gnad shin hu che ba der/ bzhi bdag chu bdud dang / btsan brag dam la btags te sa 'dul mdzad nas 'gram bting nas gdan sa btab ste therdzo brang bzhengs pa la ming dbang 'dus pho brang zhes gnang ngo / /148

sde srid gtsang pa'i dpung dmag gsum pa'i khyetshogs las rnam par rgyal ba/tsho༅/ / sde srid gtsang pa'i dbu bla rje btsun hā ra nā tha sde srid kyi tsa nas log gyon snyos shig skyel ma'i sar sde srid kyi phebs sgo la/ me mangs 'di thams cad ra lung pa la mosnas pa'i stabs/ sde pa dang 'grag pa lugs legs mdzad dacerdzos 'du/zhis dang / sngar lugs ma legs pa la stodag pa bskur mkhan yang mang pe sku nga gin 'dug cha gnyig nas rnam rtog rang mi dgo sa pa 'dug kyang / rnam grangs mang po rang gī gleng tsa na/ rtog dpyod phran bu yong gin 'dug pas ji ltar legs gros 'di tshul du phebs kyin 'dug gsu/ngas/ lan du/ ra 'u/nga pa dang 'u/gas legs khu/nga na los kyang dga'/ chu thag sku gas sa cha than thun sde ma pa gnang 'dug pa de dgos pa rang chung bar 'dug pas glod pa rang dga' mod zhus/ zhes dang / 'o so cag ni chos pa'i sde tshan su dang su la/'ang sdang sems snying ma sdug byas ma myong / lhag hu ra lung pa gong ma ba dang lhag bsam dkar bar yod / mjal ni ma myong / rin po che mi pham chotshes rgyal gyi skabs yig 'brel yang che ba yin/ zhes gsungs 'dug yang sde pa gtsang sa rang kun spangs drang nas btsams gar zhin la brten ra lung pa dang 'gal ba de ga kun la gsal/ nged ra lung pa dang thug ma myong / zhes dang / yang chos/ pa dgra ru langs pa 'di 'du dang / 'jig rten phal pa'i dgra gnyen yin cig mi 'du bas/ rang la mi gcadad pa'i bag sku da mtshams tshigs zin pa zhig ni dgos rgyur 'dug ces gsungs pa las sde srid garma bstan spyong dbang po dang zhabs dung 46 rdzo nang rje btsun hā ra nā tha'i rnam thar nyis brgya don lnga las /149

rin nge che 'a/gas legs thugs snang gtsang mar //ra pa yin na yang / ma hā ka la lcam dul bka' sdod bcas kyis phrin las sdong spongs g.yel med du mdzad pas/sman rdzongs kyi rgyud 'di dag 'byug pa'i mnga' 'og tu tshud pas rtse sa srid kyi mnga' thang stobs 'byor dar rgyas su gyur pa de'i tshe/ gzhan sde bla ma lag lnga phyogs gtogs bcas mthu stobs ci yod kyis 'gran kyang ma thub pa'i tshe/ sod kyi rgyal po gtsang sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal sku dgra dngos de ni sngar nas bsgral tshar zhing / de'i sras /mi bstan spyong dbang po ni yab tsam sku dgra ma yin zhing / 'dir zhabs dung rin po che nas kyang sras bame bstan skyong dbang po gzhon nu yin pas phyis su cir 'gyur mi shes dathodangs pas gtang nā mas su mdzad 'dug pa bzhin gyis su phan tshun thugs snang dag pa la/ lhag par jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha dang / sa kyi bdag chen mthu stobs dbang pos mchod yon legs spyor gyi dgongs pa bzang pos phan tshun legs sbyadar gyi the nya 'grul ba las/ sde srid nas kha zhe med pa'i bshags pa phyal zhing maglerdzod sku na thugs snang gtsang mar gyur kyang / bla ma lngas zhu nan che bas srid kyi ngo srung tsam du spyi lo 1639 rab byung nyanya sa mo yos lo la dmag dpon sde pa sgo lung pas gtsos bod kyi dmag ltor bcug ste 'ong pa na/ zhabs grang rin po che lcags ri'i mgon khang du gyon te/ che sa skyong la mi dang mi lab pa bzhin bka' stsal zhing / phyag nas gnang ma thag glo bur du spyan gzigs thams cad 'gul zhing bskyod pa'i zil dpag tu med pa byung ba dang / nub gcig 'bras la'i phyogs nas btso chen po me zil 'thor bzhin du 'ongs nas bod dmag gi sgar du babs/ dmag dpon gyis gtsos thams cad 'jigs te chodas rje 'byug pa'i mtshan brjod cing dmag mi phal cher bros/150

zhabs dung rin po che dbang 'dus pho brang dang / gdung brgyud ngag dbang 'jam dpal dang sde pa dbu mdzad srongs thang du bzhugs pa la/ snyo dang bod 'dres ma'i dmag dpung gis dbang rdzong dang spungs thang gi nye skor du dmag sgar bcas te yun ring du bsdad pas/ zhabs dung gi gsung las/ 'ong spungs thang du bzhugs mi ces brod dngangs re 'dug gis/ 'o bo thabs shig bya yi gsungs te/ la dwags rgyal po seng rge rnam rgyal gyi sku mched rgya pasas bstan 'dzin la phyag mdud cig dang /dpung dmag gzhan ma rnams la snying gar ljags sngags re gnang nas btang bas/ phyi'i dmag mi chos khyab can ma'i dasung chen por mthong ste bros pas/ sprungs thang gi dmag rnams kyang 'jigs shing rkang pa lam la mi tshud par bros nas snyo rdzongs bde 'jam du bkod pa ra gyur to/ / de skabs sems can gyi bde spyid dang bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes thu lagacig tu brtse bar dgongs pa'i dbang gis 'grag chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i gdan mu gsang sngags ཿrdzos gling nas dpag bsam dbang nge yang thugs kyis ma bajosnad pa'i tshul 'di ltar/ ༄gyi/ de pa bas gtsang pa dang lto nas zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam par rgyal ba gnyis snya pa'i 'phrul la brten pas/ 'u/gas ma legs pa'i sde gzar langs/ gtsang da thung snyor gcug dus dmag dpon sgo lung par thal chag med ngos thugs legs lo ba'i thugs bsam che dgos tshul se gas bka' rberteg dang gnang spyin dpag med 47 de ni lto'i ཿphas 'byung 'jam mgon smon mtha'i phreng ba so bdun rgyab nas gsag48 dpag bsam dbang pe 'i rnam thar skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i rāsnas gar sdeb grangs brgya zhe bdun mdun nas/151

sal/ bka' las/ da lam gyi 'di la nged rang la byed sa zhig yod na rgyu lus gang ci'i sgo nas 'khro sgo dka' las 'khur dgos pa byung yang byed dgos pa'i bab thob tsam yod na'ang / lto nas zhabs grang rin po che nged rang la gzigs phyogs ma legs pas byed sa ni gang yang mi 'dug yin kyang blos bzod par mi 'dug pas 'di la bar zhugs sa kyi zhabs grang las casgos pa mi 'dug pas na de ga'i zhabs bskul zhu bar sa skyu la mi sna gtong dasku sa gsungs/ da lam gtsang 'byug gi sde gzar 'di la bar zhugs legs spel gī skabs de ka nas yin 'dug pa thal sku nga ma byung tsam 'dir/zhabs dung rin po che rab lto nang / de ltar phebs ma thub kyang phag ri tsa ma du phebs dgos zhu ba'i zhu tho dang bka' ngag nan chags pa dang bcas rdzong ltar mdzad pa bzhin/ sa kyir de ga'i zhu ba phrul bas/ bdag chen rin po che'i bka' las/'byug pa thams cad mkhyen pa snyan grags dang mthun pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad pa bla na ma mchis pa rang du 'dug snyo nas dpon slob kyis khyod slob dpon la 'dzug mi 'dzug 'di mdzad nas thugs kyis mi bakhrod pa 'di 'du gnang ba mdzad pa la dad pa 'alha ra ba 'dug zhabs dung thugs gyong gtsang pa dbang che bas byed bde ba dang phan the gas pa zhig e skusgong mi shes te/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' nan chag pa 'dug pas snga 'gros gtsang pa dang snyor mi sna zhig btang / de nas nga rang cis kyang 'aX ga༄/ngas zhal bzhes gnang / mdzad pa la bsngags pa'i zhu lan kyang rgyas pa byung / de'i tshe bka' las/ da lam snyo'i dmag 'di thal song chen po rang mi yong ba 'dug mdang ngos kyi rmi lam na khyi dmar po zhig dang spyang ki zhig 'dzings grabs la so sor gyes song / 'on kyang bya thabs med pa'i blo tshab po zhig rang 'dug pas/152

sal/ bka' las/ da lam gyi 'di la nged rang la byed sa zhig yod na rgyu lus gang ci'i sgo nas 'khro sgo dka' las 'khur dgos pa byung yang byed dgos pa'i bab thob tsam yod na'ang / lto nas zhabs grang rin po che nged rang la gzigs phyogs ma legs pas byed sa ni gang yang mi 'dug yin kyang blos bzod par mi 'dug pas 'di la bar zhugs sa kyi zhabs grang las casgos pa mi 'dug pas na de ga'i zhabs bskul zhu bar sa skyu la mi sna gtong dasku sa gsungs/ da lam gtsang 'byug gi sde gzar 'di la bar zhugs legs spel gī skabs de ka nas yin 'dug pa thal sku nga ma byung tsam 'dir/zhabs dung rin po che rab lto nang / de ltar phebs ma thub kyang phag ri tsa ma du phebs dgos zhu ba'i zhu tho dang bka' ngag nan chags pa dang bcas rdzong ltar mdzad pa bzhin/ sa kyir de ga'i zhu ba phrul bas/ bdag chen rin po che'i bka' las/'byug pa thams cad mkhyen pa snyan grags dang mthun pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad pa bla na ma mchis pa rang du 'dug snyo nas dpon slob kyis khyod slob dpon la 'dzug mi 'dzug 'di mdzad nas thugs kyis mi bakhrod pa 'di 'du gnang ba mdzad pa la dad pa 'alha ra ba 'dug zhabs dung thugs gyong gtsang pa dbang che bas byed bde ba dang phan the gas pa zhig e skusgong mi shes te/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' nan chag pa 'dug pas snga 'gros gtsang pa dang snyor mi sna zhig btang / de nas nga rang cis kyang 'aX ga༄/ngas zhal bzhes gnang / mdzad pa la bsngags pa'i zhu lan kyang rgyas pa byung / de'i tshe bka' las/ da lam snyo'i dmag 'di thal song chen po rang mi yong ba 'dug mdang ngos kyi rmi lam na khyi dmar po zhig dang spyang ki zhig 'dzings grabs la so sor gyes song / 'on kyang bya thabs med pa'i blo tshab po zhig rang 'dug pas/152

sa kyi zhabs dung phebs pa dang rtse maphran tsam la nged ra'i 'di nas kyang mi sna zhig gtong dgos pa 'dug snyo'i zhabs grang sku gzhogs su yang thar na zhu yig cig byed/ bka' bakhyon 'du yong shas la ste don med kyis lab pa ni min/ 'ong gtsang pa rgya ras kyi gdung 'dzin gdan sa'i khri thog pa yin pas 'khur dgos pa'i bab thob yod gsungs/ de nas sa kyi nas bdag chen rin po che chings don la chibs la bsgyur ba'i gnas tshul gsan ma thag dpe na nge zhwags de bas gathertes mi sna nyis sprel lha la rdzongs ba gnang / thugs dam brtags pa ji bzhin sde gzar phar lag hu sku nga ba'i gtsang dpung rnams phag rir 'then pa dang thug ltor 'gro ma dgos/ legs spel sa kyi zhabs dung nas gnang mi sna sprel nge tshur 'o(ga 'o/ tsu/sa rnams zhus pas/ sems 'a tshab /nga ste da lam 'tshams po rang byung gsungs/ che sa mdzad shākya phran tshogs nas/ snyo nas 'ong dpon slob rnams kyis ni 'byug rdzus pa tsho rang gsungs bka' kyon gnang ba yin/ nged rang dpon slob 'di 'du'i thugs tshad gnang don mi 'dug zhu ba la/rje'i zhal nas pha tshan dgra dang rus pa gser zer ba yin/ brdzus dngos ci yin kyang / nged rang gi cha nas/ chodas min byas nas dkar brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar ma 'khyongs par 'khyod dgos pa yang med/ yang chodas rje 'byug pa'i bstan pa las kha phyir 'chus kyis zhabs dungs pa yang med/ bstan bshig cesas min gyi las ka byas na ni/ rje padma dkar po dngos su dbu paṇa krong nge phebs kyang rdugs 'dug bstan pa la gang phan dang dkar rgyud gong ma'i rnam thar 'khyongs na ni brdzus ma yin kyang des 'thus pa 'du/ lar rang tshig skam po phar lab tshur lab 'di la a 'thas kyi phyogs snga kun slong bcos pa 'di rang gis lan pa yin 'dug gsungs/ zhes gsal/ spyi 153

lo 1638 sa pho stag lo la red 'dug de ltar gtsang sde srid yab phun tshogs rnam rgyal skabs dmag lan gcig dang sras garma bstan spyoXng dbang pe 'i skabs lan gnyis 'ongs 'dug rung chos skyong srung ma'i nus mthus bzlog ste gtsang dgang gi khyedags las rnam par rgyal 'dug rshasna/nang gi dgra bla lag lnga'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal te rdo sngon rdzong rtsis bzhes pa/ / de yang lto rdzongs 'dir dus rabs bcu gsum bcu bzhi tsam la gyon nas gdan sa bcags te bzhugs pa'i bla ma lag lnga la rjes snge/ dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyon te dpung shed g.yul 'khrugs kyis gdan sa dang sbyan bdag 'phyogs pa 'du snyam na/ de 'du ba ni gtan nas min zhing bla lag lnga rang rang so so'i bsam spyor ngan pa las byung ba yin 'dug rgyu mtshan ni 'di ltar/ snyo rdzongs 'dir zhabs drang gi sngon la byon pa'i bla lag lnga tsam gyis ma tshad pa'i bla ma gzhan yang mang po sku da pa gsal po zhu na/ spa spo gnas phu dgon par gnas phya sprul ༷yi gathe nga dkar lar gathe nga dkar la'i sprul kriX mtshams brag darga na par mtshams brag sprul sku/ sngan lung sgang steng dgon par sgang steng sprul sku/shar ri dwangs dgon par ri dwangs bla ma/ nyi zer sgang la nyi zer sprul skru sogs sngar nas byon pa'i rnyingama'i bla ma rnams dang / de bzhin spa sgar dgon par spa sgar bla ma/spyi zhing dgon par spyi zhing bla ma/ ri tshogs dgon par ri tshogs bla ma/ shar wang dgon par shar wang bla ma/ phang yer dgon par phang yer bla ma/ nas pa dgon 154

par nas pa bla ma sogs sngar nas gyon pa'i sa kyi bla ma rnams kyis/ zhabs grang ngag dbang rnam rgyal lto rdzongs 'dir rjes su gyon pa na gdul bya dus la babs te 'gro don phrin las dang sku bsod dbang thang ji tsam rgyas kyang de la phrag dog dang 'gran sems gtan nas med pas chags sdang gis dmag 'khrugs ma byas par brten/ bla ma nga dgon pa de rnams la zhabs dung gis kyang gang yang ma byas par gdan sa ke gon pa rnams rang mal dang / gdan 'dzin bla ma rnams kyang da lta'i bar rang mal du yod pa bzhin bla ma lag lnga pos kyang gong gi bla ma de rnams dang 'du ba zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal la phrag de ga 'gran sems kyis chags sdang dang dmag 'khrugs ma byas na da lta'i bar rtse nga gi bla ma gzhan rnams dang 'du bar gdan sa ke nga bla ma rnams rang mal du yod nges pa yin rgyu yang / bla ma lag lnga pos ni gong du bshad pa'i rnying ma dang sa kyi'i bla ma gzhan dang 'du bar ma bzhugs par 'ong rang thag lnga bsdongs te zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal la phrag dog dang 'gran sems skyes te mthu rtsal nus pa ci yod kyis dmag 'khrugs yang yang byas pas ma thub par/bod du gtsang sde srid dmi bstan spyong dbang po la rgyab dpung zhus te dmag 'grigs yang yang byas kyang ma thub par mthar bo rang tsho'i gdul skal zad pa ni nyi ma nub pa 'gor thabs med pa lta thu dang / zhabs grang ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi gdul byu dang 'gro don phrin las dus la babs pa ni nyi ma shar ba lag mthil gyis mi 'gebs pa'i dpe bzhin/ zhabs grang ngag dbang rnam rgyal phrin las kyi sdongs grogs ni dpal mgon ma hā ka la lcam dul gyis mdzad pas/ ka31ga pa'i brgyud 'dzin wang glang ma lung gi bla ma dpal ldan dmag 'khrugs skabs lnga lam du gshegs/ lcags zam pa'i 155

/dan sa rta macesag sgang dmag 'khrugs skabs me la bsregs te mthu med par byas/gnas rnying rje btsun rang gi bya spyod kyis bston du tshud/ bla ma lha pa gcig su po thabs bral bas gnas sgos te phag ri thag nye sa khang thu ltag lung rdzong du byon nas snyo rdzongs 'dir nang gi dgra bla lag lnga'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal te spyi lo 1641 dang rab byung 11 lcags sgrul lor bla ma lha pa'i gdan sa rim gzhung rdo sngon rdzong zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis rtsis bzhes te rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas bgegs bskud dang srung 'bor mdzad de bkra shis chodas rdzong zhes btags nas/ gdan sa phan tshun gnyis zhes pa las nam zla dbyar gzhugs gnas kyi gdan sa mdzad 〈sna/ /156

dge sog /'dres ma'i dpung dmag dang po'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba rin sprungs rdzong bzhings pa/༄nyu / / de nas spyi lo 164'a rab byung 11 pa'i chu rta lor bod gangs can rdzongs sog po bstan 'dzin che sa rgyal gyis dbang bsgyur nas thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun tshi ba pa'i sku phreng lnga pa chodas rgyal khri sredang lde'u btsan phrin las kyi sprul pa/ rgyal dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho dbu blar bsten nas ma nga' ris skor gsum/ dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ mdo lams sgang dug dbang yon du phul te bod rdzongs spyi'i bla mar mnga' gsol/ sde srid kyi khrir se ga rgyal bstan 'dzin ཿtshes rgyal dang / nang se a'u 'am bsod nams che sa 'phel bzhugs skabs/ sku ga po'i dmag dpon dge sku ga te/ red kyis sngar g.yul ngo las yang yang rgyal ba'i lang 3/ra dang stobs shugs dregs pa'i nga rgyal gyis lto mon kha bzhi mnga' zhabs su bsdu ba bla snyam pas spu lo 1644 rab byung 11 pa'i shing sprel lor thog mar dmag dpung zhig bcug pas/ gasku thabs kyis ka wang rdzong bslus kyang cher gzhed ma thub/ ma hā ka la dathung tshogs gyi zil ma bzod par rim pas go khrab dang / me mda' la se gas pa'i mtshon cha mang po dang /gur chen dang / rta drel la sogs pa rgyu nor mang po rtsis bzhes te/ nang so dngos grub dang / 'brong rtse nas dang / 'dus 'byung nas se gas dmag dpon rnams shi chad med par 4)te'adrir bzung / 'brug pa'i mthu la glags ma rnyed pa'i grags pas khyab/ smadan du bla lag lnga dang 'byug pa thug pa'i dmag bskul la lha pa'i gdung 41 'ong sa lnga ji 'i rnam thar dā ku la'i gordzos bzang pod ka pa brgya bcu gcig gi mdun nas/ 157

brgyud sku gzhon pa byon/ de nyin mchodad yon rnams rdzong du bzhugs gral la phebs pa dang 'grigs/ nged la rgyu mtshan gsungs pa sde par gnas tshul 'di bzhin yin 'dug pas deng sang dacing snon zhig mdzad na dka' tshogs cher med 'phros zhus par khrel dgod dang bcas gtsang pas sdug po btang nas da mag mi byed ka med byung de 'du'i blo rgya med gsungs kyang / me chu ring du ma bsad pas sor dang 'dom gyi dper song zhing / gtsang dus snyo 'byug gi bu gte gnad che ba rdzong go rnams su yod pa glod bkrol mdzad pa'ang snying rje rgas pa zhe sdang gi rgyu byas/ zhes gsal/shing sprel/ rmikhrid yon snyo brag phyogs su phebs pa'i gdong du/ zhes dang /bod sog gi dmag bdun brgya skor yon du rtab 'aspos kyis gnang 'dug pa dgang chung bas la nyes kyi rnam pas nang so dngos grub dang 'brong rtse dang / 'dus 'byung nas kyis gtsos pa la shas btson la 3/ra/ se ga dmag dum thu de tshur thar yang klad 31ra ba lta thus ma legs tsam ༄/nga 'dug/ zhes gsal/spang ri zam pa'i mgon lang du 'jog rgyu'i mgon po'i sku bzhengs pa'i me ris rnams bakhrod ba'i phyag rjes bsgrubs shing gtsang mkhan chen nas ye shes mgon nge 'i phyag mtshan mi rta bcu gsum dus gcig la bsad pa'i ral gri changs gzung gser tshags can zhig phul rten 'brel bzang dbo ngas shin tu thugs dgyes par gyur/ de'i5 /sa mgon po'i srog 'khor gri snying gi bca' bzhi gnang ba na/ mgon po'i chod ga'i skabs yun shin hu ring por phyag rol dug brdungs spyan dmigs lta 50 rnam thar dā ku la'i rtse sa bzang brgya nyer bzhi'i rgyab nas/51 zhabs drung rnam thar cerdzos kyi sprin chen po'i dbyangs go gcig gi mdun nas/158

stangs mdzad pa na/ bya rog gdong can gyis mi gnyig 'khrid cadangs nas 'cham stabs dang bsres nas bsgral sku nga gsungs/ nangs par mgon phyogs su dge ldan pa'i dmag dpon gcig bsad pa'i gri snying gtam snyan bcas 'bul mi 'byor/ sku bzhings grub nas bzhugs khang du bcug pa'i tsho sgra dang ltas chen po khu/nga /|rshar rnying che sa kyi snying po nyams len gyi mthar thug rnams gcig par ma zad/gnas skabs su'ang rgyal dbang rje la serdzogs pa na rim skusnang ma dag dang/ padma dkar po'i dus nas sngags rnying ma la dgongs bzhed cher yod pa dang / slob dpon padma 'byung gnas zhal gzigs shing / 〈snags pa chen perdzo'i snang ba thugs nyams ༄/ bzhes ge'i rgyun bzang po mnga' bar ma zad/ rig 'dzin zhig po gling pa nas lhag par 'brel chags shing gter che sa rnams kyi bka' babs/ khyad par du'ang rje nyid kyis ku ru zhi ba dang / dug po'i bsnyen sgrub rtags thon par gnang zhing / rig 'dzin thongs 'dus kyi lung bstan las/ yi/ rgyan nga dang rtag hu bka' baX sa mdzad/ ces gsu ngas pa dang / sde na pa nyid rtswa can du mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan nas/slar u rgyan yul gyi sa'i cha/ dri med mdangs ldan gyi mtsho dkyil padma las brdzus te skyes nas gyon pa ni zhes slar a/ rgyan gu rur sprul te khyodan par gsungs pa dang / phyi/ u rgyan nga nyid gnyal smad lha rjer skye/ / dwags po'i ri la dom sgom khyu 'byung zhes/ /lung bstan bden na gsar rnying 'gal mi srid/ / 'gal bar bsam rnams 'khrul pa snying re rje/ / zhes zhabasna grang rang gis mdzad pa'i myong grol chen po'i dkar chag tu gsungs 'dug pa'i dgongs pa ni ston pa bcom ldan 'das nyid slar skyod rgyan rin pa' zhabs grang rnam thar ཿphas kyi spyin chen po'i dbyangs brgya nyer drug mdun nas/ 159

po cher sprul te gyon pa dang / o rgyan rin po che dwags po lha rjer sprul te gyon pa yin paradagongs pas na/ skorshas 'dir yang skyed rgyan rin po che la lung bstan zhu bar mdzad cing / lung bstan thob nas shing bya lor rig 'dzin chen po sangs rgyas gling pa'i gdung brgyud/ lha sras dam 'dzin gyi rnam 'phrul rig 'dzin chen po zhig po gling pa'i skye mtha'/ garma rig 'dzen snying po shar kong po'i yul nas gdan dungs/sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi ཿwas bka' skyodangs su rdzogs pa dang / bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa bskyed rdzogs spye dang bye brag gi gdams pa dbang khrid/ mkha' 'aspo bka' srung gi chodas skor zab cing rgya che ba dang / phur sgrub thugs kyi snying po dang thugs rje chen po 'chadar ba las lha la la se gas pa gsang sngags rnying ma'i blangs kyi rnam grangs mang du gsan/ de nas spa ༷ khyodags sa/ gdan sa zhig bcags dasku ngas te zhabs dung rin po che dpon slob rig 'dzin snying po dang bcas pa spa spor gyon nas sa dpyad gzigs/ spa hro rin srongs rdzong bzhengs pa'i skor la lo rgyus gnyis snang / dang po ltar na/dam che sa pad dkar dgung 'o/ lngar babs dus yab kyis pang du blangs nas lcags ri rdo rje gdan la/ dpal 'grag pa rin po che mthu chen ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs dung du mjal bar byedan/ 〉thos rir phebs nas zhag 'ga' sku nga tsa na yab la bla ma'i bkas/ rdo rje rgyal po khyod la da dung thu gcig yod pa 'du gsungs/ yod lags zhugs pas/ khyod kyi mi brgyud kyis nga la phan thogs par 'dug pas/ da lta /3 zhabs grang rnam thar cheras kyi sprin chen po'i dbyangs go bdun gyi mdun nas/ji rtse dam chorshas gad dkar gyi rnam thar thugs rje chen po'i dri bsung bdun gyi rgyab nas/160

song la gzhis bu smad rnams 'dir 'khrid 3/ga khyod la dgra phyi'i char pa bas nang gi thigs pa 'od pa zhig skurdzong bar 'dug gsungaso/ bka' bzhin gsang stabs kyis yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa sku zhabs su 'byor/ de dus yab rdo rje rgyal po rang gis dmag dpon mdzad nas spa spo ri na chen srongs rtsis bzhes/ de bzhin yul snyo/ gyogs kyi rgyal khams thamasacad kyang rim bzhin chab cadag tu bcug sku / zhes gsal/yang dung grang rnam thar nas/ de skobs zhabs drung rin po che gsang sngags zab don pho brang nas/ spa gro dpal ri dang / gyang sar la tsas la/ 'grus byedas sdings se gas la rjidang sa brtag dpyad gnang ba las/ bla ma 'brug bsam gtan khu darbon/ bla ma bkra shes/ bla ma daskadan mchodag 'byug rgyal/ che sa rje 'byug grags/ri na chen 'byug rgyal/ bla ma btsan dar yab sras rnams zhabs grang rin nge che mjal 'thul la phyin te/ ce khrab gcig gis gcesas pa'i le tshan phul nas/ bla ma rin po che rjo nga sa gzhan du btsal ba ma gnang zhig spa spo khung pa'i sa mdud rdzong sa'i cadas su gyur pa rdzong hū ral la de rang lags pas bzhes pa zhu/ rdzong yang de la rang la rgyug pa mkhyen lags zhus pas/ phebs ste/ra/ khyod hū ral bla ma rnams las re che yang che la byung yang byung / khrab phul ba 'di yang rten 'brel legs/ da ni bu gte bral 'ul thams cad yangs pa yin pa ma zad/ rjidang la gar babs snge/ bdag kyen ma thong srol kyang yod do gsungs/ gdan sa phan tshun dang / spa spo phyag ma dzod bcas snyepa deb yig re re gnang / rdzong gi sa rin yang yong ngo gsungs/ phyos gnang byin s+ho cher gnang ba la/ gzar chen rdor rgyal bas dmag dpon byas te rdzong hūṃ ral la 5tā hū ral drung dung nga ba sras kyi rnam thar mdo tsam gleng ba rin po che'i do shal nga brgyad rkya rgyab nas sasal /161

'phyog zer ba rnams mtshang checad/ / zhes gsal ba bzhin sgru ral brag 'di sa gnas mang po'i dkyil du 'dug pas mchog tu dge bar dgongs nas der gyon pa na/ hū ral bla ma rnams kyis kyang dad pas macerdzod gzhis su phul nas der bzhugs skar phab/ gang ltar yang spyi lo 1646 rab byung 11 rje nyid dgung lo 53 me khyi lor hū ral rdzong gyang thog tshad lnga pa de bshig ste lto 'phye brtags sa che ga sta gon bgegs spyod bcas mdzad de pho brang bzhengs nas ring por ma thogs par grub ste 'byug rin chen srongs zhes btags se / / /lhas byung gi thugs dam cadad gsal gzigs snang la mi nag po zhig byung nas stag tshang gi gnas 'di khyod la 'bul/ 'di khyod kyis bzung nas sus kyang 'phrog par mi 'gyur ba'i phrin las nged kyis sgrub zer nas song ba gzigs/ sang kro 'khor la de ring nged tsar 'ong mi byung na ma bkag par gtong zhig gsungs/ stag tshang dkon nyer phyag mjal sgog sngon chag pa zhig khyer te 'ongs pa bdag med du lus par/ gong sas mi ma byung ngam gsungs/4 spung po zhig sgo na yodad zhus pas da lta thong gsungs te bcar/ khyod ga nas yin gsungs pas stag tshang nas yin zhus/ der da lta sdod mkhan su yod sogs gsungs/ kasku ga pa'i gra rigs 'ga' sku da ces rgyu mtshan rgyas par zhus/ gong sas ras dkar gyi dar cog 'dom gang tsam zhig gnang nas 'di khyer la gnas kyi rtse mor 'phyar te khug dug po lan gsum brgyag la dus de ring nas stag tshang gnas 'di ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis dbang ba yin pas dga' gus rnams sngar bzhin sngerdzod lugs dang / mi rangs pa rnams da lta rang 'gro chas gyis zer ba rnams ma brjed par nga ro chen po sgrogs shig 56 bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyi rnam thar 'dodi pa'i re 〉snang dpag bsam gyi ste ma sum brgya gcig gi mdun nas gsal/162

bzung / rim pas spa gro'i yul rdzongs zhabs kyis bcags te sprungs thang bde chen pho brang du phebs nas gzar chen chos rjer bka' tham 'di zhin gnang bar mdzad/3 rang re dbal las palisi las yigyed po rnams i ngesargyu / nged kyi gzar chon chos rjo snod brgyudari'i par bcas pa rnams/ gzhan ma ltar 'do pas brdzus pa'irigs brgyud nyag lhog tsam min pu sdon dus khro nyo je gag 'an gyilo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba'ido na ro gangs can du bstan pa phyis dar laspran che/ bar du chos rnge rsā tshang pa'izhal slob snyad 'thug bstan palibadag pho kyai'i dkar ba/ tha mar mtshungs med rgyal dbang rje'i dgomo dang gnyen gyi'abrel bar song bas 'grug palha ma/ da lta snar rgyaladang spyan pa ga〉 bdag lhe༄ rtod 'kho bstan pa'i gagibatsugs ba la lus srog 'asto nus pa'izhabs togadagra 'dul gyiregs ram thabs rten 'brel sna chogs pa'i sgo nas sri tshe bar go pa dang /des na spyi'i dkar brgyud/ ltos dpal 'thug pa na ྾ rkyi thugs kyisras/ snying lhas song bas bdag la bsam pa'irjes 'jugarnams byas/ kho rang dathon brgyudarim par ljong gzhesi byes sogs gang du yang gzhan dang yimanyam pa'imatheng bkur/ gdan sngas / skyems chang / rta skyel des 'degs sogs dang / lhag par khong rang spyis bzlum pa'i shā rigs rnams la ro|gson gyi'al ngul sogs la bsnyad btaX rtsa ba nas yis ba ye ges mge3 po dpang por bcol b.lim/ 3 dpal 'thug pa mthu chen nas 'joms rdo /sa gris/zhes pa'i bka' geg zhabs stsa rin so /'i phyag gris phyag tham can gzar chon chos 164

dzee khyo dbang 'dug nor bu nas shung bad lta 'thug gzhung dpe mañdzad khang du mjal yul du bzhugs yeshe pa nas zhal babazhus pa lags snang/ / dge ldan pa'i dpung chen gnyis pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal te rang btsan je brtan du gyur pa/༄7/ / de nas bod du nang so a'us g.yo thabs kyis 'byug pa'i gdan sa'i dathu che rje'i zur sras dpon slob bstan rgyas pa/ cog grwa bla ma sogs gtso che rnams 'di ra skru zhabs su brdzangs nas chings sna sbrel te srongs thang 'du khang chen mo'i khri chog por zhabs grang nyid phebs/ sde pa dbu mdzad dang gnyer pa g.yang 'dzin gyis ma khron gnyer byas te/ bod kyi sde dpon che gras nyer gcig tsam 'dir btson du yod ge de rnams kyis rang rang go khrab dang mtshon cha rnams thogs te ngos kyis lag bdar te phyal ba de las/ dmag dpon gtso bo nang so dngos tshib dang / mda' dpon bkras sgang nas gnyis kyi go khrab mchon cha 'bor gsum rten 'brel gyi che bar dgongs mgon po gtso bo'i bzhugs gdan du phul/ dge sog o rod kyi gser khrab ngang / sde pa 'dos chung ba sogs dmag dpon dug shos tsho'i go khrab rnams da lta ma son po sgrub mche da kyi skabs spyan gzigs su bsgrigs pa 'di dag yin la/ ma'on bang gi mtshan yang ga5/la rgyal maskutshen khang du ga31la te gago/la las rnam par rgyal ba'i gtang rag dga' ston rgya cher mdzad pa'i gtam phyogs kun du grags pa na/165

bden mi bden brtag pa'i ched nang so nor thu phag rir thug 'ongs nas bden pa ra shes te log / 'byug pa la dga' ba'i bod pa rnams kyis/ bla ma snyo ru bzhugs 'dug / 'thul ba lto la rgyab song / dngos grub 'grag pas bsdus 'dug / nor thus bya ra byas se nga / / zhes pa'i tshig gi glu blangs pa dbus gtsang thams stad du grags/ sde bdag 'go dpon rnams bston las btang ste bde bar slog pa bod du 'byor nas yang mi ring bar/ nang so dngos grub kyis gdan sa ra lung rtsis len la slobs/ de skabs gdan sa'i gnyer pa 'byug rnam rgyal ba yin pas rtsis spyod byas mthar 'ong cho la nges par sdig rgyur phyi'i rnam 'gyur las shes nas/ sku chas gnang chen zhig lus 'dug pa de yang blangs nas 'bul dgos zer len khul du 'gro ba skad byas gsang thabs su bros te srongs thang du 'byor nas mgron gnyer bste/sa/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong se gas bstan pa'i phrin las rgyas par gyur/spyi lo 1648 rab byung 11 pa'i sa gyi lor bod kyi yar lha sham po'i lung bstan pas/ na ro'i sprul pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis/ / lta sgom spyod 'bras bzhi yi sgo dag nas/ / snang srid khams gsum dbang du 'dus pa la/ / 'dre na chung bod kyi brnyas snge/ ga la 'dṛṣṭar/ / khrab chen dag la gad bdar mkhas na yang / ngan sngags dug mda' brtan pa ga la srid/ / 'jig rten lha la gsol mchodad rems na yang / /ye shes lha yi bka' chad ga la zlog / sra zhing mkhregs pa rdo rje pha lam la/ mchon cha sno yang 'jig pa ga la srid/ / phran gya chung gi dmag rnams snying re rje/ / dge byas sdig byas mi rnams thams cad kun/ / bsad kyang ngan sku(nga gasnge/ma du ga la gtong / / rdo rja 'chang nyid yin nges dathu bsnyung bzhes/ / glang gi lo la 'gong po166

sprun dgu po/ / smon lam dbang gis thams cad rjerdzol bar nus/ / phag gi 'o/ la rgyal sras thugs rje myur/ / skal ngan bod 'bangs mi rnams snying re rje/ / zhes 'byung ba ltar/da sngar bod khri skor bcu gsum lhag pa'idamag gis lto 'byug pa mi gcig la ma thub zer ba'i grags pa ngan pa bzlog ste snyo mon bod kyi mnga' zhabs su bsdu ba'i sems ldan bod kyi sde pa bsod nams che sa 'phel lam nang so a'us spyi lo 1648rab byung 11 pa'i sa byi 'o/ra slar yang dge ldan pa'i dgang chen gnyis pa snga ma las shin hu stobs che ba'i dmag dgang brdzangs te zla ba lnga sdebar gcad gang thub bskul yang / zhabs dung rin po ches dgongs 'dus rgyal chen bzhi'i mtho 'dzugs mdzad pa de nyid rdo rje pha lam gyi brag la chu shing mtshon chas btab pa ltar se nga nas gcad ma thub pa'i khar/ snu sa skyong dang sde brgyad kyis rgyud bskul ba'i rnam pas bod kyi dmag dathung rnams go mtshe na dang brgyags phye thams cad kyang khyer dbang ma khu/nga bar bskyur te bros par //ra/'a87 'o/ra dbus dpung rnams kyis spru nag lar tsha lam gyis slebs sar phyin/gtsang dgang gis nyung ral lar ste/ra rgyag tsha 'tshil pas/ da cha zla gcig tshun la thus 'gro tshul sa gro rtse bkras bzhis sde par zhus 'dug kyang / sde pa nor thu sdod ma nus par 'ud zhogs kyis bros pas sgar chas dang go cha phal cher yang spro/ra bas phag rir dkyil sgar la cog bu zhig 'thubs dartse sa pa 31gas skad cha bshad thebs med pa mang po gleng 'dug de'i skyon gyis dbus dpung rnams kyang tshur ldog par dka' chogs shin / che bas grang che rbesgor gsum yang 'khang lang tsha bar snang / zhes gsal ba 57 gong sa lnga pa'i rnam thar du ༷/ la ka pa brgya bzhi bcu'i rgyab phreng lnga pa nas/167

bzhin/ go khrab dang mtshon cha'i 'thul ba mang po phyag mdzod du 'byor/ dmag dpon dang lding dpon thams cad bston du bzung / g.yul las rnam par rgyal cing rang dbang rang btsan je brtan du gyur pa'i dga' ston dang chodas skyong gi gtang rag chen po mdzad/ thugs byams brtse'i yul du dgongs nas mi ring bar bod dpon btson du tshud pa thams cad gnang spyin dang bcas bde bar rang yul bod du btang gnang bar mdzad/ de yan zhabs grang rin po che rang nyid bzhugs skabs la bod dmag thengs lnga cadangs pa las rgyal la thob 'dug rtse /snga da dmag gis gatherdzod mi tshugs gsungs shing bye ba phyag tsha dang dar dkar rdzong bzhengs tshul/ste༅༅ / / da phyin chad dge ldan pa'i dmag yodang mi nus sam zhus pas/ tshod med pas da rung yongs/ nged rang la gnod ni mi tshugs/ da byung na go mtshon gyis langs ba 'dug pas skusgos dar rang dasku(sa gsungs pa/ 'phral bzhad gad kyi tshul du gsungs kyang phyags lung bstan lta bur gyur/ phyis su spyi lo 1656 57 rab byung 11 pa'i me pho sprol la sde srid dang po gshegs lo dang / me mo bya lo sde srid gnyis pa'i skabs —la bod kyi sde srid bsod nams rab brtan kyi dmag 'ongs pa dang / yang 'dir sde srid gsum pa'i skabs spyi lo 1668 rab byung 11 pa'i sa sprel lo bod kyi sde srid grong smad pa phrin las rgya mtsho'i dpung dmag 'ongs pa dang / spyi lo 1675 76 rabasgyung 168

11 pa'i shing yos dang me 'byug la sod kyi sde srid blo bzang spyin pa'i dmag 'ongs pa dang / yang 'dir sde srid brgyad pa'i skabs spyi lo 1714rababyung nya' pa'i shing rta'i lor sog po lha bzang khang gi dmag 'ongs pa dang / yang 'dir sde srid bcu do'i skabs bod kyi sde srid tha'i ji bse da nams stobs rgyas nas dmag thengs gsum 'o/ngas med/ dpal ldan 'byug pa'i bstan pa la gcad ma tshugs pa casnag hu gsal bas ma blosnangs 'a/nga bstan dnge sa sa/ sa/ra/de yang bod nas snga phyor dmag dpung chen po yang yang lnga ngas pa na dmag la la rtsi ba rnams kyi don du ngan song spyong ba'i cho ga chen po zhig byed rtses yin gsungs te/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje sems dpa'/ shākya thub pa la se gas pa sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam la sku1gas pa lha brgya dang batherdzo lnga sku par rnams zhabs dung rang gi phyag bzo dngos gtsang legs par grub nas byin rlabs dam rdzas mang po rin po che sna tshogs kyi phye ma'i sman 'dam las 'bum phrag mang lngardzo thugs sran pa med par nyin mtshan 'or yug hu spar btab ste phyag len du bstar nas rab gnas gnang bar mdzod/ dus skabs de yan chad du dar dkar nang zhes pa mtha' 'khob yul rdzongs khug bkyog cig yin par brten/ yul rdzongs gzhan phyogs thams cad nas dmu rgod mi sun pa'i mi rigs rnams yul thon yor jag gi tshang du yod pa der/ spyi lo 1650rab byung 11 pa'i lcags stag lor chodas kyi rgyal po zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis de phyogs kyi gdul byu ma rungs pa mi sran pa rnams kyang 'dul ba'i dus la babs par mkhyen te gdan sa spungs thang rdzong nas gzhung maX na gnyer dpa' zhing 169

brtul phod pa 'byug rnam rgyal ba dpa' tsal pa'i dgang tshogs dang bcas pa btang nas zhi dug thabs mkhas kyi rgod nas tshar bcad de mnga' zhabs ༄/ bsdus nas sngo/la phyogs bde 'jam la bkod cing rdzong bzhengs nas dar dkar bkra shis yang rtse'i rdzong zhesaming bangags de gyogs kyimi ser la gson po'i kyen sel rim grodang 〉 / gshin po'i rnam shes yar 'dren gyi don byed mkhan dar dkar spyi bla'am dpon slob bstan pa phrin las bskos te chodas srid thugs gnyis kyi bka' khrims bzang po'i srol btsugs/ bkra shis chodas rdzong du tshe dpag med kyi sgrub mchod dang spungs thang rdzong du dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes kyi sgrub mchod chen po gnas skabs chodas srid lugs gnyis kyi mnga' thang stobs 'gyor yun ring brtan cing mthar thug 'brel thog gi yid can rnams thar pa byang chub kyi go 'phang la dgod pa'i phyir btsugs par mdzad/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang khyad par du dpal ldan 'byug pa'i bstan pa mi nyams par srung zhing skyong bar mdzad pa'i mgon mang sgrub mche da kyang sprungs thang du thog mar btsugs par mdzad pa se gas mdor na bstan dang 'gro la sman pa'i mdzad phrin dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas so/ / 170

brtul phod pa 'byug rnam rgyal ba dpa' tsal pa'i dgang tshogs dang bcas pa btang nas zhi dug thabs mkhas kyi rgod nas tshar bcad de mnga' zhabs ༄/ bsdus nas sngo/la phyogs bde 'jam la bkod cing rdzong bzhengs nas dar dkar bkra shis yang rtse'i rdzong zhesaming bangags de gyogs kyimi ser la gson po'i kyen sel rim grodang 〉 / gshin po'i rnam shes yar 'dren gyi don byed mkhan dar dkar spyi bla'am dpon slob bstan pa phrin las bskos te chodas srid thugs gnyis kyi bka' khrims bzang po'i srol btsugs/ bkra shis chodas rdzong du tshe dpag med kyi sgrub mchod dang spungs thang rdzong du dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes kyi sgrub mchod chen po gnas skabs chodas srid lugs gnyis kyi mnga' thang stobs 'gyor yun ring brtan cing mthar thug 'brel thog gi yid can rnams thar pa byang chub kyi go 'phang la dgod pa'i phyir btsugs par mdzad/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang khyad par du dpal ldan 'byug pa'i bstan pa mi nyams par srung zhing skyong bar mdzad pa'i mgon mang sgrub mche da kyang sprungs thang du thog mar btsugs par mdzad pa se gas mdor na bstan dang 'gro la sman pa'i mdzad phrin dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas so/ / 170

shar phyogs su ceras rje dpal ldan 'grag pas dbang bsgyur tshul/ ༄༄/ / 'dir stobs dza/gas su dbang che ba rnams kyis las zhan nyam chung ba rnams rang dbang med par bkol zhing mnar gcod dug po btang / yul lung chags sdang rgo / ri zhin gyi sa mang tshan nyung tshan 'thab pa sku gas g.yul 'khrug dang 'thab rtsode rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / dgra jag che ma kun mang bas spong gi stod smad bar la yang skyel mkhan dgos pa sogs mi srun kla klo gdug pa'i yul gling du yod pa de/ chodas kyi rgyal sgo zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis zhi rgyas dbang dug gi phrin las rnam pa bzhi yis btul te thed rim spar gsum sku gas ceras rje dpal ldan 'byug pa'i gdul zhing du bsgyur zin te/ de bzhin rim pas nyi ma shar phyogs kyi rgyal lams kyang chodas rje 'byug pa'i gdul zhing du bsgyur tshul ni/ de yang chos 'khor rab brtan rtse ni sngon nas ngag dbang chodas rgyal gyi sras yongs 'dzin ngag gi dbang phyug gi gdan sa yin pa las/ snu sa rje 'byug pa'i mnga' 'ongs su yin pas spyi bla mi 'gyur brtan pa bskos nas rdzong rgya bskyed de bzhengs nas/ chodas rje 'grag pa'i bstan pa btsugs te yod pa las rim pas shar rdzong dug chos rje 'byug pa'i mnga' 'bangs su 'gyur ba'i lung bstan dus la babs pa na/ spyi lo 1646 rab byung 11 me khyi zhabs drang rin po che dgung grangs 53 la shar phyogs la ling rgyal po bde ba dang / 'byug rgyal gnyis sa cha dang 'bangs kyi skor rsha sa ma 'chams par dga' ldan pa'i sde srid la zhu bar se nga bas/ lta sa nas dpon 171

richen gnyis gnang ba khrid de kha ling du slebs pa dang / rgyal po bde ba dang / 'grag rgyal gnyis bden rdzun phye bas/ lto bod skad brda ma 'phred pa'i gshis kyis lo rgyus ji ltar bshad kyang mon skad ma go bar lo tsā ba re dgos zer ba bzhin/ 'byug rgyal gyi phyogs nas bod 'grag pa'i bla ma thub bstan pad dkar gyi thu rnam sras rdo rje/ bde ba'i phyogs nas rta wang bla ma chodas dbyings rgya mcho gnyis lo tsā byas nas ba den rdzun bsdur bas/ bden rdzun 'du yang mon bod skad khyad par gyis/ 'byug rgyal phyogs nas gsal dngas khungs chod pa'i tshig bshad pa lding dpon gnyis yid mgu bas/ rgyal pe bde ba yid ma rangs par phrag de ga gis dpe na gnyis la phra ma zhus pa/khyod dga' ldan pho brang pa'i dpon yin yang bsnyen bkur tshogs chang dung mi mi 'dug bla ma rnam sras la thu smad mang pos tshe gas chang dung mkhan 'dug khyed nga'i khyim la gdan dungs zer nas khyim la 'khrid de/ zas rigs mang po dang lhag par chang a rag se gas mang nge dungs pas/ dpe na gnyis chang gis bzis nas gtam sna 〉pyogs smras pas/ bde bas glags rnyed par 'dug snyam nas phra ma zhus pa/nged kyi khyim du gdan 'dren zhus te bza' btung gi bsnyen bkur phran tsam ma gtogs bla ma rnam sras kyi tshogs chang 'dren mi lha'i thu mo 'du ba mi 'dug zer bas/dpon gnyis kyis de lta bu'i mdzes ma yod dam zer/ yul stod dar ma dar phi la yod zer bas/ lta bar 'gro zer nas dpon g.yog rnams gom pa 'khyor zhing phyon te/bla ma rnam sras kyi rtse grogs thu mo lha 'du ba gnyis khrid nas ki sgra sgrog cing yong bas/bla ma rnam sras bsam par/ nyes med su mor de ltar byed pa mi cadas snyam ki ki'i khus lan btab pas/ lding dpon bstan srung zer bas nged la mir ma brtsis par 172

khus lan btab pa zer nas sku nga bas/ bla ma rnam sras kyis kyang grwa pa therdzogs ldan gnyis khrid nas phyir thon yong bas lding dpon 'khor bcas kyis grwa pa rtogs ldan der bsad do/ / bla ma rnam sras kyis kyang lding dpon snying thad gri shugs che btsugs pas shi yod bsam skug ste bros pas/ de la mtshon srung zab mo yod pas ma shi ba'i skad cha thos kyang / dge ldan pas bskos pa'i dpon yin pas phyags su tsad gcod kyis nag gzhi dug po yong bsams nas/ la cadag yul gsum dang ku re lung brgyud krong sar du slobs te dpon slob mi 'gyur brtan pa mjal/ skad cha zhib par dris pa'i lan rim par zhus pas/ dbu cog mdzad de khyod bla ma rin po che'i sku gzhogs su mjal bar 'gro dgos 'a dug gsungs/ dpon slob phyag phyir phyin pas sprungs thang du slobs/ sde pa dbu mdzad kyis sna khrid de zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal zhal mjal ba'i mod la/ spyan ras gzigs dngos kyi snang ba byung zhing mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/ zhabs dung gi bla ma rnam sras la bka' sul pa/ ༷༷da ༷/la dang skye sa gang nas yin/ 'dir ci la ye nga gsungs/ lan zhus pa/ pha yul bod dbus gzhung rgyal rab brtan rtse nas yin/ pha'i ming thub bstan pad dkar zer ba yin/ skye sa ni shar phyogs tsha se nas yin/ nga'i a pa gra sding po che nas 'grag pa sprul sku snyan grags dpal bzang gis shar phyogs mon yul du dgon lag yod pa rnams kyi bla mar bskos nas btang ba yin/ bdag kyang phas 'dzin pa'i dgon lag rnams bdag 'dzin byas te sdod pa la/ dga' pa'i ldan sku tshab dang / la ling rgyal po rnams mig la bab po ma byung bas/ bla ma'i dung du 'di phyi'i kyibs gnas zhu bar yong ba yin 173

zhus pas/ bla mas/ khyod kyi pha thub bstan pad dkar de/ nga ra lung la yod dus/snang dkar rtse'i sde pa khri dpon pas gdan 'dren byung ba dang / yar 'brog sgang gsum la nged dpon slob sgar btegs nas phyin dus ma ṇi'i dge bkrol chen po thub bstan pad dkar gyi thu yin 'dug gsungs/ thugs dgyes/ skra thud bzhes/ dbang lung man ngag thams cad gnang nas rdo rje 'dzin par bkod/ bkra shis mnga' gse la mdzad/ skru gsung thugs rten dang ma ཿtshed chas se gas gnang nas nyi ma shar phyogs su bstan pa spel cig ces bka' lung gnang bas/ shar phyogs kyi yul lams su dpon lag mang po gcig 'og gcig mi 'dzul ba nga rgyal dmu rgod kyi yul der/dug pos ma bcun par zhi ba'i sgo nas bstan pa spel thub mi yong ba 'dra zhus pas/zhabs dung gi zhal nas/ phyis nga'i bstan pa shar phyogs su rgyas pa'i lung bstan )de pas snying lams ma chung bar gyis shig gsungs/ zhabs spyi bor blangs nas krong gsar du log co gsum song ba dang / sngar bum thang snu sa 'khor dpon po spyin bdag tsa ba yin pa la/ rgyu kyen zhig gis mi 'gyur brtan pa la lngardzo 〈snag pa dang / dacing chen lan gsum bcug kyang glags ma khel bar log dpon slob thugs la bla ma'i lung bstan yod pas 'dul snyam g.yo 'phrul mang po bkram nas/ nub chu stod snu sa mdzad rgya mo bkug ste bka' gnang bas/ che sa mdzad rgya mos nga bas che sa 'bor dpon dang thag nye ba chu smad gdung bsod nams dbang po yod/ bka' bzhin gyi g.yo thabs ngas 'o la bslab bo zer nas bslabs pas/ des kyang nga bas sha khrag gis 'brel ba sdom mkhar mi dpon dbang thob yin/bka' bsgos pa bzhin g.yo thabs bo la byed bcug go zer bslabs pas/ des kyang 174

bka' bzhin 'grub nus pa nga la med kyang / nga'i zhang the lcam mkhar gnas pe mar rgan la sogs pa'i pha tshan rnams cheras 'bor dpon po'i bka' blon nang ma yin pas/ bslu e tshugs lta'i zer song ngo/ / dbang thob kyis mi 'gyur brtan pas bsgo ba rnam sa nang blon la smras pa/ 'ong yid ches nas las blangs se / de mi 'gyur brtan ge la zhus gas/ dpon hre ba kyis da ni dgang chen bcug gsungs nas/ spungs thang nas dmag dpon gnyer pa 'byug rnam pas gtsos tso chen gyi dgang chen dang / shar dar brgyad/ mang sde lung pa'i dmag dang bcas mi 'gyur brtan pas dmag dpon mdzad/ bla ma rnam sras kyis dmag rgyab byas nas/ thum thang cesas 'a6tsher ༷/ra ba zhing gi rdzong la dmag gis bsko ra nas rgyab pa dang / nang drodan las len rnams kyis sna len byas nas rdzong bcom pas/ chodas 'khor dpon po rta kyang mi kyang byas bod du gos so / mnga' 'bangs sum thang sde bzhi thams cad mnga' casnag tu bcug padma gling pa'i sku gdung sogs rten khyad 'phags dang / nor rdzas dpag med rtsis blangs/byu dkar rdzong gi gshams ra bsgrigs nas rdzong bdag gnyer pa 'o/nga ba bskos/ mi rnams kyis 'di ni mig long ba rkang pa zha ba yin pas dpon mi 'ong zer/ mi 'gyur brtan pas/ sngon bum thang lcags mkhar du sin dha rā dza zhes byung ba la/ gu ru rin po ches ma 'e ngas pa na khyod mig 'o/nga ba rkang pa zha bar skyes nas bum thang 'di dbang sgyur ba'i dpon du 'gyur ro/ / zhes lung bstan yod gsungs pas kun yid ches so der dmag dasung rnams ngal bso zhing yod pa'i skabs/ zhabs dung gi lung 175

bstan dus la babs pa dang / shar ku re lung du rag sa'i dpon lha su dar de nyes pa med par/ spyi ling dpon chen dar ma dang / phag dung rgyal po dga' ba gnyis la mthun nas bsad/ de'i yug sa mo reng mo dang / blon 'bangs rnams kyis lan byed dasku sa bsam yang stobs mnga' thang gis ma thub par ci dug la thug yod skabs/'byug pa'i dpung chen bum thang la slobs nas snu sa 'khor dpon po bcom pa'i skad cha thos pas/ 'ong rnams shin tu dga' nas dpung chen gdan 'dren zhu bar pho nya brdzangs pas/ dpung chen ku re lung du phyin pas/ rgyal po dga' ba dang dpon chen dar ma gnyis kyi dpung gis bsus nas 'thab pas pham nas bre sa/ dasnga na nge rnams btson du bzung / mnga' 'bangs ku re lung stod smad thams cad mnga' 'og tu bcugagleng gleng du rdzong btab nas lhun grub rtse zhes btags/ dpon po 'byug phran chogs bskos so/ /dgang chen shar bo long phyogs la 'khyogs pas/ bo 'o/nga pa rnams 'jigs te 'bab zhus kyis mnga' 'og hu 'dus/ dong stor bkra shis yang rtse'i rdzong btab/'brong mdo gsum zung lung pa tshun 'bab zhus byas/ dgang chen tshur 'o/ga smin rgyal yul gsum slobs/ khyodang phu rgyal po stobs mnga' thang che bas smadal ba lung pa la dza/gas bce'ongs pas gshodang sgar pa rnams ma rangs par rgyab rten zhu ba la ༷ sa sgyusdur gus nas / chos 4 dzad dkar ngo sa0 dmi chen zhu sgyur nga spra na rsā khrod sbyi yul du rdzong btsan zhing sa 'dus che ba yod pas der gyon par zhu zer/ dmag dpon gnyis kyis zhal gyis bzhes nas dpung chen la 'khyogs pa tsam la sngangs shing skrag nas lam bar gyi dnge na lag mi sde rngams cad dpa' 'thums nas mnga' 176

'bangs ༷/ sdo/gas/stong thu rgyal pos rgol ba'i gasgo mas ra bsgrigs pa dasung chen 'gro zhor ming med du brlag nas gzhong sgar du slebs/ snga tshang phyo tshang rgyal blon 'khor bcas phyogs gnyis su phye nas 'khrugs ce da kyi skabs ma da pa la/ dasung chen gyi stobs la gnyis ka ha las nas hab thob kyis 'bab zhus khu/nga ba snga tshang nas rgyal snga dar 'jam dang gtso che rnams/ phyo tshang nas rgyal po zla2 la sprun chas dang gtso che/ ba gong bre mi he long nas rgyal po rdo re sogs yongs kyis/ de nas bzung chodas rje 'byug pa'i bka' ci gsungs sgrub rgyu yin zer nas las blangs shing gnyis ga'i zhu yig zhabs 'dzul khyad med kyang / sngar nas 'dris gshis kyis dmag dpe na gnyis snga tshang pa la dag snang che tsam mdzad/ dmag dpon gnyis gzhong sgar du rdzong gi gasgo mas ra mdzad nas bzhugs/ bla ma rnam sras kyis dpung la 'thor zhig 'khrid nas a/ dza rong weng spi bram pa la sgar bca' nas sdod/ rtsing mi cho lnga/ bkra shis sgang pa/ rkang lung pa/ba ling pa rnams la mi sna bang chen btang nas/ khyod rang rnams 'bab zhu byed rgyu dang dmag bcug rgyu ci yin gyi lan gtong zer bas/ bla ma rnam sras dang la ling pa zhi 'on yod gshis/ kha ling pa'i dmag dpung u dza rong la yong nas smras pa/khyod rang chos sa dang ri rgyus legs par ston pas chodag dpung stob sa 'khrugs tsal shed nged tshos byed zer nas dmag bkod bshams nas mardzod skabs/ bla marna ma sras dmag mi khal gsum tsam gyis chu la ñtsa༄ rgyab sto grang ma'i chu tshur la 'thon byung ba ngang / la ling pa rnams pyi bsam pad / de rnam sa me chus mi thub pa 'du snyam rgol — la smre tshom byas pa dang / ba gong rgyal po rdo ri u dza rong pa dang nye ba'i gshis 77

kyis/ la ling pa'i la la nyan nas 'byug pa la rgol rtsis ma byed/ rmedzos 'khor dpon dang ku re lung dpon stobs chen rnams kyis ma thub par bcom pa yin/ lhag par la ling pa rnams dgun rgya'i las sgor 'gro bas khyod rang rnams kyis zam pa srung mi tshugs/ da lta nas 'bab zhu byed pa dug zer bas/ phyo/ dza rong bas 'bab zhus byas te weng li'i zam sna gtad pa dang / la ling dang rkang lung pa rnams kyang thabs med 'bab zhus byas/ nang du ma rangs par casnag hu 'dzul sems gcig kyang med/rgyal po bde ba dang / bla ma rnam sras ma 'chams pa dang / shar phyogs 'dir la ling pa rnams mi mang stobs mnga' thang che ba'i dregs pa dang / rkang lung rgyal po pho brang a chi pha spad/ me rag bla ma nag seng stobs mnga' thang che zhing / dga' ldan pa'i la lo sgyur mi dang nye ba yin gshis rgyab dpung la yid ches te rgyu kyen des yin 'dug de nas rtseng mi rgyal po stong ldan dpon chen gtso rgan rnams yong nas/ nged tsho ni pha spun snga tshang rgyal blon rnams bzhin phyag phyod zhu zer 'bab zhus byas so/ /de dus bkra shis sgang pa dang thus mkhar pa 'chigs skabs yod pa la cerdzos mdzad dkar po dung gis bkra shis sgang pa la smras pa/ khyod rang tsho'i rgyab rten zhu sa 'byug pa byas na kha dug dbang chen sku nga zer/ bkra shis sgang rgyal blon spos byas nas rgyal po tshe dbang dang lha nga gnyis weng li zam par bla ma rnam sras kyi grang du song nas/nged kyi kyibs mgon zhu sa khyod rang yin/ nged/kyi yul sa 'dus che zhing rdzong sa btsan po yod pas der byon par zhu zer ba dang / rgyal po snga tshang phyo tshang che rigs chung rigs thams cad 'dzoms nas/ tshig chad rdo/ da res nas bzung ཿtshes rje 'grag pa'i mnga' zhabs su 'dzul ba yin no zer nas/ rgyal po dang mi sna gtso che rnams 178

kyis/ la ling pa'i la la nyan nas 'byug pa la rgol rtsis ma byed/ rmedzos 'khor dpon dang ku re lung dpon stobs chen rnams kyis ma thub par bcom pa yin/ lhag par la ling pa rnams dgun rgya'i las sgor 'gro bas khyod rang rnams kyis zam pa srung mi tshugs/ da lta nas 'bab zhu byed pa dug zer bas/ phyo/ dza rong bas 'bab zhus byas te weng li'i zam sna gtad pa dang / la ling dang rkang lung pa rnams kyang thabs med 'bab zhus byas/ nang du ma rangs par casnag hu 'dzul sems gcig kyang med/rgyal po bde ba dang / bla ma rnam sras ma 'chams pa dang / shar phyogs 'dir la ling pa rnams mi mang stobs mnga' thang che ba'i dregs pa dang / rkang lung rgyal po pho brang a chi pha spad/ me rag bla ma nag seng stobs mnga' thang che zhing / dga' ldan pa'i la lo sgyur mi dang nye ba yin gshis rgyab dpung la yid ches te rgyu kyen des yin 'dug de nas rtseng mi rgyal po stong ldan dpon chen gtso rgan rnams yong nas/ nged tsho ni pha spun snga tshang rgyal blon rnams bzhin phyag phyod zhu zer 'bab zhus byas so/ /de dus bkra shis sgang pa dang thus mkhar pa 'chigs skabs yod pa la cerdzos mdzad dkar po dung gis bkra shis sgang pa la smras pa/ khyod rang tsho'i rgyab rten zhu sa 'byug pa byas na kha dug dbang chen sku nga zer/ bkra shis sgang rgyal blon spos byas nas rgyal po tshe dbang dang lha nga gnyis weng li zam par bla ma rnam sras kyi grang du song nas/nged kyi kyibs mgon zhu sa khyod rang yin/ nged/kyi yul sa 'dus che zhing rdzong sa btsan po yod pas der byon par zhu zer ba dang / rgyal po snga tshang phyo tshang che rigs chung rigs thams cad 'dzoms nas/ tshig chad rdo/ da res nas bzung ཿtshes rje 'grag pa'i mnga' zhabs su 'dzul ba yin no zer nas/ rgyal po dang mi sna gtso che rnams 178

rang gi yul du gyes bla ma rnam sras dmag dacing bcas gcadang sgar du 'o/ga dmag dpon gnyis la 'bab zhus cerdzor gser dngul rnams phyal nas/ gnas tshul zhib par zhus pas/ re zhig de ltar yin gsungs se / /de nas nub phyogs snyung la 'bi nas gdung nor thu dbang dpon g.yog gzhong sgar du yong nas/ dmag dpon gnyis la nged kyi lung pa 'khan ris rnam gsum thams cad la nya mkhar gdung gis dbang bsgyur nas gzhan gyi mi sde 'aX ga mnga' 'bangs thams cad la mi 'a sa mi 'tshams pa'i sdug po 'o na btang gi yod pas/ de 'dul ba la gyon par zhu/ dasung gi sna 'dren dang lam rgyus ri rgyus ngas byacad las blangs gas/ dmag dpon gnyis kyis zhal gyis bzhes te// dasung bcas snyung la 'bi la phebs/ gdung nor thu dbang spun mched blon 'bangs rnams kyis bsus te bsnyen bkur zhabs rtetsheg phyag mjal phul de nas ceras rje 'byug pa'i zhabs mtsheg 'dzul ba yin pas/ pha tsho thu rabs la thugs rjes mi 'dor bar zhu zer zhing dngu nga gi sna khrid de song bas/ gong zhing /phang mkhar/ su brang / skusnang phu/ rta li/ thu li bcas pa'i 'khan ris rnam gsum gyi gdung dpon thams cad la la ni dag snang mo sa gus kyis zhabs la btud/ la la sngangs skug gis btud/ nya mkhar la slobs pa dang / gdung de stobs mnga' thang tshe zhing 'khan ri rnam gsum la dbang bsgyur/ gzhong sgar gyi mkhar btsan po la dmag rgyub/ thu brag gi rdzong btsan po la gsang dmag rgyab te bcom pa'i ri rgyal gyis rgol zhing 'thab pa'i grabs bsgrigs te yod pa la/ dasung chen rnams kyis dga' ba'i ngar sgra sgrog cing me mda' dus gcig la rgyab pa'i 'ur sgras thung pa gang 179

ba byung bas/ rgyal blon 'khor bcas sngangs skug 'dar zhing dpa' zhum nas rang dbang med par bros/ slar zhabs la btud nor rdzas mang po yul yul 'bor thams cad mnga' 'bangs su bcug de nas krong gsar du byon pa'i lam khar re phas bla ma rgyal mtshan gyis bka' la mi brtsi bar/ gnya' rengs byas te bros/ phyis rma bya gdangs la 'chig hu yong bas ming med du btang / de nas dgang chen rnams krong gsar du slebs/ dpon slob kyis dga' ston gnang rgyun nor rdzas dpag med kyis thams cad yid tshims shing bde spyod du so so'i yul du log go/ de nas zla ba la shas na bla ma rnam sras shar phye gas lung par sngar dam bcas tshig rdo bzhin yod med dang / mnga' zhabs yin pa la khral lngar gyi rgyun re btsugs dge sa bsam tsha se a zhang tsho'i tsar gyon nas bzhugs/ phyogs mthar mi sna khral dang 'u lag dgos pa'i lung btang ba dang / mi sdes khral rnams 'phral du ma nyan pa dang / bla ma'i sgar pa rnams so sor btang nas dbang shugs che ba'i ngos nas bral bsdus yong bas/ la ling rgyal po chang lo dpal rgyal blon 'khor bcalasu/ btsan mkhar rgyal po the brang a chi 5 spad/ gcen mkhar rgyal po sangs rgyas pe rnams ma rangs par/ 'ong gsum spos byas te ngo log rtsis byed pa dang / bla ma rnam sras kyis skad cha thos nas gzhong sgar/ rtsa mang / snga tshang phyo tshang / bkra shis sgang bcas kyi dmag bkug pa dang / la ling rgyal po chang lo dpal gyis la ling phyo skor nang skor gyi dmag khrid de gcen mkhar du yong nas rgol grabs bsgrigs/7lo po pho brang gis pha chi mang las rgol ba'i grabs bsgrogs gnas yod pa la/dag mdzad dam che sa rab rgyas kyis dmag dpon byas te dmag rnams khrid de song 180

bas/ pho brang a chi yis sdom mkhar rgyal po tshe ring las sngar nas blon po phyog pa'i zhi 'on gyis/ rgyal po tshe ring spun gnyis kyis dmag gi sna len dang gdong bsu byas te 'ong gi yul du bzhag sang nyin gnyen mkhar dang pha chi mang la 'tshang la rgyab pas/ kha ling pa rnams kyis dmag dasung ste/bas la ma mgu bar gcer mkhar ༷ nga gi 'thab ra'i nang nas phyir thon pa dang / spong stong rgyal po glang ngas cis la khrab gon ral gri 'phyar zhing dbyugs nas dmag mi rnams kyis rjes la rgyugs te se nga ba dang / gdong bsu'i dmag rnams sngangs skrag gis spong gi 'thab ra'i nang du 'dzul ba dang / / rgyal po glang ngas de cho mnyam nang du 'dzul bas nang nas rgyal po sangs rgyas po rgol du sku nga ba la/ dbu mdzad dam ཿtshes rab rgyas kyis me mda' rgyab ste der bsad pas/ nang gi dmag mi rnams skrag ste rgol ma nus par yod pa la/rgyal po chang lo dpalakhokyis mkhar mthon po'i 'dzegs nas mda' rgyab pas/ phyi'i dmag mi rnams kyis reg ma nus par yod pa la tsho dbang rgyal po se nga nas/ thabs kyis bslus nas khrid yong ste/ mkhar mthon po'i rtse la btsan dar 'phyar bas/ pha chi tremang nas rgyal po pho brang dang dmag mi rnams kyis mthong bas/ da ni rgyal po'i dmag pham pa yi na 'dug bsams dmag mi rnams skrag nas ༷snas/rgyal po pho brang btson du bzung / sang nyin bla ma rnam sras tsha se nas byon/ rgyal po chang lo dpal dang pha spad btson du bzung ba spungs thang du rdzangs/ mkhar mthon mtho ral pa tsa ba nas bshig blon 'bangs thams cad mnga' cadag hu bcug rdzong sa btsan po zhig 'tshol ba la/ sngar mi 'gyur brtan pas bka' bskos la yang lung pa la sa 'dus che zhing sa btsan perdzo beng mkhar la rjesang btab na/ phyags su bstan pa la 181

phan pa rgya chen po yong gsungs pa dang / tsheng mkhar pa rnams kyis kyang rdzong nged kyi spong la rgyab pa drag zhus kyang ma gsan par der dbu mdzad dam snurmes rab rgyas bzhag yul sde che zhing sa yangs pa bsil drod stoms shing rgya bod kyi 'dod yon 'alnga'oms pa nyams dga' bar gzigs te/ bla ma rnam sras la ling la khyodan nas/rgyal po chang lo dpal gyi mkhar sa btsan po byi ri zor la btab/ shar phyogs lung pa'i rgyal po gtso las mi sna dug tshad der 'dus shing khrims bzos/ khral 'u lag kyang der bsdus so/ /bla ma rnam sras bsam par/ ra sti jo bo lams pa ma 'das sku nga nga la bu mo sterazhing mag par bcug pa yin yang / 'das nas mi 'dug pas sgam ri lung pa'i blon 'bangs rnams kyis nga la dag snang ji ltar ma da dam/ me rag bla ma nag seng dga' ldan bla ma dbu che yin pas ji ltar bya ltacad snyam nas/ dmag dum zhig bcas me rag phyogs la phyon pas/ bla ma nag seng gha thu hre/ba bcas yul thon nas la tshesag yul gsum du song nas mi 'dug me rag sag steng dang sgam ri khung pa'i mi sde thams cad kyis 'bab zhus byas mnga' casnag hu bcug pas/ sus mkhar ceras mdzad kyang bros song 'dug bar mtsho gsum wang seng kung ba nas rgyal po gzugs kyi gser kong / rdor rgyal po/ ram gong ra nas sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ 'ong rgyal po gsum gyis sna dungs te slebs byung bas/ gzhan rnams rang bzhin zhor la mnga' tshasnag tu bcug go/ byi ri zor la log nas mi ser 'dzin spyong / sgrig rnam gzhag rdzong rtsig pa/ btsan mas byed pa sogs bkod pa bshams shing zla ba brgyad tsam song ba dang /182

bla ma nag seng gis sna byas nas dmag dpon 'phan yul grang 'tsho dang sde pa dzam lha gnyis kyis 'khrid pa'i bod kyi dmag dgang dang / mon pa'i rigs kyi dmag yong nas spyi ling shing la sgar chags te weng mkhar grong stod la 'tshang la rgyab ༷gang ba dang / dathu mdzad dam cheras rab rgyas kyis me mdas mi gsum bskud mar bsad pas/ dmag rnams 'ur langs te skya ling shing du 'o/ga dmag phal cher la ling byi ri nor la song nas rdzong bskor/ bla ma nag seng dang bus mkhar tshe sa mdzad kyis g.yo skyu byas nas/ khyod kyi rgyal po chang 'ordzo dpal de/ 'grag gzhung phyogs las nged kyi lag tu thob yeshe zer nas/ yul 'di phyogs kyi sku sa chas rnams bstan pas/ kha ling pa yid ches te nge 'o1ga pas bla ma rnam sras tshugs ma thub par tsha se la ༷tshes pas/lam du la ling pas bsgugs te bka' blerdzon dathu mdzad nor thu der bsad/ bla ma rang tsha so la 'dzul ba dang / dmag thams cad der sprungs te bstesnar nas mi thar ba dang /na rang thung thung pa'i rgyal po nor su a chi spun mched rnams dga' ldan pa'i blo yid nang ma yin pas 'ong ngo chen bcol nas/ srog la mi yong ba'i srog nor ra ti tham pa'i g.yu chen 'ba' g.yang kyi dkar byin nas nyes spyodan med par dmag mis bskor nas/ spyi ling shing du bka' blon nor bu'i mgo dang bcas dmag dpon gnyis kyi dung du slob byung bo dang / dbu mdzad dam chodasi rab rgyas dang weng mcher rgyal blon /mas thabs ci dug 1—sa byas pas/ dbu mdzad kyis da lan bla ma mi'i lag tu tshud pa las nged rang tshos tshugs mi thub/ re zhig ngas kroX gsar du song nas/ dpung rgyub kyi dmag zhus nas sleb sku nga / de'i bar khyod rang 'bab zhus nas sdod zer te gzhung la gyon/ tsheng mkhar pa rnams kyis rdzong ni spyod ma nyan par 'bab zhus byas 183

pas/ ma 'gyur dang thu chen lan nas da ni dga' ldan pho brang pa'i mnga' zhabs yin rsha swār/ bla ma rnam sras dang ma 'gyur dang gya chen khyer nas/ dmag dasung rnams gyes nas so so'i yul du log go bla ma lha sar khrid de btson lang du bzhag pa las bros pas 'ded mos rjes bsnyags kyis zin nas der bkrongs 'dug / 3dbu mdzad kyis kre nga gsar du mi 'gyur brtan pa la gnasta tshul zhib par zhus pas/ dpon hre ba kyi zhal nas sngar ngas bslabs pa bzhin rdzong sa weng mkhar du bzung na yong rgyu yin pa la nor 'dug gsungs/ su gang ltar bla ma'i lung bstan yod pas da rung bstan pa btsug rgyu sku nga gsungs nas/ gzhung tso chen gyi dmag dum zhig dang / dbang ྅dus pho brang mnga' zhabs gang yodad dmag dang / mang sde lung pa'i dmag gang yed bcas la dmag dpon sku dung pad dkar chodas 'phel dang / gnyer pa long pa gnyis kyis byas/ dbu mdzad kyi sna 'khrid nas dpung chen btegs nas yong pas/ dgra lha chodas skyong gi mthu yis gnam sa 'bol ba tsam gyi 'jigs skrag byung ba dang / rtseng mi rgyal po stong ldan gyis sna len dang gdong bsu byas te/ dmag dgang gi sgar chen zle ba gnyis pa'i nang gong thung du slobs pa dang / dwags pa 'bi mi'i dmag rnams sa srung la gnon 4rmo pa la bar cho gsum du slebs pa dang / gong thung nas dbu mdzad kyis dmarge dum zhig khrid de song bas/ dwags pa'i dmag rnams mkhar sing pa'i rtse la btsan sa bzung nas/'grag pa'i dmag dang sna phrad nas 'dzings grabs byed pa la/ dbu mdzad kyis me mda' gcig rgyab pas che sa spyong gi nus mthu dang / tshe sngon gyi las gang yin ma shes par 'phrul 'a'o/ra lta thus dwags pa mi khal lnga tsam sngangs skrag gis 0drir langs te 184

mkhar sing pa'i brag rtse las g.yang la lhung nas shi bas/ dmag mi gzhan rnams 'jigs shing skrag ste bros pas/ shar phyogs kyi mi 'go mnga' 'og tu mi 'dzul bsam pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa rnams kyang dpa' 'khums par rda/ra te / /tsheng mkhar du gyon nas btsan sa bzung zhing phyogs thams cad du pho nya bang chen btang nas/ 'bab zhu byed par yong rgyu yin nam/ so so'i yul du dmag sgar btegs rgyu yin gyi lan gtong zer bas/ la ling phyi skor nang skor/ u dza rong pa/las pa 'o sa pa/ sgam ri 'u/nga pa/ me rag sag steng / bar 31 gas/ma thams cad 'bab zhus byas pa la kha 'chams nas/ rgyal ngete gce'o las mi 'asku( thams cad dbu mdzad kyi dung du slebs/ dbu mdzad kyis mi ser rnams phyag mjal 'bul ba dang bcas gong thung du dmag dpon gnyis kyi grang du khrid/ dmag dpon gnyis kyis/khyod rang rnams 'khrugs rtsod byed ma dgos par/ gros khyab che ba'i sgo nas 'dir yong ba shin hu legs gsungs/de nas tshig dam bca' byed pa la chodas spyong srung ma gsol mchodad kyis mnyes par byas nas lha dpang du btsugs/ cho chen gyi rgan 'go dbang 'dus pho brang gi rgan 'go mang sde lung pa'i rgan 'go chu stod pyi chos mdzad rgya mo/ gzhong sgar chos mthed dkar po gdu nga / snga tshang rgyal po dar 'jam/ phyo tshang rgyal po zla'u la/ ba gong rgyal po rdor lde/ rtseng mi rgyal po stong ldan rnams zas nor gnang sbyan gyis tshim par byas nas mi dpang du btsugs pa'i dung du/ shar phyogs kyi rgyal po gtso chen thams cad kyis mna' tshi ga dus de ring nas gzung dpon dga' ldan pho brang pa rgyab tu skyur zhing / che sa rje 'byug pa mdun du len nas/ bka' gang gnang gsung ci sgrub 185

mkhar sing pa'i brag rtse las g.yang la lhung nas shi bas/ dmag mi gzhan rnams 'jigs shing skrag ste bros pas/ shar phyogs kyi mi 'go mnga' 'og tu mi 'dzul bsam pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa rnams kyang dpa' 'khums par rda/ra te / /tsheng mkhar du gyon nas btsan sa bzung zhing phyogs thams cad du pho nya bang chen btang nas/ 'bab zhu byed par yong rgyu yin nam/ so so'i yul du dmag sgar btegs rgyu yin gyi lan gtong zer bas/ la ling phyi skor nang skor/ u dza rong pa/las pa 'o sa pa/ sgam ri 'u/nga pa/ me rag sag steng / bar 31 gas/ma thams cad 'bab zhus byas pa la kha 'chams nas/ rgyal ngete gce'o las mi 'asku( thams cad dbu mdzad kyi dung du slebs/ dbu mdzad kyis mi ser rnams phyag mjal 'bul ba dang bcas gong thung du dmag dpon gnyis kyi grang du khrid/ dmag dpon gnyis kyis/khyod rang rnams 'khrugs rtsod byed ma dgos par/ gros khyab che ba'i sgo nas 'dir yong ba shin hu legs gsungs/de nas tshig dam bca' byed pa la chodas spyong srung ma gsol mchodad kyis mnyes par byas nas lha dpang du btsugs/ cho chen gyi rgan 'go dbang 'dus pho brang gi rgan 'go mang sde lung pa'i rgan 'go chu stod pyi chos mdzad rgya mo/ gzhong sgar chos mthed dkar po gdu nga / snga tshang rgyal po dar 'jam/ phyo tshang rgyal po zla'u la/ ba gong rgyal po rdor lde/ rtseng mi rgyal po stong ldan rnams zas nor gnang sbyan gyis tshim par byas nas mi dpang du btsugs pa'i dung du/ shar phyogs kyi rgyal po gtso chen thams cad kyis mna' tshi ga dus de ring nas gzung dpon dga' ldan pho brang pa rgyab tu skyur zhing / che sa rje 'byug pa mdun du len nas/ bka' gang gnang gsung ci sgrub 185

mi byed ri zer mna' bor/ gang 'os bab bsnyun gya chen btsun bral rnams bsdus/gnyer pa long ba dpyang bcas gzhung du log sku drung pad dkar chodas 'phel 'bor bcas weng mkhar du byon/ rgyal po lha lnga'i khyim du bzhugs nas rdzong gi btsan cha bzos/ spong stod du ltag rdzong brtsigs/ spong smad la rdzong gi dathu rtse lcags ri 'or 5/ga bcas bzhengs nas der bzhugs te/ rgyal khrims dang ceras khrims bcas/dbu mdzad kyis thabs kyis 'khor los bsgyur te bka' blon mdzad/ mtho ba khrims kyis gnon/ dma' ba thabs kyis skyong / nor rdzas dang rang 'dod ngo so la ma lta bar/ khrims dang nyi ma gzhung rgyugs kyis bzang po la bya dga' ster/ ngan pa la chad pa gcod pas 'phyog sa med/ bslu mkhan med/ ma nyan byung na nag gnyed dug pos tshar bcad pa'i grags pa sa steng du khyab pa'i stobs las/ deng sang gi bar bstan pa shar phyogs su dar khyab yodad pa ni sku dung dang dbu mdzad gnyis kyi phyag rjes yin no/ / de dus gung gdung rgyal po yang sa ri rong dog cing btsan pas 'ogatu 'dzul ma nyan par gnya' reng byas nas yod pa la/ lo la shes song ba dang / sku dung pad dkar snu sa 'phel dang gsol dpon bstan pa don ldan gnyis kyis dasmung bcug ste rgyal po btul nas mnga' 'bangs la bcug pa yin no/ / de ltar snga gong shar phyogs kyi lung par stobs kyis 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po chen po gcig gis dbang ma bsgyur ba'i gshes kyis/ so so'i lung par rang rang gi stobs 'byor mnga' bang la mgu nas/ nga che nga dug snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyi dregs pas/gcig 'og gcig ma 'dzul ba lung phran rer dpon po sum thang du chos 'khor sde pa/186

kur rsā du rag sa'i dpon po lha thu dar/ spyi ling dpon chen dar ma/ phag gdung rgyal po dga' ba/ stong phya rgyal po/ snga tshang rgyal po dar 'jam/ phyi tshang rgyal po zla'u la/ gagong sgar chodas mdzad dkar po gdung / ba geng rgyal po rdo ri/ gcen mkhar rgyal po sangs rgyas/ rtseng mi rgyal po stong ldan/ sgom mkhar rgyal po tsho ring bkra 36 sgang rgyal ོ/ cho dbang / spong stod rgyal po lha lnga/ rkang lung rgyal po pho brang a chi 5 spad/ la ling rgyal po bde ba/ 'byug rgyal/ me rag bla ma nag seng / nya mkhar gdung / gung gdung rgyal pe / re phas bla ma rgyal mtshan sku(gas rgyal phran mang du yod pa rnams 'khrugs rtsod kyi ngang du yod pa la/chos kyi rgyal po zhabs byung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis lung bstan te/ dpon slob mi 'gyur brtan pa/ bla ma rnam sras/ dgra mdzad dam cesas rab rgyas/ bka' hā na nor ga sku dung pad dkar chos 'phel rnams kyi snying stobs dang skyu tsal du ma'i 'phrul gyis dmag dgang gi sgar chen btegs te/ shar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi rgyul lams thams cad rim gyis ceras rje dpal ldan 'byug pa'i mnga' mtsheg tu bcug ste rdzong gzhis bzhengs/ ཿtshes rje 'grag pa'i mnga' zhabs su 'dzul ma nyan pa/ ku re lung nas rgyal po dga' ba/ dpon chen dar ma/ kha ling rgyal po/ stong phya rgyal po/ nya mkhar gdung /gung gdung rgyal po/ re phas bla ma rgyal mtshan sogs btson dang thu gter bzung /rdzong gzhis rnams la sa skyong rdzong dpon re bskos te chos rje dpal ldan 'grag pa'i chos srid lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/phan tshun 'thab cing 'khrugs rtsod thams cad rgyun chad/ phyogs mtha' dag nas las 187
