sgo'i la phye nas zas nor longs spyod kyi dpal 'byor gong du 'phel/ bston dang bu gter bzhag pa rnams kyang sngar byas la 'khyod sems dang / phyin chad ཿtshes rje 'byug pa'i bka' khrims dang len zhabs phyid ci 'byor smre ngag zhus pa las dgongs yangs bka' drin bskyangs te/ so so'i yul du khang gzhis nor rdzas blon 'bangs bcas gnang nas bde spyod kyi dpal la longs spyod de sdod rgyu byung ba yin no/ / 'di yang nyi ma shar khyodags su byung zhing gsal ba'i me ma(nga zhes pa wā gin dus bris pa las btus pamatho/ / dpe na lag rnams bste/sa tshul dang phyogs kyi rgyal khab dbang du 'dus pa thugs dam sdokyigs/ the5'a/ ༄༄ / / chodas kyi rgyal po zhabs dung ngag debang rnam rgyal che sa srid lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa'i spyin bdag 'bangs mi ser/ thed dar theg bcu gsum/ shar dar brgyad/wang cho chen brgyad/ spa ro bar skor tsho dug dar dkar yul gling chen po brgyad/dgon mkhar stod mkhar smad/ kyibs khra gling gsum/ mang sre tsho ba'i mo bam thang 1 sde bzhi/ kur mdo bzhi/ yang tsa tsha lnga/ 'khan ris rnam gsum/ gzhong sgar tsho bdun/ bkra shis sgang tsho bcu/ la ling gdung bsam ma do gsum sogs/ lto rdzongs kyi phyogs thams cad du phrin las dar zhing rgyas te dba' du 'dus/ gdan sa dang po lcags ri bdu da 'dul pho brang / rim pas gsang sngags zab don pho brang /sprungs thang bde chen pho brang / dbang 'dus pho brang / rgyal sa bkra shis chodas rdzong /188

sku bro rin sprungs rdzong / dar dkar bkra shis yang rtse/ mgar sa bkra shis mthong smon/ gling bzhi g.yul rgyal rdzong / ཿtshes 'khor rab brten rtse/ bya dkar g.yul rgyal rṣa / lhun rtse'i jo nga / dong snyir bkra shis yang rtse/ gzhong sgar rdzong / bkra shis sgang rdzong / gzhal sgang rdzong rnams bzhengs/ gdan sa de rnams su dpon lag rin sprungs spyi bla bstan 'dzin 'grag sgra/ rim phyag rdzong dpon a'u tshe ring / sprungs thang rdzong dpon pad dkar rab rgyas/ dbang 'dus rdzong dpon la dwags rgyal sras bstan 'dzin/ gzhung mgron gnyer pa g.yang 'dzin/ chodas rtse spyi bla mi 'gyur brtan pa/ dar dkar dpon sle ba bstan pa phrin las sogs dang / de cadag rdzong phun rnams la rdzong dpon re dang / rdzong lag che chung thams cad la gnyer chen/ maspon gnyer/gzim dpon/ gzim nang / grang yig sha gnyer/ sgo ra pa/ rta dpon/ dar dpon/yul tshan so sor grang pa sku tshab/ mi ser gyi 'go dpon rgod po/ las tshan bcas bskos nas lha khrims med hla khrims rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing dang / ceras khrims dar gyi mdud pa lugs gnyis kyi khrims lha rmedzos dge ba bcu dang / mi snu sa gtsang ma bcu drug dang mthun par sku la btod/ 0 lha nang tsam ma tshad pa/ byang chub sems kyi rten 'brel gyis/ / skye 'a〈sna thams cad dbang 'dus — na sa/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin rgyal ba'i sras lnga ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi snyan pa'i grags pa de dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams kyis 'dzam bu'i gling gi phyogs thams cad du khyab par bsgrags pas/ sngar bshad pa bzhin phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po'i gling / (por cu gal )zhes pa'i yul de'i rgyal po nas rgya mtshor tshi btang nas bang chen pa ched du 'byor ba dang / stod la dwags rgyal po seng ge rnam rgyal gyis gangs ri dar che bla brang dgon/189

sku bro rin sprungs rdzong / dar dkar bkra shis yang rtse/ mgar sa bkra shis mthong smon/ gling bzhi g.yul rgyal rdzong / ཿtshes 'khor rab brten rtse/ bya dkar g.yul rgyal rṣa / lhun rtse'i jo nga / dong snyir bkra shis yang rtse/ gzhong sgar rdzong / bkra shis sgang rdzong / gzhal sgang rdzong rnams bzhengs/ gdan sa de rnams su dpon lag rin sprungs spyi bla bstan 'dzin 'grag sgra/ rim phyag rdzong dpon a'u tshe ring / sprungs thang rdzong dpon pad dkar rab rgyas/ dbang 'dus rdzong dpon la dwags rgyal sras bstan 'dzin/ gzhung mgron gnyer pa g.yang 'dzin/ chodas rtse spyi bla mi 'gyur brtan pa/ dar dkar dpon sle ba bstan pa phrin las sogs dang / de cadag rdzong phun rnams la rdzong dpon re dang / rdzong lag che chung thams cad la gnyer chen/ maspon gnyer/gzim dpon/ gzim nang / grang yig sha gnyer/ sgo ra pa/ rta dpon/ dar dpon/yul tshan so sor grang pa sku tshab/ mi ser gyi 'go dpon rgod po/ las tshan bcas bskos nas lha khrims med hla khrims rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing dang / ceras khrims dar gyi mdud pa lugs gnyis kyi khrims lha rmedzos dge ba bcu dang / mi snu sa gtsang ma bcu drug dang mthun par sku la btod/ 0 lha nang tsam ma tshad pa/ byang chub sems kyi rten 'brel gyis/ / skye 'a〈sna thams cad dbang 'dus — na sa/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin rgyal ba'i sras lnga ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi snyan pa'i grags pa de dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams kyis 'dzam bu'i gling gi phyogs thams cad du khyab par bsgrags pas/ sngar bshad pa bzhin phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po'i gling / (por cu gal )zhes pa'i yul de'i rgyal po nas rgya mtshor tshi btang nas bang chen pa ched du 'byor ba dang / stod la dwags rgyal po seng ge rnam rgyal gyis gangs ri dar che bla brang dgon/189

gnyen po ri rdzong dang / 'bri ra phyag rdzu 'phrul phyag go rdzong bya spyibs/ ye ri dgon phyag gad sor/ so mo rgyu/ shi ha ra/ zangs dkar bya nga sogs kyi mi ser sde ma lag bcas pa dang / yang glo ceras rdzong sde ma lag dang bcas pa phyal nas/ rgyal po seng go rnam rgyal skru mched rgyal sras bstan 'dzin 'dir gyon te che sa rje 'grag pa'i bka' 'bangs su bzhugs te dbang 'dus pho brang gi rdzong dpon mdzad 'dug /de je sa rgyal snga nyi ma rnam rgyal gyi skabs sku mched rgyal sras bstan 'dzin nor su 'dir byon nas dge 'dun gyi sder zugs te mkhan po khri thog brgyad pa mdzad pa dang / de mtshungs rgya gha ) la dang ku che bi har nas ra dzā pra ma ṇa ran sku gas rgya gar gyi rgyal therdzos kyang shar am bha ta la nas/ nub dha ling la thug rgya gzhis rnams kyibs rten du phrul ba serdzogs rang bzhin gyis mtha' bzhi'i rgyal lams thams cad dbang du 'dus/ gangs ri'i rdor 'dzin dang / glo chos rdzong gi bla ma/ rgya gzhis lag gi sku tshab bcas pa thams cad gdul bya so so'i dad sgor gang mos bzhin bskos par mdzad do/ / sngar dmag 'khrugs kyi skabs su mi dang sems can mang po shi ba rnams kyi sgrib spyong du/ yi dam dang sangs rgyas byang sems brgya dang bco lnga tsam gyi sku brnyan khyo ba phyag tsha skad cig kyang snyod med phyag gi 'du byed gnang nas bzhengs pa dang / rdzong gzhis so so'i babs sgo yongs sdud/ mnga' zhabs kyi lo tog nor gyi sha dpya/ chad pa'i bab/ dbang yon sogs thams cad dkon malha ga gi bsnyen bkur mchodad thebs dang / dge 'dun gyi 'tsho ba yo byad du byir zhing rgya95 khab spyi mthun gyi bsod nams chogs bsags bo na'i gzhir 'gyur pa yin no/ /de yang 'di ltar spungs thang du zla dang po'i nang mgon po'i sgrub mchod zhag 190

gnyen po ri rdzong dang / 'bri ra phyag rdzu 'phrul phyag go rdzong bya spyibs/ ye ri dgon phyag gad sor/ so mo rgyu/ shi ha ra/ zangs dkar bya nga sogs kyi mi ser sde ma lag bcas pa dang / yang glo ceras rdzong sde ma lag dang bcas pa phyal nas/ rgyal po seng go rnam rgyal skru mched rgyal sras bstan 'dzin 'dir gyon te che sa rje 'grag pa'i bka' 'bangs su bzhugs te dbang 'dus pho brang gi rdzong dpon mdzad 'dug /de je sa rgyal snga nyi ma rnam rgyal gyi skabs sku mched rgyal sras bstan 'dzin nor su 'dir byon nas dge 'dun gyi sder zugs te mkhan po khri thog brgyad pa mdzad pa dang / de mtshungs rgya gha ) la dang ku che bi har nas ra dzā pra ma ṇa ran sku gas rgya gar gyi rgyal therdzos kyang shar am bha ta la nas/ nub dha ling la thug rgya gzhis rnams kyibs rten du phrul ba serdzogs rang bzhin gyis mtha' bzhi'i rgyal lams thams cad dbang du 'dus/ gangs ri'i rdor 'dzin dang / glo chos rdzong gi bla ma/ rgya gzhis lag gi sku tshab bcas pa thams cad gdul bya so so'i dad sgor gang mos bzhin bskos par mdzad do/ / sngar dmag 'khrugs kyi skabs su mi dang sems can mang po shi ba rnams kyi sgrib spyong du/ yi dam dang sangs rgyas byang sems brgya dang bco lnga tsam gyi sku brnyan khyo ba phyag tsha skad cig kyang snyod med phyag gi 'du byed gnang nas bzhengs pa dang / rdzong gzhis so so'i babs sgo yongs sdud/ mnga' zhabs kyi lo tog nor gyi sha dpya/ chad pa'i bab/ dbang yon sogs thams cad dkon malha ga gi bsnyen bkur mchodad thebs dang / dge 'dun gyi 'tsho ba yo byad du byir zhing rgya95 khab spyi mthun gyi bsod nams chogs bsags bo na'i gzhir 'gyur pa yin no/ /de yang 'di ltar spungs thang du zla dang po'i nang mgon po'i sgrub mchod zhag 190

gas lnga/ zla ba de'i mthug tu dam tshig bskang gso rgyas pa/ ca zla'am la 'jam dkar gyi sgrub mchod mtshan brjod 'thum gter dang je bstan pa'i nyi ma'i dus mchod/zle ba 3 pa la mgon po'i rtag gtor bskang mdos kyi tsha ga zla ba thug la rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi gzungs 'bum gter/ zla ba lnga pa nas dgu pa'i bar gtsug gtor rnam rgyal gzungs grwa lnga/ sgrol ma nyer gcig sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo/ rnam 'joms cho ga rgyas pa/ gsang sgrub dbang che ga mgon po lcam dul gyi rten mdos 'a ga 'jigs byed chesna ga rgyus pa sesgogs kyi sgrub mchod rig sngags 'bum phrag mang po'i bzlas pa dang de dang mtshungs par lhan skye dung phyur chen po btsugs te tshogs mchod rgya chen po mdzad pa de bzhin/ rdzong gzhis gzhan thams cad la yang dus mchod 'thum gter mang po btsugs par mdzad de 'khor 'i gsum gyi mdzad pas chos rje dpal ldan 'byug pa'i lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa gong du 'phel bzhin bzhugs pa na/ri yi ru rin po ches rje nyid rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor thugs dam la zhugs na mtha' dmag zlog cing bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas su yong bar lung bstan pa bzhin/ dpal mabo na lcam dul tshogs kyis kyang de ltar rgyud bskul bar brten/ dbu mdzad bstan 'dzin 'byug rgyas sde srid bskos te dbang tshad thams cad gnang nas/ ceras srid dang rgyal srid kyi bstan pa'i bya ba phra rags thams cad bslab ston rgyas par gnang nas de lugs phyo nang gi bka' blon las 'dzin/ grwa tshang gi mkhan po dbu mdzad/ che sa khrims grwa dmang se gas spyi sgos thams cad la bkod 'doms khyab par byed dgos zhes zhal chems zhib par stsal/ snyo rdzongs 'dir sngon chad chodas lugs ris med kyi bla ma mang po gyon pa thams cad las lhag pa ཿtshes kyi rgyal 191

gas lnga/ zla ba de'i mthug tu dam tshig bskang gso rgyas pa/ ca zla'am la 'jam dkar gyi sgrub mchod mtshan brjod 'thum gter dang je bstan pa'i nyi ma'i dus mchod/zle ba 3 pa la mgon po'i rtag gtor bskang mdos kyi tsha ga zla ba thug la rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi gzungs 'bum gter/ zla ba lnga pa nas dgu pa'i bar gtsug gtor rnam rgyal gzungs grwa lnga/ sgrol ma nyer gcig sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo/ rnam 'joms cho ga rgyas pa/ gsang sgrub dbang che ga mgon po lcam dul gyi rten mdos 'a ga 'jigs byed chesna ga rgyus pa sesgogs kyi sgrub mchod rig sngags 'bum phrag mang po'i bzlas pa dang de dang mtshungs par lhan skye dung phyur chen po btsugs te tshogs mchod rgya chen po mdzad pa de bzhin/ rdzong gzhis gzhan thams cad la yang dus mchod 'thum gter mang po btsugs par mdzad de 'khor 'i gsum gyi mdzad pas chos rje dpal ldan 'byug pa'i lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa gong du 'phel bzhin bzhugs pa na/ri yi ru rin po ches rje nyid rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor thugs dam la zhugs na mtha' dmag zlog cing bstan pa dar rgyas yun gnas su yong bar lung bstan pa bzhin/ dpal mabo na lcam dul tshogs kyis kyang de ltar rgyud bskul bar brten/ dbu mdzad bstan 'dzin 'byug rgyas sde srid bskos te dbang tshad thams cad gnang nas/ ceras srid dang rgyal srid kyi bstan pa'i bya ba phra rags thams cad bslab ston rgyas par gnang nas de lugs phyo nang gi bka' blon las 'dzin/ grwa tshang gi mkhan po dbu mdzad/ che sa khrims grwa dmang se gas spyi sgos thams cad la bkod 'doms khyab par byed dgos zhes zhal chems zhib par stsal/ snyo rdzongs 'dir sngon chad chodas lugs ris med kyi bla ma mang po gyon pa thams cad las lhag pa ཿtshes kyi rgyal 191

po zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis snyo mon la bzhi gril po thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pas dbang du bsdus nas sa gnad che sa rnams su chodas srid kyi la lo sgyur ba'i rdzong gzhis dang lha lang mgon khang bzhengs/ der dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs te 'bangs mi ser nas khral bsdus pa rnams chu zos su ma song bar dkon mchodag mchod pa'i yo byad dang dge 'dun la 'tsho ba sbyar/ de rnams kyis lha khang mgon lang rnams su dus maḥtshed 'bum gter btsugs te bstan spyi'i sku rim bsgrubs pa las rgyal khab spyi mthun gyi bsod nams rgya chen po bsags par gyur nas 3snas srid lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa dar bzhin rgyal khab rang dbang rang btsan mi nyams par yun ring du brtan par 'gyur ba'i gzhi legs par bting nas spyi lo 1651 dang rab byung bcu gcig lcags yos lo zla ba 3 pa'i tshes 11 la zhabs grang rin po che rang nyid dgung grangs 58 la thugs dam rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la bzhugs se / / der sku mtshams nang gi zhabs 'bring bya daserdzos rigs thams cad dung dam chenes rgyal mtshan pas mdzad do/ / 192

po zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyis snyo mon la bzhi gril po thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pas dbang du bsdus nas sa gnad che sa rnams su chodas srid kyi la lo sgyur ba'i rdzong gzhis dang lha lang mgon khang bzhengs/ der dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs te 'bangs mi ser nas khral bsdus pa rnams chu zos su ma song bar dkon mchodag mchod pa'i yo byad dang dge 'dun la 'tsho ba sbyar/ de rnams kyis lha khang mgon lang rnams su dus maḥtshed 'bum gter btsugs te bstan spyi'i sku rim bsgrubs pa las rgyal khab spyi mthun gyi bsod nams rgya chen po bsags par gyur nas 3snas srid lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa dar bzhin rgyal khab rang dbang rang btsan mi nyams par yun ring du brtan par 'gyur ba'i gzhi legs par bting nas spyi lo 1651 dang rab byung bcu gcig lcags yos lo zla ba 3 pa'i tshes 11 la zhabs grang rin po che rang nyid dgung grangs 58 la thugs dam rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la bzhugs se / / der sku mtshams nang gi zhabs 'bring bya daserdzos rigs thams cad dung dam chenes rgyal mtshan pas mdzad do/ / 192

rtsa ba'i sa bcad bzhi pa bstan pa bar dar sde srid khri rabs kyi ma( rgyus la/sde srid khri rabs dang pos lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa ji ltar bskyangs tshul/༄༄ / / bcom ldan nor thu 'dzin pa'i gdul zhing 'dir/ / mnyam med chos rje da pal ldan 'byug pa yi/ / lugs gnyis gser gyi 'khor 'o/ rtsibs stong gis/ /dbang bsgyur phyogs las rnam rgyal rgyal khab kyi/ / yid can kun la phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ / bka' srol 'jam la dam pa 'i ཿshis khrims dang / / lci la gnon pa'i rgyal khrims lugs zung gis/ / bkyings pa'i sa spyodang byedan tshul gsal bar bya/ /zhis tshigs su bcad pas skabs phye nas/ sde srid khri rabs dang nge dbu mdzad bstan 'dzin 'byug rgyas ni/ dpal ldan 'byug pa gtsang pa rgya ras kyi zhal 〈snab dam pa gter khungs pa zhes/ dam can sgo smad dam la btags mkhan grub thob chen po de'i gdung brgyud mgar sa rdzong gi cha lnga ga dgon cadab mtsho yul gsar du grags pa 'brug pa dbu che'i rigs su spye lo 1591 rab byung 10 pa'i lcags yos lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung 'o/ bcu gcig la bod gtsang du ra lung dbus su 'byug se ba byang chub gling gi mnyam med chetshes rje 'byug pa'i snyan grags kyis yid 'phyog cing / sngon smon las kyi 'a hro sad de ra lung du chos la/ gyon te zhabs drung bstan pa'i nyi ma yab su sa kyi dung du ba spa ra/ 'byug pa bka' brgyud kyi dbang lung khrid gsum gyi gdams si thongs su rdzogs pa zhus te gar thig dbyangs serdzogs gsang sngags kyi ཿtshe ga phyag bzhis rnams la gce bor byings te mkhyen rab kyi rtsal rgyas/ dgung 'o/ bco lnga la 193

dge tshul bsgrubs/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud rig pa'i gnas dang dkyil chodag gang la yang ma mkhyen pa med pas dgung grangs nyi shu nas ban tshang dgo 'dun sde'i dbu mdzad dang phyag mdzod sbrags ma mdzad/ mkhas grub lha dbang blo spos las dkar nag rtsis gzhung gdan gzhi dang dus 'khor gyi rgyud phyo nang gzhan gsum gyi gnad la sgro 'dogs chodad par spyangs pa mthar phyin par mdzad de/ gzhan la'ang mang du spel bas dus 'a'o/ra ba rnams kyi bshad pa'i rgyun 'ong la ma thug pa med par grags/khyad par dbyangs 'char rtsis la mkhas pas phas rtsershal ga5/la 'khrugs skabs/ rang phyogs kyi dpung phar 'jug ji ltar bya ba skutshegs gnad ma 'chil pas dmag 'khrugs rnam pa kun tu rgyal la 'ba' zhig the ba pa'i rgyu mtshan cig des yin zhes kyang grags/rgyal khab gzhan du rgyal srid 61 nas rkyeXng ba'i rgyal 〈sna gzhan dang mi 'du bar/ zhabs dung rin po tshes sman rdzongs 'dir byang chub sems dpa'i chos srid dang rgyal srid lugs gnyis zung 'brel/ de bzhin gshegs pas kyang bsngags pa'i 'a'or lo bcu/dang po snu sa kyi rgyal srid la dbang thob cing mnga' gsol ba/ gnyis pa las kyi 'khor lo/ / gsum pa tshar gcod rjes 'dzin/ bzhi pa che sa blon dang baspos te chodas bzhin skyong ba/ lnga pa grong khyer dang pho brang srung ba/ grag pa rgyal srid kyi dpal la spyod pa/bdun pa 'jigarme pa dang bcas pa'i sa spyong ga brgyad pa sngon gyi tshul dun zhing yang dag par spyod pa/ dgu pa rang dang gzhan gyi las dgo sdig sems pa/ bcu pa 'jig rten bde zhing spyid pa'i phyir dkon mchog mchod pa ste/ sa snying 'a'or lotsā pa'i mdo la sogs pa nas gsungs pa'i 'khor lo bcu dang 'brel ba'i chodas rje dpal ldan 'byug pa'i che sa srid lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa 'dzugs par gyon pa'i lung bstan 194

dus la babs pa'i tshe/ dgon cadab mtsho bla mar bka' 31ga gnang ba bzhin/ cadab mtsho bla mas 'di nas yar chibs bsu dang srung skyob kyi dasung tshogs bcas btang nas/ spyi lo 1616 rab byung 11 pa'i me 'byug lor gdan sa ra lung nas che sa kshi rgyal po zhabs dung rin po che sman rdzongs 'dir chibs la bsgyur ba'i skabs phyag mdzod dathu mdzad bstan 'dzin 'byug rgyas mtshams spyor dang phebs lam du phyag phyo zhus te gyon/ de yang dpal ye shes mgon pos sman rdzongs 'di nyid zhabs drung rin po che la mchod gzhis su phul te phrin las sgrub par sku dngos su sde srid dbu mdzad chen por sprul te sngon pa yin par 'dug mkhan chen bsod nams 'ad zer gyi gsung las/ zlorgon po'i mdos cerag gnang ba'i skabs shig lcags ri'i mgon lang chen po nas sde pa dbu mdzad na bzas gaspro/ga pa byas te 'phyar cadang ba'i gzigs snang byung ba dang / yang dbang 'dus sgyu brang du mtshams bzhugs skabs shig gshin sgo'i ro sreg che ga la byon dgos pa'i do gal chen po byung ba na/ mtshams 'di grol nas 'gro dgos ma tsug cig zer ye shes mgon por dmod bor bas/ rmi lam du sde ge dbu mdzad gyon nas da res khyod rang 'bro mi dgos gsungs pa rmis pas 'gro ma dgos pa byung ba las/ ye shes mgon po'i sprul pa yin par thugs yid ches te/ rje mkhas grub kyis rgod tshang pa'i sprul pa yin tshul dang / zhabs dung rin po ches las mgon yin par gsungs kyang / lo bos ye shes mgon po yin par thag chod gsungs/ zhabs dung rin po che ltor gyon pa nas bzung chab srid kyi la lo sgur mi 58 ngag dbang dpal ldan bzang pos mdzad pa mkhan chen bsod nams 'od zer gyi rnam thar snyan tshig 'astod 'jo'i 'gri shing bcu bdun gyi mdun nas/195

bka'i mdun na 'don chen po mdzad de snyo rdzongs 'dir snya gnas dge gsum ming tsam yang med par thams cad ceras rje dpal ldan 'grag pa'i bka' 'bangs su bsdus te spyi lo 1651 rab byung 11 pa'i lcags yos lo zla 3 pa'i tshes 10 la zhabs dung sku mtshams bzhugs skabs dbu mdzad bstan 'dzin 'grag rgyas sde srid bskos te bka'i phebs sgo/ da lam phyo nang gi bka' blon las 'dzin rnams dang / grwa tshang gi dbu mdzad mkhan po dge bskos se gas che bgres rnams dang / grwa dmangs sogs spyi sgos thams cad la nged rang gis lo rgyus shig byed dgos rgyu yin yang khams kyis mi phyogs 'dug pas dbu mdzad khyed kyis so so la de lugs bkod 'doms khyab par byed dgos zhes bstan pa'i bya ba phra rags thams cad kyi bslab ston zhib rgyas dang /'das ma cadangs kyi 'o/ rgyus mtha' rgyas dang bcas pa'i bka' bkod zhib par gsungs nas bcad rgya dam nge ra zhugs te zla ba gsum tsam sku nga mtshams/ sde srid dathu mdzad chen pos snyo kha bzhi'i phyogs gyi lgi bla rdzong po che phra rnams dang / nang gi bka' blon sna chen por gtogs pa rnams dang / gzhan yang stod mnga' ris bal po sogs kyi dag che sku skye dpon po sku tshab gnyer las 'dzin rgan 'go sogs phra rags/ thams cad la bzhugs gral rgyas pa zhig mdzad nas/ der sde pa dbu mdzad bstan 'dzin 'byug rgyas kyis da lam thams cad la bslab ston zhu rgyu'i don la/〈mi gsum mkhyen pa bla ma rin po che bye ba mchod rten gyi phyag las se gas bya ba che bzhag chung bor byas te sku mtshams bcad rgya dam por zhugs pa 'di/ spyir gu ru 59 rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyi rnam thar rje mkhan khri grag pa ngag dbang lhun grub kyis mdzad pa skal bzang legs bris 'dod pa'i re skong dpag bsam snye ma nga gcig gi mdun nas/196

jag chodam kun gyi gasnad 'tsho med pa rgan mo gser khur gyi lung pa bde bar bkod par mdzad/ spyir sku gzhon dus nas shes bya kun la mkhyen rab kyi 'jug sgo yangs pas chotshe ga'i gdangs dbyangs sku gas gzhi kun mkhyen pad dkar gyis dbyangs yig dri za'i rgyud mangs la/ blo bros rnam dpyed kyi tsal bton te rang lugs bod dang mi 'du ba rgyas bsdus 'bring gsum/ rol mo 'khrol lugs/ dung dang rgya gling / phyag rgya bca' lugs sku gas zhabs dung rin po che dngos bzhugs dus nas spyan bstar gyis mdzad cing rme ga'i chings dang mtshams spyor bcas gsar du bcoms te dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa las/ mtshan bde yangs dag mdzad chen smad zhes grags/ phyi srid lugs kyi skor la rin srongs spyi bla/ tshadas rtse spye bla/ dar dkar spyi bla rnam gsum/nang du rdzong bdag phyag mjod pa gsum/ maspon bdag bka' blon che chung gsum/tshogs ras dmar po che chung bcu gsum/ skru tshab brgyad cu bcas bskos/ de la lha chodas dge ba bcu dang / mi chodas gtsang ma bcu grag dang mthun pa sde srid dbu mdzad chen mo'i sgrig lam rnam gzhag ces kun gyis mig ltos kyi dper byed pa/ ya rabs dam pa'i srol bzang skye so'i lugs dang mthun zhing dam pa'i chodas dang mi 'gal ba 'di mdzad/ de la rten nas zhabs dung rin po che'i zhal nas/ sdo rmi dbu mdzad 'di snyo nang gi sgrig rnam gzhag gcig pū la bka' drin che bar ma zad/ che sa 'jig rten gang gi thad nas kyang rus thon pa chodas rje 'byug pa'i phyag marsha pa yin zer ba la rgya bod hor gsum du ngom chodag pa zhig yin gsungs/ lcags yos lor zhabs dung thugs dam zhugs pa nas bzung lugs gnyis 'bor 'o/sa sgyur ba'i rgyal srid 63 bstan 'dzem rab rgyas kyi rnam thar nga dgu'i mdun nas/200

chos bzhin du bkyings te/ spyi lo 1656 rab byung 11 pa'i me sprel lor gdan sa lcags rir dbyar nyi ldog gi gsung ཿtsheg skabs zla lnga pa'i tshes nyer dgu la 'dus chogs kyi dbur ljags dbugs dpal ye shes mgon po'i thugs gar thim ste kro snyun med du zhi bar gshegs/ sku sgur yang me mchod ma phrul bar de nyid du bzhag ste gzhung nas dge 'dun gyi sder phyag 'gyed ras bzang sum cu'i rtsis kyis ma ṇi dung sgyur sogs dgongs rdzogs gtos che ba bsgrubs/ sku sngar phyis su spyi lo 1681 rab byung 11 pa'i lcags mo bya lo la rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas sde srid mdzad skabs su mkhan chen bsod nams cadad zer gyis sbur byings mdzad tshe me sngo sangs 'ba' zhig hu gyur ba'i ngo mtshar dang / spur byings zin kyang sreg rdzas cung ma rdzogs pa'i bar rgyal sras bstan 'aci na rab rgyas nas sum chu slebs pa 'bul ma thag slar sngerdzo sangs kyi me rang 'bar byung bas tshe gas pa thams cad dad pa'i gdung dza/gas skyes pa'i ngo mtshar byung 'dug/shitho lug dus dgra'i dbang po'i zor sgrub skabs sde pas yul gsar pa bstan 'dzin 'byug rgyas la dmigs su bkar ba zhig daserdzos tshul gsungs pa 'kherdzor ling rnams zin pa'i gyis spyon tsam byung rung grwa tshang la'ang spyan dmigs mdzad dgos pa'i chogs gtam btang / de don bzhin yul gsar pa gtso bor byas te zor ba bsgyur bas stabs 'grigs pa bzhin yin nam 'i ltar yang ring por ma 'o/na par dmar bshal btab nas tshe'i dus byas pa gnas rnying dka' chen gyis mig mthe nga lag zin pa'i gnas tshul phag ri rdzong sdod gnam gang 'byug rgyas gyis sde par phul 64 rnam thar du ku la ka sgo|ga grangs nyis brgya zhe dgu'i rgyab yig phreng bzhi pa nas/201

bar brten btang raka dang tshigs bcad bris pa'i snyan dar phyal/ zhes gsal/ /sde srid khri rabs gnyis pas bstan srid bskyungs tshul dang dge sku ga gi dpyang chen gsum pa'i phyogs las rīrnam par sbyo/'a/ ba/ rsā༅༅ / / sde srid gnyis pa la sngon pa bstan 'dzin 'grug grags ni/ yab bstan pa'i nyi ma'i lcam zur pa zhig gi sras su spyi lo 160'dang rab byung 10 pa'i chu stag lo la sku 'khrungs/ zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal dang zhal gyi dbyibs kyang mtshungs par grags/ lku chung ngu'i dus nas blo spos gsal zhing rnam dpyod kyi 'jug sgo shin tu yangs pas sde snod dang rgyud sde rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhye na rab kyi tsal rgyas/ khyad par tshad ma dang / gasku( ba rig pa'i sdo/da la mkhas par shu/ra/ yab bstan pa'i nyi ma las 'byug pa bka' rgyud kyi dbang khrid man ngag chodas lung sku ngas su rdzogs par zhus/ spyi lo 1646dang rab byung 11 pa'i me khyi lor spa hro rin spungs rdzong rgya bskyed de bzhengs nas rin spungs spu bla thog mar la sngon chi sa rje bstan 'dzin 'byug grags bste/sa 'dug der lugs gnyis kyi bstan srid ceras bzhin du bkyings te lo bcu tsam song ba na spu lo 1656 me sprel lo zla 5tshos 'khal sde srid dngu mdzad chen mo sku gshegs pa'i rgyal tshab hu sde srid gnyis pa'i gser khrir mnga' gaskusnal/thugs shin hu zab cing sgam pas bka' khrims kyang 'jam rtsubs ran pas spyotshong bar mdzad pas/ sngar sde pa dbu mdzad skabs kyi sgrig lam shin tu dam pa gu dog po'i 202

rnam ge cung zad sangs par /lngar ces grags/ spyi lo 1656 me sprel zla 8 pa nas spyi lo 1657me bya lo zla drug bdun pa'i bar la rgod nas gong sa lnga pa dang sde srid bsod nams rab brtan bcas nas snyo rdzongs kyi rgyal sems mnga' 'bangs sa/ bsdu ba'i bsam pas bod khri ṇḍa ra bcu gsu/ma dmag dang sog po 'dres ma'i dmag dasung chen po grabs bsgrigs te/ spa bro'i phyogs nas sgam po nas/ sde dpon bkra shis brtsegs pa/ dgon bla ma bde maḥtsheg mgon po/gling bzhi phyogs nas gong dkar grang yig tsha gur nas sku gas/ thum thang phyogs nas sdo ge bsod nams dbang gyel/ gdung nag po se gas/ bkra shis sgang nas lha rgya ras ge sogs phag ri nas/ kyi gur nas sku gas kyi dmag dpung chen wa sa ri lung thams cad khyab par 'ongs te sde gzar chen po g.yos kyang / sde srid de nyid nang du byung sems rtsa ba brtan cing dang/'a ba dang / gzhan sde rnam par gcadan pa'i dgra thabs kyi 'phrul la shin hu mkhas pa dang / sngar nas zhabs dung rin rnge ches phyin chad bod dmag gis nged rang la gcad mi thub ces zhal bzhes gnang yod pa bzhin/ dus 'dir skru mtshams bcad rgyar thugs dam dasku ngas pa la rtse gcig/ tu bzhugs sku da pa bzhin/ srung skyob rgyab rten 'jig rten pa'i lha srung la brten pa'i bod kyi dmag da sung chen po rnams kyis/ srung skyob rgyab rten ye shes pa'i lha dpal mgon ma hā ka la lcam dul sde brgyad tshogs la brten pa'i dpal ldan 'drug pa la gnod pas brdzi ma nus pa rdo rje pha lam la chu shing gi mdung bsnun pa ltar gyur 'dug yar lha sham po'i lung bstan las/ 'jig rten lha la gsol mche da rems na yang / / ye shes lha yi bka' chad ga la zlog / sra zhing mkhregs pa rdo rje pha lam la/ / mtshe na cha sna yang 203

'jig pa ga la srid/ / ces gsungs pa bden par 'dug /sga rshabs stor dpung 'degs gnang bar 'gro lding pa'i skabs nas tshos dug gi nyin sde pas zur khyab bdag bla ma dang thun mong du brtag pa mo rtsis gyis gsungs pa rje bla mas dgongs 'dus kyi mkha' 'gro'i mo dang de nub thugs dam gsal snang gi brtag pa'ang mdzad par mngon/ nged kyis dbyangs 'char gyi dmag rtsis byas pa gnyis ka mkhran pa rshanan hu 'o(nga pa babs pas de ga'i tsu/ mtshan gyi sam ṭa phul bar ma mnyes pa'i mo ngag rnams nges tshul gyi lan zhig byung / 'di dang dbyibs mtshungs par dgang 'degs gdong bsam yas gnod spyin chen pos kyang sde par bka' spro/ga gnang 'dug tshar chen cerdzos kyi rgyal po'i kri thang phyag nas ma dang thugs dam rten gyi mgon po shing dung ma gnyis dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po'i rigs brgyud u bzhi lha gshongs pas lto'i dmag grabs kyi dgos cha'i zhu rten du byung ba ltar blo'i re ba bskang / nang so dngos grub dang dpon tshang byang ngos dung 'tsho gnyis la steng grib kyi dogs pa zhig snang bas khyab 'jug dug dbyung gi dbang bskur zhing rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs chung du dartsershas tshul bzhin bris zhes gsal/'a85 skabs mon du dasung chen khyogs shing sde pa dpon g.yog kyang zhal balko la gtsang du phebs pa'i dug zhan thams cad 'tshub ling nge pa'i skabs su yod/ ces dang / waṃ 7pa nor thus lkog hu gnas tshul dang sgrags da cha dmag bsgo la ba sde par rgyu mtshan zer dgos lugs byung rung dmag gi cha mo rtsis lung bstan gang la'ang ma 65 du spru la ka pa 31ga grangs nyis brgya lnga bcu'i rgyab phreng gsum pa nas/66 yang ka pa 31ga grangs nyis brgya nga gcig gi rgyab phreng gsum pa nas/ 67 yang ka pa nga gcig rgyab phreng grag ji nas204

babs shing / der ma zad mi dmang gi blor yang mi 'thad pa nas baspro/la btab kyad thugs la ma song gshis yang sgyur la dasku sa pa mi 'dug kyang / zhes snang / dme gasprel la lto bod kyi sde gzar chen po langs pas sa spyong bsed nams rab brtan dpung thog hu rgyal rtser phebs pa mjal bar khyodan/ zhes gsal/ rdo rje gdan du bcom ldan 'das mnyam par bzhag pa la bdud dmag bye ba dung sgyur gyis ma thub pa bzhin/ dpal ldan 'byug pa'i lha che sa skyong srung ma'i mthu stobs nus pas mgon bla ma bde mche ga mgon po gza' gdong thug gi 'phral du spongs pa sogs phal cher shi/ gzhan sde dpon bkra shis brtsegs pa se gas 'asku dpon sum cu/lding dpon 'bangs 'khor sum brgya lhag tsam btson du bzung / de skabs gtsang paṇa chen blo bzang glerdzos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis 'dums chings mdzad de lha 'bangs thams cad bde bar slog pa'i bka' drin mdzad 'dug pa rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar nang gsa~X'/ lo sngon ma'i zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du sog po 'ga' zhig dang / khams pa dwags kong sogs sod thams cad kyi dmag dasung snyo phyogs su bcug de dang dus mnyam du sa kyi zhabs grang sku dngos dang / sde pa spyid sgod pa dpon g.yog rnams mdun chings kyi dgongs pas gyon nas skor 'phen sna tshogs yang yang mdzad 'dug kyang / phar tshur gnyis ka nas gsan dgongs ma byung ba'i ngang nas 'o/ 'bor la thug 68 bsedi nams masnurag grub kyi rnam thar gong sa lnga pas mdzad pa dpyode ldan yid dbang 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu'i ldeb grangs skusna bzhi'i rgyab phreng gsum pa nas/69 nor bu'i phreng ba lngeb grangs brgya dang lnga bcu nga bdun gyi rgyab phreng lnga pa nas/205

tsam dpung ma gyes/ ji skad du chogs kyi gtam las/ / ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ / mi rnams la yang mardzod par mngon/ / tsha grang gzir bas dmyal bar mtshungs/ / dbul bas gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa/ / 'di yi dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal yang / / mthu ldan stobs kyis mthu med pa/ / rnam par gnon cing 'chi ba dag /chu nge lta su nyid yin rbesna/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal khams thams cad sdug bsngal gyi me 'bar bas mnar zhing kun hu mnar ba'i skabs su 'ga' zhig gis/ khyod kyis chings shig byas na bde ba la 'god pa zhig e yong zhes bskul ba dang / bdag nyid kyis kyang ston pa bla na med pa des/ sems can don byed nga la gus yin nga ni sems can kun la byams/ / zhes bka' cil pa spyi sor cad/ sems can thams cad la dmigs pa'i snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te lag stong du chings byed pa'ang skabs su mi 'bab snyam/ sde pa phyag mdzod dang / 'byug pa gdung brgyud rin po cher rnam gzhag dgangs mtho ba re re dang / se so'i dmag dpon rnams la thams cad bsdoms pa'i la btags brgya lhag dngul srang stong phrag sman rtsi yug brgya/gos yug lnga bcu/ gser srang gsum/ g.yu tshi dkar dmar sku gas dngos po rnam grangs mang po dang bcas/ ཿtshes mdzad bserdzod nams phran tshogs dang / dka' chen tshogs gse ga pa che sa 'byor legs pa dpon g.yodag 'ga' shas chings par btang pas/ dalngardzos 〈sna'i rnam gzhag btang ba la ma ba31sa par phan tshun gnyis gas gsan dgongs rnam par dag pa mdzad nas lo bzhi lnga'i bar lab chings yang dag par bsdoms te snyo bod kyi skye so thams cad btson khang me 'bar ba nas legs par thar ba lta thu'i spro ba thob yod 'dug cing / lto'i dasung 'jug snga gong gi skabs nas 206

bzung gnas rnying rje btsun grang se gas dug zhan sna tshogs phar tshur gnyis kur btson du lus nas 'o mang du serdzong ba rnams kyang ma lus par brje spyod grangs nyis brgya tsam byas te rang rang gi yul du bde ba'i dbugs dbyung ba thob par byas shing / de las byung ba'i dge ba rnams bla na med pa'i byang chub hu bsngo ba'i phyir smras pa// su sti 'di ltar bsgrubs pa'i rnam dkar phyang po'i tshogs/ / srid pa'i rtse mo nas bzung dmyal ba'i bar/ / las dang nyon mongs rba klong dug 'khrug cing / / sdug bsngal gsum gyi chu srin mang lngardzos gtses/ / nyam thag 'a6snar ba'i rgya masnangar chud pa yi/ / mar //ra 'a〈sna rnams thabs shes tshi rdzings gyis/ / bsgral nas sku gsum rin chen mche ga len pa'i/ / lam ston ded dpon bzang por bdag gyur cig / ces gsal bas me sprel zla brgyad pa'i nang bod dmag casnangs nas me bya zla dug pa bdun pa'i bar bod 'brug 'khrugs te mthar paṇa chen tre bzang ceras kyi rgyal mtshan gyis chings bsgrigs te gyes 'dug / rgonis chung snu sa spyong chen pos thog mar dmangs dang mi mthun pa'i dgang 'gro khyab yong ba'i phyogs kyi lung bstan pa/ dpung man nang du chug tshe da la da cha bsams pa bzhin byas ma setreng bas tshul ldan mi sku nga ba gsung ba phag ri nas bzung zhag 'phyal nyin 'phrul du ma se nga ba'i ce la khyad kyis phyin te hung ral khar tsha shugs kyis bskor 'chings rū tshom med pa zhig btsams na de lo rsā sog lams kong tshang ma yod zer ba'i dgra skad kyis rdzong bskyur byed nge sa yin 'dug kyang sde pa nor sus tshul ldan ma nus pa'i spyon du snang bas chodas skyong la log lta dgos rigs su mi gda'/ de yang chodas spyong rnams kyis khung bstan mo rtsis/ mi 70 gong sa lnga pa'i rnam thar du ku la'i pod ka pa'i sgo ga grangs nyis brgya nga spyig gi mdun phreng gnyis pa nas/3207

dmangs kyis brjod rigs gang la dpag kyang lto'i dpung 'jug de 'gro khyab che ba zhig yong rigs mi 'dug rung dbus dpung dang lams kong rnams dgon dang bum thang du bcug tshe bum thang man chad tshur chad pa tsam gyis mtha' brten pa'i rjes yongs rigs la tshang ma spa spor dril ba sde pa nor bu'i che 'don la mi 'gro ba'i khar khong pas pho ma skyes pa'i dmag yun gyis bee ge sogs nad rims dang snyo tshad kyis mi gces mang du gron/ gan la sa'i sgor gasku ga stag lung sman spong pas rgyal rtser sde par phul ba'i zhu yig la da la'i bā thur dang ma gcig tha'i ji gnyis bstan pa'i lcags ri dang nor thu khur bzhes mdzad dgos pa'i gces phangs che bas dbyar gyi ring phag ri tsam la 'then/ gzhan su shi'ang mi la mi thogs pas ma sprel 'jug dgos zhes sod gangs can pa thams cad sdebs su stong kyang ji mi snyam pa'i rgyu mtshan phul snang ba dgos don ji ltar yang 'bras spungs su ched bstad ston par btang byung / tshur 'then rtsis mdzad 'dug rung sog po'i dpon po gnyis gzhan dang mi 'du ba'i dpa' mdzangs rtul phed pas dasung chen 'then na nged gnyis yong ba gzhir bcas/ dmangs ma bzhag ste 'o/ga pa'i gtam 'khur nas se ga po'i khrod du gdong ston mi nus zhes 'gyon ma nyan/ ma gcig tha'i ji glo bur du spongs pa mon tshad yin nam zer/ maX na gnyer grang pa can mang dag gis zab 'og nas brjod rigs tha'i jis sde pa nor bur sdang thug ches par brten zas spyor zhig byung 'du gleng / 'ong gi bsngo byung 'byor don bzhin gnas spar nan tan du bgyis shing sgur byang ri khrod dga' ldan sle ba dpon byams pa rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rus pa bkyil byung bar satstsha lag bdar mang du btab/ gdan sa gong cadag gi zhabs dung rin po che gnyis 208

sman mchis so cog 'bad rtsol chen pos bsgrubs te phyag mdzod nang sman gyi rigs gang yang ma tshang med par mdzad de/ bod gangs can gyi sman pa yod do cog la min 'gyed lan gnyis gnang bar mdzad/ srongs thang rdzong du dgo 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba ka chen sum cu'i rgya khyon glo 'bur bcas bzo bkod phrul du gyin pa la skyes rabs dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i srid pa chags tshul dang / mngon pa'i lugs kyi 'jig rten chags tshul rnams 6dzan rtsis mdzes pa gsar du bsgrubs/ khyetshogs bzhi'i las sgo las ji ltar byung ba'i 'thul dngos nor rdzas thams cad bar ma dor chud mi za bar bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs su dmigs te spu lo 166'arab byung 11 pa'i chu stag lo la rin chen gnyis pa'i rgyu las bde bar gshegs pa'i masnu da rten brgyad kyi gtso bo bkra shis sgo mangs thog se gsum lhag tsam dang / gzhan thog sku gnyis ma bcas rin po che sna tshogs kyi phras mdzos pa da lta dngul 'bum mche da rten du grags pa bzhengs pa'i 'go btsugs shing / spyi lo 1665rab byung 11 pa'i shing sgrul lo nas tsan dan dkar dmar rgyu las marme da rten brgyad kyi bzo grwa 'asnod btsugs par mdzad 'dug zhu lo 1666rab byung 11 pa'i me pho rta lo nas bka' 'gyur gyi glegs bam mthing 31ga la gser gyis bris pa bzhengs pa'i 'go btsugs par mdzad cing / dge 'dun gyi sde las blo gsal rnam dakhyodad can rnams sdom gsum brtag gnyis/ rtsa rgyud sku gas tshig don blo 'dzin byed du bcug cing / tshogs rgyugs 'thul mkhan rnams la mang ja dang mtshan grangs se gas gang la gang mthos rnam gzhag gzengs bstod de gnang bar mdzad dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bstan pa la gcig /lnga gces pas rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas sku na gzhon nu'i skabs sprungs thang rdzong du sde srid rang 210

phan thogs nges pa'i phyo mtha' gzigs te grwa tshang gi sgrig la btsugs par mdzad pa serdzogs/ mnyam med dpal ldan 'byug pa'i bstan pa sman sbyordzongs rgyal lams 'dir yun ring du gnas pa'i thabs la gcig hu dgongs par mdzad pa de rnams shin tu bka' drin che/ de ltar sde srid 'di nyid chos rje 'byug pa'i gdung brgyud du gtogs shing / lugs gnyis kyi bstan srid la mdzad pa'i phyag rjes kyang shin tu rlabs che bas smos kyis mi langs/ sde srid phyag mdzod kyi thugs khur bzhes te lo nya'atsam song ba spyi lo 1667 rab byung 11 pa'i me mo lug gi lo zla 'a pa'i tshes 15 la dngul 'thum mched rten chen mo dang bka' 'gyur gsor zhun gyis bzhengs bzhin pa sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo 'phro can du lus te sku zhi bar gshegs/ / 212

sde srid gsum pas bstan srid ji ltar bskyungs tshul dang dge ldan pa'i dgang chen bzhi pa dang lnga pa'i phyogs 'a/'a/ rnam par shākya'/ ba/ ༄7/ / sde srid khri rabs gasnge/ma pa cesas rgyal mi 'arda/ra brtan pa'am mtshan gzhan ke ma chos lhun grub ni/ spu lo 1613rab byung bcu pa'i chu glang lor bod smin 'khyud du sku 'khrungs/ sku gzhon dus nas dge 'dun gyi sder zhugs te dbu mdzad kyi 'gan bzhis pa nas dpal ldan 'grag pa'i bstan pa la lhag bsam rnam dag gis phyag phyod zhus pa las/ ngag gi dbang phyug gi gdan sa chodas 'khor rab brtan rtse'i spya blar bskos/ der rdzong rgya bskyed de bzhengs pa dang / skru gsung thugs rten mang du bzhings/ sngar bshad pa bzhin bla ma rnam sras ldo rje dang / dngu mdzad dam che sa rab rgyus/ sku dung pad dkar ཿtshes 'phel sogs kshi dasung spogs la brten nas byus mkhas kyis bum thang chotshes 'khor sde pa bcom ste bya dkar rdzong bzhengs pa nas/ rim bzhin lhun rtse'i rdzong / yang rtse'i rdzong / gzhong sgar rdzong / bkra shis sgang rdzong /gzhal sgang rdzong bcas rdzong dug rten brten par bcas pa bzhengs pa'i byas rjes che bar brten/ sde srid gnyis pa la snge na cerdzos rje bstan 'dzin 'byug grags gshegs pa'i rgyal tshab hu dung dam cerdzos rgyal mtshan gyis sde srid gsum pa zhabs dung rin po rtse'i bka'i sam ṭa nyid la phebs pa yin zhes spyi 'o/ 1667 rab byung 10 me lug la spong gsar dpon slob nas sde srid kyi khrir bskos gnang 'dug de skabs rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas 'dus sder bzhugs pa dgung ma( sum cur phebs pa dpal 213

ldan 'byug pa'i bstan pa'i la rgyar dgongs nas/ 'dus sde'i khrod nas zur bzhugs gsol te sde srid rang dang mnyam par bdag kyen spar cing dbu 'phang bstod de bla ma khri par mnga' gse la nas/ da ni chodas rje 'byug pa'i gdung nyid thugs 'gan bzhes te bstan pa 'dzin spyong spel gsum mdzad dgos zhes gsungs/ thub/sa gtad de kyi nang gi bya ba gal che chung thams cad la bka' ba〈snas gnang zhing zhabs dung yab sras ཿtshes srid lugs zung gi phrin las nyid kyis mdzad dgos pa'i zhu gse la bslab ston bzang po yang yang bskul ma mdzad cing bkur sti dang gzengs bstod chen po mdzad do/ / sngar che sa 'khor rab brtan rtse'i spyi bla mdzad bzhugs dus sde srid gong ma gnyis kyi skabs zhabs dung yab sras kyi sku mdun ma thar bar mdzad stabs bde min khu/nga ba thugs la dun te/ : sngar dpe da srol de bzhin da dung bstan don gyi gzhi chen por nged kyi blo spos phra mos kri na nag redom 'jal du song tsho bstan don la slebs rgya chung srid pas/ bya ba 'gang chen ma zhu ka med gī rigs la sesnang sa yab sras kyi sku zhabs su nged cis kyang bcar ཿtsheg pa zhu dgos zhes dbang gzhan la ma gtad par bka' nan ñtsa bas gsungs pa la/ zhabs dung sngar nas zhing gshegs pa'i 'o/ rgyus 'di nyid/'dir nang nas bla ma lha pa sogs bla lag lnga dang / phyo nas bod dmag gi dgra mang bar brten/ sde srid dbu mdzad dang drung dam chodas rgyal mtshan gyis chodas srung la gnyer du bcol te phyo nang gi mi sus kyang mi shes par gsang rgya dmya par byas te dnge sa sa/ thugs dam la bzhugs skusnad tshul byas nas/ gaskutshel chas rnams snga dro bzhes thug nas phyo dro tshogs kyi bar nam rgyun phul te bzhag pa ma gtogs/ zhabs dung rin 214

po kṣe sngar nas zhing phebs tshar ba de chasnang la nang lugs su gsu/ngas ma btub dgongs te/ phyis su grang dam ceras rgyal mtshan la mi 'tshams pa byas te dbang 'dus klo drang du zur bzhugs mdzad pa las skyes masnu ga dam pa 'di nyid mi ring bar dpal ldan 'grag pa'i bstan pa la thugs phreng bzhin der dgongs pa rdzogs 'dug / de skabs bod nas sman rdzongs rgyal lab 'di nyid bod kyi mnga' 'og hu bcug rgyu'i dgongs bzhed rgyun mar yod pa'i stabs kyis sde srid mi 'gyur brtan pa khri thog 'kho de yun ma ring ba'i dus na bod nas dmag 'ongs dug go /dge ldan pa'i dpung chen bzhi pa'i phyogs las rnam par sbyo/la thenil/ de yang 'bras phrengs kyi 'go dpon mon pa a tshog zer ba de yis sngar 'di ga'i mang 'a cadag yin pa la/ rjes su bod lams dga' ldan pho brang pas dbang bsgyur pa na/ mon pa a cerag de rgyal dbang lnga pa'i sku mdun du bcar te mgo gtad zhus nas 'grag par ngo log ste dmag 'khrugs byed pa'i rgyab dgang du spyi lo 1668 sa sprol la yī nas sde srid phrin las rgya mtsho'i dmag dpon chen po sgam po nas kyis gtsos pa'i da thung chen 'tshengs skabs su/rsha 〉la snyo 'byug pas tshur rgol byas par gdong len du dgang bcug skabs bsam yas su lha sa nub pa rin chen rdzongs rta byas te gshod phyin chen por spyan 73 rgyal dbang lnga pa'i rgya bod hor sog gi mchodag dman bar pa rnams la phrin yig snyan ngag tu bkod pa'i chab sgo ga rab snyan rgyud mangs brgya lhasna gcig gi mdun nas/215

gzigs dang phrin bcol du gse la pa rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon/ bstan 'gro'i phan bde prel ba'i mel tsho mkhan/ / dpag dka'i mthu ste/bas mnga' ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ sde brgyad dmag gi la lo sgyur ba'i dpon/ / snu sa rgyal sde lnga sprul yum blon por bcanas/ / sogs sgo lo ka dug dang / de bzhin du sa sprel snyo 'byug pas tshur rgol byas par gdong len gyi dpung bcug skabs lcang lo can pa bstan 'dzin dpal bzang rdzong rta byas te stong 'dus su snu sa skyong gshan pa bya khri mig gcig par spyan gzigs dang bcas phrin bcol du gse la ba gzhan sde mi rtag lam du 'god pa 'i mtshon rnon/ log 'dren snying gi khrag dron rkan sgu dang / / bcas te dgyes gsol sredag gi gshan pa che/ / bstan srung chen nge bya khri mig gcig pa/ / srid gsu ma skad cig myul ba'i lha khyod gson/ / sogs sprod lo ka bcu gnyis dang / sa sprel snyo 'brug pas tshur rtse la byas par gde nga len du dpung bcug —skabs chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse la mor rdzong rta bgyis te tshe sa spyong tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can la spyan gzigs dang bcas phrin bce la du gse la ba blang dor bzhin ras gsal ba'i me long / lkog hu gyur kyang khyod kyis mngon sum du/ / gzigs pa'i dri med spyan ldan srog gi bdag / tshangs pa chen po dung gi thor tshugs can/ / 'bod pa'i sgra la snyan gyi dbang po gtod/ / sogs sgo lo ka lnga dang / sa sprel snyo 'grag pas tshur rgol bgyis par gdong len du dpung bcug skabs thang po cher lcang lo can pa bstan 'dzin dpal bzang rdzong rta byas te thang chen rgyal po chen por spyan gzigs dang bcas phrin bcol du gsol ba ha halti gad rgyangs/ gnod phyin chen po shing bya can gyi blon/ / gshan pa lag dmar mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bdag / spyan sngar dam skong mchod sprin tho 216

gsal ltar/ / 'thul gyis zhi rgyas dbang gi las kun sgrubs/ / skurdzogs 31 'o( /ka bzhi rnams pyi phrin brtsol lag bzhi bcas dmag dpung chen po phyogs sku se ra bkyes snadug pa dang snyo 'o4byug pas mon pa a che ga sogs rang zhabs kyi steng du dpung bcug pa'i chud rgol de lam du bzhag na ma 'thus pa'i dgang lag bzhi gte nga ba panar bas grwa tshang du jus rim btsugs/ spyan gzigs snyan dar chogs chas spel ba'i phrin bcol dang thung bstan zhu bar bas/ma yas su lha sa nub pa rin chen/ tshong 'dus dang thang pu cher lcang lo can pa bstan 'dzin dpal bzang / la mor chang khyim pa ngag dbang ma khye na brtse rnams btang / zhes gsal ba bzhin/ sa sprel 'o/ de la bod nas sde srid grong smad pa phrin las rgya mcho'i dmag dpon sgam po nas gyis gtsos dpung dmag chen po khag bzhi phyogs sku sku nas gasku sa/ sum thang phyogs nas bya dkar rdzong 3nar/sdo srid kyis bla ma ngag dbang rab brtan dgang sna 'khrid de thum thang phyogs su brdzangs pas/ de nyid snying stobs che zhing dmag gi sgyu tsal dang byus mkhas kyi sgo nas byu dka ra rdzong slar bde blag tu thob 'dug /dbang 'dus pho brang rdzong dpon dge 'dun chos 'phel rdzong la gling bzhi phyogs kyi dmag dpon du song ba/ phas rgol gyi gdong 'degs ma thub pas shin hu yid mem zhing / nyin gcig bzang po'i 'o/gas bya ba der dmag rgyab la phyin pas/ der yang byus nyes su song bas mi mang po shi/ 'o rang che sa rje phun tshogs pas shed 'dren pas thar tsam byung / ma gsang sgrub sde bya ba sa gnad shin hu che ba zhig ma da 74 rgyal dbang lnga pa'i rnam thar dā ku la la pa bdun cu tham pa'i rgyab nas/ 217

pa gzhan rgyas mnan pas sprir khyodag rgyab/ me mda' se char bzhin btang bas rdzong phyo'i dmag thams cad nang du bros pa sogs kyis shin hu mi bde ba bcas 31ra la khad du gyur pa de'i tsho/ sde srid mi 'gyur brtan pas bum thang bya dkar nas ngag dbang rab brtan tshur bos te dgon dmag lhag 'jog la yar yod pa 'khrid de 'grog gling bzhi'i phyogs su rgyab dasung du btang bar mdzad 'dug pa las g.yul 'khrugs kyis rgyal la cob ste/ bya dkar g.yul rgyal rdzong zhes pa dang / gling bzhi g.yul rgyal rdzong zhes pa de las byung / de yang de skabs gzhung du mkhan chen bsed nams 'od zer gyis mngon spyad kyi chod ga gnang ba'i skabs rtags mtshan ji ltar byung tshul ni/ skobos der yang gzhan gyi dpal la phrag de ga sdang sems kyi zug pas brgyal ba lta thur sgam po nas kyi dmag dgang tshan cher brdol byung nas/ mngon spyod kyi rlo ga zhig gnang ba'i zhag gsum pa'i thad/ da ni cerdzos srung rnams bring ma zing langs pa ltar byung ngo dge 'dun rnams thugs rim sgrims shig gsungs/ zhag bzhi pa'i thad bzhes rol gyi skabs su gsung cerag pa thams cad kyi shangs la sha khrag gi dri ngad stor ba byung / zhag lnga par liṅgas skad ngan sgo ra ba sogs mngon spyod kyi gzhung nas ji ltar bshad pa'i dgra bo khug rtags rnams kun gyi mthong snang mthun grub hu gsal po byung / zhal nas las mkhan rnams kyi nang nas gdong dmar 'di ches thu ba 'dug gsungs shing / sgam po nas zer ba 'o skyes pa dar ma shin hu skyen pa sha dkar po mi 75 malan chen bsod nams 'od zer gyi rnam tha ci ngag dbang dpal ldan bzang pos mdzad pa snyan tshig 'dod 'jo'i 'khri shing bcu bdun gyi mdun nas/ 218

ra khyug ge ba zhig 'dug gsungs/ rjes su mgo lag khyer cadang dus ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin 'grigs pa ༷nang / zhes gsal/ de bzhin sde srid kyis bla ma khri pa rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas la zhus te lcags ri'i mgon khang chen po nas ye shes mgon po'i gtor bzlog 'phangs pa'i rko cas der/ sros pa dpal 'byor gī thu mo rnal 'byor ma zhig yod pa la dge bsnyen chen po zhugs te/ rje dpal ldan 'byug pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi/ / nga bka' nyan jag pa me len yin/ / mgon sprul pa'i skyes mchodag rin po che/ / mthu nus pa'i me rtse dbal tsha bas/ / dpal 'grag bstan khyodags la brdeg gzas shing / / sku ngas 'aX ba'i bde spyod 'phyog byed pa'i/ / khong dge ldan stobs kyis dregs pa yis/ / dasung sa gzhi gang ba'i g.yul bshams kyang / / dus 'o/ zla'i yun 'gyangs mi bsgug par/ /'phul sang dang gnangs kyi dus dag la/ / rtags mtshan ma myur du ce na la nye sa/ /zhes pa sogs mang du lung bstan pa bzhin bod dmag tsho'i mthong snang la/ lha chodas spyong srung ma'i rnam 'phrul mtshon cha sna tshogs dang ru dar mang po khyer ba'i dmag da thung chen pos ri lung thams cad khengs par mthong 'jigs sngangs kyis/ go mtshon thams cad skyur nas bros kyang ceras srung dam can rgya mtsho'i dpung gis bskor te ma thar bar dmag dpon gatheng ro/ sgam po nas sku gas dmar bsad btang nas mthod lag len zhing / gzhan yang sde dpon dang / lding dpon sogs gte'ur bzung / dmag byings rnams 'o/ gnyis lhag bsdad kyang dpal ldan 'byug pa'i ceras srung gi mthu nus la 'gran par ma nus 31/ /rmordo' dpon gsum gyis gceras pa'i dathung chen gyis rang zhabs ma bsgul spya ca gong sa lnga pa'i rnam thar dā ku la la pa don gcig gi mdun nas/219

dgra rtse phyogs bzhi nas glo 'bur bton te zur bcu gnyis mtha' bskor te bde gshegs so lnga/ sman bla mched brgyad/ gnas brtan bcu grag rjesgol ma nyer gcigagu ru mtshan brgyad/ rje la ma 'jigs pa brgyad spyoXb/ tsho lha rnam gsum/ rigs gsum mgon po/ tshib chen brgyad cu/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga/ bka' brgyud gser phreng sogs rdo nag la brkedas pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems sku rten sum brgya lhag gis bskor ba dang / glo 'thur dbus ma'i dri gtsang khang du ston pa'i sku gser zangs las grub pa rgyab krerdzol pa tu rgyan ṇa drug gser gyi gzi cad 'bar ba dang / g.yas g.yon du nye sras brgyad maḥsgog zung bcas thog tshad ma dang / gle 'bur g.yas su thugs rje chen po nam mkha' rgyal po dang gam na du mgon po lcam dul gsum serdzogs —rten brten par bcas pa bskadad pa phran sum tshe gas pa snga na med pa bzhengs par mdzad/ rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyis rab gnas nyin lnga'i bar rgyas par mdzad pa na rdo nag gi ston pa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i zil pa phrum phrum kun gyi mthong snang du gyon par grags so/ / spyi lo 1674 rab byung 11 pa'i shing stag la sde pa la sngon pa bstan 'dzin 'brug grags kyi bka' 'gyur gser ma bzhengs 'phro yang legs par sdi/ba rngo(/ /dge ldan pa'i dmag dgang lnga pa 'ongs tshul ni/ 7 de yang sngar sa sprel nas shing yos bar chings bsgrigs kyang / yang chings don la ma gnas par a cerag gis chings ma grol rtse nga thog mar 'grag pa la tshur rbodal rī'adug pa ni/ zlorgo snga mgyogs kyis zla ba dang po sngon ma'i nyer lnga dug tsam la steng 77 du ku la la pa nyis brgya sku dgu'i rgyab nas/ 221

gdung rdzong mer bsregs pa'i chag tshim re che bzos pa/ byed pa pha dang brjod pa thu'i dper 'dug rung 'grag pas de lan gyi dmag byed pa mi bden rgyu ci la yod na'ang de lan tsam gyis zhe sdang zhi byed byas ngos phyir 'then yong la re dang / 'phral du sgab gsong btang ba'i phyi'i ya bo rgyug pas bcar na snyo bod kyi 'gro ba mang po nyam thag gi rgyur se nga dogs 'jam gang chags byas par 'bro gzor rgyas bsdus mi 'dug gshis sa mtshams kyi nye len du dpal de nas dang / bde maḥtsheg mgon po rta rkang gi serdzo 'dzin cadas 'tshams btang zhing rgyal rtse nas skusnags nas 'tshams tshigs rnam par lta bar mda' dpon phran chogs kyang brdzangs/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/mo na pa a cerdzog gis chings spol mtshams lag snga mgyogs kyis 'byug pa'i rdzong mer bsregs te chag tshim chen po bzos pa so/gas mon pa a cerdzog gi dasung gis thog mar 'byug pa la tshur cerdzol bas/ 'byug nas mo na pa la lan du dmag dpung bcug 'dug(shā phyogs kyi yul mon pa'i skye bo rnams kyi sde dpon du gyur pa a chog ces bya bas 'byug pa gzhung la rgol bar gyur pas/ de'i steng du dmag gi dgang chen po bkye pa'i gal du/ rje 'di nyid kyang gyon dgos par gyur pas thugs shin tu spyo zhing /zhes gsal ba bzhin/ spyi lo 1676 rab byung 11 pa'i mel 'ibyug lo la mon pa a snu ga pas ri bo dge ldan par mgo gtad kyibs 'grus kyi g.ye 'phrul lta bus 'bangs kyis rje la bsdo ba'i dpe ltar nub brda ling rdzong nas 'khra ba'i zings rkyen 〈snang bar brten gzhung nas/ mgre na gnyer rdor legs pa dpung bcas gzhug pa 78 kun bzang ras chen gyi rnam thar legs bshad rgya mtsho'i sdes mdzad pa bskal bzang ngal bso grag mdun nas/79 rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas rnam thar dpag bsam 〈snangs 'du'i rtse ma bo brgyad rgyab nas/222

gnang zhing / zhes gsal ba ltar dgang dmag bcug ste blosnan sa ro/nga btsan pas dmag 'khrugs rgyal pham shan ma phye ba la/ phyog cherag gi rgyab dgang du bode nas 'byug ge'i thog sde srid blo bzang phyin pas dasung chen brdzangs shing rim gro sgrub tshul/ lto phyogs kyi thus rim la dge lugs grwa tshang rnams la mang ja 'phar ma byedar sbrel the ga sngags dgon dang / gzhi dgon rnams kyis gtor bzlog mdo grwa rnams dang sa lugs aṅgi dang po rnams la ja thug bzhi re'i thog sher snying / grwa tshang gis tshe bdag gi gtor bzlog ser 'a bras gnyis su ja tshul bco lnga sngon du 'di nyin ja 'phar bzhi dang / dbus gtsang gi dgon lag thams cad nas mdo sgrub dang bcas pa'i chogs zangs la sbub/ se gas nas/ bzhes sgu dang bcas lha 'byug steng du la bsgyur/ zhes grus rim gyi mthu dasung bskyed de dgang chen btang 'dug /de yang de'i sngon snyo bod mon gsum gyi skye 'gro rnams sdug cing nyam thag la ma bkod gong zhi ba'i chings mol zhig yod na dgongs te 'di nas btsan gdong dbu mdzad sogs phag rir baspyod de bar chings bgyis par/ der bod kyi mi snes lam tsam las len bgyis kyang / sde srid blo bzang phyin pa'i thugs 'dod la chings mol de ma khel bas dus 'khrugs kyi sku lang chen po shar 'dug pa ni/ sau bya'i chings snyo pa la rgyal du songan ṭā des kyang ma 'thus phyin lab pa'i spros pa dang bral na'ang /zhis dang / lto bod gī chings tha ma'ang snyo 'byug gis byas pa'i chings pa rnams kyis btsan gdong dbu mdzad kyi rjes zlos lta bu'i gzu chung btang ba sde pa thugs tshig 80 rnam thar glu ku la pod la pa nyis brgya nga grag mdun nas/ 81 rnam thar glu ku la la pa nyis brgya re bdun rgyab nas/223

gnang bar mdzad/ de nas sdeb spyor gyi gzhung / sgra tsan spri pa/ snyan ngag tshad ma rnam 'grel/ sher phyir mngon rtogs rgyan sogs 'chad nyan gyi srol dar zhing rgyas pa nas gzhan yang 'bras yul skyed tshal nas mdo rgyud mang pe rwa1sa pa'i nor gyis phyug pa slob dpon dung ram pa kun dga' nor bzang gdan dungs te/ bshad grwa dar zhing rgyas pa se gas bstan pa la bka' drin shin hu che/ gdan sa sprungs thang gi dbu rtse chen mo gser gyi rgya phibs dang bcas pa dang / zhabs grang ma chen gyi dbu thog hu gsor gyi rgya phibs/ sde srid gong ma'i bka' 'gyur gsor bris gyi 'phyo dang / gling bzhi g.yul rgyal rdzong / nub brda ling rdzong la sogs pa btab pa dang / yul rdzongs mang por gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten dang maṇa thang mang po bzhengs/ gsung rab mang po par du bzhengs/ mdor na shar gdung zam la ling rta wang tshun chad dang / nub brda 'i/nga rdzong gi bar snurmes rje dpal ldan 'grag pa'i snu sa srid gdugs dkar gcig gi lnga ga lung dang dbang bsgyur ba ni/ sde srid 'di nyid kyi mdzad pa'i phyag rjes yin pas chos rje mi 'gyur brtan pa zhes ma ngas su grags pa yin la/ rje ro/kya rin chen gyis spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra'i rnam 'phrul yin par gsungs/ sde srid kyis a pa sgrub pa ngag dbang bsam gtan la da ni gdung brgyud 'jam dpal rdo rje'i lcam zla ba bzhi lnga tsam nas sras 'khrungs te 'khrungs ston legs par bsgrubs rjes sde srid phyag mjod kyi rtsis rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas la phul nas/ gdan sa lcags rir sgrub pa rgyab tu 'gro zhes gsungs shing zur bzhugs kyi dgongs pa gtad par mdzad/ de ltar rgyal srid chodas bzhin du bkyings nas lo bcu gsum song ba na/ thugs 'dod 228

kyi thog tu babs mi 'dug de'i le lan ni sngon sum thang chodas 'khor dpon dang /shar phyogs kyi rgyal po rnams bsad bcom yul bton dang phal cher mnga' 'bangs su bsdus pa dang / lhag par du chodas spyong rgyal po'i chod 'phrul ston pas de'i bskang gso bcad de mchod gral nas bton pa sogs mdzad spyed dugs thal du sog ba dang /sde srid kyi go sar byon dus kyang rgyal po khyod rang la 'di tshur brgal nas ma cadangs shig nga yang la 'di mi 'da'o zhes dam bzhes tho yor brtsigs kyang / gyis su la de brgal te shar phyogs su sgar bskor la gyon pa sogs lha 'dre dug po dang chad rdo byas ge tha tshig las 'das pa'i kyen gyis dang / gzhan yang sngar bod dmag cadang skabs thum thang khyodags snge/ bla ma ngag dbang rab brtan dmag darngo(na byas btang ste rgyal la thob/ gling bzhi'i phyogs su dmag dpon dge 'dun che sa 'phel btang tshe 'ong dpa' gtum brtul pheb can yin na yang pham pa na/ bla ma ngag dbang rab brtan rgyab da gang du btang bas rgyal la rgyob pa las/ sde srid kyis bla ma ngag dbang brtan bka' drin chen pos thugs kyis 'dzin te nang blon du bzhag dge 'dun chodas 'phel bka' bkyon dug po gnang brten/ dus de nas tshur nang nas rgyal blon gnyis la dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis 'khon du 'dzin te sde srid kyis tshos srid kyi bstan pa'i don du rdzong dang / gtsug lag khang dang maṇa thang sku gas bzhengs pa la las ka mang zhing de sa skyel 'ur las kyis brdab gsig btang ste mi ser spyod du ma ster zhes snyad 'dogs te/bslu 'brid kyisaskye therdzo ngan pa rnams la mthun nas gsang dmag bsags te spya 'o( 1680 rab byung 11 pa'i lcags sprel zla nya' pa'i nang spungs rdzong pa dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis ngo rgol rgyab ste glo thur du sde srid kyi steng du dmag 'ong 'dug rje mkhan 229

chen bsod nams 'od zer dang dge 'dun dmang gis sde srid kyi kyibs mdzad de srog spyon med par gdan sa lcags rir zur bzhugs mdzad pa'i lo de'i zla lnga pa'i tshes 'a0la bde ba can gyi hrīsnan lam gsungs bzhin du dgung grangs 68 la zhi bar gshegs so/ / gzhung nas dgongs rdzogs bka' 'gyur kyi pod du tshang bar bzhengs pa dang /chodas rtse spyi bla nas lung pa shes rab lhun grub gyis mang sde stag rtse lha khang thog gnyis ma gsar bzhengs/ gzhung du tsan dan dkar dmar gyi rgyu las dbyen bzlum maḥtshed rten dang rnam rgyal mchodad rten la sogs pa sku gsung thugs rten mang du bzhengs so/ /snyo slagrag la dmigs mngon spyod kyi las rim par nyams su blangs pa'i lag rtags dpon tshab smon spyid pa mi 'gyur brtan pa/ yul gsar pa'i tsha bo ngag dbang rab brten sogs bod pa tshor byas pa che ba mang po dmar gsod kyi mtshon nang zhig byung skabs rtsa ba gsum gyi lha chogs la sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag dang da 'chodal thugs dam tshes gsum nas nyin gsum bar bskang ba'i tshe 'dod don gsol ba/ ki gang 'ordzog 〉ra dmigs bsal gse la byang / zhes gsal/de yang rnam thar sku1gas yig cha rnams su mi snang yang rgan rabs rnams kyis bshad srol gyi lo rgyus cung zad 'dir 'phros su brdzod par bya ste/ bum thang bya dgar g.yul rgyal rdzong nas mel gcig lhag tsam gyi sa gnas thang shing gis bskor ba'i sgang zhig yod pa thob rgyal rdzong zer ba de la/ sngon bod 'byug g.yul 'grigs kyi skabs bod kyi dmag sgar gcig sgang de la chags yod pa dang / dmag sgar gnyig gtsang chu'i 'gram gyi thang la chags skutshed pa las/ gaX/la 'khrugs kyi skabs 'byug 85 gong sa lnga pa'i rnam thar dā ku la ga pa ko bdun mdun nas/230

brtan rtse'i grwa tshang dbyar bum thang sku rjes su gse la thab byon skabs/ zla ba lnga pa'i nang bya dkar g.yul rgyal rdzong gi mgon khang nang sngon srol nyi bzlog dang bsnyun te mgon po'i mdos chodag lo ltar gnang zhing / de skabs las mgon bya rog gdong can gyi spyan 'dren dang bstun te/ sngon srol thob rgyal rdzong gi sgang der bya dkar gzim dpon dang dar dpon srung 'khor pa sogs gyon te/ snga lo'i dar phyog rnying pa phab ste dar lce/ga gsar pa 'phyar nas srung 'bor pas rgyas gsesgol rab gnas byas shing / sngon srol bzhugs gral dang dar dpon la zong dgu tshan re'i thob yod pa phyis su sum tshan re gnang ste/ ṭing )nga bang rnga brdung ste chibs gral tsar te thob rgyal rdzong nas bya dkar rdzong du gyon srol ma nyams pa lo ltar byed kyi yod pa rgan rabs kun gyi mthong yul du yod pa yin/ dar dpon la zong sum tshan re thob yod pa de rgyal po 'jigs med dbang phyug gi skabs su maX na gnyer gyang grus dar dpon gyi go gnas skra ma ma yin pa tshab byas te 'o/ shas bsdad skabs therdzong la yang gnang ste zhus myong zhes/ 'o bos dri ba byas pas lo rgyus de ni cal sgra min par dngos gnas dung gnas bden pa red ces gsu/ngas khu/nga ba dang / sngerdzon rgan rabs gzhan gyi ngag las lo rgyus de mang du thos pa gyis su gzhal sgang rdzong dpon dug tshe|sa phrin las rnam rgyal dang / krong gsar mgron gnyer gyang tshis gsal po gsungs kyi 'dug go mgon po'i mgos chog lo ltar gnang srol dang / de skabs thob rgyal rdzong gi dar lcog rnying pa phab nas gsar pa 'phyar ༷rtol dang ༷/nga 'acerdzor pas rgyas gasku1la rab gnas byed sku(la gyi phyag bzhes dmigs bsal gnang gi yode 'u/gas la dpag na nges par bden pa dang / de bzhin bod pa brlag thang nas kyang sngon gyi dus sa 'og nas bod kyi ca 232

chas gri chung dang khem su sogs red kyi yod/ thang de'i ming bod pa brlag thang yin shwe zhes rgyal lcam padma bde chen gyi zhal nas kyang dngos su thos shing / de yang dus skabs de tsam la yin par sems so/ / sngon gor khyi rgyal po dang sgro 'byug dharma rā dza mardzo yon 'brel ba'i gtam rgyu da/ ༄ oswa sti sngon tshe rter kṣa rādzadang lo'agrag mi rādzaganyis mchodararigakhu / / ———— 1/// / lha // )//snye / yon 'brel ba'i gtam rgyud kyi gsal 'debs cung zad zhu gsol lags/ de yang 'di skad thos te/ sri sgor kha'i rgyal brgyud la snga ba/ thog mar dar phe sa yab/ de'i sras thur da sa yab/ de'i sras tsha tar sa yab/ de'i sras ram sa yab kyi skabs su/sku mched 'ga' zhig yod pa rnams ma 'chams nas/ nang 'khrug rgyab bzhin yod pa ma tshad/ gdung brgyud kyang med nas/ thugs shin tu ma bde bar yod dus nam zhig na/ rgyal mo'i rmi lam du snyo 'byug dharmā rā dzas kyibs 'jug byas nas/ bla ma zhig zhu sa te dgra sri zhig kyang mnan/ yab yum gnyis gas byin rlabs zhus na/ 'khrugs 5 de yang zhi bar gyur cing / rgyal khams/kun la dbang bsgyur nus pa'i sras rgyun mi chad par 'khrungs yong / 9 zhes lha'i lung bstan byung ba bzhin/ rgyal mos rgyal po la zhus pas/ rgyal po thugs shin hu dgyes nas/ lto 'grag la pho nya brdzangs nas kyibs 'jug zhus shing / bla ma zhu ba'i 'go 'dzugs gnang dus/ 'byug dharmā rā dzo chos rgyal mi 'gyur brtan pa yin pas/ thugs dgyes bzhin bla ma dam chos pad 0 233

chas gri chung dang khem su sogs red kyi yod/ thang de'i ming bod pa brlag thang yin shwe zhes rgyal lcam padma bde chen gyi zhal nas kyang dngos su thos shing / de yang dus skabs de tsam la yin par sems so/ / sngon gor khyi rgyal po dang sgro 'byug dharma rā dza mardzo yon 'brel ba'i gtam rgyu da/ ༄ oswa sti sngon tshe rter kṣa rādzadang lo'agrag mi rādzaganyis mchodararigakhu / / ———— 1/// / lha // )//snye / yon 'brel ba'i gtam rgyud kyi gsal 'debs cung zad zhu gsol lags/ de yang 'di skad thos te/ sri sgor kha'i rgyal brgyud la snga ba/ thog mar dar phe sa yab/ de'i sras thur da sa yab/ de'i sras tsha tar sa yab/ de'i sras ram sa yab kyi skabs su/sku mched 'ga' zhig yod pa rnams ma 'chams nas/ nang 'khrug rgyab bzhin yod pa ma tshad/ gdung brgyud kyang med nas/ thugs shin tu ma bde bar yod dus nam zhig na/ rgyal mo'i rmi lam du snyo 'byug dharmā rā dzas kyibs 'jug byas nas/ bla ma zhig zhu sa te dgra sri zhig kyang mnan/ yab yum gnyis gas byin rlabs zhus na/ 'khrugs 5 de yang zhi bar gyur cing / rgyal khams/kun la dbang bsgyur nus pa'i sras rgyun mi chad par 'khrungs yong / 9 zhes lha'i lung bstan byung ba bzhin/ rgyal mos rgyal po la zhus pas/ rgyal po thugs shin hu dgyes nas/ lto 'grag la pho nya brdzangs nas kyibs 'jug zhus shing / bla ma zhu ba'i 'go 'dzugs gnang dus/ 'byug dharmā rā dzo chos rgyal mi 'gyur brtan pa yin pas/ thugs dgyes bzhin bla ma dam chos pad 0 233

dkar gnang ba gor khor 'byor 'phral du/ dgra sri mnan pas sku mched ma 'chams pa'i 'khrugs pa de'ang 'phral du ski zhing / rgyal po yab yum la byin rlabs rtsadzad pas/ mi ring bar sras gsum 'khrungs pa'i rgyal srid la/ 'gram par sa yab/ de'i sras kyikhrisku sa yab kyi dus su/ tsi rang tsa dgon gyi gtsos nub kyi dgon khang rnams dang / ra khyi na sa ru to'i zhing dang / mgo kri bcad rigs kyi chos khrims sogs gnang ba'i tshul zur du gsal ba ltar yin no/ // yang de'i rjes bla ma dbyangs dpon/ de'i rjes bla ma sum thang chos rje'i skabs/ su/ rgyal po dbyu ta ra sa yab/ de'i sras pri thi pa ti sa yab/ de'i sras ṇa ri sprur pa sa yab kyi skabs su/ bla ma 'gro mgon ngag dbang 'grag rgyal snyo nas gyon skabs su spyod spong dang mnga' ri'i sa mtshams mtshams thum pa che'i rdzong du/ gor khri'i dmag mi ti ling kha pa rnams la/ bod dmag gis bskor te bsad par rtsom tshe bla mas bod dmag rnams la/ gor khyi'i dmag rnams skyon med du ma btang na/ nged gor 'byug gnyis las rgya gcig yin pas/ nam mthug khyod bod rnams brlag nyon che ba yong zer bas/ bod dmag rnams dngangs nas gor dmag ti ling la pa rnams btang ba'i bya ngaga' la/ nā ga tha li dgon pa dang / chetshes khrims bar song rdzogs yul grag zhing gnyis bcas/ bla ma sngon ma'i gsum bshul gang yin gyi mo hor dang yig cha rnams kyi don bzhin/ zangs yig gnang tshul zur du gsal ba ltar yin no/ /yang de nas rgyal po snyi ra bhang ta sa yab/ bla ma ཿtshes grags dkon maḥtsheg de'i rjes bla ma snu sa dbyings/ yang snu sa grags dkon mchodag de'i rjes bla ma zangs dkar blon po/ 0 yang ཿtshes grags dkon mchesgog gi skabs su/ rgyal po la rmis ltas bzang po zhig 234

ris 5) bla ma cesas grags la zhus pa/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ rgyal lams sdo/na la dbang bsgyur nus pa'i sras zhig 'khrungs sku nga ba'i snga ltas su gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal thu the rū sna ren 'khrungs/ de skabs mchod yon dam tshig shin hu gtsang ba'i rten 'brel las/ rgyal po'i mnga' thang je rgyas su 'gro ba'i 'go shar dus su/ rgyal po'i zhal nas// nged la sngar yang de ltar byung ba thams cad/ 'byug dharma rā dza'i bla ma dang chos srung gi mthu las byung ba yin zhing / da rung yang / yam bu'i gling gsum gyi gtsos rgyal lams thams cad dbang du bsdu rtsis yin pas/ bla mas kyang nged kyi dmag rgyab ci dug mdzad da gos shing / yam thu'i gling gsum dbang du 'dus zin pa'i thog nas/ / khyim pa'i rigs rnams rgyal pos dbang rgyu dang / — dgon pa chodas pa sku bcad kyi rigs rnams bla ma la phrul rgyu yin gsungs ba ༄lngeng bsnyun/ bla mas kyang dmag rgyab ci dug mdzad pas/ rgyal lams thams cad dbang du 'dus shing /rgyu nag rgyal po'i do zlar 'gran pa 'di 'du byung dus su/ gong gi zhal bzhes kyi snying po la shar dgon lag dug cig ma gte gas ji gsung bzhin ma byung bar lus pa yin rno/ / yang de yi rjes bla ma phrin las 'grag rgyal gyi skabs su/ 'byug pa'i mnga' 'og gi snyi rdza phya'i rā dza garma rta shing gis lo gcig gi 'thul ba ma rgyab pa'i kyen gyis/ 'byug nas sku tshab btang dus 'khrug pa rgyab kyen gyis lag nyes la thegar/de'i blon po bhu dhu gar ṇa rā dzar bskos nas yod dus su/ rgyal po pri thi sna ren gyis/bla ma rgyal khang la bos nas/ bla ma khyod rang snyor phebs la/ nged kyi rog po dharma rā dza gzhi dar la 'di ltar zhu rogs mdzod/ snyi dza phu'i rā dza bhu dhu garaṇa bo ni g.yog po yin/ g.yog pos rgyal po'i srid mi gnon snyi dza phya'i bhu dhu garaṇas gang rgyab pa'i 235

'thul ba de nged rang gis rgyab chodag pa yin pas/ snyi dza phya de nged la gnang bzhu zer ba'i mo hor gyi rten la/ ha sgo'i yul dang 'phags pa shing kun zhing lnga lhar shing lha mchod pa'i zhing cacas kyi zangs yig rgyab nas thul tshul zur du gsal ba ltar yin no/ /yang de nas rgyal po shing ka spar btab sa yab/ de skabs bla ma rtses pa lhunagrub/ yang bla ma 'phrin las 'grug rgyal gyi skabs su/ rgyal the shing ka spar ta shegs nas sras rā sna bha rnyur sa yab 'o/ gnyis tsam 'o/na pa khri la mnga' gasku la nas skud tshe/rgyal mos bla ma la sri'u gaskusna bcol bas/ rgyal bu bar chad las rgyal ba'i dga' ston gtang rags su tshe ras dang shin dhu ra'i zhing serdzogs gnang ba'i tshul zur du gsal ba ltar yin no/ / yang de'i rjes bla ma bstan 'dzin 'byug rgyal gyi skabs su/ 'bras rdzongs rgyal po sngon 'grag pa'i 'og yin pas/ par skabs ngo log ste bod 'og hu zhugs tshe/lto 'grag nas dmag bcug par thag bcad dus su/ bod kyi rgyal pos 'byug dharma rā dza la nor mang po phul nas/ da 'bras rdzongs pa khyod rang gi 'og la btsugs tshog pa yin dmag ma btang zer ba'i bar la/ 'dir rgyal po rā sna bha dhur sa yab bar du khur mkhan bha rnyur sa yab kyis/ blam bstan 'dzin 'byug rgyal rgyal khang du bos nas/ 'bras rdzongs rgyal pos sngon dus 'byug dharma rā dza chen por ngo log nas/ go rgyal por rgyab bcol byas 'dug par brten/ da yin na nged rang gor 'byug gnyis las rgya gcig pa byas nas/ da lan 'bras rdzongs de nged kyis len rtsis byas/ de'i bar 'bras rdzongs pa'i rgyab lto 'byug nas mi mdzad pa zhig gnang ba zhu lags/ phyis 236

'bras rdzongs nged kyi thob byung na/ khyod la 'di nas mthong smon dang ka la ri gnyis phyal chog pa yin zer ba'i mo hor gnang ba'i don bzhin/ lo gsum song ba dang 'bras rdzongs thob zin 'phral du/ mthong smon dang ka la ri gnyis zangs yig rgyab nas gnang ba yin kyang / mthong smon phyir log byed dgos byung ba'i sa tshab la/ bla ma sgang / 'du 'du sgang / thang zhing sogs kyi sa mtshams bcad de zangs yig dang mo hor rgyab nas gnang ba yin no/ /de nas bla ma mtshams pa'i skru skyes kyi skabs su/ go rakṣa'i dmag mi bod la bcug dus spyid spong rgya mtsho dgu po/ sngar goras rgyal po'i mnga' 'og hu 'dzul/ rjes su ngo log rgyab nas serdzoraṣa dmag mi ku bsad rgyab bsad pa'i rjes su/ sku rakhi'i dmag mi dgang che ba'i stabs kyis spyod spong rgya mtsho dgu'i yul dpon ddhin bdag bcas pa thams cad bzung lcags sgrog rgyab gsod par thag chod tsho/ snyo 'byug pa'i bla mas srog kyibs mdzad btang ba'i phyag mjal tshul la/ spyod 〈snang rgya maces dgu nas bskal pa ma stong par 'o/ ltar bzhin me tog phyal rgyu'i gan rgya dang bcas phul ba lags sku// /yang de'i rjes rgyal pos bla ma rgyal khang du bos nas/ nged kyi bod la dmag btsugs rgyu yin pas/ snyo nas bod pa'i rgyab ma mdzad zer ba'i zhu yig phyal dgos gsungs ba bzhin/ zhu yig phul 'phral lha nas sku tshab che mngags kyis 'dir yodang nas/ bod gangs can de bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde spyod thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas yin pas/ de la dmag btsugs na mthug khyod rang la dga' mo mi cadang zhing /skye 'gro thams cad sdug la spyor mthar/ khyod rang gi rgyal khams de da lta su gang cadag kyang ma yin par/ gnam bskos kyi rgyal po lta thur 'dug pa de/ de 'du byas kyen 237
