ngan pa'i dbang gis/ rgya nag po'i 'og la sgo ra nyen 'ong bas ma mdzad zhus kyang ma gsan par/ therdzod la dmag btsugs pas/ 'o( gsum nas rgya krung thang gi dmag blugs te/ gorakṣa'i tshogs rnams rgyal khab gzhan la bros dgos thug pa dang / snyo 'byug nas bla ma 'phrin las 'byug rgyal dharma rā dza rang gi dung yig shes rab brag mgo ceras rje gnyis btang nas 'khrug bzlums byas pas rgyal khab gzhan la khyodan ma dgos par rgya nag la 'gyal ba rgyab pa'i 'go 'dzugs pa yin no/ /yang de nas bla ma 'phrin las 'grag rgyal/ de'i rjes bla ma sa ma'i skabs su/goraṣā nas a 30ma la dmag lam lto 'grag nas dgos zer ba la/ snyo 'byug dharma rā dza 'byug rnam rgyal gyi thugs dgongs la/ sngon bod la dmag ma rgyab byas kyang ma gsan par rgyab pas byus nyes skusnang ba mthong serdzong kyen gyis thugs cung ma 'khel bar ma btang ba yin pas/ de'i rjes dharma rā dza chodas grags gser khrir 'bod dus/sngon 'byug dharma/ rā dza gzhi dar nas kyi rbhe rdzi phya'i brel ba'i 'phro lus la/ dharma rā dza 'jigs med seng ge'i dus nas kyang brel ba thag ma chod pa'i 'phyo 'thud par sku tshab rgya bla ma zla ba bkra shis btang nas 'phro de ni ci yin med par lus song ba yin no/ /de nas rgyal po snyir bhan rdzu dha snyi ra sa hā/ bla ma ngag dbang nor thu/ de rjes bla ma sangs rgyas nor bu slob 'phral du/ chu mo byu lo'i zla ba lnga pa'i tshos bzhi la mchod rten chen po'i srog shing rnying gog hu song bas 'jig song ba me mo glang lo'i zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu la grub bo/ /de nas bla ma bse da nams rgya mtsho/ rgyal po rā dzin dha ra sa hā/ de rjes bla ma shes rab mchodag ldan/ de rjes dpal ldan dbang po/ de rjes bla ma spyin pa mthar phyin no/ /238

ngan pa'i dbang gis/ rgya nag po'i 'og la sgo ra nyen 'ong bas ma mdzad zhus kyang ma gsan par/ therdzod la dmag btsugs pas/ 'o( gsum nas rgya krung thang gi dmag blugs te/ gorakṣa'i tshogs rnams rgyal khab gzhan la bros dgos thug pa dang / snyo 'byug nas bla ma 'phrin las 'byug rgyal dharma rā dza rang gi dung yig shes rab brag mgo ceras rje gnyis btang nas 'khrug bzlums byas pas rgyal khab gzhan la khyodan ma dgos par rgya nag la 'gyal ba rgyab pa'i 'go 'dzugs pa yin no/ /yang de nas bla ma 'phrin las 'grag rgyal/ de'i rjes bla ma sa ma'i skabs su/goraṣā nas a 30ma la dmag lam lto 'grag nas dgos zer ba la/ snyo 'byug dharma rā dza 'byug rnam rgyal gyi thugs dgongs la/ sngon bod la dmag ma rgyab byas kyang ma gsan par rgyab pas byus nyes skusnang ba mthong serdzong kyen gyis thugs cung ma 'khel bar ma btang ba yin pas/ de'i rjes dharma rā dza chodas grags gser khrir 'bod dus/sngon 'byug dharma/ rā dza gzhi dar nas kyi rbhe rdzi phya'i brel ba'i 'phro lus la/ dharma rā dza 'jigs med seng ge'i dus nas kyang brel ba thag ma chod pa'i 'phyo 'thud par sku tshab rgya bla ma zla ba bkra shis btang nas 'phro de ni ci yin med par lus song ba yin no/ /de nas rgyal po snyir bhan rdzu dha snyi ra sa hā/ bla ma ngag dbang nor thu/ de rjes bla ma sangs rgyas nor bu slob 'phral du/ chu mo byu lo'i zla ba lnga pa'i tshos bzhi la mchod rten chen po'i srog shing rnying gog hu song bas 'jig song ba me mo glang lo'i zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu la grub bo/ /de nas bla ma bse da nams rgya mtsho/ rgyal po rā dzin dha ra sa hā/ de rjes bla ma shes rab mchodag ldan/ de rjes dpal ldan dbang po/ de rjes bla ma spyin pa mthar phyin no/ /238

de'i rjes la bla ma dkyil slob rgyun pa/ de'i rjes la bla ma dkar rgyud dbang phyugadi'i rjes bla ma snang steng pa'i skabs/ de skabs gora'i pa dang bod pa 'chig dus sko dka' blon bshad sgras 'byug nas bla gzim bsod nams don grub spogs 'tshol te lko pa las gor 'grag mchod yon nang 'gyang tsam song te bal po'i mchod rten dang sa gnas rnams mno thang du ma byung ba lus serdzong / ces pa'i gtam rgyud brjed tho deb khrar bkod pa lags skutshe/ / dus rabs bcu bdun pa la sde srid mi 'ashu/ra brtan pa'i skabs lha ra ṣi dang 'byug pa mthi 'brel khu/nga ba nas dpal ldan 'byug pa'i bstan pa spel ba'i phrin las pa/bla ma dam snurmes pad dkar byedan pa la tshusgor ṣi rgyal pe na ran phug pa sa yab kyis dasmo sde nā ga tha li sogs mchod zhing dang mi ser rnams phrul ba zangs yig brkos te phyal ba'i zangs yig gi 'du badza/theg༄nyu/ / su ti shri gi ri rā dza tsa kra tsu rā mā ni ṇa rya rnaste yadi rnag kya dhe gli bīg dā bī ru snye bha li bi rā dzā ma ṇa ma hon ṇa ta shri gri maṇa ma hā rā dza dhi rā dza/ shri shri shri man rna rasgo 'thug pa la sa ha dhe pa nang sa haṃ sa ma ra/ bi rdza ye na maḥ de'i don 'di ltar slo dus snyo pa bla ma nā ga tha rili'i dgon pa ku su bir ti byas te gnang ba yin/ spyin bdag rnams kyis ci khyodags kyis zhabs tog zhu dgos/ bla ma 'di khyod lung pa 'di rnams kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma byas nas gnang ba yin/ spyin bdag thams cad de ring nas thag chod nas lto pa bla mar gnang yod/ mthong mon/ rgol rdzong / ñtsal ling ma/ spa 239

rdzong yul dang zhing gnyis/ dgon pa sgangs/ dga' bde blang / 'di yi yul tsha na dug rnams kyis bla ma'i bka' gang gnang gi zhabs terdzog grub dartse sa/ yang bka' 31ga gnang de na ltar yul tshan 'di rnams nā ga tha li'i bla ma ma gte gas/ bla ma su gang gis kyang rnga dang dril bu bsil mi ཿtsheg nā ga tha li sa bcad sngon tho bla ma padma rdo rje brgyud pa bla ma bstan 'dzin rdo rje yis dbang ba'i sa mtshams gang yin lto pa bla ma la gnang yod/chu 'brug zla tshes la ma hā rā dzo sri ti ṇa ran gyis mchode zhing lang pa gnang ba'i zangs yig don ltar lag 'dzin zur du bkod pa ni/ la khu pa til gong lo ga gnyis la gong mar ro po ni bdun la dza ba gcig chad/ 'og mas ro po ni gsum dang dza ba gcig ko 3 ro po ni gnyis/ rgyan rnyol gong 'og gnyis la gong mar ro po ni bzhi/'og mar ro po ni gsum/ mol he pi ro po ni dug thu sal ro po ni dug bha la la ro po ni phyed dang dgu tsa la thu ro po ni lnga/ bha ku 'o la gong 'og gnyis la ro po ni gsum/ yang bha ku bo la ro po ni gnyis la dza ba gcig chad/ krang sla ro po ni phyed dang gnyis dang e la krol ro po ni gcig ku ṭa phyog ro po ni bzhi/ shing rta bha lu ro po ni baṭi bhang rjed ro po ni phyed dang bzhi/ krang sla ro po ni bzhi/ spang phyog ro po ni bzhi dang sngo shid ro po ni gsum la dza ba gcig chad/ spyim krol ro po ni phyed dang gnyis/ srang sgo'i yul gsham la ko ྅ ko la ro po ni khal gcig dang gnyis/ tsa ti po to la ro po ni khal gceg dang dza ba gcig bo po lang ro po ni bdun/ yong sgom ro po ni brgya dang nyer bzhi dzab gsum/ shing kun gyi sa mtshams la shar la rdo chen khro gnyis/ nā spyim kre la/ nub na lam tshun chad/ byang nas 'a/nga chu nags tshal mched 240

rten phyi nang gi khri shing bcas pa dang / bya rgod phung ri rdza khang dang / shar gyi sa mtshams 'bras shing / tshu( na lam chen/ nub na 'bras zhing yan dang / byang nas 'bus zhing yur ba bcas dang / ha byedar nas zhing ti ru man lung chu yan bcad ༷ sgo sgyung man bcad gnang ba'i zangs yig chen smada'i 'du dza/sa lags se / /sa 'byug zla ba dug pa'i tshes bcu gsum la/ 'o/ kherdzom rā dza ra1dzi mā la rnye bas bla me chos dbyings la 'bras zhing zangs yig dang bcas gnang ba'i zangs yig gi nang don de bzhin/ khra gu la ro po ni nyi dza/ tsa lnga/ sa mtshams rgyal po'i zhing gi nub/ shad /ba la khru bdun brgya dang nyi dza/ tsa drug lha byung la hri brgya dang nyer dug su ga rnye ba'i zhing shar nub la lnga bzhi brgya dang bcu dug lha byung la lnga sum brgya dang go pre ga nub la rdo chen pos mtshams/ byang la gnyis za ra/ shar la gnyis za ra/ lha la snang gis mtshams chodad pa'i ro po ni nyi shu rtsa lnga/ lang sa tshod zhing ro po ni dug shar /ba kyi zheng khru sum brgya dang nyi dza// byung tre khru brgya dang nyi dza// khra gu gi dgon sa bcas gnang ba'i tho chung 'du badza/sa lags/ 'o khom rgyal po ñdzi ma dhe ba klu nad kyis 'dzin pa'i bla ma cerdzos dbyings kyis sman bcerdzos rim ༷ mdzad pas nad las thar ba'i thon 'bul la khra dgu dang rje gu bde ba'i sa bcas gnang ba'i rjes su/ sku ra ṣā rā dza spyi nyi na ran gyis kyang snyo 'byug dharma rā dza la sngar bzhin phul ba'i zangs yig gi 'du badza/sa lags 31/ /zangs yig chen mo'i nang ltar mchod rten chen po mchod pa'i yo byad kyi 'bras zhing sgor shing dang bcas pa yod tho la/ snyi ru dho ro po ni bdun/ dzha ta snying ro po ni gsum/ ti tso ro po ni gsum/ ta ka snyi la ro po ni lnga/ to pa ro po ni bdun/ shwe ru 241

po tsa ro po ni bzhi/ ce rgol ro po ni bzhi/ glo phyed blol ro po ni gsum/ tsho rnyol ko gsum la ro po ni bcu/ sgo dho ro po ni gsum/ dza lang ka ro po ni gcig dza ba yogashi ro po tso ro po ni gnyis/ shing kun nang la ro po ni bdun/ tsa thu ro po ni dgu zlo gnyis/ dhu la ro po ni gnyis/ ko lan kra ro po ni gcig dang dzab gcig yi la lhu khu ro po ni gnyis/ ༄ye ka ma shi ro po ni gnyis/ pā la ro po ni lnga bcu/ lhug khyas ko ro po ni gcig snyi khu yi ti ro po ni phyed dang gnyis/ e ka 'og ro po ni gnyis/ slo gan 'phrog ro po ni gcig rā dza bho ro po ni bdun/ mahā lhu rgol ro po ni gcig dang dza ba gsum/ kyin krol ko ro po ni gnyis/ nā'o ṭi ro po ni phyed dang gnyis/ rdzo khi ropo ni phyed dang gsum/ dham pta ra nyi tsho gnyis la ro po ni phyed dang dgu/ tso sgam ko ro po ni bzhi/ lo ho lo ro po ni gnyis/ ko wa su khu ro po ni gcag e tsa sal ro po ni bzhi/ u tsu 'og ro po ni gcig na 'u logs ro po ni gnyis/ ) ko ro po ni bzhi/chu dro mo'i zhing yod tho zangs yig 'du bshus/ swa sti sri man masno rā dzo spu she ru ka sngon thog lha pa bla ma gyi khyin ca ka zhing de yar mar legs nyes med pa zhing gsum dang / ka lari yul thams cad spyin bdag bi rta byas te dharma rā dza la thul tshar su gang gis kyang slabs gleng med pa thag gcad nas gnang tshar/ yang khyin chu ༷ smad ca ko zhing lo khu nu ltar kritan ma ni ra ni gyis za ba'i zhing de nyi shu phyed dang bzhi yi sa dang / yang dha las bhas bha sha yis za ba'i sri nyi dza/ gsu/ma dang / yang san ta ku mal sa ha gis za ba'i zhing sa nyi sde/ phyed dang bzhi/ yang aṅga sgu zhing sa bsang khang gu ngu gi za ba'i nyi shu lnga yi sa de rnams thams cad snyo pa bla mar gnang tsha ra/ ཿ yang yong rga phya yis sa tshab tu shin dha li nas nyi dza/ bcu bzhi gyi sa bcad nas gnang ba'i 242

rtags bcas pa 0/ 31gatra// /gasnyi shri gi ri rā dza shag kra tsu ra mu ni na ru na ran te ya nu ca di bi bi ta pi ru da bha 'i/ bi rā dza ma nam nu na ta shri mi na mahā rā dza bi rā dza shri shwe mahwa rā dza'i rā na bha /ra sa ha bha dhur bsam shes dza dhe bha nang sa da sa mā ra snyi dza'i nam sngon dus lto 'byug dharma rā dza dang gor khri rgyal po gnyis chu dang cad ma lta thu shin tu mthun 'grog nas 'bras rdzongs rgyal po yi rgyab rten snyo nas ma mdzad zer ba'i zhu rten phyag mjal mthong smo na yul 'di phul ba'i sa tshab hu yul dang zhing gi sa mtshams tir sul sgang ga 'o la nas bzhes pa gtsang chu mtha' nas yar nub khyedrogs/ me 'u/nga 〉sna la chu nas man snyo phyogs/ ༷/la bhal ci gi sa mtshams nas yon tar lngardzo la nas shar khyo dgas/ sa hu ra mi sdod pa'i sa rnying pa bde ba'i rje shing bha ta ra'i ka zhing nas byang phyogs/ sa mtshams de yi nang gi ka la ri yul gyi rigs thams cad mthong smon gyi sa tshab dang /thang zhing gi sa mtshams nas sin du ra'i 'o la bhanadha ri bha men gyi birta dam bhas kyi lo wa nas nub phyogs/ anadha tha ri bo la so dang shinadhu ra'i lam zar thu zur gare la tsa sgang gnyis kyi bar du/ phrang lam nas shar phyogs/ shinadhu ra'i 'o la lung pa dam phag 'o la'i lung pā nas snyo phyogs/ phye snyal byasate song ba'i gzhung lam sin dhu ra'i 'o wa chu lung nas byang phyogs/ de'i sa mtshams nang du yul bla ma sgang 'du 'du sgang ma ta ri de yi sa mtshams nang nai pā la bha men gyi sa 'phyog pa'i nyi shu gsum gyi sa lgo/ bal po nas 'phyog pa'i sa nyi shu gnyis kyi sa dang / yang thang shing a rtso ri ldan par bha la wa gyis za ba'i zhing sa nyi shu gcig gi sa dang / tsodha ti li la cub bzhi gis za ba'i zhing sa nyi dza/ dug gi sa dang / gan (pe sa sa mtshams phag kye tu 'o la nas 243

nub phyogs/ ras gar mu ra ri tu nas shar phyogs/ am rtso ri lhan bar gyi she ba zhing nas snyo phyogs/ gzhung lam ku mal chu nas byang phyogs/ de yi sa mtshams nang du yod pa'i zhing khyon bsdoms zhing lnga dang yul gsum/ de thams cad snyo 'byug dharma rā dza la birta byas te zangs yig rgyab nas thag chod nas phul tshar ba'i zangs yig gis 'du bsde/sa lags sku(/ /sde srid khri rabs bzhi pas bstan srid ji ltar bskyangs tshul ni/༄༄ / / dpon slob dung che sa rje'am rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas ni/ 'byug pa'i gdung brgyud 'khrul med yin te/ 'grag dang ra lung du gdan rabs brgyud pa seng ge mtshan dasdo/ rigs gasnge/ma rnam 'phrul sku1gas su/ grags pa las/ 'jam dpal dbyangs khyi rnam 'phrul 'jam dbyungs ye shes rin chen gyi sras chung ba drang rdo rje rab rgyas/ de'i sras nang so rin chen bzang po/ de'i sras 'byug pa kun legs/de'i sras stod pa khyags nags nang las ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ de'i sras tsho dbang bstan 'dzin yab dang / yum lcang sgang la bla ma'i sras mo dam chodas bstan 'dzin zer ba sngar lo bcu dgu'i skabs nas zhabs dung rin po che'i las rgya mar bzhes te sras resna zhig 'khrung sa par grags kyang gzhan dbang gi kyen las phyos su tshe dbang bstan 'dzin la gnang ba las/ gu ru rin po ches/ rdor gdan mthil nas bstan 'dzin ming can 'byung / / de bzhugs ring la snyo bod yug cig bde/ / zhes 244

lung bstan pa bzhin/ 'byug sgom zhig po'i gdan sa rdor gdan rta mgor spyi lo 1638rab byung 11 sa stag lor ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs/rgyal po khri sredang lde'u btsan gyi rnam 'phrul yin pas lhums su bzhugs dus nas/yab kyi gzigs snang la dge snyen jag pa me len gyis sras sprul sku zhig byon rgyu yin/phrin las thogs med nged kyis sgrub pa'i dam bca' 'bul gyis bdag la rta'i rten 'dzugs shig cis kyang dgos zhes byung ba las/ bde chen phyag hu lha rta dang gsol khu'i rgyun yang 'dzugs par mdzad/ dgung 'o/ lnga la yab gshegs/ dgung 'ordzo brgyad wa grwa tshang du bzhugs/ zhabs dung gis sku phud bzhes te mtshan bstan 'dzin rab rgyas zhes gnang / khyod kyi yab des nga la phan pa chen po byas/ da ngas khyod la drin gno byed dgos pa yod ces gar cig dbyangs se gas zhal khrid zhib rgyas dang /dkar brgyud kyi zab ceras thams cad kyi dbang khrid bka' lung man ngag bum pa gang gyo'i tshul du stsal/ thugs pyi sras su bzung nas sde pa dbu mdzad bstan 'dzin 'byug rgyus la'ang rdor gdan sras thu 'di nged rang gi thu 'jam dpal rdo rje dang mtshungs pa'i gces spus gyis zhes gasnge/ngas/dgung lo 14la zhabs dung thugs dam la zhugs/ zhabs spying rin po che'i phyag rnga'i skad thos pas dun pa'i kyen gyis tshugs thabs ma byung bar gsang spyod kyi rtsig pa'i ngos la shangs kyis dri snom pa dang sa 'dred cing zhal du gsol bar byas/ dgung lo nyer gsum la yum gshegs/ sde srid dbu mdzad gī sa ba ma dpon sle ba snyan grags dbang po las dus 'a'or rtsis sa ris bsgyur bgod sku gas la mkhas par byings/pye nga yig tshe dbang rdo rje dang dpon slob phrin las dpal 'bar sogs las lañtsa wartu 245

sogs yig rigs zhabs dung dang chodas mdzad ngag dbang gsung rab dge slong khams pa sku gas las/ mgos dang gos gtor serdzogs skutshen tan gang la yang legs par byings/ zhabs dung thugs dam zhugs rjes sde srid rtse nga ma gnyis nas lathugs rtse chen pos gnyes par bskyungs pa ma gte gas go gnas gang yang thul mi 'dug/ —sde srid gsum pa ceras rgyal mi 'ashu/ra brtan pa sde srid mdzad ma thag rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas dgung lo 30 'i thog zhabs dung rin po che'i rgyal tshab khri rin po che'i go gnas sde srid rang dang mnyam par phyal 'dug / dgung lo zhe gsum thog dge 'dun ceras 'phel gyis cheras rgyal mi 'gyur brtan pa khri las phab pa na/ grwa tshang dge 'dun dang dpon lag thams cad kyis sde srid mdzad dgos par gasku la ba btab pa bzhin spyi lo 1680 rab byung 11lcags sprel lo zla nya' tshes 13la gser khrir mnga' gasku la mdzad/ khri ston rten 'brel legs 'bul thog mar mkhan rin po che bsod nams 'od zer nas dar dkar nyin mo bde legs kyis sna dungs pa'i 'bul tshan/ dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mcho'i spyi 'thul/ de nas rim bzhin gzhung gi phyag mdzod pa dge 'dun chodas 'phel/ bkra shis che sa rdzong phyag mdzod pa a'u/ dbang 'dus pho brang rdzong bzhugs cog grwa ba bstan 'dzin pad dkar/ rin spungs spyi bla ngag dbang che sa grags/ che sa rtse'i spyi bla nas lung pa shes rab lhun tshib/ dar dkar spyi bla rab brtan/ mgar sa'i rdzong dpon rdo rje dbang rgyal/ gling bzhi rdzong bdag gsol dpon las pa/ rta mgo nas lcam rje btsun dung / stag tshang 'od gsal sgang nagaci dpon slob spyin pa rgyal mtshan/ mchad thang rdo lung nas dnge na sle ba phrin las dpal 'bar/ khu byug la 246

sogs yig rigs zhabs dung dang chodas mdzad ngag dbang gsung rab dge slong khams pa sku gas las/ mgos dang gos gtor serdzogs skutshen tan gang la yang legs par byings/ zhabs dung thugs dam zhugs rjes sde srid rtse nga ma gnyis nas lathugs rtse chen pos gnyes par bskyungs pa ma gte gas go gnas gang yang thul mi 'dug/ —sde srid gsum pa ceras rgyal mi 'ashu/ra brtan pa sde srid mdzad ma thag rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas dgung lo 30 'i thog zhabs dung rin po che'i rgyal tshab khri rin po che'i go gnas sde srid rang dang mnyam par phyal 'dug / dgung lo zhe gsum thog dge 'dun ceras 'phel gyis cheras rgyal mi 'gyur brtan pa khri las phab pa na/ grwa tshang dge 'dun dang dpon lag thams cad kyis sde srid mdzad dgos par gasku la ba btab pa bzhin spyi lo 1680 rab byung 11lcags sprel lo zla nya' tshes 13la gser khrir mnga' gasku la mdzad/ khri ston rten 'brel legs 'bul thog mar mkhan rin po che bsod nams 'od zer nas dar dkar nyin mo bde legs kyis sna dungs pa'i 'bul tshan/ dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mcho'i spyi 'thul/ de nas rim bzhin gzhung gi phyag mdzod pa dge 'dun chodas 'phel/ bkra shis che sa rdzong phyag mdzod pa a'u/ dbang 'dus pho brang rdzong bzhugs cog grwa ba bstan 'dzin pad dkar/ rin spungs spyi bla ngag dbang che sa grags/ che sa rtse'i spyi bla nas lung pa shes rab lhun tshib/ dar dkar spyi bla rab brtan/ mgar sa'i rdzong dpon rdo rje dbang rgyal/ gling bzhi rdzong bdag gsol dpon las pa/ rta mgo nas lcam rje btsun dung / stag tshang 'od gsal sgang nagaci dpon slob spyin pa rgyal mtshan/ mchad thang rdo lung nas dnge na sle ba phrin las dpal 'bar/ khu byug la 246

chos spyong pho brang / glong rdzogs theg chen tshe sa 'khor/ rta lang rme bkra shis 'byug rgyus bcas kyi bla ma sprul ༷/ krenas rab rgyal mtshan/ bum thang cesas brag bla ma dam chos pad dkar/ theg chen rtse nas ye shes dngos grub/ shel tog dgon nas dpon slob 'grug bstan pa/ se ba la rnam rgyal rtse nas rnal 'byor pad dkar/ la steng dgon nas chodas mdzad 'byug kyib khra rdo la skyer nas ceras mdzad ras chung pa/mtshams brag nas ngag dbang rdo rje/ sgang steng gsang sngags ཿtshes gling nas ngag dbang padma lhun grub/ gdong dkar sprul sku ngag dbang shes rab/ smal po'i bla bur nas sprul sku gsang sngags rgyal mtshan/ mda' sterdzong bla brang nas rig 'dzin phyo/ rgyun lga tshogs/ sa kyi spyi bla bakhrod pa rin chen/ —ngor spyi zhing sprul sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ chodas sdings/ ri tshogs/ nas spags te dgon sde gsum gyi chodas rje rnams dang / shar wang bla brang nas mang thos 'jam dbyangs sogs snyo rdzongs 'dir mchis pa bka' brgyud rnying ma sa kyi ngor bcas kyi dgon sde thams cad nas dang /mdor na sman rdzongs rgyal khab kyi chab 'bangs su gtogs pa lha sde mi sde thams cad /sa 'a thul men bgrang bya'i yul las 'das pa'i mchod sprin chen por bstar bar bgyis so/ / bod gangs rdzongs nas dpal sa kyi pa chen po rje kun dga' bkra shis /dbas nas sngerdzon yab mes skusnang ma rnams kyi dus nas sa 'byug phan tshun thugs snang pe ga pa'i 'brel zab mchis pa las snyan tshig gis gsung 31ga dang chabs cig khri ston legs skyes rgya cher 'bul bar bgyis sku / / stod mnga' ris gdan sa gad rdzong nas rgyul po bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal kyis kyang gzim dpon shun gdong dkar po/ mchod da kon phrin las dpal 'bar sogs pho nya ched mngags gdong gser zho stong dang /247

yang gser zho lnga brgya longs pa'i sa thig che ba bcas dang / dngul kram nyis stong /gur gum gyi sgom rtse/ gu gul gyi ltang rtse/ sgyu ru brgya phreng lnga/ shel dkar brgya phreng gsum/ 'dril dkar dmar/ long gi stob dar/ le snam zer phrug sogs 'thul tshan rgya cerdzoms pa phyal/gangs ti si nas rdor 'dzin sku skye dung gis gu ge gnyer pa 'byor ra ched mngags mdun khri 'thul/ gser brgya/ dngul brgya/ gur gum shel dkar dmar sogs brgya/ stod mnga' ris 'byug pa'i grwa rigs su gtogs pa'i mgon sde che phra thams cad nas kyang khri 'bul pho nya 'byor/rgya gha ḍi la nas rā dza pra ma na ran gyi sras mosna ghu na ran gyis gser krang bdun brgya/ dngul krang stong / rgya gos la dog lnga ldan yug ring 'thu ras ras dkar la sku gas dos brgya phrag bcas 'thul mi pho nya ba ha ri sha ba dhar 'byor/ sngon zhabs dung rin po che dang / sde pa la sngon pa'i dus su'ang 'bul sna'i gtso bor 'di slobs par grags/ 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan rgya mtsho nas zhabs brtan shis brjod kyi tshigs bcad bcas khri 'thul rgyas par phyal bar mdzad do/ / de nas dpal ldan 'byug pa'i chab 'bangs su gtogs pa phyogs shar nub kyi yul tshi spyi bye brag gi mi sde dpya khral 'bul gyi grangs tho bzhin/ mi khyim re la dngul krang re ma'i rtsis kyi g.yu dang dngul phor dngul gyi spo long khro zangs rta glang ras zong gi rigs sogs spyin bdag spyir gnang / tsho chen brgyad gyi dpa' tsal pa rnams la rgya chos kyi stod 'gab re gnang nas ched du gzengs bstod mdzad pa sogs lha 'bangs thams cad la khri ston gyi gnang spyin rgya cher mdzad par grags so/ /248

yang gser zho lnga brgya longs pa'i sa thig che ba bcas dang / dngul kram nyis stong /gur gum gyi sgom rtse/ gu gul gyi ltang rtse/ sgyu ru brgya phreng lnga/ shel dkar brgya phreng gsum/ 'dril dkar dmar/ long gi stob dar/ le snam zer phrug sogs 'thul tshan rgya cerdzoms pa phyal/gangs ti si nas rdor 'dzin sku skye dung gis gu ge gnyer pa 'byor ra ched mngags mdun khri 'thul/ gser brgya/ dngul brgya/ gur gum shel dkar dmar sogs brgya/ stod mnga' ris 'byug pa'i grwa rigs su gtogs pa'i mgon sde che phra thams cad nas kyang khri 'bul pho nya 'byor/rgya gha ḍi la nas rā dza pra ma na ran gyi sras mosna ghu na ran gyis gser krang bdun brgya/ dngul krang stong / rgya gos la dog lnga ldan yug ring 'thu ras ras dkar la sku gas dos brgya phrag bcas 'thul mi pho nya ba ha ri sha ba dhar 'byor/ sngon zhabs dung rin po che dang / sde pa la sngon pa'i dus su'ang 'bul sna'i gtso bor 'di slobs par grags/ 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan rgya mtsho nas zhabs brtan shis brjod kyi tshigs bcad bcas khri 'thul rgyas par phyal bar mdzad do/ / de nas dpal ldan 'byug pa'i chab 'bangs su gtogs pa phyogs shar nub kyi yul tshi spyi bye brag gi mi sde dpya khral 'bul gyi grangs tho bzhin/ mi khyim re la dngul krang re ma'i rtsis kyi g.yu dang dngul phor dngul gyi spo long khro zangs rta glang ras zong gi rigs sogs spyin bdag spyir gnang / tsho chen brgyad gyi dpa' tsal pa rnams la rgya chos kyi stod 'gab re gnang nas ched du gzengs bstod mdzad pa sogs lha 'bangs thams cad la khri ston gyi gnang spyin rgya cher mdzad par grags so/ /248

de nas bstan pa'i tsa ba dge 'dun sde dar rgyas kyi dgongs pas sto chen nang skor lhan bdag 'gang che'i rigs nas thu gsum bar ma brgya ste/ra du nye ba'i batsho na khral bsdus te zla lnga pa'i tshes bcur sku phud bzhes te 'dus sder btsugs skusna/ / dbang 'dus pho brang rdzong dpon gnyer pa 'grag bstan 'dzin bskos/ lo nyi shu tham pa spo nga dpon byas kyang skud pa skyu bo zhig kyang zur gsog ma byas par bstan pa bo na snying la bsam pa las tshan gyi mig 〈snas la macesag hu phan pa zhig khu/nga / zhabs drung gi sras 'jam dpal rdo rje'i sras mo mtsho skyes rdo rje 'khrungs/de nas gdung brgyud 'jam dpal rdo rje'i yum khri lcam gos dkar sgrol ma 'di nyid sngar spyi lo 1638 rab byung 11 swās sa stag lo bstan 'dzin rab rgyas rang nyid 3mings pa'i dus nas bod du gyon te 'byor bas phongs la dgra yul du tsho gang bag gzon cad brgyal ngang bce'on 'u/gas sa/ bzhugs pa la ti rub brgya tham pa phyag rtags spye lo 1680 rab byung 11 pa'i lcags sprel lo la u rgyan phran chogs pa phyal du btang /'o pas spung brdzus kyis thabs sgo gang zab kyis sku(nga nas rgyal yum la phyal te gsung phrin rnams zhus pas yum gyi zhal nas/ nged snyo nas bod du yongs skabs 'ong 'khrungs tsam yin ngo mi mkhyen yang zhabs dung rin po che'i thugs zhen gyis gnang ba yin mod/ sngar gyi sde srid na rim sus kyang khab skud tsam gyi rtags kyang med par da lam rje rin po che rgyal tshab hu phebs ma thag bdag la 'di tsam gyi do gal mdzad de gnang ba shin hu bka' drin che zhes phyag thal smad sbyar te spyan chab bcas gsungs tshul 'dir 'byor te zhus 'dug jo shāka rnam gnyis rang byung thugs rje chen po sogs 85 rje ngag dbang lhun tshib kyis mdzad pa'i bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyi rnam thar brgya zhe drug rgyab phreng bzhi pa nas gsal/249

de nas bstan pa'i tsa ba dge 'dun sde dar rgyas kyi dgongs pas sto chen nang skor lhan bdag 'gang che'i rigs nas thu gsum bar ma brgya ste/ra du nye ba'i batsho na khral bsdus te zla lnga pa'i tshes bcur sku phud bzhes te 'dus sder btsugs skusna/ / dbang 'dus pho brang rdzong dpon gnyer pa 'grag bstan 'dzin bskos/ lo nyi shu tham pa spo nga dpon byas kyang skud pa skyu bo zhig kyang zur gsog ma byas par bstan pa bo na snying la bsam pa las tshan gyi mig 〈snas la macesag hu phan pa zhig khu/nga / zhabs drung gi sras 'jam dpal rdo rje'i sras mo mtsho skyes rdo rje 'khrungs/de nas gdung brgyud 'jam dpal rdo rje'i yum khri lcam gos dkar sgrol ma 'di nyid sngar spyi lo 1638 rab byung 11 swās sa stag lo bstan 'dzin rab rgyas rang nyid 3mings pa'i dus nas bod du gyon te 'byor bas phongs la dgra yul du tsho gang bag gzon cad brgyal ngang bce'on 'u/gas sa/ bzhugs pa la ti rub brgya tham pa phyag rtags spye lo 1680 rab byung 11 pa'i lcags sprel lo la u rgyan phran chogs pa phyal du btang /'o pas spung brdzus kyis thabs sgo gang zab kyis sku(nga nas rgyal yum la phyal te gsung phrin rnams zhus pas yum gyi zhal nas/ nged snyo nas bod du yongs skabs 'ong 'khrungs tsam yin ngo mi mkhyen yang zhabs dung rin po che'i thugs zhen gyis gnang ba yin mod/ sngar gyi sde srid na rim sus kyang khab skud tsam gyi rtags kyang med par da lam rje rin po che rgyal tshab hu phebs ma thag bdag la 'di tsam gyi do gal mdzad de gnang ba shin hu bka' drin che zhes phyag thal smad sbyar te spyan chab bcas gsungs tshul 'dir 'byor te zhus 'dug jo shāka rnam gnyis rang byung thugs rje chen po sogs 85 rje ngag dbang lhun tshib kyis mdzad pa'i bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyi rnam thar brgya zhe drug rgyab phreng bzhi pa nas gsal/249

la zhal gser dang snyan dar sku/gas yangayang phyal/spyi lo 1681 rab byung11 pa'i lcags mo bya lor spungs thang rdzong gi gser gyi rgya phebs legs par grub pa'i dga' sde na gyi rab gnas rgyas par gnang / sprul sku pañtsa de wa/ dharma de wa/ dharma shing / la trang de ga rdzi wa shing sogs bal po'i bzo bo rnams gnang spyin gyis yid mgu bar mdzad/ sde srid dbu mdzad kyi sku spur yun ring song ba de yang gong sa'i bkas mkhan chen bsod nams 'od zer lcags rir skru mtshams bzhugs yod pa nas sprur byings mdzad/ yab tshe dbang bstan 'dzin gyi sprul skru yang gtsug phyad bzhes te mtshan mi pham ngag dbang 'byug rgyas zhes gserdzol te 'dus sder btsugs/ spyi lo 1681 rab byung 11 pa'i lcags mo bya lor spa spor gyon tshong 'dus su 'bri g.yag ba glang ra lug phag pa se gas mang po bsad pa'i thang mgor khang brtsegs macerd brten bzhengs/yang shar wa chen ngar wa se gas dbang rdzong cha zhabs dang / ཿtshes rtse'i cha zhabs shar phyogs kyi rgyal po mi sde che dug dang / dgon yul 'brog gling bzhi spa spo tsho chen cad gzhung sogs phyogs so so'i spyin bdag dug sgo sa rigs kyi gces phyug dbang po spyon med gzugs mdzes blo gsal rigs/ btsun khral du 'o/ ltar bsdus te bstan pa'i tsa ba da) 'dun gyi sde dar rgyas mdzad do/ /bo gdong 'chi med sprul sku 'phral kyen zhig gis gdong dkar dpon slob sprul sku la brten/ bkra shis sgang phyogs nas 'dir nged rang 'byug pa la mgo gtad byung bar/ bod gzhung nas chings khrar rdo phog hu mi 'gyur bar 'phral du slog 87 go nga gi 'phyog zhe bdun gyi rgyab gsum pa nas/ 250

dgos yi ge yang yang byung bas/ thabs zab par dgongs chings sna sprel te yum pre ri lto la gyon rgyu dang / bo gdong sprul sku slar slog la spyon med sngar bzhin gdan 'jags yong ba'i chad rdo byas/ yum dung snyo brag sa sbug la nas phebs pa'i snyo rbod sku tshab zhal 'dzom thog nas brje len skabs khri chen po la gdan dungs te/nged rang gi las 'dzin thams cad kyis 'thul tshan chen po phul bas bod pa kun ha la sdo/ par grags/ gong sa bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyi bka' sgo ga don bzhin snu sa rtse spyi blas gtsos kun gyis zhabs nas bteg bzhin dbang 'dus pho brang rdzong du phebs/pye lo 168'arab byung 11 chu khyi lo dpyid kyi dus zla 'di'i tshes la gdan sa sprungs thang rdzo nga du phebs mgyon gnyer rdor legs dang phyag mdzod pa dge 'dun chodas 'phel gyis ka srongs nas bas/sa te gzim chung du bzhugs gral rgyas par gnang / de nas snge srid dang mjal skabs bdag gi bla ma zhabs dung 'jam dpal rdo rje 'khrungs pa'i rgyal yum de gdan sar nam zhig phebs sam snyam pa de bsam the ga babs pa'i skabs 'dir/ thog mnas rten 'brel ma 'chugs par byed dgos gsungs mjal dar rtse lho gnang bar mdzad pa se gas mthong cher mdzad zhag 'ga'i bar nyin rer bzhugs gral rgyas par mdzad/ khri lcam sku sa dkar bye1la ma zhabs dung yab sras gzim 'gag nas phyag 'bul du gyon/ rtse 31da gnyis ka nas na bza' sku gas gyon skyes rgya noms ge stsal/ gong sas yum dung la dar gos gser dngul se gas gang dgos phyag mdzod na sa len rtse ga thugs 'dzangs mdzad mi dgo sa gsungs pas/ 5/ma dung gis nga'i lus pas skyes pa'i thu 'jam dpal rdo rje yin yang drin lan de rje rin po che bstan 'dzin da ba rgyas kyis 'jal ba 'dug nga 'di 'du'i dga' ba dang spyod pa yong zhes ngos 251

dang gzhan du yang yang gsungs par mdzad/ sprul skru mi pham chodas 'phel chu po'i tsha chur phebs pa la chen babs pas ljid kyis shing sdong 'gyel bas spongs re zhig 'das kyen ngan pa'i dbang gis ri de'i bdud btsan gyi 'khor du skyes nas sdug bsngal chen po myong ba gzigs te 'phral du las mgon la bka' bsgos te 'dre srin lus las rnam shes gnas spar mdzad de wang phyogs su skyes skye ba sprin zhing che sa sgor zhugs se / / mi ring par rbhe har gyi rgyal khab nas rā dzas gzim dpon sku tshab la gtong dasku sa tshul gser yig pa byung ba bzhin nor thu dpag bsam khar btang /nub mo gol phyogs nas rā dza da nga rtsis gzhi zhig 'dug par rā dza'i rgyab gnon spa gro'i mgron gnyer bzhi dar mtha' mtshams kyi dasung rags rim dang / brda ling rdzong bzhugs phrin las lhun grub pa dasung bcas bcug pas smad sku la ma hā ku mā ra bal po phyogs la bros/ rgyal po gser gyi byi chung de 'bras rdzongs rgyal por shed bzung byas song bar/ de skasgos brda ling rdzong bzhugs kyis gnas nang pa 'di snga thog 'di zhabs yin yang bar skabs shig nas spyi lding / da lta bod 'og kha gtsang bsgyur song bas 'di phyogs la'ang gcad 'gal che tsam 'dug gong sa'i thugs la yod na tshogs med chodam sla ba'i zhu yig rin mings rdzong bzhugs dang gzim dpon nor thu brgyud de 'byor/de lan bka' sgo ga nged snu sa rje 'byug pas bstan 'gro'i don ma gtogs rang 'dod ched sngar yang phar rtsod rigs gtan nas mdzad pa med/ da skabs dpal ldan 'byug pa stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i dus 'o 'bras rdzongs pa tsam 'dul ba la dka' tshegs med pa dgra gnyen sus kyang shes mod/ 'on kyang 'ong 'og hu tshud ma 252

tshung tsam gyis nged rang 'byug bstan la phan gnod du 'gyur pa spru tsam yang med/sems can bde spyid sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rag las/ de gnas pa bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu gtso/ des na rgyal po phan tshun g.yul 'gyed mtshang 'du dang 'thab rtsod med par rang yul so sor rgyal srid ceras bzhin skyong na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar/ sem sa can gyi bde spyod zhor la 'byung / lhag par gnas nang 'di gu ru rin po chis bal yul chen therdzor bsngags pa'i gnas chen yin pas/ de la dmag las mtshon bshams byas na bstan pa spyi sgos la nges par gnod don med zings kyen 'dun ga31mas ma byed/ ces gsungs/ gu rus rgyal po khri srong ldelnga'i btsan la zhal chems gdams pa/ mnga' thang chetsheg mod zin na chab srid brtan/ / gcad med dgra ru ma 'dzin 'dzam gling rgyal/ / spos thag gzhan la bskrur na chab srid skyel/ / blo sna rang chod zungs shig 'dzam gling rgyal/ / zhes gsungs pa dang mthun/ de nas gong sa bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyis sngon zhabs dung rin po che'i skabs 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan rgya mtshos mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa'i srol btod/ sde pa la sngon pa'i skabs slob dpon kun shes dang ka bcu pas se la bzung / sde pa mi 'gyur brtan pas gtsang mkhan chen gyi dung du wa gin du me lha swa ra sku gas sgra ka la pa dang sdeb spyor rin chen 'byung gnas se gas bslab par btang ba dang / lhag par 'bras yul skyed tshal nas slob dpon dung ram pa kun dga' nor bzang gdan dungs te bshad grwa dar zhing rgyas pa la bar skabs nas nang zings kyen la brten cung zad 'thor ba'i rnam par larig pa da lam dar rgyas shig byed dgos 'dug gsungs/slob dpon rab 'byams/ shākya rab rgyas/ spyin pa rab rgyas/ chodas nyid rdo rje /253

rig 'dzin lhun grub rnams la/ dgo 'dun gyi sde nas dbang dwangs blo gsal thog mar 30 skor bcug pa nas rim pas bcu phrag re yang yang bcug par mdzad de bzhugs gnas kyang zur du bkod/ bde mchodag lha mgon tshos bcu sogs dus mchod kyang bshad pa'i phrin las dar rgyas kyi ched du btsugs par mdzad/ slob dpon rnams la yang bkur bzos sngar las che ru mdzad/ bdag kyen rnams rim pas gong du spar/ gzhung 'dzin tshogs rgyugs phyal mi la mang ja gnang spyin rnam gzhag se gas bkas bcad ye mi mdzad par slob dpon pa tshos ji ltar 'dod zhus bzhin stsal/gzhan yang bka' 'gyur gsung rje ga kun mkhyen pad dkar bka' 'bum rnams klog hu bcug gsung rab kyi spar mang po gsar du bzhengs/ lhag par che 'phrul zla ba'i chos gcig nas bco lnga'i bar rigs lung gi tshogs bshad chen po'i srol btsugs pa se gas mtshan nyid 'chad nyan gyi bshad grwa'i sde shin hu dar rgyas mdzad do/nyin gcig thugs dgongs la gzim khang kun gsal pho brang 'dir sngon bdag gi rje bla ma ngag dbang rnam rgyal yun ring bzhugs te yon thar 'di kun la zhabs mthil gyis yang yang bcags pa'i byin rlabs can la/ da ni thams cad kyis rdog brdzis kyi yul du gyur 'dug ces gzim khang de'i sngar gyi yon thar rnams rten sgrom du bakhrodas te rāsnags ma cung tsam yang 'khyar du ma bcug par me lhar phul gsar pa bting par mdzad/ zhabs kyis reg pa'i in thar la'adi de tsam tsa chen mdzad pa zhabs dung la dad pa ji ltar yod 'dis shes so/ / tsuskre rgya gha ḍi la'i rā dza la blon po kung ku ri dzo ki dhe was ngo rgol byung 'dug pas de'i mdza' sgrig la gzim dpon 88 bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyi rnam thar brgya re gcig gi rgyab nas gsal/254

khang gi thog tu byon nyin dgung phyag legs par bsil te snu sa gos kyi sne mo gnyis nas bzung sgos brtul te pha bka' brgyud kyi bla ma sogs rtsa gsum chodas skyong rnams la gdung sdesags dug pos spyan chab dang bcas te sku ཿtshes nam mkhar lan 'ga' 'phyar bar mdzad pa'i de ma thag 'byug sgra sgrog cing der bzhugs bzhin par char ga babs te mi thams cad dad pa skyes/ dkar spe 'da' zhing nas dbang 'dus lha slo lab hu bzhes pa las sras lcam sring gnyis 'khrungs sku yal bas gdung gi 'dod pa yang lhod par gyur/ 'bras rdzongs a 'dzin gnyis po'i bar gyi mdza' sgrig la rtse mgron gnyer rgyas thang nas zer ba phag ri brgyud 'bras rdzongs su 'gro skabs lto bod gnyis sa mtshams sterdzor nas cung 'grigs min la brten nas ma〈snan gnyer rgya'i thang nas kyis/ lha 'grag pa yang rtsis med bzhugs na bzhugs ran/ de min las mtha' si 'dur 'gyur mi shes zer gtam rbad kham chen po lab 'dug pa sde srid kyis gsan pas mgon khang du gyon te dmod pa dang bden bdar drag po mdzad/ de 'phral spyi lo 1685 rab byung 11 pa'i me glang lo zla 10 par rigator brgyag gnang / bla ma bsod nams cadad zer gzigs snang la khyim pa genyis dang btsun pa gcig mgon lang nang tshud sku nga ba btsun pa slar thon 'aX ba gzigs pa bzhin/ gtor gdan nas la yang rjes gnyis nang du 'gro ba dang gcig phyir song ba 'dug pa bzhin stag lo zla 'apa'i nang mgron gnyer rgyas thang nas 'o rgyal rtser 'grum nad kyis shi 'dug pa'i gtam tshogasan te ceras rkyeXng la gtang rag phyal/ dung yig mkhas dbang bstan pa phrin las pa las blo gsal dbang dwangs lag tsal ldan pa rnams yi ge 〈snab pa'i grwa btsugs te spyi lo 1686 rab byung 11 pa'i me stag lor mthing shog la bka' 'gyur yongs —258

rdzogs gser gyis bris te bzhengs/spyi lo 1687 rab byung nya'ame yos lor mon pa a 'dzin 'di phyogs la mgo gtad byas par brten/ sa chen zhabs dung kun dga' bkra shes/ bkra shis lhun po'i /ga 43/ rtse gdong pa sku ngo / / rgyud shad sku tshab sogs kyis lto bod legs spyor gyi dgongs pa bzhed de a 'dzin phyogs gtogs bcas pa 'byug zhabs dang / gnas /nga spyi lding gi chings bsgrigs/ der dbu rtse'i sku tshab bstan 'dzin nor thu/ spa gro'i spyi bla ngag dbang dpal 'byor/ 'byug rgyal rdzong dpon byams pa smon lam/gzim dpon dar rgyas la sku gas phyag gasku ga brgya skor tsam dang / bod gzhung nas masan gnyer chang khyim pa ngag dbang ble rdzo bzang rgya mtsho/ rgyal rtse'i sde pa rdo dgon pa/ geg ri'i rdzong dpon 'or gnas/ zhal ngo padma sogs brgya skor bcas dbu rtsi mngad do/ / 'o1 der yi/ rgyan tshe ring gar 'chams bslab par btang nas cerdzo pas gzhan las sne gdong rtse pa 'bras gtsang bar brten rig ma bcu dug gi gar 'cham bslabs te slar 'gyor nas chodas rje dpal 'byor sogs la slob ste bku shis chodas rdzong du chos bcu'i skabs dang / spungs rdzong du che 'phrul zla ba'i sgrub chen gyi dus su rig ma bcu rngu ga gi mchod rgyun btsugs par mdzad/ lo der spa spo spyi bla ngag dbang dpal 'byor dgongs pa zhus te bsam gtan pad dkar bste sa/ spyi lo 1688 rab byung nya' sa 'byug lo rgirmir tshes bsnyun rta mgor grang nor thus las bska/dad bgyis te gtsug lag lang zur bcu gnyis the ga gsum pa zla ba gnyis kyi 'ongs su bsgrubs te 'og thog thub pa'i dbang po/ / bar thog 'jig rten dbang 13 bstan 'dzin rab rgyas rnam thar brgya lha lnga'i rgyab nas gsal/ 259

phyug phyag bzhi pa/ steng thog tshe dpag med bcas la zangs nya ga 1 600 dang gser zho dug brgya brgyad/ dngul chu zho bzhi stong nyis brgya las nang rten yang legs par grub/ lams sde dge rgyal po sangs rgyas bstan pas bla ma zhu ba'i pho nya snga 'o/ nas byung ba bzhin/ de lor rigs rus yon tan sogs gang sa nas snu sa rje dpal 'gyor ram byams mgo na ngag dbang rgyal mtshan de nyid 'thos bab hu gzigs te/ zhig gling 2 gi rta mgrin nā ga klu 'dul gyi dbang dang / lha mo dud sol ma'i rjes gnang stsal te/mnga' gsol nas spyi lo 1688 rab byung nya' sa 'byug lor phyag g.yog dgu dang rta drel bco brgyad bcas rdzongs tshi gnang / 93 spya lo 1689 rab byung nya' sa sprul lor hor zla 6pa'i tshos 15la bkra shis chodas rdzong du dpon slob grags pa rgya mcho/ sprul skru 'byug bstan 'dzin/ dpon slob shes rab dbang phyug skutshegs la/ bzang sku sa la dog sna tshogs yug sum brgya lhag pa'i rgyu las/ ston pa'i gos sku mthong grol chen po zhal tshad la bstan 'dzin rab rgyas rang gi phyag lnga dug yod pa skru yongs rdzogs la phyag lnga nga gnyis tshad du longs pa'i g.yas su phyag na padmo dang g.yon du 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs skru brnyan can gyi 'tshem 'dub ma'i mthong grol chen mo 'dub pa'i dbu btsugs/ spyi lo 169༷rab byung 13lcags rta lor sa zla'i nya la pad dkar lhun grub mkhan khrir mnga' gsol//byi brda ling phyogs su 'dam sang rdzong gsar brgyab gnang nas nang rten gu ru'i sku dang zhabs grang gi sku bcas sal/ zhabs grang gi sku 'bag chen smad gser zangs las 93 nyes brgya bcu tham pa'i mdun nas gsal/94 bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyi rnam thar nyis brgya sku drag mdun nas gsal/260

bsgrub pa'i dbu 'dzugs ston mo'ang rgyas par mdzad/ slar yang blo gros kyi nor ldan o rgyan tsho ring bod du gyon nas gar 'cham gyi grags pa che ba'i gong dkar chodas sde nas gtso sor gu ru mtshan brgyad sogs dang / gzhan yang sne gdong rtse'i chos sdo dang /lha lung ཿtshes sde serdzogs nas gar 'chams legs par bslabs shing legs cha badri sa te lus 'gyur dbyangs rta tsa tshig zin bris bris te zla ba brgyad tsam la gu ru mtshan brgyud mtshams gcod/ gtum rngams/ rgyan dug mkha' 'aspo sde lnga / dpa' mo'i rnga 'cham/ ging 'cham bcas legs par mthar phyon par bslabs te gzigs phyal bas shin hu dgyes te sku grang tshe dbang rdo rje sogs la slob tshe rang lugs kyi gar 'cham las kyang zur brgyan te khrigs su bsgrigs/ bkra shis chos rdzong du spyi lo 1690 rab byung 13 lcags rta'i lo la nyin dang po zla ba 8tshes 8la sa 'dul gyi 'cham dang rig ma bcu dug nyin gnyis par mtshams gcod dang gtum rngams dur khrod bdag mo/nyin gsum pa la gu ru mtshan brgyad dang dpa' mo'i rnga 'cham mkha' 'aspyod sde lnga'i mchod dbyangs kyis yid tshims par byas so/ / mkhan chen pad dkar lhun grub kyis dge 'dun rnams rgyun du dkyil che ga 'o na mdzod pa la dkyil 'khor blos bslang zhig byung na bskyed rim la cher phan pa 'dug tshul zhus pas/ rtse nga sas de ga bzhin bsgrub dgos snyam pa sngar nas yi na yang byedas srid kyi brel pa che bas lus serdzong gsungs 'phral du rgyal byed tshal pa bstan pa rgya mtsho rbod du btang / 'ong gis blos bslangs rigs mi 'du ba mang po mjal cha tshad thig tsa bzo bkod sogs yid la nges par mdzad nas 'dir zhus pas/ gser dngul sogs rin chen sna tshogs kyi rgyu las bde mchodag lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor rten 261

dang brten par bcas blos bslang bzhengs par mdzad/ spyi lo 169nyarabasgyung nya'alcags lug lo'i zla 1 tshes 'a la ling ga mnan sreg chur skyur ba'i dmigs rten zam gsar par gnang ba bzhin rjes su zla 5pa'i nang lcags rir mde sa khyedags gnang ba'i skabs mgon khang nang du mdun du bud med na rgan du song ba dngos su thug pa gzigs te grang yig rta mgrin dbang rgyal la nyid kyang zam gsar pa dang sa thags nye zhing yul phyogs gcig pa'i thugs zhin gyis/ khong pa'i gnas tshul brjod na mi dgyes mod zam gsar sras mo da nangs mgo na khang 'dir slobs byung bas 'ong ma thu'i tshe mtha' ltos shig gsungs pa bzhin mi ring bar zam gsar sras mo dang dbang rgyal/ brag skyes phyogs gtogs bcas pa yang rim gyis ming med du sku nga 'dug zam gsar ma thu 'di pas dge 'byug gnyis kyi bar la zings kyen hesnang ba ma zad/ nyam chung gis chen po ngagrar bzung bas phyangs so/ / dus skabs der bod nas sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshe sa khrims yig dngas shel me 'o/nga sku gas su dkar 'grag gi bstan srid spyir rma 'byin par mdzad pa dang / mon dang spo mo ba'i skor nas bar zhugs la yi ge gnang ba don bsdus/ rdzog ci spye lo 1691rab byung 13lcags lug lo la gnang ba/ snyo bod kyi mtshams 'dir sngar yang 'khrugs longs mang tsam byung ba kun kyang bod nas 'dod pa la yan du btang ba'i byed pa ma gtogs nyer len gyi rgyu kyen med pa 'ba' zhig yin pa smos ma dgos/ a 'dzin can slog mi 'os pa'i bden 'brel/ 'bras rdzongs 'di snga thog 'di zhabs yin pa snyo bod sus kyang brjod med yin/ phyos bod nas 'then 95 nyis brgya zhe dasdo/'i mdun nas gsal/262

khyor byas me sprul chings dan du bar pas spyi lding du bzhag 'dug kyang der ma gnas bar spa sim gsar brgyag sku1gas khra 'gal khu/nga bar/ bar pas kyang de gal gnang ma nyan/ de rjes me yos chings khrar yang spyi lding yin par/ chang khyim pa nas a 'bras gzugs gcig hu bod 'og la gtsang du bsgyur ba sogs khra rtsir rdo phog de 'phul byas serdzong ba mi 'gab tshul zhus kyang nyan 'josnag ma khu/nga / slar a 'bras nang ma dan pa la bod nas a 'dzin can bor te zam 'bras sgo bsnyun dmag gis lo pa'i rgyu nor 'ol g.yog phyogs/ mi mang bsad 'o rang bros thar tsam gyis yong lugs de bzhin yon pa nyam chung gi sgyubs byed pa ni dam pa'i spyod tshul yin pas los mdzad/'dzin bcang yang ma byas par btang stoms su bzhag pa la/ bod gzhung rang dang /bar ba che dgu/ bla ma lha pa phag ri rdzong pa sogs so so nas bang phyin bcas thabs sna tshogs kyis 'then thabs 'gugs 'dren ji snyed byas par/ 'di nas bkag 'gegs ma byas kyang 'o pa rang bod kyi gnang sgo la zhen pa gting nas log ste ma nyan par 'u thug pa'i bzhag lugs de bzhin la 'dir gsungs bab yod med thugs gzhig legs par gnang dasku(sa/ 〈sna mdzi ba rnams kyang zam gsar pas ltag gcus ches pa'i yul du sdod thes ma byung tshul sngar nas song ba ltar dang / zam gsar pa 'di ri dog chod kyi sha rgo bdas chad bzhin yin yang bod pas gnya' rengs la btang nas sa mtshams stod len sogs kyang phag ri phyogs dang spu 'gre mi byed par rang dun byas gshis/ spo mo ba tsho dang sngar yang shod 'jags che ba ma byung / 'o pa de gar spyang khu nor bdag hu bcol phyin da dung de bzhin las ma 'das pa gzhir bcas yin/ bod nas mtha' mi'i rngo srung la rang sde rtsa brlag hu song yang ji mi 263

snyam pa yin 'dug par/ 'di nas bzung sprod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan e yod zhib hu dgongs dgos/ phan tshun nas hre ga te sa re gnyis 'dug pa'i char gang 'gab lta bsam yang / bod nas 'o pa ma hre ga na mtha' mir mgo gtad bcol ba'i gtam tshong pa rnams kyi rna lam du'ang rgya nag nas me'i 'phrul shes dang sgo sgo ga thu mgo dkar sku gas sngar ma grags pa bsdigs brngam dzig rdzog mang po yod tshul 'dug pa/de ltar na rang nor sman dang mi zas dug du gzigs te snga phyir phar rtsod ma mdzad cing / de min las 'bras dge sdig mi dgos su thob rtsis pa rang gis rme ga na/ dingasang du rug se gas rgya gar dang 'dris che sa khyad btsan pa bcas gang gsungs sku nga ba gzhir bcas rang byan tshud pa zhig sku nga rgyu 'dug rung / lung bstan sku gas nas mtha' mi'i sna 'dren 'di pa bdud las su 'dug pas dgos don chung bas mi mdzad mod/ don gyi char bod pa'i rdzog gtam dang mon dang spo mo ba'i skor las mi bden bden gyi phebs sgo mang lugs bcas/ 'di ga zhabs dung rin po che yang snyo phyogs spyi dang / rgya gar shar phyogs bhang ga la/ kong rtse snye ha ra'i rgyal khab kun la sku dbang btsan pa'i dgongs pa mtho gshis/ nged gcig pos zos med kyi snyan 'bul 'di 'du 'phral du zhu ga la nus/ de ga macerag zhabs nas babs 'brel dang mthun pa'i gcod rgya ma thub tshe/ bar pa rang yang dngu snyung ba la dka' las mi yong bas re zhig bzur te bod pa'i la rbad kyi 'bro khyab ci 'dur 'gyur gzigs na 'gab 'du bsam pa mkhyen dbyings rin po cher bzhugs pa zhu zhes 'di bzhin gtong bar mdzad do/ /de nas bka'i blon po rnams dang / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes thu che bgres tham sa cad 264

kyis dgongs dbyangs gcig gis gong sa la bstan 'gro'i don du bdag mo bzhes dgos par gse la ba btab pa las/ yum de legs khab tu bsus/ rta mgor spu 'i 1591 rab byung 12 lcags lug zla 6 tshes 11 la lha lcam kun legs kyang sku bltams/spyi lo 169'a rab byung 1'apa'i chu sprel lo zla 3 tshes 10la mthong grol chen po legs par grub pa'i rab gnas kyi chogs dngur rje nyid rang phebs/ mkhan chen bse da rnams 'od zer/ grang phrin las 'byug rgyas bcesas bde ma chodag rab gnas rgyas par mdzad tshe nam mkha' dwangs par 'ja' rim pa snge/ma ldan du thub pa sku(gas mtshan ltas bzang po bcas bzo bo rnams kyang gnang phyin gyis mgu bar mdzad/ rab gnas gnang nas mi ser dmang la mjal la gnang skabs dgon dang snyedad pa'i yul nas rgan slo mig long ba rgyab hu 'khyer te cadangs pa gnyis dad pas mthong grol la phyag 'tshal nas bltas pas mig bye ste mthe nga nas slar 'o/ga dus 'khar ba btsugs te gnyis ka rang gis 'bro nus pa byung 'dug de bzhin du gnas brtan bcu grag rgya nag lugs 'dzem 'dub ma thog tshad chen po yang lo mang po ngang bsrings te legs par grub pa'i rab gnas mdzad/ gzhan yang skurdzong ma'i gdan sa phyedags thams cad du lko pa'i lhakhang dang sku rten rnams zhig gsos mdzad cing dong tir yang rtse rdzong gsar du brgyag ste kri/ rten yang gnang / gdan sa'i bakhrirgag lag lang rnams su gser da ngul gyi mchod chas dang / bzang gos khyad 'phags kyi 'tshems 'dub thang ka rten khebs chotshes ce sa sku gas grangs las 'das pa gsar du bsgrubs par mdzad/ spyi 'o/ 169'a rab byung nya' chu sprel la sprel zla'i tshos 10 dang bsnyun te bkra shis chos rdzong du dge 'dun dug brgya tshang bas gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma brgya mchodad dang tshogs 265

kyi lha khung zhig bzhengs pa'i dgongs gtad mdzad pa bzhin de lor da pon slob grags pa rgya mtshor zhal bkod zhib rgyas su sul te/ spyi 'e1 169'arab byung bcu gnyis chu spyel gyi lo zla ba 1zla mthug tsam nas las 'go btsams te spyi lo 1694 rababyung nya'ashing khyi'i bar du gtsug lag thog gnyis legs par grub ste der 'dzin bdag kyang shākya bstan 'dzin bskos/ mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi sde lo ltar gsung chodag gnang bar 'gyon dgos pa'i rgyun yang btsugs par mdzad gnang 'dug zhu lo 1693rababyung 13pa'i chu bya lor gangs ri'i rdor 'dzin sku grang ngag dbang chos zhaphel/ gad rdzong gdan sar 'brog pa dbu mthod/ glo so chos rdzong du klo bo skru skye 'bro mgon ngag dbang bsam gtan pa rdzongs pa gnang / shu 8kyi nas bstan 'gyur gyi ma dpe blangs te gdan sa gzhung gsum du bri ba'i dbu 'dzugs pa dang / de yi yon la sa kyi'i mchod gzhis sngar gzhung du bzhes pa rnams slar hre ga gnang / spyi lo 1694rab byung nya'akhyi lor srongs thang du dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang ka ring gnyis kyis dbus nas gtegs pa'i ka ba lnga bcu nga dug gi khyon thog gnyis tshon rtsis mdzos par byas pa/ khor yug rdo gcal gyi bde lam yangs pa bkod pa'i khyad par gyis brgyan pa tshogs med du tshib/ de lor sku snyung gzhi thebs te spungs thang du gyon ma thub bkra shis ceras rdzong du lus dgo 'dun grwa byung mkhan chen pad dkar lhun grub la rtsis phul te gdan sar gyon/ gong sa snyun bab shin tu lci ba las su yang mjal la med gshis sku bzhugs med pa'i cal gtam sna snangags bsgrags/ ྅snen gyi skabs shig nor thu'i dung rim rdzong pa bskos te gong sa'i gzim dpon dang rim rdzong 18 sra/ma brgya bcu tham pa'i masdokyin nas gsa'/ 267

pa sbrel ma byas dbang dza/gas che stabs dge 'dun ceras 'phel ma rangs par zhabs dung rtse yum sras sogs dkrogs te spyi lo 1694shing khyi zla ba 10pa'i tshes nya la thitsho rdzong dmag gis bskor te nang zings slong / gong sa bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyis da char yum sras rang gis bstan pa'i 'dzin spyodang thugs 'gan bzhes par spyo ba 'dug na de bzhin rtsis 'bul byed chog nga rang yang rta mgor 'gro chas gyis/ nor su khyod rang yang nged kyi gang zer nyan te 'khor 'bangs mang po'i srog la gnod par 'a//ra ba'i dmag 'thab kyi las ma byed zhes bka' nan dug 〈sna phebs/ 〈snar thu dathe na gasku1ga la shas bcas gsang thabs su 'dre sa par tsams kyang ma thar/ de nas rje btsun grang gis bar du chings bsgrigs te/ rdo mchod rten du bzhag rtsis byas song bar lam bar du bsad 'dug de yang sngar spyi lo 1667rab byung 11me lug la bstan 'dzin rab rgyas mi 'gyur brtan pasal bla ma khri pa brgodas dus dge 'dun ཿtshes 'phel dbang 'dus pho brang rdzong dpon byas te yod pa na bo rang gi phyag g.yog rlud nas nor gya de bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyi zhabs phyo bar phyal 'dug pa phyis su gong gzim dang thim rdzong pa zung 'brel byas dge 'dun chos 'phel rang gi gong du song tshe phrag dog mi bakhrod pa skyes te bsad pa yin nges su 'dug go/de nas mi ring bar gdan sa nas dpon slob sprul sku dang / zhabs drung rtse'i gaskutshel dpon 'grug bkra shis/ sku nga sa'i gzim dpon 'byug rgyal mtshan rnams phyag 'bul la slobs/ rtse yum sras dang sde pa dge 'dun ceras 'phel zhu tshig la/ da lam nang blon gyi byed pa la ma rangs par spyor ba 'di ma byas ka med du song ba ma 99 bstan rab rang gi rnam thar dpag bsam rtse ma sras brgya nyer grag gi mdun nas gsal/268

ba mngags te bkug nas/ dam che sa pad dukar lcags rir ngag dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhabs grang du mjal bar phebs/ sdi'i tshe bka' las/ 'o tshos rje rin po che nyid rang dang po yab mes gong ma nas bzung bla ma rin po che rang gi phrin las pa 'gyur med yin phyir/ nged kyang khyed la re ba yin zhing bstan pa'i 'gan bzhes dgos par 'dug pas de rtsis mdzod ces gsungs/ rje btsun dam chodas pad dkar gyis phyag thal mo sbyar nas/ lags rang gi khyer gas lcetshegs pa zhig yin na bla ma'i bstan pa la gasku zog ga la yod/ khyer gas mi lce gas pa dang / na so cher rgas bsnyun phyag phyir 'gro dka' bas dgongs pa snyed par zhu zhus pas/ da res khyod rang las casgos pa zhig mi 'dug pas thag bcad zin gsungs nas legs par bsngags pa'i mgul dar yang gnang byung bas/ mings thang du byon nas gza' skar dus spyor thun sum tshogs pa la mkhan por mnga' gse la bar mdzad/ bkra shis ceras rdzong du gyon/mi ring bar rgyal sras ngag dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje lcags ri nas phebs/ dam sel gyi kyen dug po las byung ba'i 'gram nag 'thor bu'i rjes cung ma dag pas/ tshor ma'i snyun dug po thebs nas 'phral du sku tshe kyen dbang du gyur/ dge 'dun pa rnams kyang ri gtsang sar phebs dgos byung / spyi lo 1695 rab byung nya' shing phag lor lams sde dge nas byams masku na ngag dbang rgyal mtshan slar bkra shis cheras rjedang du phyag phebs/ khams nas bsnams pa'i gser dngul ja sgam dar skusnas rta drel rgyab dang bcas pa dngos po che phra lhag lus med pa sde srid dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi mdun du 'bul chen gnang nas/ gzhung gi phyag mthod phyo nang thams cad mtshan don 107 byams mgon rnam thar thams cad mkhyen pa'i ro la sna brgya bzhi'i rgyab nas/ 7276

5sko pa'i byams martse na bla ma'i 'bul bas gang bar mdzad ces grags/ de bzhin 'dus tshogs rin po cher yang gser dngul dar gos yug ja sgam dngos spyad dngos gsang gi 'e tshan sgom mtho ba dang / zhal grangs re la dar mji la gang re dang bzang ja'i mang bskol bcas bsnyen bkur gyis mchod par mdzad/ sde srid dge 'dun che sa 'phel gyis sgang steng sprul sku bstan 'dzin legs pa'i don grub kyang dbang 'dus pho sring du gtan dungs te zla ba gsum tsam bzang btson du bzhugs bcug ye da par snang snye/ sdo khrid phyag 43 pa'i khri dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis 'dzin te yod pa'i skabs der/ bdud dang bgegs kyis brlams shing dkrugs pa'i skye bo 'ga' zhig gis g.yo khram byas me ma zad/ sde pa ra nga yang phyogs zhen gyi dbang gis 'bon du 'dzin nas/ rje 'gro ba'i bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi rnge bor bzhugs pa bstan 'dzi na rin po che 'di nyid kyang / dbang rdzong du sadan dungs te zla ba gsum tsam ba/gas dgos par snang / zhes dang / rje nyid rang gi thugs rje lta thus de skabs chos rje rgya gar tog kha ba 'byug rgyal mtshan zer ba rje nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ge de nyid sde pa'i gzim dpon du yod pa'i stabs kyis kyang / g.yon can skye bo'i 'khrul 'khor gyi gaskusna thabs bsdudag cing gzhan mas zhu dbang du mi gsan par sngar yin spigs srol gnang ba byung ngo zhes gsal/ skodzos der bod dbus gtsang gi dpung chen snyor g.yos tshe/ chodas 'khor rab rtse pa'i mi 'go zhig snga 'gros su mtshams pa'i sarasong ba bsad pa'i kyen byas te/ zhes gsal bas/ sde pa dge 'dun cesas 'a1/la 108 rje bstan 'dzin snuras rgyal gyis mdzad pa bstan 'dzin legs pa'i don tshib kyi rnam thar don gsum kṣi rgyab nas/1078 bstan 'dzin legs pa'i don grub rnam thar don dgu'i mdun nas/277

gyi skabs su yang sod dmag 'ong ba 'du/ lha lung thugs sras bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje zhi bar gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs dngul 'bum mchod rten bzhengs sar sprungs thang nas sde srid dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis kyang ti rub nyis brgya dang /dngul por che chung bcu tham pa gnang / sde srid dge 'dun chos 'phel de nyid tshim zhing gzu lum 3 bas de dus dbu mdzad pa rnams kyis gsung tshog cung ma 'grogs pas/ waṃ 1shā dgo 'dun chos 'phel rab hu khros nas tshogs gral gyi mjug hu phebs/rje bla ma nyid kyis gtsos chogs pa bying la btub byung na 'di dang 'di ma btub byung na 'di dang 'di zhes mi 'tshams pa'i bka' dug po stsal/ der yul gnyan po la tshig ngan shor bas sde pa nyid kyi sku bsod la shin hu gnod pa byung / chos rje 'byug pa'i bstan pa'i bsam khur yin zer phrag dog gis phyogs ris chags sdang byas te/nyes med bsad brdungs btson bcug sogs mang ba'i dbang gis lha srung ma mo 'khrugs pa'i ltas su nam mkhar gza' skar mtshan ma ngan pa shar zhing / spyi lo 1696rab gang pa'i me ri lo ngami/ ta/ tshang ngas bsa' 'a ma 'ang ngag po mching pas daX37 1tshokārdo niḥ54 /༄rdorsha / / / dani/ne da/re / rwapes / / la / / / dge 'dun gyi sder spongs chad mang du byung bas sde gcig tu bzhugs thebs ma byung bar phyogs sosor gyes dgos pa sogs 'o brgyal gyi dus ngan pa shar 'dug spyi lo 1698 rab byung nya' pa'i sa stag la gdan sa bkra shis chos rdzong me rkyen gyis 110 rgyal sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i dam chos pad dkar gyi rnam thar yon tan nor su'i 'od kyi dkyila'akhor don gcig gi mdun nas / 111 rje ngag dbang lhun yib nus mdzad pa bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyi rnam thar 'dod pa'i re skong dpag bsam gyi snye ma su ske brgya so gnyis rgyab nas/ 278

'jig pas slar nyams gso sngar bzhin bzhengs par mdzad/ spu lo 1700rababyung nya' ge'i lcags 'byug la byams masku na ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyi 'khrungs khrirmi du bud dme da gcig bag mar se nga ba'i gnyen rtsis las khams mchu thug ste zhal rtse gcod du btang ba na/ sde srid dge 'dun chodas 'phel gyis yang g.yo thabs kyis chodas rje phran chogs pa de'i gral du ma gtesnags bzhin dbang gis bkug ste dam bsgrags chen nge byas shing btson du bcug pa de'i tshe/ yul mi thams cad 'tshogs te mi 'os pa'i bya ba bab bcol 'di 'du btang lha mas su bzhag na/ nam phyags kyi gtan khrims la'ang saso nyen che bas/ 'di ni zhu nan bya bar rigs se zhes nang gros byas te zhu rten bcas chotshes rje la nyes pa med tshul la mthun gyis zhus nge ra ma btang ka med byung yang /mi ring bar chodas rje'i sras po 'byug dar rgyas btson du bzung nas btang ma btub pa dang / yum dang sku mched rnams mtha' 'khob dar dkar yul du spyugs/ nor rdzas rnams thal ba bzhin gte ra/ khang khyim me la bsregs te rmi lam gyi snang ba bzhin bzos zhes gsal/ —sdu/3 skabs der mi 'ga' zhig la sde pas bka' bkyon te srog dang dbral bar btsam tshe/ rje bla ma nyid la thubs zhus pas/ rje nyid gī thugs snying rjes ma bzod pur sde pa'i dung du byon te rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ der sde pa sngar las kyang je khros su song chotshes rje gnas brtan pa rang bzhugs tshugs na legs par bzhugs/ de ltar ma yin pa'i gsung gsungs mang na mgul na 'di slobs ma nga zhes phyag gro'i yu ba nas 11'a byams mgoni ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar thams cad mkhyen pa'i sna la sna brgya brgyad kyi rgyab nas/113 yon tan nor ci'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor don gcig gi rgyab nas/279

bzung ba gnang / zhes shin hu yul gnyan po mkhan chen dam chesnas pad dkar la'ang de ltar byas pa dang / sngar che sa rje mi 'gyur brtan pa dang rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas khri las phab cing nga rgyal dang phrag 〈snag chags sdang gis 'u/gas gnyis kyi khrims che sa bzhin du ma bkyings pa'i las kyi 'bras thu 'phral du smin par snang ste/ sde srid de yis chab srid bskyangs te lo dug song nas bdun pa'i thog sde srid rang gi byed pa rgyu mthun gyi myong bar nges pa'i 'bras thu thog tu babs pa na/ sgruzlo pa'i sku 'byug sgra rgya mtsho dang dpon slob dam che sa pas kyang sde pa dge 'dun chodas 'phel phab pas long rang yang kyen dbang du se nga ba byung 'dug ces gsal ba bzhin /spye 'o/ 1700 rab byung 13 lcags 'byug la sprul sku 'byug grags rgya mtsho dang dpon slob dam chodas pas glo thur du nang 'khrugs chen po g.yos te sde srid dge 'dun chos 'phel macedron khar bkum ste chu la skur/ mi mang nge sku ga dang phral zhes gsal/tsurmirmi can gyi las ngan rwanyabs che bas slar dus 'grigs chen po langs/ sde si/dge 'dun che sa 'phel mtshon gyis bkum/ de nub rje nyid ci yin nam dgongs yar byon/ 'du khang thog hu gyon nas gzigs pas/ 'ong pa rnams mda' mdung rong rongamatshon cha zing zing byed cing zhe sdang gi nga ro chen po sgrog gin 'dug gsungs/ rje'i thugs la 'di bzang po'i bya bar ma srid 'ong pa rnams ci men cig byas 'dug dgongs/ slar gzim cung du byon dar cig bzhugs tsa na/ mi gcig grang du 'ongs nas yar byedan par zhu zhus pas/ rje nyid kyis sus 31ga gsungs pa yin gsungs pas/114 bstan 'dzin legs pa'i don tshib kyi rnam thar rgya gsum mdun nas/ —115 yon tan nor su'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gong gi 'phros don gcig gi rgyab nas/280

rje 'byug grags rgya mtsho'i drang du lags zhus/ sde pa rgan po gar sku nga gsungs/ bo pa srog dang phral zhus pas/ cad na nga mi 'gro thag che da yin/ khyed rang rnam pa cho gang dga' gyis gsungs nas byon du ma 'dod/ dar cig nas dpon hre ba dam che sa byung nas/ rje rin po che da lan sde pa bgres po bya ba de tsam zhig hu thal song bya thabs med/cis kyang yar byon par zhu zhes zhu ba nan gyis phul/ der rje'i thugs dgongs la da lo na phyin pa dug dartse ngas nas dretshon par zhal gyis bzhes/ yar khyodan rje 'byug grags rgya mtsho'i dung du phebs/ der rje nyid kyis khyod rang las rgyu 'bras kyi bdag po byas mi la chos bshad nas khyod rang gi mdzad ngan 'di lta thu'i bya ba 'phral nyid thugs gsum du ma bzang gsungs nas thugs rgyal chen therdzo bzhengs/ 6tshe pa rje 'byug grags rgya ma31sa gtsos sus kyang lan zhu ma nus/ slar gzim chung du phebs/ ring nge ra ma 'o/na pa na dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang bcas bkra shis chodas rdzong du byon/ gsang sngags zab don rbo brang du phyag phebs pa'i tsho sde pa'i phyogs gtogs rnams kyis slar dmag chen po bkyes te 'o pa rje 'grag grags rgya mtshal rgyal sa nas phab/ mi mang po sku ga dang phral cing shar phyogs su byon pa'i sngan lung sgang steng shar grang pa'i gzhis gar bzhugs zhag gnang tshe/ sdig can gyi skye so 'ga'i g.yo 'phrul las dgung lo so bdun spyi lo 1701 rab byung nya' pa'i lcags sprul zla lnga pa'i tshos 19 la kyen dbang du gshegs dgos byung ste spur bying byas shul nas chu mig brdol 'dug dus de'i skabs kyi bya ba ni rtsub 'gyur gyi tshal du lha mayin gyi dmag lhags pa 'ducad/ / rim par rje nyid ke nga dge 'dun brgya'i grangs dang lhan du slar sprungs thang bde chen du phebs/ srog la thug pa 'ga'i kyibs mdzad/ phal cher ni sredag dang 'phral tshar 'dug gsungs/281

dung yig ngag dbang tshe ring rgyal sar basmi sa/ rim par dus ngan de sangs/ dbang 'dus pho brang du sde pa bgres po'i sprur chu nas rnyed pa zhugs la bzhu ba'i phyir rje nyid dge 'dun dang bcas pa phebs/ zhes gsal/den drizhin sde srid dge 'dun snu sa 'phel ba mi sha bda' 'ded kyis mi 'gas mtshon khar bskul te dus kyi che sa nyid du gyur to/ / de nas mi ring bar yang sde srid pa'i phyogs gtogs gī dmag mang po lhags nas ji ltar 'phags skyes pos shākya'i tshe gas ma 'u/sa pa bsad pa'i khrag gi rba blo nga babs pa dang mtshungs pa de ltar gtsug lag khang gi phyo nang kun tu mi ro nyal nyil dang khrag gis gang bar byas kyi bar du bsad cing bcom ste/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi rang mtshangs mngon du gyur par byas/ de nas rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po'i thugs rje'i stobs las 'khrugs long chen po de yang rang zhir song nas/ grang yig ngag dbang tshe ring zhes rnam dpyod yangs pa'i blo nor gyis phyug pa de sde srid kyi khrir 'bod de bde 'jam du gnas par gyur to/ / 116 rgyal sras rtogs brjodi dpag bsam sku ngas 'du'i snyi ma zhe lnga'i rgyab nas/ 28༷

sde srid khri rabs dug pas bstan srid bskyangs tshul/༄cu/ / sde srid phyag mdzod dug pa ngag dbang tsho ring ngam yongs grags la sde pa pre ri yig ni/ dus rabs bcu drag pa'i nang yul dkar sge gong ma nas skru 'khrungs te lung ngu'i dus nas rang bzhin gyis blo gros dang rnam dpyod bkra bas gdan sa chen sgo spungs thang du dge 'dun gyi sder zhugs nas yi ge'i phyo mo dbu can dbu med nas btsams lañtsa dang wartu sku gas yig rigs dang / dag yig za ma te ga dang sum rtags dang snyan ngag sdeb spyor rtsis dkar nag sogs rig pa'i gnas gang la yang legs pur byings shing / gzhan yang 'dus sde chen po'i phyag bzhes gar thig dbyungs gsum sogs mdor na cerdzos srid lugs gnyis kyi shes bya'i gnas gang la yang rang byan chub pus mkhyen rab kyi rtsal marmedzig tu rgyas nas sde srid kyi gser yig pa byas pas dung yig ngag dbang tsho ring zhes yodangs su grags/ rnam dkar gyi phyogs la shin tu thugs rmos che bas ya rabs dam pa'i ndhe da tshul la gnas pa zhig mchis pa de nyid/ cengs rje snagrag pa'i bstan pa la phyag phyo ci 'byedar zhus pa las gzhung nas rim gyis gdan sa ke bang 'dus pho brang gi rdzong dpon go gnas su bskos bzhag gnang ste der bzhugs pa'i skabs/ spungs thang du nang 'khrugs me ltar 'bar ba'i kyen las dge 'dun che sa 'phel 'jig rten phyo ma'i lam du gshegs pa'i mthar/ spyi lo 1701 rababyung nya'alcags sprul lor lha mi srid sde thams cad kyis sde srid dug pa'i khrir mnga' gsol bar ma dzad/ sgang steng sprul sku bstan 'dzin legs pa'i don grub gyis kyang rta gnyis kyis 283

gtsos le tshan bzang po phul 'dug sde srid nyid kyis kyang sprul sku mchodag la thugs mnyes shing sngar rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyi sku thog la gang yod kyi bkur bzos legs serdzol ma nyams par zhus 'dug / de nas mi ring bar rgyal ba'i bstan ga la bya ba las kyi 'khor lo sngar rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas dang de'i sngon chos rgyal la sngon pa bstan 'dzin 'grag grags kyis bzhengs pa'i bka'i 'gyur gser bris ma rdzong mes 'jig skabs me mchod bzhes te med pa la sde srid 'dis bkra shis chos rdzong du maring sgo ga la gser gyis bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs bzhengs 'go btsugs/bka' 'gyur nang gses 'dul ba/ mdo/ rgyud sogs pod ka pa rnams glogs shing gser zangs pa tra ri mo barsha sa legs kyis gasku gas pa dang / tog la sangs rgya sa byang sems kyi snang brnyan gser ston gyis mdzes pa snga na med pa shin tu dngos gtsang zhing mdzes pa bzhengs par mdzad/ gdan sa sprungs thang 'du khang nang du rten gyi gtso bo tshe dpag med kyi snang brnyan gser zangs las grub pa sum thog ma gsar du bzhengs par mdzad pa serdzogs skyes thu dam pa kun gyis bsngags par cadas pa ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad bzang lhur bzhes te rgyal srid chodas bzhin du bskyangs par mdzad/ sngar sde srid dge 'dun snurdzis 'phel gyis byams mgon ngag dbang rgyal mtshan de nyid rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po dngos su mor sprul te gyon pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen byang chub sems dpa' chen po gzhan dang mi 'du ba'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje dang ldan pa chos rje 'grag pa'i bstan pa la shin tu bka' drin can de nyid kyi yab sras bkrongs shing yum dang sku mched gzhan rnams nyes med du yul phud de mtha' 'khob dar dkar du spyugs pas sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa las/ slar rang gi bsnyi gnas su bde 284

bar dbugs 'byin pa ni shin hu bya bar rigs pacad dgongs te mtha' 'khob dar dkar gyi gnas las yum sras rnams yar cadang chodag pa'i bka' sgordzog bzang po sde srid ngag dbang tshe ring gis gnang bar mdzad 'dug //mi la skutshegs pa rnams sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa las dathugs 'byin pa ni bya bar rigs pa'o snyam pas yurme sras rnams rang yul du bde bar cadang che ga pa'i bka' phebs stsal zhing / zhes dang / dga' zhing spro bzhin du lam du zhugs te tshe ngas nas u la bya ba'i sa gnas su 'byor ba na/ lto rdzongs skye dgu'i bsod nams kyis ma theg par chos kyi rgyal po de nyid lo gsum tsam rgyal srid bkyings te spyi lo 1703 rab byung nya' pa'i chu lug lor glo thur du snyun thebs te sku gshegs pa'i khyen las yum sus rnams sa gnas der 'gor zhig ces pa'i yi ge sde srid lnga pa'i phyogs gtogs rnams kyis springs pa las yang der lus sku1 /sde srid 'di yang khri cog yun ma ring bar gshegs pa'i rgyu kyen/ de yang /spyon med yon tan ldan pa mgo nag mi la dkon/ / 'dzer med dung zhing ldem pa tsan dan nags la daskorshan/ / zhes pa ltar/ rgyal sras sprul kri/ sdo/na dga' rgyal mtshan la mi 'tshams pa cung zad bgyis pa'i rgyu kyen gyis yin 'dug shis ri'i mgon khang chen mo la gzigs rtog gnang zhing / der spyan gzigs kyi dar sna tshogs lhab lhub tu dpyangs pa phyag gis g.yengs par/ sde srid pas de 'du ma mdzad ces phyag la 'jus 117 byams mgosnan ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar pa/kya rin chen gyis mdzad pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i re la mosna gya gnyis rgyab nas/118 rgyal sra sa sprul sku'i rtogs brjod shākya rin chen gyis mdzad pa dpag bsam yongs 'du'i snye ma re gnyis mdun nas/285

pas/ thugs mi dgyes pa'i rnam pas spyan chab 31ra tshad pa byung zhing / dam can che sa srung rnams sku lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'bral ba med par bzhugs pas skabs der sde srid pa mgon khang gi nang du la sbub tu 'gyel ba se gas bka' chad kyi rnam pa byung ba ma zad/ rdor 'dzin rgyal po bya ba gnyim po'i bzlas bsnyen dung sgyur lhag nges sku nga ba'i nus ldan gcig mchis pa'i rmi lam du'ang / sde srid pa mi nag po bzhis lag pa rgyab hu bcings nas macerdzon khang du 'khrid pa mis pa bzhin sde srid par zhus te/ bskang bshags sku gas bzlog thabs la 'bad kyang phan pa chen po ma byung ste/ mi ring bar tshe'i 'du byed dor ba'i nyer len du gyur to/ / ji ltar rgyal ba'i sras rnams la/ / cung zad kyang ni brnyas byas kyang / / mar me'i mdangs la dga' ba yis /rgyug pa'i phye ma leb dang mtshungs/ / zhes gsungs 'dug pa dang / des ma tshad yang de nas bdag kyang rje nyid dang mnyam du bkra shis che sa rdzong du phyin/ der yang dbang dang che sa kyi dga' ston gnang bar brtsams pas/ sde pa dung yig gis thabs kyis gnang du ma ster/ de skabs rje nyid kyang thugs snyung ba ltar gyur/ zhes dang /8 16ra bdag gi bsam pa la rje bla ma dang lhan du gnas 'di rang du bsdad na bsam pa der yang sde pas bzhugs su ma ster/ grang nas bdag la khyod rang sdod na sdod de min rje bla ma phar sprungs thang du gyon dgos 'dir bzhugs rgyu mi yong gsungs/ der bdag gis rje bla ma ma bzhugs na bdag kyang mi snge da ces smras nas rim par spungs thang du phyin/ rje bla ma dge 'dun dang bcas pa'ang phebs/ der ring por ma lon pa 119 malan chen dam ཿdzis pad dkar gī rnam thar rgyal sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa skusnan tan nor bu'i'od kyi dkyil 'bor don drug rgyab nas/ 286

na sde pa dung yig pa gshegs/ de'i sprur byings dang yongs su bsngo ba'i rim pa rnams rgyas par gnang / rim par dbu mjo da bsam gtan bstan 'aciran rgyal sar bskos/ zhes gasnge/ngas 'dug pas gsal 'o(/ /sde srid bdun pa'i lo rgyus/ ༄༄/ / sde srid phyag mdzod bdun pa dbu mdzad bsam gtan bstan 'dzin nam dargon dpal 'byor ni/ sku chung ngu'i dus nas gdan sa chen por dge 'dun gyi sder lhag la zhugs/ ceras rje dpal ldan 'byug pa'i ring lugs gī gar thig dbyangs sesgogs yon tan gang la yang the gas pa med par byings/ ceras srid kyi sgrig lam rnam bzhag las cung zad mi 'da' bar the ga tu 'khris pa'i las 'gan rnams gang yang mthar 'khyol bas rim gyis 'dus sde chen por dbu mdzad kyis 'gan bzhes te 'o/ mang du bzhugs/ /lhas der mgon po'i sgrub mace da btsugs par nye dus sde pa dung yig kyang 'das nas/ dbu mdzad dpal 'byor sde pa'i khrir mnga' gse la/ zhes gsal ba bzhin/ sde srid drug pa ngag dbang tshe ring sku gshegs pa'i rgyal tshab hu spya lo 1703rab byung nya' shing sprel lor sde srid bdun par khri mnga' gsol bar mdzad/thugs rgyud zhi zhing snyod pas chags sdang phyogs ris med par mnga' 'bangs kyi sor kun la spyi sloms chen pos bka' khrims dung zhing byams pas bskyangs dang spyong bzhin pas smal po dpon slob pa'i thog sde pa ngag dbang tsho ring sku gshegs te u 130 bstan 'dzin legs pa'i don tshib khyo rnam thar rgya bzhi/ rgyab nas/287

la'i sa gnas su thogs te lus pa'i byams mace na ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyi yum dang sku mched rnams ma thogs par rang yul du gtong zhig ces pa'i bka' sgo ga bka' drin du stsal ba las/ nyes pa med par mtha' 'khob dar dkar gyi yul du spyugs te yun ring mor sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa de rnams rang gi gnas su 'byon che ga pa'i bka' 31ga phebs pa las yum sras rnams phyo/ la nas gyon te dbang 'dus pho brang du 'byor ba na/ byams mgon ngag dbang rgyal mtshan bo thang sdod lung du bzhugs pa nas thugs 'phreng bzhin pas dbang 'dus pho brang rdzong du yum dang mjal bar gyon te yum bgros smad dang legs par mjal ba'i skal bzang byung zhing byams mgon ngag dbang rgyal mtshan dang go/ma sras rnams shin hu thugs dgyes shing ma nyes pa'i nam mtha' nas sangs te rang yul du bde bar bkod 'dug/gzhan yang de'i tshe/ sdi nisgrid kyi khrir dbu mdzad dpal 'byor bzhugs shing /bong dang rdzong dpon pa lhan cig hu gsol pa nan chen pos btab ste rgyal sras gcung rin po che ngag gi dbang phyug gi gdan sa chos gī 'khor lo'i yang rtse'i dgon pa de'i'adren par phebs dgos pa'i zhu ba byung / zhes gsal ba bzhin bstan pa la gzhan dang mi 'du ba'i thugs bskyed rgya che bas shar ko mag 'phung che sa rje ye shes dngos grub yongs 'dzin ngag gi dbang phyug gi gdan sa chos 'khor rtse'i 'dren par bskos ‘/ sogs kyi phyag rjes bzang po yod bzhin/ che sa 'byung byams mgon smon mtha'i phreng bar bstan pa la phan gnod gang yang med kyang 'o/ gsum tsam sku skal 131 zhabs grang phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi dbu bla ye shes dngos yib kyi rtogs brjod beḍūrya'i mchod sdong nyis brgya bcu tham pa'i mdun nas/288

sde srid khri rabs brgyad pas bstan srid bsgyungs tshul dang lha bzang khang gi gapa/la 'khrugs khu/nga ba/ ༄༄ / / sde srid phyag mdzod brgyad pa 'byug rab rgyas ni wang srin mo nas 'khrungs/chung dus nas gdan sa phan tshun du snu sa rje 'grag pa'i sgar lto gral du gtogs te mgar sa'i rdzong gi sha gnyer byas pas dam can sgo mo dang ma thu ltar gyur/ de nas rim gyis gzhung mgron gnyer nas bkra shis chos rdzong gi rdzong dpon go gnas thob 'dug rtsis mkhyen zhing gto bcos byas pas wang pha jo zer/ mi ra'am rgya yod pasasde pa rgya bo yang zer/ sde srid de nyid gī lo rgyus ni/ sde srid dbon dpal 'byor dnga'agrag rab rgyas kyi bar mtshams sa/ rgyal sras sprul sta/ //na dga' tso/la mtshan gyis ཿtshes srid kyi 'gan zung 'brel rje nyid rang nas bzhes dgos byung ba bzhin lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i dge bcu'i bka' khrims btsan pos lhag par bsdams te bzhugs/de yang zhabs dung rin po che zhing phebs pa spyi lo 1651rab byung 11 6gas yos nas 1707rab byung nya' pa'i me phag gi bar sde srid rim byon gyis gsang rgya dam par byas te bzhag pa bzhin da dung snga ra bzhin bzhag na sman sku na che bar ma nga rgyu yin na'ang / rgyal sras ga na pa ti'am kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis spu 'ordzo 1707 rab byung nya' me phag lor gsang rgya brtol bar mdzad 'dug de skabs rim rdzong pa 'byug rab rgyas dang sprungs khyodang pa bstan pa dbang khu/ga gnyis ma mthun par g.yul 'khrug la nye ba'i skabs/ rgyal sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan dge 'dun pa'i tshogs kyi dbus song ge'i khri la phebs te/ rdzong dpon gnyis gral gsham du bkug nas bka' bkyon dug 290

gong ma'i ming pa bkrongs pa zhes zer/ yul tshan gnyis kyi bar bla ma bkrongs pa'i sa gnas der khang bzang mchod rten zhig da lta yang yod/ bla ma zhang gi sku 'du yang gzhal sgang rdzong nang yod cing dus mchod sogs kyang gzhal sgang rdzong der da lta'i bar lo ltar byed rgyu 'dug go/ de yang bla ma zhang de nyid bkrongs dgos pa'i don 'byug rab rgyas pa de nyid sngar nas chags sdang khyedags ris che zhing tshul min gyi bya ba byas pa las bla ma zhang gis sngar rje mkhan po la zhu yig gcig dang thim rdzong pa 'byug rab rgyas la zhu yig gnyig phyal ba 'gyal mkhan gyis nor nas rim rdzong pa la 'bul rgyu rje mkhan po la phul/ rje mkhan po la 'bul rgyu thim rdzong pa la phyal 'dug yi ge de'i nang thim rdzong pas mdzad spyod ngan pa mdzad tshul rnams rje mkhan nge la nang lugs su zhus pa de 3ma rje'ong pa 'byug rab rgyas pa rang nyid kyis dngos su mthong ba'i kyen gyis yin 'dug ces dug sgo sa chu smad dung pa 'gyur med bde chen 'od zer gyi gsung las thos so/ /de sngar rdzong dpon phan tshun ji ltar 'bon pa tsam nas thim rdzong pa 'byug rab rgyas kyis rje nyid kshi yum de la bslus ma mgo g.yog ji snyed byas te/ 'jig rten gyi gtam dper/ snying tshor ma las rtsubs/ la cad mas las 'jam bya ba ltar rje nyid kyi zhabs pad 'degs pa la ngal ba med tshul dang / 'o rang blos 'gol ltos 'gyur rje nyid 'o na yin pas ci mdzad legs par mthong ba dang ci gsungs dang len byed rgyu'i la spyangs snying bton pa 'du ba mang po bshad cing / yum nyid la'ang bdag kyen mthong bzos rje nyid rang dang mnyam pa'i gus btud bcas snying bkus pas/ yum yang thugs 3 na hu khel te rje nyid la re ba'i g.yar ngo bcas zhu ba nan cher phul ba'i 292

'byug sgra rdo rje'i lung byang las/ snga sor lto 'dir lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs kyi sprul pa kun dga'i ming can zhig byung / de rig 'dzin chen po padma'i sprul pa zhig gis rjes su bzung na phrin las mthar phyin rgyu yin te/ bon blon lha bzang klu dpal skye ba zhig gis dang po zhwa ltar 'khur/ bar du gos ltar gyon/ tha mar lham ltar phud ces gsungs pa bzhin/ sde pa pha jo sa mi 'tshams pa du ma byas pa'i kyen gyis/ thugs nges 'byung bcas bkra shis chodas rdzong bla ma lha lang du bcad rgya 'o/ gsum bzhugs skabs thugs spyo shas kyi gsung mgur/ thim yul bkra shis che sa rdzong sa re 'tshubs /rje btsun rnam gnyis ceras kyi dbyings su gshegs/ / ngag dbang kun dgar sdug/ bsngal ci yang byung / / sogs gsungs 'dug spyi lo 1713rab byung nya' pa'i chu sprul 'o/ la rgyal sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan bcad rgya ༷ la nas sprungs thang du khyodzen nas byams masku na ngag dbang rgyal mtshan sku gas la bde marmedzig lha lnga ma serdzogs kyi dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs gnang / sde pa pha jo de nyid tshe sngon son blon lha bzang klu dpal dang gnas rnying rje btsun gyi skye ba blangs pa'i skabs su smon lam btab pa dus su smin te rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po khri las phab ste mi bdag bdag hu re/ bdag po sgo phyir 'don zer ba ltar der bdud blon chos dug hu sdang bas khri las phab ste dbang rdzong du bzhugs su bcug de nas de ga'i maX na gnyer skag rgyal bya ba shin hu ma rungs pa'i thub chodad dang ldan pa zhig mchis pa des rnam pa kun hu 'tshe bar byed cing /gzhung nas kyang bon spru95 ngan pa'i g.yo 'phrul ji snyed pas sku tsho'i 'du byed la bar du gcod par btsams te/ zhabs phyo sgrub pa zhig dang bcas spyi 'o/ 1713rabasgyu nga nya'achu sgrul lo hor zla bcu pa'o/ tshes dgu'i tho rangs khyim bya'i skad dang po 'tsher ba dang 294

'byug sgra rdo rje'i lung byang las/ snga sor lto 'dir lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs kyi sprul pa kun dga'i ming can zhig byung / de rig 'dzin chen po padma'i sprul pa zhig gis rjes su bzung na phrin las mthar phyin rgyu yin te/ bon blon lha bzang klu dpal skye ba zhig gis dang po zhwa ltar 'khur/ bar du gos ltar gyon/ tha mar lham ltar phud ces gsungs pa bzhin/ sde pa pha jo sa mi 'tshams pa du ma byas pa'i kyen gyis/ thugs nges 'byung bcas bkra shis chodas rdzong bla ma lha lang du bcad rgya 'o/ gsum bzhugs skabs thugs spyo shas kyi gsung mgur/ thim yul bkra shis che sa rdzong sa re 'tshubs /rje btsun rnam gnyis ceras kyi dbyings su gshegs/ / ngag dbang kun dgar sdug/ bsngal ci yang byung / / sogs gsungs 'dug spyi lo 1713rab byung nya' pa'i chu sprul 'o/ la rgyal sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan bcad rgya ༷ la nas sprungs thang du khyodzen nas byams masku na ngag dbang rgyal mtshan sku gas la bde marmedzig lha lnga ma serdzogs kyi dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs gnang / sde pa pha jo de nyid tshe sngon son blon lha bzang klu dpal dang gnas rnying rje btsun gyi skye ba blangs pa'i skabs su smon lam btab pa dus su smin te rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po khri las phab ste mi bdag bdag hu re/ bdag po sgo phyir 'don zer ba ltar der bdud blon chos dug hu sdang bas khri las phab ste dbang rdzong du bzhugs su bcug de nas de ga'i maX na gnyer skag rgyal bya ba shin hu ma rungs pa'i thub chodad dang ldan pa zhig mchis pa des rnam pa kun hu 'tshe bar byed cing /gzhung nas kyang bon spru95 ngan pa'i g.yo 'phrul ji snyed pas sku tsho'i 'du byed la bar du gcod par btsams te/ zhabs phyo sgrub pa zhig dang bcas spyi 'o/ 1713rabasgyu nga nya'achu sgrul lo hor zla bcu pa'o/ tshes dgu'i tho rangs khyim bya'i skad dang po 'tsher ba dang 294

bsnyun/ lha'i bu kyi rengs snying rje chen po'i mdangs kyis lam gsal kha bzhin du gyur pa'i tsho/ sus kyang ma tshor bar pho brang gi phyi sgo chen po nas thon te gshegs par mdzad do/ / sngar dar zab kyi 'bol stan la goms pa'i zhabs mthil padma ltar 'jam pa de nyid sa rdo'i rdul rtsub pa dang ldan pa'i lam du zhugs te na bza' dang zhabs chas sogs kyi rkyen tsam yang bsnams pa ma byung bas shin tu casna brgyal bzhin par chu klung dwangs chu'i rgya rab zam pa bya ba nas thon te phebs/ sgang 'bur zhig na lam mdo bya ba'i yul chung zhig mchis pa der phebs pa na nam langs byung bas/ de nyin de ga'i tshal gsob kyi gsang lam zhig tu yib nas bzhugs shing / de nas nam skusnas pa dang bstun snyo phyogs kyi ri bo shin hu rtsub pa/ nags tshal gyi mun pa snyug po dang ldan pa lam mi mnyam zhing rderdzog pa zhig nas yar phebs pas/ rgyus med kyi sa la 'dris me da kyis 'khyams pa'i dbang gis/ res 'ga' ni 'gyel/ res 'ga' ni sbub/ de'i tshedamus long byung thang la 'khyams pa ltar gyur pas shin tu casgo brgyal ba byung zhing / ri rtse mtshon cha gzings pa ltar 'dug pa der brag thug la byang bstan zhig na zla skor tsam bzhugs/ de nas rnam rgyal gling bya ba'i dben par dgo slong ngag dbang spyin pa'i rtsar gyon te bzhugs/ de nas ri nags bya ba'i bsti gnas su phebs pa na/ 'brog pa dag gis mthong ste dbang rdzong du bya btang bas/ mgron gnyer skag rgyal bya bas gtsos pa'i dmag mang po ltags te/ gar song rjes snyegs sha ba khyis 'ded kyi tshul btsal zhing /zungs shig chings shig ma btang zhig bya ba la sku1gas pa'i sgu 'jigs 'jigs su sgrog pas nags tshal thams cad 'gongs par myul te/ ma shi bar do'i snang tshul shin tu 'jigs gas mtha' bskor te de dag gis zin nas/ dmyal srung 295
