rnams kyis dmyal ba pa la/ bya ba ltar gshed che'i tshogs kyis brgodar te gyang sar byu ba'i gzhis su phebs te/ zhabs phyo sgrub pa ba de dmar gasku da du btang / mgron gnyer skag rgyal gdug pa can des mi mang gi dbus su rje nyid la brnyas pa chen po'i sgo nas dma' phab cing gshe ba dang spyo ba dang / bsdigs pa dang ngan brjod sna chogs gtong bar byed do/ / de nas g.yung dung spyod byu ba'i gtsug lag khang du tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas phebs te sku srung ba thub chod rnams la gnyer du gtad nas mgron gnyer dmag dang bcas pa log rje'i zhal sle ba dgo sle nga ngag dbang dar rgyas byu ba mtshams grol te mjal du byung / bla ma rin po che gdan sar mi bzhugs par ri khrod du gshegs pa ci tsug lags zhus pas/ dam nyams pha jo yin mod gsungs/ da lta rang dmyal bar spyi'u tshugs su se nga nges pa la ma se nga ba ci 'du zhig yin nam zhus pas/ rje'i bka' las/ las kyi rnam smin bslu mi srid pa yin/ sngon zhabs dung rin po che nas gnas rnying pa tsho thabs kyis dengs par mdzad pa'i skabs/ gnas rnying rje btsun mas smon lam 'o/ga pa btab pa'i mthu smin pa yin/ rje btsun ma de'i skye ba pha jo 'ong pa yin/ tsho'i 'phen pa ni ma rdzogs/ rta sgrul gnyis kyi bar na 'gal khyen chen po zhig yodang / bkod pa'i las la bros pas mi thar bya ba yin pas thabs med gas/ngas/ ༷/ ༷/nga pa gdug pa can de 〉pyos chab la gserdzol ngan btab nas zhus pas snyun tshab shin hu che ba'i thog slar yang brtsegs nas dungs pas/ hor lugs sprul lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshos nyer bdun/ nyi ldog la lo 'pho ba'i lugs brtsi na rta lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyer bdun/ spyi lo 1713rab byung nya'apa'i sprul lam rta lo zla nya'apa'i 'a7 la mtshan dpe'i me tog rkyen ngan dug po' sad kyis bcom ste dgongs pa 296

mya ngan las 'das 'dug sku/ /spyo lo 1714 rab byung nya'apa'i shing rta lo zla 3pa'i tshes 'a0pa'i nyin gcig la sa g.yos lan 15 byung ba mi ring bar zla brgyad pa'i nang bod nas sog po lha bzang khang gi dmag 'grigs 'byung ba'i snga ltas su gyur/ de yang se ga po lha bzang khang gi dmag 'o/nga dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / shar rta wang gi dge lugs pa'i dgon pa dang / 'byug pa nang ma gshin pa'i rkyen las the da la dga' ldan the brang par rta wang pas rgyab dasung zhus pa las/ bod rgyal po lha bzang lang gis 'dir sde srid 'byug rab rgyas la yi ge 'di ltar btang 'dugabasod nams kyi dpung pas mtho ba'i snyo phyogs kyi rgyal po chen po gang gis mnyan par 'os pa'i tshig bsnyad pa 'di la dang ba ston cig phyogs de'i yul 'khor gang yin pa de ni khyod nyid kyis longs spyod par 'os pa/ skyong bar 'os pa yin gyi/ bdag cag gis phrag dog pa dang 'gran zla yod pa mi bzod pa'i sems med do/ / cadan tang skye so phra ma mkhan 'ga' zhig gis dbyen bce sa te rgyu chung ngu la/ 'bras gya mi dge ba chen por 'gyur pa'i rjes su 'jug pa ni gnas ma yin no/ / gal te dpung gi spyor ba rtsom par 'gyur na ni skye dgu kun la bde bas phongs pa/ nyam nga ba/ mi bzod pa'i gdung ba nyams su myong zhing / de'i rnam par smin pa ni/ sa'i khams la ma yin/chu'i lams la ma yin/ rlung dang me'i lams la ma yin te byed pa po shāmi cag gnyis la smin pas 'chi 'phe sa nas/ mtshams med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen snga ra skye bar gdon mi za bas de'i slad du phrag dog pa'i bsam pa spangs te/ nangs kyi dus na bod rje sangs rgyas rgya mchos ji ltar bcas pa 'i gtan chings ri mor 'bod par byas pa 297

de'i don nyams su blangs na kun hu dge bar mi 'gyur grang / gal te de las ldog par spyod na ngas yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa'i dgang gi tshogs grangs kyis mi langs pa mig mi bakhrod pa'i tshogs nye bar bshams te yul 'khor de brlag par byas/ ming gi lhag mar byas na khyod cag nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes bya ba bsrings 'duga'adi'i lan du 'di nas sde srid 'byug rab rgyas pas 'di ltar btang 'dug slong gol gyi rgyal po gang gis bdag cag la bsnyad par byas pa'i tshig gang dang gang yin pa thos shing / don blo la nges par byas shing brtags na/ gna' bo'i dus ring slo zhig nas nge da rje gzhan 'khyodar phran 6)gas la phrag dog pa ma rungs pa du mas bdag cag la yang nas yang du g.yul bshams shing rtse la bar byas/ stesnabs dang nus mthu ci skutshed pas glags bltas pa mang mod kyi/ khyod cag rgyal bar gyur pa'i gtam gleng bar mtshes pa 'ga' yang mchisasam/ dper na sre ga chags phra mo bal 'dab kyi rgya la 'thums pa rang gi yan lag thams cad bskyod de stobs ci yod pa dang / tsal ci yod pas g.yo bar byas kyang rang nyid ngal zhing sdug bsngal bar 'ching byed tsam du zad kyi/ bal 'dab la gnod par 'gyur ba'i go skabs yod dam/ khyod kyis 'gro ba rnams la snying rje rje ltar gyi tshig hu smras pa'ang thos par gyur te/ de yang 'dab chags gtum po khra zhes bya ba dang / gcan gzan mi bzad pa spyang ki'i snying rje dang rjes su mthun pa'i snying rje mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ma yin no/ /de'i slad mong gol gyi rgyal po gang khyod dpung gi gtso bor 'dong pa tsam du cha ma 'tshal gyi/ 'jig rten na mthu che ba tshangs pa dang / dbang po dang / dug po dang / gzhon nu gdong dug dang /thags bzang ris la skurdzogs pa ra mdar sbran nas 'di na rtse la bar lhags na'ang sgyur 298

mdzad ma hā ka las 'a/nga du bstan pa'i 5/la na ྅༷da pa bdag cag 'u/sa kyi ba spru phra 3sna tsam g.yo ba'ang mi rung na ci dga' ba gyos shig ces pa'i yi ge bod kyi rgyal po'i phyag tu 〈snan nas ༷ sa 'tshigs rab hu 'chigs te dpral ba na dpral rtsa gas/ma gyen du 'greng zhing / phyag la bgo ba'i gos dasung pa'i bar du res mos kyis brdzes bzhin par myur bar dpung gi tshogs chen po snyo phyogs su bgrod par bskul te spya lo 1714thab byung nya' shing rta lo zla brgyad par spa gro'i phyogs su lha bzang khang rang nyid dang bcas pa'i dasung gi tshogs dang / bum thang gi phyogs su tha'i ji dang / er khe da'i ching / bum thang pa gsum dang bcas pa'i dgang tshogs chen po dang / shar phyogs su bā ring tha'i ji dang / lha rigs kyi sa spyong ba dang 'o bo'i skyed bdag dang / zur khang gu yang la sha khar grags pa dang bcas pa'i dgang cesags chen nge rnams dus gcig hu lhags so/ / sum thang phyogs kyi dpung rnams mon la dkar chung brgal nas shing sgo ltag gyong zhes pa'i sar 'thab mo lag sprod de mi mang po shi mes byung / de nas rim ges bod dmag rnams bya dkar du slebs/ nyin mang pe 'i bar dmag rgyab kyang bya da kur rdzong de shin hu btsan pas glags ma rnyed cing bod kyi dpa' rtul dong spe rab brtan dang dge bsnyen bya ba sku gas mang po bsad/ 'byug pa'i dmag mi yang mang po bsad/ yul spong gi khang khyim mang po me la bsregs shing rgyu nor 'phyog bcom dang zhing gi 'o/ thog 'jo mas pa sku gas mnga' 'bangs rnams sdug bsngal mi bzad pas mnar ba'i skabs der/ sde srid 'byug rab rgyas kyis lcags ri'i martse na khang chen por sems dpa' chen po ngag dbang pad dkar rdo rje chodas skyong rnams la bskang ba phrin brtsol gnad smin gnang du bcug pas/ dpal 'byug pa'i rdo rje ཿwas spyong rnams 299

kyi mthu tsal nus pa dang / sgang steng sprul sku bstan 'dzin legs pa'i don grub kyis kyang bka' brgyad kyi gtor bzlog chen po 'phangs pa sogs kyi mthu nus kyis dmag dgang rnams 'byug pa'i bstan srid la gcad 'gal chen po gang yang ma byung bar slar mtsheg 'dug /de skabs byams mgo na ngag dbang rgyal mtshan spa 〈snar rin sprungs spyi bla bskos te re zhig bzhugs/spyi lo 171parab byung nya'ashing lug la dbang 'dus rtse'am zab don lhun rtse gsar pa bzhengs te nang rten thub pa'i dbang po sman 'jim las grub pa nyis thog ma dang /bye ba mchodad rten/ tsan dan gyi bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad sogs rten gsum ngo mtshar ba mang po bzhengs/ gasku la 'debs 'thum gter/ lhan skyes dung sgyur sogs rnam dkar gyi bya ba rgya che bar mdzad/ gsung rab kyi par yang mang du bsgrubs/zab don lhun rtser 'dus tshogs rin po che gdan dungs te phyag 'gyed dngul gyi me togather rnams kyi sku ceras re dang bzhugs gdan lugs pags re phrul te bsten bkur phran sa/ma 31gas pa sdo/sa/rabs chad bsdu ba zhes sngon bu med pa'i ris kyi yul gzhi rnams dpon gyis bsdu srol yod pa de yang sde srid 'dis bsdu ma dgos par bcad de la bzhi lto'i chab 'bangs kun la byams skyong dang / dngul ma ṭa re ma'i gnang spyin sogs mchod spyin gyi dge ba yang byas 'dug rgya gar mug dza/ dha dang / snya ḍi kha'i mnga' ris su khyo ga shi ba'i chung ma rnams khyo ga'i ro dang mnyam du bsreg srol 'dug pa de yang sde srid 'dis rgyun bcad par mdzad/ de skabs byams maskusnan ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyis bskul pa bzhin/ ceras khrims dge bcu'i rnam gzhag rgyas par phye ba'i bka'i khrims 3(5)

yig gsar pa bkode drung sgrig lam bsdams pas mnga' 'bangs rnams 'phral yun gyi bde ba la bkod par yang mdzad 'dug /de nas mi ring bar spyi lo 1717 rab byung nya'apa'i me bya lor sog po 'jong ga tshe ring don tshib kyi dmag dasung chen po bod dbus gtsang du lhags te rgyal po lha bzang thang bkrongs nas lha sar dbang bsgyur pa na/ snyo rdzongs 'dir yang yong nyen che ba'i bzlog thabs la sde srid 'grag rab rgyas kyis sgang steng sprul skru bstan 'dzin legs pa'i don tshib sprungs thang du gdan dungs te bka' brgyad kyi gtor bzlog dang /gshin rje dregs 'alngardzoms kyi mnan bsregs 'phangs gsum 'dun bshig dmag bzlog la sogs pa'i skru rim rgyas par mdzad/ mtha' dmag gi la gnon du sum thang sku rjes su bdud 'dul mchode rten bzhings te rab gnas mdzad pa las/ mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i nus mthu 'phral du byung / lhag par sprungs thang du bka' brgyad kyi gtor bzlog gnang dus gtor ma las me 'bar te dar mo che'i rtser son zhing / me zil 'phyo ba dang bcas dgra'i phyogs su song ba kun gyis mthong ste sde srid kyi snyan lam du son pas/ sde pa thugs shin hu dgyes nas rta gcig dang legs la khri'i gzhi dang chu 'thag rnams kyang gtang rag tu phul 'dug bstan srid la sman pa'i mdzad pa gzhan yang bkra shis ceras rdzong du tshe dpag med gser zangs las grub pa dang /bka' 'gyur kyi pod du bzhengs/de ltar sde srid 'byug rab rgyas 'dis spyi lo 1707 rab byung nya' me phag nas 1719 sa phag gi bar lo nya' bstan srid bskyangs te de nas sde srid rang gi tsha so dge bshes ngag dbang rgya mtsho sde srid bskos te/ 'grag rab rgyas 'o rang dbang 'dus 301

yig gsar pa bkode drung sgrig lam bsdams pas mnga' 'bangs rnams 'phral yun gyi bde ba la bkod par yang mdzad 'dug /de nas mi ring bar spyi lo 1717 rab byung nya'apa'i me bya lor sog po 'jong ga tshe ring don tshib kyi dmag dasung chen po bod dbus gtsang du lhags te rgyal po lha bzang thang bkrongs nas lha sar dbang bsgyur pa na/ snyo rdzongs 'dir yang yong nyen che ba'i bzlog thabs la sde srid 'grag rab rgyas kyis sgang steng sprul skru bstan 'dzin legs pa'i don tshib sprungs thang du gdan dungs te bka' brgyad kyi gtor bzlog dang /gshin rje dregs 'alngardzoms kyi mnan bsregs 'phangs gsum 'dun bshig dmag bzlog la sogs pa'i skru rim rgyas par mdzad/ mtha' dmag gi la gnon du sum thang sku rjes su bdud 'dul mchode rten bzhings te rab gnas mdzad pa las/ mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i nus mthu 'phral du byung / lhag par sprungs thang du bka' brgyad kyi gtor bzlog gnang dus gtor ma las me 'bar te dar mo che'i rtser son zhing / me zil 'phyo ba dang bcas dgra'i phyogs su song ba kun gyis mthong ste sde srid kyi snyan lam du son pas/ sde pa thugs shin hu dgyes nas rta gcig dang legs la khri'i gzhi dang chu 'thag rnams kyang gtang rag tu phul 'dug bstan srid la sman pa'i mdzad pa gzhan yang bkra shis ceras rdzong du tshe dpag med gser zangs las grub pa dang /bka' 'gyur kyi pod du bzhengs/de ltar sde srid 'byug rab rgyas 'dis spyi lo 1707 rab byung nya' me phag nas 1719 sa phag gi bar lo nya' bstan srid bskyangs te de nas sde srid rang gi tsha so dge bshes ngag dbang rgya mtsho sde srid bskos te/ 'grag rab rgyas 'o rang dbang 'dus 301

rtser zur bzhugs mdzad kyang srid don la the byus mdzad de sngar rgyal sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan la 'gras pa'i zhe nad kyis sde srid dgu pa ngag dbang rgya mtshe 'i skabs su yang rgyal sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi yang srid 'jigs med nor ga mang sde bon khris su gong sa mi pham dbang po'i gcung por 'khrungs pa de/ sde srid khri pa ngag dbang rgya mtsho dang dge 'dun dmang gis gzhung du gdan 'dren mdzad pa la/ sde srid bgres pa 'byug rab rgyas kyis ngan gathegams sna tsherags byas pa'i rkyen las sngar rgyal sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi grwa bu sle ba mang po yod pa de thams cad ma rangs par go bgos mtshon cha thogs te/ sde srid bgres pa'i steng dmag rgyab ste zing 'khrugs chen po langs/ sde srid bgres pas bod rgyal bsod nams stobs rgyas la mgo gtad zhu ba'i yi go btang 'dug bod rgyal nas/ sngar khyod rang sde srid kyi khrir bzhugs dus nga'i gong ma lha bzang khang la ngo rgol gyi yi ge phul nas g.yul bshams pa yin yang /da ni dgra mchan tshesag 'jug pa thu bas gces/ zer ba'i dpe bzhin dus la babs par gda' bas/ khyod kyi spogs ram 'di nas mdzad cadang zhes pa'i bka' sgo ga gnang yod tshul bshad kyi 'dug mod kyang / bka' shog 'dir ma 'byor gong dgun thog der dbang 'dus rtse'i rgya phibs kshi tog rlung gis khyer ba sogs bzlog tu med pa'i mi shis pa'i mtshan ma ngan pa mang pe khu/nga ba bzhin/ mi ring bar sems can rnams kyis myong bar nges pa'i las de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag gis kyang zlog hu med pa lta bus spungs thang du sde gzar chen po langs/ bka' blon phal cher gro khar bkum/thim gzhung du'ang dmag dasung chen po lhags par brten/ sde srid bgres po 'byug rab gyes nyid rje phyogs las rnam rgyal dang bcas pa bkra shis snu sa rdzong du gyon/ der 302

dmag 'jigs la brten pa'i bzhugs/ bde po ma byung ste/ sde srid bgres po 'byug rab rgyas 'a'or bcas khyodags gzhan du blerdzos par btsams pa las/ rje khye1gas las rnam rgyal nyid kyang lhan du gyon dgos pa'i bka' nan cher stsal te de ga'i lha khang rnams la mchod 'bul dang smon lam mdzad de/ nam phyed tsam na pho brang nas phyir byung ste bros thabs kyis gshegs pa las/ sde srid bgres pa de nyid kyis sngar gzhan wa gnod pa cher byas pa'i las kyi zhags pas bcings pa lta thus shin hu ring ba'i sa mtha' bskor zhing nyin shad mtshan shad kyis bgrod bgrod pa'i ji zhig na/ has lung pa zhes byu ba der slobs pa'i tsho/ rjes snyags kyi dmag mi mang pos zin te 'gro ba'i lam stor par gyur to/ / de'i tshe sde srid bgres po 'byug rab rgyas de ni byi'u chung khras bzung ba ltar snying 'dar zhing shin hu 'jigs skrag par gyur la/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal nyid kyang thugs ma bde zhing phyir phebs te mthar gyis rin chen sprungs kyi pho brang dang nye bar phyogs pa na/ dmag mi sa gzhi gang ba tsam gyi nga ros spyi zing zhes byed cing / pho brang gi nang du byon pa'i tsho srog gcod kyi gshed ma mang pos sde srid bzung bar cerdzom pa na/ sde srid bgres pa 'byug rab rgyas pa des rje khyedags las rnam rgyal gyi na bza' la dam du 'jus nas gtong ma 'dod pas/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal nyid kyang thugs lhag par brtse zhing bakhrod blag med pa byung yang skyob pa'i mthu ma byung ste thugs stod du 'tshangs te gsung phra mo smre ngag phyung zhing cho nge bton par gyur to/ /tshoder gshed ma dag gi lag mthu dug pos dam du bzung nas rje phyogs las rnam rgyal dang phral te lag pa rgyab hu bcings nas btson khang du bcug nas/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal ni srung bya pa dang bcas pho brang gi dbu rtse rta mgrin lha khang du gdan 303

dungs so/ 'di ltar 'byor pa'i mtha' ni rgyud pa yin pas sde srid bgres pa 'grag rab rgyas pa de nyid g.yang sa chen po nas chu bo chen po'i gzhung la rgyang bskyur du btang nas tshe'i dus byas shing / tsha bo gnyis dang g.yodag po gcig kyang chad gas bcad de bsad par byas so/ / gter bton 'byug sgu rdo rje'i lung bstan las/'o/ ni bcu 'dzin bsod nams zad du slebs/ / nags spang g.ya' mo 'i mtshams nas bzung ste mod/ / nag mo rgya bal mtsho mo'i gting du lhung / / zhes gsungs pa'i lung bstan thog tu babs 'dug go / de bzhin ngag dbang pad dkar gyi rtogs brjod las kyang / skrurla dus mi rtag pa'i dbang las/ rje btsun phyogs las rnam rgyal ba yang rdzongs gzhan du phebs shing / sde srid bgres po yang 'chi bdag gi khar bkum pa dang / de'i sku tsha sde srid pa yang btson du bzung zhing blon po rnams kyang dus kyi che sa nyid du gyur pa'i skabs gdon gyis yid dkrugs pa'i skye bo ma rungs pa dag phan tshun chags sdang gi dbang las skye po la la ni mtshon gyis bkum/ la la ni thog rdib pa dang phal che ba dag ni gri rgyab nas gtsug lag lang rnams khrag gi rjen dri ngar po 'thul zhing / zhabs drung rin po che bzhugs pa'i sku'i mdun gyi thad du mi mang po dmar gsod du btang ba'i khrag mtsho 'khyil zhing / phyo nang kun tu gsod cig rgyobs shig pa'i sgras gnam sa bir bas dbang med pa dag brgyal zhing ngu ba'i skad/ dmyal ba'i gting nas 'byin pa lta thus bar med du gtams pa'i srin po'i spong lta thur gyur pa'i dus de yang re zhig zhi bar gyur te/ zhes gsal/sde srid bgres pa 'byug rab rgyas pa de yis sde srid ma mdzad pa'i sngon gzhan rgyud 13'a dung srong dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng ldeb 'a4rgyab phreng 3pa nas/304

bskul te sngar bla ma zhang bkrongs/ sde srid mdzad nas spya lo 1716 rababyung nya' me spyil la gter bton 'byug sgra rdo rje bkrongs pa rje ngag dbang phrin las rnam thar nang gsal/ spyi 'o/ 1713rab khu/nga nya'achu sgrul la rgyal sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan bkre ngas ge'i las kyi 'bras bu smin te rab byung 1me sa mo bya spyi lo 17'tsho la kyen dbang du gshegs 'dug sku( / sde srid khri rabs dgu pas chab srid bkyings pa dang nang 'khrugs chen po khu/nga tshul/ ༄༄ / / sde srid phyag mdzod dmi pa dge bshes ngag dbang rgya mtsho ni/ yul wang 'a tshag lung nas 'byug rab rgyas kyi dnge na rigs su 'khrungs/ sku gatshe na nu'i dus nas sgrig la bzhugs nas dkyil cesag dang gar rig dbyungs 31gas la rang byan tshud ger byings/ bla ma tsan du pa nas sgra dang snyan ngag sdeb spyor se gas rig gnas kyi skor phal cher gsan pa'i skabs bla ma des phyos su sde srid kyi khrir 'bod par lung bstan/ zhabs dung gsung sprul khyodags las rnam rgyal gyi sku/ngas 'dzin mdzad/ de nas mi ring bar sde srid 'grag rab rgyas zur bzhugs gnang ste rgyal tshab tu spyi 'o/ 1730rab chobyung 12 lcags byi lor sde srid kyi khrir bsgos/ thugs bskyed rmad du byung bas dge 'dun gyi sde'i che sa khrims dang phyag wen thams cad dngos gtsang bar bsgyur/sde srid 'di yis paṇa chen thum thang chodas rje ngag dbang bsod nams slob dpon du 305

bskos te sgra pa'i grwa tshang logs su phye nas sgra ka tsan dbyangs gsum dang sdeb spyor rin chen 'byung gnas sum rtags se gas 'chad nyan gyi bstan pa shin hu dar rgyas su mdzad/ srongs thang du bka' 'gyur sgyu pod dang / 'jam dpal dbyangs dang gu ru padma 'byung gnas dang gser zangs kyi sku mi tshad las brgal ba/ spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i gos skra mthong spol chen mo dang / bkra shis chos rdzong du rgya sno kyi lo paṇa tshang ma'i thang ma gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i 'chings rabs rnam thar yongs rdzogs kyi thang ka / lcags ri bdud 'dul yang dben du zhabs dung rin po che'i gser sku chen mo sku gas legs par bzhengs shing / rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar dang mgur 'bum/ 'dus pa rin po che tog gzungs/ mdo mangs kyi 'phro 'thud dang / dus 'khor rnam bshad kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa la sogs pa'i gsung rab kyi par pon che ba bzhings/ gu ru rin po che'i sgrub gnas kun tu gsol 'debs 'thum gter dang / lhan skyes dung sgyur sogs rnam dkar gyi phrin las grangs las 'das pa mdzad/ gar thig dbyangs dang sgrig lam rnam gzhag serdzogs la rtsal du bton te lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa che sa bzhin du bkyings/sde srid 'di ni gter bton 'grag sgra rdo rje'i lung bstan las lha sras mu khri btsan po'i rnam 'phrul du gsungs 'dug dus skabs der ཿtshes rgyal byang chub sems dpa' zhes sku ngas su grags pa yin la/ bar chad las rgyal na bstan 'gro'i don mtha' yas pa 'grub par 'dug kyang / rgyal sras 'jigs med nor thu bon sbos snu sa rje nas gong sa mi pham dbang po'i gcung por 'khrungs pa de gzhung du gdan 'dren zhu ba na/sde srid bgres po 'byug rab rgyas kyis sku gong ma rgyal sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan nam 306

snya na pa ti'i zhe 'bon gyis sprul kri 'jigs med nor thu 'di la yang byus ngan gyi g.yo 'phrul sna tshogs brtsams pas/ spungs thang 'dus sde chen por gong ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi grwa bu slob mang po yod pa de rnams kyis sde srid bgres par zings 'khrugs chen po langs/ de nas sde srid ngag dbang rgya mtsho 'di nyid ni gzhung gi 'ongs ma mdzad thabs med byung bas lto nang 'dir skye 'gro spyi'i bsod nams dman pa'i las dbang gis sde srid ngag dbang rgya mtsho dang grwa tshang dmang bcas gzhung phyogs gcig dang / sde srid bgres pa 'grag rab rgyas dang de'i malha na gnyer dkar sgris don grub bcas phyogs gnyis su sku nga nas nang 'khrugs me ltar 'bar/ sde srid bgres pa 'byug rab rgyas pas gzhung la ma thub par bode rgyal bsku1da nams —1bas rgyas la mgo gtad dmag rgyab zhu ba'i yi ge btang yang ma phan par the nga du bshad pa bzhin sde srid bgres pa kyen dbang du gshegs tsho/ mi ring bar mgron gnyer dkar ṣpe don grub sde srid bgres pa'i phyogs gtogs rnams kyis sde pa dge bshes ngag dbang rgya mtsho 'di yang bzung ste btson du bcug pa nas spyi lo 17'tsho rababyung nya'as byu lor mtshon khar bkrongs/ de ltar nang 'khrugs skabs chodas skyong srung ma rbad bskul byas pa'i 'thu ldog gis srid skyong zhang dbon gnyis ka kyen dbang du gshegs dgos byung 'dug rnam thar 'o/ rgyus gzhan du nang 'khrugs kyi rjes su mi pham dbang po khri mnga' gsol ba ltar snang na yang gong sa mi pham dbang po'i rnam thar nang ltar na gcen mi pham dbang po sde srid dang gcung 'jigs med nor bu bla ma khri par mnga' gsol dus sde srid ngag dbang rgya mtsho bzhugs 'dug pas/ de'i rjes su nang 'khrugs kyis bkrongs pa yin par nges pa 'di ltar/ shākya rin chen gyis mdzad pa mi pham 307

dbang po'i rnam thar na gcen mi pham dbang po dang gcung 'jigs med nor thu spungs thang du gyon te phebs pa na yongs 'dzin dam pa mkhan chen chos kyi rje bo nyid dang /sa'i tshangs pa chen po sde srid ngag dbang rgya mtsho yang mjal rten bkra shis pa'i la btags bcas rgod lang ka srongs chen mo ra zhabs bsur phebs shing / bkra shis pa'i dga' 〈snan phun sum ༄ḍags pa'i bzhugs gral rgyas pa mthe ris kyi mdun sa lta bu'i bkod pa rgya chen pos kyang mnyes par byas so/ /de nas mi ring bar gtso cher rgyal sras 'dus chogs rin po che spyi dang / khyad par yongs 'dzin dam pa malan chen ཿtshes kyi rje so dang sa'i tshangs pa chen po la sogs pas zhu ba nan cher yul te/ mchog gi sprul sku rin po che rnam pa gnyis 'jig rten snya dang bcas pa'i spya gtsug gi nor thus gyi dor byas pa'i rkang bteg can/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor 'o sa sgyur ba gser gyi drwa ba dag pa la spyod pa'i che sa kyi khri 'phang mthon por/ nā ro ta pa'i rgyal tshab chodas kyi 'khor los sgyur ba chen por lhan cig hu mnga' gsol zhing / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang sle ba mar bcas pas dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i dge mtshan gyi ltas bzang po bcas/ bkra shis dang bde legs kyi dpal yon rmad du byung bas mdun bdar te/ yongs 'dzin mkhan rin po che dang sa dbang mche ga gi dbu mdzad snyo nang las tshan gyi sne mor gtogs rigs thams cad nas 'bul ba phyad dud kyi bsnyen bkur kun hu bzang po'i mchod spyin ltar gnyibs shing /legs so'i me tog gi char chen po mngon par phab par gyur to/ / zhes gsal bas de ltar na mi pham dbang po sde srid khri mnga' gsol ba'i rjes su nang zings kyis ngag dbang rgya mtsho bkrongs pa yin par 'dug go / sde srid 'di'i skabs su spyi lo 1715 308

nya736rab byung 1'di'i shing sgrul lam me rta gang yin la gsal la mi snang yang 'bus rdzongs dang dmag 'khrugs byung 'dug sdu de dag gi tsho yul dus 'gro ba snyigs ma lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i dbang las/ yul 'bras mo rdzongs su g.yul bkye bar gyur te/ skye 'gro maḥtsheg dman thams cad dmag 'jigs kyis zos mi bde zhing / spyod sdug sems bral rnam pa sna chogs zhig byung ba ma zad/ mi ring bar thus nyes su 'acerar bas mi mang po'i sredag la sgar thum byung ste yul lams thams cad dud slo'i 'ur rdzis khyab cing / rang la bza' rgyu med kyang pha rol po la brtse ba'i dbang gis myu ngan mchi ma dang bcas rje'i sku zhabs su byang thu bsreg pa dang ba3rsha smon zhu ba yang dpag med zhig 'dus par sa/ra pa na/ zhes gsal 'e1/ /133 ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar thams cad mkhyen pa'i ro la sna nyis brgya gcig gi mdun nas/ 309

sde srid bcu pas bstan srid skyong skabs bod dmag lan gsum cadangs pa dang lha sar sku 65ba bsrergags pa/༄༄ / / sde srid phyag mdzod bcu pa gong sa mi pham dbang po ni/ rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyi sprul pa'i sku mang sde bon khris yul du yab rta mgrin tsho dbang dang /yum ngas/ dbang thu dar gyi sras su spyi lo 1709 dang rab byung nya' sa glang lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung 'o/ bdun la dge 'dun gyi sder bzhugs/ zhabs dung phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis skra phyad bzhes te mtshan ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'grag rgyas zhes gse la/ mkhan chen bakhrod nga/ phrin las nas dge bsnyen dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/sngags 'chang rgyal byed tshal pa bstan pa rgya mcho sku gas hre ba dpon bsten nas yon tan gang la yang cogs pa med par dpyis phyin par byings/ 'dus sder lo bdun bzhugs/ ma ngas 'dzin mkhan rin po che ngag dbange lhun grub kyis mtshan ngag dbang bstan 'dzen mi pham dbang po zhes gse la/ sgang steng sprul skru bstan 'dzin legs pa'i don grub kyis zhus pa'i por sgang steng gsang sngags che sa gling du byon nas pad gling gter che sa sogs gsang chen rnying ma'i che sa ste/ra mang po zhus te de'i rgyal tshab hu bzhugs skabs/ rgyal dbang /mi pa zhu nag sku phreng bcu gnyis pa byang chub rdo rje dang / zhwa dmar kri phreng brgyad pa dpal chen chodas kyi don grub yab sras gnyis bum thang thang khris su gyon pa na/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen pos gsang thabs su mi kyir brdzus te byon nas phyag dang mjal dar rtse 310

g.yodas te bod rgyal bsod nams stobs rgyas la mgo gtad kyang sngar bshad pa bzhin sde srid bgres pa chu gror bkum/ sde bgres phyogs gtogs rnams kyis skru tsha sde pa ngag dbang rgya mtsho yang bston du bzung nas mthar mtshon khar bkrongs/ mi mang po dmar gsod btang nas blon po rnams kyang dus kyi chos nyid du gyur te gshin rje'i spong ltar gyur 'dug de nas dpyid kyi dus la babs pa na gong sa mi pham dbang po 'khor bcas bkra shis cerdzos rdzong du gyon te sngar rgyal sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis btsugs par mdzad pa'i lha mo'i sgrub mchod chen mo yang sngar srol bzhin btsugs par mdzad pa dang / dgongs 'dus tshes bcu dang 'jigs byed kyi sgrub mchod rgyas pa gserdzol 'debs 'bum gter skusnags sngar las lhag par btsugs par mdzad/de nas mi ring ba na skye 'gro spyi'i las snang gis zhabs 'og gi blon po rnams la ma mthuX par spyi lo 17'kho rab byung nya' sa bya lor nang 'khrugs dug hu byung 'dug de sdus nang zings shin hu che nas/ thim phu klu spong du/ sde pa dge bshes phyogs kto/mgron gnyer sri thub sogs kyi dmag dgang dang / 'byung bzhi'i nang du/ sde pa pha jo'i phyogs kyi/ mgyon gnyer dkar khris don grub kyi dmag sgar btab nas/ nyin gyi ring la gri mdung sogs thogs te gdong 'thab byed cing / mtshan mo dmag sgar chags rgyab pa zhes ki sgra dang swa sgu dang me mda'i sgras gnam sa 'alo la ba ltar byas/ zhes ba/bsu'//masan gnyer dkar sbyi'i phyogs thung pham pa na/ sngon nas bod rje bsod nams stobs rgyas la mgo gtad kyibs zhus pa bzhin bod rgyal la ra mda' mthod ces zhu 125 bstan 'dzin chodas rgyal gyi rtogs pa brjod pa sgyu ma chen po'i gar stabs so bdun rgyab bzhi nas/312

phrin sgo nya btang ba las/ bod dmag dang po 'ong tshul/ /zlorgo dasang chen po bshams te dasung grogs bya'o snyam pa'i dgongs pa med kyang dkar spe yi chad mi 'gyur tsam gyi bka' 31ga sa mtshams kyi dmag sgar du gnang ba la/ sa mtshams 'asku( dasmo rnams kyis bka'i dgongs don ma go bar snyo rdzongs bod kyi mnga' zhabs su bsnga ba'i saXs kyis sa mtshams kyi dmag dgang rnams bteg skurdzo / zhes gsal ba dbye / rmermi can gyi las bsags pa myong bar nges pa rgya mtsho'i dus rlabs bzhin du yol ba med pa dang / bstan pa'i 'gal kyen chags snyong gi rnam pa lta thus snyo nang gi skye 'gro thams cad don med du gcig la gnyig 'tsho zhing / gshe ba dang / rdeg pa dang / smos shing brgyad par byed pa sogs 'tshub snyong gi rnam pa ji snyed g.yos shing /rbod dmag gi dgang kyang lhag pas nyes me da kyi lus can mtha' dag phye ma leb me rtse'i dbal gyis bskyed pa ltar 'cho ba'i 'du byed dor ba sogs sdug bsngal mi bzad pa'i 'khor lo reg gle da kshi spru gri'i so lta thus gtsos par gyur pa/ zhes gsal ba bzhin thog mar sa mtshams kyi nge da dmag cadangs nas dkar spe dang bsdongs te dmag rgyab pas rin sprungs rdzong dang 'brug rgyal rdzong bod pa dang dkar spe don yib kyis thob/de skabs mi rje shes rab dbang phyug spa spo dpon slob byed de bzhugs yod pa yang re zhig mdo mkhar chodas 'khor sgang du byon nas bzhugs 'dug / bod dmag 'di ni spyi lo17'kho sa mo bya lor yin 'dug / slar yang 'byug gzhung phyogs nas rgan thu blo gros can dang dpa' zhing brtul 136 mi dbang rtogs brjodi 'jig rten kun du dga' ba'i gtam sum brgya zhe bdun rgyab lnga nas/ 117 mi pham dbang po'i rtogs brjod dbyangs can rgyud mang so dgu mdun bzhi pa nas/313

phode pa rnams bsam pa mtha' cig tu mthun par byas te dmag rgya pas bode dang dkar spe'i dmag spa bkong ste phyir rgol ma nus par rin spungs rdzong dang 'byug rgyal rdzod bzung ste bsdad yod pa'i rdzong gi phyir 'byug gzhung gi dmag sgar chags pas /gle tshe sa mtshams kyi dgang gis pha rol tu rgol ni zin/ phyir ldog pa'i mthu ni med/de la ra mda' ma mngags na nyam nyes par 'a//ra bar gzigs pas/ mi'i bdag po'i lung gis bsgos nas yul dbus gtsang gi g.yul gyi la 'o pa gsum dang / nyang rsā 'brong dkar rtse pa bstan 'dzin no yon la sogs terasung gi tshogs ha cang mi mang ba dang / mong gol dgang nyung shas dang bcas te mngags par mdzad pa las/zhes gsal ba bzhin/ therdzod dmag mtshengs te dmag 'thab pas 'byug gzhung dmag dgang pham ste bros/ 'ga' zhig gis 'bras la'i spyi bor stag gong rgal zhes pa la btsan mkhar bzung ste bsdad/ der yang dmag rgyab pas bod dmag dang dkar spe phyogs kyis 'bras la phar bcad thob ste rin spungs dkar spe don grub kyis bzung 'asatswa snas kyang sems can gyi las ngan la bcos su med pa lta bus bod dmag dgang chen lhags shing / sde gzar gyi 'khyoms chen po g.yos par gyur te/ de'i tshi chu ma bde na nya mi bde ba'i dpe bzhin shing dung brag phyag brten pa'i ri khrod sgom chen gyi tshogs kyang ma bde bar gyur cing / zhes dang / gsad par 'os pa'i btson rigs kyang bka' blon tshor thabs mkhas kyi phebs sgo stsal zhing gnang byin bcas bde bar hre ga 'thab gral du shi ba rnams la'ang gnas sgo bsngo smon sku gas thugs rje'i kyibs nya' mi dbang rtogs brjod sum brgya zhi bdun mdun gsum nas/nya' mi pham dbang po'i rtogs brjod zhi gnyis rgyab lnga nas/314

chog nas mi 'dor bar mdzad/ ces gsal/ bod dmag de'i skabs/ /lhaji paṇa chen dang / sa kyi khri chen dang / dmi pa zhwa nag bcu gnyis pa byung chub rdo rje dang / zhwa dmar bzhi pa cheras kyi don grub bcas bla chen rnams thugs kyis ma bakhrode par bod rje mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyas la dbyen zlums par gasku la ba bzhin gnang nas/ kurma pa zhwa dmar nag yab sras gnyis 'dir byedan te chings bsgrigs nas dargon sras tshe ring dbang chen mi gter mngags pa gsal/de yang rgyal dbang garma pa yab sras dang gong sa mi pham dbang po sngar nas gzugs snang shin hu gtsang ba yin par brten/ snyo bod kyi bstan 'gro'i don la dgongs te bar du chings 'dums mdzad pa la the da rgyal bsku da nams 〈snabs rgyas kyis kyang legs par gsan te gami pa yab sras phag ri brgyud 'grag rgyal rjidang du phebs te the da gzhung dmag dpon nga lan tha'i ji dang mjal phrad mdzad de rin sprungs rdzong du gyon/'byug gzhung sku tshab gzhung mgron gnyer stod pa dang thim rdzong pa nang blon don grub spos 'gyor/ bod gzhung dmag dpon blo bzang dang cog mda' dpon lcang can bcas spa 〈sna tsherang 'dus sa/ dmag sgar babs/ rgyal dbang zhwa dmar nag yab sras dang bod gzhung mda' dpon mi drag rnams dang / 'grug gzhung sde srid mkhan po bcas bka' mol zhib par mdzad de chings don byung nas bkra shis chodas rdzong pho brang chen po'i dathu rtse'i nang du zhal 'dzom thog dkon mche ga gsum dang bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho dpang du gsol nas bro sor te/ spyi lo 1730 rab byung nya' pa'i lcags khyi zla 10pa'i tshos bcu bzhi'i nyin bod 'byug 'tshe chu'i rgyun 'gyur med kyi rtags bzhag 130 mi dbang rtogs brjod sum brgya zhi bdun rgyab nas/315

legs par grub ste bod dbus gtsang gi dmag dpon rnams kyang rang sar gyes te dga' 'byug mthun lam byung zhing khrims sgo rang bdag so sor byas te/ sa skyong mi pham dbang po'am rin chen phrin las rab rgyas kyi khu so dbon sras tsho ring dbang chen du grags pa 'byug gzhung ༷/ tshab 'o( chags pa mi gter mngags/ 'grag gzhung nas lha sar sku tshab 'go dang po 'di nyid yin/ de nas dgun spungs thang du phebs te bde maglerdzog sgrub mchodi dang masku na mang sgrub mchod la rgyal ba dmi pa yab sras kyang gyon te gzigs mo mdzad/ dgyes rdor lha dgu'i dbang lung sogs gnang ste lcags phag lor gangs can gyi rdzongs su byon/de sngar dkar spe nas kyang 'byug gzhung la ngo rgol mi byed rgyu dang / 'byug gzhung nas kyang dkar spe la gcad 'tshe mi byed rgyur chings don byas kyang sems can gyi las ngan la bcos thabs med pa lta thus slar yang blon po rnams snga ma'i zhe 'khon gyis nang zings dug tu g.yos pa byung bar/ das/ bizlums pa'i bro sor zhing rtags bkod pa de'i phyo nas kyang nang phan tshun mi mdza'o bas res 'ga' ni 'byug yul gyi bla dpon dag gis gar spe'i sde la rgol/ res 'ga' ni gar spe'i phyogs kyis 'grag sde la rgol bar byed pa rim par byung zhing / de'i tshe bod rdzongs nas kyang dbyen zlums kyi pho nya mngags pa dang / bod rje bsod nams stobs rgyas la dang por kyibs gse la bar byed pa po dkar spe nyam nyes kyi dogs pas g.yul bshams cung zad 'du mdzad dgos pa dag shā/'a med kyis/ zhes gsal ba bzhin dpyang dmag btang dgos pa byung 'dug bod dmag dasung chen gyis thim gzhung bar med khyab pas gyon stabs ma bde 131 mi dbang rtogs brjod sum brgya zhe dgu'i rgyab lnga pa nas/ 133 mi pham dbang po'i rtogs brjod zhe lnga'i rgyab lnga pan 316

bar/ re zhig rje rnam gnyis mkhan hre ba dge 'dun bcas pa thams cad dbang 'dus rbo byang du phebs dgos byung zhing / zhes gsal ba dang / snarmirmi can spyi mthun gyi las ngan gyi bcos su med pa lta thus/ snyo nang dpon ris nang ma gshin pa'i kyen las/ nam zla dpyid sku sa la nye bar gyur pa na/ thim gzhung kun tu bod dmag gi dpung chen po lhags te/ snyo nang gi skye 'gro mche ga dman thams cad zos ma bde bar gyur cing / mthar bkra shis ceras rdzong la bskor rgyag zla ba gsum lhag gi bar du byas par brten/ rim gzhung gi 56la 'alo ra thams cad me la bsregs pa se gas kyis brlag par gyur cing / lo thog dus smin gyi zhing thams cad kyang 'jags kyis 'phyur ba sogs dus byas mi rtag pa'i che sa nyid mngon sum du snang bar gyur to/ /thed gzhung du dug tshad langs snge/ nye yang thim gzhung du bode dmag ma gyes pas/ gzhung sa rnams kyang gsol thabs phebs ma bde bar dbang rdzong nor thu'i pho brang du phebs shing /dge 'dun rnams shar bo dang gi phyogs su phebs so/ / zhes dang / tswa snarnyi rim gzhung nor 'dzin gyi khyon kun 'gongs pa'i bod kyi dmag dpung chen po yang rdzo la glags ma rnyed pas phyir dengs shing / zhes gsal ba bzhin bod dmag dacing chen lhags te sde gzar gyi 'khyoms chen po gasku sa pas shin hu dka' ngal che bar gyur 'dug / mi ring bar chodas srung gi mthu mngon par bdo bas bod dgang thams cad rang byer song / bod dmag 'di skabs kyi zla 6pa'i chos thul se lar byams mgon ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gshegs tshul la dpag na spyi 'o/ 173'arab byung nya'apa'i chu khyi lo la yin tshod du snang / dgon gyi mi sor rnams sngar dkar spre'i 'ongs yin pas 133 shākya rin chen rnam thar le'u lnga pa bzhi rgyab drug pa nas/ 134 mi pham dbang po'i rtogs brjod brgyad rgyab lnga nas/317

bzhin phyag 'thul dang 11na lam yang dag par zhus/bod rgyal mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyas kyis sngar bod 'byug nang zings skabs rang la mgo gtad bcol ba po dkar sge don grub kyang yi chad ma gyur tsam gyi rgyab dpung mdzad daskutshes shar ba ma gtesnags ceras rje dpal ldan 'brug pa la thugs zhin sdings nas yod pa'i thog gong sa mi pham dbang pe thugs rje dang thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pa med du byung bas rin spungs cha zla ga dkar spe don grub bo pa 'das rjes slar 'byug gzhung du rtsis spyod gnang bar mdzad pa yang 'di yin zhing / dus de nas tshur bod 'byug mthun lam legs par 〈snang ba dang 'byug gzhung rgyal khab rang dbang rang btsan sra brtan je btsan du gyur pa lags sku / / de bzhin bka' blerdzon/ masan gnyer tsag lo'i pa/ grang 'khor rnams kyis kyang rdzongs rta gya noms pa phul te snyo rdzongs su gyon te mi ring bar 'grag rgyal rdzong / rin sprungs sogs brgyud de bkra shis chodas rdzong dang spungs thang rdzong du phebs so/ /de nas snyo rdzongs 'dir bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher mthod de spyi lo 173 8 rab byung nya' sa rta lor zla lnga pa'i chos bco lnga'i nyin bzang po spyad pa'i smon lam 'don gyi yod pa'i thams cad skad du bdag gis ཿtshes ston to/ / zhes pa'i mtshams su zhi bar gshegs sku(/ / 321

sde srid bcu gcig pas chab srid bskyangs pa/༄7 / / sde srid bcu gcig pa khu bo dpal 'byor lo rgyus ni/ 'chings yul mang sde bon khris nas yin zhing gong sa mi pham dbang po dang rgyal sras sprul sku 'jigs med nor thu kro mched kyi khu bo yin pas/ rgyal sras sprul sku 'jigs med nor thu mkhan rin po che ngag dbang lhun grub sogs 'dus sde dang sde srid ngag dbang rgya mtshos gzhung du gdan sar spyan dungs dus mnyam du gyon nas rgyal sras sprul sku'i gzim dpon mdzad de bzhugs/ gong sa mi pham dbang po thog ma nas rgyal srid la thugs 'dod med pa'i thog lto rdzongs 'dir skye bo ngan pa rnams kyi chags sdang mi bzad pa'i zings 'khrugs kyis thugs shin hu khu/nga bas rgyal srid spangs te sus kyang ma shes par me 'byug lor bod du phebs pa'i shul du rgyal sras sprul skru 'jigs med nor bu ni sngon nas dgongs pa rdzogs te med pas sde srid 'os pa zhig su yang med par brten/thugs rgyud bzang zhing chesgos srid lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen rab macerag tu rgyas pa 'bangs mi ser rnams la yang bka' khrims dung por byams brtses spyong ba'i bla ma mi pham dbang po dang 'jigs med nor thu sku mched kyi khu bo dpal 'byor 'di nyid 'dus sde dang bka'i blon po lhan rgyas kyis 'os bab tu gzigs te/ spyi lo 1736 rabasgyung 1'a me 'grag lor sde srid kyi khrir mnga' gsol/ཿtshes rje dpal ldan 'grug pa'i bstan pa la thugs bskyed rmad du byung bas gdanas lcags ri me kyen gyis 'jig pa 'di nyid/ zhig gasku sa sngar las mi dman par bzhengs nas dngul 'bum mcherd rtene sku gas legs par grub ste gser gyi rgya phibs 322

kyang bkal/ 'bangs mi ser rnams la yang thugs byams skyong gi bka' khrims dung pos phyogs dang ris su ma phyes par lha chodas dang mi che sa mthun par bsgyungs/ gong sa mi pham dbang pos bsgrubs pa'i spyan ras gzigs gser zangs kyi sku'i 'phro 'thud kyang legs par bzhengs par mdzad pa dang / 〉sprersha 'khor rab brtan rtser sde srid bgros po dpal 'byor der bzhugs 'dug pa yang mjal/ sgra pa'i sde gsar du btsugs mkhan bong yin pas/ khyod rnams nged kyis bzos pa'i dge bshes yin gsungs thugs mnyes/ gnang cha mtshon pa re mdzad de hre ba gnyer la nan bskyed dgos pa'i zhal ta gnang / zhes gsungs 'dug pa dang / sdi3 gid bgres pa dpal 'gyor der bzhugs pa'ang mjal/ sgra pa'i sde gsar du btsugs mkhan bong yin gas/ zhes pa se gas tshig don gcig pa gsungs 'dug pas/ sgra pa'i grwa tshang sngar sde srid dgu pas btsugs kyang bar skabs nang 'khrugs kyis sde srid rang yang mtshon bar gshegs shing bod dmag gis yang yang gtses pas rgyun chad pa ltar sku nga ba sde srid khu bo dpal 'byor gyis ngag dbang dpal ldan bzang po slob dpon du bskos te rje kun dga' rgya mtsho dang sku na tan mtha' yas se gas sle ba phrug btsugs ste grwa pa'i sde gsar du btsugs par mdzad pa sku gas bstan srid la dman pa'i mdzad phrin gyis 'jig rten na char chu dus su 'bebs shing 'o/ phyugs legs pa dang / nad mug 138 rje yon tan mtha' yas kyis mdzad pa ngag dbang kun dga' rgyu mtsho'i rtogs pa brjod pa mchodag gi dang po'i rba rlabs dug pas/139 rje 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa yon tan mtha' yas kyi rnam thar/ ye shes 'di stod 'a tho ba'i nyi ma'i nyer bzhi'i mdun nas/323

gdan dungs so/ / zhes dang / pho lha(3 du bka' blon tsho'i dung du bkug nas sde srid pa'i ngag brgyud pa'i bka' sprig pos/ dar dkar phyedags su phebs dasku sa tshul khu/nga bas/ zhes dang / de nas chu smada'i phar 'gram gyi bye ma'i thang nas rje nyid pho nya ba mtshon cha ring thung mang po'i chas dang ldan pas bskor bzhin khyodan tshe/ thams cad kyis ma'i ste 'di lta thu'i gnas tshul du khrel zhing yid lhag par pham mo/ / zhes dang / de'i mi cho sa srung rnams ma mnyes pa'i ltas glerdzo thur du rlung nag chen pe hū sgu dang bcas pa'i 'tshubs mas zam pa de'i lang thog thams cad dang / sde srid bo rang gi khang thog //sdu rlung gis gtor nas mi shis pa'i mtshan ma mngon sum du ston no/ / zhes dang /sde srid ngag rgyan pa yang legs byas kyi 'tsho ba zad cing / rje byang chub sems dpa' 'di nyid la yang mi cadas pa'i las mang po bgyis pa la brten rdo rje'i chodas srung rnams lhag par mi mnyes pa'i tshul mang ba'i dbang gis ngan ltas sna tshe gas pa dang / dbang rdzong mgon khang chen por 'dus tshogs kyis bskang ba mdzad skabs sde srid pa rab gsal du yod pa'i mdun du cog rtse'i khar bya rog gdong can khros pa lta thu'i khā tas skad dug po 'byin cing / sdang mig dang bcas pa'i gasgo ga pa brdabs pas sde srid 5 sngangs stabs su khros te gri bton pa sku gas khu/nga ba dang / de skabs 'ga' zhig gi rmi lam du yang sde srid pa bya rog bzhis khyer ba se gas byung ba bzhin dbang rdzong de thar rang blo gyar du 'chi bdag gshin rje'i khar sbrim smad/ / zhes gsal/143 ldeb grangs so drug pa'i mdun phreng gnyis pa nas/ 144 ldeb grangs pho dgu'i mdun phreng gong ma nas/327

zhib mor dpyad de bden pa dgra yang mthong bzos dang brdzun pa thu yin yang nag chad bkal cing bka' khrims dung bar mdzad/ mthong hrol gu ru rin po che'i sku brnyan chur 'dom bco brgyad/ zhing du 'dom bco lnga bzang dgos sna tshogs las grub pa dang / bkra shis che sa rdzong gsar bzhengs lta thu'i zhig gsos dang / dngul gyi zhabs dung rin po che'i skru thog tshad ma/ ston pa'i sku brnyan 'dom lngar nye ba gser zangs las grub pa/ sangs rgyas sde nga gi sku(la thang mjod lha sa sna tshe gas las grub pa/dngul gyi spyan ras gzigs srong btsan sgam po/ rgya mo bza'/ bal bza'/ blon po thon mi/ mgar stong btsan sogs kyi lku brnyan dang / bka' 'gyur gser las bzhengs pa dang / spungs thang gi dbu rtse 'dom dug cu re dug gi khor yug gi tshad la gser ṭam stong phrag bzhi dang dgu brgya dgu bcu go gsum dang dngul chu sgo re nyis stong dgu brgya brgyad cu gya gnyis song ba'i gser gyi rgya phibs chen mo dang / sgo slo che'i steng gi rgya phibs gnyis sgron/ sgrub sde bya rgod phyang po/ kun gsal pho brang ba ling rin chen khang bzang se gas gtsug lag lang dang sgrub khyim mang po btab/ spungs thang rdzong sogs phal cher gser dngul gyi sgo rgyan/ lha mgon sgrub mchod chen mor lngar 'o/ngas pa'i maṇa shel gsum brtsegs gsor dzongs brdungs se gas gser dngul gyi mchod spyad bskrun/ ma ṇi dung sgyur/ lhan skyes dung sgyur/ gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma/ 'jig rten dbang phyug 'thum gter lan mang / dus gcig la tshar dug cu re gcig sogs bka' 'gyur tshar mang po klog hu stsal ba dang / snyo la bzhi'i lha lang rten la zhal gser/ na bza' mar me zhal zas skusnags lan mang / lha nang gi mgon khang kun la gser dngul g.yu byur sku gas spyan gzigs/ gri macesan me mda' 332

gsum bcu gcig dgu pa bdun pa lnga pa ste le tshan brgyad/ glang chen mche ba se gas dngul khar phab na ma ṭam nyis snyedang nyis brgya dgu bcu tham pa dang / maḥtsheg sprul 'jigs med grags pa la yang de dang mtshungs par phul/ngag dbang 'jigs med seng ge la/ gser ljangs brdungs kyi mgul ga bzo khyad can/ bal po'i dngul ṭam brgya/ ma ṭam brgya/ rtse spyod bcu sprel/ sman rnying yug gos chen kha dog sna lnga yug chen lngas bcu gsum le tshan/ gu ru rin po che'i tshems mche ba g.yas 'khyil gcig dam rdzas a dam 〉ཿdam zhig gling gter gyon ngo ma lnga sogs dam rdzas 'gang can mang po dang / dbang ril byu ru brgya phreng ba so'i phyag 'khor/ bya tshe ri nga gi gzugs brnyan nyams dod za 'og mngags thags yol ba gnyis/ bzang ja sbag gcig dkar ma la gzhong pa/ bzhes cen la gcod can gcig dngul gyi chibs sga rgya nag bzo khyad bcas dam rdzas dang nor bu'i rigs ma the ba'i ma ṭam chig stong gi gong du longs pa phyal/ shākya rin chen la gser dngul dar gos bcu gsum le tshan/ chibs sga 'bor bcas khyon bsdoms ma ṭam bzhi brgya lnga'i gong thang phul/ro/kya bstan 'dzin la/ gser dngul dar rga sa bcu gsum le tshan skutshegs ma ṭamabargya dang dug cu re bzhi'i gong thang phrul/ sa spyong bgres por/ gser dngul dar gos serdzogs bcerdzo lnga le tshan/ chibs sga 'a6snar bcas khyon ma ṭam dgu brgya dang bcu tham pa/rdo rje slob dpon la ma ṭam nyi shu/ mdzed thog tshad/ sman bar khra yug gos chen yug bcas ma ṭam dug cu/ mtshan nyid 〈snab dpon ma ṭam bco lnga/ dar thog tshad/ sman la lnga/ gos ljang sprin ris la lngas gtsos dgu tshan ma ṭam so lnga'i rtsis/ rta mgo'i 334

gsum bcu gcig dgu pa bdun pa lnga pa ste le tshan brgyad/ glang chen mche ba se gas dngul khar phab na ma ṭam nyis snyedang nyis brgya dgu bcu tham pa dang / maḥtsheg sprul 'jigs med grags pa la yang de dang mtshungs par phul/ngag dbang 'jigs med seng ge la/ gser ljangs brdungs kyi mgul ga bzo khyad can/ bal po'i dngul ṭam brgya/ ma ṭam brgya/ rtse spyod bcu sprel/ sman rnying yug gos chen kha dog sna lnga yug chen lngas bcu gsum le tshan/ gu ru rin po che'i tshems mche ba g.yas 'khyil gcig dam rdzas a dam 〉ཿdam zhig gling gter gyon ngo ma lnga sogs dam rdzas 'gang can mang po dang / dbang ril byu ru brgya phreng ba so'i phyag 'khor/ bya tshe ri nga gi gzugs brnyan nyams dod za 'og mngags thags yol ba gnyis/ bzang ja sbag gcig dkar ma la gzhong pa/ bzhes cen la gcod can gcig dngul gyi chibs sga rgya nag bzo khyad bcas dam rdzas dang nor bu'i rigs ma the ba'i ma ṭam chig stong gi gong du longs pa phyal/ shākya rin chen la gser dngul dar gos bcu gsum le tshan/ chibs sga 'bor bcas khyon bsdoms ma ṭam bzhi brgya lnga'i gong thang phul/ro/kya bstan 'dzin la/ gser dngul dar rga sa bcu gsum le tshan skutshegs ma ṭamabargya dang dug cu re bzhi'i gong thang phrul/ sa spyong bgres por/ gser dngul dar gos serdzogs bcerdzo lnga le tshan/ chibs sga 'a6snar bcas khyon ma ṭam dgu brgya dang bcu tham pa/rdo rje slob dpon la ma ṭam nyi shu/ mdzed thog tshad/ sman bar khra yug gos chen yug bcas ma ṭam dug cu/ mtshan nyid 〈snab dpon ma ṭam bco lnga/ dar thog tshad/ sman la lnga/ gos ljang sprin ris la lngas gtsos dgu tshan ma ṭam so lnga'i rtsis/ rta mgo'i 334

sprul skur ma ṭam sum cu/ mjod thog tshad/ sman bar kha lnga/ bzang gos sprin ris dzong la lngas gce'os ma ṭam sum cu rtsa gsum gyi dgu tshan/ kun bzang ras chen sprul skur daskusnangs mtshungs ma ṭam sku( gasnge/ma gyi dgu tshan/ gnyer pa 'grag rnam rgyal la ma ṭam bzhi bcu'i le tshan/ 'dus pa rgya mtshor gser dngul dang dar zab rnying pa thog tshad/ sman rnying yu ga bzang gos dmar po yug gur gum mdog can ma yug gnyis/ ser po 'byug tshang nyal yug gsum/ ser po sprin ris can yug dugagaser thus dkar po yug bdun/ ser po yug gnyis/ ljang khu yug lnga/ sngon po yug dug ste rin thang chen po'i gos yug so bdun gyis ga tsos le tshan rnam grangs bcu gsum/ dge bdun zhal grangs lnga brgya dang dug cu so sor mdzed thung dngos gtsang re dang ba so'i phyag 'bor re/ phyag 'gyed dngul kyang ma ṭam bzhi stong bzhi brgya brgyad cu/ phyag 'khor ma the ba'i khyon bsdoms ma ṭam bdun stong grag brgya nyi shu tham pa/ btsun gsar brgya dang gcig la dngul ma ṭam nyis brgya gnyis/ mdzed lung ser bzhi/ cha bdun dang 'byug ris can yug gnyis/ sprin ris yug gcig mdzod thung re/ ba so'i phyag 'khor re/ phyag 'khor ma the ba'i khyon ma ṭam bdun brgya bcu gnyis/ 'di yan zhabs drang yab sras 'bul ba/ ba serdzo'i phyag 'a'or/ dam rdzas dang nor bu'i rigs rnams ma the ba'i rin thang dngul lar phab pa'i bsdoms chig khri sum stong dang brgya gnyis/ bka' blon che ba dgu se se ra/ gzhung phan tshun gnyis skal nyi shu so sor chibs zhon brgya dang dug cu tshogs thob dkar 'du ma brgya dang bzhi bcu dro rgyar thob pa brgya dang dug cu lto gzan dkyus ma bzhi brgya brgyad cu srongs thang bza' pa bdun cu don gnyis bkra shis chodas rdzong bza' pa brgya dang bzhi bcu/335

sprul skur ma ṭam sum cu/ mjod thog tshad/ sman bar kha lnga/ bzang gos sprin ris dzong la lngas gce'os ma ṭam sum cu rtsa gsum gyi dgu tshan/ kun bzang ras chen sprul skur daskusnangs mtshungs ma ṭam sku( gasnge/ma gyi dgu tshan/ gnyer pa 'grag rnam rgyal la ma ṭam bzhi bcu'i le tshan/ 'dus pa rgya mtshor gser dngul dang dar zab rnying pa thog tshad/ sman rnying yu ga bzang gos dmar po yug gur gum mdog can ma yug gnyis/ ser po 'byug tshang nyal yug gsum/ ser po sprin ris can yug dugagaser thus dkar po yug bdun/ ser po yug gnyis/ ljang khu yug lnga/ sngon po yug dug ste rin thang chen po'i gos yug so bdun gyis ga tsos le tshan rnam grangs bcu gsum/ dge bdun zhal grangs lnga brgya dang dug cu so sor mdzed thung dngos gtsang re dang ba so'i phyag 'bor re/ phyag 'gyed dngul kyang ma ṭam bzhi stong bzhi brgya brgyad cu/ phyag 'khor ma the ba'i khyon bsdoms ma ṭam bdun stong grag brgya nyi shu tham pa/ btsun gsar brgya dang gcig la dngul ma ṭam nyis brgya gnyis/ mdzed lung ser bzhi/ cha bdun dang 'byug ris can yug gnyis/ sprin ris yug gcig mdzod thung re/ ba so'i phyag 'khor re/ phyag 'khor ma the ba'i khyon ma ṭam bdun brgya bcu gnyis/ 'di yan zhabs drang yab sras 'bul ba/ ba serdzo'i phyag 'a'or/ dam rdzas dang nor bu'i rigs rnams ma the ba'i rin thang dngul lar phab pa'i bsdoms chig khri sum stong dang brgya gnyis/ bka' blon che ba dgu se se ra/ gzhung phan tshun gnyis skal nyi shu so sor chibs zhon brgya dang dug cu tshogs thob dkar 'du ma brgya dang bzhi bcu dro rgyar thob pa brgya dang dug cu lto gzan dkyus ma bzhi brgya brgyad cu srongs thang bza' pa bdun cu don gnyis bkra shis chodas rdzong bza' pa brgya dang bzhi bcu/335

ja dpon ja g.yog bcas dgu spungs thang dpon sgor dug cu/ bkra shis chos rdzong pa'i dug brag wang bzhi bcu so se ra bcas bsdoms ma ṭam chig stong sum brgya bzhi bcu tham pa ste kun dril chig khri bzhi ste/nga lnga brgya zhe dug ge / sprul skru 'jigs med grags pa mnga' gaskutshel dga' snyedan skabs lnga la bzhi'i mi ser mtshengs la gnang phyin sul dus mkhan rin po cher zab go sa dang mjod chen yug gis gcesas bcu gsum le tshan/ dngul ma ṭam sa/ma cu 'dus sde zhal grangs dug brgyar dngu'il ṭam bzhi re/chibs zhon dang tshogs thob brgya dang nyi shur dngul dong tse re re/ dro rgyar thob pa lto gzan dakhu/sa ma gza' pa gzhi gnyer bcas dug brgya brgyad cu tsa gcig / bkra shis chos rdzong cha 'og dpag sgar drang 'og gling bzhi rdzong 'og spungs thang cha 'ogathed chu shar ri'i byung cadag chu nub ri'i dung 'og mgar sa'i rdzong cadag mtsho zhabs dpon slob 'og dbang 'dus pho brang rdzong dpon/ shar dung 'og sge nag grang 'ogaphang ye dung 'og byu ra sgang dpon slob 'og dga' seng dung 'og nas rnying dung 'oga.u la'i dpon 'og rtse rang dung 'og chos 'khor rab rtse'i cha 'og nub pa'i dung 'ogabrag steng dung 'og glang mthil dung 'og stangs se sbe grang 'og bya dkar rdzong gi cha 'og rgyal rtse'i spyi nga 'og chu smad dung 'og u ra'i dung 'og stangs dung 'og chos 'khor grang 'og lhun tshib rtse'i cha zhabs/ stang mo chu dung 'og kur stod dung 'ogaspyi ling grang 'og 'khor ma'i dung 'og gling rgyal dung 'og bkra shis yang rtse'i cha zhabs nas tsha li grang 'og rin chen sgang dung 'og 'bum sde gling dung 'og btsan mkhar dung cadag bkra shis sgang cha zhabs nas rtse mig dung cadag bar cho gsum dung 'og rong thung drung 'og ra dhe drang 'og la ling grang 'og gzhong sgar cha zhabs nas 336

ja dpon ja g.yog bcas dgu spungs thang dpon sgor dug cu/ bkra shis chos rdzong pa'i dug brag wang bzhi bcu so se ra bcas bsdoms ma ṭam chig stong sum brgya bzhi bcu tham pa ste kun dril chig khri bzhi ste/nga lnga brgya zhe dug ge / sprul skru 'jigs med grags pa mnga' gaskutshel dga' snyedan skabs lnga la bzhi'i mi ser mtshengs la gnang phyin sul dus mkhan rin po cher zab go sa dang mjod chen yug gis gcesas bcu gsum le tshan/ dngul ma ṭam sa/ma cu 'dus sde zhal grangs dug brgyar dngu'il ṭam bzhi re/chibs zhon dang tshogs thob brgya dang nyi shur dngul dong tse re re/ dro rgyar thob pa lto gzan dakhu/sa ma gza' pa gzhi gnyer bcas dug brgya brgyad cu tsa gcig / bkra shis chos rdzong cha 'og dpag sgar drang 'og gling bzhi rdzong 'og spungs thang cha 'ogathed chu shar ri'i byung cadag chu nub ri'i dung 'og mgar sa'i rdzong cadag mtsho zhabs dpon slob 'og dbang 'dus pho brang rdzong dpon/ shar dung 'og sge nag grang 'ogaphang ye dung 'og byu ra sgang dpon slob 'og dga' seng dung 'og nas rnying dung 'oga.u la'i dpon 'og rtse rang dung 'og chos 'khor rab rtse'i cha 'og nub pa'i dung 'ogabrag steng dung 'og glang mthil dung 'og stangs se sbe grang 'og bya dkar rdzong gi cha 'og rgyal rtse'i spyi nga 'og chu smad dung 'og u ra'i dung 'og stangs dung 'og chos 'khor grang 'og lhun tshib rtse'i cha zhabs/ stang mo chu dung 'og kur stod dung 'ogaspyi ling grang 'og 'khor ma'i dung 'og gling rgyal dung 'og bkra shis yang rtse'i cha zhabs nas tsha li grang 'og rin chen sgang dung 'og 'bum sde gling dung 'og btsan mkhar dung cadag bkra shis sgang cha zhabs nas rtse mig dung cadag bar cho gsum dung 'og rong thung drung 'og ra dhe drang 'og la ling grang 'og gzhong sgar cha zhabs nas 336

ba rgan dung 'og snga tshang dung 'og phyo tshang dung 'og tsa mang drung 'og gong 'dus dung 'og gzhal gzhong cha zhabs nas rta li dung 'og stag mo'i dung 'og 'byug rin chin sprungs cha zhabs nas dol shar dung 'og dol steng dung 'og 'byug rgyal rdzong 'og lam gong grang 'og 'byug chos sdings drung 'og lung gnyis dung 'og yul gsum dung 'og rdo mkhar dpon slob 'og nyas grang 'og gsang sbas rdzong 'og rdzong gsar 'og rgyal stag byung 'og brda ling dung 'og dar dkar bkra shis yang rtse'i cha zhabs kyi mi ser bcas lha la bzhi'i chab 'bangs su gtogs tshad la gnang spyin sdiyab/spyi lo 1748 rab byung 13 sa 'brug lor spungs thang du zhabs dung sku gdung dang ged gling sku gdung gdung brgyud gzim khang gis gtsos gtsug lag khang gtsang khang nyi shu spyir gser chab/ sgos mar me zhal zas rnams stong dang chig brgya/ nang 73 dkar dmar 'dres pa sum cu so bzhi/ mdzod thung bzhi bcu lke gsum/ sman rnying la bzhi bcu tham pa phul/ spung sa thang cha zhabs nas rnam rgyal rtse sku gas lha khang brtso lnga rnams su sku brnyan che chung 'dres pa sum brgya dang sku1 gsum la zhal gser/mgo gnyis/ mjod thung dkar dmar bcu dug 'dom 'khor dgu/ sman rnying la so bdun/ gos chen kha gsum/ byang 'dar 'dom 'khor gnyis/ sgos mar me zhal zas rnams stong phrag gcig mgar sa bkra shis mthong smon du/ bla ma lha lang / ka bzhi ma/ gzim cung bcas par sku brnyan bzhi bcu zhe bzhi la gser chab/ gos chen dmar po la gsum/ mdzod ring gnyis/ mdzod thung bzhi/ sman rnying la bzhi/ sgos tshe zhal gsum brgya mchede gcig gdan sa lcags ri dang bkra shis cesas rdzong gi 337

ba rgan dung 'og snga tshang dung 'og phyo tshang dung 'og tsa mang drung 'og gong 'dus dung 'og gzhal gzhong cha zhabs nas rta li dung 'og stag mo'i dung 'og 'byug rin chin sprungs cha zhabs nas dol shar dung 'og dol steng dung 'og 'byug rgyal rdzong 'og lam gong grang 'og 'byug chos sdings drung 'og lung gnyis dung 'og yul gsum dung 'og rdo mkhar dpon slob 'og nyas grang 'og gsang sbas rdzong 'og rdzong gsar 'og rgyal stag byung 'og brda ling dung 'og dar dkar bkra shis yang rtse'i cha zhabs kyi mi ser bcas lha la bzhi'i chab 'bangs su gtogs tshad la gnang spyin sdiyab/spyi lo 1748 rab byung 13 sa 'brug lor spungs thang du zhabs dung sku gdung dang ged gling sku gdung gdung brgyud gzim khang gis gtsos gtsug lag khang gtsang khang nyi shu spyir gser chab/ sgos mar me zhal zas rnams stong dang chig brgya/ nang 73 dkar dmar 'dres pa sum cu so bzhi/ mdzod thung bzhi bcu lke gsum/ sman rnying la bzhi bcu tham pa phul/ spung sa thang cha zhabs nas rnam rgyal rtse sku gas lha khang brtso lnga rnams su sku brnyan che chung 'dres pa sum brgya dang sku1 gsum la zhal gser/mgo gnyis/ mjod thung dkar dmar bcu dug 'dom 'khor dgu/ sman rnying la so bdun/ gos chen kha gsum/ byang 'dar 'dom 'khor gnyis/ sgos mar me zhal zas rnams stong phrag gcig mgar sa bkra shis mthong smon du/ bla ma lha lang / ka bzhi ma/ gzim cung bcas par sku brnyan bzhi bcu zhe bzhi la gser chab/ gos chen dmar po la gsum/ mdzod ring gnyis/ mdzod thung bzhi/ sman rnying la bzhi/ sgos tshe zhal gsum brgya mchede gcig gdan sa lcags ri dang bkra shis cesas rdzong gi 337

macerdzod khang rnams la gser chab/ snyan shal/ ma3snad pa yang yang phyal ba grangs kyis mi che da/ bkra shis cerdzos rdzong cha zhabs nas/ gdan sa rta mgo sogs lha khreng sum cu so bzhi rnams su sku brnyan che chung sna chogs stong phrag gsum dang drug cu re gsum la zhal gser/ gos chen la lnga bcu/ nang mdzod tshon sna 'dres pa so bzhi/rtse sgrod gya gnyig nyi mdzod bcu gsum/ brgyad sbas bcu/ dar ling can 'dres 5/ga gsum/ sprodas mar zhal gsum rnya nga phrag gnyis dang nyis brgyacatshe/ /rin srungs pho brang nang / bla ma lha khang / rta mgrin lha lang / 'du lang /mgon khang chen mo/ phyag mdzod/ dpon slob gzim khang / de yangs kyi lha lang rnams su sku brnyan che chung brgya dang nyer bzhi la zhal gser/ mdzed rnying grag nyi mdzod bzhi/ rtse sprod bcu gcig gos chen la dgu/ sman rnying la bcu dug dar 'ing sngo/ga gcig 1snas mar zhal gasnge/ma lnga brgya re/ rin sprungs cha zhabs nas/ 'bras la bsam gtan rtse mo sku gas lha khang lnga bcu nga gcig rnams su skru brnyan che chung sum stong nyis brgya brgyad la zhal gser/ gos chen la dgu/ mjod rnying brgyad/ phyi mgo tshon 'dres zhe gcig rtse spyod lnga bcu nga brgyad/ sman rnying la brgya dang nyer lnga/ dar ling tshon 'dres yug bdun/ sgos mar zhal zas sum stong re/ dbang 'dus pho byang du skru brnyan che chung stong dang lnga brgya la zhal gser/ gos chen la lnga/ mdzod gcig phyo mdzod gnyis/ rtse sprod dug sman rnying la lnga/ sgos mar zhal zas rnams nyis brgyu/dbang rdzong cha zhabs nas/ bar grong lha khang sogs lha khang drag cu re gcig rnams su sku brnyan che chung gsum stong lnga brgya bcu gsum la zhal gsor/ cerdzos chen tshon 'dres la bdun/ mdzod phyo nang 'dres pa bco brgyad/ rtse sprod re bdun/ sman rnying khu don 338

gnyis/ sman bar khra la nyer lnga/ dar ling chon 'dres yug bzhi/ zangs khra bzhi/ sgos mar zhal zas rnams stong dang chig brgya/ ཿtshes 'khor rab brtan rtser/ bla ma lha bang / ka dug ma/ gzim cung / spyan ras gzigs lha khang / dngul 'bum lha khang rnams su sku brnyan che chung brgya dang dug la zhal gser/ sku(sa chen la bcu gsum/skud rnying sngo dkar 'dom 'khor gsum/ rtse spyod bzhi/— min rnying la nyer gcigasgos mar zhal zas rnams nyis brgya/ ceras rtse'i cha zhabs nas/ stag rtse'i lha khang gong 'og sogs lha khang sum cu so brgyad/ bya dkar rdzong gi mchod khang gnyis/ sku rjes lha khang sogs lha khang lnga bcu nga gsum bcas kyi skru brnyan che chung bzhi stong sum brgya bcu gcig la zhal gser/ gos chen la zhe dug mjod brgyad/ rtse sprod brgya dang nyi shu/ sman rnying la nga bdun/ sman bar kra yug gsum/ rgya gar sman rtse yug bzhi /byang dar chos sna tshe gas yug bcu ste/ra/ rgya dar yug la shas/ mar gro la khal gsum gyi mar me/ zhal zas nyis stong / sgos lnga stong bzhi brgya/ 'thul mi do dam/ mchod 'thul ba/ lha bris pa rnams la yang gser dngul zho bcu skedar/ ma ṭam brgya phrag lhag pa/ thong sna du ma'i gnang cha mdzad/ de bzhin dgon sde so so'i bla ma rnams dang / spyi sar gos dar khro ma ṭam sogs kyi gnang cha yang mdzad do/ /spyi lo 1749 rab byung 13 sa mo sgrul lor spungs thang mgon lang chen mor bskang ba rgyas pa dang bcas gser ṭam gsum/ zhe06 li la nas skyugs pa'i 'e ra bu khyim bya'i sgong nga tsam pa shel mdog tu 'tsher ba khyad thon gcig sogs rdzong gzhi thams cad kyi mgon khang du nor gya klu 'jim gser dngul dar gos rab gnas rgyas gsol bskang ba rgyas pa bcas sgrub pa'i yo byad ma ṭam nyis brgya sku brgyad/ lo 'dir mchodag sprul 339

gnyis/ sman bar khra la nyer lnga/ dar ling chon 'dres yug bzhi/ zangs khra bzhi/ sgos mar zhal zas rnams stong dang chig brgya/ ཿtshes 'khor rab brtan rtser/ bla ma lha bang / ka dug ma/ gzim cung / spyan ras gzigs lha khang / dngul 'bum lha khang rnams su sku brnyan che chung brgya dang dug la zhal gser/ sku(sa chen la bcu gsum/skud rnying sngo dkar 'dom 'khor gsum/ rtse spyod bzhi/— min rnying la nyer gcigasgos mar zhal zas rnams nyis brgya/ ceras rtse'i cha zhabs nas/ stag rtse'i lha khang gong 'og sogs lha khang sum cu so brgyad/ bya dkar rdzong gi mchod khang gnyis/ sku rjes lha khang sogs lha khang lnga bcu nga gsum bcas kyi skru brnyan che chung bzhi stong sum brgya bcu gcig la zhal gser/ gos chen la zhe dug mjod brgyad/ rtse sprod brgya dang nyi shu/ sman rnying la nga bdun/ sman bar kra yug gsum/ rgya gar sman rtse yug bzhi /byang dar chos sna tshe gas yug bcu ste/ra/ rgya dar yug la shas/ mar gro la khal gsum gyi mar me/ zhal zas nyis stong / sgos lnga stong bzhi brgya/ 'thul mi do dam/ mchod 'thul ba/ lha bris pa rnams la yang gser dngul zho bcu skedar/ ma ṭam brgya phrag lhag pa/ thong sna du ma'i gnang cha mdzad/ de bzhin dgon sde so so'i bla ma rnams dang / spyi sar gos dar khro ma ṭam sogs kyi gnang cha yang mdzad do/ /spyi lo 1749 rab byung 13 sa mo sgrul lor spungs thang mgon lang chen mor bskang ba rgyas pa dang bcas gser ṭam gsum/ zhe06 li la nas skyugs pa'i 'e ra bu khyim bya'i sgong nga tsam pa shel mdog tu 'tsher ba khyad thon gcig sogs rdzong gzhi thams cad kyi mgon khang du nor gya klu 'jim gser dngul dar gos rab gnas rgyas gsol bskang ba rgyas pa bcas sgrub pa'i yo byad ma ṭam nyis brgya sku brgyad/ lo 'dir mchodag sprul 339

mi pham 'byug sgu rnam rgyal ma ra ti kur sku mtshams ༷ la dus gser ṭam gser gyi ga'u ma ṭam bcu dug gi rdzid can gcig bde gshegs 'phel gdung 'khrul med gsum sogs nor bu'i rigs dang zab gos yug lnga dang thong sna bcu gsum sogs thul/lo 'di'i khrums zlar sngon pha jo 'byug sgom zhig pos ma 'ongs pa na chos sde 'byung bar lung bstan pa'i pha jo sdings su/ thub bstan bya rgod thung po'i gtsug lag khang dang / sgrub khang shi dza/ tham pa dus gcig la grub par mdzad de thub dbang shākya rata na dang / 'dus tshogs la rab gnas kyi 'bul nod/ las byed so sor yon gyi gnang cha/ gtsug lag khang dang sgrub sde la/ mchede chas dang nyer spyad kyi gtan 'jags/ mtshams gam ga rgyun 'ogs se gas gnang bar mdzad/ 'ordzo der bod nas bka' 'gyur gdan dungs te tshar dug cu re gcig klog tu stsal yon ma ṭam nyis stong nga gnyis/ bstan 'gyur tshar dug klog sku na ma ṭam dug brgya lke lnga/ 'bum dang mdo sde tshar dug cu tā ga sku na ma ṭam sku gsum/ 'di rnams dus gcig la bklags pa brjod kyis/ rgyun du klog pa dang dge 'dun gyis klog pa brjod kyis mi lang / gdan sa ra lung nyams gso'i phyir rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtshor dngul ṭam nyis stong rgya chings yug chen zong sna mang po phul/ 'byug pa rin po che dkar rgyud phrin las shing rtar zhig gsos zhal 'debs dngul ṭam nyis stong / zhu rten ma ṭam stong phrag sogs 'bul bar mdzad/ spyo lo 1750 rab byung 13 sdugs rta lor mchog sprul 'jigs med grags pa lcags rir sku mtshams 'i gsum gegs med grub pa'i dga' ston la gser dngul g.yu byu ru sogs dang / sman rnying yug gnyis/ mdzod thung bcu sbrel/zab gos mdzod chen yug gsum/ zong sna tshogs nyer gcig bco lnga tshan/ bcu gsum 340

tshan/ chibs sga dang bcas pa'i chibs pa thul/ rgyal sras rin 〈sna cher gser ṭam ma shem sogs zab gos mdzod chen gyis sna dungs bco lnga le tshan/ mkhan rin po che dang /'dus pa rgya mchor de dang cha mtshungs phul/ lo der bod rje dā las bha dur dang / stod sgar dpon dgung ye shes tshe brtan sku mched gnyis ma mthun bar zing kyen che tsam byung nye bar/ sems can mang po'i srog gi 'jigs pa spyob phyor/ rgyal dbang rtse'i zhabs dang / paṇa chen rin po che/ sa kyi gdung brgyud rin po che/ grub dbang rin sgo che/ bod rje dā las bha dur/ dgung kro mched/ se 'bras dge gsum bla ma rnams la so sor gser dngul zong sna bcas 'bul tshan mang po dang / sras mo bde ldan sgrol ma dang bka' sdusan bzhir ma ṭam sum brgya nga bdun gyi le tshan bcas 'thul gnang bcas/ dar dkar dpon slob/ bka' blon tshe ring dang nang gzan sum brgya skor la dngul ṭam stong phrag bzhi dang bcu bdu na/ rlon cha'i rigs rdzong lag so sor bkod nas gnang / me rkyu /da 'a rdzas/ mde'u bcas gzhung dang rdzong lag se se nas gnang ste rdzongs bde mdzad nas mgo zla'i nyer lnga la mings thang nas thon te rgyal zla'i nyer lnga la lha sar 'byor/ thugs bskyed rnam par dkar ba'i bden mthus 'phral du bde 'jam la song nas/ das zla'i nyer gsum la sprungs thang du slar 'byor/ g.yul rgyal mgon khang du gtang rag rgyas par phul/ ྅tshen smad rgyas par mdzad nas dar dkar da sgon slob la legs dar zhwa gos lham gsum rta sga 'the ra bcas dang / nang gzan so sor legs dar gnang spyin gya sna ma pa sal nas phebs 〈sna yang legs par gnang rngo / /spyi lo 1751 rab byung 13 lcags lug lor dpal shākya rin chen/ 'jigs med 341

grags pa/ 'jigs med seng ge/ shākya bstan 'dzin gyis dathus 'dus tshogs kyis 'khor lo bdun pa'i bsnyen pa dung sgyur la sgong sbyan sreg bcas legs par bsgrubs te/ zhabs grang mdun thub sku rgya gar li ma gcig lha gakhem gyi gu ru gtso 'khor gsum/ ཿdzhai gsam phyag rdor gter ma 'khyid gang ma gcig gser ljangs brdungs kyi 'khor lo g.yu byu ru'i khra can gcig rgya dngul gsol sder ma ṭam lnga brgya'i ljod ldan gcig rgya dngul gsol sder ma ṭam lnga brgya'i rgyud ldan gcig dngul kong khor yug gis gtsos bcu gsum le sngon/ ngajung brgyud rin po cher dzhai /khem gyi rnam 'joms 'khyid gang ma/ gser ṭam gcig ma ṭam nyer lngas bcu ga༄/ma le tshan/ de bzhin gong gi bla ma so so dang 'dus tshogs su gser dngul dar gos zong sna bcu gsum le tshan gyi 'thul ba mdzad/ lo der stod la dwags su rgyal po bde spyong gi thu khu tshan gyis blon chen no no tshul khrims bsad/ de'i thu no no dbang rgyal sprun la'ang ngan spyed sna tshogs bshams pas bong gnyis kyis la che'i dgang bton rtsis byas skabs chings bsgrig rgyu'i dgongs pa gnang nas/ rgyal po bkra shis rnam rgyal dang / no no dbang rgyal sprun la zhabs dung skru brnyan dang dam rdzas khyad can/ zab gos gser dngul sogs rub nyis stong chig brgya nga tshonasum 'gong gi gnang cha bcas sku tshab ngo ma rdzongs rta mdzad do/ / rispyi lo 175'a rab byung 13 chu sprel lor phyar pa'i lha tshogs brgya dang bcu dug bzhengs pa'i rgyur/ gser zho re bzhi/ dngul ṭam bdun brgya/ chu zangs sgo ri so gnyis serdzogs rgya che ba gnang zhing / grub ste/na la maḥtsheg sprul/ rnam gnyis/ mkhan rin po che/ 'dus tshogs la gser dngul zab gos sogs kyi 'thul nod rgya chen po dang 342

bzo rig pa rnams la yang de bzhin mdzad/ lo 'dir gser gyi rgya phibs chen mo gzungs gzhug khyad can baX/bas/spyi lo 1753 rab byung 13 chu bya lor rgya phibs chen mo'i zhig gsos kyi rgyur/gser gyi chab thum/ gser gyi phor pa/ gser gyi dpung rgyan/ lag gdub/ gser gyi nyag thag gar log gi gser/ lha ṭa la pa'i gser/ rgya gser dang bod gser lcug ma/ gser ṭam gser gyi 'khor lo/ / gser thigs che legs sogs gser ṭam stong dang dug brgya bco lnga'i rtsis dang / dngul chu'i rgyur gser ṭam sum brgya bzhi bcu tham pa ma ṭam snyad med nyis stong gter du gtams/ spyi lo 1754 rab byung 13me khyi lor ma ṭam nyis stong gi tshab tu gser ṭam sum brgyu bzhi bcu tham pa bcug pa 'di rnams mgon khang chen mo'i gser sgrom nang gnye ra du bcol nas yod/ lo der gdan sa sprungs thang gi phyag mdzod dang / bkra shis chos rdzong / dbang 'dus pho brang / rin mings phyag 73/ chos rtse'i phyag mgo/ ci dar dkar bkra shis yang rtse/ mgar sa bkra shis mthong smon phyag mjod rnams su gser dngul dar zab rin chen sogs gter du gtam pa smos kyis mi langs pa cerdzos rgyal rang gi rtogs brjod du gsal ba ltar ro/ / 'brog gling bzhi rdzong / spa spo 'byug rgyal rdzong / brdar 'dam tshang rdzong / mgon mgar sa'i rdzong bzhir dgra nyen che sar dgra cha yod pa nang zings skabs 'thor chibarlag tu song ba la/ me mda' gnam lcags rme tig dpag chen la hor/ dkar rgyal ma sogs dgra cha mang po gtan 'jog mdzad/gsang zab pho brang du 'bras zangs bre khal 'thum/ chig khri sum stong / chig brgya rnams mi rje rang gi phyag mthod thog nas ma gtogs gzhung gi khral bsdus sku(gas min 343

par rtsis sprod gtan 'jog mdzad/chu mo bya lor bzang gos yug chen nyis brgya brgyad cu lhag pa/ sman rnying yug chen zhe lnga sogs las mthong grol chen mo dang / bor nyer gcig phyed 'phyar che chung bzhi bcu/ rten khebs se gsum/ phangs khebs bzhi/ mchode khebs 'dom grag lhag pa/'dom bdun pa/ rta mgrin gos sku nyis thog bcas legs par bsgrubs/ mthong khrol tshangs thig 'debs dus dbu khyodags nas mkhan chen dang / zhabs pad khyodags nas thugs sras lnga pa 'gyur med macerag tshib dpal 'bar thig skrad bsnams shing / dbus nas mi rje nyid kyis thig gdab pa dang / dus mnyam rdza rnga dang rgya gling sgra rang 'grigs khu/nga zhing / zla ba bcu gnyis su legs par grub nas rab gnas dga' stesnan la/ rgyal sras rin po che dang / zhabs dung sprul sku se serdzor gser ṭam/ ti rub/ bal ṭam/ ma ṭam/ dar mdzod/ rtse sprod/ sman rnying yug/ na bza' cha tshang / gos mdzod chen/ dar ling yug a 31ma gos chen/ ka shi ma'i ras bzang yug chen sku gas le tshan nyer gcig ma/ batherdzo lnga ma/ bcu gaste/ma ma/ lnga ma se1gas 'thul tshan mtha' yas pa dang / de bzhin rje mkhan chen dang phyogs rnam rin po che'i sprul skru sde bgros bcas la yang 'bul tshan gtos che ba dang / 'dus chogs rin po che dang bka' blon rdzong sdod las sne snyo kha bzhi'i ddhin bdag mnga' 'bangs su gtogs tshad la gnang phyin stsal/spyi lo 1753 rab byung 13 chu bya zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu nas bcoms te mu khyud du bskor ba'i tshad 'dom re dug yod pa'i gser gyi rgya phibs chen mo bzhengs/ de la rgyu dngos khyon bsdoms ma ṭam chig 'bum/ bzhi khri nyis stong brgyad brgya gya dug 'khrul med du song / gser zangs gī bzo bo nga bzhi shing bzo lnga/ bzo chung brgyad cu 344
