tham pa ste shing bzo zhag bzhi bcu la grub cing / gser zangs 'o1 bzhi la legs par grub/ spyi lo 1756 rab byung 13 shing khyi lor rab gnas kyi dga' ston la/ zhabs dung sku gdung dang rgyal sras rin po che'i spyan sngar gser g.yu ma ṭam nang mdzod rtse sgo min rnying yug bzhi gos mdzod chen yug lnga zong sna 'dres le tshan nyer gcig bco lnga bcu gsum/ dgu ma bdun ma na bza' cha tshang sku gas dang dnge sa spyad mang po chibs pa rgya nag gser ༷ la chibs sga bcas sngerdzom ma ṭam chig rje nga grag brgya bzhi bcu/ zhabs dung sprul skur chig stong sum brgya bzhi bcu'i 'gong dang / rin po che'i sprul skur nyis brgya'i 'gong / phyogs rnam sprul skur brgya dang so dug dge 'dun spyi sar bdun brgya nyi dza/ tham pa'i 'askusnang serdzogs dang / las byed rnams la 'dzugs par grol ston gyi 'thul nod gnang sbyan gya noms pa dang / chos rtse'i dpon slob 'byug thun tshogs la na bza' cha tshang / rta sga 'chadar bcas ma ṭam grag brgya nyer gcig gi 'gong / spa spo dpon slob padmar ma ṭam gnyis brgya'i 'gong dang / spungs rdzong pa/thim rdzong pa sogs lto nang 'bod kyi bka' blon las sne sku tshab gnyer pa gnyis skal che ba gnyis skal dkyus ma/ chibs zhon tshogs thob dkar 'du ma dro rgyar thob pa sto gzan dkyus ma se gas tā kha bzhi'i mi ser grangs gong mtshungs rnams la gnang spyin thengs gsum pta song ngo / gangs rdzongs nas rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho nas sngar mthong grol bzhengs skabs zab gos rin thang can nyi shu lhag pa dang / sman rnying / nang mdzod sogs phon cher gnang / rgya phibs chen mo ra yang zhal 'debs ma ṭam khal chen lhag nges kyi gser bzang / spus sgyur ci zhus re ba las 'a/rdo/ga par stsal ba dang / rgya phibs

chen mo'i rab ston la/ thugs rje chen po'i skru gser zangs ma rin po che sna tshogs kyi phra can lnga 'dom rgyab skutshel can/ gnas brtan bcu drug tshems 'dub thang ka nyi shu rtsa gsum/ gser sung nyer lnga/ dngul rta mig ma bre chen lnga sogs rin po che'i rigs dang/ zab gos sprad thag yug dang mngags thags yug se gas sku bdun/ snang mdzod tshon sna lnga rdzogs tshar gsum/ gsed rtags tshon rdzogs tshar lnga/ rtse sprod tshon rdzogs bcu tham pa/ mdzod dkar po nyi shu rtsa lnga/ rtse spyod nyis brgya nyi shu/ sman rnying yug gsum/ na bza' cha tshang / rtse ja rdol chen 'khor drug nyer brgyad/ hu ja 'khor drug bzhi bcu/ ko rtse 'khor dug nyi shu sogs dang / mgyogs 'gro rin thang can gyi chibs sga bcas rtags brgyad kyis mdzos pa'i lha reg dkar po srid du ring ba bcas stsal/slar yang zhabs pad du rgya phibs chen mo'i dga' ston la/ 'jam dpal dbyangs gser zangs ma khru tshad gcig rgyal therdzo bka' 'bum glogs bam/ lcags phur khrol ma gser dngul gyi tshags can/ dung g.yas 'khyil 'du ba'i dbang ril/ nor thu klu 'jim che ba gcig sprul gyi dbang ril pad rag mdog can gcig gser ma bdun/khardzu ram ti rub stong phrag gcig sogs nor bu'i bye brag dang / rmeng chen che ba/bse rwa/ gcan gzan gyi pags pa sna snarags dang / tsan dan dkar dmar/ a ka prubatsod ltang / 'bras ltang mang po/ gser khrol dngos gtsang gi chibs sga bstad pa'i snyo rta bzang po gsum sogs ma ṭam nyis khri re gsum gyi gong thang 'bul bar mdzad pas/ rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho thugs shin hu dgyes pas mi rje 'di la bsngags brjod kyi chab lha ga gnang skyes bcas stsalakhab 'di ltar/ 346

chen mo'i rab ston la/ thugs rje chen po'i skru gser zangs ma rin po che sna tshogs kyi phra can lnga 'dom rgyab skutshel can/ gnas brtan bcu drug tshems 'dub thang ka nyi shu rtsa gsum/ gser sung nyer lnga/ dngul rta mig ma bre chen lnga sogs rin po che'i rigs dang/ zab gos sprad thag yug dang mngags thags yug se gas sku bdun/ snang mdzod tshon sna lnga rdzogs tshar gsum/ gsed rtags tshon rdzogs tshar lnga/ rtse sprod tshon rdzogs bcu tham pa/ mdzod dkar po nyi shu rtsa lnga/ rtse spyod nyis brgya nyi shu/ sman rnying yug gsum/ na bza' cha tshang / rtse ja rdol chen 'khor drug nyer brgyad/ hu ja 'khor drug bzhi bcu/ ko rtse 'khor dug nyi shu sogs dang / mgyogs 'gro rin thang can gyi chibs sga bcas rtags brgyad kyis mdzos pa'i lha reg dkar po srid du ring ba bcas stsal/slar yang zhabs pad du rgya phibs chen mo'i dga' ston la/ 'jam dpal dbyangs gser zangs ma khru tshad gcig rgyal therdzo bka' 'bum glogs bam/ lcags phur khrol ma gser dngul gyi tshags can/ dung g.yas 'khyil 'du ba'i dbang ril/ nor thu klu 'jim che ba gcig sprul gyi dbang ril pad rag mdog can gcig gser ma bdun/khardzu ram ti rub stong phrag gcig sogs nor bu'i bye brag dang / rmeng chen che ba/bse rwa/ gcan gzan gyi pags pa sna snarags dang / tsan dan dkar dmar/ a ka prubatsod ltang / 'bras ltang mang po/ gser khrol dngos gtsang gi chibs sga bstad pa'i snyo rta bzang po gsum sogs ma ṭam nyis khri re gsum gyi gong thang 'bul bar mdzad pas/ rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho thugs shin hu dgyes pas mi rje 'di la bsngags brjod kyi chab lha ga gnang skyes bcas stsalakhab 'di ltar/ 346

'ardo snabs 'byug sde srid nas mi sna gsol dpon ngo g.yog ched mngags gdong snga sor gos sku dang rgya phibs sogs gsar bskrun la dgos pa'i sku byad gang ci spus ka zhus gnang du ma zad mthun kyen yang rlabs chen sal ba'i bka' drin las snodas sku chi tshad gsar bskrun grub pa dang srongs thang gtsug lag khang gi rgya phibs kyang 'grub pargyu nye ba bcas rab gnas kyi dga' ston spu lo 1756 rab byung 13byi lo'i chod 'phrul zle nang du bgyi ཿrdzog pa yod pas 'di dag tshang mar gzhal bar dka' ba'i bka' drin med du byung ba'i legs 'bul dang / gtso bor deng dus 'gro mgon khyod kyi thugs rjes sa steng yongs la rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing 'gro ba thams cad bag yod bde spyod kyis 'tsho ba'i bka' drin snying nas dun te slar yang mtha' dbus bstan 'gro yongs kyi mgon skyabs dgang gnyen du zhabs kyi parmo bskal pa brgya phrag gi bar du brtan par gse la ba 'debs pa'i zhu yig pi warta can snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa'i tshig don phran sum tshogs pa/ rten rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi gser skuchos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i bka' 'bum cha tshang pod/ lcags phur bkrol ma/ nya klad nas 'thon pa'i rus pa dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gyi dbyibs can/ klu 'jim dpag chen gyi mde 'u tsam/ gdengs can gtsug gi dbang ril padma ra ga'i gdangs can sogs khyad nor dang byu ru'i rgyal lag stegs bcas/ che sa skyong gi rten rdzas la rung ba'i gser mda' g.yu sgro byur stong ma/ dngul mda' cha/ gser dngul spel ma'i gzhu g.yu dang byu ru'i phra ldan/ gser gyi mtheb skor/ gser dang byu ru'i 'phreng ba/ rje sgam po pa'i lugs kyi na bza' cha skor/ gser dngul gyi ṭam la/ gzhan yang 146 rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtshe 'i rnam thar brgya gcig gi rgyab gnyis pa nas/347

'ardo snabs 'byug sde srid nas mi sna gsol dpon ngo g.yog ched mngags gdong snga sor gos sku dang rgya phibs sogs gsar bskrun la dgos pa'i sku byad gang ci spus ka zhus gnang du ma zad mthun kyen yang rlabs chen sal ba'i bka' drin las snodas sku chi tshad gsar bskrun grub pa dang srongs thang gtsug lag khang gi rgya phibs kyang 'grub pargyu nye ba bcas rab gnas kyi dga' ston spu lo 1756 rab byung 13byi lo'i chod 'phrul zle nang du bgyi ཿrdzog pa yod pas 'di dag tshang mar gzhal bar dka' ba'i bka' drin med du byung ba'i legs 'bul dang / gtso bor deng dus 'gro mgon khyod kyi thugs rjes sa steng yongs la rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing 'gro ba thams cad bag yod bde spyod kyis 'tsho ba'i bka' drin snying nas dun te slar yang mtha' dbus bstan 'gro yongs kyi mgon skyabs dgang gnyen du zhabs kyi parmo bskal pa brgya phrag gi bar du brtan par gse la ba 'debs pa'i zhu yig pi warta can snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa'i tshig don phran sum tshogs pa/ rten rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi gser skuchos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i bka' 'bum cha tshang pod/ lcags phur bkrol ma/ nya klad nas 'thon pa'i rus pa dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gyi dbyibs can/ klu 'jim dpag chen gyi mde 'u tsam/ gdengs can gtsug gi dbang ril padma ra ga'i gdangs can sogs khyad nor dang byu ru'i rgyal lag stegs bcas/ che sa skyong gi rten rdzas la rung ba'i gser mda' g.yu sgro byur stong ma/ dngul mda' cha/ gser dngul spel ma'i gzhu g.yu dang byu ru'i phra ldan/ gser gyi mtheb skor/ gser dang byu ru'i 'phreng ba/ rje sgam po pa'i lugs kyi na bza' cha skor/ gser dngul gyi ṭam la/ gzhan yang 146 rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtshe 'i rnam thar brgya gcig gi rgyab gnyis pa nas/347

'phags yul dang lto rdzongs sogs kyi dpyad pa khyad du mtshar ba dang rta sga 'bor/gos dar ras cha snam rigs 'byu dkar se gas dngos 'gyor gyi 'thul ba rngams chen rin thang brjod par dka'i ba'i mchod sprin dang bcas rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi grwa pa lnga bcu tham par bsten bkur te zhabs pad brtan par gse la 'debs zhus shing / sde srid la gos skru rgya phibs se gas rnam dkar rlabs chen bsgrubs par legs se gzengs bstod kyi bka' lan pi warta snyan tshig gi lam nas bya ba 'chi med grub pa'i dbyungs snyan zhes pa sbal ba ni 'di lta ste/gdod nas nyer zhi 'pho 'gyur bral ba rdo rje snying po mchog gi kro / sgrib gnyis rnyog pa'i cha las 'das pa ye shes dam pa'i pha rol hu/ / son pa gang la shes bya thams cad dog med cig car 'char bakhrod pa'i/ / rgyal ba rnams dang dam ཿtshes bdud rtsi slob mar bcas pas khyod la srungs/ / bsod nams stobs kyi dasung pas byin pa yi/ / rgyal thabs nor bu'i cod pan bcings bzhin du/ / gtsug lag mang por blta ba'i 'dren byed can/ / sa spyad lha yi dbang po gang de la/ / gcig min shes bya du mar byings pa'i mdangs/ / rnam bkra tshe na brgya'i ris su shar ba las/ / rtse spos rlog bral shel gyi a dar sha / ya mtshan stong gi bkod pa ci yang 'dzin/ / che sa dkaralas kyi sa bon gtsang ma'i 'phrul/ / smon lam dag pa'i 'o lag rdzogs pa can/ /'bangs la sman pa ster ba'i dpag bsam shing / / deng skabs lha phyogs nags ma'i tshal du skyes/ / rang srid glang po'i stobs dang ldan pa'i lus/ / bag yod dal bur rgyu ba'i bgrod byed 'og / ches dman phongs dang rgud pa'i srin thu yang / / rang gi ṅka gnas mal bzhin du bag yangs spyong / / mngon mtho'i dpal 'byor 'bum du 348

brtsegs pa'i rdul/ / dbang phyogs sa 'dzin phrag pa la 'dzegs te/ / ce nga phrag zla ba rgyus pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ / lhag bsam 'od dkar khor yug kun tu 'phro/ / gang gi legs spyod ma la yar skyes gsar/ / kun phan sman gyi thung po'i lang tsho la/ / dam du 'khril ba'i chab 'bangs phal gyi shing / / rdzogs ldan gna' bo'i 'ongs su bsnyems pa mtho / / sku na tan khrag khrig grangs su gre la ba yi/ / 'dab ma bdud rtsi'i snying po dang ldan pa/ / yid ngor mtshar du che ba'i man ra/ / nam yang 'gyur ba sgangs pa'i rang bzhin nas/ /dri za dga' ba'i tshal du mngon rtsen pa'i/ / smin legs phang 'aX 'i rgyud las dungs pa'i glu/ / lus sredag rgyan gyi snyan tshig nyams spo gas pa/ /thos 'dzin dag pa'i bcud dang chabs gcig tu/ / 'jam dpal rdo rje'i byin rlabs gar thu ru/ / grub pa'i sku se gas gsang ba gsum gyi rten/ /bgegs dang kla klo'i sde 'joms snga ltas su/ / rten cing 'brel 'byung dge ba'i 'khrul 'bor sesgogs/ / bskusgod nams gzugs can ba'in du sar 'phe sa pa'i/ / rnam mang rgyal po'i khab nas carshangs pa'i rdzas/ / khyad 'phags dbyig gi bye brag sna tshogs pa// thugs 'dzin 'byor ba'i spun zlar 'phyur bur spungs/ / 'di na ches dkar las kyi nya lcibs 'og / dal dang 'byor pa'i khyad chos muka ti ka / glo thur nye zho'i dri dang mi 'grogs par/ / lhag bsam 'od kyi rang bzhin 'ong nas 'dzum/ / snang byed dkyil 'khor cha las mig gi rum/ / bsil spyin bdag po'i 'od las me char bzhin/ /dpyad gsum dag par ma byas gya gyu'i ngag / gtan spangs dung sredang chen po'i bden tshig la/ / yid dbang lhag par gtod pa'i blo spos sgo/ / ris med 'gro la phan byed nor bu'i gter/ / spyin pa'i slad du rnam par yangs mod kyang / / rang nyid dge 349

brtsegs pa'i rdul/ / dbang phyogs sa 'dzin phrag pa la 'dzegs te/ / ce nga phrag zla ba rgyus pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ / lhag bsam 'od dkar khor yug kun tu 'phro/ / gang gi legs spyod ma la yar skyes gsar/ / kun phan sman gyi thung po'i lang tsho la/ / dam du 'khril ba'i chab 'bangs phal gyi shing / / rdzogs ldan gna' bo'i 'ongs su bsnyems pa mtho / / sku na tan khrag khrig grangs su gre la ba yi/ / 'dab ma bdud rtsi'i snying po dang ldan pa/ / yid ngor mtshar du che ba'i man ra/ / nam yang 'gyur ba sgangs pa'i rang bzhin nas/ /dri za dga' ba'i tshal du mngon rtsen pa'i/ / smin legs phang 'aX 'i rgyud las dungs pa'i glu/ / lus sredag rgyan gyi snyan tshig nyams spo gas pa/ /thos 'dzin dag pa'i bcud dang chabs gcig tu/ / 'jam dpal rdo rje'i byin rlabs gar thu ru/ / grub pa'i sku se gas gsang ba gsum gyi rten/ /bgegs dang kla klo'i sde 'joms snga ltas su/ / rten cing 'brel 'byung dge ba'i 'khrul 'bor sesgogs/ / bskusgod nams gzugs can ba'in du sar 'phe sa pa'i/ / rnam mang rgyal po'i khab nas carshangs pa'i rdzas/ / khyad 'phags dbyig gi bye brag sna tshogs pa// thugs 'dzin 'byor ba'i spun zlar 'phyur bur spungs/ / 'di na ches dkar las kyi nya lcibs 'og / dal dang 'byor pa'i khyad chos muka ti ka / glo thur nye zho'i dri dang mi 'grogs par/ / lhag bsam 'od kyi rang bzhin 'ong nas 'dzum/ / snang byed dkyil 'khor cha las mig gi rum/ / bsil spyin bdag po'i 'od las me char bzhin/ /dpyad gsum dag par ma byas gya gyu'i ngag / gtan spangs dung sredang chen po'i bden tshig la/ / yid dbang lhag par gtod pa'i blo spos sgo/ / ris med 'gro la phan byed nor bu'i gter/ / spyin pa'i slad du rnam par yangs mod kyang / / rang nyid dge 349

ba'i 'bras thu chad nar bas/ / casnan te ga thur sman macerag bsregs pa'am/ / btul yang dri zhim 'dor min gzugs kyi zla/ / shin tu 'phongs pa'i gnas skabs de dang der/ / sems kyi brtan pa mi nyams smon par mchis/ / sa spyod khyod kyi grags dkar lha yi rnga/ / gtong ba chen por dpa' ba'i dbyug gu yis/ / bskul ba'i don ldan rang rtags snyan pa'i sgra/ / khor yug ri so'i bar du ldir ba bzhin/ / 'ja' ston thags su bkram pa'i za cadag ngos/ / e ḍi ya na'i rig 'dzin mchodag gi gzugs/ /'dab stong ge sar dbus su slar yang ni/ / skye ba sprul sku'i rang zhal bstan pa snyam/ /sprungs thang nor 'dzin lte bar lhun chags pa'i/ / rnam par rgyal ba'i khang brtsegs lnga brgya pa/ / chodas dang srid kyi longs spyod rgya che'i rlabs/ / sum rtsen spong khyer bzhin du yangs pa der/ / rin chen gser byings dpal gyis 'khyud pa yi/ / rgya phibs bkod legs khyad par gyis mtho ba/ / ngo mtshar gzi byin rtag hu 'bar ba des/ /nyin mtshan khyad par dbye la ngal ba byin/ / grub pa'i 'khor 'o/sa sgyur ba nā ro'i zhabs/ / mi yi srid par zlos pa 'byug pa rje'i/ / ཿwas srid dpyang pas 'degs pa'i dbang phyug gyur/ / sngon med rnam dkar lag rjes khyed nyid mtho/ /'phral dang yun gyi bde ba dam pa'i srog / 'phyog la sgo ba'i 'dod pa mi bzad ma'erton/ / ral gro'i 'o/ ma gtibs pa'i phang phyang la/ / phal cher dpag bsam shing du 'chis/ bas bshāsmo / 'khu/nga bar dka' la 'jig par sla ba dang / / phan pa nyung la gno/na pa du ma'i tshang / / khur du che la snying po ches chung ba'i/ / zang zing nor la dpyod ldan su zhig chags/ /de bas dam pas bsngags par casgos pa'i phyogs/ /ma ngas su btang bas bsod nams las kyi gzugs/ / 'dren byed yul du 'gyur ba'i 350

ba'i 'bras thu chad nar bas/ / casnan te ga thur sman macerag bsregs pa'am/ / btul yang dri zhim 'dor min gzugs kyi zla/ / shin tu 'phongs pa'i gnas skabs de dang der/ / sems kyi brtan pa mi nyams smon par mchis/ / sa spyod khyod kyi grags dkar lha yi rnga/ / gtong ba chen por dpa' ba'i dbyug gu yis/ / bskul ba'i don ldan rang rtags snyan pa'i sgra/ / khor yug ri so'i bar du ldir ba bzhin/ / 'ja' ston thags su bkram pa'i za cadag ngos/ / e ḍi ya na'i rig 'dzin mchodag gi gzugs/ /'dab stong ge sar dbus su slar yang ni/ / skye ba sprul sku'i rang zhal bstan pa snyam/ /sprungs thang nor 'dzin lte bar lhun chags pa'i/ / rnam par rgyal ba'i khang brtsegs lnga brgya pa/ / chodas dang srid kyi longs spyod rgya che'i rlabs/ / sum rtsen spong khyer bzhin du yangs pa der/ / rin chen gser byings dpal gyis 'khyud pa yi/ / rgya phibs bkod legs khyad par gyis mtho ba/ / ngo mtshar gzi byin rtag hu 'bar ba des/ /nyin mtshan khyad par dbye la ngal ba byin/ / grub pa'i 'khor 'o/sa sgyur ba nā ro'i zhabs/ / mi yi srid par zlos pa 'byug pa rje'i/ / ཿwas srid dpyang pas 'degs pa'i dbang phyug gyur/ / sngon med rnam dkar lag rjes khyed nyid mtho/ /'phral dang yun gyi bde ba dam pa'i srog / 'phyog la sgo ba'i 'dod pa mi bzad ma'erton/ / ral gro'i 'o/ ma gtibs pa'i phang phyang la/ / phal cher dpag bsam shing du 'chis/ bas bshāsmo / 'khu/nga bar dka' la 'jig par sla ba dang / / phan pa nyung la gno/na pa du ma'i tshang / / khur du che la snying po ches chung ba'i/ / zang zing nor la dpyod ldan su zhig chags/ /de bas dam pas bsngags par casgos pa'i phyogs/ /ma ngas su btang bas bsod nams las kyi gzugs/ / 'dren byed yul du 'gyur ba'i 350

skabs rnyed na/ / ste/nga gsum pha mtha' yas kyang brgal bar snang / / kun lte ga sems kto sgyu ma mkhan po yis/ / rang gi snang ba tsam du 'du byas kyang / / 'bras thu byang chub mtshog gi rang bzhin du/ / smin pa'i skal bzang thob par gdon mi 'tshal/ /de ltar legs byas te ga gi khyad par la/ / yi rang bsngags pa brjede pa'i skyes gsar la/ / mi ring dam ye bsre ba'i dga' ston skabs/ / spyo ba'i bya ma rta yang mngags par 'dun/ / ceras lugs legs par spyad pa'i bdud rtsi yis/ / nor 'dzin sim pa ster byed gang gi blo/ / lhag bsam chu 'dzin dkar po 'khrigs pa'i klong / / yun ring 'chi ba'i bden tshig dbyar rnga phyung / / snyigs ma ches cher spungs pa'i gor ma rdo/ / phyogs mtshams kun hu brdal ba'i rang mtshang 'di/ / rin chen dbyig gi snying por sgyur ba'i khur/ / bdag ltas bakhrod pa'i go skabs ga la zhig / cadan kyang lha dang bla ma'i byin rlabs srog / 'chi med rdo rje'i chodas su grub pa'i gter/ /deng 'dir rang gi bgo skal la spyad nas/ / yun ring 'tsho ba'i 'dun pa 'dor mi bgyid/ /slar yang dge legs 'byung gnas dad pa'i gzhir/ / gtong phed bag yod ngang tshul blo khros sogs/ / 'dod spyin nor bu brtsegs pa'i lang bzang la/ / 'tshe kyen phra mo'i go skabs rgyang bsrings te/ / legs byas rkang bzhi rdzogs pa'i dus ste/na cha/ / 'bangs la nye 'bon med par 'gyed bzhin gu / sim byed snyo phyogs rlung gis bskul ba'i mchid/ / sman du 'bab pa'i dri bsung chad med mjod/ /de skad rgya mcho'i lha mo las byung ba'i/ / rig byed seng ge'i rgyud mang bzhad pa'i dbyangs/ / sna chogs bdog pa'i zlos gar dang lhan cig / gyu 'dzin lang bzang masnu ga nas gtam du dge /zhes pa 35pa/351

spyi lo 1754 rab byung 13 shing khyi lor/ rgyal sras rin po che lo lnga'i cad rgyu gro la ba la/ legs 'bul zhabs dung sprul sku'i skabs bzhin phul ba dang / / 'dus sde rin po cher dgung lo dug cu longs nas thugs 'dun che na ma gtogs/ / gsung che ga dang sgrig sku gas dmang mnyam rgyugs mdzad mi dgos shing / / mtshan mo yang kun ra'i nye skor gang rshasnas su bzhugs pa dang / / las ka pa'i gral nas chogs dang thugs bzhed yod na lcags ri dang bya rgod phung po se gas la mtshams khungs su rgyun bzhugs nas/ ma ṇi stong tsa'i skal ba bzhes chog pa dang / yang sde las thon nas rang sa'i yul phyogs kyi rdzong lag rnams su bzhugs 'dod yod na bzhugs che ga cing / rdzong kha'i sgrig rgyug mi dgos/ par bdag kyen sku tshab ngo can dang mnyam zab bzhes chotsheg pa dang / gzhung phan tshun du bzhugs na dgung lo bdun cur 'o/ngas nas chibs zhon pa'i gras mdzad che ga pa dang / nad yun ring nas lo gnyis gsum song rung ma dug pa'i rigs kyang bdag kyen gong mtshungs kyi bka' tham phyag mdzod du bzhag par mdzad pa'i sri zhu sngar las lhag pa/'i srol gtod par mdzad do/ /spyi lo 1756 rab byung 13 shing phag lor thub dbang shākya rin chen mkhan po'i khri nas dgongs pa zhus skabs gser dngul dar zab dang / le tshan nyer gcig se gas ma ṭam chig stong lnga'i gong phyal nas zhabs pad brtan par gse la ba btab/mkhan po'i khri thog bstan 'dzin cerdzos rgyal mnga' gasku la ba'i legs 'bul ma ṭam nyis brgya bzhi bcu'i rtsis phul spyi lo 1757 rab byung 13 me glang lor chodas rgyal srong btsan sgam po/ sam sgo ṭa/mgar stong btsan/ bal bza'/ rgya bza' rnams dngul lhad med las bskrun ci nga 352

gzungs gzhug 'jig rten na rnyed par dka' ba'i gter byon skru gsung thugs rten 'phel gdung ring bsrel dang nor bu'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul ba mi dbang rtogs brjod nas gsal ba ltar dang / 'di dang kun gsal pho brang rab hu gnas pa'i dga' 〈snan dus gcig hu mdzad pa'i skabs rgya gar a 31ma nas rā dzas/gse ra gyi phreng ba/ gser gyi gha ṭa gser gyi rna rgyan dang dasung rgyan bzhes cen/dngul gyi thum pa skusnags 'thul dnge sa sna tshe gas bcas cerdzos rje 'byug par gus btud dang bslab ston zhu mi 'byor ba la yang sto nang mdzod sna lnga/ sman rnying yug sogs dar gos dang gsor gyi pha li/ gla rtsi/ rta gnyis sga chas cha tshang bcas gnang /mtsho chen brgyad/ dgon/ dbyar gzugs pa/ shar cho brgyad/ spar lung gi dpa' rtsal pa cho res 'gro dgos rigs dang / lhag par gling bzhi'i tsho res 'di zhabs drang dang chos spyong 'dus chogs thugs rjes/ da nas lung phyogs gar yang dus bde 'jags yod pas rbad gcod bka' drin bskyangs pa dang / sngar se la dar dkar ba'i dbang yon chum bre chig khri nyis stong brgyad brgya re/ spungs thang brgyud gling bzhir bcug pa de/ tsho res bsgo la nas grag stong brgyad brgya gling bzhir bkyil rgyu/bre chig stong nyis brgya spungs thang dang / bre bzhi stong brgyad brgya bkra shis chodas rdzong du chad gzhung pas bkyil rgyu/ zings kyen 'du shar na tshang ma gling bzhir bkyil dgos pa'i bka' tham yang gnang ngo/ /spyi lo 1757 rab byung 13 me glang lor/ bkra shis chos rdzong dbu rtse phyed gsar brtsegs/ rdo gcal phyed gsar bskyed/ kun ra phyed gsar bskyed se gas gzhi nas bslangs pa lta bu'i nyams bce sa mdzad/ sa stag mardzor/ bkra shis ceras rdzong 353

du dngul lhad med rub dgu stong nyis brgya las zhabs dung gi kro bzhengs/ sgam zhur chu zangs srang nyer dgu/ gser ṭam bcu tham pa/ mdun du sangs rgyas 'ede srung gi mtshoms mche ba 'khrul med dung dkar g.yas 'khyil dbyibs can shel gyi sgo khyim du kun gyis mthong bar bzhugs su gse la zhing / sangs rgyas 'phel gdung ngo ma bdun/ chu zangs rnam 'joms gter ma/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gter ma/ lcags phyar gter ma/ rje btsu ne ma'i kro tshigs la gyon pa'i spyan ras gzigs/ nor thu bsam 'phel/ klu 'jim/ rdo'i snying po/ rta'i rwa ba/ sgrul gyi dbang ril/ nya rtsib duji rang byon gser dngul sogs nor 9bu'i rigs dang / mas sku'i ring bsrel gzungs 5sngags mang pe bcas nang gzungs/ khyad 'phags phyag len ma 'chugs par 4 legs paru lnga/ba/ spyi lo 1760 rab byung 13 lcags 'grag lor/ rim rdzong zhig gsos legs par grub pa'i dga' (1na la/ rgyal sras rin 〈sna cher gser ṭam gas/ma/ ma ṭam bzhi brgyu/nang mdzod gsum sprel/ sman rnying yug gos chen gyis gtsos le tshan/ chibs sga 'khor bcas ma ṭam chig stong dug brgya bcu gnyis rtsis dang / zhabs grang sprul skur yang de dang cha mtshungs/ mkhan rin po che khri zur gnyis la yang / gser ṭam dngul ṭam sku gas ma ṭam dug brgya/ sum cu re'i rtsis phrul/ de bzhin rin po che'i sprul skuphyogs rnam rgyal sprul sku/ 'dus chogs rin po cher yang sku gsung thugs rten gser dngul dar gos rta sogs ma ṭam chig stong dug brgya nyer dgu'i rtsis/ de bzhin chos rtse'i dpon slob/ de 'og bka' blon che rigs phyogs kyi rdzong pa/ sku tshab/ gnyis skal/ chibs zhon/ tshogs thob se gas las sne thams cad dang / bzo rigs pa rnams 354

la gnang spyin yid mgu ba dang / 'ur las pa khri cho gcig lhag par zhag nyer gcig gi rgyugs tshwa sdor bcas gnang ba sku1gas 'grerdzo serdzong chung du rnams dang rgyags chas ma cus pa'i ma ṭam chig khri lnga stong sum brgya gya grag dang / snyo la bzhi'i mi ser grangs gong mtshungs la yang gnang spyin ma ṭam re stsal bar mdzad/ dus skabs der ka shi mir tshong dpon lū ta'am byar gdong zhes grags pa mang po bcas zhabs su phyag 'thul la 'byor te/ rgya gar/ la che/ rgya nag lams se gas kyi khyad nor mang po phyal/thag ring nas zhal la re ltos can yin pas gnang cha la/ dar gos dang gser gyi nyer spyad sogs ma ṭam chig stong lnga brgya dang dgu'i rtsis gnang / phyogs kyi dgon sde grangs gong gsal che ba rnams su bla mar gser zho gsum re ma ṭam brgyad cu/ rtse sprod/ sgam zhu/ ñdzi sa chag re grwa pa rnams la ma ṭam brgya re/ chung ba rnams su gser 'o re/ ma ṭam lnga re/ gzhan rtse nga mtshungs/ grwa par ma ṭam sum cu re gnang / sprungs thang mgon po'i sgrub mchod slabs/ zangs shin hu che ba chang sum mi rgyab brgya dang dug cu tsam shong ba brdungs shing / dngul snyad med rub brgyas yar spron gser gyi pa tā can lnga yang bsgrubs/ lcags sprul 'etor zhabs sgrul 'jigs med grags pa sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su/ rgyal sras rin po cher ma ṭam lnga brgya dang don gnyis kyi 'gong / mkhan rin po cher gdung bzhu dang dgongs rdzogs bsdoms ma ṭam bzhi brgya'i rtsis/ de bzhin bla slob 'dus pa rgya mtsho/ bka' blon/ rdzong dpon/ phyogs kyi spyi bla/ sku tshab/ gnyis skal/ dkyus ma sogs dang / lto la bzhi'i ri ser spangs gong mtshungs la gnang rgyun ma ṭam re stsal ba 'dis thengs lnga pa song /spyi lo 176 ra rab byung 13 chu rta lor rgyal sras mi pham 'byug sgra rnam rgyal sku 355

la gnang spyin yid mgu ba dang / 'ur las pa khri cho gcig lhag par zhag nyer gcig gi rgyugs tshwa sdor bcas gnang ba sku1gas 'grerdzo serdzong chung du rnams dang rgyags chas ma cus pa'i ma ṭam chig khri lnga stong sum brgya gya grag dang / snyo la bzhi'i mi ser grangs gong mtshungs la yang gnang spyin ma ṭam re stsal bar mdzad/ dus skabs der ka shi mir tshong dpon lū ta'am byar gdong zhes grags pa mang po bcas zhabs su phyag 'thul la 'byor te/ rgya gar/ la che/ rgya nag lams se gas kyi khyad nor mang po phyal/thag ring nas zhal la re ltos can yin pas gnang cha la/ dar gos dang gser gyi nyer spyad sogs ma ṭam chig stong lnga brgya dang dgu'i rtsis gnang / phyogs kyi dgon sde grangs gong gsal che ba rnams su bla mar gser zho gsum re ma ṭam brgyad cu/ rtse sprod/ sgam zhu/ ñdzi sa chag re grwa pa rnams la ma ṭam brgya re/ chung ba rnams su gser 'o re/ ma ṭam lnga re/ gzhan rtse nga mtshungs/ grwa par ma ṭam sum cu re gnang / sprungs thang mgon po'i sgrub mchod slabs/ zangs shin hu che ba chang sum mi rgyab brgya dang dug cu tsam shong ba brdungs shing / dngul snyad med rub brgyas yar spron gser gyi pa tā can lnga yang bsgrubs/ lcags sprul 'etor zhabs sgrul 'jigs med grags pa sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su/ rgyal sras rin po cher ma ṭam lnga brgya dang don gnyis kyi 'gong / mkhan rin po cher gdung bzhu dang dgongs rdzogs bsdoms ma ṭam bzhi brgya'i rtsis/ de bzhin bla slob 'dus pa rgya mtsho/ bka' blon/ rdzong dpon/ phyogs kyi spyi bla/ sku tshab/ gnyis skal/ dkyus ma sogs dang / lto la bzhi'i ri ser spangs gong mtshungs la gnang rgyun ma ṭam re stsal ba 'dis thengs lnga pa song /spyi lo 176 ra rab byung 13 chu rta lor rgyal sras mi pham 'byug sgra rnam rgyal sku 355

gshegs pa'i gdung bzhu dang dgongs rdzogs gnyis la/ khri rin po cher ma ṭam brgya dang zhe lnga'i rtsis/ mkhan rin po cher dug brgya lnga'i rtsis/ de bzhin bla slob gzhan dang 'dus chogs rin po cher 'bul nod gya noms pa dang / bka' blon/ gnyis skal/ dkyus ma rnams la yang gnang spyin stsal zhing / gangs rdzongs su jo shāka rnam gnyis sogs rten mang por zhal gser/ mchodad me/ snyan shal/ bla dpon 'brel mchis 'ga' la 'bul ba/ thed thim shar spar gyi dgon sde thams cad la 'bul nod dang / 'gyed ci 'os su gnang bar mdzad/ de nas thub dbang shākya rin chen dgongs rdzogs su/ bdag cag gi ston pa'i sku gser zangs ma gzhu 'dom lnga pa dang / nye ba'i sras brgyad snge/ma ༄rshag ma rje rang gi daskusgongs gtad bzhin legs par bsgrubs pa la/zangs rdzon dmar sung brgyad stong drag brgya tham pa/ gser ṭam drug brgya dngul chu sgor sum brgya dug cu/ gser btul ma zho brgya dang bdun cu/ gser 31ga dpal byin brgya bam nyis brgya lnga bcu/ mtshal dre re nyis brgya bcu gnyis skusnags rags rtsis ma ṭam nyis khri brgyad stong nyis brgya dug cu'i gong song / rab gnas dga' ston la mchodag sprul 'jigs med seng ge la/ gser ṭam/ ma ṭam/ mdzod sman rnying yug sogs le tshan nyer gcig ma ṭam bzhi brgya go gsum gyi rtsis dang / malan rin po cher phyag las khur mdzad pas gong mtshungs las nyis brgya lhag pacad/ / 'dus sde rin po che dang las byed pa'i rigs maḥrdzog dman bar ma thams cad la cesas bsnyun gnang cha yid mgu nges pa dang / spungs thang pa dang / bkra shis chodas rdzong sogs kto chibs zhon/ tshogs thob dkar 'du ma/ dro rgyar pa rnams ma ṭam re se gas gnang ngo / /blon chen sogs lto gzan rigs dang / cilto lad pa gzungs gzhug rigs ma the bar ma 356

ṭam sum khri dug stong bdun brgya song / rten 'di'i gtso 'khor gyi gzungs gzhug la chos sku'i ring srel mi rgyab nyis brgya/ rgya dkar nag li ma gtso bor gyur pa'i sangs rgyus byung sems yi dam chodas skyong nor lha'i skru rgyab lhag pa/ bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur tshar re/ rdo rje gter ma gsum/ sangs rgyas ring bsrel nor thu bsam 'phel sogs dngos gtsang bar bzhugs/ rabs chad bsdu ba zhes bu med pa'i ris kyi yul gzhis dpon gyis bsdu se la sde srid 'byug rab rgyas pas bcad pa/ shar phyogs su sngar srol dar ba'ang mi rje 'dis rgyun bcad pa yin/ rgya gar rgyal khams mug 〈co dang / ghaṭa la'i chab 'og rnams su sngar srol khyo ga shi res chung ma rnams kyang ro dang lhan cig bsreg pa yin 'dug pa/ sngar sde srid 'byug rab rgyas pas lan cig bcad 'dugakyang / bar zhig nas sngar bzhin byed 'dug par rta bzang nyi dza/ tsa grangs gla rtsi la sogs pa'i dngos nor stobs che ba gnang nas/ mu stegs byed dang 'brel ba'i lugs de 'du don med la sdug bsngal che tshul sku gas las 'bras kyi ཿtshes mang po gsungs te bka' gnang ste rbad chodas song ste/ sems can mang po'i srog skyob par tshad/ yang dharma de ba'i bu sngon nas chodas rje 'drug par bltos pa can yin pa/thug shu haṃ pa dang zings kyen phran thu byung bar brten cung zad rgyud pa yod tshul gsan pas/ mtha' mtshams kyi mi chen rigs la mthong bzos phan thogs che ba 'di/ rang bzhin gyi mi ser la phan slebs che bar dgongs rta bzang po bcu gsum/ gos chen gyi slog pa/ gos yug lnga sman yug gla rtsi thub nyi dza/ tsa grangs kyi gnang cha gya noms pa gnang / lha ṭa la'i rgyal blon rnams kyang snga phyo mang por gnas tshul gyi zhu yig dang /gser dngul gyi spyad mang po sogs 'thul ba grangs kyis mi chod pa byung / phyags kyi 357

ṭam sum khri dug stong bdun brgya song / rten 'di'i gtso 'khor gyi gzungs gzhug la chos sku'i ring srel mi rgyab nyis brgya/ rgya dkar nag li ma gtso bor gyur pa'i sangs rgyus byung sems yi dam chodas skyong nor lha'i skru rgyab lhag pa/ bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur tshar re/ rdo rje gter ma gsum/ sangs rgyas ring bsrel nor thu bsam 'phel sogs dngos gtsang bar bzhugs/ rabs chad bsdu ba zhes bu med pa'i ris kyi yul gzhis dpon gyis bsdu se la sde srid 'byug rab rgyas pas bcad pa/ shar phyogs su sngar srol dar ba'ang mi rje 'dis rgyun bcad pa yin/ rgya gar rgyal khams mug 〈co dang / ghaṭa la'i chab 'og rnams su sngar srol khyo ga shi res chung ma rnams kyang ro dang lhan cig bsreg pa yin 'dug pa/ sngar sde srid 'byug rab rgyas pas lan cig bcad 'dugakyang / bar zhig nas sngar bzhin byed 'dug par rta bzang nyi dza/ tsa grangs gla rtsi la sogs pa'i dngos nor stobs che ba gnang nas/ mu stegs byed dang 'brel ba'i lugs de 'du don med la sdug bsngal che tshul sku gas las 'bras kyi ཿtshes mang po gsungs te bka' gnang ste rbad chodas song ste/ sems can mang po'i srog skyob par tshad/ yang dharma de ba'i bu sngon nas chodas rje 'drug par bltos pa can yin pa/thug shu haṃ pa dang zings kyen phran thu byung bar brten cung zad rgyud pa yod tshul gsan pas/ mtha' mtshams kyi mi chen rigs la mthong bzos phan thogs che ba 'di/ rang bzhin gyi mi ser la phan slebs che bar dgongs rta bzang po bcu gsum/ gos chen gyi slog pa/ gos yug lnga sman yug gla rtsi thub nyi dza/ tsa grangs kyi gnang cha gya noms pa gnang / lha ṭa la'i rgyal blon rnams kyang snga phyo mang por gnas tshul gyi zhu yig dang /gser dngul gyi spyad mang po sogs 'thul ba grangs kyis mi chod pa byung / phyags kyi 357

la rgyar dgongs nas zhu don 'os can rigs dan khel ba dang / gos chen rta sogs gnang cha yang bor yug tu mdzad pa se gas/ chodas rje 'grag pa'i mnga' ris mtha' rgyas kyi ched du/ yul tshi tha dad pa'i mi che phra mang por bdag kyen mdzad pa brjod kyis mi lang ngo/ / gnang spyon grag pa song / spyi lo 176'a rab byang 13 chu pho rta lor/ mkhan rin po che bstan 'dzin che sa rgyal dgongs pa zhus skabs/ gser ṭam/ma ṭam bzhi brgya/ dar go sa serdzogs ma ṭam chig ste/nga lnga brgya'i rtsis phul te zhabs pad brtan par ga31la ba btab/ cesas rje ngag dbang phrin las mkhan khrir mnga' gsol ba yang / skru gsung thugs rten gser ṭam ma ṭam gos chen yug se gas bce lnga le tshan/chibs sga 'khor sogs ma ṭam bzhi brgya gya dgu'i rtsis phul/ chu lug lo'i zla dang po'i dus tshes bzang por mchodag sprul 'jigs med seng ge mnga' gsol ba'i legs 'thul rgyas pa/ 'dus chogs rin po cher mang 'gyed/ mdun na 'don dang nang gzan rnams la gnang cha dang / rje la bzhi phyin 'bangs grangs gong gsal rnams la ma ṭam re ma'i gnang spyin stsal ba 'dis lan bdun song ngo / /de nas lo nyi shu tham pa song nas sde srid khri thog nas dgongs pa zhus te 'byug phun tshogs legs 'bul du ma dang bcas mnga' gse la te ba ling rin chen khang bzang dang dbyar kun gsal pho brang du bzhugs te/ 'phral yun gyi bde ba thams cad sku gsung thugs rten rnams 'a/ macerdzod pa dang / skyes bu dam pa rnams la sri zhu bgyi ba las lhag pa med par dgongs nas/ shar tsa mace ga grong / snyo gha ) la/ nub dha li la/byang gling bzhi'i bar gyi lha khang thams cad la zhal gser/ snyan shal/ sgos/ mar me/zhal zas bla ma dang grwa sder mang ja dang gnang cha mdzad par/ gzhan rnams gong 358

gsal ltar dang / gong du ma 'bod pa/ bkra shis sgang / la ling snag tshang / dung mthar dgon pa'i lta khang / dngas sangs dartse na pa/ mthu mkhar dbosnan pa/ sgral dgon pa/ cong zhi dgon pa/ mkhar ru dgon pa/ khre phug lha lang / nye le dgon pa/da tig snag tshang / sag steng lha khang / phong mig lha khang / che 'gro lha lang / gyen 'go lha lang / sgo rang rtse'i lha khang / rtse mig snag tshang / 'jam kha'i lha lang / dgon ge sko ra'i lha khang / sbag gi gdung lha khang / gtor ma zhang tsha'i lha khang / spru ki ri'i lha lang / bsam gtan gling lha khang / ske dmar lha khang / ri gzhogs lha lang / ke se khri'i lha khang / gong thu gzims khang lha lang / ro thug snag tshang / spong phug lha thang / ri byedam lha lang / phug lha lang / bar ce'o gasnge/ma gyi snag tshang / zhus gnang chu skor/ bkra shis sgang gang lha khang / 'byug ཿtshes gling lha lang / ram gong ras lha lang / mnga' dbang lha lang / phra sgom dgon pa/ ro lam dgon pa'i lha lang che chung / yas/ 'phol dgon pa/ sa mtshams dgon pa/ dhu ti lha lang / sa gling lha lang / sbri gdung lha lang che chung / rgyan lung chu skor/ tshang zab lha khang / lhun grub rtse/ gling rgyal snag tshang / btsan mkhar lha khang / wang gur lha lang / wang zhing lha khang / ceras rje snag tshang / spyid pa'i lha lang / gdung lha khang / dkar phyag lha lang / 'khor 'o/'i snag tshang / 'khor lo'i lha lang / lug khyu'i lha lang / seng ge rdzong / rong mo steng lha khung / la bar lha lang / sgang dkar lha lang / gzhong lha lang / bkra shis gling /theg chen rtse/ stag mo chu'i snag tshang / gzar thang lha khang / dkar nyen dgo na pa/ltag ku'i dgon pa/ grod mo gzhong / dpal ri rtse'i dgon pa/ skye sa sbe'i lha lang /khyi mo zhing / khyi ni lha khang / la grong lha khang / rta she brag lha khang / gzhong smad lha 359

gsal ltar dang / gong du ma 'bod pa/ bkra shis sgang / la ling snag tshang / dung mthar dgon pa'i lta khang / dngas sangs dartse na pa/ mthu mkhar dbosnan pa/ sgral dgon pa/ cong zhi dgon pa/ mkhar ru dgon pa/ khre phug lha lang / nye le dgon pa/da tig snag tshang / sag steng lha khang / phong mig lha khang / che 'gro lha lang / gyen 'go lha lang / sgo rang rtse'i lha khang / rtse mig snag tshang / 'jam kha'i lha lang / dgon ge sko ra'i lha khang / sbag gi gdung lha khang / gtor ma zhang tsha'i lha khang / spru ki ri'i lha lang / bsam gtan gling lha khang / ske dmar lha khang / ri gzhogs lha lang / ke se khri'i lha khang / gong thu gzims khang lha lang / ro thug snag tshang / spong phug lha thang / ri byedam lha lang / phug lha lang / bar ce'o gasnge/ma gyi snag tshang / zhus gnang chu skor/ bkra shis sgang gang lha khang / 'byug ཿtshes gling lha lang / ram gong ras lha lang / mnga' dbang lha lang / phra sgom dgon pa/ ro lam dgon pa'i lha lang che chung / yas/ 'phol dgon pa/ sa mtshams dgon pa/ dhu ti lha lang / sa gling lha lang / sbri gdung lha lang che chung / rgyan lung chu skor/ tshang zab lha khang / lhun grub rtse/ gling rgyal snag tshang / btsan mkhar lha khang / wang gur lha lang / wang zhing lha khang / ceras rje snag tshang / spyid pa'i lha lang / gdung lha khang / dkar phyag lha lang / 'khor 'o/'i snag tshang / 'khor lo'i lha lang / lug khyu'i lha lang / seng ge rdzong / rong mo steng lha khung / la bar lha lang / sgang dkar lha lang / gzhong lha lang / bkra shis gling /theg chen rtse/ stag mo chu'i snag tshang / gzar thang lha khang / dkar nyen dgo na pa/ltag ku'i dgon pa/ grod mo gzhong / dpal ri rtse'i dgon pa/ skye sa sbe'i lha lang /khyi mo zhing / khyi ni lha khang / la grong lha khang / rta she brag lha khang / gzhong smad lha 359

khang / ku ru stod snag tshang / 'khor chu dgon pa/ gzhi len dgon pa/ dung dkar dgon pa/ kun bzang gling / gter sgang lha khang / spyid gling snag tshang / gnas kyi lha lang / thim yul lha khang / spyod gling lha lang / bskor dga' gling lha khang / sgang zur lha khang / gzhong mkhar / tsa mang lha khang / cha gling lha khang / tsakli lha khang /mdo nges lha khang / gtor gzhong lha khang / snga tshang lha khang / ri gling lha lang / ya lha lha khang / phyo tshang lha khang / lcags sa mkhar lha lang / sha mi dgo na pa/ g.yag sgang dgon pa/ kyen dkar lha khang / 'thur mi lha lang / ba rgan snag tshang / dgra med rtse'i lha khang / bde ba'i lha khang / na rim lha khang / smug hūṃ lha lang / dga' gling lha khang / lha nga 'dus snag tshang dang lta khang gnyis/ bkra shis yang rtse/ tsha li snag tshang /spol ston dgon pa/ gdung lu me na dgon pa/ sha shing dgon pa/ la gsar gdung pa'i dgon pa/ gser nyag dgon pa/ spang blang dgon pa/ mya ngan dgon pa/ dung dgon pa/ 'bum gling snag tshang / sha ldi steng dgon pa/ spang li dgon pa/ stod spyod dgon pa/ spar la cadag spen rtse/ cadan me lag mchan lha khang / bsam grub lha rtse/mang ri gdung / ma sha li gdung / btsan mkhar snag tshang / yi/ rgyan gling / nag byed lha khang / sha shing lha khang / gyang phyag dgon pa/ rab pad lha khang / lte mkhar lha lang / me nang sgang lha khang / rin chen sgang snag tshang / bsam gtan chetshes gling /lam 'phrang ḍiṭig gser khyim mang / dpal ri/ 'u/nga mar lha khang / mkhar brtan daskutshen pa/ bsam grub cesas gling / zhal gzigs mang / che legs dasku na pa/ bsam grub can/ bzong dkar lha khang / mkhar sa dgon pa/ gzhal gzhong rdzong / gdangs mkhar lha lang / bkre ngas lha khang / stag dung snag tshang / gong phyag lha khang / gong 360

thug sprul sku'i lha lang / ngag la lha lang / nye rog la'i lha khang / spyo dkar spyan pa'i lha lang / stag ma'i daserdzon pa/ stag ma'i lha khang / bsam mkhar lha kheng / rta li snag tshang / lang 'dor sbe'i lha khang / wa gdangs lha lang / bsam mda' lha khang /wa ngag snya khang / stong lam rsha'i lha khang / 'om gling lha khang / shing mkhar lha lang /shing mkhar gnas kyi lha khang / the rang lha khang / sbu li lha khang / bstan rgyas dgon pa/ rta li lha khang gsum/ dkyil mkhar lha khang / nya kha'i lha khang / nor thu sgang /srin chogs dpal gling / gdung bsam snag tshang / khang pa lha khang / g.yu dung lha thang / mkhar lha lang / phu chu lha lang / phyo mo lha khang / ri sdings lha khang / pa tsho lha khung / khus gdung lha khang / mkhas ri dgon pa/ o ro lha lang / che na ri'i lha bang / ri mtshams lha khang / sha li la/ bde ba thang gi rdzong bcas la zhal gser dbus zho nyis brgya nyi dza// snyan dar/ gos chen yug nyis brgya/ nang mdzod sum brgya/rtse spyod sum brgya/ sman rnying yug dgu/ sman bar yug bzhi brgya/ dar ling yug brgyad brgya/ byang dar yug dgu brgya/ sprodas/ mar me/ zhal zas/ bsnge rten sku gas gya noms pa gnang / spyi lo 1765 rab byung 13 shing bya lor sde srid phun chogs gshegs dgongs rdzogs dang bye ba mchod rten gyi phyag las 'phyo bkyings par mdzad/ 'dus chogs dang bka' blon rnams pas slar sde srid mdzad par gasku la yang / sku na smin pas mi rtsogs tshul gsungs nas/ mi dbang bstan 'dzin mnga' gsol bar mdzad/ sgong dag chen mo mdzad de gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug 'bum gter bsgrub pa'i dga' ste/na la/ maḥtsheg sprul 'jigs med seng ge'i zhabs 361

pad du gser ṭam lnga dang ma ṭam chig stong sogs dang / zab gos yug chen nyi shu tham pa'i gcesas pa'i le tshan nyer cig ma/ bcu dgu ma/ bcu bdun ma/ bco lnga ma/bcu gasnge/ma / bcu gnyig dgu ma bcas le tshan bdun gyis ༄snag grangs ma ṭam bzhi stong nyis rlobargya nga bzhi/ de bzhin sde srid khri zur/ mkhan po khri zur/ 'dus tshogs rin po che slob dpon rdzong dpon dpon slob gnyis skal chibs zhon sogs dang /snyo kha bzhi'i mnga' 'bangs spyir gnang zhun stsal ba 'dis gnang spyin lan brgyad dang / tsho chen brgyad la lan gnyis bcas bsdoms lan dgu sku nga /de ltar cerdzos rgyal shes rab dbang phyug gi bstan srid bskyangs tshul mdzad pa shin hu rgya che ba rgyas par dge ba'i cer ga rab hu gsal ba'i gtam mu tig therdzo shal du gsal zhing / 'dir mdor bsdus te bris pa ste lha khang rnams kyi ming bkod dgos pa ni/sde srid 'di nyid gcig su'i mdzad rnams las gsal ba ma gte gas/ gzhan sngerdzon dang kyis kyi sde srid gzhan rnams gī skabs lta zhog sngar zhabs dung gi skabs su yang lto rdzongs nang 'bod phyogs so sor 'bangs mi ser yul spong rnams su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i rtags lha khang ji tsam yod pa gsal po med par brten 'dir bris pa yin la/ dgos pa ni gang zag re zung rjes su yi rang gi dge ba thob phyir dang de lta thu byed nus par shog / ces smon 'dun bya ba'i phyir ro/ / de skabs nad mug 'khrugs rtsod med par mnga' thang rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la spyod bzhin pa'i ngang nas dgung grangs don gnyis la zhi bar gshegs/ sku / /362

sde srid bcu bzhi pas bstan srid bskyungs tshul/ ༄༄/ / sde srid bcu bzhi pa 'byug phran chogs ni/ stod wang nas ya rabs dam pa'i rigs su sku 'grings/ chung dus nas ཿtshes rje 'byug pa'i sgrig lam la zhugs te chos srid lugs gnyis kyi rnam gzhag la rang byan tshud sdu/ra byings/ de nas thog mar chos 'khor rab brtan rtse'i dpon slob mdzad/ dpon slob 'byug phran chogs zhes blo spos kyi nyi mas phyogs gsal bar byed pa zhig yod pa des/ gser gyi rgya phibs brgya byin thogs pa'i nor thu btso blag pa zhig gis/ mthu chen ngag gi dbang po'i chos kyi 'o brang chos 'khor rab rtan rtse zhes bya ba'i dbu rtse g.yogs par byas so/ /de'i rab tu gnas pa'i dga' ston la gdan 'dren gyi bya ma rta zhu yig thogs pa cadangs bas/ zhes gsal ba bzhin de skabs paṇa chen bstan 'dzin ceras rgyal snga phyo lan gnyis gdan dungs te chodas kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing / dbu rtse gser gyi rgya phibs bkal ba'i rab gnas kyi dga' sde na rgyas par mdzad 'dug /rim gyis thim phya bkra shis chos rdzong du rdzong dpon gyi go gnas thob/ de skabs chos rgyal shes rab dbang phyug dang mkhan rin po che bstan 'dzin ཿtshes rgyal mchod yon zung gdan sa bkra shis che sa rdzong zhig gsos kyi bka' bgros mdzad de/ gzhi nas gsar bzhengs lta thu mdzad pa de la/ mkhan bstan 'dzin ཿtshes rgyal gyis rdzong dpon 'di nyid la gsungs tshul/ dezha steri lo gsum gyi ring rdzong 'di'i zhig gsos kyi 147 bstan 'dzin chorshas rgyal gyi rnam thar rje sku na tan mtha' yas kyis mdzad pa sgyu ma chen po'i sgar stabs re bzhi'i mdun nas/ 148 rtogs brjod sgyu ma chen po'i gar stabs don dgu'i mdun grag pa nas/363

khur 'khyer ba po ni/ rnam dpyed kyi nor can rdzong dpon 'grug phun tshogs te/ 'di phan sems dang blo stobs dang snying sran dang gtong phod che la/ 'jam rtsub ran pa'i thabs kyis bskosnal mkhas pas dka' tshogs cher med pa grub pa yin/ zhes gsungs 'dug de nas rim pas 'byug rin chen spungs kyi dpon slob bskos/ paṇa chen bstan 'dzin cerdzos rgyal gdan dungs te bsten par rdzogs te mtshan bstan 'dzin 'byug sgu zhes gnang / dpon slob 'dis snga phyo mang por longs spyod kyi dngos po thul ba'i rnam grangs brjod kyis mi lang zhes gsungs 'dug / dpon sle ba bstan 'dzin 'byug sgra nas spyin bdag mdzad de paṇa chen bstan 'dzin ceras rgyal dang / 'jam dbyangs shākya bstan 'dzin sku gas kyis spa spo stag tshang du dartse ngas 'dus kyi sgrub chen bdud rtsi snu sa sman bcas zhag nyer gnyig gi bar bsgrubs par mdzad/ de'i tshe dkyil 'khor gyi dathus su 'ja' kha dog lnga ldan thug pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rtags mtshan mang po byung zhing / der dpon sle ba bstan 'dzin 'byug sgu 'o rang byon te sman gyi sgrub chen grol ba'i dga' ston rgyas par mdzad/ de skabs paṇa chen bstan 'dzin che sa rgyal nas dpon sle ba bstan 'dzin 'byug sgra yis lto la bzhir lung sgyur ba'i rten 'brel yang bsgrigs zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ mi ring bar cerdzos rgyal shes rab dbang phyug sku na smin te dgongs zhu mdzad pa'i rgyal tshab tu dpon sle ba bstan 'dzin 'byug sgra spyi lo 1763 dang rab byung 13 chu lug zla nya po la sde srid kyi khrir mnga' gse la nas dpal ldan 'byug pa'i bstan srid dbu 'phang dgung du bstod cing / snyo la bzhi'i 'bangs mi ser rnams la byams skyong dang / sngar zhabs dung rin po che'i phyag bzhes bzang po'i srol 'jig rten na 'phral yun gyi phan bde'i rgyu bye 364

ba mchod rten gyi phyag las mdzad bzhin pa'i 'phror/ dbyin lo 176pa rababyung 13shing byu lo zla 'a pa'i nang glo bur du snyun dug po thebs te gsang zab du phebs/ sku rim dang sman dpyad gang gis kyang ma phan par rje mkhan po bstan 'dzin ceras rgyal dang mi rje shes rab dbang phyug la phyag thal mo sbyar te bye ba masnu da rte na las 'phyo ma 8 'khyol ba zhig bka' drin skyongs/ da bzhugs shig ces dang / gam du 'khod pa rnams la 'pho ba'i gserdzol 'debs gyis shig gsungs nas bde bar kri gshegs so/ /sde srid bco lnga pa 'byug bstan 'dzin gyis che sa srid bskyungs pa/༄༄/ / sde srid 'grag bstan 'dzin de nyid skru 'khrungs pa'i yul smad wang nas yin 'dug chung dus nas chodas rje 'byug pa'i gdan sar sgar lto'i gral du gtogs pa nas lugs gnyis kyi la 'o/ gyen du 'degs nus pa'i skyes thu dam pa zhig yin pa las/dbang 'dus pho brang gi rdzoṭa dpon mdzad de rim gyis sprungs thang rdzong dpon gyi go gnas su bzhugs pa'i skabs sde srid 'byug phran tshogs gle thur du bsnyungs te sku gshegs pa na/ cesas rgyal shes rab dbang //ga la dge 'dun pa dang bka' blershan rnams kyis slar sde srid mdzad gnang zhes zhus gserdzol 'debs kyang / sku na bgres stabs kyis mi lce gas tshul gsungs nas mi rje 'di nyid 'os bab hu gzigs te spyi lo 176pa rab byung 13 shing bya lor bka' blon dpon lag lhan rgyas dang bla slob 'dus 365

tshogs spyi mthun gyi dbus su sde srid kyi khrir mnga' gsol bar mdzad/ rta4rlo kyi rgyal po chen po bstan 'dzin zhes grags pa don dang ldan pa mi rje dam pa 'dis/ rang nyid lugs gnyis kyi byed po ra seng ge'i khri 'phang mthon por phebs ma thag tu/ rgyal sras ngag gi dbang po'i dgongs bzhed phyag las kyi 'phyo/ gsang sngags phyo nang gi lha mang po'i sku brnyan bye ba mchod rten gyi la bskangs te/ yul bal po'i bzo bo dag gi rig byed kyis bskyed ba'i dri gtsang khang 'di gser tshon gyis byugs shing gser gyi rgya phibs dang ma2de rdzas ya mtshan can mang 〈snas brgyan par mdzad nas/ rab hu gnas pa'i ston mo rgyas pa dang 'brel bar snyo rdzongs skye rgur gnang spyin stsal/de nas bdag cag gi ston pa shākya thub pa dgung 'o/ bcu gnyis pa'i tshad/ ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa jo bo ro/kya mu de'i kri tshad ma/ rgyal khab chen po bkra shis chodas rdzong du bzhugs pa 'di bzhengs par mdzad pa yin la/ zhes dang / de snarnyi rgyal ba'i bka' gangs can gyi rdzongs su 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi susta ka brgya dang gcig dri med 'os dang dkar chag bcas lams sde dge'i sa skyong chen po bstan pa tshe ring gis sbyan bdag byas nas dmi bstan pa'i nyin byed dpal gtsug lag che sa kyi snang ba zhes bya bas dag byed kyi gtso bo mdzad de bzhengs pa'i mtshal par ma de la ma phyo byas/ snag 3/ga sogs rgyu dngos kyi rigs mi ser la khral bkod sogs gzan cha spu tsam yang med par phyag nas stsal zhing / yig mkhan gyi bza' btung sogs kyang gzhung gnyer tshang la gzan sgo ci yang med par sgor gyi phyag mjod nas 149 rje yon tan mtha' yas kyis mdzad pa bka' 'gyur dkar chag chodas kyi dung chen po skye ba lnga pa'i dbyangs kyi lnga'i rgyab nas/ 150 ldeb bcu gcig gi mdun phreng gnyis pa nas/366

rma ri la gya 〈snams pa gzab sbyo/sa tsu/na chags sa/ gnang ste/ thams cad 'asdokyil zhes pa me slo phag lo'i mgo zla'i gral chos dge bar dbu btsugs/ snyo nang gi yig mkhan bzang ke gu bsdus nas so so'i yi ge rgyugs bzhes kyi thog yi ge cung zad zher ba dag gnang cha 'os rigs dang bcas blosag pa'i dug bsdus yig mkhan lnga bcu lhag tsam gyis dal zhing snyod la brel g.yengs nus bar chad med par snga dro nam langs tsam/ nas dgong mo yi go mig chod kyi bar du bris/ zhus dag gtso bo brda spyod pa'i slob dpon chen po bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gyis 'khur bzhes mdzad/ bar skabs /rdzo nang 'dir bzhengs ge'i bka' 'gyur la dag 3/sa su bgrang bar cadas pa nyid do/ /'a85 ldang 'brel bar 'phags pa thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa thog tshad ma gso ra zangs 04sa/ grub pa bzo dbyibs khyad du thon pa rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phra tshom can dang / sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi gral thang dngos gtsang dgu dang / dri gtsang lang gsar mar gsor 3ron sna 31gas kyis bkrag pa sku'ogs legs par bsgrubs te/ thams cad 'dul zhes pa me mo phag mardzo'i gral tshes dge bar rab tu gnas pa'i dga' ston lha mi kun tu dga' ba'i ltad mo sna tshogs bcas rgyal po'i 'gyor pa chen pos bkra shis par bgyis sku / / zhes gsal ba bzhin dus yun thung ngu spru bstan srid la sman pa'i mdzad pa'i phyag rjes rgya chen po bzhag cing rgyal srid cesas bzhin du bkying 'phyor snyo rdzongs kyi skye dgu'i bsod nams dman pas spyi lo 1768rab byung 13 sa byi zla 11 gnam stong la bde bar sku gshegs so/ /151 ldeb bcu gsum gyi mdun phreng lnga pa nas/ 367

sde srid bcu drug pas chab srid bskungs tshul dang rim rdzong me 'jigs gnyis pa 〈snang ba rgya 'grug 'aX/gas pa/༄7 / / sde srid bcu grag pa bsod nams lhun grub bam yongs grags su bzhi dar zhes grags pa ni/ wang sbed med yul nas 'khrungs shing pha ma shi ba'i dwa phrug lto gos dkon pas dgun la mtshan mo glang gi drod la 'jar te nyal bar yang bshad/ thog mar rtsi rang srang srung pa'i bya rogs byed de sdod skabs gzhung du 'bul ba phrul bar thon pa dang / dge 'dun grwa tshang nas rud pa kun dga' rin chen dang 'phrad de spogs bshes byas/ de las bzhi dar rim gyis rtsi rang srang srung ba thob/ de nas snu sa 'khor rab brtan rtse'i dpon slob kyi go gnas thob ste der sdod pa'i skabs mchod khang rgya bskyed de gsar pa bzhengs nas/ gzhung du paṇa chen bstan 'dzin ཿwas rgyal mkhan po mdzad skabs cerdzos 'khor rab brtan rtser gdan dungs nas btsun gsar mang du bsdus te rab byung gi sde btsugs par mdzad tshul/ ny-i kās shar phyogs kyi rgyal khams/ dge bar skyong ba dpon slob bzhi dar zhes bya bas/ chos 'khor rab brtan rtser mchod lang chen po zhig gsar du bzhengs/ der shar phyogs kyi 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i yon yongs su byings shing bsod nams kyi zhing du dge 'dun dkon mchodag gi grwa zhig legs par 'dzugs pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pas/ gdan 'dren gyi nge nya ba zhu yig dang bcas slebs pas phebs pa shar/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa gnang ste bsod nams lhun grub ces ming sal/ zhes gsal/15'a bstana'adzin ཿdzis rgyal gyi rtogs brjod sgyu ma chen po'i gar stabs yon tan mtha' yas kyis mdzad pa gya bzhi rgyab nas/368

sde srid bcu drug pas chab srid bskungs tshul dang rim rdzong me 'jigs gnyis pa 〈snang ba rgya 'grug 'aX/gas pa/༄7 / / sde srid bcu grag pa bsod nams lhun grub bam yongs grags su bzhi dar zhes grags pa ni/ wang sbed med yul nas 'khrungs shing pha ma shi ba'i dwa phrug lto gos dkon pas dgun la mtshan mo glang gi drod la 'jar te nyal bar yang bshad/ thog mar rtsi rang srang srung pa'i bya rogs byed de sdod skabs gzhung du 'bul ba phrul bar thon pa dang / dge 'dun grwa tshang nas rud pa kun dga' rin chen dang 'phrad de spogs bshes byas/ de las bzhi dar rim gyis rtsi rang srang srung ba thob/ de nas snu sa 'khor rab brtan rtse'i dpon slob kyi go gnas thob ste der sdod pa'i skabs mchod khang rgya bskyed de gsar pa bzhengs nas/ gzhung du paṇa chen bstan 'dzin ཿwas rgyal mkhan po mdzad skabs cerdzos 'khor rab brtan rtser gdan dungs nas btsun gsar mang du bsdus te rab byung gi sde btsugs par mdzad tshul/ ny-i kās shar phyogs kyi rgyal khams/ dge bar skyong ba dpon slob bzhi dar zhes bya bas/ chos 'khor rab brtan rtser mchod lang chen po zhig gsar du bzhengs/ der shar phyogs kyi 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i yon yongs su byings shing bsod nams kyi zhing du dge 'dun dkon mchodag gi grwa zhig legs par 'dzugs pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pas/ gdan 'dren gyi nge nya ba zhu yig dang bcas slebs pas phebs pa shar/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa gnang ste bsod nams lhun grub ces ming sal/ zhes gsal/15'a bstana'adzin ཿdzis rgyal gyi rtogs brjod sgyu ma chen po'i gar stabs yon tan mtha' yas kyis mdzad pa gya bzhi rgyab nas/368

de nas spyi lo 1768 rab byung 13 sa byi lo zla nya' pa'i chos 4 la sde srid kyi khri la phebs pa nas/ dga' ba zhes pa spyi lo 1769 rab byung 13 sa mo glang lo'i khrums zla'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin/ /ris gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i thugs rje 'dus pa dpal ngag gi dbang po bstan 'dzin rnam par rgyal ba'i skru 'bag mthong spol chen po/ lha mgron/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs 'chings rabs lga sum chogs pas bskor ba/ rgyar gzhu 'dom bco lnga/ dbangs su gzhu 'dom bco lnga pa 'di bzhengs pa'i dathu btsugs te/ rgyal gyi zla ba tshes bco lnga ste zla ba bzhi'i 'ongs su legs par grub cing / zhar la phran sa/ma snangags pa bcu gnyis/ gu ru mtshan brgyad dang gtso bo bcas dgu/ bstan 'dzin chodas rgyal bcas zab gos kyi thang ka che 'e gas nyi shu tsa gsum/ 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs g.yos kyi snyed du khro chen bkra shis go 'bar sgor gzhu 'dom bzhi/ nang zheng 'dom dor nye ba dang / tsho chen brgyad kyi dpa' bo'i bdud rtsi'i snod khro chen bsod nams dpal 'khyil bya ba che chung gong ma tshungs bcas bsgrubs/ gnam 'o/ 'di'i nang rang res 'bad cerdzol gang yang ma byas kyang ho gzhung nas 'byug pa'i gdan sa phyo mo ra lung thel dang / bal po'i rgyal po nas 'phags pa shing kun 'byug gzhung la gnang 'dug pa mthong grol 'di'i mthu dang gzi byin gyis 1)sdu so/ / zhes gsal/ sngon gyi dus su paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen bzhugs shing thugs dam rdo rje'i 153 yon tan mtha' yas kyis mdzad pa mthong hrol chen mo bzhengs tshul bsod nams rgya mtsho mngon par spel ba'i zla ba bzhi mdun nas/ 154 skusnan tan mtha' yas kyis mdzad pa 'dzam gling dga' tshal lam bsode nams dga' tshal bzhings tshul kun da'i pheni po gnyis kyi rgyab nas gsal/369

ting nge 'dzin gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i sa gnas der/ 'dzam gling dga' tshal gyi gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhengs/ /rmicho 'grag pa'i bstan srid kyi byed po bsod nams lhun grub ces pa'i bla dwags can rang nyid kyi lhag bsam dag pas/ phyag hu dngos po ci byung chud zos su mi 'gro bar rnam 'gyur zhes pa spyi lo 1770 rab byung 13 lcags pho stag lo'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshos bdun rgyal thur 'dzom pa'i 'grub spyor dge bar/ 'og hu 'chad 'gyur gyi rin po che sna tshogs pas bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po dgung 'o/ bcu gnyis pa'i tshad 'di lugs su byugs par btsams pa'i tshe/ byug theng gcig la ha cang che ba 'di lta thu 'dug pas ji ltar cadang snyam sems 'dzangs kyang / rang nyid kyi lhag bsam rnam par dag pas shin hu spar la gtsang ba slar byi dor cher ma dgos pa byung / de nas rim gyis 'khor ba 'jig nas mos pa'i bar sangs rgyas stong / lag na rdo rje dang / tshangs pa gtsug phyad can rnams kyang / serdzogs gser zangs kyi sangs rgyas stong skru bzhengs par mdzad 'dug 156 yang mi rje chodas kyi rgyal po bsod nams lhun grub ces bsod nams kyi stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba chen po de yis/ rje btsun ngag gi dbang po rnam par rgyal ba'i thugs rten du sku tshe byin gyis brlabs pa'i mche da rten gser dzings brdungs dang /155 skusnan tan mtha' yas kyis mdzad pa srungs thang du sangs rgyas stong bzhengs tshul gyi dkar chag bsede nams rab gsalag༄/ma /shā tsu/ba nab/ gamu/'a/156 yod tan mtha' yas kyis mdzad pa gdan sa spungs thang du gsor gdung chen mo bzhings tshul gyi gtam dam pa'i chosakyidabyangs gnyis kyi rgyab nas/ 370

bkra shis 'byung ba dang dbyen zlum mchod rten gnyis dngul lhad med kyis nyis thog tu nye ba dang / kun dga' ra ba'i steng du 'od kyi nyin mor byed pa zil gyis gnon pa'i gser gyi rgya phibs legs par bzhengs pa dang / gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi sku 'u/gas snge/ blugs te bzhengs nas dpon hre ba byar gdong par gnang nas chu mo phya ru bzhugs su gsol/ mtha' dbus kyi rdzong gzhis thams cad la yab bstan pa'i nyi ma'i dus macesad btsugs par mdzad/ rje sku na tan mtha' yas kyi bka' 'bum du mi gsal kyang rje bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gyi rnam thar nas sde srid 'di yis bka' 'khu/ra gser ma yang bzhengs par snang ste 'di ltar/ sdi 58da bsod nams lhun grub kyi bka' 'gyur gser ma bzhengs pa'i dung yig la gong sa'i bkas bkug pa bzhin spungs thang du gyon/ der phyag bris mgyogs legs thugs barbemon che bas grang yig gzhan ma mi gnyis 'dra'i las ka rje 'dis 'khor mor gnang ba nyin rer ma dpe mtshal ma nas 31ga thu dgu dgu re chag tshed bris pa yin gsungs/ de ltar mi phal pa dang mi 'du ba sprul pa'i zlos gar du snadug pa nges/ 'o/ 'khor lhag tsam la gser ma po snyi brgyad dgu zhig bris grub/zhes gas/'a//spyi lo 177'a rab byung 13 chu 'byug 'o ra bkra shis chodas rdzong mes 'jig pa chu 'gram 'bras zhing du 'o/ gcig gi khongs su rdzong gsar du bzhengs pa bsgrubs pa la ming bsod nams pho brang zhes btags kyang / phyis su bkra shis chodas rdzong rang du 157 rje yon tan rgya mtshos mdzad pa rje bstan 'dzin snam rgyal gyi rnam thar skal bzang 'dod 'jo'i 'khri shing bcu gnyis rgyub nas// 371

ming chags/ rje nga mes 'jig pa na gnas bdag bdud brag pa bdas te gnas bdag gsar pa sprus smad la'i wa rje brag btsan btsugs par mdzad/ lta klu gzhi bdag rnams la bka' 31ga gnang bas char pa chad pa dang babs pa rngo(gas bka' la gnas par grags shing bstan srid la sman pa'i mdzad phrin rgyas par gnang ste bzhugs/cadan kyang sde srid 'di nyid rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyi yang srid gsum pa khri sprul 'jigs med seng ge la dad mos chung zhing gong ma'i gser khrir bzhugs kyang dbang tshad med pa dang / 'dus sde'i chos srid kyi dbang tshad sde srid bzhi dar rang gis bzhes te khrims shin hu bsdams pa'i tshe/ rdo rje sle ba dpon shes rab seng ges 'dus sde'i chodas phyogs kyi bya ba bla ma grwa tshang rang gis sngar bzhin mdzad cerdzog par zhus pa'i kyen las/ /ska'i bkyon bcas rdo rje slob dpon gyi go sa nas zur dgon sgrub sde bkra shis 'grag rgyas dang che sa skyong gi pho brang gi bla mar btang ba dang /sgu pa'i slob dpon bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal yang nyes med mi dkar zhwa nag gi dpe bzhin zur du bton te gdong dkar la'i bla mar btang ba rnams mdzad spyod dugs thal du song ba dang / zhabs dung yang srid gnyis pa ཿtshes kyi rgyal mtshan la dad mos che zhing sod nas gdan dungs te khri 'don mdzad pa sogs/ chags sdang phyogs ris che bar mdzad pa'i kyen las/ ci'adus sde dang khri sprul 'jigs med seng ge yang sde srid la thugs mi mnyes shing / / nang nas khyodags gnyis su gnas pa'i skabs der dpag bsam khar zings 'khrugs ldangs/ spyi lo 177'a rab byung 13 chu 'byug gi snga gong 'byug pa dang phyi gling gzhung 158 shes rab seng go'i rnam thar dpag bsam ye ngas 'du'i 'khri shing bsto brgyad mdun nas gsag 372

gnyis kyi bar mthun lam yod med kyi lo rgyus gang yang mi 'dug spya lo 1077'alor 'grag pas rgya gar ku tsa bi har zhes pa'i sa gnas de 'byug nga/'i spo yin shes/ de bar dbang btsongs kyis rgyal po no wan dar nā ra yan de snyepo bcas me gnyis bzung ste khrid song 'dug de nas long gi mi tshan nas phyo gling gzhung la spogs ram 'tshol te phyo gling gas skab )na jo hā na si'i mnga' cadag gi dmag mi btang ste 'byug pa rnams dang 'dzings 'dug de ltar phyo gling pas chadang la grogs ram byas te dmag rgyab skabs rgya dmag gi gdong len du dmag mi gtang rgyu'i skor nas sde srid kyis mtshan nyid slob dpon kun dga' rin chen la bsnyun gros mdzad pa na/ sde srid bzhi dar mtshan hā ba kun dga' rin chen dang sngar mthun kyang / phyos su sde srid rang chags sdang phyogs ris che ba'i kyen las sde srid las kyang kun dga' rin chen khri sprul 'jigs med seng rge la dad cing nang nas thugs mthun pa'i gshis kyis sde srid la/ rgya dmag gi gdong len du sku gcadags ḍūtshod rang khyodan pa dug gzhan gyis tshags la mi tshud ces zhus pa ma tshad brtag ril phab pa na gnyis ka bzang bar bag sa pa las bzang bar babs brten/ 159 'dod pas ngoms mi shes pa'i nga rgyal dang zhe sdang dug pos snyo nang gi thu gces thams cad rang nyid kyi dasung du khrid cing / rgya gar wa spyang dang 'phar ba dang dur bya sogs la mi sha'i mchode zhin byed pa'i skabs de dag hu/ zhes gsal ba bzhin dmang dang blon po tshos ba31la btab kyang ma gsan par gzhung gi 'gan khur re zhig mtshan nyid sle ba dpon la gnang nas sde srid bzhi dar rang nyid dpag bsam khar 159 sku sgar bla ma ngag dbang kun dga' rgya mtsho'i rtogs brjod rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs zhe bzhi mdun nas/373

dmag la byon/ sde srid dmag la byon pa'i rjes su sngar nas phyogs gnyis su yod pa'i stabs kyis 'dir zings 'grigs langs/ de'i thog dpag bsam khar dmag pham ste/ dha ling ko )/ ci tsa ko 3/ dpag bsam kha bcas phyo gling par shor ba dang dus mnyam 'dir gzhung du dge 'dun dang dpon lag rnams nang zings tshab cher langs ste sde srid gī tsha bo sogs rje yon tan mtha' yas kyi gzim cung du kyibs zhu bar 'tshangs pa na rje sku na tan mtha' yas kyis sredag bskyubs mdzad/ de nas khri sprul 'jigs med seng ge'i bkas mtshan nyid slob dpon rud pa kun dga' rin chen sde srid kyi khri la mnga' gsol bar mdzad/ gzhung nas sde srid bzhi dar gyis rgya phyogs su phung gzhi chen po bzos tshar 'dug pas sde srid 'grag hu thon mi ཿwag pa dang / thon na sa phyogs gang nas thon rung gsad daserdzos par bka' 31ga bkram zhing kyibs khra nas lam bkag pas/ sde srid bzhi dar dpagabasam kha nas bros te yar byon pa na gzhung du gyon sa med par gsang stabs kyis rin sprungs su 'dzul/ gnas brtan rdo rje rnam rgyal la bya ba gzhan la yid 'gyed med rung da lta'i sgrub sde bkra shis 'grag rgyas gī bla ma rdo rje slob dpon gyi go sa nas zur dgon gyi bla ma ra btang ba de thugs tsa nas ma bde zhes/ sngar mdzad spyod dugs thal du gyur pa la thugs 'gyod pa gsung 'dug rin sprungs rdzong der yang bzhugs ma tshugs par bod la gyon nas serdzos la gur spubs te bzhugs pa'i mtshan mor 'brog pa rnams kyis gur bstims te spyi lo 1773 rab byung 13 chu sgrul lor bkrongs par bshad kyi 'dug rgo/ 374

gtol med du gyur pa la/ zhes gsal ba bzhin/ mi ring bar sde srid rnying pa bzhi dar gyi phyogs gtogs rnams kyis gsang zab rdzong nas nang zings bslangs kyang gzhung la glags ma khel/de skabs rgya mtshams kshi sa gzhi'i skor nas phyo gling pa dang 'grag gzhung gnyis 'grigs min gyis brel ba tshab che ru song ba las phyo gling pas dmag dgang chen po btang nas gong gsal 'grag gi sa cha rnams 3tsher ba ma tshad da dung nyen la chen po yod pa'i skabs der/ lha gī thu bo rje btsun sangs rgyas rgya mtsho bstan 'gro'i don la sku srog kyang gtong bar nus pa'i thugs bskyed kyi go cha chen pos/ 'dab chags bya yang nam mkha' nas byul ba'i dbyar gyi tshad dug chen por rgya gar du gyon nas yun ring bzhugs te rgya 'byug gi chings 'dums legs par grub nas khyodan pas/ zhes gsal ba bzhin/ spa sgar bla ma ngag dbang kun dga' rgya mtsho'i hre ba ma phyis dar dkar dpon slob du gyur pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshos kyang rgya 'byug chings bsgrigs 'dugaspyi lo 1774 rab byung 13 shing rta lo zla bzhi pa'i tshes nyer lnga la chings yig gcig bzos 'dug pa chings yig de'i nang gsal/ rgya 'byug gnyis rgyal khab gcig gi sa cha gcig gis dbang btsongs kyis len pa yod na/ de rnams gang yang slar log sprod de rgyal khab gnyis kyi sa cha de rang 'jags de sngar zings brel ma langs pa'i sa mtshams de gar bzhag rgyu dang / 'brug lag tu yod pa'i ku tsa snyi har rgyal po dang bo'i spun mched de wan de ba bcas pa'i btson pa sogs slar log rgya gar gzhung lag par rtsis sprod dgos rgyu/ rgya gar mi ser ngan pa re gnyis nas 'grag pa'i mi ser 161 ngag dbang kun dga' rgya mtsho'i rtogs brjod rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs zhe drug gi rgyab nas/376

/ sa kyang / phyag sku ra bcu las gang bcad kyang tsha ba dang / mi brgya'i dbus na rang rsha /no gces zer ba bzhin thag phyo nang gang sa nas bcad tshar ba yin gasnge/ngas nas ma gsan par lo bcu gnyis bar rgyal srid cerdzos bzhin du bkyings te spyi lo 1788 rab /nga 13sa pho sprel lo zla bcu gcig pa'i nang dbang rdzong gsung chog nas 'phyo bskyungs trī rgal srid spangs te tsā ri'i gnas gzigs la phebs 'dug / de nas rim pas bas/ma yas mchims thur khyodan nas thugs dam la bzhugs pa na lha nas kyi dpe na 'asku gyogs gtogs rnams kyis gnas tshul zhib cha'i zhu yig 'bul du khu/nga ba gzigs dus/ bka' las nga bla ma mkhan chen gyi thugs bzo med yin 'du'i bka' sal de pal cher bcos ma rang yin nam snyam pa rang gi log rtog red/ long gi thugs brtsos min phyogs lhung med par mdzad pa de da gzod go bas/ bka' drin che zhes byi ga thal mo byir ba gnang 'dug / de nas mi ring bar spyi lo 1789 rab byung ba cu gsum sa 31 byu 'o(ra sta/ zhi bar gshegs/ /381

de srid bcu dgu pas chab srid bsgyungs pa/ rsā༅༅ / / sde srid khri rabs bcu dgu pa 'byug bstan 'dzin nam sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin ni/ yul wang sil sil nang rgad po dkar po'i gcen por 'khrungs/ chung dus nas ceras rje 'byug pa'i sgrig lam rnam gzhag skusgogs cesas srid lugs gnyis kyi tshul la rang byan tshud pa'i mkhyen rab kyi padmo rgyas shing rim gyis sprungs thang rdzong dpon go gnas thob ste bzhugs pa'i skabs gong sa 'jigs med seng ge khri thog hu bzhugs yod pa la/ snyo rdzongs 'dir phyogs gnyis su yod pa'i dbang gis thugs sran te bla slob 'dus sde'i tshogs kyis ji ltar gse la ba btab kyang ma gsan par gyon pa'i rjes su skye 'gro'i las dbang gis dbang rdzong du 'khrugs zings langs/ gzim bgre16 4phang yer pa sku gas dpon 'go 'ga' shas rje mkhan chen shes rab seng ge nā len dar gzhugs sad sku nga nas zhus pas/ de skabs 'gram nad thon te dgo 'dun rnams kyang lag se sku ra ri la bzhugs sku da pa rnams la de ma thag dge 'dun lag so sor mi ngan phung khrol gyis dkrugs par 'ong na 'dus sde bstan pa'i gtso bo yi na pas su'i phyogs su yang ma lhung bar ri rgyal ltar bzhugs dgos/ long der 'ong mi tshor sna len gzhan lta ci chu phor gang yashā zlo gtong gsungs chos skyong la dmod bor ste hre ga ces gsungs 'dug der tsho chen gyi rgan mi las tshan rnams kyis skye 'gro mi ser rnams sdug mi dgos pa'i spyin 'bangs kyi bde thabs shig bla ma dge 'dun nas 164 rje shes rab seng ge'i rnam thar dpag bsam sku1ngas 'du'i khri shing zhe bzhi'i rgyab nas gsa'/165 shes rab seng ge'i rnam thar zhi lnga'i mdun nas/ 382

gzigs dgos tshul yang yang gral mthug na cadangs te zhus par brten/ 'bangs kyi spyid sdug lta mkhan zhig med mi rung bas/ sprungs rdzong pa de pha bzang gi thu gang ci nas 'ong 'e sa tshul zhus pa dang / de khar gong sa rang gi mi sna rnams kyis kyang deng ma thub pa dang / de skabs nad rims dang 'khrugs zings kyis mi bde ba sna chogs byung bas skye 'gro'i bde thabs su lto nang gi che phra tshang mas sprungs rdzong pa bstan 'dzin spyi smo 1788rab byung 13 sa sprel lor gong sa'i gser khrir mnga' gse la te mtshan sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin du gse la/ zings kyen bde 'jam du gyur/ skye dgu rnams nye ring med par byams brtses spyong bar mdzad cing / rje yon tan mtha' yas kyi tsā ri'i lung bstan gyi dgongs don bzhin bde mchog bzhengs 'phro de 'tshub cha ji snyed byung yang / sde srid sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin gyis snying stobs chen pos bsgrubs/ mdo sde brag tu gser zangs gyi ston pa'i sku rje yon tan mtha' yas kyi skra tshad ma zhig bzhings/ 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan 'dzin skyong du bskos/ der rgyun gyi mar me sgos dkon gnyer ngo g.yog dang mtshams g.ye ga gi pogs sogs bkra shis ce sa rdzong nas thob rgyu'i bka' khra gnang / gdan sa lcags ri se gas dang khyad med par dgo 'dun nang na〈ge mtshams la byedan cerag par mdzad/ rje shes rab seng gos gdan sa zhig 'debs par bzhed pa la sde srid 'di yis rje shākya rin chen gyi gdan sa dar rgyas 'gyur ba se gas gī dasku sa pa la brten/ tshetsheg min gyi gam du 'debs par zhus pa bzhin sde srid dre na 'bangs kyis zhabs tog ci 'gyor zhus te tshegs med du grub nas 'og min gnyis pa dga' ldan lnga brang zhes mtshan gserdzol/ 383

ṭwāṃ swārdozhin zla bar rgyal khab chen po bkra shis che sa rdzong nas chodas kyi rgyal po byung chub sems dpa'i bka' yig dmar po rten dang bcas phebs don/ nyi zer sprul sku phrin las rab rgyas 'di la rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi lung rgyun gtsang ma yod 'dug par stag tshang bla ma skurdzogs nas zhu 'asnga da che bas gaskusgol ba btab pa bzhin gnang rtsis yod bsnyun/ khyod kyang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes thu dam par song bas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bsam nas cerdzong na dga' bar 'dug pas de lugs byed dgos pa'i bka' 31ga yin pas/ rang nyid dga' dugs te brel ba che bzhag chung bor gyis 'phral du dbang 'dus rtser zhabs pad du byir/ ceras rgyal byang chub sems dpa' de yang shin tu dgyes te thugs brtse ba'i bsrub ston dang nyer mabo'i yo byad bzang po bcas bde chen pho brang du brdzangs/ bka' 'gyur gyi lung ma ngas rdzogs legs par thob/ yang sa'i bdag po'i bka' tham dmar po khyer ba'i pho nya zhig byung / gdan sa spungs thang du bzhugs pa'i bka' 'ashu/ra gser ma'i zhus dag bgyid par 'phral du 'byor dgos pa'i bka' khung yin 'dug pas 'phral du 'gro chas bgyis te spyi lo 1791 rab byung 13 lcags phag zla dang pa'i chos nya la bar rtsa nas thon/ rang gi slob thu blo gsal gzhon nu rnams kyi mdo 'dzin byas te bka' 'gyur gser ma gnyis kyi zhus dag legs par grub pas mi'i dbang po thugs mnyes par 'gyur te snga dgong gi ja dang gsol chogs sogs gong sa'i sku mdun du rtag par zhus te chodas dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur/ dpon sle ba rnams la gtang rag dga' ston dang gnang spyin rgyas par sbal/ zhes gsungs 'dug pa se gas rgyal srid chotshes 166 glang dkar bla ma ngag dbang cho sa kyi rgya mchoda'i rnam thar byung chen spyod pa'i me long so gsum rgyab nas/384

bzhin du bkying bzhin par spungs thang du snyun thebs nas mi ring bar bsku da nams kyi thems skas las mtherdzo ris sa/ gathegags/ che klag rgyol byang chub sems dpa' de nyid lo shas bzhugs na snyo nang gi bstan 'gror sman yon shin tu che ba 'byung bar nges te/ sngon nas kyang dge ba'i tsa ba rgya cher bsgrubs pa ma zad khri thog tu ji ltar phebs pa nas sku gsung thugs rten lha khang gsar bzhengs dang zhig gsos/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde'i zhabs tog bsnyen bkur/ snyo nang gi bka' 'gyur yod tshad dbyar dgun gyi dus chen gnyis la yo byad tram̐ ga stsol gyis bklag srol/ ma ṇi dung sgyur grangs med rtsis med/ sgrol ma dang rnam rgyal ma se gas kyi 'thum sde bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ dus bzang ltar chags lnga sa dang la chod me lha khang thams cad la 'bul sku la/ 'bangs la gnang spyin se gas dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po mdzad mkhan sngar yang ma byung zhing phyis su'ang 'byung bar 'gyur pa nyin mo'i skar ma tsam du zad do/ / de bzhin rje shes rab seng gos kyang gong sa mi dbang chen pos sri zhu'i bkur snyi sngar las mi dman pa lhag par mdzad/ ces gsungs gas sku tshe brtan ga sde srid bcu gsum pa dang 'du ba zhig cadang bar nges so/ / 167 zhis glang gar bla ma ngag dbang ceras kyi rgyu mtsho'i rnam thar byang chen skyed pa'i me 'o/nga se lnga'i rgyab nas gsungs 'dug/ 385

ke mag rgyab rgyu yin pas/ lto nas bod pa'i rgyab ma mdzad zer ba'i zhu yig phul dgos gsungs pa bzhin phyal skabs/ gor rgyal nas yig rten gor ṭam dos lnga bskur 'dug de 'phral snyo nas ku tshab btang nas bod ga/ngas can de bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde spyid 'byung ba'i gnas yin pas der dmag btsugs na phyos su khyed rang spyod po mi 'ong zhing / skye 'gro thams cad sdug la spyor ba'i mthar khyod rang gi rgyal thab da lta su'i 'og tu yang ma yin pa gnam bskos rgyal po lta bur 'dug pa de/ma thar kyen ngan pa'i dbang gis rgya nag po'i cadag la 31ra nyen le nga bas ma mdzad zhus kyang ma gsan par therdzod la dmag batsho gas pas/ 'o( gasnge/ma nas rgya klung thang gi dmag thon te/ goraṣa'i tshogs rnams rgyal khab sa/zhan la bros dgos thug pa'i skabs/'byug nas bla ma phrin las 'byug rgyas dang sde srid rang gi dung yig sher brag mgo'i glerdzos rje gnyis btang nas 'khrugs bzlums byas pas bal 〈sna'i rgyal rngo rgyal khab gzhan la ༷snas ma daserdzos par rgya nag la 'bul ba rgyab pa'i sresapa de dus btsugs pa yin zhes bshad/ /(lnga du sde srid dbu mdzad kyi khra ba de kri khams ha cang 'khrugs/ par gyur ba'i sngas margodar rje nyid gdan 'dren zhus pa bzhin ma phebs thabs bral gyis phebs/ zhes gsal bas mi ring bar sde srid dbu mdzad kyibs khra pa de sku lams ha cang 'khrugs par gyur te/ rje 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gdan dungs te sku rim ji ltar mdzad kyang ma phan par snum zad kyi mar me bzhin sku gshegs pa'i rjes nas gong sa bserdzod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bstan srid bskyungs te bzhugs bzhin par spyi 'o/ 1796 me 'byug zla nya pa'i nang zings 'gru/ gas langs te zur bzhugs mdzad/ 169 yang 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gi rnam thar brgya drug cu mdunanas387

dbu mdzad kyib khra pa sde srid mdzad pa rje 'jam dbyungs rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar nas cung zad gsal ba ma gtogags dus mtshungs gzhan gyi rnam thar rtogs brjo da rnams su 'e1 khams gang la sde srid mdzad pa dang yun ci tsam bzhugs pa dpyad pa byas pas re zhig ma rnyed do/sde srid nyer gcig pas bstan srid bskyungs tshul nang 'khrugs spungs rdzong me 'jigs gnyis pa byung ba/༄༄ / / sde srid khri rabs nyer gcig pa 'byug rnam rgyal ni/ yul wang dar lung khu nas 'khrungs/ sku chung ngu'i dus nas gdan sa phan tshun du 'byug gzhung gi bka' 'bangs su gtogs te rim gyis gong gzim gyi go gnas thob 'dug de nas spyi lo 1796 rab byung 13 me 'byug lor sde srid kyi khrir 'bod de chab srid chos dang mnya par spyong ba na/ spyi lo 1798 rab byung 13 sa rta lor sprungs thang bde chen pho brang rdzong me 'jig gnyis pa byung / sa skyong bgres pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang khri pa 'byug rnam rgyal gnyis ka thang rje'ong du bzhugs/ mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs rgyal — mtshan dang 'dus tshogs rin po che rnams bkra shis chos rdzong du gyon/ dge 'dun gyi sder dmya rgod rnams kyis zings 'khrugs langs pa rje 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis thabs mkhas skyu'i grags rjes kki bar /lngar/sde srid khri pa 'byug rnam rgyal gyis rgyal srid chab 'bangs rnams phan bdes spyong zhing cesas rje ma nyam med dpal ldan 'byug pa'i bstan pa la lhag bsam thugs bskyed 388

med du byung bas rgyal ba'i bka' brgyad stong pa/ gzungs bsdus/ rgya cher rol pa/rtog gzungs gzungs grwa lnga gser cadad se gas dang / sman gyi rgyud bzhi/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum/ padma thang yig gser phreng ma/ bka' brgyud gser phreng mi la'i rnam thar dang mgur 'a bum/ dwags po thar rgyan rgyal dbang rje 'i bka' 'thum zhabs dung rnam thar sgra ka tsan dbyangs gsum se gas gsung rab mang nge par du bskrun par mdzad/ dus skabs der bal po'i bla tshab sa ka zhes pa de yin 'dugagorakhri rgyal pos bla tshab sa ka rgyal khang du bos te 'byug rgyal po la zhu rgyu/ long rgya a shom la dgang dmag gtang tsu/ yin par dmag lam 'byug brgyud daskusnas par zhus zhos btang 'dug 'di nas gong sas sngar sde srid bse da nams rgyal mtshan skabs rgod la dmag ma rgyab ces 'di nas mi dre ma mngags kyang ma gsan par dmag rgyab ges gyis rgya nag gis nge da kyi dmag rgyab byas te bal yul gyis rgya 56la du 'thul ba shor ba sogs byung ba yin dgongs te gang yang ma gsungs par btang ba yin zhes glengs/ spungs thang rdzong de slar yang lo 'bor lhag tsam la rten dang brten par bcas pa leg0su par baX/bas//mi ring bar spyi lo 180'a rab byung 13 chu khyi la sde srid zur pa bsod nams rgyalamatshan dang khri pa 'grag rnam rgyal gnyis nang ma gshin bar gzings 'khrugs chen nge wangs te 'thab mo lag spyod skabs gong sa khri pa 'grag rnam rgyal gyi sku la me'i 'phrul 'khor gyis bsnad de 'di phyogs rnams dngas skrag gis phyir bros/ de nas mi ring bar sde srid khri pa 'byug rnam rgyal ma 'tsho bar chab srid 'o1 bdun tsam bskyungs nas sku gshegs/ de'i phyogs gtogs phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi sprul sku ye shes rgyal 389

rmichosan zhabs zla dang bcas pa rnams rje 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gzim sgor kyibs gse la la phebs pa bzhin/ rje 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis gong sa bse da nams rgyal mtshan la mtshams spyor legs par mdzad de sredag gi 'jigs pa las thar bar mdzad nas rang yul du bde bar btang 'dug/170 rje 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar nyis brgya dgu'i rgyab nas gsa'/sde srid nyer gnyis pas bstan srid bskyangs pa dang nang 'khrugs kyi me 'jigs gasnge/ma pa khu/nga ba/ ༄༅༅ / / sde srid khri rabs nyer gnyis pa byer yang che sa rgyal bsod nams rgya la mtshan ni/ re zhig zur bzhugs gyi skabs kun mkhyen padma dkar po'i bka' 'thum chesgos tshan nyise brgya dug cu re lnga yod pa cha tshang par du brkos pa'i spyin bdag mdzad/ sngon nas sde srid 'byug rnam rgyal phyogs gtogs bcas pas phyogs rnam sprul sku ye shes rgyal mtshan bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gasku la skabs nas bdud kyis brlams pa'i g.yo can skye so lega'i g.yo 'phrul las/ sde srid khri pa 'byug rnam rgyal dang zur pa bsong nams rgyal mtshan gnyis thugs ma mthun par dṛṣṭar te skye dgu rnams sdug la ljuXr nye ba'i skabs/ rje 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas khri bsdum sa mdzad de re zhig zhi nas bange 'jam du gnas par gyur kyang / slar yang spya lo 180'arab byung 13 chu pho khyi lo'i dgun zla'i sgrub chog grol ba'i gtor 'thul skabs su glo thur du nang zings langs te sde srid khri pa 'byug rnam rgyal lnga pa'i lam du gshegs 390

rjes spyi lo 1803 rab byung 13 chu mo phag lor sde srid zur pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan slar yang gong sa'i khrir 'dzegs/ sdo srid 'byug rnam rgyal gshegs mi'i phyogs gtogs rnams kyis slar srongs thang rdzong me spar te me 'jigs gsum pa byung / zings 'khrugs dang rdzong mes 'jig ge'i rkyen ngan de yis rje mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan ha cang thugs gdungs she gzim khang nas phebs te/ 'phreng ba'i shing gi tsa ba'i khyams su bzhugs te skra mdung chen mo zhes lan gsum gsungs te dgung 'o/ grag cu re gcig chu phag zla gnyis pa'i chos 8 la zhi bar gshegs/ ceras rgyal bserdzod nams rgyal mtshan gyis slar yang hro 'khor lhag tsam la rdzong sngar bzhin du bzhengs/ de nas mnga' 'bangs byams spyong gis bstan srid bkyings te yan ha cang mi ring bar spyi lo 1805 rababyung 13shing glang lor sku zhi bar gshegs/nang 'khrugs kyis sde srid 'grug rnam rgyal dang rje 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gshegs tshul dang / bsode nams rgyal na tshan sde srid kyi khrir byedan tshul rnams thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pas mdzad pa'i rje 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar yib rigs bzhad pa'i rgyud mangs ldeb grangs nyis brgya dgu nas mar gas la/391
