rmed gsungs pa dang / yang mi rnams ca co'i sgra grags pa gsan nas/ sngon sde srid bsod nams lhun grub skabs sgra cher grags pa byed rgyu mi casang / da sgrig mi 'dug ces gsungs pa dang / ka la ma bslabs gong brgyad stong pa klog gnang ba dang /brtags pa gnyis pa'i dbu 31ga tshang ma thugs nas spyotshor bar mdzad pa dang / sde srid kyi mtshan sngar bkra shis rnam rgyal yin pa la/ sle ba dpon chu la bas sde srid la ming gcig gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ ba31da nams rgyal mtshan zer ba ༷/sa zhes gas/ngas pas/ sde srid lhag par du mos gus chen po skyes pa las brten nas/ phyos su bsod nams rgyal mtshan slar yang sde srid nyer gnyis pa'i skabs 'o/ gnyis lhag tsam sde srid kyi khrir bzhugs te/ spyi lo 1805 rab byung 13 shing glang lo'i 'go la sde srid kyi khri thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa dgung 'o/ bco lnga bzhes pa la phul te/ bsku da nams rgyal mtshan rang nyid sde srid kyi khri thog las dgongs pa zhus te dben par ba/rgirmi pa la/ mi ring bar snyun thebs te bsnyungs nas sku gshegs pa'i rjes su/thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa rang nyid sde srid kyi thugs 'dod med pas sde srid kyi khri las dasku ngas pa zhus te/ bserdzod nams rgyal mtshan gyi tsha the sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin thim phu rdzong dpon nas sde srid kyi khrir bkod zhes gsal ba bzhin/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin gyi bar du thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pas sde srid yun thung ngu zhig mdzad de sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin bsgos pa 173 thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa'i rnam thar brgya brgyad kyi rgyab nas/ de nas mi ring ba'i char sa skyong ba dra / dhwa dza'i mtshan 'chang ba'ang dbon pa la thugs phyogs te/ srid skyong gi khri nyid du kyibs mgon rin po che bzhugs su gsol nas rje nyid nas kyang rgyal po'i zhu po ma bzlog par rgyal srid chodas bzhin du spyong bar mdzad cing / zhes gsal/393

gsal 'o// / sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin sde srid kyi khrir bzhugs pa'i skabs bstan srid la sman pa'i bya ba gang yang mdzad long med par chodas rtse dpon slob tsha phyag pa rdo rje nas sde srid byed 'dod kyi re 'dod che bas gzhung la rngo rgol byas nas dmag dpung 'khrid de rim gzhung du brtol nas zings 'khrugs langs pas/ bstan srid la nyes skyon gang yang ma byung thog nas sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin dgongs pa zhus te/ ba ling rin chen khang bzang dang / dben gnas kun bzang bde chen du gyon nas thugs dam la bce na nga/da ma dzad de bzhugs/ sde srid khri rabs nyer bzhi pa'i lo rgyus ni/༄༄ / / sde srid khri rabs nyer bzhi pa dbu mdzad spa gro pa ni/ spa gro dol phu nas ya rabs snu sa ldan gyi rigs su 'khrungs te skru na gzhon nu'i dus nas gdan sa chen po spungs thang rdzong du dge 'dun gyi sder zhugs/ 'bri klog nas bzung ste gar thig dbyangs gsum serdzogs skusgon tan la bslab byings mthar 'aḍūtshol nas/ ceras khrims sku gas kyi las 'gan tshul bzhin spol nas rim gyis dbu mdzad kyi go gnas thob ste bzhugs pa'i skabs / sgrilngapa tshe 'thung ba'i tshang la rdo phog pa bzhin sde gzar gyi 'khyom chen po de yang zhi bar ma gyur cing rlung gis baspyod pa'i byin za bzhin ches cher 'bar bar gyur to/ srid skyong thud dha'i mtshan can zur bzhugs mdzad cing / sde srid kyi khrir dbu mdzad chen po bskos par gyur to/ / zhes gsal ba bzhin/ che sa rtse dpon 174 thugs rdi/la 'jigs med grags pa'i rnam thar brgya bcu gnyis mdun nas/394

spo ba tsha phyag pa rdo rjes dmag dpung chen po g.yos te sde srid sangs rgyas bstan 'dzirno zud bzhugs mdzad pa'i rjes su spyi lo 180pa rab byung 13 shing glang lor mkhan spob 'dus sde lhan rgyas thog nas dbu mdzad spa spo ba sde srid kyi khrir bskos par mdzad snye dug lugs gnyis kyi chab srid che sa bzhin du skyong ba'i skabs der/ thog mar sgrub brtson ngag dbang ra ba rgyas dang gong sa 'jigs med seng ge'i gdan sa/ thub bstan gsang sngags che sa gling ngam ta 'o/gas zhes grags pa'i gdan sa chen po de nyid thugs sprurmi 'jigs med grags par phul 'dug sdi ni/da kyi khrir dbu mdzad spa spo ba mnga' gsol yang / slar yang chodas rtse dpon slob tsha phyag pa rdo rjes nyan du ma 'dod par sazhung la ngo rgol gyi dmag dungs te zings 'grigs chen po langs pa'i skabs der/gu ma padma ཿtshes grags dang rje ngag dbang cerdzos rgyal mkhyen rab che ba'i bka' drin las legs bsdums mdzad de snyo nang spu la bde thabs ci yang stsol ba'i bka' baspos bcas te sdud pa zhi bar mdzad/ bla ma padma che sa grags sde srid dang mnyam par bste/sa sta sde srid lhan rgyas su/ bzhugs jo ga nas 'bangs mi ser la phan pa'i sri ma gsar bkod gnang zhing / re zhig zhi 'jam bde 'jags su gnas te chab srid bkyings pa'i mtshams/ yang sde srid gnyis thugs snang ma mdza' bas spyi 'o/ 1807rab byung 14 me yos lo zla 1 pa'i chos 15 la srongs thang rdzong du zings 'grigs langs/ mkhan slob 'dus 31gas rnams kyi thabs mkhas thugs rje la brten 'phral du khri bsdums mdzad de sde srid dbu mdzad spa gro ba dgongs pa zhus te zu ra bzhugs mdzad 'dug go/ 175 rje shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar bden gnyis grub pa'i shing rta bcu gasra/ma mdun nas/395

sde srid nyer lnga pa dang nyer dug pa'i lo rgyus/༄༄ / / sde srid khri rabs nyer lnga pa padma chodas grags ni/ de skas/ dbon sras tshe ring dbang chen gyi skye mtha' phyos gong sa'i khrir son pa padma chodas grags/ zhes gsungs 'dug pa bzhin/ khyetshogs rnam sprul skru ye shes rgyal mtshan dang 'jigs med seng ge'i sprul skru tshul khrims grags pa rnam gnyis the da du gnas gzigs la chibs bskyod gnang ba slar 'o/ga phebs pa'i zhabs zlar padma ཿwas grags kyang gong sa mi pham dbang po'i khu so'i skye mtha' yin par brten khri sprul tshul khrims grags pa'i nang blon byed de 'dir gzhung du byon 'dug de skabs chos rtse dpon slob kyi dmag dpung thim gzhung du lhags pas/ sde srid sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin dgongs pa zhus rjes sde srid kyi khrir dbu mdzad spa spo pa mnga' gsol yang / chodas rtse pas ma nyan par brten sde srid dbu mdzad spa hro pa dgongs pa zhus pa'i rjes su sprul sku tshul khrims grags pa'i nang blon padma tshos grags de spu lo 1807 rab byung 14 me yos lor sde srid kyi khrir bskos te bzhugs thog nas/ sman rdzongs kyi chab 'bangs mi ser rnams la phan pa'i sri ma gsar pa bkod cing bkra shis che sa rdzong gi kun dga' ra ba gser tshon gyis legs par mdzes pa'i zhabs tog zhus/ sngar bla ma gnas rnying pa'i gdan sa sa dmar rdzong kha'i lha lang nyams pa rje shes rab rgyal mtshan la bka' gnang ste nang rten ston pa thog tshad ma bcas gsar du bzhengs par mdzad pa dang / mdo sde brag gtsug lag khang tsi gser te ga chen smad nam phyags mtha' brtan pa'i phyir brag 175 rje 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan rgyu rnam thar brgya bzhi'i rgyab bzhi pa nas/396

sde srid nyer lnga pa dang nyer dug pa'i lo rgyus/༄༄ / / sde srid khri rabs nyer lnga pa padma chodas grags ni/ de skas/ dbon sras tshe ring dbang chen gyi skye mtha' phyos gong sa'i khrir son pa padma chodas grags/ zhes gsungs 'dug pa bzhin/ khyetshogs rnam sprul skru ye shes rgyal mtshan dang 'jigs med seng ge'i sprul skru tshul khrims grags pa rnam gnyis the da du gnas gzigs la chibs bskyod gnang ba slar 'o/ga phebs pa'i zhabs zlar padma ཿwas grags kyang gong sa mi pham dbang po'i khu so'i skye mtha' yin par brten khri sprul tshul khrims grags pa'i nang blon byed de 'dir gzhung du byon 'dug de skabs chos rtse dpon slob kyi dmag dpung thim gzhung du lhags pas/ sde srid sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin dgongs pa zhus rjes sde srid kyi khrir dbu mdzad spa spo pa mnga' gsol yang / chodas rtse pas ma nyan par brten sde srid dbu mdzad spa hro pa dgongs pa zhus pa'i rjes su sprul sku tshul khrims grags pa'i nang blon padma tshos grags de spu lo 1807 rab byung 14 me yos lor sde srid kyi khrir bskos te bzhugs thog nas/ sman rdzongs kyi chab 'bangs mi ser rnams la phan pa'i sri ma gsar pa bkod cing bkra shis che sa rdzong gi kun dga' ra ba gser tshon gyis legs par mdzes pa'i zhabs tog zhus/ sngar bla ma gnas rnying pa'i gdan sa sa dmar rdzong kha'i lha lang nyams pa rje shes rab rgyal mtshan la bka' gnang ste nang rten ston pa thog tshad ma bcas gsar du bzhengs par mdzad pa dang / mdo sde brag gtsug lag khang tsi gser te ga chen smad nam phyags mtha' brtan pa'i phyir brag 175 rje 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan rgyu rnam thar brgya bzhi'i rgyab bzhi pa nas/396

steng du bkal bar mdzad pa se gas 'o/ gcig tsam bstan srid la sman pa'i phyag las mdzad cing chab srid bkying 'phyor/ tsa rmodro pa nor thu rin chen zer ba de nyid mi blo sna mang ba rang bzhin mi drang ba zhig yod pa de nyid/ sde srid padma chodas grags ༵ ma dga' bar thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa la dbyen brtsos kyi zhu tshig ༷sdo ༷/nga gi go sa 'di bdag dgongs pa zhus pa'i rjes su zhabs grang sprul glu la 'thul rtsis tshogs kyang zhabs dung sprul sku 'di yang thugs rgyud 'gong pos dkrugs pa ltar bzhugs sa gcig tu mi chags pa'i bla ma'i mdzad pa tshul bzhin ma mdzad par brten/ da rgyal srid 'di sprul sku la mi 'bul/ sprul sku bo rang nor bdag med rta thur med kyi dpe bzhin gang dgyes ci bder gshegs snu ga pa sogs/ kyibs mgon chodas kyi rje dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa mi khyur mi brtsi bar smad ra ji snyed pa 'dus sde'i khrod du tshogs gtam du bsgrags pas/ rje rin po che'i skru gsung thugs kyi mdzad phrin la log par lta ba'i gang zag ngan pa de ni bla ma'i sku dgra mngon mtshan can yin pas/ mngon spyod dug po'i las kyis bstan dgra sde dang dgang du bcas pa rtags thon ma mdzad pa ni cha ma yin zhing / bdag cag rnams lus sredag 'ban du btsugs nas rje rin po che'i bka' tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa la ya nga bag tsha ma mchis pas/ ci mdzad kyi bka'i gsang ba myur du stsol bar zhu ba mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes mdza' ba'i bar du dbyen tshig mang po yang yang zhus/ 'dod don snying po khri rin po che tshul khrims grags pa chos srid zung 'brel gyi rgyal thabs la bkod 'dod dang / rang nyid khrims bdag gzhung mgyon gyi go sa 177 thugs sprul 'jigasamed grags pa'i rnam thar brgya skus grag rgyab nas/178 thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa'i rnam thar brgya sku1 bdun rgyab nas/ 397

thob 'dod pyi g.yo sgyu'i gtam bo na yin pa de/ thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pas gsan dgongs gtan nas mdzad mi 'dug kyang / de bzhin chen po gzhan dang gzhan du yang dbyen tshig phung khrol byas pa las/ thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa'i mnal dang 'od gsal 'dres pa'i gzigs snang la spungami ching mo chu chen po de rigs pa tsam yang ma lus par skam te nya che chung thams cad 'gre ldog byed pa dang / de'i rjes su khrag gi rgya mcho zhig 'khyil ba la lha min yul nas yin zer ba'i mi gtum po go mchon thogs pa 'ga' zhig lnga ngas nas khrag mtsho de las gnam la 'thor hub kyis 'thung gdong lag bkru ba zhig gzigs gsungs/ mo chu skam pa de sa skyong padma chodas grags zhing gzhan du gshegs pa dang / khrag mtsho 'khyil ba de de'i rjes su zing kyen chen po langs rgyu'i rtags su mngon no/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ spu lo 1808 rab byung 14 sa 'grag lor tsa mang pa no ra thu rin chen gyis dkrugs shing byas te slar yang 'khrugs zings chen po langs te sku tshe bsnyungs te gshegs 'dug / sde srid khri rabs nyer dug pa rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyi yang srid bzhi pa tshul khrims grags pa ni/ spye lo 1790 rab byung 13 lcags khyi lor bon khris su sku gong ma 'jigs med seng ge'i dbon brgyud du 'khrungs/ gzhung du gdan dungs te shes bya'i gnas mtha' dag la gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad de sku nga ma'i gser khri la mnga' gserdzol nas bzhugs pa'i skabs 'dir/ thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa'i rnam thar las/ mi ring bar sde srid padma chodas grags snum zad kshi mar me bzhin du sku tshe'i 'du byed dor nas zhing lams gzhan du gshegs pa'i rjes/ khri rin po che tshul 179 thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa'i rnam thar brgya zhe gnyis rgyab nas/398

khrims grags pa nyid ཿrdzos srid lugs gnyis kyi rgyal thabs kshi cod pan bcings te gser khrir mnga' gsol to/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin spu lo 1808 rab byung 14 sa 'byug lor gzhung bla slob 'dus tshogs dang dpon lag lhan rgyas kyis khri sprul tshul khrims grags pa sde srid kyi khri la mnga' gsol te chodas srid lugs gnyis chab srid skyong ste bzhugs bzhin pa la/ yang mkhan 〈snab 'dus dmang dang lhan rgyas tshogs pas thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa spang dkar therdzor bcad rgya dam par bzhugs pa yi/ tshugs kyis spungs thang rdzong du gdan dungs te nyin 'khor tsam du gyon pa na/ sde srid phyogs sprul tshul khrims grags pa thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa dang ring mosna'i dus nas phan tshun thugs shin hu mkhran pa las/ thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa'i sku mdun du gyon te gcam bu'i tshig tsam ma yin par thugs kyi dkyil nas 'di ltar zhus 'dug tshul khrims grags pa bdag ni re zhig rgyal chodan mkhan 11ba 'dus tsherags tshang ma'i ngo ma bzlog par srid skyong gi go sa 'di ma bzung ka med byung ba ma gtogs/gzhi nas rgyal srid kyi dpal 'byor la yid chags pa ma mchis pas/ rje sprul pa'i sku dang 'o bo lus so so yin na'ang don thugs tha dad du ma mchis pa bzhin/ bdag srid spyong las dgongs pa zhu ba dang / rje sprul pa'i sku rin po che nyid kyis srid skyong gi 'gan khu ra ci nas kyang bzhes par zhu ba mkhyen/ zhes nan gyis zhus pa la/ thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pas lan/ sku nyid kyis ma mdzad pa mdzad tshar/ spyid sdug legs nyes ci 'byung rung / lo shas bar sku nyid rang gis mdzad par rigs/ bo bo la bka' nan rdo rje'i thog ltar ñtsa ba 'di lta bu mi gnang bar zhu mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes gsungs te zhal gyis ma bzhes 'dug kyang / slar yang mkhan slob 'dus sde'i mi sna 399

khrims grags pa nyid ཿrdzos srid lugs gnyis kyi rgyal thabs kshi cod pan bcings te gser khrir mnga' gsol to/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin spu lo 1808 rab byung 14 sa 'byug lor gzhung bla slob 'dus tshogs dang dpon lag lhan rgyas kyis khri sprul tshul khrims grags pa sde srid kyi khri la mnga' gsol te chodas srid lugs gnyis chab srid skyong ste bzhugs bzhin pa la/ yang mkhan 〈snab 'dus dmang dang lhan rgyas tshogs pas thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa spang dkar therdzor bcad rgya dam par bzhugs pa yi/ tshugs kyis spungs thang rdzong du gdan dungs te nyin 'khor tsam du gyon pa na/ sde srid phyogs sprul tshul khrims grags pa thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa dang ring mosna'i dus nas phan tshun thugs shin hu mkhran pa las/ thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa'i sku mdun du gyon te gcam bu'i tshig tsam ma yin par thugs kyi dkyil nas 'di ltar zhus 'dug tshul khrims grags pa bdag ni re zhig rgyal chodan mkhan 11ba 'dus tsherags tshang ma'i ngo ma bzlog par srid skyong gi go sa 'di ma bzung ka med byung ba ma gtogs/gzhi nas rgyal srid kyi dpal 'byor la yid chags pa ma mchis pas/ rje sprul pa'i sku dang 'o bo lus so so yin na'ang don thugs tha dad du ma mchis pa bzhin/ bdag srid spyong las dgongs pa zhu ba dang / rje sprul pa'i sku rin po che nyid kyis srid skyong gi 'gan khu ra ci nas kyang bzhes par zhu ba mkhyen/ zhes nan gyis zhus pa la/ thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pas lan/ sku nyid kyis ma mdzad pa mdzad tshar/ spyid sdug legs nyes ci 'byung rung / lo shas bar sku nyid rang gis mdzad par rigs/ bo bo la bka' nan rdo rje'i thog ltar ñtsa ba 'di lta bu mi gnang bar zhu mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes gsungs te zhal gyis ma bzhes 'dug kyang / slar yang mkhan slob 'dus sde'i mi sna 399

bcas kyi le tshan dang bcas sde srid mdzad dgos par u tshugs kyis zhu gsol 'debs pas thugs la ma babs bzhin zhal bzhes mdzad pa las/ thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa nangs par sde srid khri mnga' gsol rgyu yin zhes pa'i gtam rdzong gi phyo nang bar gsum du grags shing / grabs sgrig kyang byas zin pa'i mdzad sgo de nyid/nangs par nam mkha'i padmo ngang tshul du gyur pa las/ rje la 'bang sa kyis bsgyur te zhabs gasku1ga rnams sdurdzo thur du nang 'khrugs ma langs thabs med shu/ra pa'i tsu/ mtshan mtsheg tu sde srid nyer bdun pa'i skabs su gsal/ khri sprul tshul khrims grags pa'i mdzad pa'i phyag rjes dang mdzad pa mtha' ma 'di dang 'di mdzad zer ba gang na'ang mthong thos su ma gyur to/ / sde srid khri rabs nyer bdun pa'i skabs nang 'khrugs byung ba'i rgyu kyen bcas pa/༄༄ / / 'dir nang 'khrugs byung ba'i rgyu kyen brjod pa ni skyes thu dam pa rnams kyang sde srid kyi khri la hab thob rgyab 'dug ces mi rnams kyi sems la log lta mi skye ba'i phyir ro/ / sde srid khri rabs nyer bdun pa zhabs grang 'jigs med grags pa ni/ 'khrungs yul wan na /khar/ gzhong mkhar mnga' le ga yab ja dpon snga tshang pa'am ming gzhan bkra shis bsod nams/ yum kun bzang bde chen gyi sras su/ spyi lo 1791 rababyung13 lcags mo phag lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la 'khrungs pa dgung lo gsum la gzhung la gdan 'dren zhus/ bco lnga la sde srid bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis sde srid kyi 400

'gan phyal ba bzhes te/ de nas sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin la rgyal srid gtad/ ceras rtse dpon slob pas 'go byas te nang 'chigs sde gzar gyi 'khyom chen po langs pas/sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin zur bzhugs mdzad de sde srid kyi khrir dngu mdzad chen mo bskos/ sde srid dbu mdzad spa gro bas gdan sa gsang sngags chi sa gling phul te/ shing glang dgung lo bco lnga zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig la ta logs gsang gling du phebs te tshes nyi shu la slar spungs thang du phebs/ dgung 'o/ 16 la spungs thang du bsam yas nas rgyal po gdan dungs/ khri sprul tshul khrims grags pa sde srid khri the ga hu bzhugs ge'i skabs/ gsang gling du cesas gnang sku mtshams bzhugs pa'i mnal lam du smad chu thegs pa gcig kyang ma 'a/sa pa bskams/ khrag ma31 'khyil ba gzigs snga ma sde srid cho sa grags gshegs pa dang phyo ma zing kyen lang rgyu'i rtags su shar/ spang dkar por kyi mtshams dam mtsham sa bzhugs pa'i skabs/ yi/ngas thang nas rgyal treren mkhan blosab snadus chogs spyi nas rdor sgotsho rdopal ldan dang / gzhung mgyon don grub rdo rje gnyis zhu yig rten bcas bcar nas gzhung du gyon dgos par gse la ba btab par/ gsung jig bcad kyis sam khur/ da lor dgung 'o/'i chag kyen che bsnyun gzhung phan tshun du 'gro ba'i skabs med/ rdzong bzhugs rnams la bka' sgo ga kyang de ltar byas yod/khyod kyi ngag sgros kyang de ltar gyis shig ces phyag dbang bcar zhu byas te btang / slar u tshugs gyis zhus par/ phyo dro log 'gyon rgyu byas te zla 3 tshos 3la sprungs thang du gyon/sde srid tshul khrims grags pa rje'i sku mdun gyon te la tsam min par snying nas re zhig rgyal blon mkhan slob 'dus chogs spyi nas srid spyong gi go sa 'di ma bzung ka med ma 180 rnam thar byang chen spyod pa rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gtam brgya nga gcigargyab nas/401

'gan phyal ba bzhes te/ de nas sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin la rgyal srid gtad/ ceras rtse dpon slob pas 'go byas te nang 'chigs sde gzar gyi 'khyom chen po langs pas/sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin zur bzhugs mdzad de sde srid kyi khrir dngu mdzad chen mo bskos/ sde srid dbu mdzad spa gro bas gdan sa gsang sngags chi sa gling phul te/ shing glang dgung lo bco lnga zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig la ta logs gsang gling du phebs te tshes nyi shu la slar spungs thang du phebs/ dgung 'o/ 16 la spungs thang du bsam yas nas rgyal po gdan dungs/ khri sprul tshul khrims grags pa sde srid khri the ga hu bzhugs ge'i skabs/ gsang gling du cesas gnang sku mtshams bzhugs pa'i mnal lam du smad chu thegs pa gcig kyang ma 'a/sa pa bskams/ khrag ma31 'khyil ba gzigs snga ma sde srid cho sa grags gshegs pa dang phyo ma zing kyen lang rgyu'i rtags su shar/ spang dkar por kyi mtshams dam mtsham sa bzhugs pa'i skabs/ yi/ngas thang nas rgyal treren mkhan blosab snadus chogs spyi nas rdor sgotsho rdopal ldan dang / gzhung mgyon don grub rdo rje gnyis zhu yig rten bcas bcar nas gzhung du gyon dgos par gse la ba btab par/ gsung jig bcad kyis sam khur/ da lor dgung 'o/'i chag kyen che bsnyun gzhung phan tshun du 'gro ba'i skabs med/ rdzong bzhugs rnams la bka' sgo ga kyang de ltar byas yod/khyod kyi ngag sgros kyang de ltar gyis shig ces phyag dbang bcar zhu byas te btang / slar u tshugs gyis zhus par/ phyo dro log 'gyon rgyu byas te zla 3 tshos 3la sprungs thang du gyon/sde srid tshul khrims grags pa rje'i sku mdun gyon te la tsam min par snying nas re zhig rgyal blon mkhan slob 'dus chogs spyi nas srid spyong gi go sa 'di ma bzung ka med ma 180 rnam thar byang chen spyod pa rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gtam brgya nga gcigargyab nas/401

gtogs/ rgyal srid la chags pa med pas sprul sku rin po che nyid kyis bzhes su gsol zhes zhus 'dug zhabs sprul gyis lan/ 'o bo la bka' nan rdo rje'i thog ltar ñtsa ba 'di lta thu mi gnang bar zhu mkhyen mkhyen zhes gsungs/ dpon lag chos slar yang u tshugs kyis zhag shas bzhugs par gserdzol ba btab ste therdzo rangs khyim bya 'bod kyi bar bzhugs par zhal gyis bzhes/ slar yang rgyal sdurdzon mkhan |(ba rnams bka' baspos mdzad de sa sros kyi dus su bcar te/ rje sprul pa'i sku rnam gnyis nang khul gsung gleng mdzad pa bzhin/ sang nyin gza' skar 'phrod spyor dge ba dang bsnyun dpal ldan 'grag pa'i bstan pa chodas srid lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas 'dzin spyong spel ba'i byed por gdong lnga'i khri 'phang mthon por bskal brgyar zhabs pad brtan bzhugs gsol ba 'debs pa lags zhes zhus/ bka' lan/ sngar zhus pa bzhin cerdzo therdzo 'ordzo zla zhag dus kyi skag chen ngan pa ma rdzogs par 'gan ri rab las lci ba 'di dbang gi sgo nas bkal tsho 'chi bdag gi zas su sbyan par the tshom med/ gsung mchid de 'du gnang mi rigs zhes gasnge/ngas/yang rdzong bzhugs rnams kyis/ skabs shig nas sde srid rnams kyang chos dang chodas min 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi mig dang bral bas rang 'dod phyags 'tshang gis mnga' 'bangs sdug la spyor ba mang zhing / mchesnag sprul rnams thugs sran dbyung ba'i mthu las rdzongs 'dir nad mug mtshon gyi bskal pa rgyun ma chad par byung bas/ de sa na bstan 'gro'i bde spyid rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la spyod pa'i phyir chos srid zung 'brel khri stan mtherdzon pe ra zhabs pad brtan par bzhugs pa zhig mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes yang yang gsol ba btab pas/ bka' lan/ khyod rdzong bzhugs rnams kyis snyo sgrongs 402

gtogs/ rgyal srid la chags pa med pas sprul sku rin po che nyid kyis bzhes su gsol zhes zhus 'dug zhabs sprul gyis lan/ 'o bo la bka' nan rdo rje'i thog ltar ñtsa ba 'di lta thu mi gnang bar zhu mkhyen mkhyen zhes gsungs/ dpon lag chos slar yang u tshugs kyis zhag shas bzhugs par gserdzol ba btab ste therdzo rangs khyim bya 'bod kyi bar bzhugs par zhal gyis bzhes/ slar yang rgyal sdurdzon mkhan |(ba rnams bka' baspos mdzad de sa sros kyi dus su bcar te/ rje sprul pa'i sku rnam gnyis nang khul gsung gleng mdzad pa bzhin/ sang nyin gza' skar 'phrod spyor dge ba dang bsnyun dpal ldan 'grag pa'i bstan pa chodas srid lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas 'dzin spyong spel ba'i byed por gdong lnga'i khri 'phang mthon por bskal brgyar zhabs pad brtan bzhugs gsol ba 'debs pa lags zhes zhus/ bka' lan/ sngar zhus pa bzhin cerdzo therdzo 'ordzo zla zhag dus kyi skag chen ngan pa ma rdzogs par 'gan ri rab las lci ba 'di dbang gi sgo nas bkal tsho 'chi bdag gi zas su sbyan par the tshom med/ gsung mchid de 'du gnang mi rigs zhes gasnge/ngas/yang rdzong bzhugs rnams kyis/ skabs shig nas sde srid rnams kyang chos dang chodas min 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi mig dang bral bas rang 'dod phyags 'tshang gis mnga' 'bangs sdug la spyor ba mang zhing / mchesnag sprul rnams thugs sran dbyung ba'i mthu las rdzongs 'dir nad mug mtshon gyi bskal pa rgyun ma chad par byung bas/ de sa na bstan 'gro'i bde spyid rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la spyod pa'i phyir chos srid zung 'brel khri stan mtherdzon pe ra zhabs pad brtan par bzhugs pa zhig mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes yang yang gsol ba btab pas/ bka' lan/ khyod rdzong bzhugs rnams kyis snyo sgrongs 402

'dir nga che nga dug rnams btang sloms su bzhag nas/ bdag gcig thad 'o/gas su bkar nas rgyal po'i chad las pog pa bzhin bo bo'i bde dog lan grangs du ma zhib par brjede kyang / khyed rnams kyi thugs rgyud 'gong pos dkrugs pa'am lcags las grub pa bzhin gsan 'jog mi mdzad pa 'di ni bdag 'chi bar gyur na bsam don rdzogs pa yin tshod 'dug pas de ltar na khyed rnams kyi thugs bzhed rdzogs phyir 'gan khur blang bar bgyicad zhes thugs bla rim babs bzhin zhal gyis bzhes sesna/ / de nas rdzong bzhugs rnams gyes nas snga dro gser khri mnga' gse la mdzad rgyu'i bkod khyab mdzad de gra sgrigs byas/ yo lang mtsho 'khol ba ltar phyo nang bar gsum du snga dro zhabs sprul khri mnga' gasrol byed rgyu yin zhes gtam glengs par gyur/ de nas sang snga dro nyi ma shar gsol ja gar gar ma yang bzhes grub rung / rje'i sku mdun lta zhog gzim lang nye ba tsam du'ang ma cadangs/ de nas nyi dros la mi rnams zhabs sprul khri mnga' gse la rgyu mi bden ji 'du zhes rang rang gi gnas su log go / de nas snga dro'i bzhes pa gsol grub nas/ 'ong rdzo nga bzhugs rnams kyi nyams sad phyir dben par byedan grabs brel ba lang long du btsams kyang / 'ong rdzong bzhugs kyis mir ma tshad khyir yang mi mngon pa'i bya ba dbyar gyi nam mkha' bzhin 'ashu/ra lde ga byed pa la khrel gzhung nge tsha bral bas/sku mdun bcar te zhabs brtan thul ba sku gas lta ci spyan gyi gzigs sar yang ma byung ngo sdus skabs de'i tshe 'ong rdzong bzhugs rnams nyin par bka' bgros mdzad pa'i 181 thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa'i rnam thar byang chen spyod pa rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gtam brgya re grag mdun nas/403

gral du je tshul grags kyi zhabs phyo dug rim 'ga' ma tshud pas/ phrag dog gi rlung 'tshub dug pos zhe sdang gis gtum rngam ngar skad sgrog bzhin du 'bod do/ /de'i tshe sred kyi dus su dar dpon bod dmag zhu mis gtsos pa'i dug rim de dag mkhan po'i sku mdun du bos te/ mkhan po'i bka' las nged mkhan slob rgyal blon rnams nas/ rje tshul khrims grags pa nyid srid spyodang la sa dgo ngas pa zhus pa'i rjes sang snga dro rje zhabs grang sprul sku mnga' gasku/la rgyu thugs thag bcad krerdzod par/ khyod rnams kyang bdag cag gis bgyi ba'i bkod pa 'di la yi mi rangs pa'am mi bakhrod pa ma mchis sam zhes gsungs pas/ ṇa nga rnams zhe sdang gi kun dkyis dug nge sa lnga gnyer bsdus pa'i ngag nas/ ci zer thugs dgongs zhib par bzhed de gsungs pa'am/ nges nyig med pa'i gsung yin/ yang na thugs rgyud rgyal 'gong gis dkrugs pa ni min las che /kha sing bdag cag gi rje dpon khrir mnga' gsol skabs khyed mkhan hre ba 'dus sde bka'i mdun na 'de na bcas mgrin gcig gi the ga nas cadas bab 'brel chags tshul mang rab brjod nas srid skyong go sar bskos pa ma gtogs/ nged dpon slob sto ma 'grangs bo sa ma dros par khyed rnam pa'i zhabs la btud de gasku la ba btab nas bskos pa yin nam/ gsang thabs kyi sgo nas khrir 'khod pa yin nam/ de ltar min tshe rang btsugs kyi zam par rang mi thar ba'i bya las 'di ji tsug yin/ kha sing rgyal sar bton pa'i grags pas rlung ltar sa steng khyab mthar/ yun ring ma lon zhing rgyu rkyen gang yang med par dgongs pa zhu ba'i tshul byis pa'i rtsed mo lta su 'di bab 'brel yod mi na khyod rang tshos gzigs dang / khyod mi chen rnams kyi gros 'di slo tha ryā 'i gros dang / glen lku/gas rtsed mo lta thu yin pa dang / nged dpon g.yog rnams 404

kyang ci yang mi yong ba'i gtam ngan 'phyar la phog gzhir 'gro bas/ snyo rdzongs 'dir stobs tsal blo rig sde dgang gtam lab zer sogs ci thed nas nged dpon g.yog las lhag pa su yang med na rang skal mi la sgo ra ba'i rgyu mtshan gar yod/ khyod rang mi chen gyi go sa bzung nas gyis pa'i rtsed mo bzhin ma mdzad par/ yong ba 'dug na nan tan mdzad/ mi yodang 'dug na 'jigs shing zhum bzhin cad brgyal mi dgos thams cad zhal mtshul rnyasnam bzhugs/ nged zhabs zla rnams chu brgal gcig la lham phud gnyis byed rgyu med/ las dang bya ba gang thad dgra zla sred med bu lta thu byung rung mi 'jigs thag chod/ snyo nang 'di'i g.yul 'grig ma tshad srid gsum dgrar ldang kyang ya nga bag tsha med/ btsams pa'i bya ba mthar ma phyin par ske mig sredag gsum la thug kyang 'khyerd med blo thag chodad pa/ zhig mi byed re zhes mdzub mo bsgyengs nas mna' dor te mkhan cipo'i gzim lang nas phyir thon zhes grags so/ /zhabs 'bangs rnams rdzong bzhugs rgyal blon ngan pa tsho'i byed babs des ci la bsams kyang blo rangs pa byung min gyis mya ngan gyi thug pas gang nas ci bya gtol med/ stobs kyis phongs/ sde dang dpung gis stong ste kun gyi mig yul du zhal spyongs wa ltar zhum zhum por gyur zhing da ni ci dug na bsam pa'i kun rtog chu gnyer bzhin rgyu bas mtshan mo de 'das so/ / sang snga dro rje'i bka' las/ 7/'a khab 'dir 'dug pa'i yul ma yin pas deng phyin chad gom pa 'dor ba lta zhog phyo mig kyang blta bar mi byu zhing rang gi dben gnas su 'gyon pa'i snya gon gyis shig gsungs pas chimes gon gzim sgar rnams 'alnga'oms nas ༷ sa btsams pa/ bdag cag gi thubs mabo na 18'a rnam thar zhung chen spyed pa rgyu ma tshor 'jus pa'i gtam brgya bdun cu'i mdun nas / 405

rin po che dben gnas su bde bar bzhugs tshe rgyu kyen ci yang med par rdzong du gdan 'dren zhus 'dir phebs grub pa dang / g.yo sgyu rnam pa du mas sma phab ste dgon phran bla chung las kyang nyams dma' bar bzos te dbu 'phang smad par byas tshe/ rang re rnams sems byis bakhrod dka' bas/ bla ma'i phyir du rdo rje dmyal bar snyung yang spyo bas/ bla ma'i sku dgrar gyur pa'i dgra 'di rnams dang bdag cag rnams dug po matstshan gyi 'bor lo bskor nas srog tsa dmar po gcod res dang snying khrag don mo 'thung res ma byed ka med gda' bas/ lus dum thu brgyar btub kyang skye ba gcig thog 'chi ba gnyis gsum byed rgyu med cing / ltas ngan mthong ba la mig btsums pas thar par ga la 'gyur/ rdzongs 'dir dgra 'ong tsam ma zad stong gsum dgrar langs kyang bag 'khums gang yang med lags pas/ da ni mngon spyod las kyi 'bor lo bskor ba'i bka'i gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba 'debs pas/ de'i tshe rje'i bka' las/ bdag gi ched phyed rnams kyi lus sredag 'bon du btsugs nas g.yul 'khrug gi spyor ba dug por 'bad pas ni 'o bo mnyes par mi 'gyur gyi/ 'gro ba'i kyibs mgon du las 'chis nas shes bzhin sdig las hab shar spyod pa tshul dang mthun pa ma yin zhing / spyod sdug legs nyes las kyi rjes su 'gro nges pas/ nang sems khyo dgra bo ma btul na/ / pyi dgra bo btul rgyun jo mang 'gro/ / zhes rje mi las gasnge/ngas pa bzhin sems btul ba'i dugs la babs gda' bas rang gzhan gnyis phung gi las spyor mi bzad dmyal ba myong 'acungar sems can la byams pa sgong ba sngags kyi tsa ltung shes bzhin rin gyis bammu bar mi rigs so/ / zhes gsungs so/ /406

rje'i gtsosna3 ngag dbang phun tshogs dang grang bgres nor thu rin chen gyis gtsos zhabs zla rnams kyis bdag cag la bka' ji ltar phebs kyang rung / gzhan gyis ༄ sa na ru nga phrag dog nga rgyal je cher 'a phel bas/ ma nyan pa yi glang po de/ / rgyal po'i bka' las dbyug pa btsan/ zhes byung ba bzhin skye so mi bsrun pa rnams kyi bya byed dang bsnyun tshe mngon spyod kyi phrin las 'di 'o na bsngags pas bla ma dang dkon mchodag gsum smod cing skur pa 'debs pa la byams shing tshar ma bcad na rtsa ba'i ltung ba pog pa ma lags sam/ nged cag gi nyams sad pa lags sam/ da ni bya daskutshes pa 'phul du ma mdzad na mi ring bar bros pa'i lam yang rnyed pa ma lags so/ / ji ltar zhi na dgra ngan bdud kyi tsa lag rnams kyis la sang bdag cag dpon hre ba rnams rmig mid gtong sems kyis gdan sa sprungs thang 'di'i sgo chen gong 'og gnyis dang chu pho klo'i zam pa g.yas g.yon dang shag skor phan tshun sogs rdzong phyo nang bar gsum dang tha na ldum ra ma ga ma nas thang rdzong dkar mo tshun lam srang gnad che ba kun mel tsho bas bkang zhing / khyad par rje rin po che rang bzhugs sa'i dkar tshang dang ka brgyad ma'i thog mda' yab kyi bar thams cad du pha rol pos thog 'bigs par byed pa'i ltags tho chen po lcags gzer lcags ngar bcas pa dang / mda' mdung rnon po dag gis go mtshams med par gtams shing gaX/la 'khrug gi grabs swārshags med bsgrigs zin pa ma zad/ nyin gyi bya ra mtshan gyi mel tsho bas gsang spyod du 'gro ba'ang zos mi bde ba spyod khyer 'di lta thu da dung mi mkhyen pa lags sam/ rtsub pas rtsub pa thul 'gyur gyis / zhi bas 'dul bar ga la nus/ / phol mig sreg dang bcad pas gdon/ /183 rnam thar byang chen spyod pa rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gtam/ brgya don gnyis rgyab nas/407

zhi chodas de yis dug tu 'gyur/ / zhes pa bzhin dpa' bskyed de ma macerdzongs par wa bzhin zhum na rang cag gi mgo thog hu gnam rdo dug po myur du 'bab par 'gyur ba the tshom med do/ / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang gang 'dul gyi skur bzhengs pa dang rjes su mthun par/ skye so ma rungs pa 'di dag 'dul ba'i slad du snying rje khros pa'i skur bzhengs pa'i dus la babs gda'o/ / —zhes gse la ba btab pas/ da terdzo na khyod rnams ches cher bskul na khyod rnams sran 'byin par mi rigs pas/ byams pa'i go cha chas pa ste/ / snying rje yi ni ya lad bgos/ / shes rab ral gri mda' zhu thogs/ / nyon mongs mi sherme g.yul ngo sel/ /zhes gsungs/ de skabs der chu brag 'go pa mi bzhi bcu yang zhabs dung du bcar nas zhabs phyi'i ci 'gyur grub par dam bcas shing / sprungs rdzong pa ka ṭa ma dpal 'bar 'chadar bcas kyang zhabs rtsar gtugs nas ci gsungs sgrub par las blang /spungs rdzong pa dang chu brag 'go pa tshos da ni ltas ngan mthong ba la mig btsums pas mi lo bas rang cas rnams kyi bya ba gang yin pa byed dgos pas spogs po rnams go cha btsan po gyon pa la la'ur 'chos shig zer ma thag spungs rdzong pa'i zla bo 'ga' zhig gis mo chu'i zam pa 'phyog / 'ga' zhig gis rta 'bog dang bcas pa rta rar bcugazla gsum tshes bcu'i dgong mo nang 'khrugs rmi mtshon gyi las la 'jug par byas so/ /rje tshul grags kyang rnam rgyal khang bzang nas dpyang thag la 'jus te mkhan po'i gzim cung du phebs/ de'i tsho rje'i bka' las/ rje tshul khrims grags pa gar gshegs gsungs/ dpyang thag la phebs pa'i 'o( rgyus zhus pas/ bka' las/ gzhan tsho'i thad rang sdug rang gis nyos pa yin pas bya thabs med/ rje tshul grags de snyigs ma'i 408

spyabs mgon padma 'byung gnas rnam sprul yin pas gar min song 'dug ces gsungs/ de nas dar dkar da pon slob da bral ba yang rje'i zhabs phyi zhu 'dod kyis sprungs thang du rje'i phyag dbang la 'byor yang / sprungs rdzong pa dpal 'bar dang nang ma gshin pa'i stabs kyis dkrigs sbyar ma byung bas/ 'o zhe sdang 'ong nas langs te khros stabs su slar log bkra shis chodas rdzong du song nas/ rin spungs dpon slob kyang bkug thim phya rdzong dpon gyi mdun du srungs rdzong du ye me da pa'i ju na tshig gi phu mas 'ong gnyis kyi sem sa bskyod par byas nas che sa rtse dpon slob la yi ge btang bas/ lnga kha bzhi' dmag dpung bskul nas bring tshang la wa sgyu ga pa bzhin zings 'khrug langs/ du'i rshabs 'dir/ der thim phya bkra shis chos rdzong du sdod mi tshos mkhan po phyogs rnam sprul sku ye shes rgyal mtshan sde srid kyi khrir bskos nas/ chodas rtse bas shar khye1gas pa'i dmag mi thams cad bsta/la nas panar 'a/nga gi sa gzhi thams cad bkang nas g.yul 'khrugs kyi bya ba tshab cher byung yang / rje rin po che'i byin mthu las rang phyogs su skyedan ma byung / pha rol po'i dmag mi rnams rkang pa lam du tshud min stor ba'i 'o/ rgyus kyang grags sku / /de nas ring min gyi char rang phyogs kyi dmag tshan gcig bar pa rgya brag lar yodad pa rnams kyis rje'i thugs rjes gsang sngags zab don po brang dka' tshe gas med par phyag la 'byor/ de nas zla bdun pa'i tshes bce lnga la rje sku 'a'or tshang ma gsang sngags zab don du phebs/ de nas ston gyi dus lo ltar dbang yon bzhes skabs su bab tshe/thim rdzong nga don grub des rdzong bzhugs lhan rgyas 'dzom thogs zhu bar/ da lan gnas 184 rnam thar byang chen spyed pa rgyu mtshor 'jug pa'i gtam brgya don bdun rme dun nas/ brgya don brgyad mdun nas/409

skabs g.yul 'khrugs las 'di ni spyi mthun gyi las ngan bde ba'i dbang las byung ba yin zhing / zhabs dung sprul sku de yang rdzo rdzongs 'di'i kyibs mgon ngo ma yin tshe/dbang sku na bongs nas ji tsam cadas pa 'ig srin mo dho la la btang na bab 'brel chags tshul brjod pas/ sa spyotshong phyogs rnam sprul skru ye shes rgyal mtshan dang lhan rgyus rnams kyis cang ma gsungs pa'i bar gamatsheg ngan dpon dkrugs lta thur gong sa macesag sprul ye thegs rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs gras mi ngan la pags kyis rang thag bcad na sa da lan gyi dbang yon 'di las srin mo sgo la ba tsho la dos 'go gcig ma tshad 'bras sa pa gang yang gtong ris zhes gtum rngam 'byug ltar bsgrags pas lhan rgyas ku na kyang smra ba'i sgobs pa mi da par gyur to/ / dus skabs de dag gi tshe rje rin po che 'i zhabs zla snyan rgyas na mas kyis kra shis rlos rdzong pa rnams la/ dbang yon skor la/ der yang chogs marme ga dge 'dun rnams dang khyod lhan rgyas rnams bzhugs pas dbang yon pyed tsam ni de khar bzhes chodag gzhir bcas dang / 'dir yang kyibs gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bo yin tshe sgrig lam gyi dbang skusgon phyed shags tsam zhig 'bul thub gal che zhing / de min mi 'thus thag chodad yin pa'i blo nges gyis/ zhes spyings pa'i lan du/ srin mo dho kha ba chos bzhes par spro ba'i dbang yon de da lta sa bon yang ma btab pas da sgos kyi cha nas 'bras thul gang yang gtang rgyu min pa'i thag bcad zin pa yin pas/ khyod rang rnam sa ma nga po'i dmag dang nyung ba'i mthu gtong lugs gang dgyes mdzod cig ces pa'i yi ge 'phral du 'byor bar brten/ de nas stobs tsal ldan pa'i da mag mi la shas song nas/ pa rol gyi dmag dathung mang pos dbang yon gyi dos bkra shis chodas rdzong phyogs khyer 'gro ba'i lam du sgug cing g.yul sprad nas pha 410

rol pa'i dmag dpon grir bkum/ byings rnams rkang pa lam du tshud min du btang /dbang yon dos mang po 'phyog ste dzogs rgyal ba'i glu dbyangaso len bzhin gsang sngags zab don rje'i zhabs pad du 'byor te/ de nas ston 'bring tshes bcu dgu la rje rin po che sku 'khor tshang ma dbang 'dus pho brang du phebs/ der zhag shas sku ngal sa/nga nas ཿtshes spyodang rnams la sngar bce la legs pa'i gtang rags da bce la phrin las gnya na po bce la nas/ tshes dge bar sprungs thang du khyodan/ zhag shas nas 'dus tshogs kyang gse la thabs sprungs thang du phebs se / /de nas ring por ma 'gyungs par shar nub kyi dmag sgar thed gzhung gi yul tshi kun tu bkang nas dmag 'khrug mtshon gyi 'khor 'o/ nyin mtshan bar med du bskor nas kyibs mgo na rin po cher rgol du byung yang pha rol gyi dmag dpon 'ga' zhig mthar byed kyi zas su spyar/ la la gte bor bzung / dmag byings rnams sran phyang la rdo phog pa ltar gyer bar gyur/ kyibs mgon rin po che'i byin mthu las rang phyogs la spyon cher ma byung yang / da dung 'gran sems kyis zhag mang por rgol bas pha rol gyi mi mang po brlag nas bde ba'i go skabs skad cig kyang med par gyur to/ / dus skabs der rje rin po che thugs khros pa'i tshul bstan nas phyag ro/la dza/bas dang phral nas dbu rtse'i rab gsal nas lha khang ka brgyad ma'i steng du dza/gas kyis 'phen par mdzad pas skyen cung zad kyang ma byung bas grub pa'i rtags mtshan matre na sum du ston par mdzad/de skabs kyi rol mo de ding sar dkar khris mchad rten rnying pa'i tshogs sbub de yin par grags 31/ /dus skabs der skye rgo ngan pa la shas kyis gong sa mchod yon gyi thugs dkrugs 411

shing zhabs 'dren pa'i khyen las/ lho rdzongs 'di'i mi mang po 'chi bdag gshin rje'i khar tshud pa'i tsho/ zed thim spar gsum gyi 'go pa rgod po spyi dpon dang bcas pa'i las tshan rnams baX sa nas/ byams martse na 'jam dpal ye shes rje rje dang / rje mkhan zur ngag dbang cesas rgyal dang / mkhan khri ngag dbang 'jam dpal grags pa gsum la 'dums mdzad dasku sa par gse la ba 'debs par brten mkhan pe rin po che khri zur rnam gas/ma gyis bo nga sa macerd sku/na phan tshun 'dums par mdzad de/ gang la'ang pham rgyal dang khyodags ris mi mnga' bar thugs ma༄na chu dang cad ma lta thur gyur cing zhi bde dga' spyid kyi dpal dang ldan par gyur to/ / dus de'i tshe bla ma rnams dang phan tshun gyi mi sna kun 'dun pa chig dril gyis zhus pa ltar/ spyi 'o/ 1809 rab byung 14 sa sprul 'o/ la zhabs sprul rin po che dang / phyogs rnams sprul sku rnam gnyis ri re zhig sde srid lhan rgyas su bzhugs par mdzad do/ / cadan kyang mi ring bar pha rol po dga' ba'i 'dun ma dang du bzhes te rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du dor bar mdzad de/ spyi lo 1810 rab byung 14 lcags rta lo sa ga zla ba'i yar chos dge bar sku 'khor tshang ma gasdudal thabs gsang sngags zab don pho brang du phebs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rje 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar btsa ma rgyu'i dathu btsugs/ snyung ste zle brgyad pa'i nang gsang gling du byon/ zla dgu pa'i nang yang sprung sa rdzong pa ka ṭa ma dpal 'bar gyis brings kyen bslangs/ sku nga sa khyodags sprul ye shes rgyalam tshan gyi gzim da bon dar shing de grir bkum/ rdo rje slob dpon/ bka' blon/ mkhan rin po che'i gzim dpon bcas bzang btson du bzung ba las/ rje rin po che nas sdigs brtse chen pos bka' tham dang gzim sgar pa gnang nas bka' blon zhal ngo dang dung 412

bstan pa gnyis zhabs dung du bkug rdor hre ba/ bla ma'i gzim dpon gnyis bkra shis chos rdzong du brdzangs par mdzad/ de lor zla bcu pa'i gtor brgyag chen mo'ang rje nyid kyis gnang bar mdzad/ dus skabs der sprungs rdzong pa ka ṭa dpal 'bar gyis rang gyon rin po che dang / ma chen gnyis rje nyid kyi phyag hu bzhes/ rdzong 'di dkar por sgrod pa dang nag por spyod 'o bos babs lta 'ong zhes ha cang mi 'tshams pa'i gtam zer bar brten/ rje'i bkas rje byams mgon tshadas kyi rje dang / ngag dbang chos rgyal rnam gnyis gyon nas long phan tshun gyi bar du 'dums mdzad/ rje rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi sku tshab ngo ma mi gsum bkra shis ceras rdzong du btang bar mdzad/ rje sku mtshams ༷ la nas bsku1da nams dga' tshal du phebs/ bla ma rnam gnyis dang zhal 'dzom mdzad thog snyungs rdzong pa 'khor dang bcas pa rdzong nas phyor bton/ rdzong gi rtsis kyang bkra shis chodas rdzong la 'gro mi ngo ma gsum pos len par byas so/ / de nas gong sa mche da yodan lhan rgyas rnams dang / mkhan sle ba 'dus tshogs bcas sprungs thang du phebs/ sprungs rdzong pa yang rje byams mgon dang mnyam ba ling du song / gcen gzim dpon ngag dbang phan chogs dar dkar dpon slob bskos/ rje sku 'bor tshang ma gsang sngags che sa gling du phebs/ de dus yang sku nga sa phyogs sprul ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi sgar lto rnams kyis srongs rdzong ba dpal 'bar gyi phyogs gtogs rtse gzim chu la bskur/ dge sle nga la shas mthar bskrad/ mgon mangs sgrub mching gre la 'phral dmag ba ling du bcug ṅgen gyi chodas rgyal gong ma rnams kyis bya dka' bas bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang dang sprungs rdzong pa dpal 'bar ma thu bcas thal ba'i rdul du brlag par byas sku / / 'o/ de'i dpyid ka phyogs rnams sprul sku ye shes rgyal mtshan sde 413

bstan pa gnyis zhabs dung du bkug rdor hre ba/ bla ma'i gzim dpon gnyis bkra shis chos rdzong du brdzangs par mdzad/ de lor zla bcu pa'i gtor brgyag chen mo'ang rje nyid kyis gnang bar mdzad/ dus skabs der sprungs rdzong pa ka ṭa dpal 'bar gyis rang gyon rin po che dang / ma chen gnyis rje nyid kyi phyag hu bzhes/ rdzong 'di dkar por sgrod pa dang nag por spyod 'o bos babs lta 'ong zhes ha cang mi 'tshams pa'i gtam zer bar brten/ rje'i bkas rje byams mgon tshadas kyi rje dang / ngag dbang chos rgyal rnam gnyis gyon nas long phan tshun gyi bar du 'dums mdzad/ rje rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi sku tshab ngo ma mi gsum bkra shis ceras rdzong du btang bar mdzad/ rje sku mtshams ༷ la nas bsku1da nams dga' tshal du phebs/ bla ma rnam gnyis dang zhal 'dzom mdzad thog snyungs rdzong pa 'khor dang bcas pa rdzong nas phyor bton/ rdzong gi rtsis kyang bkra shis chodas rdzong la 'gro mi ngo ma gsum pos len par byas so/ / de nas gong sa mche da yodan lhan rgyas rnams dang / mkhan sle ba 'dus tshogs bcas sprungs thang du phebs/ sprungs rdzong pa yang rje byams mgon dang mnyam ba ling du song / gcen gzim dpon ngag dbang phan chogs dar dkar dpon slob bskos/ rje sku 'bor tshang ma gsang sngags che sa gling du phebs/ de dus yang sku nga sa phyogs sprul ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi sgar lto rnams kyis srongs rdzong ba dpal 'bar gyi phyogs gtogs rtse gzim chu la bskur/ dge sle nga la shas mthar bskrad/ mgon mangs sgrub mching gre la 'phral dmag ba ling du bcug ṅgen gyi chodas rgyal gong ma rnams kyis bya dka' bas bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang dang sprungs rdzong pa dpal 'bar ma thu bcas thal ba'i rdul du brlag par byas sku / / 'o/ de'i dpyid ka phyogs rnams sprul sku ye shes rgyal mtshan sde 413

srid kyi khri las dgongs pa zhus nas gsang chen snu sa 'bor du phebs/ chos rtse dpon slob rdo rje gser khrir mnga' gsol/ dpyid mthar gsang zab hu gyon/ mi ring bar srid skyong rdo rje snum zad mar me bzhin dus chos su gyur/ rdzong bdag rnams bkra shis chos rdzong du 'dzoms nas rim rdzong bsod nams 'byug rgyas sa spyong gi khrir mnga' gsol/ gong sa zhing gshegs kyi phyag g.yog shar phyogs pa'i rigs dang bla khri'i phyag gasku ga dang / sku gzhogs phyogs rnam bcas pas brel ba langs nas rje'i zhabs dung du'ang snyan 'thul tsam zhus pa'i kyen gyis phyag g.yoyi tsho chen gyi btsun pa rnams kyang gong sa'i dbang du gyur nas chu brag 'go pa rnams kyang rang sar gyes/ rdzong bdag rnams kyang rang sar log par gyur/ sa spyong ba'ang sngar rje rin po che dgra zlar bzung ba'i ngan pa'i bag chags kyi rgyun zhe la brnags stabasru kyis dad pa med pa las/ dus skabs der/ mkhan sku bgres ngag dbang ceras rgyal mnal lam du/gsang zab tu rje'i phyag dbang la byon nas gzim cung gi sgor phebs pa las/ gzim cung gi sgo glegs dam por bsdam sa nas sgo 'gag na chab la ba de ma gtogs mi su yang mi 'dug par/ mkhan bgre sa kyis/ rje'i gzim khang gi sgo 'di bsdams nas ci zhig bya/ phyag gamardzog rnams gar se nga zhes dris pas/ chab la ba des/ da lta rje'i sku mdun du chodas skyong srung ma thams cad zhal 'dzom nas bka' baspos gnang gi yod/de rnams phyir thon pa dang mi su 'phrad 'chi bar 'gyur pas zhabs zla rnams bros nas song / bo bo 'gro sa ma rnyed par sdod yod lags zhes zhus pas/ de tsa na gzim thung gi sgo de har gyis phye nas chodas srung chogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zing langs nas thon pas bla ma yang 'jigs nas sgu zing byed pa zhig byung ba'i mod la mnal sad/ mkhan 414

bgres kyis de ltar gzigs tshul rtse nga sa bsed nams 'grag rgyas la zhus nas/ zhabs dung sprul sku'i thugs zin pa zhig ma byas na sde srid kyi khrir bzhugs mi rim par legs ldan 'ong rigs mi 'dug pas cis kyang zhabs la 'dud par rigs sku zhes gsungs pa'i 'etshe rgyus grags/ der rgyal drodan tshang mas sngar byas las la 'khyodi bshags kha zhe gnyis med kyis phul te bzhugs gnas kyang gzhung phan tshun dang gasku la thabs kyang mchod yon lhan cig hu phebs dgos par gasku la ba btab pa las zhal gyis bzhes/de nas rim pas gsang zab nas dbang rdzong brgyud sprungs thang du phebs/ mkhan 'jam dpal grags pa dasku ngas pa zhus/ rje rin nge ches mkhan po'i thugs 'gan bzhes/ zhabs kyi snyun ji thur song / snyun kyen zhag shul dgon pa nas byung bas rdzong de 'grang rgazhi nas bshig ste sa rdo rnam sa rang sar bkyil te sman bcos sku rim ji ltar byas kyang ma phan par/ snyun gzhi de gzhan gyis gtad btsugs pa yin par mkhyen te/ phyogs rnams sprul sku ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi yongs 'dzin sher brag mgo'i chodas rje dga' dbang la thabs malas mthun 'jug mdzad de dris pas/ ceras rje dga' dbang des zhabs dung sprul sku'i sku brnyan bzos te rgya skyegs kyi sgrom nang sku smad chur bcug pa'i gnyid rus byas pa dung por zhus nas/ gtad de nyid 'phral du bshig pas snyun las grol zhing bzod gsol byas pa'i lo rgyus 'dug gzim dpon tshul khrim sa da pal 'bar spungs rdzong pa bskos/ me phag lor gsang gling du phebs/ sa glang lor gzim cung rab gnas dga' ston rgya cher ma dzad/ dus der chos rtse dpon slob rdo rje rnam rgyal sngar phra bo sde srid 'grag rgyas pa'i rus zhen gyis rje la dad pa med khar/ cadas min gyi gtam 'chal sna tshogs byung ba bar skabs thu gcig smu zhig 415

mchis pa'ang 'phral du shi nas/ bla ma ma dgyes pa'i che sa spyong gi 'khu ldog 'du snyam sems 'dzangs pa dang / tshe 'di'i 'dun thabs sgrub pa la yang rje ma dgyes na 'grub dka' bar mthong nas/ sku mdun du phyag 'bul 'byor 'bul ba dpang mtho bcas la zhe med pa'i bshags pa phul ba bzhin bzod pa bzhes/ bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po mdzad de lgi lo 1830 rab byung 14 lcags stag dgung grangs bzhi bcu tham pa la gsang sngags cheras gling du zhing lam sa gzhan du gshegs sku / //de nga nga thugs sprul 'jigs rnge da grasas di 'i rnam thar las btus pa lags so / / 416 ru

mchis pa'ang 'phral du shi nas/ bla ma ma dgyes pa'i che sa spyong gi 'khu ldog 'du snyam sems 'dzangs pa dang / tshe 'di'i 'dun thabs sgrub pa la yang rje ma dgyes na 'grub dka' bar mthong nas/ sku mdun du phyag 'bul 'byor 'bul ba dpang mtho bcas la zhe med pa'i bshags pa phul ba bzhin bzod pa bzhes/ bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po mdzad de lgi lo 1830 rab byung 14 lcags stag dgung grangs bzhi bcu tham pa la gsang sngags cheras gling du zhing lam sa gzhan du gshegs sku / //de nga nga thugs sprul 'jigs rnge da grasas di 'i rnam thar las btus pa lags so / / 416 ru

sde srid khri rabs nyer brgyad pa'i lo rgyus ni/ ci ༄༄ / / zhabs dung gi gsung sprul khyodags las rnam rgyal gyi sku phreng gsum pa/ ngag ke bang ye shes rgyal mtshan ni/ rim phu bkra shis cheras rdzong gi chab cadag wang la sar la nas spyi lo 1781 rab byung 13 lcags glang lo la 'chings/ sku na chung ngu'i dus nas gdan sar spyan dungs/ rje mkhan po shes rab seng ge nas bar ma da ba byung dang dge tshul sdo ma pa zhus shing dbang lung la 'thor zhus/ rje mkhan po 'jam dbyangasari rgyal ma tshan las bsnyen par rdzogs te brda yig za ma tog dang sum rtags snyan ngag la sogs rig gnas dang bshes spyings dang spyod 'jug brtag gnyis sdo ma gsun / la sogs pa mdo sngags kyi gzhung la gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad/ gdam sa ngag sdong po sum bsgril dang phyag chen lhan cig skyes spyor sogs smin khrid gdams pa yongs su rdzogs/ pa zhus te/ gsang chen cerdzos 'a'o/ra du sku 3/tshams dam par bzhugs te thugs dam nyams bzhes ma dzad/ sde srid 'byug rnam rgyal gyis tsa ba'i bla mad bkur te bzhugs pa'i skabs/ sde srid 'byug rnam rgyal dang sde thud bsod nams rgyal 4 tshan gnyis ma ma༄na pad nange zing dmag 'grigs langs te sde srid 'byug rnam rgyal bkrongs te/ sde zur bsod nam sa rgyal ma tshan slar sde srid khri thog gyon/ sde srid gshegs mi'i phyogs gtogs rnam sa shin hu 'jigs skrag chen po dang bcas phyir bros/ phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi sprul sku ye shes rgyal mtshan yang sde srid gshegs mi'i phyogs gtogs su sku nga bas phyag gasku ga rnams dang bcas sngangs stabs kyis rje 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis mgon kyibs mdzad de bal po'i lha khang du bzhugs su 4/7

bcug dgung grangs nyi dza/ rtsa gcig la khri sprul tshul khrims grags pa dang phyogs sprul ye shes rgyal mtshan gnyis mnyam du bod la lha sa dang bsam yas la skusnags pa'i gnas gzigs la byon/ slar log byon dus dbon sras tsho ring dbang chen gyi skye ba padma chos grags kyang 'khrid de gyon 'dug sngon goms kyi bag chags bzang pos snu sa srid lugs gnyis gar mkhyen rab zla med par gyur pas spyi 'o/ 1807 rab byung 14 me thos dgung grangs nyi dza/ rtsa bdun la mkhan po'i khri la mnga' gserdzol te bzhugs skabs/srungs thang du khri sprul tshul khrims grags pa sde srid kyi khri the ga bzhugs bzhin pa la thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa sde srid mdzad dgos par zhu gsol btab pa'i kyen las zhabs g.yodag rnams zings 'khrug langs pa'i thog rim phu bkra shes che sa rdzong du bzhugs mi rnam sa kyis chags sdang gyogs ris dbang gis phyogs sprul ye shes rgyal ma tshan chos srid gnyis ga'i bdag po sde srid ma ja da dgos par zhus te ñtsa lo 1809rab byung 14 sa sprul la snge srid kyi khrir bsgos 'dug de la brten nas nang 'khrugs kyi brel ba gcig ma cerd ge las brel ba gcig langs/ phyogs sprul ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'ongs nas/ thim rdzo nga pa dang / spa gro dpon slob/ mas rtse dpon slob/ dar dkad dpon hre ba bcas kyi dmag dang / thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa'i longs nas spungs rdzong pa dang / dbang 'dus pho brang rdzong dpon/ chu brag 'go pa sogs kyi dmag sbrang tshang blda la pa bzhin gyi dmag 'grigs chen po langs te mi ser rnams brdabs gsig btang ste nyam thag pa'i skabs/ byams maskurdzon ngag dbang 'jam dpal ye shes rdo rje dang / rje mkhan po bgres pa ngag dbang cerdzos rgyal dang / mkhan po khri thog 'jam dpal grags pa gsum gyis macerd ma na khrigs 'dums mdzad de 418

phan tshun su yang pham rgyal dang phyogs ris med par thugs mthun chu dang mtshe ma 'du ba zhi 'jam bde spyod kyi dpal dang ldan par gyur te/ thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pu dang / phyogs sprul ye shes rgyal mtshan sde srid zung 'brel du bzhugs 'dug de nas mi ring bar thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa zur du bzhugs te/ sde srid kyi khri la phyogs rnam sprul sku ye shes rgyal mtshan bzhugs te ཿtshes srid lugs gnyis kyi tsha4ba srid bde bar skyong bzhin par bzhugs pa la/ thugs sprul 'jigs grarges phyogs gtogs sprungs rdzong pa ka ṭa dpal 'bar gyis phyogs rnam sprul sku'i gzim dpon dar shing bsad pa las slar nang 'khrugs langs te/ sprungs rdzong pa ka ṭa dpal zhabar bo rang bza' tshang thu phrug dang bcas pa gzhung dmag gis thal bar brlag 'dug de nas lugs gnyis kyi chab srid che sa bzhin bkyings te sde srid kyi khri thog lo gsum bzhi tsam bzhugs te dgongs pa zhus nas gdan sa gsang chen chesnas 'khor du gyon te/ skal dzin gyi gdul bya rnams la phyag chen gyi sngon 'gro spyor ba bzhi ldan/ dngos gzhi gdams ngag sdong po gsum bsgril/ nā ro chodas drug phyag chen lhan cig skyes spyor la sogs pa'i smin grol gyi dga' ston 'gyed bzhin bzhugs pa nas bod du byon/ de nas ri ma gyis rgya nag hu yang gyon pa'i 'o/ rgyus snang / de skabs rgya nag nas bsnams gyon ge'i shes rab kyi pha rol hu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa yum rgyas pa gser gyi glogs bam mgo la bzhag pa tsam dang / zhal phye ba tsam gyis ga〈snan bgegs sku1gas nye bar zhi ba'i byin rlabs tshan kha gzhan las che bar grags pa gsang chen ceras 'alo ra du bzhugs/ shing tog a 'bras kyi se na yang de skabs phyogs rnam sprul sku ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis rgya nag nas bsnams te byon par grags pa ltar yin par nges te/ shing 419

'bras 'di 'byug la ma gtogs rgya bal na ma mthong ngo / / de yang zhabs grang rin sgo che'i gsung sprul khyetshogs rnam sprul skru ye shes rgyal mtshan dang / thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa dang / bla ma khri pa rgyal sras bstan 'aci na rab rgyas kyi sprul sku tshul khrims grags pa rnams nang 'khrugs dṛṣṭang ba de ni mi phal cher gyi sems la bla ma sprul pa'i sku rnams kyang sde srid kyi khri la hab thob rgyab ste nang 'khrugs byung ba ltar log par rtog pa yong srid mod/ de ni gtan nas ma yin gyi 'jig rten pa'i gtam dper/bla ma dang yid bzhin nor thu 'du zhes zer ba bzhin/ zhabs mtsheg gi 'khor g.yog rnams sdo so'i bla ma ci yid bzhin gyi nor thu lta thu la re ltos 'cha' nas sdod pa yin pas/ so so'i dme ma go sa mtho zhing dbang tshad chen po yod na 'khor g.yog 'o rang rnams la khe rgud btub cing 'bab khungs mtsheng rgyu dang / gang byed kyang stabs bde bar 'ong bas na/ don ngo ma 'khor g.yog so so'i don la bltas te zhabs 'og gi blon po rnams dang dpon lag rnams kyi rang phyogs so so'i bla ma sprul sku rnams go sa mthon po sde srid kyi khri la bkod gang thub byed de rang srog blos btang ste phyogs so so chags sdang khyetshogs ris kyis dmag 'khrugs kyi bya ba la zhugs pa yin 'dug go /de nas gdan sa gsang chen ceras 'alnga ra rang du gtan du bzhugs te phal cher thugs dam bcad rgya'i ngang du chos spyod gī mdzad pa gong 'phel du bzhugs te dgung lo lnga bcu spyi lo 1830 rab byung 14 lcags stag la zugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus te zhi bar gshegs so/ / 420

sde srid khri rabs nyer dmi pa tsha phyag pa rdo rjer grags pa ni/ tsho༄7/ / chung du nas gdan sa phan tshun du sgrig lam la zhugs/ rim gyis byedas rtse dpon slob kyi go sa thob ste bzhugs pa'i skabs/ gzhung du sde srid gong ma rnams nang 'khrugs gelngang ba rnams dang / zhabs drang thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa dang /'jigs med seng go'i sprul skru tshul khrims grags pa phyogs rnam sprul kri ye shes rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhabs cadag gzim sgar pa rnams chags sdang zings 'khrugs nar mar byung ba rnams/ tsa ba sngar sde srid sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin gyi skabs nas bzung /zings 'khrugs langs kyen phal cher tsha phyag pa rdo rje 'ong gis bzos yod par brten/lo de'i dpyid gar son pa na gong sa phyogs rnam sprul sku dgongs pa zhus nas gsang chen chos 'bor du phebs/ chos rtse'i dpon slob rdo rje gser khrir mnga' gsol/kyibs mgon rin po che nas dzogs mdud mgul dar le tshan mgyogs 'gro spyang shes bcas sal bar mdzad/ skusnang sa nas kyang zhabs brtan legs 'bul gzab rgyas phul bar byas/ spya lo 1811 rab byung 14 lcags lug lo'i zla bzhi pa'i nang chos rtse dpon slob tsha phyag pa rdo rje sde srid kyi khrir 'dzegs kyang / rang gis byas shing bsags pa'i mi dge ba'i las kyi 'bras thu bslu ba med par rang gi rjes su 'brangs te zla ba tsam song ba na/ thim rdzong pa bsod nams 'grag rgyas kyis ngo rgol byas te bkrongs nas srid skyong rdo rje de yang snum zad kyi mar me bzhen du dus kyi chos nyid dang ldan par gyur to/ / ( 421

sde srid khri rabs sum cu pa'i skabs kyi 'o/ rgyus/༄yo༅ / / sde srid khri rabs sum cu pa bsod nams 'byug rgyas ni/ yul wang sri khyod nas spyi lo 1777 rab byung 13 me bya lor 'khrungs nas gzhon nu'i skabs bum thang phyogs su gnas bskor baspyod de bya dkar rdzong dpon ma hā bha la'i zhabs su sto gzan btang / de nas thog mar bya dkar sgo ra pa nas rim gyis che sa rtse dpon slob kyi go gnas thob/ phyis su rim rdzong pa mdzad skabs chos rtse dpon slob tsha phug pa rdo rje sde srid kyi khri las phab ste bkrongs nas/ bsod nams 'grag rgyas rang nyi da spyi lo 181'arab byung 14 chu pho sprel lor sde srid kyi khrir byon/ de skabs sde srid gong ma tsho'i sgar sto rnams kyis sde srid la ngo rgol bya rtsis byas kyang glags ma khel/ sde srid 'di nyid zhabs dung 'jigs med grags pa la sngar mi mo sa kyang rje ngag cadabang ceras rgyal gyis mtshams snreXr legs par mdzad pa las/ phyos snge/ zhabs sprul la yid ches kyi dad pa thob ste tsa ba'i bla mar bsten nas zhabs tog bsnyen bkur legs par zhus 'duga'adus byas kshi dge ba gzhan rgya cher mdzad pa'i 'o/ rgyus gang yang mi snang / de skabs shākya 'od zer sde srid zung 'brel mdzad ces pa'i lo rgyus 'dug kyang sde srid des 'di dang 'di mdzad ces pa'i dmigs bsal 'o/ rgyus gang yang mi 'dug de dus rgya 'byug gnyis sa mtshams sterter 'grigs min khu/nga ba la/ ma༄na lam gyi rgo nas legs par bzo phyir rgya gzhung nas dbyin ji'i sku tshab bā bu ki shān gan zer mi zhig spyi lo 181pa rab byung 14 shing phag la 'byug yul du btang 'dug ki shān gan te nga skabs rgya gar a 422

sam bi dza ni si ni rtsi rang bcas nas thon te srongs thang du slebs 'dug co pa 'grag yul du 73ngas te 'byug sde pa dang bla ma gnyis mjal 'phrad skabs rgya 'byug gnyis kyi mthun lam dang / zhes mtshams skor gsung gros de ltar gnang yod zer ba gang yang mi 'dug sngar khyodags sprul ye shes rgyal mtshan sde khrir bzhugs skabs bal yul 'phags pa shing kun zhig ral sku nga b.ri brten/ bla ma sangs rgyas nor thu zer ba chu mo byu lor nyams gse zhu bar btang ba de me glang 'o/ra sde srid 'di'i skabs legs par grub ste bla ma de 'dir gyon/ de nas mi ring bar sde srid kyi sku la snyung gzhis thebs te zur bzhugs mdzad gnang 'dug/sde srid so gcig pa'i lo rgyus/༄7/ / sde srid khri rabs so gcig pa bstan 'dzin 'byug sgra ni/ thang dar lung nas spyi lo 1771 rab byung 13 lcags yos lor 'khrungs/ sku chung ngu nas chos rje 'byug pa'i rdzong gong ma'i sgrog lam la zhugs/ de nas dang por sprungs rdzong pa'i bdag 'gan bzhes shing mi ring bar gong gzim gyi 'gan khur mdzad bzhugs skabs/ sde srid bsed nams 'byug rgyas dartse ngas pa zhus pa'i rjes su mkhan sle ba 'dus tshe gas bcas pas sde srid mdzad dgos par gsungs te spyi lo 1817 rab byung 14 me glang lor sde srid kyi khrir gyon/ / de'i sngon nas zhabs dung 'jigs med grags pa tsa ba'i bla ma bsten nas zhabs to/sa gang legs zhus shing gus zhen yod pa las/ sde srid mdzad pa nas zhabs dung gi sgar lto thams cad kyang sde pas bdag 'dzin mdzad de phyag 423

phyid zhu ba'i skabs der/ chodas rtse dpon slob dpral bas gong sa la ngo rgol bya rtsis kyis zhabs sprul rin po cher zhu yig gsang stabs su phul ba'i lan du zhabs dung nas/dmag las de 'phral rgyal la thob kyang thugs dmyal bar skye ba'i rgyu yin pas dmag 'khrugs ma byed ces gsungs kyang mi nyan par gzhung du dmag dasung bcug ste g.yul 'thab pa/ra/ dge 'dun pas thugs kyis ma bcad par mkhan rin po che khri zur gnyis chings sgrig bar zhu bskul mdzad pa bzhin byon rung / der ma 'byor zhag shas gong nas snurmes rtse'i dpon slob dbral cung pa de ral gri'i lam nas 'chi bdag gshin rje'i spong du gshegs zin 'dug pa bla ma rnam gnyis kyis me bying sogs mdzad dgos rigs mdzad nas slar phebs/ de nas chab srid lo 5 bskyangs te dgongs zhus kyis gsang sngags zab don pho brang du byon te bzhugs so/ / 424

phyid zhu ba'i skabs der/ chodas rtse dpon slob dpral bas gong sa la ngo rgol bya rtsis kyis zhabs sprul rin po cher zhu yig gsang stabs su phul ba'i lan du zhabs dung nas/dmag las de 'phral rgyal la thob kyang thugs dmyal bar skye ba'i rgyu yin pas dmag 'khrugs ma byed ces gsungs kyang mi nyan par gzhung du dmag dasung bcug ste g.yul 'thab pa/ra/ dge 'dun pas thugs kyis ma bcad par mkhan rin po che khri zur gnyis chings sgrig bar zhu bskul mdzad pa bzhin byon rung / der ma 'byor zhag shas gong nas snurmes rtse'i dpon slob dbral cung pa de ral gri'i lam nas 'chi bdag gshin rje'i spong du gshegs zin 'dug pa bla ma rnam gnyis kyis me bying sogs mdzad dgos rigs mdzad nas slar phebs/ de nas chab srid lo 5 bskyangs te dgongs zhus kyis gsang sngags zab don pho brang du byon te bzhugs so/ / 424

sde srid khri rabs sku gnyis pas bstan srid bsgyungs tshul dang lha mtshams sdu wor si'i skor dang 'dir nang 'khrugs byung tshul/༄7/ / sde srid khri rabs se gnyis pa phur rgyal lam ཿtshes kyi rgyal mtshan ni/ thang srid me nas ya rabs dam pa'i rigs brgyud du spyi lo 1774 rab byung 13pa'i shing rta lor 'khrungs/ skra gzhon nu'i dus nas dge 'dun gyi sder zhugs te chodas rje 'byug pa'i ཿtshes srid zhwa/gas gnyis kyi sgrigs lam rnam gzhag sku gas la rang byan tshud par byung nas/ phyis ༄/ gnyer chen gyi las 'gan blangs nas gzhung la phyag phyo legs par zhus pa las rim pas thim phya hong dpon gyi go gnas bzhes/ de nas ༷sgas brgya'i dpal la gzigs pa'i spyan yangs rim rdzong pa ཿtshes kyi rgyal mtshan de nyid sa'i tshangs pa mchotsheg gi khri 'phang mthon por mnga' gse la/ zhes gsal ba bzhin/ cerdzos rtse dpon slob dpral cung gi ngo rgol thog sku snyun gyis gtses pa las gdan sa chen po sprungs thang bde chen pho brang rdzong du sa skyong bstan 'dzin 'byug sgra srid pa'i dpal 'gyor rmi lam sgyu ma lta thu las nges par 'byung ba'i thugs kyis rgyal srid spangs te dgon par phebs pa'i rjes su/ spu ṅge 183'arab byung 14chu rta lor sde srid kyi khrir gyon pa nas spungs thang rdzong du zab gos kyi mthong grol chen po bzhengs/ de nas sla 8sprod pa'i lor gdan sa chen po bkra shis chodas rdzong gi sgo chen gong ma'i thog sa skyong ba chodas kyi rgyal mtshan gyis 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sku brnyan rten brten pa dang bcas pa'i dri 185 thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pa'i rnam thar byung chub sna ra sus brtsams pa nyis brgya nyer brgyad rgyab nas/186 'jigs med grags pa'i rnam thar nyis brgya nga gnyis kyi rgyab nas gsa'aka425

gtsang khang gsar du bskrun par mdzad/ ces gsal ba bzhin/ snyi 'o/ 18'bu rab byung 14 me khyi lor sde srid 'dis rdzong nang du spyan ras gzigs kyi sku sogs sku gsung thugs rten rgya chen po gsar du bzhengs par mdzad/ bkra shis chodas rdzong gi dbu rtse chen po'i rgya phibs mu khyud 'dom grag cu re gnyis zangs dos nyis brgya brgyad cu rgya brgyad las brdungs te gser to la lnga stong brgyad brgya dang / dngul chu to la nyis khri sum rnyasnang sum brgya bzhi bcu zhe brgyad bcas kyi rgyu dnge sa las legs par grub pa dang / de bzhin padma'i bka' sdod dge bsnyen chen po bzhugs pa'i gnas bde chen phyag gi gtsug lag khang gi rab gsal gser zangs las grub pa dang / mnga' mardzog gi 'bangs mi ser yongs la gnang spyin stsal ba sogs ཿwas dang mthun par rgyal srid tshul bzhin du spyong nas rgyal khab bde spyod dang ldan par bzhugs pa'i skabs der/sngar bā thu ki ro/na gasta sgogi 'grag nas slar rgya gar du song ba'i rjes su rgyal 'ab gnyis 'grigs min byung ba dang mthun lam bzos pa se gas 'o/ rgyus gang yang mi 'dug kyang spya lo 18'do rab byung 14 sa byi la bar ma'i rgyal khab nas dbang bce'ongs kyis rgya gar a sam gyi sa cha mang 31sa len byung bar brten/ rgya gar gzhung phyo gling pa nas dmag mi btang nas bar ma'i dmag mi dang dmag rgyab ste a sam sa cha tshang ma slar thob cing / bar ma'i dmag mi thams cad kyang a sam nas bston btang 'dug de'i rjes su snyo phyogs a sam gyi dpon lag rnams kyis rang gi rgyal khab kyi sa bdag 'dzin bya thub mi 'dug ces pa'i mno bsam rgya gar gzhung gis btang ste/ a sam rgyal lab de rgya gar gyi gling gis len nas de'i mgo 'dren bya rgyu gang yang rgya gar gzhung gis byed pa yin/ 426

de skabs 'grag a sam gnyis nyu war si zhes pa'i sa cha'i ste/ra nas 'grigs min byung 'dug tso war si de rnams la lhu shen sdu war si ( yang na a sam sdu war si ) zhes 'bod pa yin 'dug pas gong gsal nyu war si de phar tshur che chung 'byug lto phyogs kyi ri rdzogs pa'i tsa nas/ rgya gar a sam tshun dang chu mo )sa ṭa nas chu mo lhun si ri yang na dur la tshun (me li 4400 gru bzhi tsam ) yin 'dug sa khun sdu thar si bsdoms 18 'dug pa sdu war si de rnams las bdun rgya gar gyi sa mtshams chu smad smad nasi dang / rnyun si ri )sa ṭa gnyis kyi bar yin 'dug de bdun la a sam sdu thar si dang / sdu thar si 11 rgya gar byang phyogs su yod pa de rnams bha gal nyu war si zhes zer ba yin 'dug a sam sdu war si bdun po 'grag pa la a sam dpon pos byin te thob pa yin 'dug rgya gar a sam gyi dpon pos mthun lam gyis nyu war si bdun po'i sa cha de rnams 'byug pa la spyodad de/ 'byug nas sa de rnams la brten pa'i sa bral len rgyur bzos bzhag 'dug 'byug pas rgya gar a sam gyi darnge na pe la 'o( ltar sa khral zer/ g.yag mthug dang rta gla rtsi gser mal chas bcas dngul la rtsis na 4 078 'dzibacas kyi khral spyod dgos pa bzos bzhag 'dug zho sam 'ongs kyi nyu war si bdun po'i ming gsham gsal/ nya sa ri gu mā/ 'a gā ling sdu war si/3 shā ko la/ rtse gnasaka/5 chu pa gu ri/ 427

6 chab ka ha ma/7 5na ji sdu war si/bhang gal 'ongs kyi nyu war si bcu gnyig po'i ming gsham gsal/ri nya 'i lim ko khri/'a dzu mār ko khri/ sne (me nā gu ri)3 tsa mar rtse (bsam rtse) 4 lu ki sdu thar si/5 sngag sa ne (pā sa la)6 shul kā/7 5rā/8 hu mā ra/9 ri sgo/ 10 rtsi rang /11 sngag yang na cho ḍa bi ji ni/gong gsal 'byug pa'i sdu war si de khar sdod mi rgya gar me tshi dza dang / kā tsa ri zer mi'i mi brgyud yin 'dug par/ tso war si re re'i nang rdzong dpon re a sam mam yang na bhang gal mi brgyud las 'thu ste 'byug sde pa nas bsterdzos mus yin 'dug rgyu gar snyo phyogs sa cha de rnams dbyin ji gzhung gi lag par len grub pa'i rjes su 'byug dang a sam gnyis kyi bar mthun lam sngar bzhin rgyal lab a sam 61 ra'i lag hu yod skabs ltar sdod 'dug/428

rjes su dā raṅga bongs pas lhu ri thu ma zer ba re riḍa por saṃ dang / snaXg nas rgya gar la lo ltar sprod dgos pa'i sa bka pa brten 'gregs len byung 'dug de yang 'byug nas sa khral zer/ rta g.yag mja'ig gser gri cung gla rtsi bcas dnga'il khar cus na grub 4 785 a na 4 sprod dgos 'dug na/ gong gsapa gyi dngos po de /ri/sa rgya gar lag par khu/nga nas 'e ma khar bce ngas tshe nam yang dngul de tsam langs kyi med par brten/ sa khral de las chad de tsam thus zer chad bton te bzhag pa yin 'dug sa khral ༷/ chad de rnams 'phral mabyedags daserig la/gas sbyo/ gar gasdo/nga nas 'byug sde pa la yi ge bkyil rung sprodad mi dre da kyi lan gang yang med par bzhag 'dug pa'i khar/ spyi lo 1828 zla 10 tshes 'a' rab byung 14tshe sa byi lo la lhu ri ghu ma'i rdzong dpon des rgya gar tsha ta si ri zer mi'i steng du dbang btsongs byas te khyim de nang yod mi'i 'byug pa'i kyibs 'tshol ba rnams dang / bdag po de bzung ste khrid song 'dug de skor dbyin gzhung nas zhib dpyod byed par btang nas zhib dpyod byed pa'i bar/dhu ri ghu ma'i rdzo nga dpon des slar bya rogs 'a80 tsam khrid de rgya gar gzhung gi byang phyogs sa srung dmag mi'i steng dbang btsongs byas te de ga'i dmag mi la shas dang / 'go dpon bsod de zhom tsho dang mi kha shas bcings te 'khrid song 'dug de ltar dbang btsongs kyis 'khrid pa'i btson pa de rnams slar log rgya gar gzhung la sprod dgos lugs kyi ste/ra 'byug sde pa la yi ge ji tsam bsta/ra kyang lan gang yang med par/ rgya gar gzhung nas dmag mi btang ste balhurtan pa rnams bcesan khang nas bte na te 'khrid song 'dug de nas bhu ri ghu ma zer ba'i 'brug pa'isdu war si de spya co nya834 rab byung 14shing rta lo tshun rgya gzhung gi pag par tshud song 'dug de skabs 429

'byug gzhugang du sde srid chodas pyi rgyal mtshan la chodas rtse dpon slob rdo rje rnam rgyal gyis dmag dpung yang yang bshams pa la brten nas/ spyi 'i 1831 rababyung 14 pa'i lcags yos lo zla 11pa'i tshes la sde srid chodas kyi rgyal mtshan sde srid kyi khri nas dgongs pa zhus te thur bzhugs mdzad 'dug/sde srid khri rabs se gsum pa'i 'o/ rgyus/༄༄ / / sde srid rdo rje rnam rgyal gyi lo rgyus ni/ wang dar lung la nas spye lo 1772 rab byung 13 pa'i sa phag 'o/ra 'khrungs/ sde srid bsku da nams 'byug rgyas kyi tsha bo yin pas chung ngu'i dus nas sde srid de'i sgar lto mdzad de chodas srid lugs gnyis kyi sgrig lam rnam gzhag la legs par byi ngas nas/ rim pas cerdzos rtse dpon hre ba kyi go gnas thob ste der bzhugs pa nas/ sde srid byed 'dod gī re 'dun chen pos pyo lo 1830 rab byung 14 pa'i lcags stag lor gzhung du sde srid chodas kyi rgyal mtshan la nge cerdzol gyi dpyang da mag batshanams pas gzhung la ma thub par/ lta sar rgya mi phyogam bha la yi ge bskur nas rgya mi'i 'go dngo na des/ mnga' cadag gi dmag mi nyung se'u tsam chos rtse dpon slob rdo rje rnam rgyal gyi grogs ram du btang 'dug pa las/ gosdu lha chos kyi rgyal mtshan dgongs pa zhus/ che sa rtse spyi bla rdo rje rnam rgyal pa sde srid gyi khrir bskos/zla 3pa'i tshes 13la skye 'gro'i las dbang gis 'khrug zings langs nas me kyen byung /gsol thab bkra shis che sa rdzo nga du phebs/ zhes gsal ba bzhin/ sde srid chodas kyi rgyal 187 rje shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar zhal gsu nga ma bden gnyis grub pa'i shing rta sesna bdun rgyab nas/430

pa yang mtho ris su gshegs/ skye 'gro'i las dbang gis 'khrug zing chen po langs zhes gsal ba bzhin/ sde srid 'di smad wang gi phyogs gtogs yin stabs stod wang tshos bkrong rgyu'i grabs sgrig yang yang byed bzhin pa'i ngang/ khri thog lo phyed dang gsum bzhugs pa'i rjes su spyi lo 1835 rab byung 14 shing lug la snyung gzhi thebs nas zhi bar gshegs so/ / sde srid 'di yang zing 'khrugs kyis skru tsho bsnyungs te gshegs sam snyam na de ltar ma yin te/ zhabs dung 'jigs med nor bu'i rnam thar ldeb bdun gyi mdun phreng lnga pa nas/ 5lda spyong ba phrin las bzlog hu med pa'i nad kyis lnga pa'i lam du gshegs 'phral nang zing dmag 'grigs shar/ zhes gsal lo//189 rje thegs rab rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar zhe lnga mdun bzhi pa nas/sde srid so lnga pa'i lo rgyus/༄༄ / / sde srid khri rabs so lnga pa slar yang chodas kyi rgyal mtshan ni/ spyi lo 1835rab byung 14 shing lug lor sde srid phrin las gshegs / skye 'a gro'i las snang gis rdzong nang 'khrugs zings chen po langs te gas/ rje'i grong khyer lta thu gyur rjes srid spyong bgres po chenes kyi rgyal mtshan slar khri thog hu phebs/ sku nga gsal sa cha 'byug gzhung lag par thob ste lo gcig song ba'i rjes/ slar sa gnas bi dza ni ru sdod mi 'byug pa'i mi ser gyis rgya gar nacad gā'an zhes pa'i steng du dbang btsongs byas nas mi mang po bcings te 'khrid song 'dug yang galiṅgar sdod mi mi ser gyis rgya gar 190 shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar de lnga mdun phreng lnga pa nas/434

daraṅga zer ba'i sa khar dbang btsongs kyis ca chas 'phyog bcom byas te khyer 'dug ge/ ma zad/ mi mang po bcings te 'byug yul du btang 'dug der brten spyi lo 1836 rababyung 14 me sprel zla 'a tshes 14 la rgya gar gzhung nas keb )na bo gil dmag mi dang bcas pa zings brel langs sa'i sa gnas der btang 'dug de nas de ga'i rdzong dpon de de wang gu rir bros te song 'dug der de wang gu ri'i rdzong dpon gyis keb )na bo gil mgo bskor ste gsad phyir dmag mi dug brgya tsam 'khrid de keb )na rgo gi pa dang 'phrad pa yin zhes sku nga ba na/ snga nga gnyis dmag 'khrugs langs/ te rdzo nga dpon de slar de wang gu ri'i phyogs su bros song 'dug de nyin nas bāka sa nyu thar si de phyi gling pa'i lag par krenar 'dug /de rjes 'brug gzhung nas sde srid chodas kyi rgyal mtshan gyis rgya gzhung la masku gur ba'i yi ge zhig bris te gzim sgar gcig gi mdun rgya gar phyo gling rgyal sa ka li ka tar btang 'dus yi ge de nang da tshun 'grag snyo mtshan sa kyi rdzong dpon rnams kyis rgya gzhung mi ser steng du dbang btsongs tshad med byas pa dang / ca chas 'phyog bcom byas te 'byug yul du khyer se nga ba sku gas kyi cha rgyus sde pa la med ma zad/ de ltar nyes pa tshad med byas pa'i ste/ra rgya gzhung nas btang ba'i yi ge yang ma rā ba/ da tshun sa khral chad lus pa yang sdu war si'i rdzong dpon nas 'phral du len dgos pa dang /grag sa sdu war si de slar 'o/ga 'a/grag sde pa'i lag par sprod dgos zhes bris 'dug de nas yi ge 'byor ma thag sde pa'i gzim sgar dang la lab ste bāg sa sdu war si 'byug pas slar log thob pa'i bka' tham phyo gling rgyal mo'i sku tshabartenas sprod 'dug rgya gzhung nas btang ba'i yi ge'i rigs sa mtshams la'i rdzong dpon nai mas kyis bkag ste sde 435

'byug sgu/ slob dpon yon tan/ rdzong dpon spyid tshal pa sogs gyon/ thugs bsnyun gyi sgo nas srid skyong bgres pa ཿtshes kyi rgyal mtshan bde bar zur du bton/ zhes gsal ba bzhin/ rje shes rab rgyal mtshan dang 'dus 〉pyogs lhan rgyas kyis skurdzong sa'i srung spyob mdzad de rdzong gzhis lcags pa sangs rgyas la rtsis spyod gnang nas sde srid bgres po chos kyi rgyal mtshan dgon par gyon 'dug go/ sde srid so dug pa dang so bdun pa'i lo rgyus/ ci༄zhu / / sde srid khri rabs so dug pa rdo rje nor thu ni/ spyi lo 1800 dang rab byung 13pa'i lcags sprel lor wang si le la na kri 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas rdzong gong ma'i sgar lto'i gral du zhugs te rim pas dar dkar dpon slob rkya go gnas thob/ rje shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar zha brgyad kyi rgyab nas/ de skabs skye 'aX 'i las dbang btā ga tu med pas 'khrug zings chen po langs/ mthon po'i go sa de yang mi rtag cing 'gyur ba mngon sum du ston pas 'dus tshogs dang mnyam du gong sa'i srung spyob mdzad/ rdo rje nor thu khrir phebs/ zhes daskre / sermis can gyi las ngan thog hu babs pas de 'phul dus 'khrugs langs gasnyadang mkhar rjengang dnge na sangs rgyas dmag la the na sprungs thang rdzong sprodar/ srid skyong chodas kshi rgyal myo/tshan nyid glo thur du mkhan chen rje'i zhab ga sar phebs/ gzhan rnams bros bzur la song / mi ring bar gong sa rdo rje nor su 193 zhabs grang 'jigs med sna ra su'i rnam thar zhal gsungs ma bdun mdun nas/437
