shos tshor lo rgyus gsungs/ bar grong lha khang du sde srid rdo rje nor thu dang bkra shis rdo rje rnam gnyis zhal 'dzoms mdzad de bshags byings kyi bskang chodag gnang /dam bca' byed par ta 'o/gas gsang gling du byon zhabs dung gi sku gdung dang mgon thang la tshogs brgya phyal nas dam bca' mdzad de bkra shis rdo rje yang srongs thang rdzong nang gyon nas rgyal drodan tshang ma thugs snang gtsang mar mdzad/de skabs rgya mtshams su spyi 'o/ 1839 rab khu/nga 14 sa phag la 'grag pas rgya gar mi bcu gcig dbang bstongs kyis khrid song 'dug sde srid nas rgya gar phyo gling rgyal mo'i sku tshab la spyi lo 1840 rab byung 14 lcags byi la yi ge zhig btang 'dugade'i nang gsal bi /lta snyur gyi gzim dpon bgres pa ri gta zhes pa des rdo rje slob dpon gyis rgyud bskul rgyab ste 'byug gi nub phyogs sdu war si rnams dbang btsongs kyis len te de ga'i mi ser thams cad 'phyo brlag btang mus 'dug pa de skor sde pa dang / bla ma gnyis nas yi ge dang sgrag gzim sgar khyi la zer ba khyod tsar btang yod rung / khyod nas de'i 'go 'dren thabs gang yang byed rgyu mi 'dug 'byug bla ma de ni phun pa'i phyogs yin ma gtogs rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyogs min/ khyod kyis rdo rje slob da pon kha la rtsa las nyan mi dgo sa/ zhes bskur ba'i yi ge 'di rgya gar gzhung la 'byor ba dang / rgya gar gzhung gi bsam par/ 'brug sde pa lo rang nas sku nga gsal gī sa cha gzhan la 31ra sku nga ba de slar 'o/ga len ma thub pa ma zad/ 'byug nas cadangs pa'i gzim sgar pa'i la la nyan tshe 'byug gis dbang ba'i sdu war si rnams rgya gar gzhung la sprod de sa cha de rnams la brten pa'i khral spyod na 'thus mus 'dug ces rgya gzhung nas de skor gyi lo rgyus lab phyor sku tshab gcig 'brug yul du btang rtsis byas 'dug sku 9 439

tshab ma btang ba'i bar rang re 'byug pas da dung rgya gzhung ༷ nga khyim lnga tsam gyi steng du dbang bcesangs byas te ca chas 'phyog bcom byas 'dug de la brten rgya gzhung nas 'byug shar phyogs nyu war si ka liṅga dang bhu ri ghu mā gnyis lo nga gi lag tu len tshib 'dug/spyi lo 1841 rab byung 14 zla 5 tshes 'anya la rgya gar phyi gling rgyal mo'i sku tshab lasde srid dang bla ma gnyis nas yi ge zhig btang nas 'khyodar pa de'i nang 'byug pas rgya gar gzhung la sa khral chad 'u/sa pa rnams dresad tsu/ yin par/ 'byug pa'i sa rgya gzhung lag par tshud pa slar log dgos rgyu dang / rdo rje spob dpon sde pa min pa'i thungs skyel daskusnas na rgya gzhung sku tshab gcig dgun dus 'byug la btang dasku sa zhes bris 'dug de skabs kyi rdo rje slob dpon ni bar cung ngam dam chos lhun grub yin tshod du snang / de nas spye lo 1841 rab byung 14lcags glang lo la keb )na dpal 'bar )na gyis bzos pa'i chings yig gi don la gnas te sa mtshams khar thung zad spyid po byung 'dug/sngar spye lo 1784 rab byung 13 shing 'byug lo la bi gan cir ja men dā ra las zhom bha ri pha la ke ṭa gam pa ni gzhung gis len te 'byug gzhung la sprodad pa de yang spyo lo 1841rarab byung 14 lcags glang pa gam pa ni gzhung gis len te ti rub spyod 'dug de skabs 'brug yul nang du 'byug sde pa'i go sar sings thang rdzong du sde srid rdo rje nor bu dang thim phu bkra shis chodas rdzong du sde srid bkra shis rdo rje gnyis mthun lam med par gnas te zings brel cher langs mus 'dug par/ ( baṅgal sdu thar si'i)don du bi gas cir gyi rdzong dpon gyi thu rdzong dpon dur gha zer ba de dang / har go 440

tshab ma btang ba'i bar rang re 'byug pas da dung rgya gzhung ༷ nga khyim lnga tsam gyi steng du dbang bcesangs byas te ca chas 'phyog bcom byas 'dug de la brten rgya gzhung nas 'byug shar phyogs nyu war si ka liṅga dang bhu ri ghu mā gnyis lo nga gi lag tu len tshib 'dug/spyi lo 1841 rab byung 14 zla 5 tshes 'anya la rgya gar phyi gling rgyal mo'i sku tshab lasde srid dang bla ma gnyis nas yi ge zhig btang nas 'khyodar pa de'i nang 'byug pas rgya gar gzhung la sa khral chad 'u/sa pa rnams dresad tsu/ yin par/ 'byug pa'i sa rgya gzhung lag par tshud pa slar log dgos rgyu dang / rdo rje spob dpon sde pa min pa'i thungs skyel daskusnas na rgya gzhung sku tshab gcig dgun dus 'byug la btang dasku sa zhes bris 'dug de skabs kyi rdo rje slob dpon ni bar cung ngam dam chos lhun grub yin tshod du snang / de nas spye lo 1841 rab byung 14lcags glang lo la keb )na dpal 'bar )na gyis bzos pa'i chings yig gi don la gnas te sa mtshams khar thung zad spyid po byung 'dug/sngar spye lo 1784 rab byung 13 shing 'byug lo la bi gan cir ja men dā ra las zhom bha ri pha la ke ṭa gam pa ni gzhung gis len te 'byug gzhung la sprodad pa de yang spyo lo 1841rarab byung 14 lcags glang pa gam pa ni gzhung gis len te ti rub spyod 'dug de skabs 'brug yul nang du 'byug sde pa'i go sar sings thang rdzong du sde srid rdo rje nor bu dang thim phu bkra shis chodas rdzong du sde srid bkra shis rdo rje gnyis mthun lam med par gnas te zings brel cher langs mus 'dug par/ ( baṅgal sdu thar si'i)don du bi gas cir gyi rdzong dpon gyi thu rdzong dpon dur gha zer ba de dang / har go 440

bind gta ma zer ba gnyis kyang zings 'khrugs langs 'dug dur gha rdzong dpon gyi rgyab dbang rdzong pa dang / har go bond gta ma gi rgyab rim rdzong pa yin 'dug nyar go bind gta ma nas rgya gzhung la'ang ro/gas ram 'tshe la 'dug rgya gzhung gis ro/gas ram gnang na lo ltar rub 50 000re spyod 'ong zhes lab 'dug phyo gling rgyal mo'i sku tshab aka lenaṭa zer ba des go nga gsal rdzong dpon su'i rgyab kyang byas mi 'dug ma zad/ 'byug sde pa dang bla ma gnyis la deng skabs 'byug pa/la nang gnas tshul ma skyed pa'i skor yi ge bris te btang 'dug skru tshab yog lan )'i bsam par rgya gzhung nas 'byug yul du sku tshab ji ltar btang rung / mthun lam bzang po zhig nam yang bzo tshugs mi 'dug sku tshab 'byug yul btang ba don med yin 'dug 'byug nyu war si rgya gzhung lag hu ma tshud pa rnams kyang len dasku sa pa'i bka' 31ga rgya gar byung khyodags sa mtshams kyi sku tshab de la bkyil 'dug sa cha de rnams la brten pa'i 'o/ ltar rub 109000re 'byug gzhung la spyod dgos zhes pa'i bka' rgya gnang 'dug de bzhin a sam tso war si yang spyi lo 1841 rab byung 14 lcags glang lo la yisi yin ḍi ya gam pa ni gzhung la sprod de lo rer sa khral rub 10 000 re 'byug gzhung la len rgyu'i chings yig bzos 'dug de'i rjes su yang 'byug pas rgya gar ༷ nga khyim lag la dbang btsongs kyis mi bsad pa dang / 'khrid de 'byug yul du btang ba dang / ca chas 'phyog bcom gyi bya ba mang rab byas 'dug de rnams lto phyogs sa mtshams skor gyi lo rgyus yin/'dir gzhung du slar yang spyi lo 1845 rab byung 14 shing sgrul lo da bkra shis chos rdzong maskutshen khang dang / gsang zab mgon khang du gsung ཿtsheg zhag lnga gnang nas 441

phyo nang dpon 'go tsho dang spungs rdzong du bzhugs pa'i sde srid rdo rje nor bu yang byon nas phan tshun thugs snang gshin pas mjal 'phrad mdzad/ bla blosab 'dus snangags masku na khang du zhal 'jo(ma the ga rgyal tre na che phra thams cad kyis la bzhi'i rgyal lams bde bar skyong ba'i mdzad bzang gong 'phel ma gtogs gros ngan phung dkrol sus kyang byed mi snu ga pa'i dam bca' zhus/ tshig don 'gyur med yig thi'u bsdams te so sor sprod/ de nas bzung thugs snang shin tu gtsang bar sde srid rdo rje nor thu dang bkra shis rdo rje gnyis zung 'brel du chab srid cerdzos dang mthun par skyong bzhin par spyi lo 1848rab byung 14 sa sprel lor sde srid rdo rje nor thu snyung gzhi thebs te bde bar gshegs so /sde srid so bdun pa'i lo rgyus ni/༄༄ / / sde srid khri rabs so bdun pa bkra shis rdo rje ni/ thim phya bkra shis chos rdzong gi chab 'og yul wang dar lung nas spyi lo 17'do rab byung 13 chu stag lor 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas sde srid che sa kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sgar lto mdzad de che sa rje 'byug pa'i las tshan rnams rim gyis mthar 'khyol te bkra shis ceras rdzong gi rdzong dnge na skusna sar bzhugs skabs/ garsha nga sgar pa lcags pa sangs rgyas kyis gordzong sa ceras kyi rgyal mtshan la ngo rgol byas pa'i rjes/ spungs thang du rdo rje nor thu sde srid kyi khrir bton pa la stod wang rnams kyis ma nyan par thim phur bkra shis rdo rje sde srid kyi khrir bton nas/ spungs thang sde srid rdo rje nor thu dang thim thu'i sde srid bkra shis rdo rje gnyis spyi lo 183'arab byung 14 sa pho khyi lo nas spyi lo 184'a chu pho stag lo'i bar 442

phan tshun mthun lam med par gnas/ serdzong du gsal ba ltar rjes su thugs snang gtsang bar sde srid zung 'brel du bstan srid bskungs tshul lo bdun bar mtshungs shing / spye lo 1848 rab byung 14sa sprel lor rdo rje nor sngo gshegs pa'i phyo lor la bzhi'i chab 'bangs mi ser yongs la gnang rgyun lan gnyig stsal zhing / de'i sngar nas kyang sman rdzongs rgyal khab spyi bde thabs su lha mgon gyi srid pa'i mdos chen ga nang zhing / 'dus tshogs la 'gran zla bral ba'i rol mo sgo gsang gsar du bsgrubs te phul ba de la/ 'cham rol bkra shis rdo rje zhes da lta'i bar 61ngas su grags pa min/ spyi lo 1849 rab byung 14 sa bya lor sprungs rdzong me 'jigs lnga pa byung ste dge 'dun 'dus tshogs kyang gsol thabs spa gro rin srongs rdzong du phebs/ sde srid kyis lo 'khor gcig la mings rdzong legs par grub pa'i rjes yun ma ring bar snyung gzhi bas) khrithog nas dgongs ma zhus te gra'o/ rabad nga lags khyi da // 1850 〈sna 1'pho ca lor mtho ris su gshegs/ / 443

phan tshun mthun lam med par gnas/ serdzong du gsal ba ltar rjes su thugs snang gtsang bar sde srid zung 'brel du bstan srid bskungs tshul lo bdun bar mtshungs shing / spye lo 1848 rab byung 14sa sprel lor rdo rje nor sngo gshegs pa'i phyo lor la bzhi'i chab 'bangs mi ser yongs la gnang rgyun lan gnyig stsal zhing / de'i sngar nas kyang sman rdzongs rgyal khab spyi bde thabs su lha mgon gyi srid pa'i mdos chen ga nang zhing / 'dus tshogs la 'gran zla bral ba'i rol mo sgo gsang gsar du bsgrubs te phul ba de la/ 'cham rol bkra shis rdo rje zhes da lta'i bar 61ngas su grags pa min/ spyi lo 1849 rab byung 14 sa bya lor sprungs rdzong me 'jigs lnga pa byung ste dge 'dun 'dus tshogs kyang gsol thabs spa gro rin srongs rdzong du phebs/ sde srid kyis lo 'khor gcig la mings rdzong legs par grub pa'i rjes yun ma ring bar snyung gzhi bas) khrithog nas dgongs ma zhus te gra'o/ rabad nga lags khyi da // 1850 〈sna 1'pho ca lor mtho ris su gshegs/ / 443

sde srid so brgyad pa'i lo rgyus/༄༄ / / sde srid khri rabs so brgyad pa dbang phyug rgyal po ni/ yul wang lar khris nas spyi lo 1800 rab byung 14 lcags sprel lo la 'khrungs/ sku na chung ngu'i dus su srungs thang du dge 'dun gyi sder zhugs te che sa rje 'brug pa'i sgrig lam rnam gzhag dang / 'bri klog yodan tan gyi gzhi la rang byan tshud par byings/ phyos su sngon las dang 'phral kyen gyis rdzong gong mar thon nas rim phu bkra shis chodas rdzong gi gnyer chen gyi 'gan blangs pa mthar 'khyol nas rim gyis bkra shis chodas rdzong du rdzong dpon gyi go sar bzhugs pa'i skabs/ sde srid /bo shis rdo rje snyun tshab chen pos bsnyungs te sde srid kyi khri nas dgongs pa zhus pa'i rjes su spyi lo 1850 rab byung 14 pa'i lcags khyi lo zla ba 'a pa'i tshos la sde srid kyi khri la 'bod 'dug kyang / mi ring bar zla ba dug tsam se nga ba na/ 'asgrini gzhung gi sde srid gsar pa la dbang thang mi 'dug gsungs te/gle bur du bod la thugs khyodags pas/ zhes gsal ba bzhin/ spa ༷ dpon slob bgres pa tshu pa khrims rnam rgyal lam a rgas has pa dang / dawa na blosab khri pa mardzon tan rin chen nam stag gzig rje na ma 'o/nga gnyis chags sdang gi zings 'khrugs langs pa na/ rim phug rdzong dpon tsha phyag pa tsho dbang dang bla ma'i gzim dpon bsod nams don tshib gnyis kyis sde srid dbang phyug rgyal pos bka' ma dung zhes bkrongs pa'i tshul ni/195 thugs sprul 'jigs med nor bu'i rnam thar so gcig mdun nas/ sde srid kyang snyun bab ñtsa ba dang bsnyun thim rdzong ridabang khu/ga rgyal 〈sna sa'i tshangs pa mcheras gi khrir bkode/ ces gsa'/196 byang chub brtson 'tshis kyi rtogs brjod ngo mtshar nor bu'i snying po'i brgya bdun rgyab nas/444

'jigs med nor bu'i rnam thar so gsum gyi mdun nas/ de'i dus su rin srongs dpon hre ba tshul khrims rnam rgyal dang yodan tan rin chen gnyis nang ma gshin pas 'khrugs gzhi che tsam shar ba sde srid nas bka'i phebs batre 'grigs min gyi kyen las bkras rdzong pa tshe dbang dang bdag gi gnyen gzim dpon bsode nams don grub gnyis gzhan kyen gyis g.yos pa las brten/sde srid dbang phyug rgyal po yang gri mardzog hu bkum/ zhes gsa'adirgi47 gi tshe sems can spyi mthun gyi las ngan mi dge ba'i rgyu mthun dang / bdag po'i 'bras thu gcig hu smin pa lta bus rgyal blon nang ma gshin pa'i lke 'gras kyis glo thur du sde srid dbang phyug rgyal po mchon khar bkum pa'i kyen las/ sde gzar chu g.yo ba ltar gyur nas mi ser thams cad sdug la spyor zhing / sde srid gshegs mi'i phyogs gtogs dpon 'go 'ga' zhig kyang bsad de nang 'khrugs me 'bar te rdzong nang gshin rje'i grong khyer lta thur gyur/ sde srid gshegs mi'i ja dpon shes rab mthar phyin gyis gtsos pa'i zhabs phyo rnams kyis gsang zab rdzong zin te/ sde srid gshegs mi'i phyogs gtogs dbang rdzong pa lcags pa sangs rgyas spa gror khri bsdums mdzad par byon nas bzhugs pa 'dir dmag rgyab la zhus te byon nas/ dbang rdzong pa lcags pa sangs rgyas dasung tshogs bcas gsang zab rdzong du 'dzul nas gsang zab rdzong zin mi rnams dang phyogs gcig byas te thim rdzong pa tshe dbang dang dmag 'khrug chen por gyur/ mi ring bar zla ba brgyad pa'i nang lha mo'i sgrub mchod skabs rim thug rdzong dpon tsha phyag pa tshe dbang lung bstan phur dmag la song ba la g.yog po ngan pa'i g.yo 'phrul gyis rgyab dpung med pa bo rang gcig su yin par brten/ dbang rdzong pa lcags pa sangs rgya'i ga kyi dmag dgang gis bsad 'dug /197 bstan 'dzin lhun grub kyis mdzad pa rje yon tan rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar so lnga'i mdun nas/ 445

de nas dbang rdzong pa lcags pa sangs rgyas kyis tsha phyag pa tshe dbang gi ma rgan bos te/ tshe dbang gi mgo lag khram shing la spyar ba der lta bcug ste/ 'di ngo shes kyi 'dug gam zhes dris pa la/ ma rgan des nga'i thu yin 'dug la/ che sa rje 'byug pa'i lā skal/ rang gi bya bzhag nyes pa las brten bya ba 'di la thug serdzong 'dug lus las skyes pa'i bu bya ba 'di la thug rung slab ni ga ni yang med/ lus las ma skyes pa'i thu nā yī/ nga mo ring mo'i spyod sdug khyod rang gis mkhyen/ khyod rang gis gzigs gnang dgos zhes zhus pa las/ de ltar yin na btub ces gsungs te thim rdzong pa tsho dbang spongs mi'i ma rgan la dbang rdzong pa lcags pa sangs rgyas kyis ma bu'i 'du shes bzhag ste spyod sdug lta ba'i 'o/ rgyus 'dug go / skye bo lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ ma btab gnad du thug pa'i mchon/ / ma 'thungs bong du song ba'i sman/ / ma myangs yid 'phyog sbrang rtsi'i ro/ / tshig gi khyad par rnams la yod/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin/ mo ring mo de'i tshig lab thang khyad par gyis dbang rdzong pa lcags pa sangs rgyas ma rgan de'i bur gyur 'dug go / 446

de nas dbang rdzong pa lcags pa sangs rgyas kyis tsha phyag pa tshe dbang gi ma rgan bos te/ tshe dbang gi mgo lag khram shing la spyar ba der lta bcug ste/ 'di ngo shes kyi 'dug gam zhes dris pa la/ ma rgan des nga'i thu yin 'dug la/ che sa rje 'byug pa'i lā skal/ rang gi bya bzhag nyes pa las brten bya ba 'di la thug serdzong 'dug lus las skyes pa'i bu bya ba 'di la thug rung slab ni ga ni yang med/ lus las ma skyes pa'i thu nā yī/ nga mo ring mo'i spyod sdug khyod rang gis mkhyen/ khyod rang gis gzigs gnang dgos zhes zhus pa las/ de ltar yin na btub ces gsungs te thim rdzong pa tsho dbang spongs mi'i ma rgan la dbang rdzong pa lcags pa sangs rgyas kyis ma bu'i 'du shes bzhag ste spyod sdug lta ba'i 'o/ rgyus 'dug go / skye bo lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan las/ ma btab gnad du thug pa'i mchon/ / ma 'thungs bong du song ba'i sman/ / ma myangs yid 'phyog sbrang rtsi'i ro/ / tshig gi khyad par rnams la yod/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin/ mo ring mo de'i tshig lab thang khyad par gyis dbang rdzong pa lcags pa sangs rgyas ma rgan de'i bur gyur 'dug go / 446

sde srid khri rabs so dgu pa'i lo rgyus ni/༄khya / / sde srid khri rabs so dgu pa zhabs dung 'jigs med nor thu ni/ yab padma gling pa'i gdung brgyud bstan 'dzin che sa rgyal dang / yum gong ma 'jigs med grags pa'i a rtse 'byug rgyal mo gnyis kyi sras su spyi lo 1831 dang rab byung 14 lcags yos/ lor dgra med rtse wan mkhar du rngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs/sde srid a thang pa phrin las kyis skru chung ngu'i dus nas gzhung du gdan springs te gser khrir mnga' gasku la/ mi ring bar sde srid a thang pa phrin las bsnyungs te gshegs/'phral du nang zings dmag 'khrugs langs/ sde zur cheras kyi rgyal mtshan slar sde srid kyi khrir phebs/ rje 'jam dpal grags pa dang 'jam dpal rgya mtshe padma bzang pe sogs skusnangs 'dzin dam pa rnams las rig pa'i gnas rnams la byings pa mthar phyin par mdzad/ sprungs thang du nang 'khrugs langs/ gzhong sgar rdzong dpon lcags pa sangs rgyas dmag la thon spungs thang rdzong 'phyogs te rdo rje nor thu sde srid gī khrir bskos/ thim phyogs su bkra shis rdo rje sde srid kyi khrir bskos te lag gnyis su song /yab krong gsar dpon slob bstan 'dzin che sa rgyal chodas rtse nas gzhung du khri sgrig par gyon pa yin nayang 'dir phebs pa'i tsho gzhan kyen gyis sde srid bkra shis rdo rje'i phyogs gtogs su sku nga bas yab kyis srongs rdzong du bzhugs ma bcug par gyon dgos shar ba la 'gyon stabs ma bde bar/ gos khyung nang bsdams te 'gyon dgos shar 'dug pa'i tshul 447

/srin spungs thang du rgyal blon phan tshun gyi 'grigs 'dum la bdag gi pha de dus chodas rtse dpon slob tu yod pa byon me mda' sgang byu bar bzhugs/ drin can de nyid mi ngan kha shas kyi g.yos pa'i kyen las bkra shes rdzong pa'i phyogs gtogs par thal/ de dang dus mtshungs snge/ ga31la gzim rnams la pha rgan gyi bka' nan ches par brten sa phag zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes 18 la slob dpon padma bzang po chod ga btang rgyu'i snyad la brten nas sngon la gdan dungs/ de rjes bdag kyang dal 'gyor gyi mi lus thob bzhin du shing 'bras zhes bya bar mtshan gse la nas de sa khyung ko nag can gyi nang du bsdams te drin can pha'i zhabs la bsten par gyur to/ / der rang gi gan sa tshul rang gis kyang brjod mi shes par gyur te pha rgan po dang 'phrad pas sems dga' ba ni me ltar 'bar/ mi nag gi grong snyugs ma dang thal bas 'tshubs pa'i nang du gu dog pa'i snang ba ni rlung ltar 'tshubs/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba gsod cig rdungs shig bya ba'i ngar sgras 'gyings pa'i nang du 'jigs shi nga ya nga ba'i kun rtog ni ri gzar la chu rgyug pa bzhin shar ba'i skabs der/ rin sprungs dpon hre ba tshul khrims rnam rgyal byon thugs dgyes pa'i gsung gleng rim pa ltar bgyis nas gyi la sgang brgyud cang yul rab la thon nas nor thu sgang du sus tshangs pa bkra shes rdo rje yang bdag bsu bar phebs/ lhan rgyas su gsang gling rje gong ma'i gdan sar slobs der tshogs 'khor bskang ba dang bcas pa grub nas phrin las sgang du phyin/ de dus bdag gi pha rgan po de yang sngon las thog tu babs nas gri 'og hu gum pa ltar sku thung phrin las 198 zhabs drung 'jigs med nor su'i rnam thar rang nyid kyi tshul gsal bar brjod pa'i gtam thar 'dod yongs kyi gdung sol zhes bya ba 'jigs med rshasnar su rang gi zhal gsungs ma dmi'i mdun nas/448

snang du len nas rje 'jam mgon bla ma rin po che dang slob dpon yon tan rgya mcho gnyis gdan dungs te rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor du bsregs byugs mdzad/ces gsal/ de skabs dgung lo dgu yin 'dug de nas bkra shis chodas rdzong du gyon nas rje shes rab rgyal mtshan spyan dungs nas sngerdzon 'a〈sna nas btsams phyag chen ceras dug se gas smin ༷snal gyi gdams pa gsan nas bstan pa'i gce'o therdzor bzhugs/ zhal gsungs rnam thar bcu gnyis rgyab nas/ spyi 'o/ 184'a rab byung 14 chu stag 'o/ra chos rtse'i dpon slob pa dang dbang rdzong pa gzim dpon sangs rgyas sogs kyis shar phyogs su sde gzar gyi 'khyoms cher gaskusnas nas ngan gakrerdzo sna chogs shig bshams te bdag gi khu bo 'byug sgra seng ge dang gcen po bsod nams don grub gnyis lhun rtse dang gzhong mkhar rdzong dpon du yod pa dang / shar rdzong gzhan pa bcas la dmag 'thab hu song bar rdzong dpon gzhan rnams dang 'ong gnyis la bral song bas gdeng ma thub par khu gcen gnyis ༷ sa/ rta dbang dang gdung bsam yas man la 'grims par gyur cing ma rgan mo de yang bzung btson du bcug pha yul gyo rten rnams bshig chos chas rnams 'thor grwa btsun rnams kyang phyogs su byer zhing snge na pha mes dus kyi chas la rnying khungs su gyur pa rnams kyang phyogs te re zhig mi tshe gcig la bskal pa dgu/ zhes 'jig rten pa'i gtam dper brjod pa dang gcig par gyur to/ / de dus 'o so na tshod phra bas gang cir phan thogs su gyur pa'i nus pa med kyang snang tshul rnam go bas sems shin tu phreng mod ci bya gtol med du gyur dus/ ma rgan mo de nyid pha yul dang bral nas dbang 'dus pho brang stag rdzong du bcug ring po ma lon par rje padma bzang pos bde bar sdod chodag pa'i bka' drin stsal/ mthar de nas kyang 'byug 449

bkra shis chodas rdzong rang du yong chodag par byas te phebs pa bdag dang lams bzang du 'phrad pa'i dga' ston la yun ring du spyod chodag pa 'di byung ngo / / zhes gsal ba bzhin dgung grangs dgu la yab bkre ngas/ bcu gnyis la 'i/ma bathengan la bcug lo sogs kyi spyod sdug myong 'dug go / de nas sde srid dbang chen rgyal po thim rdzong pa tshe dbang gis bkrongs/ tshe dbang yang dbang rdzong pa lcags pa sangs rgyas kyis bkrongs te zings 'khrugs chen po langs kyang bkra shis che sa rdzong ma 30ra bar yod pas/ dge 'dun mangs dang rin spyi tshul khrims rnam rgyal nas thugs sprul 'jigs med nor su la sde srid mdzad dgos par gsol ba btab 'dug zla149 bdun pa'i nang bstan pa'i chag chen gyi dbang las ma smad khros pa'i dal yams rdo rje tshor ma can gyis rdzong gi phyo nang kun khengs pas/ mo ma'i ngag lab yin zhes lhan rgyas rnams 'dod mthun gyi thog bdag re zhig chodas srid zung 'brel gyi khri thog hu sdod dgos pa'i gnas tshul bshad pa bzhin/ ra'i rdzi bo mi 'ong bzhin du rta rdzi byed pa'i dpe ltar gnyis med seng ge'i go sa de nyid bdag hu 'dzin par byas so/ sde / zhes gsungs pa bzhin dbyin lo 1850 rab byung 15 lcags khyi lor dgung grangs nyi shu tham pa la sde srid kyi khrir mnga' gse la nas cerdzos rje dpal ldan 'grag pa'i lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa zung 'brel du spyong ste bzhugs pa na zla 11 pa'i tshos la 'grum nad kyis bsnyungs pa bsnyun gdangs te sde srid khri nas dgongs pa zhus te gdan sar bzhugs pa'i skabs der/'byug gzhung khyerags snge/ setre sa ma༄snan therdzor bzhugs pa rnams kyis thugs sran nge zhus shing / rgya bod gang du byon rung gyon zhes zhus pa'i kyen gyis thugs nges par byung ste/199 thugs sprul 'jigs med sna ra su rang gi rnam thar zhal gsung ma sku ga༄6ma gyi rgyab nas/450

spu spo sgo ra nang rje shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi gdan sa kun snang 'ad gsal du gyon nas bzhugs te 'khor sle ba ma rnams la skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i smin spol gyi chodas gnang zhing / thugs dam dang chodas spyad kyi mdzad pa dkon mchodag mchod pa dang / lku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa sogs 'bor lo gsum gyi mdzad phrin spyong bzhin du bzhugs pa na'ang / zhabs 'khor du gtogs pa dge slong zhal grangs bco lnga dgo 'dun pa'i sde nas mtshan 'dzin chus byings zhes skal pa mi 'thob par bton pa dang / des ma tshad pa sngar nas zhabs dung rang gis dbang ba'i 'dod dgu'i longs spyod 'byung ba'i khungs/ lto mtshams rgya yul tshong gi las sgo rnams kyang dngos dang brgyud nas thabs tshul sna tshogs kyi rnyed nas 'phyogs pa se gas/ 'o/ga sgrub du mas kun snang 'od gsal du yang thugs bag ma phebs pas bzhurnganas ma spro bar/ bod du gyon nas tsho smon gling nas rab btags kyis ngang pa dang khu byug la chab 31ga gnang ba nas btus pa 'di ltar/ sde srid di'i chodas lhun grub dang mkhan chen yon tan rgyal mtshan la phrul ba nas/ dam pa'i sprul par las 'ches ltor skyes kyang / ma nyes las kyi rtag par gdungs pa des/ / gnas chen bskor ba'i 'dun pa yid la shar/ / rang phyogs dgra dang gzhan phyogs gnyen yin pas/ / gong ma'i gsung bzhin ma 'dris phyogs brten nas/ / rten gsum gnas dang dam par yid 'chil bas/ / rgyal lams ste(ra ba lags par thugs la dgongs/ / zhes dang / sngon dus sprul sku zhu rgyu'i gnas tshul dang / lhan cig byedas kyi byu bzhag 'di 'o na/ legs na srol gtod ngan ga tshar gcod ces/ / gsol lan bo 'a00 zhabs dung 'jigs med nor su'i gsung chab 3snag nas datās pa/451

bore lugs gnyis gzigs pa zhis/ / gsung daskusnas med bzhin gsungs pa bka' drin che/ / da ni skutshen mchod gnas masan rgyang ring bas/ / ma gsan snyan spyid ma gzigs spyan spyid pas/ / 'grang /tshegs gnyis la tsha gyang mi mdzad zhu/ / zhes dang /da dus rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing chag / cesas khrims dar gyi mdud pa rnam par ral/ gdug can spyad ngan byed pa'i cha lugs la/ / bltas tshe lha minasang 'dir 'phos pa'am/ / kla klo'i yul du slobs snyam rū tshom skye/ / zhes dang / nor longs spyod char sprin ltar 'du ba'i/ / sa mtha' yi las sgo rgya che yang / / rang sngon gyi spyin shugs stobs chung bas/ / dus da res pha rol dacing gi bcom/ /de yin kyang gnod lan gso 'jal ba'i/ / blo shar na khyod kyi 'ong snying rtsal/ / rang slom chung spung po'i tshul bzung ste/ / rten jo shaka mjal du 'gro re ran/ zhes dang / kha spyang pos rang shugs zhing 'di nyid/ / mgon khyod kyi yin zhes smos na yang / don longs spyod dbang thang mnga' ris bcas/ / las thabs kyis 'a〈snag la khrel med kyi/ / mi ngan pas rgyal lams gang dus su// / rang 〉tshems las spung thersha tha shal ba/ / las gnas chen ma bskor thabs dang bral/ / shes dang / lus skyes nas bgrang bya nyer dgu'i bar/ /las rgud sdug mtho dman sna tshogs myong / / lus dman sa bzung bas dus 'da' zhing / / ngag mtho dman kun dang mthun par smra/ / yid chags sdang snang ba spangs na yang / / tshe sngon bsags las ngan dza/gas dug pas/ / mi mthon po'i go sa 'dzin pa rnams/ / thabs mkhas kyi ngang nas 'o sor 'tshe/ / pa hro lung pa'i mi ni dad pa shin tu che zhing longs spyod 'dzoms/ / pha rol dgra rnams bdag la don med shin hu sdang ba'i tshul bsam tshe/ / ba mos me tog bcom pa bzhin du dgra bgegs rdul du ma rlog 452

par/ / ma lus 'gro ba'i don la phyogs der yong ba'i re ba gting nas zad/ / tsā ri / yi gnas chen brngo ra la bsam thog lus po 'dis ma 'khel/ / tsha grang mi snyedams go kyi yul 'di rang yul snyo rong min na yang / dza lang ngan spyad dbang du song ba'i rmi ngan med pas sdod zos bde/ / wa skyes lta thu ngo tsha med pa'i rang yul dpon dang bul bas dga'/ /de las gzhan yang / sbas yul lha ro/nga gi mthil ni/ / 'dul ba'i go skabs shig dka' bas/ / rang 'dod snying 'ong du 'tshangs pa'i/ / spyo bo ngan ge la ma 'gran/ / gyong dang pham la de blangs nas/ / gang 'dod long rang tshor spud sgo / / ces dang / skyes pa'i pha yul mon gyi shar phyogs nas yin te/ / da lta mdzub ris bde yis ston sa tsam yin no/ / 'od gsal spyos kyi gdung rigs bstan 'dzin gyi ming skyon/ / bdag gi pha ste g.yul thog mtshon tshetsheg tu gum sku nga / drin can a ma rgan mo g.yung dung gi rgyal smad/ / mi gnas lnga lam zhugs nas 'o( 'ga' zhig thal sku(nga / /bka' drin gsum ldan 'jam dbyungs bla ma dang mjal nas/ / rnyed dka' rdo rje /ga rtse'i man ngag 'du thob yod/ / rang dbang rang la ma 'dus na gzhon gyi dus nas/ / kyibs gcig mtshan ldan bla ma cerdzog dbyings sa/ gshegs sku(/ / nyams len gnad du ma phyin stoms las kyi ngang nas/ / tshe lo sum thu sku la ba'i gnas skabs 'di byung rngo / / smon pas mdza' mor 'thams pa'i bde chen gyi mtsho mo/ / tshe 'dir mnyam lce 'grogs pa'i skal ba ni mi 'dug / lan chags rigs kyi thu mo rin chen gyi mtsho mo//byums pas pang du len pa'i dus tshod de yol song / / nyams dga' kun snang 'ad gsal sdod nyams shig spyo yang / / rnam smin las kyi phung po gangs can du 'phos 453

song / / bza' btung longs spyed 'dzoms pa lto rdzongs kyi rgyal khab/ / mi sdug srin pos gang ba'i 'jigs rngam gyis skyo nas/ / kyibs gcig rdo rje 'chang dbang zhabs pad du bsten te/ tshe gling pho brang nang na zos bde ru gnas so/ / chodas med bdag gi byung tshul de tsam du zad mod/ / gzhan gsos bu mo'i sems la de ltar du zhog dang / /zhes dang / kun snang 'od gsal nas 'khor hre ba rnams kyis khu byug la 'di ga'i gnas tshul zhu phrin du phul ba nas/ bsam ngan 'chang ba'i che btsan a nan da/ /mi 'dod bzhin du gshin rje'i pho nyas khrid/ / dmar ser gos kyis g.yogs kyang 'jig rten pa'i/ / dam bzhag brtan po mi gtong 'dod pa'i rgyal/ / snyigs dus bshes gnyen brdzu ba'i cher 'gying yang / / rnam par zhig nas lnga pa'i lam du thal/ / zhes pa sku gas phyal 'dug kye kye nyon dang ngang pa gzhon nu khyod/ / 'dab chags khyod kyis bgrod pa'i zhwa 'a phyogs na/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang byang chub spyong ba'i zhing / / sbas yul tsan dan rdzongs su grags pa yod/ /de yi nang gses sman rdzongs spa spo'i yul/ / spyi dang khyad par kun snang tshetshed gsal zhes/ / 'jam mgon bla mas byin gyis brlabs pa yi/ /ngabon pa'i lang par 'tsho ga'i grogs rnams dang / mo / dbang phyogs shar zil la mo'i phar rgyab na/ / a thang gzhong yul spyid pa'i spong khyer du/ / sngon las smon lam 'brel ba'i mtshams sbyar ba'i/ / snying mdza' bde chen mtsho mo ma thu sogs/ / bdag la rṣa pa rnams dang de las gzhan/ / snying nas dun pa rnams la gtam 'di smros/ / sngon dumagrin sngon khu byug thu mo la/ / mngags pa'i brjod tshig 'khrul med yid la nge sa /thog med skye bar rgyal ba'i spyan snga na/ / las blangs bskul ba'i gtam tshig snying la 454

brnag / 'ordzon kyang sras bcas rgyal ba'i phrin las ni/ / snyed bcud mtshungs pa rten 'brol gnad du che/ /thub pa mtshan dpe kun rdzogs ཿtshes kyi dbyangs/ / sgrog pas 'gro ba 'dren mod legs skar gyis/ / yon tan ma mthong skyon gyi gong bur rtog / shākya sde bcas brlag dus snyun tshul ston/ / padma'i sbubs 'khyungs skye 'chi'i rkyen bral ba/ /mnyam med rgyal dbang padma kā ra de/ / nus tshul mthu yis sde brgyad zil gnon zhing / /nyams pa tshar gcod rjes 'dzin mthu rnyed kyang / / las ngan blon po nag pos la bsgyur tshe/ / 'bro phan mdzad pa rdugs pa'i rnam 'gyur ston/ / kho bo ce sa gzugs tsam zhig / 'chang mod kyi/ / gong ma'i rnam thar rjes su slob pa la/ / snying stobs zla ba'i cha shas ma rdzogs gas/ / snyigs spyod mun pa sel ba'i thabs dang bral/ / lhag par rnam gsum zhabs te ga sgrub pa yis/ / mnyes par bgyis pa'i bstan 'dzin phal cher yang / /chos kyi 'gro lugs legs par shes bzhin du/ / skye bo phal cher log pa'i lam du 'khrid/ / ston pa'i gdan rabs chodas kyi seng ge'i khrir/ / 'bod nas grub rigs bstan srol skyong bzhin sa / bstan 'dzin gtso bo nā ro ta pa la/ / 'gran sems phrag dog zug krus nga rgyal na/ / mi shes blun rmongs ba glang khyu rnams la/ / re 'khang dgos don ma mchis sems la rāsnag / bstan rtsa rgyal sras 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ / spyedarī ngan ston la chotshes 'gal ma mdzad ces/ / phur tshugs gsol ba 'debs wa ngo med par/ / sdig can chu la 'phangs nas 'dren pa khyod/ / rgya bod gang du 'gro yang song zhig ces/ / bde bar lung spyin bgyis pa ma thos sam/ / de mod skye 'gro blo yis ma bzod par/ / 〉sgoms chung tshul gyis dben par gnas bcas nas/ / rang dbang nor las dkon mchodag mchod pa dang / / rten gsum bzhengs sogs dge bcu 455

spyad bzhin du/ / sems can don la bcesan pa'i gnas skabs su/ / gnas ngan len pa bag med spyad pa yi/ / chodas gzugs rnams la bde skyed 'byor ba'i mus/ / ltos bcas car smrig 'chang ba lnga phrag gsum/ / don med mtshan gyi yi ge chus byings nas/ / sgur po ras su bor ba'i rnam thar bstan/ / ma 'gyangs 'dod dgu'i longs spyod 'byung ba'i khungs/ / rgya yul tshong gi las sgo dbang rigs kyang / / dngos dang brgyud nas 'phyog pa'i thabs tshul gyis/ / sloms chung la la mi dmigs rgya yis btab/ / bsam zhing bsam na cesas kyi gnas 'u/gas kyis/ / sangs rgyas lag bcangs sprad kyang yid ches bral/ / gnas skabs rgyud sdug ngang tshul de 'du na/ / phyogs der yong ba'i dgos pa ci 'dug pa/ / 'di na rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i byin mthu dang / / phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba yab sras kyi/ /thugs rjes 'a31 ba'i phung khams bde mus nas/ / sum rtsen spong khyer sa la 'phos pa lta'i/ / dga' ldan tshe smon gling gi pho brangan/ / bde bar gnyid spyod chos spyod 'phel ba dang / / ngangos 'byor yid sprul kun bzang sprin spros te/ / jo shākya mjal ba'i skal bzang 4spyod pas mchis/ / zhes dang /lhag par rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i 'phrul/ / kun 'dus mtsho skyes rdo rje mi gzugs su/ / shar ba'i sngags spyon che mchodag 'dus pa rtsal/ / snying la bcangs dang bslus na dkon mche ga rdzun/ / chodas gzugs pa'ang 'gro ba 'dren pa yi/ / dam bca' ma zad de srid gangs rdzongs su/ / bde bar spyod de padma 'od gling du/ / rnga yab gling pa'i thugs dkar 'phos pa'i tsho/ / ltos bcas skal bar ldan rnams der 'tshogs nas/ / zab gsang rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'bor cher/ / lhan cig 'jug pa'i smon lam zab mo yi/ / mtshams spyor brjed med zhing mche ga 'di nas 'debs/ /456

da skad snying nas gdams pa'i tshig phreng 'di/ / brjed med snying gi ga'ur rgyas btab nas/ / lha gling mun pa'i khang bur nyam thag pa'i/ / mgon med rnams la ngang pa gzhon nus sprod/ / ces zhabs dung 'jigs med nor su'i gsung ko ga'i la'i rgyangs glu nas bris pa dge / de nas sa kyi khri chorasna gyi sras 31 zhig phyag rgya ma bzhes pa 'o( sdo/sa su bshad kyi 'dug kyang gsal la gang yang mi snang / mthar dgung 'o/ sum cu serdzo gcig spyi lo 1861 la zhi bar gshegs sem/ /'aXn rigs nu rig le 'dzin ma bdag mo skal bzang /rma mtsho mo bya ba /sde srid khri rabs bzhi bcu pala'i lo rgyus/༄༄/ / sde srid khri rabs bzhi bcu pa lcags pa sangs rgyas ni/ 'khrungs 5/pa wang se le kha nas gong sa rdo rje nor thu'i gcung po yin/ sde srid rdo rje rnam rgyal gyi sgar lto nas rim bzhin gzhong sgar rdzong dpon thob ste der bzhugs pa'i skabs gzhung du sde gzar langs te 'dir gyon 'dug sde srid chodas kyi rgyal mtshan khri thog bzhugs yodad pa gsang thabs kyis rdzong 'phyog rtsis byas te dar 'phyar sgang nas mtshan mo bltas tshe rdzong nang me phar tshur byas pa mthong ste las ka de ba31la na dug chod zer lab pas/ bod dge bgros zhig yod pa des/ me de rdzong 'og ma'i gnas brtan bcu dug chod ga yod pa des yin/ rdzong gong mas mi tshor zheso ldum ra 'og rdo phog gi steng nas dar shing btsugs te rdzong nang 'dzul te rdzong 'phyog mkhan slob dge 'dun bcas pas sde srid chos gī rgyal mtshan kto kyibs mdzad de zur du bton/ pho rgan rdo rje nor thu dar 457

dkar dpon slob nas sde srid bskos/ kho rang gong gzim dang dbang rdzong pa sbrel ma mdzad de bzhugs/ phyis su rdo rje nor thu dang bkra shis rdo rje gnyis ka gshegs rjes dbang chen rgyal po sde srid mdzad pa'i lor zings 'khrugs chen po langs mthar thim phyogs su lcags khyi lor zhabs dung 'jigs med nor bu sde srid khrir mnga' gsol ba la/ sprungs thang du spyi lo 185nya rab byung 14lcags phag lor lcags pa sangs rgyas kyis kyang sde srid kyi khrir 'dzegs pa na dgi 'dun dmang dang dpon lag tshos 'dod pa med par dmag 'khrugs langs pa'i rgyab dpung dpon 〈snab bgres pa a rgas has pas chos rtse dpon slob mtsho skyes rdo rjer zhus pa las/ krong gsar nas chos rtse'i mgron gnyer 'jigs med rnam rgyal/ dung dkar pa rgyal mtshan/ spyid tshal pa rdo rje rnam rgyal gsum dmag sna 'khrid de gzhung du bye na skabs/ mings thang du 'grum nad thon te sde srid lcags pa sangs rgyas nor sgang du byon te bzhugs yod par/ 'ong skru mched gsum gyis nor gya sgang nas lab dzo khar 'gro ba'i lam du bsgugs te sde srid lcags pa'i gnya' rgod ( gnya' rgod ) zer ba ni dpa' bo stobs shugs can dmag dpon yin la/ mig col ma zer ba de bsad pa larme/ sde srid lcags pa sangs rgyus kyi dmag gis 'ong gsum 'ded pa na bla gzim bsed nams don grub kyis rta lor glosnang ga༄/ma zhag gas/ma sbas bzhag pa'i rjes ༄// bla ma'i gzim sgar dug cu tham pa therdzong gsum ri brgyud de mgar sa thug bkyil bar btang nas gzim sgar rnams slar log ste dkar khris so ral sgang du lto chas sgrig sdod par sde srid lcags pa sangs rgyas kyi dmag mi rnams 'byor te/ khyim me spar gzi34 sgar pa khal gsum po khyim dang sgrags gasku1na bsregs btang nas bsad de sde srid lcags pa sangs rgyas la glags ma 458

dkar dpon slob nas sde srid bskos/ kho rang gong gzim dang dbang rdzong pa sbrel ma mdzad de bzhugs/ phyis su rdo rje nor thu dang bkra shis rdo rje gnyis ka gshegs rjes dbang chen rgyal po sde srid mdzad pa'i lor zings 'khrugs chen po langs mthar thim phyogs su lcags khyi lor zhabs dung 'jigs med nor bu sde srid khrir mnga' gsol ba la/ sprungs thang du spyi lo 185nya rab byung 14lcags phag lor lcags pa sangs rgyas kyis kyang sde srid kyi khrir 'dzegs pa na dgi 'dun dmang dang dpon lag tshos 'dod pa med par dmag 'khrugs langs pa'i rgyab dpung dpon 〈snab bgres pa a rgas has pas chos rtse dpon slob mtsho skyes rdo rjer zhus pa las/ krong gsar nas chos rtse'i mgron gnyer 'jigs med rnam rgyal/ dung dkar pa rgyal mtshan/ spyid tshal pa rdo rje rnam rgyal gsum dmag sna 'khrid de gzhung du bye na skabs/ mings thang du 'grum nad thon te sde srid lcags pa sangs rgyas nor sgang du byon te bzhugs yod par/ 'ong skru mched gsum gyis nor gya sgang nas lab dzo khar 'gro ba'i lam du bsgugs te sde srid lcags pa'i gnya' rgod ( gnya' rgod ) zer ba ni dpa' bo stobs shugs can dmag dpon yin la/ mig col ma zer ba de bsad pa larme/ sde srid lcags pa sangs rgyus kyi dmag gis 'ong gsum 'ded pa na bla gzim bsed nams don grub kyis rta lor glosnang ga༄/ma zhag gas/ma sbas bzhag pa'i rjes ༄// bla ma'i gzim sgar dug cu tham pa therdzong gsum ri brgyud de mgar sa thug bkyil bar btang nas gzim sgar rnams slar log ste dkar khris so ral sgang du lto chas sgrig sdod par sde srid lcags pa sangs rgyas kyi dmag mi rnams 'byor te/ khyim me spar gzi34 sgar pa khal gsum po khyim dang sgrags gasku1na bsregs btang nas bsad de sde srid lcags pa sangs rgyas la glags ma 458

khrol ba'i skabs/ thabs mkhas kyi gasku 'phrul spa spyod dpon sle ba bgres pa tshul khrims rnam rgyal lam phyog rgas nyas pas sku|sa chen ༷/sa legs kyi na bza' legs ldan zhig btsems te bo rang phyag g.yog 'gram nad las thar pa gcig yod pa de la sprod de dhe'agram nad kyis na mi la bkab ste drod ma yal bar legs par bltabs te phul btang ba sku gzugs la che chung ran tog to yod med gzigs gnang chung na gos chen 'di'i banyo da rung yod pas btsems te phul cadang lan gsungs gnang zhes zhus pa las de 'phul bzhes pa'i kyen las/ 'grum nad thebs te sde srid lcags pa sangs rgyas spyi 'o/ 1851 rab byung 14 phag lo zla 1tshes 7 la 'phral du 'grum nad kyis 'jig rten phyo ma'i lam du gathegags 'dug/ sde srid zhe gcig pa dang zhe gnyis pa'i lo rgyus/༄gyi/ / sde srid khri rabs zhe gcig pa rdo rje spob dpon bar cung ngam dam chos lhun grub ni/ yul bar pa'i sa nas sku 'khrungs te chung ngu'i dus nas dge 'dun gyi sder zhugs/ 'bri 〈snag dang gar thig dbyungs serdzogs shes bya'i gnas gang la yang mkhas par byings/ ceras khrims se gas 'dus sde'i las tshan gyi 'gan khur rnams gang yang mthar 'khyol nas rim gyis rdo rje slob dpon gyi go gnas thob/ de nas dgongs pa zhus te dben gnas rta lang khar byon nas thugs dam la barbemon nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/de skabs gzhung du rgyal khrims chodas bzhin du skyong ba'i sde srid gcig med par brten/rdzong bdag phan tshun serdzo so rang sa nas dbang thang stobs shugs nga cher 'gran pa'i 459

khrol ba'i skabs/ thabs mkhas kyi gasku 'phrul spa spyod dpon sle ba bgres pa tshul khrims rnam rgyal lam phyog rgas nyas pas sku|sa chen ༷/sa legs kyi na bza' legs ldan zhig btsems te bo rang phyag g.yog 'gram nad las thar pa gcig yod pa de la sprod de dhe'agram nad kyis na mi la bkab ste drod ma yal bar legs par bltabs te phul btang ba sku gzugs la che chung ran tog to yod med gzigs gnang chung na gos chen 'di'i banyo da rung yod pas btsems te phul cadang lan gsungs gnang zhes zhus pa las de 'phul bzhes pa'i kyen las/ 'grum nad thebs te sde srid lcags pa sangs rgyas spyi 'o/ 1851 rab byung 14 phag lo zla 1tshes 7 la 'phral du 'grum nad kyis 'jig rten phyo ma'i lam du gathegags 'dug/ sde srid zhe gcig pa dang zhe gnyis pa'i lo rgyus/༄gyi/ / sde srid khri rabs zhe gcig pa rdo rje spob dpon bar cung ngam dam chos lhun grub ni/ yul bar pa'i sa nas sku 'khrungs te chung ngu'i dus nas dge 'dun gyi sder zhugs/ 'bri 〈snag dang gar thig dbyungs serdzogs shes bya'i gnas gang la yang mkhas par byings/ ceras khrims se gas 'dus sde'i las tshan gyi 'gan khur rnams gang yang mthar 'khyol nas rim gyis rdo rje slob dpon gyi go gnas thob/ de nas dgongs pa zhus te dben gnas rta lang khar byon nas thugs dam la barbemon nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/de skabs gzhung du rgyal khrims chodas bzhin du skyong ba'i sde srid gcig med par brten/rdzong bdag phan tshun serdzo so rang sa nas dbang thang stobs shugs nga cher 'gran pa'i 459

'chig zings kyis 'bangs mi ser thams cad sdug la spyor ba'i skabs bla hre ba dge 'dun rnams kyis/ 'bangs mi ser rnams kyi spyod sdug gzigs ched chags sdang phyogs gtogs su lhung ni med pa'i bka' bgros mdzad nas/ spyi lo 185'arab byung 14 chu byi lo tshes pa dang mkhan chen khri zur gnyis dang / zhabs grang sprul pa'i skudage 'dun pa rnams zhal mthun gyi sgo nas phyo nang med pa'i yul mi'i rgod spu thams cad bkug ste mi ser la sdug spyor gtang ni med pa'i bka' nan che bar gnang zhing spyi mthi gyi sgo nas rdo rje slob dpon bgres pa dam chos lhun grub/ sde srid lcags pa sangs rgyas sku gshegs pa'i rjes su bla hre ba lhan rgyas kyis gzhung du gdan dungs te/spye lo 185'a rab byung 14 chu byi lo rlo 'phrul zla ba'i tshes 13 la sde srid kyi khrir mnga' gse la/ de nas sde srid 'di yis lugs gnyis kyi bka' khrims btsan pos chab srid cerdzos dang mthun par tshul bzhin du spyodang zhing 'bangs mi ser la byams brtses gzigs pa dang ldan na yang / de skabs zhabs dung thugs sprul 'jigs med nor bu shar phyogs su gnas gcigs la gyon nas gu ce rin po che'i lung bstan bzhin a thang nas gsang yum zhig bzhes pa la sde srid 'di dang rje sku na tan rgyal mtshan gyis thugs sran phyung nas/ spa spo sgo ra nang zur dubazhugs pa dang bod du gyon dgos pa'i kyen byas 'dug de skabs dpon lag rnams kyis rdzong gzhis hab thob rgyab ste dmag 'khrug rgyun ma chad par langs nas rgyal khab la bde spyod med par 'ordzo gnyis sku(nga mtshams sde srid dam che sa lhun grub dgongs pa zhus 'dug /sde srid zhe gnyis pa ni/ de rjes dge 'dun pas bstan pa dang 'bangs mi ser la phan thabs su dgongs te spyi lo 1854 rab byung 14shing stag lor sprungs thang rdzong 460

du byams sprul 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin sde srid kyi khrir mnga' gsol 'dug yang thim rjisnang pa yi/ ma de bas nyan ma btub par 'chigs zings dza/gas cher langs nas thams cad 'ordzos mi bde bar shu/ra ba'i skabs rje skusnan tan rgyal mtshan gyis thabs mkhas thugs rje chen pos khri 'dums legs par mdzad de/ dam chodas lhun grub slar zung 'brel du sde srid mdzad de sde srid khag gnyis su gyes dgos pa byung 'dug go/de skabs snyo mtshams su 'byug gzhung nas de wang gu ru'i rdzong dpon dang bla ma'i.a khu bcas skru tshab gnyis spyi lo 1854 rab byung 14 shing stag la 'byug gis dbang ba'i nyu war si rgya gzhung gis za spyad byas pa'i sa bral de yar seng dgos lugs kyi don du rgya gzhung du btang 'dug snga nga sku tshab gnyis kyis rgya gar gzhung nas sa sril yar seng ma thob par log 'ong skabs dbang btsongs kyis rgya gar spong khyim lag gi mi ser cibacom ste ca chas mang rab cig khyer song 'dug de wang gu ri'i rdzong dpon dang bla ma'i a khu nas de ltar khyer se nga ba'i rjes su yang lto mtshams 'grag pa rnams kyis rgya gar byang phyogs spong khyim lag la dbang bstongs dang ca chas 'phrog bcom byas te de wang gu ri'i rdzong dpon tsar bskul 'dug de ltar rang re 'grag pas rgya gar spong khyim mi ser la 'o ltar dbang bstongs dang ca chas 'phyog bcom byas pa sogs thams cad de wang gu ri'i rdzong dpon des byed bcug 'dug de ltar ngan pa byas pa'i 'ordzo rgyus 'byug sde pa dang bla ma gnyis la rgya gzhung nas zhu yig thog zhus te sde pa dang bla ma gnyis nas krong gsar dpon slob la/ de wang gu ri'i rdzong dpon gyis rgya gar mi ser nas 'phyog bcom byas pa'i ca mas kyi rin dngul log ldab byas spyod dgos pa'i bka' shog gnang 'dug bka' shog 'byor te krong gsar dpon slob — 461

du byams sprul 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin sde srid kyi khrir mnga' gsol 'dug yang thim rjisnang pa yi/ ma de bas nyan ma btub par 'chigs zings dza/gas cher langs nas thams cad 'ordzos mi bde bar shu/ra ba'i skabs rje skusnan tan rgyal mtshan gyis thabs mkhas thugs rje chen pos khri 'dums legs par mdzad de/ dam chodas lhun grub slar zung 'brel du sde srid mdzad de sde srid khag gnyis su gyes dgos pa byung 'dug go/de skabs snyo mtshams su 'byug gzhung nas de wang gu ru'i rdzong dpon dang bla ma'i.a khu bcas skru tshab gnyis spyi lo 1854 rab byung 14 shing stag la 'byug gis dbang ba'i nyu war si rgya gzhung gis za spyad byas pa'i sa bral de yar seng dgos lugs kyi don du rgya gzhung du btang 'dug snga nga sku tshab gnyis kyis rgya gar gzhung nas sa sril yar seng ma thob par log 'ong skabs dbang btsongs kyis rgya gar spong khyim lag gi mi ser cibacom ste ca chas mang rab cig khyer song 'dug de wang gu ri'i rdzong dpon dang bla ma'i a khu nas de ltar khyer se nga ba'i rjes su yang lto mtshams 'grag pa rnams kyis rgya gar byang phyogs spong khyim lag la dbang bstongs dang ca chas 'phrog bcom byas te de wang gu ri'i rdzong dpon tsar bskul 'dug de ltar rang re 'grag pas rgya gar spong khyim mi ser la 'o ltar dbang bstongs dang ca chas 'phyog bcom byas pa sogs thams cad de wang gu ri'i rdzong dpon des byed bcug 'dug de ltar ngan pa byas pa'i 'ordzo rgyus 'byug sde pa dang bla ma gnyis la rgya gzhung nas zhu yig thog zhus te sde pa dang bla ma gnyis nas krong gsar dpon slob la/ de wang gu ri'i rdzong dpon gyis rgya gar mi ser nas 'phyog bcom byas pa'i ca mas kyi rin dngul log ldab byas spyod dgos pa'i bka' shog gnang 'dug bka' shog 'byor te krong gsar dpon slob — 461

nas kyang rgya gzhung byang phyogs a sam du yod pa'i skru tshab de la yi ge bskur 'dugayi ge de nang / de wang yi ri'i rdzong dpon gyis rgya gzhung gis dbang ba'i sa gnas khar mi bsad dang ca chas 'phrog bcom las ka ngan pa byas par brten/ rdzong dpon gyi go gnas las bton te dgongs yangs btang 'dug sde pa nas bo'i steng du bkal ba'i nyes bya phyed ka rgya gzhung nas btab dgos zhes krong gsar dpon slob nas de lta bu'i yi ge byung / rgya gar phyi gling rgyal mo'i sku tshab nas krong sar dpon slob la/ da tshun de wang gu ri'i rdzong dpon gyis rgya gzhung spong khyer lag nas dbang btsongs kyis 'a phyog bcom byas pa'i ca chas rnams slar rgya gzhung la spyod rgyu med na/ de'i rin dngul rtsis rgyab ste 'byug gzhung la rgya gzhung nas thob pa'i lo ltar gyi sa khral nas phab rgyu yin zhes pa'i yig lan zhig bskur 'dug de nas rgya gzhung la thugs bden dgongs dag zhus pa'i yi ge zhig krong gsar dpon slob nas btang 'dug ca chas 'phyog bcom byas pa'i rtsis rgyab ste rub 'a do00 a sam lo ltar nas pab bzhag 'dug de skabs krong gsar dpon slob 'jigs me da rnam rgyal yin 'dug /de rjes slar pū ka cad 'ongs kyi 'grag pas dbang bstongs kyis rgya gar a run siṅga zer ba de bzung nas 'grug yul/ du khrid song 'dug yo run siṅga zer ba de sngon 'byug pa'i mnga' cadag gi mi ser yin pa bar skabs 'byug pa'i sa spangs te rgya gzhung gi sa khar sdod pa yin 'dug de skor a dran siṅga rgya gzhung lag hu dgos lugs dang de bcings te 'khrid mi rnams la khrims btang dgos pa'i yi ge zhig bkror 'dug 'byug sde pa nas lan a dran siṅga de sngon nas 'byug sde pa'i bya rog yin brten rgya gar gzhung la btang mi tshugs zhes bka' 31ga gnang 'dug de skabs 462

nas kyang rgya gzhung byang phyogs a sam du yod pa'i skru tshab de la yi ge bskur 'dugayi ge de nang / de wang yi ri'i rdzong dpon gyis rgya gzhung gis dbang ba'i sa gnas khar mi bsad dang ca chas 'phrog bcom las ka ngan pa byas par brten/ rdzong dpon gyi go gnas las bton te dgongs yangs btang 'dug sde pa nas bo'i steng du bkal ba'i nyes bya phyed ka rgya gzhung nas btab dgos zhes krong gsar dpon slob nas de lta bu'i yi ge byung / rgya gar phyi gling rgyal mo'i sku tshab nas krong sar dpon slob la/ da tshun de wang gu ri'i rdzong dpon gyis rgya gzhung spong khyer lag nas dbang btsongs kyis 'a phyog bcom byas pa'i ca chas rnams slar rgya gzhung la spyod rgyu med na/ de'i rin dngul rtsis rgyab ste 'byug gzhung la rgya gzhung nas thob pa'i lo ltar gyi sa khral nas phab rgyu yin zhes pa'i yig lan zhig bskur 'dug de nas rgya gzhung la thugs bden dgongs dag zhus pa'i yi ge zhig krong gsar dpon slob nas btang 'dug ca chas 'phyog bcom byas pa'i rtsis rgyab ste rub 'a do00 a sam lo ltar nas pab bzhag 'dug de skabs krong gsar dpon slob 'jigs me da rnam rgyal yin 'dug /de rjes slar pū ka cad 'ongs kyi 'grag pas dbang bstongs kyis rgya gar a run siṅga zer ba de bzung nas 'grug yul/ du khrid song 'dug yo run siṅga zer ba de sngon 'byug pa'i mnga' cadag gi mi ser yin pa bar skabs 'byug pa'i sa spangs te rgya gzhung gi sa khar sdod pa yin 'dug de skor a dran siṅga rgya gzhung lag hu dgos lugs dang de bcings te 'khrid mi rnams la khrims btang dgos pa'i yi ge zhig bkror 'dug 'byug sde pa nas lan a dran siṅga de sngon nas 'byug sde pa'i bya rog yin brten rgya gar gzhung la btang mi tshugs zhes bka' 31ga gnang 'dug de skabs 462

lto nang 'dir nang zings dbang gis sde srid gnyis dam chos lhun grub thang rdzong du bzhugs/ zam pa gnyis thim rjesang yi/ ma de wa dang bka' sdurdzon ka shar gnyis kyis bzung / dbang rdzong pa kun dga' dpal ldan bcas nang 'khrugs me ltar 'bar ba'i skabs/ che sa rtse dpon slob 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyon te chings bsgrigs mdzad pa'i legs drin du sngon 'dir gzhung la chodas rtse nas ti rub dos bzhi phul dgos 'dug pa de mi dgos par bzos/ shar rdzong dpon lag rnams gzhung nas bskos kyi yod pa de yang chodas rtse pa rang nas bsko bzhag byed chodag pa'i chodad 'dums bzos te gyon pa'i rjes/ mi ring bar spye lo 1855 rab byung 14 shing yos lor byams/ ༷/'a/ rin bar ba/thegab/05/ 463

sde srid zhe gsum pa dang zhe bzhi pa'i 'o/ rgyus/rsā༅༅ / / sde srid khri rabs zhe gsum pa kun dga' dpal ldan nam bserdzod nams stobs rgyas ni/ shar sbed nag las 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas rdzong gong ma'i bsgrig lam la zhugs/ lcags pa sangs rgyas dang mag ༷/da yin pas sangs rgyas sde srid mdzad pa'i skabs dbang rdzong pa bskos 'dug byams sprul 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin zhi bar gshegs pa'i rjes su sde gzar langs nas thed phyogs gdan sa spungs thang du spyi lo 185pa rab byung 14 shing yos la kun dga' dpal ldan dbang rdzong pa nas sde srid kyi khrir bskos/ rje yon tan rgyal mtshan las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa zhus te bsede nams byedabs rgyas zhes mtshan gasku1la/ de nas mi ring bar gdan sa rim phya bkra shis chodas rdzong du sde srid dam chodas lhun grub dgongs pa zhus te dben par byon nas thugs dam la bce na te bzhugs/sde srid lke bzhi pa ni/ thi ma phu bkra shis chodas rdzong gi rdzong dpon u ma de ba'am shes rab mthar phyin gyis dbang shugs kyis sde srid khrir 'dzegs pa na sde srid lag gnyis su gyur/ sde srid kun dga' dpal ldan dang phyo/ ma de wa gnyis dge 'dun pas khri bsngams mdzad de zings 'khrugs med par phan tshun gnyis ka gaskurdzol thabs phebs chog par mdzad mod/ 'on kyang sdi srid gnyis nang khong ma mthun pa'i zhe 'gras kyis srid skyong yi/ ma de ba'am shes rab mthar phyon nyid/ kun dga' dpal ldan gyis rgyud bskrul te spyi lo 1857 rab byung 14 me sprul la gong gzim sbra thung gis bkrongs 'duga'aX' rje yon tan rgyal mtshan rgya rtogs brjod 41rgyab phreng 6pa nas gsal/464

de nas kun dga' dpal ldan gyis gdan sa phan tshun spyi 'dus su dbang bsgyur te sde srid mdzad de bzhugs ring re zhig zings 'khrugs med par 'bangs mi ser rnams kyang cung zad spyid po byung yod par bshad kyang / sde srid de'i skabs su'ang snyo mtshams su sdod mi 'byug pa'i 'go dpon rnams kyis rgya gar gyi mi mang po bcings te 'grag yul du khrid song 'dug der brten rgya gzhung nas rgya gar byang phyogs sa mtshams su sa srung dmag mi batshoskogs 'dug 'byug pas bcings te 'byug 5/la du btang ba'i rgya gar gyi mi rnams slar 'ordzog rgya gar gzhung la spyod rgyu med na/ rgya gzhung nas 'byug la 7 ltar a sam nyu war si la brten pa'i sa khral 'di nyid bkag rgyu yin pa dang / yang na baṅgal sdu war si rnams rgya gar gzhung gi lag par len rgyu yin zhes lab 'dug de ltar rgya gar gzhung nas 'dir yi ge ji tsam bskur kyang 'di nas mar lan med pa'i khar slar 'byug pas dbang btsongs kyis rgya gar gyi ca chas 'phyog brtsom dang mi bsad byas pa'i mthar/ rgya gar gzhung nas jar pa'i gu ri'i sar da mag khang chung ba zhig btsugs 'dug de'i rjes su slar yang 'byug snyo mtshams kyi 'go dpon rnams nas mi sum brgya bzhi brgya tsam khrid de ku tsa bi har rgya gar phyug po zhig gi stong dbang bstongs kyis rgyu dngul rub nyis khri lhag tsam 'phyog bcom byas te khyor song 'dug der brten rgya gar gzhung nas rang res 'byug pas dbang ba'i pā la ko ṭa zer ba'i sdu war si rgya gzhung gis len 'dug rgya gzhung mi ser nas 'phyog bcom gyis khyor ba'i rgyu dngul dang btson pa rnams rgya gzhung la rtsis sprod rgyu med na gong gi sa cha de yang mi spyod ces yi ge bskur 'dug sde srid 'di'i skabs snyo mtshams pyi gnas tshul je sdug la song 'dug bstan pa'i zhabs tog rgya cher mdzad pa'i co 465

'phyog bcom gyi ca chas dang sgo nor sems can 'byug yul du khrid song ba ma tshad rdo rje gling yang len rgyu'i grabs sgrig byas 'dug rgya gzhung nas dmag mi byang phyogs sa mtshams khar btang ste 'byug pa'i dmag mi chu mo )sa ṭa brgal te 'gro thub ma byung bar slar 'byug yul du log song 'dug de'i rjes 'byug gzhung nas lo ltar gyi a sam sdu war si la brten pa'i sa khral 'i/na par dar dpon rgya gzhung du btang 'dugalo ltar rdzong nang 'thum sde sku mchod mang rab bzung dgos par brten sa bral rub 10 000des langs kyi mi 'dug yar seng sum brgya bzhi brgya dgos lugs brjod 'dug/ de nas spyi lo 186'a rab byung 14 chu khyi la rgya gzhu1 nas sku tshab gcig 'byugargyal sar gtang dzo/ yin zhing / 'byug sngo/la casgong skabs 'tshil lam gang na sa gtang rgyu yi na nam sku tshab de 'ong tsho lam bar grogs ram rdzong lag so so'i rdzong dpon dang sku tshab rnams nas bya dartse sa rigs bka' 31ga re bkram gnang zhes zhu yig gcig ngo ma rgya gar mu kun do zing zer ba'i mdun spyi lo 186'a rab byung 14 chu khyi zla 7 tshes la 'grag yul du btang 'dug na/ ngo ma de 'byug snyo phyogs sa mtshams dpon rnams kyis bkag ste lam bar zhag grangs mang po lus se nga stabs rgya gzhung la sla 'o/ga spyi lo 186'a rab byung 14 chu khyi zla nya' pa'i tshos la mgatogs 'byor mi 'dug rgya gzhung nas sku tshab gtang dzo/'i 〉tsher lan gsham gsal ltar 'byug sde pa phran 〉pyogs rnam rgyal nas ngom de'i mdun btang 'dug da res khyod nas rang re rgyal khab gnyis pyi ri 4 3/tshams kha'i mi ser bar 'khrugs pa zhugs pa'i skor nas 'o/ rgyus lab phyir sku pa gcig btang rgyu yin gsungs kyi 'dug na de lta thu'i zings brel chung ngu zhig gi 461—

rnam rgyal la rgyab dgang 'tshol te dpon slob gnyis gzhung du dmag la byon pa'i lo der/ zhabs dung 'jigs med nor bus lha sa nas mar mthu gnang ba yin zer gang ltar yang spungs rdzong la chus 'a jig pas skyon chen po byung / sde srid kyi phyogs rnams rim phya dang / sprungs rdzong pa'i phyogs rnams spungs thang du dmag grabs bsgrigs te rgyab pas gzhung mgyon gnyer brang bkra shis kyis gtsang chu'i zam pa thob ste dpon hre ba 'jigs med rnam rgyal dang bcerdzon 'grus rgyal mtshan rnam gnyis kyi dmag rnams rdo skyong la nas lod stod phya na phebs/ der sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal rang dang spu khro dpon slob nyi ma rdo rje ma gtogs dbang rdzong pa sri rgyal dang / thim rdzong pa gami 'byug rgyal spa gro'i mgron gnyer gzim dpon thams cad dmag dpon du gyon te 'dug par/ 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyis dmag bkod rgyab ste g.yul 'thab skabs sde srid phyogs kyi mi mang po bsad pas phyo bros byas/ rjes 'ded bgyis pas dbang rdzong pa dang rim rdzong pa gzhan du bros sa dang gab sa med par khyim zhig hu 'dzul/ khyim de'i lcags ri'i phyo nas dmag gis bskor bas/ dbang rdzong pa'i dmag dpon shar dung pa chu brag rgya mtsho zer ba 'di nyid mgo la lcags rmog khyab tam btsugs lus la dar gyis g.yodags/ lag g.yas ral gri dang gasku na dug li thogs te dug li'i sku lcags ri'i steng btsugs te nang nas phyo la macerdzongs/ phyo nas nang la maḥtshengs yud tsam la mi gnyis gsum gri dzam rgyab pa sku gas dpa' tsal che bas dpe na hre ba rnam gnyis phyogs la shi rmas byung yang cher ma gnod/ mthar 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyis me mda' rgyab pas bo'i sprus mo'i steng phog ste bsad pas/ dbang rdzong pa sri rgyal dang rim rdzong pa dmi 'grag rgyas gnyis sku gzhogs chodas rtse pa 'dir srog skyob la gyon zer 470

ba'i smre ngag 31ra bas/ 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyis rang khyodags pa rnams la da res lto nang zings tsam ma gtogs phyi'i dgra ma yin pas khyed rnams cung zad lhod rogs mtshad gsungs te nang la gyon pas/ rdzong dpon gnyis kyis smre ngag gi sgo nas da res sprungs rdzong pa'i dmag rogs tsam gnang ba ma gtogs nged dang 'on 'dzin gang yang med pa lags gshis/ 'chi nges pa zung gi sku ga skyob thugs rjes gzigs pa mkhyen zhus pa ltar sku ga kyibs mdzad pas/ mings rje nga pa dang bka' sdudan gyis dgra lag par tshud skabs sku ga rkyetshon med pa mi 'tshams par zhus kyang / rdzong dpe na gnyis rang sa'i khyim du bsdad rgyu las phyi'i rgyal lab dang snyo nang rdzong gzhis bcas gang du yang 'gro mi che ga pa'i gan yig khra gsal bzhes te se se ra btang / dge 'dun pas khri bsdums mdzad de sde srid gnag rdzi pa sangs sam phran tshogs rnam rgyal nyid spyi 'o/ 1863 rab byung 14 chu phag 'o/ la sku sredag la nyes skyon med par zur du bzhugs/dbang 'dus pho brang rdzong dang bkra shis chos rdzong gnyis thob/ nyi ma rdo rje spa hro dpon slob rang 'jags dang / dar lung stobs rgyas dbang rdzong pa bskos shing /gzhung mgyon bkra shis sprungs rdzong pa bskos te btang / gzhung rta dpon la gsar stobs rgyas 'jigs med rnam rgyal rang gi yab sprun gyi brgyud pa yin pas rang gi sku tshab hu thim rdzong pa bskos te bya dkar dpon slob dang chodas rtse dpon slob rnam gnyis rang gnas su byon/ de ltar gong du gsal ba bzhin spu lo 186'a rababyung 14 chu khyi lor sde srid phran tshogs rnam rgyal la sprungs rdzong pa dar lung stobs rgyas kyis ngo rgol zings 'khrugs chen 〈sna langs nas gzim sgar gtang tsu/ 'u/sa pa ma zad/ 'khrugs zings cher song nas spungs rdzong pa dar lung stobs rgyas kyis chos rtse dpon slob dang 471

bya dkar dpon slob dmag rgyab 'tshol ba bzhin gyon nas spyi lo 1863 rababyung 14chu phag long dbang rdzong dang bkra shis chodas rdzong thob/ sde srid gnag rdzi pa sangs sam phran tshogs rnam rgyal dgongs pa zhus te spyid la'i dgo na par byon 'dug /sde srid de dug pa dang zhobadun zhe brgyad zhe dgu lnga bcu pa'i lo rgyus/༄༄ / / sde srid khri rabs zhi dug pa tshe dbang sri thub ni/ yul wang khar khris nas 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus rdzong gong ma'i sgar lto'i gral yin pa las rim gyis bkra shis chodas rdzong gi gnyer chen byas/ de nas thim phya rdzong dpon gyi go gnas thob ste bzhugs pa'i skabs/ spyi 'o/ 1863 rab byung 14 chu phag 'o/ra sde srid phran tshogs rnam rgyal dartse ngas pa zhus pa'i rjes sde srid kyi khrir mnga' gasku(la te bzhugs pa na/tshe dbang sri thub smad wang yin par brten stod wang rnams kyis nyan ma btub par sde gzar chen po g.yos/sde srid zhe bdun pa ni/ phyogs lhung gi nang 'grigs zhi ba'i phyir/ rje sku bgres sku na tan rgyal mtshan dang bla sle ba dge 'dun gsung ༷ sa mdzad thog nas ceras khrims bgres po rim phya zi lu la pa/ ( tshul khrims ye na tan sde srid zhe bdun gyi khrir bton te tshe dbang sri thub dang sde srid zung 'brel mdzad kyang ) sde zur gnag rdzi pa sangs ma rangs par rje bshad sgrub cad zer la byir nas 'dus sder rim gro zlog thabs mdzad pa las 'phral du sde srid de sku tsho bar chad kyen dbang gis gshegs/ tshe dbang sri thub zur bzhugs 2yi da/472

sde srid zhe brgyad pa dkar brgyud dbang phyug ni/ yul spa gro shar pa ri bar nas skru 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas dge 'dun gyi sder bzhugs te rje shes rab rgyal mtshan bsten mdo rgyud rig gnas dang gar rig dbyangs gsum serdzogs shes bya'i gnas thams cad la legs par byings/ dang po bal po'i bla ma mdzad de'i rjes su gangs ri'i bla mar bste/sa nas 'byug gzhung la 'bul ba rgya chen nge phul 'dug 'dir gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang lung rgyun chad pa gangs ri'i bla ma dkar brgyud dbang phyug 'di la rje ma na tan rgyal mtshan gyis rgyud bskul te dur dgon du dbang rgyun khungs gtsang par mchis pa las sku( na la ma nyerdzos par legs par zhus te gangs ri nas dgongs pa zhus te 'dir gyon nas/ rje yodan tan rgyal mtshan sogs la gnang ste da lta brgyud pa yod pa de nas yin zhes bshad kyi 'dug phyis 'byug gzhung du spyi lo 1864 rab byung 14 shing byi lor sde srid kyi khrir mnga' gsol kyang mi ring bar lo de'i dbyar dgongs pa rdzogs/ sde srid zhe dgu pa ni/ de skobasi mkhan slob dge 'dun spyi dang rdzong bdag so so nas gong sa'i khri la rje sku bgres sku(na tan rgyal mtshan yud tsam bzhugs par gasku(la kyang / sku na smin pa'i tshul sku gas gsungs nas ma gsan par/ bstan dang 'a〈sna la phan bde spel nus pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes thu gcig slob dpon gyi gral nas bsko dgos pa'i bka' gnang bzhin/ dge 'dun thugs mthun gyi sgo nas snron zla'i yar tshes dge bar/ gtong ba la goms shing byams pa'i thugs kyi bdag nyid can lung dang rig pa/'i mdzod mdzin mtshan nyid slob dpon bston 'grus pad dkar gong sa'i 'a03 rje yoni tan rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar skal bzang rna ba'i bcud len nga lnga'i mdun nas/473

khrir mnga' gse la bar mdzad do/ / zhes gsal ba bzhin/ mkhan hre ba dge 'dun rnams dang rdzong bdag dpon lag kun mos mthun gyis dpal ldan 'grag pa'i chodas srid lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa skyong ba'i sde srid kyi khrir spyi lo 1864 rababyung 14shing pho byi ba la mtshan nyid slob dpon brtson 'grus pad dkar sde srid kyi khrir mnga' gse la 'dug kyang de skabs sri ngan lta thu zhig gis yusko mi ring bar zhi bar gshegs/de nas sde srid lnga bcu pa slar tsho dbang sri thub sde srid kyi khrir bzhugs pa'i skabs/ sa nyeb e sha li e )na pā ) dang 'o/ tsā ba chi thu bla ma bcas 'phral du 'grug yul du cadang rgyu'i skor yi ge btang 'dug de nas zhu yig nang zhus pa ltar 'ong rnams rab byung 14 shing byi spyi lo 1864 zla dang po'i tshes la rdo rje gling nas con te 'byug pa'i sa 'dam sang de nas brda ling rdzong de nas sib sur 'byor ba dang dos mi dang rta rkuskyir skor sib su'i gnyer pa la 'o/ rgyus lab tsho/ gnyer pa nas e sha li e )na la dos mi dang rta 'ur mi thob/ gang yin zer na/ rgya gar nas sa nyeb 'ong rgyu'i rgodar sde pa dang bla ma nas gnyer pa la bka' 31ga ma byung / bka' 31ga med par khyod kyi rogs ram bya thub mi 'dug khyod rang zhag bdun phrag lhag 'dir bsgugs sdod na bka' lan zhig gzhung nas 'byor 'ong / de dus 'gro na dug 'ong zer lab 'dug gnyer pa nas lan de khu/nga nas sku tshab e sha li e )na phyag ro/gas la shas dang cerdzos mang rab sib sa/ra bzhag nas 'byug 5kyil du cadangs te zhag gnyis gsum tsam na gsang sbas rdzong du 'byor 'dug de ga'i gnyer pa nas kyang rta'ur dang dos mi bcas sde pa'i bka' sku/ga med par sprod thub med pa'i lo rgyus bshad 'dug de ltar rdzong lag so so'i gnyer pa rnams nas dos mi rta 'ur gtan nas thob kyi mi 'dug sde 474

pa'i bka' rgya yod pa yin nam snyam gsang sbas gnyer pa la dris 'dug gsang sbas gnyer pa nas sa nyeb 'grag la gtang mi gtong gi skor bka' 31ga gang yang med/'byug yul du 'gro rgyu yin nam rgya phyogs su slar log 'gro rgyu khyod rang gi thugs 'dod 'khrid rgyu ma gtogs phran nas gang yang lab rgyu med brjod 'dug sa nyeb des de sa sib su rdzong nas phyag rogs rnams slar log rdo rje gling du song zhes yi go bskur 'dug bo rang dang pā ) gsang sbus rdzong nas dbyin zla 'a tshes la thon te bsod sgris sdod skabs sde pa'i zhabs nas cadang ba yin zer ba'i gzim sgar pa dang 'phrad 'dug gzim sgar pa'i mdun brda ling ko di'i rdzong dpon la bka' shog gnyis gnang 'dug pa de e sha li e )na gyis la phye klog tshe/ de nang brda ling ko di'i rdzong dpon des rgyu gar pa sa mtshams nas brgal te 'grag nang du gte nga dasnodas pa de ci yin nam/ de'i nyes bya khyod nas gzim sgar re la rub 70 re sprod dgos dang / khyod nas thabs shes kyi lha nas rgya gar sa nyeb de slar 'o/ga rgya phyogs su gtang dgo sa dang /gal srid sa nyeb chos nyan ma btub tsho 'ong gi rogs ram byed bsam rtse brgyud de 'dir zhabs rtsar gtang dgos zhes bka' gnang 'dug de nas sa heb dang pā ṭi tsho bsod khris nas thon te sbrel gong la brgal te shā phi ji brgyud rdo ri la nas has rdzong du 'byor 'dug der sdod ring has dung pa nas 'ong la rogs ram legs par byas 'dug nyas rdzong du zhag lnga dug tsam ngal bso bsdad de zla 'a chos 19 la spa spor 'ong 'dug spa ༷ cang na na slebs pa dang sde pa'i zhabs nas gzim sgar la shas shig 'ongs te 'ong sa heb tsho slar log rgya gar du 'gro dgos lugs brjod 'dug sa heb e sha li e )na nas 'byug sde pa dang bla ma'i bka' 31ga mjal dgos bka' dang 475

'khril rgyu yin zhes lab pa bzhin bka' sgo/ga bton te sa nyeb rnams la spyod 'dugabaka' 31ga nang slar log 'gro dgos pa'i bka' rgya med stabs zla 'a tshes 'a' la spa spor song 'dug spa spor 'byor tshe sa heb rnams sdod sa'i grabs sgrig gang yang med par gur sbub rgyu'i sa gnas 'o rang pā ) tsho nas 'tshol te sdod sa grabs sgrig 'o rang nas rgyab pa yin 'dug / spyi lo 1864 dbyin zla 'a tshes 'a3 la spa spo dpon slob gsar bgres gnyis kyis chi thu bla ma sos te/ sa nyeb 'grag yul du 'khrid cadang dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dris 'dug rjes su dpon hre ba nas khong sa nyeb rnams la sde pa'i bka' lan ma 'gyor tshun spa spor bsgugs te sdod dgos zhes gsungs/ rjes su spa hpho dpon slob bgres pa des 'ong sa nyeb rnams la legs par mdzad 'dug spa gror 'byor te zhag 16 song rung sde pa'i zhabs nas bka' lan gang yang phebs rgyu med par spyi 'o/ 1864 rab byung 14 shing byi zla 3 tshes bcu tham la spu gro dpon slob nas phyag dbang zhus te rim phyar song 'dug spa spo nas spyi mi thang la de nas tsha li mar 'phel brgyud sprungs thang rdzong du tshes 15 la 'byor 'dug/sa heb e sha li e )na 'byug yul du gtasnang skabs gsham gsal ltar gyi bka'aspro/ga rgya gzhung gis gnang don khyod rang 'byug sde pa dang bla ma gnyis kyi zhabs sar 'byor pa nas labyin gzhung dang 'byug gzhung gi bar du chings yig bzo dgos rgyu don 65na ba/pag34 ba/ba/'a//dang po 'byug pa'i dbang ba'i sa cha 5 la ko ṭa zer ba de rang re rgya gzhung lag tu len dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang de la brten pa'i sa khral bkag ste 'byug 476

'khril rgyu yin zhes lab pa bzhin bka' sgo/ga bton te sa nyeb rnams la spyod 'dugabaka' 31ga nang slar log 'gro dgos pa'i bka' rgya med stabs zla 'a tshes 'a' la spa spor song 'dug spa spor 'byor tshe sa heb rnams sdod sa'i grabs sgrig gang yang med par gur sbub rgyu'i sa gnas 'o rang pā ) tsho nas 'tshol te sdod sa grabs sgrig 'o rang nas rgyab pa yin 'dug / spyi lo 1864 dbyin zla 'a tshes 'a3 la spa spo dpon slob gsar bgres gnyis kyis chi thu bla ma sos te/ sa nyeb 'grag yul du 'khrid cadang dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dris 'dug rjes su dpon hre ba nas khong sa nyeb rnams la sde pa'i bka' lan ma 'gyor tshun spa spor bsgugs te sdod dgos zhes gsungs/ rjes su spa hpho dpon slob bgres pa des 'ong sa nyeb rnams la legs par mdzad 'dug spa gror 'byor te zhag 16 song rung sde pa'i zhabs nas bka' lan gang yang phebs rgyu med par spyi 'o/ 1864 rab byung 14 shing byi zla 3 tshes bcu tham la spu gro dpon slob nas phyag dbang zhus te rim phyar song 'dug spa spo nas spyi mi thang la de nas tsha li mar 'phel brgyud sprungs thang rdzong du tshes 15 la 'byor 'dug/sa heb e sha li e )na 'byug yul du gtasnang skabs gsham gsal ltar gyi bka'aspro/ga rgya gzhung gis gnang don khyod rang 'byug sde pa dang bla ma gnyis kyi zhabs sar 'byor pa nas labyin gzhung dang 'byug gzhung gi bar du chings yig bzo dgos rgyu don 65na ba/pag34 ba/ba/'a//dang po 'byug pa'i dbang ba'i sa cha 5 la ko ṭa zer ba de rang re rgya gzhung lag tu len dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang de la brten pa'i sa khral bkag ste 'byug 476

gzhung la ma sprod pa'i don gnad de rang re rgya gar gzhung gi sa cha de za skyed bya dgos bsam ste len pa ma yin par/ 'byug pas dbang bstongs bgyis te rgya gar gyi spong khyim lag gi mi ser gyi ca chas 'phyog bcom byas te khyor song ba dang mi ser bcings te 'byug yul du khrid song ba sogs slar log rgya gzhung lag par ma byung bar brten yin pa'i ra khungs dag par zhu dgos / gnyis pa dzadang gsal ltar ca chas 'phyog bcom byas pa dang rgya gzhung mi ser 'byug pa'i lag par btson pa byas yodad rigs rgya gzhung lag par spyod na/gong gi sa cha snga la ko ṭa zer ba de slar log 'byug gzhung la spyod rgyu yin pa'i lo rgyus zhu dgos dang / gasnge/ma pa rgya gar gzhung gi sta/ tshab cig 'byug rgyal sar bzhag na ji 'tshams kyi bsnyun spos rgyab dgos pa dang / bzhi pa rang re rgya gar dang 'byug pa'i mi ser gnyis kyi stong lam de rang re rgya gar 'byug nang stong rgyab par 'ong na 'ong chodag pa dang / 'grag pa rgya gar du 'ong na bkag cha med par stong rgyab chog pa'i yi ge bzo dgos pa dang / gong gsal ltar las ka gang yang mthar 'khyol se nga na/ gnad don de rnams gang yang la gsal bkod de chings yig bzos pa nas 'grag sde pa'i phyag tham zhus te khyer 'ong dgos/gong gsal bka' gnang ba ltar bong sa heb e sha li e )na nas bka' don gang yang mthar bkyil thub byung mi 'dug bo pa sa heb e sha li e )na sprungs thang du sdod skabs sdod pa'i gur nas gom thengs gang 'gro sar yang srung bya pa btsugs te mi ser dang kha lab mi snu ga par bzos pa ma tshad/ kho'i lo tsā ba chi bu bla ma yang nyin — 477

gnyig spungs rdzong bston lang nang btsugs 'dug de nas mtha' mthug 'ong sa heb pā ṭi rnams la rin dngul khar gnyer tshang yang btsong mi snurmeg ces mi ser la bka' 3/ga gnang ste gnyer tshang rbad bcad bzos nas/ sa nyeb e sha li e )na dang pā 3 la de lta bu'i gdug rtsub btang ste bzhag 'dug mtha' mjug spyi lo 1864 zla3 chos 'a la phyi dros spos la bo pa e )na dang pā 3 bcas pa sprungs rdzong nas nub shul rgyab ste dbyin zla 4 tshes 1 la rin sprungs 'gyor/der spa spo dpon slob bgres pa nas bo'i rogs ram byas 'dug de lta thu'i dga' bsu spa spo dpon slob bgres pa nas byas gnang sto 'ong yang cung tsam blo bde ba byung ltar dug der zhag gcig sdod skabs spa spo mi ser nas bo pa e sha li e )na la da res spa spo cha 'dus kyi mi ser gyis krong sar dpon slob dang dmag rgyab rgyu'i grabs sgrig rgyab nas sku da ces lab 'dug ye sha li e )na nas spa hro rdzong nang rgya gar gzhung gi mi se ra btson pa byas mi grangs 300 tsam mthong 'dug de rnams slar log rgya gar lag par dgos lugs brjod 'dug na spa spo dpon slob nas spyod mi 'dug de nas rab byung 14 shing pho khyi ba spyi lo 1864 zla 4 tshes 'a la khong e sha li e )na dang pā ) spa gro nas has de nas gsang sbas brgyud de rgya phyogs su log song 'dug de nas sa nyeb e sha li e )na gyis ka li ka tar phyo gling gzhung la 'o/ rgyus de tsho brjod 'dug/478

sde srid lnga bcu nga gcig pa'i lo rgyus ni/༄7/ / sde srid khri rabs lnga bcu nga gnyig pa gong sa 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi rigs brgyud dang 'khrungs yul ni/ mkhas grub kun dga' dbang 〈snag gi gsung gros dngos tshib rgya mtsho'i gter zhes bya ba brgya gya dug gi rgyab nas/ yab rig 'dzin chen po'i 'al nas/ nga'i kun dbang 'di nyid 'ong lus la 'bor tshe/ bdag pha ma gnyis kyi rmi lam rtags bzang po yang mang du byung / nub gnyig gi rmi lam na/rol mo'i sgu ldir ba zhig byung bas/ nam mkhar bltas pas/ nam mkha'i mthongs nas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa gcig a ma'i spyi gtsug tu thim pa yang byung / thu 'di pas 'phyo can zhig yin 'dug gsungs/ zhes dang / de 'e ga skye ba byang phyogs bams kyi yul/ / maḥthog chodas rar ཿtshes kyi rgyal po ni/ / ye shes 'bum pa zhes pa'i mi ri du 'khrungs/ / 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis byin gyis rab hu brlabs/ / zhes dang / mon yul mtha' ru pad gling byon pa thos/ / lus 'di ma spangs mjal bar sems na yang / / gnas skabs 'brel bas rgyu yi kyen ma thub/ / dnge sa bcas 'u/sa 'di mi ring phyir bor yang / / bag chags sems kyis thogs med bum thang du/ /ma ni sum 'dren zhes bya'i lus la 'a6der/ / zhes sesgogs gsungs pa dang / kun dga' dbang phyug rang nyid kyi gsung mgur nas/ dad ldan thu slob kho bo'i glu 'di nyon/ /gling ni ma nor snyo phyogs 'dzam thu'i gling / / sa ni ma nor bum thang yul gyi dbus/ /skyes sa ma nor lhun grub chodas kyi gling / / pha ni ma nor rig 'dzin padma gling / / ma ni ma nor mtsha/ laldan 'thum 'dren lus/ / rus ni ma nor gnyesnas sa rgyal ba'i brgyud/ /419

rigs ni ma nor kun bzang chodas kyi dbyings/ / zhes gsungs pa'i gter chen padma gling pa'i glu gsung thugs kyi sras mkhas grub kun dga' dbang sgyug la yab kyis rten skal gnang ste ku re lung du thu khyod la ma'o ba'i lung chung yod pa der song la 'gro don gyis shig yang khyod kshi sa phyogs dung dkar gyi dbyibs 'du ba zhig yod pa de la gnas gzhi 'dzin 'ong zhes lung bstan pa bzhin ku re lung du byon te thog mar ma'o chung gdan sa bcags te la'u chung chodas rje dang / de nas dung dkar 'du ba'i sa khyodags snge/ khyodan nas gdan sa bcags te bzhugs nas sras badzo/da bzhag pa las gdung dkar cheges rje zhes krerdzongs su grags pa der mkhas grub kun dga' dbang phyug gi sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis maco chung dang dung dkar gnyis zung 'brel mdzad/ de'i sras ceras rje rta 'phel/ de'i sras 0sgron gnyis las chung ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/de'i sras bstan pa'i nyi ma/ de 'i sras chodas rje padma dang a zhe dge legs dbang 'dzom gnyis la sras pi la mgon po dbang rgyal 'khrungs/ chung dus yon tan slob spyong sgang steng la phran tsam bslabs te lha 'u/nga gsung sprul bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhabs la gtugs nas thos bsam mdzad cing smin grol gyi gdams pa mang du zhus te slar yang yul du byon nas yun ma ring bar/ zhabs dung 'jigs med grags pa dang nye tshan du gyur gshis zhabs sar brten dgos byung bse phyag zhus te 'byug gzhung du gyon nas 'o/ shas bzhugs/ de nas 'khrungs yul du byon sgang steng sprul sku phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi sring mo lha sgron zer ba bag mar bsus te dung dkar gyi khyim 'dzin mdzad kyang lha sgron tshe las 'das pa'i rjes su che sa rje rang gi grwa pa gyang gsar du bu mo spun gsum yod pa'i bar ma bsod nams dpal 'dzom dang lhan bzhugs mdzad pa las/480

sras tshe ba dung dkar pyopa mtshan/ de 'og 'jigs med rnam rgyal/ de 'og lhun rdzong 5 rdo rje/ sring mo tsho ring sgrol ma bcas byung / 'jigs med rnam rgyal ni spyi lo 18'dzirab byung 14 shing mo bya 'o/ra 'khrungs/ mtshan bsam tshib ces btags/ chung ngu'i dus nas shes rig bkra zhing dpa' tsal dang snying ste/bas che bas dus la babs na sha rmos spang phyag zer ba'i dpe bzhin/ sku nar son nas pha yul rgyab skyur gyis chodas rtser dpon slob gī gzim sgar byed par 'gro ba na stang rna ru rgod po'i khyim du 'byor te der lug rdzi dang nor rdzi zla ba la shas mdzad/ de nas rim bzhin chodas rtser 'byor nas dpon slob gtam gzhis chodas rje skye/ rgyan phran rtsegs kyi sgar lto'i gral du zhugs te chodas rje 'grag pa'i bka' 'bangs su gte gas par mdzad/ mi ring bar skyo/ rgyan phran tshogs zur bzhugs mdzad de chodas rtse spyi bla'am dpon slob dbang chen rdo rje'am mtsho skyes rdo rje mnga' gsol ba'i spying du chab g.yog chab kha pa gsol dpon sogs mdzad skabs gang yang le 'o/'i dbang du ma se nga bar mthar phyin par tshib pas thugs mnyes te gzim nang gi thugs 'gan bzhes shing gzim sgar dmang gi 'bo bdag dar dpon gyi 'gan yang 'dres mar mdzad/ dbyar gyi bzhusas gnas skru rjes kyi sgrub gnas su ku ru rin po che'i gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma 'bum ther dang bskang bshags/ bya dkar g.yul rgyal rdzong gi rten mdos/ sku rjes kyi tshes bcu chen mo/glang ma lung du lha mo'i bla mtshor lo dus kyi gsung che ga 'brel bar gsol thab phebs bzhugs kyi mdzad byed sku gas gang yang le gas par mdzad/ mi ring bar mtshams pa'i chong dpon gyi 'gan bzhes/ sngar gyi tshong dpon gzhan las rang bzhin gyis go sa ma tho bar gyur/ tshong dpon gyi skabs bod du gyon pa na dpon slob zur bzhugs o 481

rgyan phran tshogs kyi sras mo padma chodas rgyud lha lung du pho rgan gsung sprul kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma'i grang du bzhugs pa'i skabs thog mar 'phrad 'dug sa lo 1848rab byung 14 sa sprel dgung lo nyer bzhi la chodas rtse'i gzim dpon gyi go gnas bzhes te 'khrungs yul dung dkar du byon pa na bla ma byang chub bce na 'grus blam dpal rir bzhugs pa'i skabs thog mar mjal ba khyodad ldan du gzigs te dbang cheras gnang ba zhus te kur stod du byon nas lhun rtser phebs/ lhun rtse'i rdzong dpon gdug rtsub che bas mi ser dug rim rnams la 'tsho zhing gtsos pa de bde blag tu cham la phab/ lhun rtse nas slar 'e1ga khyodan pa na bla ma byang chub ba35na 'grus rgyal ba mkhas lnga/ba rgya macerdzo'i skru rim tshe sgrub gnang ste sku rjes su bzhugs pa'i dung du gyon snyan brgyud zab dbang rgyas pa bskur bar mdzad de bla slob dang yon mchodad dam par gyur/ 'byug rdzongs spyi'i dar rgyud kyi brtags pa zhus pas/ bde mchodag lhan skyes rtsa bsnyen dung sgyur dang 'khos rtser bde macerag snang brnyan zhal nub gzigs ma zhig bzhengs na khyod rang sku brgyud rim pas snyo rdzongs 'di ga'i gtsug nor 'gyur bar lung bstan pa ltar myur du sgrub pa'i thugs 'dun mdzad de chos rtser byon/ dgung lo nyer lnga spyi lo 1849 rab byung 14 sa mo bya la 'grag gzhung du sde srid bkra shis rdo rje'i skabs gdan sa sprungs thang rdzong mes 'jig pa'i zhig gsos rtse sa rtse'i chab 'a ga las thum thang sde bzhi dang mang sde pa'i las mi mi ser rnams kyi 'go dpon mdzad de gyon/ shar nub kyi dpon lag che ba thams cad der 'dzoms/ pho nga rgyal can gnya' rgod rnams kyang rdo 'thu ba/dgang rdo 'phangs pa/ tsal gyis mche ngas pa/ gri yis shing gcod pa/ dasung shed kyis dbyug res byed pa sku gas ste bas dza/gas skyu tsal 'gran pa gang la'ang gnya' rgod 482

zhing thon te bkra shis yang rtse dang / gdung bsam rdzong / gzhong sgar rdzong / bkra shis sgang rdzong rnams phas rgol gyi dgra rnams sus kyang rgol ma thub pas bde blag tu rim pa bzhin du rtsis blangs te/ rdzong dpon gsum dang rgya grang bcas mdun bcug byas te dpon slob mtsho skyes rdo rje'i phyag dbang la bkyil nas gzhung la btang / shar dpal la'i la phar bcad snu sa rtse dpon slob kyi mnga' zhabs su bsdus/ de nas yang rgyung tsam zhig na gzhung du zings 'khrugs langs te pho rgan dung dkar pa rgyal mtshan dang nu so spyid tshal la rdo rje rnam rgyal bcas gyon/ sde srid lcags pa sangs rgyas kyi dmag dpon gnya' rgod mig thol ma zer ba de mang sde stang si khris nas thud med gcig la thugs btsan gyis bzos pa'i thu sus kyang mi thub pa'i stobs dza/gas can zhig byung ba de cher lon nas gzhung du sde srid kyi sgar lto byas rta dpon gyi go gnas thob pa yin 'dug dpal rtsal pa dang gnya' tre da gzhan rnams las snga ma'i dmag 'grig gi skabs rnams su 'o pa ru ngar zhing khyerang pas rgol ba na/ 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyis khyod nub phyogs kyi mi ni min/ de tsam 'gan 'bag mi dgos zhes gsungs pa'i tshe/mig thol mas lan ro khyi lto gang nas za sa nas hab zer ba khyod kyis ma go ba yin nam zer nas rgol ba'i zhe 'khon gyis de skabs sde srid lcags pa sangs rgyas nor sgang du bzhugs/ 'o pa nyin mo sde srid kyi dung du bsdad mtshan mo lab tsa lar gnas tshang rtsar 'gro ba'i lam du 'jigs med rnam rgyal spun gsum gyis bskugs te bsad pa'i rkyen las mgar sa/ phu ma byang thang bskor te gyon skabs zhabs dung 'jigs med no ra gra'i pho rgan gzim dpon bsod nams don grub kyis sgar lto drug cu tham〈rsha 'ong gsum mgar sa thug skyel bar btang ba slar log ste dkar spe sar khyim gcig nang sto chas 484

sgrig ste sdod pa na/ sde srid lcags pa sangs rgyas kyi dmag mi rnams kyis me spar te khyim dang brigs mi dug cu thal bar brlag 'dug rsha / 'jigs med rnam rgyal min gsum la yag lha lung brgyud de che sa rtser 'gyor/de nas sngar bsnon 'grus rgyal mtshan gyi thog mar chodas rtse dpon slob bsko rgyu'i zhal bzhes yod kyang skabs 'dir brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan bsgo rgyu'i gleng mo byung bas/ re zhig snyung brdzus kyis sla'u gzhong du bzhugs te rdzong nang du ma gyon pa las/dpon slob mtsho skyes rdo rje bka' spos pa rnams dang gsung spos mdzad de sngon la 'jigs med rnam rgyal dpon slob bskos te lo 3 nas dgongs pa zhus te brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan bsko rgyur spos thag bcad 'dug de nas sngar thang rdzong nang sredag mgo bston pa'i legs drin dang skabs der gnya' rgod mig thol ma bsgral ba la brten nas spyi lo 1853 rab byung 14 chu glang lor dgung grangs 'kho la chos rtse dpon slob tu mnga' gsol/ de nas mi ring bar kyibs rje byang chub bce na 'grus kyis lung bstan pa'i bde mche ga snang brnyan zhal nub gzigs ma'i lha khang rten brten par bcas pa smregos par bzhengs tshib mtshams 'aX masku na gtsang pa rgya ras kyi sku tshigs las byedan pa'i phag mo rang byon 'khrul med phyag hu se na pa ye shes sems par phul te phag mo dngul sku bzhengs pa bcas rab gnas legs par grub/ de nas yang gzhung du sde srid bar cung pa dam 2rdzos lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ bka' blon ka sha sogs zings 'khrugs langs pa pas gzhung du byedan nas 'alngasam brag martse 'i thang la bzhugs te khri bsdums mdzad pa'i legs drin du sa khral rub gos bzhi chodas rtser bzhag chodag pa dang / shar rdzong dpon lag rnams gzhung la snyan zhu mi dgos par ཿwas 485
