rtse nas dpon slob rang gis bskos chodag pa'i thugs don grub ste slar gyon nas kyibs rje byung chub bce na 'grus gdan 'dren pa'i zhu yig phyal ba gyon ma thub pas shin hu thugs gdungs/ 'byon pa'i thabs su ri rgya klung rgya bsdams te sredag gcod kyi rigs mnga' 'og thams cad du spang bcug ste spar pa bstan 'dzin zer ba de snar thang du bka' 'gyur par gdab par btang ba dang 'brel/ kyibs rje byang chub bcerdzon 'grus gdan 'dren zhu ba'i zhu yig phyal bas rten 'brel gyi lnga legs lam du gyur bas phag ri nas spa gro brgyud de byon/ bka' 'gyur gdan dungs te nya la dang 'brang la dgon par gnang / bla ma byang chub bce na 'grus 'brang la dgon pa dang tshangs kha brgyud de chodas 'bor da ba brtan rtser phebs nas mtshadad yon zhal 'dzom mdzad/dpon sle ba 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyis tshan grangs gser dngul gyi thums sku gas phul te gsol ba btab pa bzhin he ru ga: glang zhal gyi dbang khrid gdams pa rngo sprod sogs ltag lus med par gnang / dpon slob zur pa skyod rgyan phran tshogs kyi sras mo padma chodas spyod dpon slob 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi lcam bzhes te bzhugs yod kyang /chos rtse da pon slob de shad phyogs kyi 'bangs mi se ra yongs kyi spyi bla yin pas sngon chodas rgyal mi 'gyur brtan pa sogs rten rab byung yin pa bzhin/ a rtse spangs te rab hā byung nas bzhugs par zhus pas/ kyibs rje byang chub bcesan 'grus kyi zhal nas/ a lce las smon mthun pa'i grogs yin pas spang mi dgos/ sras yag po 'khrungs nas rgyal khab la phan therdzogs pa tshesang zhes gsu/ngas/ zhabs brtan ste/ba ma sa bla ma la 'bul ba yin yang da res zhin bdag la 'bul dgos gsungs te rdo rje 'jigs byed la brten pa'i byad grol dang brtan bzhugs 'bul gnang bar mdzad/486

mgon po byang bdud dang las mgon bya rog gdong can dbyer med pa'i dgra lha'i rten 'dzugs btsugs shing bya ro/ga dbu zhwa byin gyis brlabs te gnang bar ma dzad/ dus nyis su phyogs kyi mi gcig zhabs sar 'byor cadang ba de bdag 'dzin byas te bzhag na khyod rang la phan rgya chen po thogs lo nga zhes lung bstan kyang gsungs te mi ring bar spyi lo 1856 rab byung 14 me 'byug lo zla 5 pa'i tshes 16 la stag rdzong du dgongs pa chos dbyings su gshegs/ spur byams pa lha lang du gdan 'dren zhus te me mchod dang dgongs rdzogs rnams legs par grub/ spyi 'o/ 1856 rab byung 14 me 'grag zle 7 pa'i nang du sras phrin las stodabs rgyas 'khyungs/ de nas spyi lo 1857 rababyung14 me sprul lo gsar tshos pa dang sngon 'jigs med rnam rgyal dpon slob bskos skabs 'ordzo gsum nas dartse ngas pa zhus te bcerdzon 'grus rgyal mtshan la gnang dartse 'is zhis mtsho skyes rdo rje rang gi sku tshab che sa rtse'i mgron gnyer pa sangs zer ba de bzhag pa la/pa sangs dug shul gyi spyad pa la dpon sle ba 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi sgar lto rnams ma rangs par 'thab 'dzingakhu/nga ba'i thog bka' gros pa rnams kyis thugs dun skutshes te ma zhus na sngar dpon 〈snab bste/sa rgyu'i zhal bzhes ltar ma mdzad pa'i rgyu kyen gyis 'cham sgar pa sgom sgo sa kur stod pa ko long zer ba la nang mol bka' gnang ste che sa mgron pa sangs bsad pa'i rkyen las/ spyi lo 1857 rab byung 14 me sprul lor chodas rtse dpon slob 'jigs med rnam rgyal dang bya dkar rdzong dpon brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan yab mtsho skyes rdo rje bcas nang 'khrugs byung / de skabs gzhung du sde srid kun dga' dpal ldan yin pa la bya dkar rdzong dpon brtsodan 'grus rgyal mtshan phyogs kyis dmag rgyab 'tshosnal ba bzhin gzhung nas dpung dmag btang yang phan tshun glags ma 487

gañdzi ra 'phral du brdungs te bkal gnang bar mdzad/ de bzhin sngar kyibs rje byang chub brtson 'grus kyis ceras 'khor rab brtan rtser bde mchodag gi snang brnyan zhal /ba gzigs ma zhig dang / byams lha lang du dus 'khor gyi snang brnyan zhal snyor gzigs bzhengs dgos par bka' lung stsal ba bzhin che sa rtser bde mche ga lha khang ḍi/gas par bzhengs grub cing / byams lha khang du dus 'khor de nyid bzhengs dgos bsam pa'i ngang du lto nang 'dir nang 'khrugs kyi brel ba da nga / lto mtshams nas ke nyin ji'i dmag 'khrugs kyi brel zings kyis rim 'gyangs su lus pa de nyid da lan 'phul du bzhengs dgos 'dug dgongs nas/ byams lha khang jo bo zhal shar du gzigs pa'i gasku na phyogs su sngar kyibs rje byang chub bcetshen 'grus rang gis sa gnas lung bstan cing zhabs kyis bcags pa der rab byung 15 me ye sa spyi 'o/ 1867wa sa bslang sa ཿtsheg la sku(gas pa'i mdzad sgo'i rigs gang yang lha lung gsung sprul kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi mas mdzad cing / nang ldeb ris rnams kyang lha lung gi pad gling lnga pa dang thugs sras lnga pa'i phyag bris rgyun 'khrul med lha bris hre ba dpon pa sangs kyi phyag bris lags shing rten brten par bcas pa ring por ma thogs pa bsgrubs te/ rab gnas kyi dga' ston pad gling brgyad pa kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma sa mdzad do/ / de ltar kyibs rje byung chub brtsodan 'grus kyis bka' lung sal ba rim pas legs par grub pa dang / bod gangs can rdzongs kyi lha ldan jo shāka rnam gnyis rang byung thugs rje chen po rnams dang / yar klung rten gsum gnas gsum dang bsam yas sku1gas zhib mjal gnas gzigs kyang legs par 'chasnar bas dbang 'dus chodas gling du lcam padma che sa spyod sras phrin las stobs rgyas dang sku rgyan dbang 493

bla slob dge 'dun pas mi ser brdab gsig btang ba la dartse ngas nas khri 'dums mdzad de slar dbang 'dus chodas gling la byon 'dugaslar sems can gyi las dbang bcos su med pa dang / mi rje de'i bse da nams kyi stobs kyis 'khor los sgyur ran pa'i dus spungs rdzong pa brang bkra shis dang dbang rdzong bgres pa sri rgyas phyogs gcig byas/ dbang rdzong bgres pa dar lung stobs rgyas dang dbang rdzong khri pa kun legs rdo rje/ thim rdzong pa ka wang mang khel phyogs gcig byas nas zings 'khrugs tshab cher sku nga stabs kyis/ spungs khyodang pa brang bkra shis pham lar thug ste mi rje 'jigs med rnam rgyal zhu bar btang nas spu 'o/ 1869 rab /nga 15 sa sgrul zla dang po'i nang ston te dbang rdzong du dmag rgyab skabs stag seng 'gyings pa ltar gcig gis gcig la glags ma khel bar 'u/sa skabs/ 'jigs med rnam rgyal rgyus phyag g.yodag gnyis rdzas sgrom spyod de rim rdzong me spar bar mtshan mo gsang thabs kyis btang nas spyi lo 1869 rab byung 15 sa sprul 'o/ra thim rdzong mes 'jig byung ba las rdzong dpon ka wang mang khel dpon g.yog rnams dbang rdzong pa dar lung stobs rgyas dang la bral te rim phyar byon dgos byung rjes/ de nas dbang rdzong du chodas rtse pa dung dkar pa rgyal mtshan dang 'jigs med rnam rgyal chodas rtse dpon slob gsar bgres gnyis dar lung ste/bas rgyas dang khri sgrig rgyu'i mjal 'phrad mdzad skabs su/ ci 'jigs med rnam rgyal sgar lto stod wang snu sa rgyal bzang po dang ka wang sangs rgyas gnyis a/ ma de wa'i tsha bo yin zhing / sngar lnga/ ma de wa gong gzim grwa cung gis bkrongs pas/ mi spyin byas 'ong gnyis kyis grwa cung bkrongs nas bros te ཿtshes rtser song nas 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi sgar lto byas yod pa las/ gyis brel ba 497

sangs rgyas stong sku/ der spyan gzigs phye 'phur rgyal mtshan bla bres sku/la ba sku gas thul ba dang khyad par dbu rtse/ kun rwa/ tshe dpag med bcas rgya phibs gasnge/ma tsam phrul ba dang / rgyal mtshan che chung lnga bcas phyal/ de'i tshe rim rdzong mang khel dgongs pa zhus te 'o pa'i nu bo bla ma tshe dbang rim rdzong pa bsgos/spyi lo 187'a rab byung 15 chu sprel lor spa spo dpon slob tshe byudabang nor bus sde srid 'jigs med rnam rgyal la ngo rgol byed de sde pa'i gzim sgar pas spa spo dpon slob tsho dbang nor thu'i sgar lto ma non par gong gzim spyod tshal pas mang khel btang dgos pa'i zhu yig phul/ chad pa 'gro dgos par bka' gnang tsho lo rnga/sa tshe dbang nor thu phab tshugs na spa spo dpon che ba 'o rang byed rgyu yin zhus pas/ khyed rang gi blo 'dod ngang bsnyun te byed snu ga ces gsungs nas mang khel spa gror byon/ tshe nor dang mang khel sngar spyod sdug gcig pa yin brten nang mol du khyod kyis sde srid la ngo rgol mi thub/ lto nang dbang rdzong pa dar lung stobs rgyas lta thu dpa' rtsal che ba'ang cham la geb tshar bas/ de bas sredag spyon med pa zhig ngas byed cadang bros bzur byas na legs lnga nga zhes thabs kyis zhus par brten/ tshe dbang nor thu bros bzur byas nas gyon spa hro rdzo nga thob 'dug/de nas mang khrol dpon slob byed rgyu'i re 'dod che yang gong gzim spyid tshal pa/ rgyul dum tshe dbang bcas/ ༷ sa bsdur thog nas/ 'jigs med rnam rgyal la zhu yig thul don/ spar rdzong dang rim rdzong gnyis 'ong spun gnyis kyi lag hu sprod na phyin chad da spa phyir min pa nang du cadang tshod 'dug pas/ da lta nas thabs shes re mdzad na mi legs sam zhes zhus btang bas/ khyed rnams pas sdud mthun gyis dpyad de khyodas shig 499

ces bka' lan phebs pas/ stod pa chu shing las dpon bskos te mang khel dbu la gri rgyab nas rab gsal nas bton te rdzong gi phyo rol g.yang la skyur nas bkrongs/tshe dbeng nor bu'i a zhang nyi ma rdo rje de 'jigs med rnam rgyal rang trī spogs po yin pas dpon hre ba rang 'jags co rang bzhag gnang bar mdzad/de nas spyi lo 1873 rab byung 15 chu bya lor sde srid las dgongs pa zhus te sku nu spyid tshal pa'am rdo rje rnam rgyal gong gzim nas sde srid kyi khrir bskos te gsang zab rdzong du bzhugs pa gnang zhing dgun spar khang du bzhugs pa'i skabs/ yang spungs thang rdzong dpon dam chodas rin chen gyis ngo rshaX/ rgyab sa kha zhug gsum tsam nas cham la phab ste tshab dngos grub bskos 'dug de skabs thum thang du che sa rtse dpon hre ba dung dkar pa rgyal mtshan dang bya dkar pa padma bstan 'dzin gnyis dmag zhakhrugs langs ko da pa'i skabs/ gzhung du'ang spungs rdzong pa dngos grub kyis spa gro dpon slob tshe dbang nor thu mag skud yin pa las de bkrugs te/ gnyer chen shar cung rin spungs su 'jigs med rnam rgyal kyi sku tshab hu bzhag yod pa de gzim dpon bar cung pas bsad de thog mar spa gror ngo rgol langs par brten 'jigs med rnam rgyal rang dang sde srid spyid tshal pa rim rdzong pa bla ma tshe dbang sras masna rgyan dbang phyug dang phran tshogs rdo rje bca sa spa gror gyon nas dmag nyin shas rgyab ste stag rdzong thob nas dmag sgar der bzhugs/ de'i bar gzhung du dbang 'dus pho brang masan gnyer a 'byug gis rdzong dpon ka wang sangs rgyas 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyis bskos pa de bkrongs te 'o rang rdzong dpon byas/ sprungs rdzong pa dngos grub kyis phyogs las sprul sku sde srid kyi khrir bton/ shar rgyal dum tshe dbad gzim dpon bskos 500

te zings brel spa spo las kyang gzhung du che bar song bar brten/'jigs med rnam rgyal rang dang thim rdzong pa bla ma tshe dbang de phyogs su gyon te gsang zab hu phebs/ bla ma tshe dbang gis dang po zhabs rang byon mi dgos 'o pa 'gro zhus te song nas/ khu ru chu bcad de pha khar thon te gyon nas/ snyungs rdzong pa dngos grub dang dbang rdzong pa a 'byug gi dmag rgyab la chos rtse dpon slob dung dkar pa rgyal mtshan gyis rmedzis rtse pa'i dmag che sa gzim zla ba dpal 'byor gyis 'khrid te btang kre da pa dang dmag rgyab pas/ snu sa gzim zla ba dpal 'byor gyis me mda' rgyab ste bla ma tshe dbang gi gnya' rgod dpon hre ba bar cung pa se gas dug tshad thams cad der bsad/ 'o rang yang dmag gis bskor te dog sar tshud 'dug pa las/ 'jigs med rnam rgyal rang dmag 'khrid de spungs thang phyogs su byon/ khu ru nas gtsang chu zam pa rgyab ste gyon nas bla ma tshe dbang dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de/dbang rdzong phyogs su dmag lag gcig dang / sprungs rdzong phyogs su dmag lag gcig bkram ste rgyab pa'i skabs der/ a rgas dam ceras rin chen gyis gnas bsterdzor 'gro rdzus byas te spa gror song nas/ sras 'a rgyan dbang phyug dang phun tshogs rdo rje gnyis ltag rdzong srung ste bzhag pa de gnyis bzung ste btson du btsugs pa gsan nas/shal rnga dam chodas rin chen gyi khyim nas shes rab rgyal mo se gas thu dang bu mo mi nya'abazung bcings kyis me mda' sgang du bzhag nas/ mi gcig dang bcu gnyis gang dga' 'dams zhes yi ge bskur gnang bas skye'o rgyan dbang 〈snag dang gzhung maX na phran chogs rdo rje gnyis sde srid spyod tsha' pa'i phyag hu thul ba las/ mi bcu gnyis po de yang btang 'dug spa spo chu rdzong srung mi dar lung dka ra rdos chu rdzong sde srid spyod tshal 501

pa'i phyag tu sgo ra nas chu med par dpon slob tshe dbang nor thu rgya phyogs su bros song bas spa spo'i rdzong thob/ sprungs rdzong pa dngos grub kyang dbang rdzong du bros rtsis byas kyang me mda' sgang dang bar grong nas 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi dmag sgar sku da pas ma thar/ mo chu'i zam brgyud yod pa'i sa nas snyungs rdzong pa dngos grub dang phyogs las sprul kro gyon pas/ 'jigs med rnam rgyal dang bla ma tsho dbang gis dmag btang bas srongs rdzong pa dang phyogs las sprul sku'i sgar lto rnams kyis ma thub par spungs rdzong pa rgya phyogs su bros/ phyogs las lab tsa kha nas bros te gsang 'bor du phebs/sgar pa phal cher thim rdzong pa'i dmag gis bsad/ gzim dpon rgyal dum tshe dbang tshal nang yib sdod pa de rim rdzong pa'i sgar pa tshal lung pa pho ba ja rdzis mthong nas skad rgyab pas dmag rnams casgongs te bsad nas/ gzim dpon rgyal dum tsho dbang / /dathu nyang med par gzim bzhugs 'dug /zer ba de nas byung /de nas spungs thang rdzong rtsis bzhes te 'jigs med rnam rgyal dbang rdzong gyogs/su gyon nas dbang rdzong dmag gis bskor bas yang 'grag gis ma thub par rdzas sgrom mdun du bzhag ste rdzong mes sreg grabs byed kyi 'dug par de skabs dbyangs slob sangs rgyas rdo rje 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi phyag zhus te yod pa yong 'byug rtsar gyon nas/ srog skyon med pare ngas byed cadang bas rdzong mes ma sregs zhes gsungs te shing ra nas bton/ mthar yong 'byug gtsos mi dgu bzung bcings mdzad de brtson du btsugs te/ dge 'dun pas gsol 'debs zhu bar gyon du re bas dbang —rdzong pa sogs mi dgu chur skyur rgyu yin gsungs te nyin bcu gnyis song rung su yang byon rgyu med pa las/ zhal rkye ngas te thams cad gtsang po'i zam nas chu la bskyur 502

'dug 'jigs med rnam rgyal zhal nas gyis su yang de skabashā rje rta la pa bshad sgrub 'od zer bzhugs na nga de tsam las bsags mi dgos pa tshetsheng rgyu yin pa la zhes yang yang gsungs 'dug / dus de skabs mi dpon 'dod pa can chos dmag 'khrugs rgyun ma chad par bslangs pa las yul mi che phra gang yang bza' ba'i rang dbang dang tshu pa'i spyod nyams med pa spyo shas nyam nga ba'i ngang du gnas pa na/ 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyis dgra sde thams cad tshar bcad de sras phrin las 〈snabs rgyas lha lung grwa tshang nas bos te dbang rdzong pa bskos/ sras ma rgyan dbang phyug spa spo dpon slob bskos te mi rje rang gsang zab rdzong du bzhugs/ de ltar lto nang la bzhi'i 'bangs mi sor la gzan pa'i shar nub kyi dpon rigs thams cad tshar bcad de rdzong gzhis thams cad phyag hu tshud cing rgyal srid chodas bzhin du spyong bzhin dgung grangs nga bdun bzhes pa na/ mings rdzong nas gsang zab hu phebs skabs rdormo skyong la'i gzhol snyong tsho lung pa na chibs g.yag therdzog nas lhung ste dbu nyis tshal du gas pas phebs rgyam the ga gdan dungs/ te nyin zhag lnga bzhugs rjes daskusnangs pa rjidags khar sras phrin las ste/bas rgyus dang o rgyan dbang phyug gnyis dang / phun chogs rdo rje dang a lo rdo rje bzhi la zhal chems gsungs pa/ nga med pa'i rjes su khyed rnams 'cham te ga te ma༄na te ga te sdod dgos/ gal srid phrin las stobs rgyas dang 61 rgyan dbang phyug la dgra byang phyo thon na thun chogs rdo rje dang a lo rdo rje gnyis kyi cha rogs byed dgos pa dang bong gnyis la dgra byung phyo thon na phrin las stobs rgyas dang skyo/ rgyan dbang phyug gis grub ste gcig gis gcig la cha rogs 'bad dgos phrin las ste/bas rgyas dang skye'o rgyan dbang phyug gnyis lus las chad pa'i bu dang / phun tshogs rdo rje dang a lo rdo rje gso ba'i 503

bu yin pas cog rang 'thad/ khyed bzhi sprun sprun cha'i mno bsam btang ste kha ma bral bar 'cham tog to 'bad sdod de gis snyo lung pa'i 'bangs mi ser gyi bde thabs dang / cheras rje dpal ldan 'byug pa'i bstan pa la phyag phyo gang dug zhus shig gsungs nas spyi lo 1881 rab byung 15 lcags sgrul lor gsang zab rdzong du sku gshegs so/ /de yang de ltar gsungs dgos pa'i don ni/ shal rnga pa dam chodas rin chen de nyid 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi sgar pa yin pas/ 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi sgo khar sgrig rgyug ste dbang 'dus chos gling du sdod pa'i dus su/ dam chos rin chen gyi sring slo bum thang du dam chodas rin chen tsar 'ongs te sdod pa'i skabs/ dbang 'dus chos gling gi rdzong nang du spyi lo 186'a rab byung 14 chu pho khyi lor lha sras o rgyan dbang phyug 'khrungs pa dang / rdzong gi phyo gdangs ra nang phran tshogs rdo rje skyes pa lo gcig zla ba gcig nyi ma gcig la dus mtshungs su skyes pa yin 'dug cing 'jigs med rnam rgyal thugs dgyes te sras 61 rgyan dbang khu/ga dang khyad med par thu tshab mdzad de thugs brtse chen pos zas sku sa kyis bkyings te gasku sa nas bskyed bsrings par mdzad pa las/ sras gnyis po lo bcu bdun skabs spa hro dpon slob tshe dbang nor thus ngo rbertel gyi ga'i/la 'aX/gas skabs gnyis ka yab 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi phyag zhus te sku da pa dang / g.yul 'khrugs kyi brel ba che da pa'i rjes su lha sras skyo/ rgyan dbang phyug spa gro dpon slob dang phun tshogs rdo rje gzhung mgyon gnyer bskos gnang bar mdzad 'dug de bzhin a lo rdo rje yang bla ma tshe dbang gis spa gro dpon slob tshe dbang nor thu'i ngo rgol skabs dang / spungs thang pa dngos grub dbang rdzong pa a 'byug bcas kyi ngo rgol dmag 'khrugs gī skabs rnams su lus se ga 'ben du btsugs te ngo sgog 504

med pa dam tshig 'a//ra ba med pa phyag zhus pa yin zhing / bla ma tshe dbang lnga rang la lus nas chad pa'i bu med par pho rgan ka wang mang khel gyi thu a lo rdo rje de bla ma tshe dbang 'o rang gi thu dang 'du ba yin par brten/ blam tshe dbang dang a lo rdo rje pha skud gnyis la 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyis phyo ltar gong ma dpon g.yog dang / nang ltar nang mi gcig gi thugs bzhed gnang ste thugs brtse chen po sku da pa las/ skye/ rgyun dbang phyug gis yab kyi dgongs bzhed bzhin rjes su phran tshogs rdo rje spungs thang rdzong dpon dang / a lo rdo rje thim phya rdzong dpon bskos gnang bar mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin zhes 'o/ rgyus khungs gtsang mar bshad kshi 'dug rtse / — 505

sde srid nga gnyis pa nas nga dug pa'i bar gyi lo rgyus/༄༄ / / sde srid khri rabs nga gnyis pa spyid tshal pa'am rdo rje rnam rgyal ni/ shar phyogs mang sde sgon khris na sa 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi yab pi la mgon po dbang rgyal gyi gcung po pā la rgyal mtshan gyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas 'jigs med rnam rgyal sngar che sa rtse gzim dpon mdzad dus dang mgron gnyer mdzad dus nas dmag 'khugs skabs nge lkog med par phyag phyod ci 'byor zhus pa las/'jigs med rnam rgyal chodas rtse dpon slob mdzad skabs rdo rje rnam rgyal gdung bsam phyogs su srang srung pa bskos/ 'jigs med rnam rgyal sde srid khrir mnga' gsol dus rdo rje rnam rgyal la gong gzim gyi go gnas gnang / mi rje 'jigs med rnam rgyal rang nyid sde srid kyi khri nas dgongs zhu mdzad pa na rdo rje rnam rgyal spyi lo 1873 rabasgyung 15chu bya lor sde srid khyo khrir mnga' gsol bar mdzad/ chodas rje 'grug pa'i bstan pa la zhabs tog bkra shis chodas rdzong du mi 'khrugs pa'i lha lang dang pha jo lding gzhol du spyod tshal lha khang gsar du bzhengs/ gdan sa sprung sa thang rdzong dang bkra shis chos rdzong phan tshun gnyis /ra phyag mdzod nang zong ja tshwa sogs kyi mdzod gtan bzhag dang tshon sgrom bcu tsam bcas kyi mdzod gsar bskrun mdzad gnang 'dug pa se gas bstan srid kyi don mdzad bzhin lo dug tsam khri thog bzhugs/ de skabs rje mkhan po blo spos rgyal mtshan yin pa sku gzugs bde min gyis chu pho'i tsha chu la gyon pa'i rjes su sde pa'i srung 'khor pa spa phrug zer ba des/ sde srid la zhus te mtshan slob pad dkar 'od zer mkhan khring mnga' gasku1la mdzad pa las/ mkhan 〈sna sdus 〈snas rgyal mtshan thugs brgyal 506

bzhis te mkhan po dgongs 'dus kyi rnal 'byor pa yin pas rta nag gi sgo nas mngon rṣa kyi las spyor mdzad pa las lo rjes mar mkhan po pad dkar 'od zer dang sde srid rdo rje rnam rgyal dang srung 'khor pa spa phyug bcas gsum ga bsgral te 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu gshegs dace sa byung 'dug go/sde srid khri rabs lnga bcu nga gsum pa ཿwas rgyal bzang po ni/ yul wang dar lung nas 'khrungs te chung ngu'i dus nas 'dus sder zhugs kyang / sde pa u ma de ba'i sku tsha yin pa las zhang po thim rdzong pa mdzad dus grwa tshang nas thon te gnag nor gyi nor dpon byas/ zhang po sde srid kyi khrir byon pa'i rjes su sde pa kun dga' dpal ldan gyi gzim dpon grwa cung gis zhang po bkrongs par brten/ nyo pa dang ka wang sangs rgyas kyis grwa cung bkre ngas pas gzhung khyodags su sdod stabs ma bde bar gling bzhi la yag brgyud de/ chodas rtse dpon slob 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi zhabs sar bcar te sgar lto byus/ rjes su 'jigs med rnam rgyal gzhung du dmag rgyab par byon dus dbang rdzong khri pa kun legs rdo rje bkrongs pa'i rjes su/ 'jigs med rnam rgyal sde srid kyi khrir bzhugs skabs gzhung mgron gyi go gnas su bskos/ de nas dbyin 'o/ 1879 rab byung 15 pa'i sa yos lor sde srid kyi khrir gyon nas bstan srid lo gnyis lhag tsam baspyangs nas spya lo 1881 rab byung 15 lcags sgrul 'o/ra sku zhi bar gshegs/sde srid khri rabs nga bzhi pa bla ma tshe dbang ni/ yul rim thu ka wang gyang sar nas 'khrungs/ yab rim rdzong pa ka sha zer ba de la bu che ba ka wang mang khel dang chung ba bla ma tshe dbang ngam bse da nams rgyal mtshan zer ba spun gnyis ma da/ dang po 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi dgra yin yang rjes su spa spo dpon sle ba tshe dbang nor bus 507

rngo rgol dang / dbang rdzong pa yang 'byug dang / spungs rdzong pa dngos grub sogs kyi ngo rgol gyi dmag 'khrugs skabs rnams su go nga cadag gi dam tshig nam yang 'gyur ba med cing ngo lkog med par srog dang bsdos te phyag phyod ci 'byor zhus pa las 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyis bla ma tshe dbang rim phu rdzong dpon bste/sa/ 'jigs med rnam rgyal sku gshegs pa'i rjes su sngar yab rje 'jigs med rnam rgyal la ngo sgog med par phyag zhus pa'i byas pa che bar brten/ phyis su skye/ rgyan dbang phyug gis sde srid ceras rgyal bzang po gshegs pa'i rjes su spyi lo 188'a rab byung 15 chu rta lor sde srid kyi khrir mnga' gsol nas lo gnyis tsam bstan srid bskyungs te spyi lo 1884 rababyung 15shing sprel 'o1ra bde bar skru gshegs/sde srid khri rabs nga lnga pa dga' ba bzang po ni/ dkar khris 'byung bzhi nang nas 'grings te chung ngu'i'i dus nas gzhung grwa tshang nang du bzhugs/ sgrig lam rnam gzhag dang gar thig dbyangs 31gas la mkhas par byings nas grwa tshang ma2de dasngatshen mdzad/ phyos su sde srid bla ma tsho dbang sku gshegs pa'i rjes su thim rdzong pa a lo rdo rje nas dbyirne lo 1884 rab byung 15 shing sprel lor sde srid kyi khrir bskos/ mi ring bar a lo rdo rje dang sprungs rdzong pa phun tshogs rdo rje gnyis kyis chos rtse pa o rgyan dbang phyug la ngo rgol gyi zings 'grags langs pas spu lo 1885 rab byung 15 shing byu zla 4 pa'i nang dasku ngas pa zhus te dben gnas mdo sde brag tu zur bzhugs mdzad nas zhi bar gadrenags/sde srid khri rabs nga dug pa sangs rgyas rdo rje ni/ spa bro spangs pa'i sar gterabaton shes rab me 'bar gyi dbon brgyung du spyi lo 1839 rab byung 14 sa phag lor 508

sku 'khrungs/ sku na gzhon dus nas dge 'dun gyi sder zhugs nas gar rig dbyungs sogs la rang byan tshud par byings nas dbyangs sle ba mdzad skabs/ 'jigs med rnam rgyal sde srid mdzad pa dang dus mtshungs pas sde srid kyi bka' ba〈snas pa byas bzhugs/ sngon yab rjes thugs brtse'i gzigs pa che ba dang / snu sa srid kyi mkhyen rgyu rica zhing ngang rgyud brtan pa dang / thugs bskyed bzang ba la brten nas tshe/ rgyan dbang phyug gis dga' ba bzang po'i rjes su spyi lo 1886 rab byung 15 me khyi lor sde srid kyi khrir mnga' gsol/ bkra shis chodas rdzong du tshe dpag med sku bzhengs pa dang /rig ma bcu dug gi rus rgyan dang / rtse sa chen gyi 'cham bo sa/ rgyal mtshan phye 'phur 'phan bla bre se gas rgya cher bzos gnang bar mdzad de rnam dkar gyi dge ba bsgrubs shing / dge 'dun gyi sde nang ya rabs dam pa'i mdzad bzang dmigs kyen mche ga tu gyur pa'i sde srid 'dis nad yams 'khrugs rtsod ming tsam med par bstan srid lo bco brgyad tsam legs par bskungs nas spyi lo 190lnga rab byung 15 chu yos lor sku zhi bar gathegags 31/sde srid khri rabs lnga bcu nga bdun pa'i lo rgyus ni/༄༄/ / sde srid khri rabs lnga bcu nga bdun pa zhabs dung gsung sprul phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi sku phreng lnga pa rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'am ye shes dngos tshib ni/ 'khrungs yul thum thang sde bzhi las stangs chu stod du spyi lo 1851 dang rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i ཿlcags phag mtsher nge mtshar ba'i ltas bcas 'khrungs/ sku na chung dus nas gzhung du 509

sku 'khrungs/ sku na gzhon dus nas dge 'dun gyi sder zhugs nas gar rig dbyungs sogs la rang byan tshud par byings nas dbyangs sle ba mdzad skabs/ 'jigs med rnam rgyal sde srid mdzad pa dang dus mtshungs pas sde srid kyi bka' ba〈snas pa byas bzhugs/ sngon yab rjes thugs brtse'i gzigs pa che ba dang / snu sa srid kyi mkhyen rgyu rica zhing ngang rgyud brtan pa dang / thugs bskyed bzang ba la brten nas tshe/ rgyan dbang phyug gis dga' ba bzang po'i rjes su spyi lo 1886 rab byung 15 me khyi lor sde srid kyi khrir mnga' gsol/ bkra shis chodas rdzong du tshe dpag med sku bzhengs pa dang /rig ma bcu dug gi rus rgyan dang / rtse sa chen gyi 'cham bo sa/ rgyal mtshan phye 'phur 'phan bla bre se gas rgya cher bzos gnang bar mdzad de rnam dkar gyi dge ba bsgrubs shing / dge 'dun gyi sde nang ya rabs dam pa'i mdzad bzang dmigs kyen mche ga tu gyur pa'i sde srid 'dis nad yams 'khrugs rtsod ming tsam med par bstan srid lo bco brgyad tsam legs par bskungs nas spyi lo 190lnga rab byung 15 chu yos lor sku zhi bar gathegags 31/sde srid khri rabs lnga bcu nga bdun pa'i lo rgyus ni/༄༄/ / sde srid khri rabs lnga bcu nga bdun pa zhabs dung gsung sprul phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi sku phreng lnga pa rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'am ye shes dngos tshib ni/ 'khrungs yul thum thang sde bzhi las stangs chu stod du spyi lo 1851 dang rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i ཿlcags phag mtsher nge mtshar ba'i ltas bcas 'khrungs/ sku na chung dus nas gzhung du 509

gdan dungs te gong ma'i gdan sa gsang chen chodas 'khor du khri mnga' gsol te 'dus sde chen por zhugs/ rje yon tan rgyal mtshan dang / yongs 'dzin ngag dbang don ldan sogs las mdo rgyud rig gnas dang bcas pa la byings pa mdzad de smin ༷ la gdams pas thugs rgyud gtams nas/ dkyil cerag gar rig dbyangs sku(gas gang la yang mkhas par byings/ sngon byings kyi 'phro yis phyag bzo'i 'du byed nas the ga la bcu gcig zhal bskadas pa serdzogs 'gran pa'i zla med par shu/ra/ gsang chen chodas 'khor gyi gdan sa la bskyed rdzogs rim gnyis kyi thugs dam la brtson te bzhugs/ sngon 'gro bzhi spyor chodas kyi 'khor lo bskor bas gdul bya rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ dgung grangs lnga bcu nga gsum la sde srid sangs rgyas rdo rje gshegs te spyi lo 190lnga rab byung 15 chu yos la sde srid kyi khrir mnga' gsol te chodas srid thung 'brel gyis bstan pa bskungs nas spu lo 1906 rab byung 15 me rta la sde srid kyi khri nas thugs 'gan spangs te gdan sa gsang chen chodas 'khor du byon/garsharshal du kun dga' ceras gling gi gdan sa bcags thugs sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan la gtad/ spyi lo 1915 rab byung 15 shing yos la mkhan po'i khrir mnga' gsol te bstan srid bskyungs/ skal ldan gyi gdul bya rnams la dpal ldan 'byug pa'i zab rgyas gdams pa'i khrid snga phyo bsdoms thengs bcu gsum chodas kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ni gsung sprul ye shes dnge sa grub ma gte gas gzhan ma khu/nga bar grags/ de ltar chodas srid lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa bskyungs nas dgung grangs grag cu re bdun me sprul spyi 'o/ 1917 la zhi bar gshegs/ 510

rtsa ba'i sa bcad lnga pa bstan pa phyis dar rgyal rabs kyi 'o/ rgyus/rgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po ma/ rgyan dbang phyug gi rigs rus kyi khungs brjod pa ni/༄༄ / / brgyud 'dzin chos gyi rgyal po o rgyan dbang phyug gi rigs rus kyi brgyud khungs ni/ de yang gnyos kyi gdung rabs nas gsal ba cadad gsal lha nas chad pa spyos sam gnyos bya thul dkar po nas rim par brgyud pa'i gdung las rgyal ba lha nang pa sangs rgyas ras chen nam gzi brjid dpal de las sman sbyodangs 'dir brgyud pa ma nyams / ciri mched pa sprul pa'i gter chen padma gling pa ni/ tshe'o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i padma thang yig las/ me 'bar mtsho la sbas pa'i gter la 'di/ / mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags 'di bstan nas 'byung / ma/ rgyan padma gling pa zhes bya 'byung / / zhes lung bstan pa bzhin kurne mkhyen chodas kyi rgyal po dri med 'od zer gyi sprul skru bum thang chodas 'khor lung pa chal zhes bya ba'i yul du yab gtos rigs don grub dang / yum padma sgrol ma/ gnyis gī sras su spyi lo 1450 rab byung brgyad pa'i lcags pho rta'i lo la skru 'khrungs/ nyi ma gsum bu chung la 'ja' 'khyil ba byung / sku gasnyadan nu nas shes bya'i ga nas thams cad gang yang ma bslabs par sde/gas kyis mkhyen rab kyi 〈snang batherdzol/spyi lo 1475 rab byung brgyad pa shing lug spre'u'i zla ba dgung lo 'ju la gu ru rin po che'i rnam 'phrul btsun pa gos ser gyon pa zhig gis gter gyi la byung 3/ga ril byin pa las/ la byang bzhin me 'bar mcho yod sar byon dun med du sku nga nas gos rnams phud de bskyur/ gcer bu mtsho'i nang mchodangs pas mtsho'i nang na bud med gos smug 511

rtsa ba'i sa bcad lnga pa bstan pa phyis dar rgyal rabs kyi 'o/ rgyus/rgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po ma/ rgyan dbang phyug gi rigs rus kyi khungs brjod pa ni/༄༄ / / brgyud 'dzin chos gyi rgyal po o rgyan dbang phyug gi rigs rus kyi brgyud khungs ni/ de yang gnyos kyi gdung rabs nas gsal ba cadad gsal lha nas chad pa spyos sam gnyos bya thul dkar po nas rim par brgyud pa'i gdung las rgyal ba lha nang pa sangs rgyas ras chen nam gzi brjid dpal de las sman sbyodangs 'dir brgyud pa ma nyams / ciri mched pa sprul pa'i gter chen padma gling pa ni/ tshe'o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i padma thang yig las/ me 'bar mtsho la sbas pa'i gter la 'di/ / mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags 'di bstan nas 'byung / ma/ rgyan padma gling pa zhes bya 'byung / / zhes lung bstan pa bzhin kurne mkhyen chodas kyi rgyal po dri med 'od zer gyi sprul skru bum thang chodas 'khor lung pa chal zhes bya ba'i yul du yab gtos rigs don grub dang / yum padma sgrol ma/ gnyis gī sras su spyi lo 1450 rab byung brgyad pa'i lcags pho rta'i lo la skru 'khrungs/ nyi ma gsum bu chung la 'ja' 'khyil ba byung / sku gasnyadan nu nas shes bya'i ga nas thams cad gang yang ma bslabs par sde/gas kyis mkhyen rab kyi 〈snang batherdzol/spyi lo 1475 rab byung brgyad pa shing lug spre'u'i zla ba dgung lo 'ju la gu ru rin po che'i rnam 'phrul btsun pa gos ser gyon pa zhig gis gter gyi la byung 3/ga ril byin pa las/ la byang bzhin me 'bar mcho yod sar byon dun med du sku nga nas gos rnams phud de bskyur/ gcer bu mtsho'i nang mchodangs pas mtsho'i nang na bud med gos smug 511

po gyon pa mig gcirge yod pa zhig gis/ gsang ba yang bcud 3/ga ser gyi sgam gtad/ slar ma3ro nas bya spru thus btab pa bzhin brag steng la slobs te gter dang po bzhes/ mi rnams kyis yid ma ches pas/ yang de'i rjes chodas 'khor dpon po thub pas khrom bsags te/ gter thon na bya dga' chen po ster/ ma thon na nga'i lung pa 'di zog pos 'gongs bas khrims la sgrol 'o/ zhes byas pas/ padma gling pa nyams 'ur te dpon po thub pa sogs mi mang po 'tshogs pa'i mdun nas phyag hu sgron me bsnams te nga bdud sprus yin na mcho 'di'i nang du 'chi bar gyur cig gu ru'i thugs sras yin na sgron me 'di yang mi shi ba rdeng / dgos pa'i nor lon te log par shog cig ces dmod sor nas mtsho la mchodangs pas/ mcho'i nang nas ston pa'i sku dang /thod pa la byir rdzas kyis bkang ba bcas bsnams nas sgron me yang ma shi bar mtsho'i nang nas byon khrom tshe gas kyi mi kun ha las par gyur pa se gas nge mtshar ba'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba'i sprul pa'i gter rje na rgyal po lnga'i ya gyal yab padma gling pas lung bstan pa bzhin ku re lung du byon mabo cung dang dung dkar du gzhis chags te sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan sku1gas rtse nga du 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi skabs su brjod pa bzhin las 'dir bskur ma dgos la/ de lta bu'i rigs brgyud phun sum chogs par sman /rdzongs bde bar spyong ba'i dpal mgon dam par bsam bzhin du sku ngas 'dzin ngag gi dbang phyug gi gdan sa bya dkar g.yul rgyal rdzong gi gzhol dbang 'dus chos gling gi pho brang du srid pa bzung bar nges so/ /512 ri

brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po dang pos lugs gnyis kyi chab srid ceras bzhin du bskungs tshul/ ༄༄ / / brgyud 'dzin rgyal po dang po tshadas rgyal skyod rgyan dbang phyug gi lo rgyus ni/rigs rus gī khungs gong du brjod pa bzhin las/ yab gong sa 'jigs med rnam rgyal dang yum che sa rtse dpon slob gtam zhing chodas rje e rgyan phun chogs kyi sras mo padma chos spyod kyi sras su sum thang chos 'bor dbang 'dus chos gling pho brang du dbyin lho 86 re rab byung 14 chu khyi lor sku 'khrungs/ skru na chung dus nas zhang po kun — bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma nas/ ma na tan gyi gzhi ma bri klog legs par byings/ spya lo 1870 rab byung 15 lcags rta dgung lo rdzo bzhes pa'i tsho yab sde srid kyi bka' bzhin yab kyis nyin smad gzi ma sgar dmang dang mnyam du sa las rdo las sku gas kun dang mthun par gnang bcug ste gasku/la chas kyang zhabs gasku ga dkyus ma'i gral du gnang ba de rang ma gtogs/ zur khrobs phran bu yum gyis gnang rung bkag ste sku ngal ha cang che/ snga dro dang dgong mo 'cham sgar pa'i gral du sgrig rgyugs te chodas rje 'byug pa'i sgrig lam rnam gzhag (pa bying ba mdzad bcug dgung 'o/ 1'a la lung bstan zam pa dang sa dmar rdzong la'i bar gyi lam sel gzim sgar dmang dang mnyam gnang ste si si shing mi khur gsum re nyin ltar 'thu dgos pa sogs dka' thub dug po spyod/spyi lo 1873 rab byung 15 chu bya dgung lo nya' la yab rje sde srid khri thog nas dgongs zhu mdzad de sde srid kyi khrir sku nu spyod tshal pa rdo rje rnam rgyal bskos yab sems rtegos khar bzhugs skabs dgung lo 17 spya lo 1878 rab byung 15 me stag la spa hro dpon 513

slob tshe dbang nor bus yab 'jigs med rnam rgyal la ngo rgol byed par brten/ sde srid dang yab spa spor dmag rgyab par gyon nas ltag rdzong thob ste rgyu dngos 'bor chen phyag hu 'byor ba'i skabs/ gzhung du dbang rdzong mgron gnyer a 'byug pas rdzong dpon ka wang sangs rgyas bkrongs te 'o rang dbang rdzong pa byas pa sogs phyogs mtha' dag nas nge 'o/ga rgyab mi mang bas/ 'jigs med rnam rgyal dang rim rdzong pa bla ma tshe dbang gnyis dbang rdzong phyogs gyon pa'i tshe ma rgyan dbang phyug dang phun tshogs rdo rje 'a spa gro lta/ga rdzong srung mi byas bzhag ste bzhugs pa na/ sprungs rdzong padangos tshig kyi g.yo 'phrul snyelas shal rnga pa dam che sa rin chen spa gror song 'ong ra'i tsha bo phan chogs rdo rje dang 'phrad pa yin zer ltag rdzong du 'dzul nas/ o rgyan dbang phyug dang phun chogs rdo rje gnyis 'dzin bzung gis rin rdzong ltag gling nang btson du btsugs bzhag skabs byed rab bgros pa nge ma dang shar 'byug rgyal gnyis kyis 'dre dang bu chung las btul zhes lab ste me mda' thengs gnyis rgyab rung skru sku(ga la nyes spyon ma byung 'dug de'i kyen las ltag rdzong nang gi phyag mjod yang chen bcu bdun dang khal chen bco brgyad ri ba'i rgyu dngos brlag stor shor ba'i nyen byung / sde srid spyid tshal pas dam chodas rin chen la khyod kyis sras ma/ rgyan dbang phyug bkrongs na yab 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyis khyod kyi mi tsa gtan brlag mdzad rgyu'i nyen la cadang / de bas yab barsharshangs na dug ces gsungs/ spa 〈sna'i gtam de gsan ma thag yab 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyis/ dam cesas rin chen khyim nas shes rab rgyal mo serdzogs mi tsa nya' me mda' sgang du bcesan du bzung nas mi nya' dang gcig 'dam la rgyab ces bka' 31ga gnang ba dam ceras rin chen gyi lag hu 'byor bas sras 61 rgyan dbang phyug 514

sde srid spyod tshal pa'i phyag hu phul bas mi nya' kyang btang gnang 'dug de nas yab 'jigs med rnam rgyal kyis rdzong gzhis rnams the ba ste sku gcen phrin las ste/bas rgyas da bang 'dus pho brang rdzong dpon bskos/ o rgyan dbang phyug dgung grangs 17 spya lo 1878 rab byung 15 sa stag lor spa spo dpon slob khri mnga' gsol te bzhugs pa na/sprungs rdzong pa dngos grub sngar bros bzur gyis rgya phyogs su sdod pa slar rngo rgol byung bar dmag rgyab ste nyin gas/ma nas pham ste slar dpag bsam la khyodags thesas skutsheng ba'i lam bar du spongs 'dug de nas dgung grangs 'ab rab byung 15pa lcags sgrul spyi lo 188nya la yab gsang zab rdzong du zhi bar gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs rgya chen po bsgrubs/ dar dkar du dpon sa ba bsam gtan rdo rje bskos gnang ba de gnyer chen bya mo ser pos bkrongs nas bo rang bros te rta 'o/ga rje zhabs dung 'jigs med chos rgyal gyi zhabs sar snge da 'dug sngar yab rje'i kro dgra bka' rtse na a zhang wang rgya phyogs bros se nga ba yang yab rje'i sku tshigs ma thal gong rim phu bkra shis chodas rdzong du 'dzul 'ong skabs yab kyi gzim sgar tsho ma rangs par brel zings chen po langs rung ya nga bag tsha ga61 'gul med par bzhugs pas sde srid bla ma tshe dbang yang thugs rangs te spa gro dpon slob e rgyan dbang phyug la mgo gtad mdzad de bo rang gi bu mo kru grong sgrol ma dpon slob kyi lcam la phul 'dug / spyi 'o/ 188'a rab byung 15 chu pho rta dgung grangs 'a1 bzhes pa na bum thang du sngar khu bo chos rtse dpon slob dung dkar pa rgyal mtshan dang bya dkar rdzong dpon zhang po padma bstan 'dzin gnyis nang 'khrugs skabs padma bstan 'dzin rgyal na maX na gso pa seng ge rnam rgyal mgron gnyer bsko rgyu'i zhal bzhes mdzad de mdo na gasku pa 515

seng ge rnam rgyal gyis dmag 'gan 'bag ste rgyab nas rgyal la ༄snab tshar dus ceras rtse mgron gnyer padma bstan 'dzin rang gi lcam chung ba'i spun u rug pa padma bkra shis bsgos pa la seng ge rnam rgyal ma rangs par sdod pa'i skabs/ blam dpal ri rdzong rgyab dus las rgyab pa maX na gnyer padma bkra shis baṇḍa sa pa la the ha cang gdug rtsub che bas las byed pa sgar sto rnams kyis ngo rgol byas pa la spos dpon rtsad bcad pa na 'ong gnyis yin pa las padma bstan 'dzin gyis chu smad pa dbang rgyal dang / mang sde pa don tshib gnyis dgongs phog bton 'dug 'ong gnyis gzhung du 'ong ba dang seng ge rnam rgyal thum thang du 'o/nga ba thu li spang du 'phrad pa las 'ong gsum der nang nas padma bstan 'dzin bkrongs rgyu'i bsnyun spos byas nas sum thang bya dkar du song nas seng ge rnam rgyal gyis lo nga gnyis padma bstan 'dzin gyi phyag dbang la btsugs nas 'ong 3 la bsgrigs te zhang po padma bstan 'dzin ñdzu lo 188'a rab byung )5 chu pho rta lo zla 6 pa'i tshes 15la mtshan sgang sku rtsed la yongs bcug ste snga dro su yang ma longs gong gzim khang nang 'dzul te bkrongs nas mgron gso pa seng ge rnam rgyal rtseras rtse dpon slob kyi rgyab la'i steng 'dzegs nas sum thang sde bzhi'i mi ser la seng go rnam rgyal chodas rtse dpo na slob byas pa'i dga' ston lo gcig tsa khral dang shing khral tsam ma gte gas khral gzhan thams cad dase ngas yangs kyi bka' rsātherdzotsā bkram 'dug de nas dbang 'dus chodas gling nas padma bstan 'dzin gyi sring mo yum padma che sa spyod kyis spa spor skyed rgyan dbang phyug gi zhabs sar bang chen pa btang nas spa gre dathe na 〈snab nub shur rgyab ste dbang gling du phebs pa'i lo rgyus gcig dang sngar nas yul skor la dbang gling du byon nas bzhugs yod pa'i lo rgyus gnyis 'dug gang ltar de nas 516

yum dang thabs mkhas kyi gsung spos mdzad de yum padma cerdzos spyid seng ge rnam rgyal rtsar byon nas dbang gling gzhis dang sras mo chodas sgron bcas kyi spyod sdug khyod rang la ma gtogs gzhan la re ba med/ padma bstan 'dzin gshegs mi'i thad 'ong ra'i mdzad spyod nyes pa las se nga ba yin pas ma dga' ba med ces gsungs pa na seng ge rnam rgyal yid ma ches par de ltar zer ba'i gtam bden pa yin na mna' za dgos zhes zer ba na padma ཿrdzos spyid kyis dbu mna' bzhes pa las seng ge rnam rgyal yid ches shing bslus te/ zla ba de'i mar ngo gnam sgang seng ge rnam rgyal gyi gshed gza'i nyi ma la byu dkar ltag rdzong nang seng ge rnam rgyal bkrong rgyu'i grabs bsgrigs byas te spa gro dpon slob ma rgyan dbang phyug dang seng ge rnam rgyal rgyab la gcig gi steng seng go rnam rgyal gyi lag pa g.yas pa'i khyodags 61 rgyan dbang khu/ga bzhugs te zhal 'jongam gnang sar lag dmar pa shal rnga pa mgo ser dang rim rdzong pa kun bzang phrin las rta dpon spang gshong pa gsol dzar grol nas chang sho zer ba'i skad gyi bde dang sgrig te 'ong gsum nang du 'dzul ba na seng ge rnam rgyal gyis ku gsod 'dus po zhes yar langs pa na skye'o rgyan dbang 〈snag gis seng ge rnam rgyal gyi lag pa g.yas pa'i bo sa kyi lag maserdzo phyag gasku1na pas mnan te phyag g.yas pas rtseb sa mchan 'o1gas g.yas pa nas btsugs ma thag rim rdzong pas thog mar gri rgyab pa'i steng mgo ser gyis gri rgyab ste yud tsam la seng ge rnam rgyal bsgul nas/ de bzhin phyo khar chu smad pa dbang rgyal dang mang sde pa don grub gnyis kyang bsad de don snying mchan zhabs nas bton nas zhang po lha lung gsung sprul bstan pa'i nyi ma la phyal nas lcam mkhar zam gyi 'gram du mchod rten 'og hu dgra sri mnan te phyin chad sku dgra rtsad nas chod pa'i rten 517

byen dmag da sung dpa' rtsal pa chos gzhu 'bar ba bsrergags lag pa 'thud de gtsang chu brgal te gtsang po'i tshur ngos sle ke thang du bzhag la shas 'dzom brag mgo'i lung chung nang bzhag skyod rgyan dbang phyug rang dasung ga mgo byings 'khrid de me mda' sgang du gyon pa'i tshe/ gzhung las srongs rdzong pa dang thim rdzong pa'i dmag rnams kyang thon nas sprungs thang 'dzom phar kha'i nor khyim rgyab la dmag lan gcig 'dzings te rdzo 4 gi mi gnyig bsad de gnyig rmas skyon byung / de nas byi li sgang du dmag thengs gcig 'dzings skabs gzhung gi phyogs mi bzhi tsam bsad de dpon slob ma rgyan dbang phyug la ma thub par gzhung dmag bkra shis ceras rdzong la 'o/ga 61 rgyan dbang khu/ga gi dmag dasung thim phya klu grong sgang nas mar thon pa dang / a lo rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis ri la me spar te lam bkag pas/ phyir log rgyab gsang zab rdzong du byon/ der a lo rdo rjes kyibs khra oṃ gling zla ba dang gling bzhi pa rdo rje sogs rdzong srung par bzhag pa rnams cham la phab ste rdzong der chodas rtse dpon slob skyo/ rgyan dbang phyug gi dmag sgar chags/ de nas cang lung bstan phyar dmag thengs gcig 'dzings skabs/gzhung rta dpon hor phrug zer ba zhig dang / zi lu la pad cung gis/ da res dpal gyi nyi ma la/ / krong gsar dpon sle ba mgo lag de/ / nga dpa' bo'i lag tu ma khug na/ /hor phrug zer ba don re chung / /zer nas ngar skad rgyab pa'i tshe/ / dmag mi nyung shas shig 'ur langs te/ zi lu la pad cung dang bong gnyis dus mnyam maḥtshengs pa dang / gyang 'og nang nas tshur chodas rtse dpon slob skyod rgyan dbang phyug phyogs dar 'bag mi de gis dkrogs mda' rgyab ste bong gnyis dus gcig hu bsad skabs/ bong tsho'i phyogs kyi dmag mi gzhan rnams thams cad bya phung la rdo phog pa bzhin yud tsam 523

byen dmag da sung dpa' rtsal pa chos gzhu 'bar ba bsrergags lag pa 'thud de gtsang chu brgal te gtsang po'i tshur ngos sle ke thang du bzhag la shas 'dzom brag mgo'i lung chung nang bzhag skyod rgyan dbang phyug rang dasung ga mgo byings 'khrid de me mda' sgang du gyon pa'i tshe/ gzhung las srongs rdzong pa dang thim rdzong pa'i dmag rnams kyang thon nas sprungs thang 'dzom phar kha'i nor khyim rgyab la dmag lan gcig 'dzings te rdzo 4 gi mi gnyig bsad de gnyig rmas skyon byung / de nas byi li sgang du dmag thengs gcig 'dzings skabs gzhung gi phyogs mi bzhi tsam bsad de dpon slob ma rgyan dbang phyug la ma thub par gzhung dmag bkra shis ceras rdzong la 'o/ga 61 rgyan dbang khu/ga gi dmag dasung thim phya klu grong sgang nas mar thon pa dang / a lo rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis ri la me spar te lam bkag pas/ phyir log rgyab gsang zab rdzong du byon/ der a lo rdo rjes kyibs khra oṃ gling zla ba dang gling bzhi pa rdo rje sogs rdzong srung par bzhag pa rnams cham la phab ste rdzong der chodas rtse dpon slob skyo/ rgyan dbang phyug gi dmag sgar chags/ de nas cang lung bstan phyar dmag thengs gcig 'dzings skabs/gzhung rta dpon hor phrug zer ba zhig dang / zi lu la pad cung gis/ da res dpal gyi nyi ma la/ / krong gsar dpon sle ba mgo lag de/ / nga dpa' bo'i lag tu ma khug na/ /hor phrug zer ba don re chung / /zer nas ngar skad rgyab pa'i tshe/ / dmag mi nyung shas shig 'ur langs te/ zi lu la pad cung dang bong gnyis dus mnyam maḥtshengs pa dang / gyang 'og nang nas tshur chodas rtse dpon slob skyod rgyan dbang phyug phyogs dar 'bag mi de gis dkrogs mda' rgyab ste bong gnyis dus gcig hu bsad skabs/ bong tsho'i phyogs kyi dmag mi gzhan rnams thams cad bya phung la rdo phog pa bzhin yud tsam 523

la bros/ de rje mkhan po ngag dbang don ldan dang dge 'dun dmang nas zhal 'dzom mdzad par gsungs pa las zhal bzhes mdzad de/ nangs par ceras rtse pa'i sku tshab rin spyo zla ba dpal 'byor dang / thim rdzong pa'i tshab tu spungs rdzong pa phun tshogs rdo rje dpon g.yog rnams lcang gling ma'i thang gi sa 'gyar zhig yod pa der zhal 'dzom gnang par gyon skabs/ sprungs rdzong pa'i chibs gas chu bar chu'i rdo zam du slobs tsho 'gro ma btub pa na/ bya rogs chos nga rang dpon gakre ga tsho la rten 'brel ma legs slar log 'gro na dug zer lab rung / nga ma shi bar lto lung pa'i brel ba mi rdzogs zer ma nyan par gyon nas zhal 'dzom mdzad/ gsang zab nas cerdzos rtse pas gsol 'dzar rgyas par bsgrigs te dungs nas ceras rtse pa'i maspon gnyer ma/ rgyan rdo rjes gri bton tshe bkab zhe la thogs sdod pa'i bar/ rin spyi zla ba dpal 'byor gyis gri rgyab thengs gcig gis dbu gnyis su bkas te thim rdzong pa phran tshogs rdo rje bkrongs 'dugami rje 61 rgyan dbang phyug sku 'khor nas gling sgar 'dam dar zho'i thog bzhugs pa la spungs rdzong 'ongs gtogs rnams kyis rgol du byung pa la dmag 'cham gnang nas mi lnga dug tsam lnga lam du btang ste srongs rje nga pa 'a'e ra bcas cham la phab zin pa na/thim rdzong pa a lo rdo rje dang gong gzim rta mgrin dngos grub/ a rgas dam chos rin chen/ mgar rdzong pa spru so la/ ka wang rdo rje 'khor bcas rdzong gzhis spangs te go la bros song 'dug pa'i tshul ni/dme rdoge'i rnam smin spyi mthun las dbang gis/ / chags sdang 'khrugs zings rba klong cher langs te/ / rang dang snying nas mdza' ba'i snang mthun spogs/ / srongs 'a04 rje bstan 'dzin lhun grub kyi rnam thar so gnyis mdun nas/524

rdzong phun tshogs lnga pa'i lam du thal/ /thim rdzong rdo rje rang 'khor bcas pa rnams/ /dbang med bod lams zhing du se nga ba'i shul/ / zhes gsal/de skabs spungs thang du zhabs dung 'jigs med chodas rgyal phyag chen nā ro chodas dug khrid gnang ba'i sgang yin 'dug sma chos phyag chen nā ro chos grag sogs/ / so so'i 'dod mos bzhin du stsol ba'i dus/ / gzhung dang shar nub 'dzin pa'i rgyal blon rnams/ / dug lnga'i las kyi 'bras bu dus kyis 'ded/ / nga mtho nga che zhe sdang me ltar 'bar/ / phan tshun 'gran sems phrag dog rlung bzhin 'tshub/ / nga rgyal dregs pa'i dug chus rab myos nas/ / lto rdzongs bde spyod 'dzoms pa'i rgyal lab 'de/ /lan gcig lha min grong khyer dngos su gyur/ /nyid kyang rgyal khab sgrul tshang lta bu'i nang / / chags sdang du ba 'khrugs pas spyan dku nas/ / ba〈snas bcas rnams la khrid kyi mthug bsdu zhing / / gsang gling rig 'dzin dga' ba'i tshal du phebs/ /zhes dang / de nas 'byung bzhi tshad pa'i spyin thang gis/ / lus kyi lo thog bcom la nye ba'i skabs/ / phyogs kyi rgyal blon 'khor dang bcas pa yang / / dmag mthug thim yul phyogs su bsdu bar phebs/ /de nang mda' mdung ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor bskor/ / me mda'i 'ur sgras nyin mtshan 'da' ba'i rjes/ / spyi bla brgya byin e rgyan dbang phyug nyid/ / sku bsod nyin byed shar ri'i rtser mdzes shing / / zhabs 'degs blon 'bangs padmo 'dzum bzhin du/ / bden tshig bslu ba med pa'i mthu nus kyis/ / pha rol dgra sde'i g.yul las rnam rgyal te/ / khyodags las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ / dmag 'grags ma〉pyon gi bskal pa rgyun chad shu/ra/ / zhes ga༄/ngas 'dug/'a05 zhabs drung 'jigs med cesas rgyal gyi rnam thar se lnga'i rgyab nas/ 525

rdzong phun tshogs lnga pa'i lam du thal/ /thim rdzong rdo rje rang 'khor bcas pa rnams/ /dbang med bod lams zhing du se nga ba'i shul/ / zhes gsal/de skabs spungs thang du zhabs dung 'jigs med chodas rgyal phyag chen nā ro chodas dug khrid gnang ba'i sgang yin 'dug sma chos phyag chen nā ro chos grag sogs/ / so so'i 'dod mos bzhin du stsol ba'i dus/ / gzhung dang shar nub 'dzin pa'i rgyal blon rnams/ / dug lnga'i las kyi 'bras bu dus kyis 'ded/ / nga mtho nga che zhe sdang me ltar 'bar/ / phan tshun 'gran sems phrag dog rlung bzhin 'tshub/ / nga rgyal dregs pa'i dug chus rab myos nas/ / lto rdzongs bde spyod 'dzoms pa'i rgyal lab 'de/ /lan gcig lha min grong khyer dngos su gyur/ /nyid kyang rgyal khab sgrul tshang lta bu'i nang / / chags sdang du ba 'khrugs pas spyan dku nas/ / ba〈snas bcas rnams la khrid kyi mthug bsdu zhing / / gsang gling rig 'dzin dga' ba'i tshal du phebs/ /zhes dang / de nas 'byung bzhi tshad pa'i spyin thang gis/ / lus kyi lo thog bcom la nye ba'i skabs/ / phyogs kyi rgyal blon 'khor dang bcas pa yang / / dmag mthug thim yul phyogs su bsdu bar phebs/ /de nang mda' mdung ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor bskor/ / me mda'i 'ur sgras nyin mtshan 'da' ba'i rjes/ / spyi bla brgya byin e rgyan dbang phyug nyid/ / sku bsod nyin byed shar ri'i rtser mdzes shing / / zhabs 'degs blon 'bangs padmo 'dzum bzhin du/ / bden tshig bslu ba med pa'i mthu nus kyis/ / pha rol dgra sde'i g.yul las rnam rgyal te/ / khyodags las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ / dmag 'grags ma〉pyon gi bskal pa rgyun chad shu/ra/ / zhes ga༄/ngas 'dug/'a05 zhabs drung 'jigs med cesas rgyal gyi rnam thar se lnga'i rgyab nas/ 525

de nas krong gsar dpon slob skyod rgyan dbang phyug 'khor bcas kyis lcang gling ma'i thang du rang phyogs pa rnams gral ring po gnyis su yar langs te bsgrigs nas lag par me mda'/ dkrerdzogs mda'/ mdung / mda' gzhu/ gi ling / dpa' rtags sogs mtshon cha lag cha'i rigs yod tshad bsnol te 'phred du bzung ba'i 'og tu phun tshogs rdo rje dang / a lo rdo rje'i bongs gtogs kyi dpa' tsal pa dmag mi yod rigs rnams gral mthug nas yar tsar 'dzul 'jug cing (gi dbang ) zhes pa dgra dbang thang klung rta chag rgyu'i rten 'brel du zhur bcug pa'i lo rgyus 'di yang de skabs gral bsgrigs pa'i 'ongs su yod pa mes mes padma bstan 'dzin gyis dngos su mig thong lag zin yin par bshad pa thos pa lags/ de nas thim phu bkra shis ceras rdzong rtsis bzhes/ sde srid dga' ba bzang nge khrir bzhugs kyang legs nyes kyi 'gan khur gang yang med bsnyun dpon slob ma rgyan dbang phyug nas sngar srol gang yin gyi gsol therdzogs zab rgyas phul nas macerdzo sde brag hu zur bzhugs mdzad/ de nas 'byug rgyal khab 〉la po 6/ rgyan dbang phyug gi mnga' cadag hu bsgyur na yang dgung 'o/ nyer bzhi las ma bzhes pas yab 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi bka' gre sa pa cheras srid kyi mkhyen sku na ldan pa thugs bskyed bzang zhing ngang rgyud brtan pa dbyangs slob spang pa sangs rgyas rdo rje de nyid spyi lo 1856 rab byung 15 me khyi lor sde srid kyi khrir mnga' gsol nas tho rgyan dbang phyug rang nyid krong sar dpon slob dang gong gzim gyi go sar bzhugs/ khu rngo dung dkar pa rgyal mtshan gyi sras ces rgyan dbang khu/ga rang gi sku mched lhun rtse pa kun bzang phrin las spyi lo 1886 rab byung 15 me khyi lo zla 3 pa'i nang thim phu rdzong dpon bskos/ dus de nas bzung lto rdzongs 'dir nang zings ngo rgol dmag 526

'khrugs kyi yo lang 'joms shing zhi nas shar nub kyi phyogs kun tu bde 'jags su gnas pa khu/nga 'dug/ de nas 61 rgyan dbang phyug bum thang du gyon skabs shar bsam gtan sgang nas gzim sgar pa drug phun tshogs rdo rje'i khyim gzhi 'phyag cing am bde chen bzang mo bcas thum thang du 'khrid 31ga ces btang ba la/ gzim sgar pa dug bde chen bzang mo'i khyim du 'byor ba dang ja chang bza' btung longs spyod legs par bsgrigs te g.yog mo dug mo rang gi tsha mor bzos nas ja chang dungs shing zhag bdun phrag gcig ngal bse gnang dgos zhes zhu ba phyal nas g.ye ga mo dug pos nyin mo glu gar zhabs bro btang bcug mtshan smad gzim sgar dug pe la gaskusnag mo dug mnyam du nyal bcug pas spro ston te gzim sgar grag po mo'i 'phrul 'bor gyis sems yengs pa'i bar mo rang gi g.yog po rnams la bkod rgyab ste nang rten 'gang chen dang khro zangs sogs sa 'og tu sbus shing / gzhan ma'o dgos rnams gam ga po rnams la dos cha rgyab nas bod du btang ba ma zad gaskutsheg smad thu tsha can zhig gi bu tsha 'dir bzhag nas mo rang gi bu tsha don grub de g.yog mo'i lag par spyod de phag rir btang 'dug mo rang yang ngal bso bdun phrag gcig nangs par tshang rgyu'i da ring phyi dror tshar gyi dos khyung nang 'dzul te phyi nas thi'u rgyab cing nang gi snying nye ba'i g.yog po gnyis kyis spungs thang nas thim phug spa spo has brgyud de bod du song 'dug yo lo rdo rje dang kho rang gi nu bo gong gzim rta mgrin dngos grub/ dam chodas rin chen dang tsha bo spru so la/ bka' blon ngag dbang shes rab de khar gnya' rgod bzhi bcas 'ong rnams dang bde chen bzang mo bcas phag rir 'dzoms nas bod du dmag rgyab 'tshol bar song 'dug sa lo rdo 527

rje nas thog mar bod kyi rgyal tshab kun bde gling pa rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan la mgo gtad de g.yo khram zhu spyor gyis bod dmag gtang grabs byed par rgyal tshab de nyid blo thur du sku gshegs pa las lus 'dug pa de ni dpal ldan 'byug pa'i chodas spyong gi mthu nus kyis yin par sems/de nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu spyi lo 1890 lcags stag lor snya lung du zhang po pad gling brgyad pa kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrub rgyu sogs mdzad phyir lha lung du gyon nas mdzad sgo rnams gang yang tshang ma mdzad de lha lung grwa tshang du mchod rdzas se gas legs par bsgrubs te phyal/ de skabs 'jam ma gon rnam gnyis kyi zhal slob lo chen bai ro tsa na'i sprul pa rig 'dzin khams gsum yongs grol mjal 'phrad byung zhing pad gling brgyad pa'i sku gdung mchod rten serdzogs phyag bstar gyis bzhengs par mdzad gnang / rig 'dzin khams gsum skusnangs grol la 'jam mgon rnam gnyis kyis bum thang sku rjes su gu ru snang srid zil gnon gyi sku da lta 'byug rgyal khab nang de las che ba med pa zhig la mcherag gling thugs sgrub bsam nga/ lhun grub lha tshogs gyis bskor ba zhal shar du gzigs pa zhig bzhengs grub na chab srid brtan cing mnga' thang dar rgyas cadang bar lung bstan yod pa rnams zhus pa las/ spyi lo 1894 rab byung 15 shing rta lo dgung grangs 33 thog 'byug rgyal khab kṣe skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi zhing gu ru snang srid zil gnon sum thog ma bsam pa lhun tshib lha tshogs kyis bskor ba bzhengs grub ste rab gnas kyi dga' ston nyin bdun gyi bar rig 'dzin lams gsum yongs grol gyis gnang nas bzo rig pa rnams la gnang byin gyis yid tshims par mdzad/ spyo lo 1897 me bya lo la re zhig 528

sku gshegs la thug par bsnyungs pa na gzhung nas srid pa spyi mdos dang rig 'dzin lams gsum sku1ngas ༷ la gyis sde brgyad khengs mtherdzos skusnags stakyi rim zhabs brtan gnad smin rgya chen po 'phral du bsgrubs te mi rje nyid snyun las grol kyang lcam rin chen padma snyun gyis zin/ spyi lo 1897 rab byung 15 me bya lo de la snyo rdzongs bstan 'gro spyi'i las snang gis sa g.yos chen po byung nas bkra shis chodas rdzong / dbang rdzong dar dkar rdzong rlos rtse rdzong bya dkar rdzong rnams zhig ral skyon chen po byung ba las rdzong bag so so'i rdzong dpon rnams la zhig gso sngar las mi dman pa rten dang brten par bcas pa sra brtan du bzhengs dbo sa par bka' bkod zhib rgyas stsal zhing ceras 'khor rab brtan rtse dang lhag par bya dkar g.yul rgyal rdzong zhig ral chen po byung ba mi rje rang nyid kyis thugs 'khur bzhes te gzhi nas gsar bzhengs rten dang brten par bcas pa sngar las lhag par mi ring bar sra brtan du bsgrubs par mdzad de rig 'dzin lams gsum sku ngas ༷ la gyis rab gnas kyi dga' snyedan rgyas par mdzad/ lcam rin chen padma sman dpyad rim spo gang gis kyang ma phan par yun ring bsnyungs nas spyi lo 1900 lcags byi lor sku gshegs nas dgongs rdzogs rgyas par bsgrubs gnang bar mjordod/dus de tsam na ka sprungs su 'byug pa dkar ji e rgyan rdo rje zer mi tshong rgyab ste sdod pa de zhabs grang 'jigs med chodas rgyal gyi sku mdun du bcar te dbang khrid zhus nas gser dngul sku sa dar sku gas 'bul dnge sa rgya chen po phul ba'i gtam skyod rgyan dbang phyug gis gsan nas skye/ rgyan rdo rje zhabs sar cadang dgos pa'i bka' 31ga gnang ba ltar/ bo pa ma rgyan rdo rje bum thang du thon nas ma rgyan dbang phyug gi sku 529

mdun phyag dbang bcar ba na spyan gyis gzigs pa'i mod la shin tu dgyes shing thugs snang gshin pa'i gsung gros nyin mtshan phyad par sran pa rme da par mdzad/ o rgyan dbang phyug gis khyod kyi pha ma'i brgyud khungs gang nas yin gsungs/ 61 rgyan rdo rjes ma rigs spa khro btsan stong pa yin la/ pha rigs gdung dkar che sa rje dpa' la rgyal mtshan thu zur pa rdzong bgres shar pa spun cung zer ba de yin zhus pas/ de ltar na nged rang gnyis pha spun gyi thu tsha yin nges 'dug ces gsungs te 'bral mi phed par thugs rtsis che bar mdzad pa nas bzung ma rgyan dbang phyug dang skyod rgyan rdo rje gnyis gyi la gong ma dpon g.yog dang nang du snying nye ba'i skrun mched kyi mdza' ba cung zad kyang mi snyod pa'i dam tshig dpang du btsugs te phyag phyo rnam dag zhu ba'i skabs/a 'o/ rdo rjes bod kshi rgyal tshab gshegs/ rjes rgya mi am bha dang bka' blon bla ma la mgo gtad de dbyen spyor gyis slar 'grag yul du dmag 'khrug 'byung nye ba'i tsho/skyod rgyan rdo rjes lha sar song nas 'ong tsho dang mthun lam byas nas lo rgyus legs par bshad de chings sgrig rgyur bzos pa bzhin rgya mi sku tshab gnyis dang rtse mgyon pha rir 'ongs/ 'di nas rin spye zla ba dpal 'byor dang gzhung mgron tsho dbang dpal 'byor btang nas lam gong / has rdzong / gdung nag/ mgar sa rdzong / gling bzhi rdzong bcas a lo rdo rje sogs 'ong lnga la sprod de khri bsgrigs te khral rigs snga ma'i lam lugs 'gal med len te 〉snang rnams spyad byedag pa tsam las/ gzhan rnams 'byug gzhung nas rang bdag ma zad/ 'artse dpe na nas khrim 'gal shar yang 'byug gzhung nas khrims gcad che ga pa'i la tshig chodad zin pa'i chings yig bzos nas a lo rdo rje la gdung nag nu bo gong gzim rta mgrin dngos grub la has/ dam chodas rin chen 530

wa mgar sa/ ka wang rdo rje la gling bzhi/ bka' blon ngag dbang shes rab la lam rgong spyod/ a lo rdo rje thu phrug dang bcas sod gzhung la rgyab rten bzung nas gro mor sdod pa'i skabs/ 'byug gzhung du phyos su yang nyen la mi 'byung phyir bde chen bzang rmo'i nu rgo tshe dbang sogs ka srongs su gong gzim e rgyan rdo rjes thabs kyis bdag 'dzin byed nas nang gi lde mig tshe dbang lag par spyod de dbang tshad ldan par bzhag nas bsdad 'asdokyig/rje mtshams su sngar gyi sku tshab rgya dung rnams rgya 'byug rgyal khab gnyis kyi b.radakrugs shing phung krol byas kyen gyis rgya 'byug gnyis dmag 'khrugs yang yang byung nas rgya gzhis rnams sgo ra 'dug cing der sku tshab mi rgyud bzang zhing dung po zhig bsko bzhag gnang dasku sa pa shin hu gal che bar 'dug brten/ skyersha rgyan dbang khu/ga gi krugs la dkar ji ma rgyan rdo rje ka spungs su yun ring bsdad pas phyo gling pa'i skad mig shes shing de tsho'i lam lugs kyang shes pa dang / ngang rgyud brtan cing kun dang masga lam legs spyor la brtsodan mi yin 'dug dgongs te snyo mtshams su dpag bsam ba sogs rgya 'grag sa mtshams su sku tshab rtse gnas kyi bka' 31ga 'di ltar gnang 'dug( shar am mar ta la nas nub dar dkar tshun gyi sa mtshams sngerdzon ma'i sa ma tshams ltar ma da med sku tshab kyis lta zhib byed rgyu/ nai pa li'i khral mi btsugs ni dang de tsho'i mgo bdag sku tshab rang nas bskos te khral 'bul lo ltar che sa zhabs su phrul rgyu ma gte gas de la gzhan gyis ra / skud sna tsam yang bkal mi byedag tshog ma zad/bral mi btsugs ni de yang skru tshab rang gis ma gtosas gzhan gyis mi zil gcig kyang 531

btsugs mi cherag sa mtshams yar mar ku jag dang snangang pa rnams la dbang shes /nga rigs kyang sku tshab nas bdag 'dzin byed rgyu'i khar/ rtse rang nas bzung a mar ta la'i bar sdod mi tsho la dbang rdzong sogs rdzong bdag sus kyang mu ri bha lha spu sprod se gas che phra sus kyang byed mi cerdzog sku tshab 61 rgyan nas kyang zhabs dung rin po che'i bstan srid la phan pa dang gong sa'i zhabs 'degs 'byor pa byung na ji srid nam gnas bar pha brgyud bus 'dzin byed rgyu dang bstan srid la phan med dang zhabs tog 'byor min se gas shar na bka' sgo/ga de rang slar 'o/ga bzhes pa nas rtsis brdar zhabs/ nas mdzad rgyu/ ) zhes pa'i bka' 31ga la zhabs dung rin pe che'i phyag tham/sde srid kyi phyag tham/ chodas rtse pa'i phyag tham/ dbang rdzong pa'i phyag tham gyis mnan pa bcas spyi lo 1900 rab byung 15 lcags byi lo zla 8 tshes 15 la gnang 'dug/de sngar btsun smad rin chen padma gshegs lar rgyal rgyud 'dzin pa'i btsun dro/bzhes dasku sa par zhal chems gsungs yod pa bzhin dge bshes smin dug gis kyang yang yang zhus pa las lhun rdzong pa kun bzang phrin las dang khol ma phyug po'i su mo tshe dbang lha mo gnyis kyi sras mo brtson 'grus lha mo thud med kyi mtshan dang ldan pa de nyid spyi lo 1901 rab byung 15 glang lo la mi rje rang gi dbu bla sbas yul rin po che sku zhabs khrin las kyis tshe sgrub tshad ldan bsgrubs pa'i tsho ril tshe chang mi gzhan gyi lag ma brgyud —par brtsodan 'grus lha mo gos rgyan gyis spras te ma/ rgyan dbang phyug gi sku mdun du tshes grangs gza' skar bzang po dang bsnyu na te 'thul bar bcar tshe/ ming pra legs pa bka' spos pa tshe ring che sa ldan zhes pa de yis lag par dar mdzod bzung nas gzim dpon gyi tshab byed de ngag nas/ rgyal mche ga khyod ni srong btsan sgam po yin/ / blo/532

btsugs mi cherag sa mtshams yar mar ku jag dang snangang pa rnams la dbang shes /nga rigs kyang sku tshab nas bdag 'dzin byed rgyu'i khar/ rtse rang nas bzung a mar ta la'i bar sdod mi tsho la dbang rdzong sogs rdzong bdag sus kyang mu ri bha lha spu sprod se gas che phra sus kyang byed mi cerdzog sku tshab 61 rgyan nas kyang zhabs dung rin po che'i bstan srid la phan pa dang gong sa'i zhabs 'degs 'byor pa byung na ji srid nam gnas bar pha brgyud bus 'dzin byed rgyu dang bstan srid la phan med dang zhabs tog 'byor min se gas shar na bka' sgo/ga de rang slar 'o/ga bzhes pa nas rtsis brdar zhabs/ nas mdzad rgyu/ ) zhes pa'i bka' 31ga la zhabs dung rin pe che'i phyag tham/sde srid kyi phyag tham/ chodas rtse pa'i phyag tham/ dbang rdzong pa'i phyag tham gyis mnan pa bcas spyi lo 1900 rab byung 15 lcags byi lo zla 8 tshes 15 la gnang 'dug/de sngar btsun smad rin chen padma gshegs lar rgyal rgyud 'dzin pa'i btsun dro/bzhes dasku sa par zhal chems gsungs yod pa bzhin dge bshes smin dug gis kyang yang yang zhus pa las lhun rdzong pa kun bzang phrin las dang khol ma phyug po'i su mo tshe dbang lha mo gnyis kyi sras mo brtson 'grus lha mo thud med kyi mtshan dang ldan pa de nyid spyi lo 1901 rab byung 15 glang lo la mi rje rang gi dbu bla sbas yul rin po che sku zhabs khrin las kyis tshe sgrub tshad ldan bsgrubs pa'i tsho ril tshe chang mi gzhan gyi lag ma brgyud —par brtsodan 'grus lha mo gos rgyan gyis spras te ma/ rgyan dbang phyug gi sku mdun du tshes grangs gza' skar bzang po dang bsnyu na te 'thul bar bcar tshe/ ming pra legs pa bka' spos pa tshe ring che sa ldan zhes pa de yis lag par dar mdzod bzung nas gzim dpon gyi tshab byed de ngag nas/ rgyal mche ga khyod ni srong btsan sgam po yin/ / blo/532

po nga ni mgar ba stong btsan yin/ / a ñtsa 'di ni rgya bza'i sprul pa yin/ / sku tshe yun ring brtan pa'i rten 'brel yod/ / ces zhus pa'i rten 'brel bzang po'i mtshams spyor gyi sgo nas brtson 'grus lha mo'am yongs grags su a zhe gle mo zhu ba btsun mor bzhis/sngar spyi lo 1888 rab byung 15 sa byi lor bod la dbyin ji thog mar slebs pa nas tshong lam gyi skor nas rnyogs gleng byung ba'i skabs der shar nyi zer sgang gi bla tshab nges don rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yod pa des don lung bstan yin pa la ltar snang phal tshig gi ka smad sum cu'i ljags rtsodam gnang ba 'di ltar/ ka li ka tar shal pa'i hu kum gyis/ / khab can gyi zhing macerag kla 〈snas gang / / ga nas bltas kyang bsam zhing spyo ba skyes/ / nga rgyal can gyi bod pa'i dmag mi tsho/ / ca co'i she tho 'byug ltar ldir yi rang / / cha lugs ro la gyur ba'i lo rgyus de/ / ja chang zhim rung sgod mar mi thal bas/ / nya hre na phag sha za rung bcud mi 'dug / hā la'i bla ma sku mtshams bzhugs lugs de/ / tha ma med pa'i 'o/ rgyus rga sku 'du/ / da lta gnas skabs bde dog blta ba'i sgang / / nam phyags mjug gi gtan bzhag mi sgrig par/ / pa sa la las len pa'i sa rin de/ / pha ri thang las len pa'i dus shig cadang / / ba mos bcom pa'i me tog ji bzhin du/ / ma gsang 'ong pa'i gting nas spyo ba skyes/ / tsa tsi med pa'i thang se 'phur ni tsho/ / tsha ga ga las blta rung mi tshud pe/ / dza gad chang la bri nag rub pa bzhin/ / wa ler shal pa'i dmag mi rje gas dus med/ / zha tshim 'theng gsum yod pa da lta bsad/ / za ma thud med rnams kyang bde ba med/ / 'a ye bstan pa'i mtha' la thug pa'i dus/ / ya rabs can gyi gangs can rdzongs 'di ni/ / ra sha za 533

po nga ni mgar ba stong btsan yin/ / a ñtsa 'di ni rgya bza'i sprul pa yin/ / sku tshe yun ring brtan pa'i rten 'brel yod/ / ces zhus pa'i rten 'brel bzang po'i mtshams spyor gyi sgo nas brtson 'grus lha mo'am yongs grags su a zhe gle mo zhu ba btsun mor bzhis/sngar spyi lo 1888 rab byung 15 sa byi lor bod la dbyin ji thog mar slebs pa nas tshong lam gyi skor nas rnyogs gleng byung ba'i skabs der shar nyi zer sgang gi bla tshab nges don rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yod pa des don lung bstan yin pa la ltar snang phal tshig gi ka smad sum cu'i ljags rtsodam gnang ba 'di ltar/ ka li ka tar shal pa'i hu kum gyis/ / khab can gyi zhing macerag kla 〈snas gang / / ga nas bltas kyang bsam zhing spyo ba skyes/ / nga rgyal can gyi bod pa'i dmag mi tsho/ / ca co'i she tho 'byug ltar ldir yi rang / / cha lugs ro la gyur ba'i lo rgyus de/ / ja chang zhim rung sgod mar mi thal bas/ / nya hre na phag sha za rung bcud mi 'dug / hā la'i bla ma sku mtshams bzhugs lugs de/ / tha ma med pa'i 'o/ rgyus rga sku 'du/ / da lta gnas skabs bde dog blta ba'i sgang / / nam phyags mjug gi gtan bzhag mi sgrig par/ / pa sa la las len pa'i sa rin de/ / pha ri thang las len pa'i dus shig cadang / / ba mos bcom pa'i me tog ji bzhin du/ / ma gsang 'ong pa'i gting nas spyo ba skyes/ / tsa tsi med pa'i thang se 'phur ni tsho/ / tsha ga ga las blta rung mi tshud pe/ / dza gad chang la bri nag rub pa bzhin/ / wa ler shal pa'i dmag mi rje gas dus med/ / zha tshim 'theng gsum yod pa da lta bsad/ / za ma thud med rnams kyang bde ba med/ / 'a ye bstan pa'i mtha' la thug pa'i dus/ / ya rabs can gyi gangs can rdzongs 'di ni/ / ra sha za 533

mi rnams kyis brlag tshar do/ / la lung mang po brgal nas cadangs pa yi/ / sha tsha nying tsha med pa'i shal pa tshos/ / sa ni thung zad thob kyang dga' bar 'dug / ha re hu re shel pa'i dmag mi chos/ / a ti yang zab cerdzos ni bsnubs la nye/ / zhes gsungs 'dug / rim gyis spyi lo 1904 rab byung 15 shing 'grag lor dbyin ji dang ho gzhung rtsod gzhi chen por gyur nas dmag 'khrugs langs skabs/ rdzong bgres shar pa spun cung gis bod gzhung la mthun lam sgo nas bka' mol bsgrigs pa dug de min phyo gling par tsa las mi thub ces zhus 'dug sa par bka' shag gis dbyin dmag la gang sa nas dgra ya byed mi thub par gzigs te zhi ba'i thabs lam bo na gnang gi yod kyang / tshogs 'du'i gdan 'thus se gas kyis dgra phyogs kyi gnas lugs ma rtogs par kha shugs 'khyer te pho zad mo la ma thug bar 'thab 'dzing byed rgyu nyag kyang brjod pa'i kyen gyis/ rgyal blon rnams kyang gnang thabs ma byung bar/ 'dir sde srid dang /krong sar dpon slob 64 rgyan dbang phyug bcas la dga' 'byug nang pa'i bstan la gcig gyur song gshis/ sod dang phyo gling 'thab rtsod de dag bde 'jags ma byung bar rang sa rang srung sogs bstan don gdung shugs chig bsgril mdzad dgos par tshogs 'du dang / bka' shag sku sku1 nas gnas tshul sal/bod pas 'byug par dmag rgyab 'chol ba na spa ༷tho dpon 〈snab zla ba dpal 'gyod gyis 'o/nga ra'i mnga' kherdzongs sa mtshams snge/ sa ༷/nga dmag mi bsrergags pa ma tshad dmag gi grabs sgrig byed pa'i skabs/ dpag bsam sku tshab dkar ji skye/ rgyan rdo rjes chos rtse dpon slob mtshe rgyan dbang phyug la rang gi rgyal khab la 'phral phugs legs nyes kyi 'aX6 sod kyi srid don rgyal rabs zla ba 'thum phrag 'char ba'i rdzing su 104nas/534

nang gros zhib par zhus shing / 'dzam bu'i gling na dbyin ji stobs shugs chen po yod ges de la bod pas gtan nas mi thub cing nga rang chos 'ong bod pa'i rgyab dasung byas na rang re 'byug pa da lta rang dbang rang btsan yod pa mthar phyo gling pa'i 'og hā tshud 'ong / de bas lhi gling pa dang mthun lam mdzad de phyo gzhung dang bod gzhung gi bar khri 'dum mdzad par byon na legs lam du 'gyur cadang zhes zhus skabs/ gzhung gi dpon lag lhan rgyas tsho dang dge 'dun dmang bcas nas ma rgyan dbang phyug bod du rgyal lab chen po gnyis dmag 'khrug gi bar du gyon na skru tshe la bar chad 'byung cadang bas ma byon zhes yang yang gsol ba btab kyang / sku tshab skye/ rgyan rdo rjes de ltar mi 'tshams nges par byerdzon pa dug ces zhus pa las 61 rgyan dbang dṛṣṭag gis gsan te gtsug lag lang dang maskusnan khang rnams la kyen sel sku rim gnad smin legs par mdzad de phyo gling pa la 'tshogs chas chum/ ('bras) skurdzogs kyi spogs ram gang dug byus shing mdza' bshes mthun lam legs par bzos te 'byon rgyu mdzad/de bzhin zhabs grang 'jigs med chodas rgyal gyi gsung las/ sdus ngan sprin dbyungs can gyi gnam 'o/'i nang / / snyigs ma'i lang tsho dar la babs pa'i mthus/ /bod yul lha ldan gzhung gi ཿtshes rgyal dang / / 'phags yul gzhung sa rgyal tshab chen po gnyis/ / gsung phrin bka' rtags lan mang brje ba'i mthar/ / thugs snang me chu bzhin du ma mthun tshe/ / rgya bod rnam gnyis 'khrugs zing yod lang gis/ / skye dgu'i bde spyod 'phyog pa'i bang chen byung / / sngar ma grags pa'i gtam ngan nyin re bzhin/ / gser snyan 'a ma'i nang du khrag bzhin 'khyil/ / rgya gar yul na kla klo gad rgyangs sgrog /307 zhabs grang 'jigs med cesas rgyal rnam thar zhal gsungs ma kya bzhi'i rgyab nas gsal /535

bod yul dbus su yo lang mtsho ltar 'khol/ / lto rdzongs skye 'bro las kyi rlung 'tshub ldang / / ci nas bltas kyang sa 'dir bag ma chags/ / zhes dang / de ni /nyini 'gro spu yi bde thabs la/ / chings zlum legs spyor mdzad pa'i dgongs bzhed bzhin/ / shar phyogs nor 'dzin skyong ba'i spu bla der/ / gnas tshul bka' 'a phrin dmar po rim par bskur/ / mi ring dgun 'bring yos kyi zla ba'i nang / / spyi bla bsil zer ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor de/ / blon 'kho ra rgyu skar tshogs kyis bskor bzhin du/ / shar rdzongs lha yi lam nas 'di ru 'byor/ / zhabs kyang gong ma'i gdan sa chen po nas/ / srongs thang rgyal po'i khab hu chibs la sgyur/ / dngos mjal yun 'gyangs se nga ba'i dun snang gis/ / mjal tshe pha bu 'phrad ltar thugs yid 'dres/ /de skabs byung phyogs phag ri'i tshong 'dus nas/ / rnam dpyod lang tsho ldan pa'i sku tshab pas/ / rgya dmag rgyal rtse'i rdzong du slobs se nga zhes/ / zhu phrin dgun kha'i rlung 'tshub bzhin du khu/nga / / de nas mkhan hre ba 'dus pa rgya mtshe dang / / nyid dang rgyal blon thams cad bka' bsgros nas/ / rgya bod skye 'gro mang po'i srog spyob phyir/ legs spyor chings zlum byed par 'byon cadas pa/ gzhan pa gang yang rung ba ma gzigs nas/ spyi bla bsed nams lung gis grub pa de/ nag zla'i yar tshes bzang por lam du zhugs/ rim gyis rgya bod 'dzom pa'i mdun sar slobs/ zhes gsal/spu lo 1904 zla nya' pa'i chos 'a6nyin dbyin dmag rnams rdza leb la rgyab ste thon pa rim pas hro mo nas sna gdong phag rir 'byor pa dang bsnyun/ bod gangs can rdzongs kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde spyod nyams par 'gyur pa 'aX8 yang gya lnga gya drug nas gsal/536

de nas mi ring bar rgyal tshab dga' ldan khri rin po che dang / bka' shag zhabs pad rnam pa tsho yang dbyin ji'i dug dpon rnams dang mjal 'phrad byung nas zhi ba'i chings kyi bka' mol 'go btsugs te/ shing 'grag spyi lo 1904 zla 7 pa'i tshos 17nyin bod phyogs nas rgyal tshab dga' ldan khri rin po che dang bka' blon tshogs 'du'i sku tshab gdan sa'i 'thus mi bcas dang / dbyin phyogs nas yang ha se ban sku gas bcas nas rtse pho brang du chings yig bzos te sod chodas ldan gyi zhing lams bde bar bkod de shing 'grag zla 8 pa'i tshes 3 nyin dbyin ji'i dasung dmag rnams lha ldan rgyal lab nas rim bzhin slar 'o(ga 'dug de skabs skyon rgyan dbang khu/ga la rgyal tshab khri rin po che dang / bka' blon zhabs pad lhan rgyas sogs bod gzhung lha sde mi sde tshang ma thugs mnyes te gzengs bstod nas bod kyi lugs sredal go gnas kyi zhwa lham sogs gnang ba na bla ma byang chub bcesan 'gyus gyis gnang ba'i bya rothog dag zhwa las gzhan mi dgos zhes thugs bzhed gnang ste ma bzhes gsungs/ de nas spyi 'o/ 1904rab byung 15 shing 'byug zla 7 tshes 17la slar rang rdzongs su 'o/ga chibs baspyod gnang nas phag ri 'byor ba dang / dbyin ji'i skemag dpon gar zhel sa nyeb mchodag nas o rgyan dbang phyug gi phyag la bzung ste da lan bod gzhung mi dug rnams kyi bya spyad la bsams na bod rdzongs dbyin ji'i mnga' zhabs su 'gro ba ma zad/ khyod kyi blon po zle ba dpal 'byor gyi byed lugs la brten nas da res nged rnams spre mo la rgyab ste 'byug la 'gro dgos pa yin rung / grogs po khyod kyi ngo so la bltas nas hro mardzo nas 'phrang ste 'aspo gi yin zhes gsungs 'dug/de nas chodas rtse dpon slob tshe rgyan dbang phyug sman rdzongs rgyal lab tu phyags 539

phebs tsho rang gzhung nas phebs ba༄/ gser sgreng rgyas pa dang bcas rang gi rgyal khab hu legs par phebs grub pa'i dga' ston rgyu chen po mdzad 'dug de ltar dpon slob 6/ rgyan dbang phyug skru la nyes spyon gang yang med par slar 'o/ga byon thub pa ma zad/bod chodas ldan zhing la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i bde spyod la gcad 'tshe gang yang ma khu/nga ba dang rang re 'byug rgyal lab la yang phyos su nyen la gang yang med par mdzad pa'i phyag rjes gang bas shin tu bzang ba dang 'phral phugs kyi bstan srid kyi don chen po legs par grub ste gyon thub pa'i skabs su ni/ mi thams cad kyis dpag bsam sku tshab dkar ji o rgyan rdo rje 'di nyid mi rje o rgyan dbang phyug dang skye ba sngon gyi las smon dam tshig gcig pa zhig nges par yin 'dug ces lab 'dugagang ltar de skabs bod gangs can rdzongs dang zisnyo mon la bzhi'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde spyod rtsa ba dkar ji o rgyan rdo rjes zhus pa la chodas rtse dpon hre ba skyo/ rgyan dbang khu/ga gis gsan pa las khu/nga 'dug/ de'i rjes su skru rim zhabs brtan 31gas legs par bsgrubs pa las/ spyi lo 190pa rab byung 15 shing sprul lor lha sras 'jigs med dbang phyug sku 'khrungs/sku tshe'i 'gal kyen zhi zhing zhabs pad brtan pa'i sku rim sgrub phyir bod nas gter bston zil gnon nam mkha'i rdo rje gdan dungs te 'khrungs ston rgyas par bsgrubs se / / snga 'o/ra dbyin 'byug gnyis mthun lam legs par byung ba la brten de'i phyi lor 'bras spu wa'i sa nyeb dpon g.yog phyo gling rgyal po'i sku tshab byas nas nyas dang / spa spo brgyud spungs thang rdzong du 'ongs te/ chos rtse dpon slob o rgyan dbangaphyug la de snga shing 'grag 'o/ 1904 la dbyin bod bar 'grigs cha rogs ram gang 540

dug mdzad pa'i legs sku 'i rten dod ke si a yi e si rtags ma phrul/dpag bsam skru tshab skyes rgyan rdo rje la dbyin ji'i gzhung nas rā dza'i go gnas gnang /de bzhin 'grag gzhung nas skye'o rgyan dbang ༄/ga gis kyang rang gi rgyal khab hu 'phral phyags gnyis su bde ba dang spyid pa byung ba 'di nyid ma rgyan rdo rjes nan gyis byus bkod byas pa las khu/nga ba'i legs sku 'i rten du dpag bsam skru tshab rang 'jags la has dung go gnas gnang / spyi lo 1906 rab byung 15 me rta la chodas rtse dpon slob skyod rgyun dbang phyug dang has drung pa dkar ji o rgyan rdo rje dpon g.yog 'khor bcas phyo gling gzhung gis sku mgyon du gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar ka li ka ltar gyon te phyo gling rgyal po'i sras jor ci dang me ri bcas mjal 'phrad mdzad de de nas dbyin ji'i gzhung dang 'byug gzhung mthun lam gyi 'brel ba bla na med pa //nga 'dug de yang chu thur mig gi go/la du gzugs sa/ ma grub pa'i las kyi gzhan dbang ya mtshan 'phrul gyi bkod pa shin hu ngo mtshar ba ni/ spyi lo 1865 rab byung 14 shing glang la yab 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi skabs dgra'i rtse smad 'di nyid da la na rigs sras cha/ rgyan dbang phyug gi skabs spyi 'o/ 1906 rab byung 15 me rta la grogs kyi dwangs mar gyur pa dang / khyim mtshes bod gangs can rdzongs gī kyibs mgon tta la'i bla ma la spyi lo 1904 rab byung 15 shing 'byug la dgra'i rtse mor gyur pa dbyin ji'i dug po'i don gcod pa de nyid yun mi ring bar spyi lo 1910 rab byung 15 lcags khyi lor rgya mi a ban dpung dmag gis chab srid dang sku sku ga la nyen pa'i skabs dbyin ji'i gzhung la re ltos 'cha' dgos byung nas mdza' bshes kyi dwangs mar gyur pa ni/ gang zag phal pa byis pa'i dgra gnyen gyi 'gyur ldog dang khyad pad gang yang ma mchis snyam pa'ang 541

'phros su thal/ dus skabs der dbyin ji dug po'i stobs shugs dang dpal 'byor mnga' thang 'dzam thu'i gling na 'gran zla bral ba'i rgyal khab chen po la/ phag ri nas lha sa'i bar lam khel mi ser rnams dmag mis rta khal mi gsum bkrol 'ded mi byed/ gnas mal gzan shing / rtswa chag sku gas la rin thob pa las/ btsan bkol btsan 'phyog mi byed pa'i bar dpang skyed rgyan dbang phyurge gis byas pa chad don la gnas pas mi ser rnams bde ba la bkod pa dang / lha sar 'byor nas bstan 'gror gnod 'tshe gang yang med par zhi ba'i chings mol mtshams spyor yang dag par zhus 'bras don chen grub pa las/ da lam stobs chen rgyal lab chen po nas ཿtshes rtse dngo/na slob e rgyan dbang phyug la de lta thu'i rtags ma thob pa'i skabs su brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal pod mnga' gasku la rgyur rang gi bsam 'char 'byug gzhung lhan chogs su zhu yig gcig 'bul dgos 'dug bsams nga/ bskyed de phrul tshul/o rgyan rdo rjes rang re'i rgyal khab 'dir/ rgyal po gcig gi lung gis dbang sgyur ba'i srid kyi brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po zhig med par brten/ dpon lag rnams gcig mgo gcig gis ma non par sngar nas da bar dbang dza/gas su che ba nas sde srid byas te lung par nang 'khrugs dmag 'dzings rgyun ma chad par byung ba'i dbang gis/'bangs mi ser rnams za bcud nyal gnyid bral ba'i 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal la rgyun du gnas dgos pa byung 'dug rgyal po gcig gis dbang bsgyur ba'i khrims mnan pa med na da rung yang sngar bzhin 'ong bas der brten rgyal lab 'di yang ring po mi thogs par nyams shing rme sa rje dpal ldan 'brug pa 'i lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa yang nyams 'gro rgyur mthong nas/ chos rtse dpon slob tho rgyan dbang phyug de nyid brgyud 542

'dzin gyi rgyal por mnga' gse la mdzad na legs rgyu'i 'byug gzhung lhan rgyas la zhu rmi ga phul ba'i 'du shus lhad med ni/bsod nams stobs kyis 'khor los sgyur ba dug shos rin po che lhan tshogs zhal mthun gyi zhabs pad gser khri'i dung du/〈sna gas/ma gus pas phyag bcas zhu gasku(la zab sku rin po che nyi ma'i dkyil 'bor mngon par gsal zhing gzhan phan phrin las kyi 'od snang phyogs bcur 'phyo zhing bzhugs zhabs brtan pa ni bka' drin snying gi dpal dam par chi lags/ mtshams zhus/ gserdzol ba 'debs pa'i zhu de na rang cag 'byug rgyal khab gcig yin kyang rgyal po 'di yin zer ba'i ming dang gtam med par sde srid ni sus byed med par 'di yin zer ba'i nges pa tsa gtan nas med par sngar da thug ni rang cag 'byug rgyal khab 'di nang brtan ba rtan zhig rtsa gtan nas med par sde pa mdzad nod de'ang phyogs kyi spyi bla dang gzhung lhan rgyas res 'ga' ni bla slob nas mdzad bzhugs pa las rgyal khrims ceras khrims gnyis ka spyoXng thub pa dka' bas sngerdzon du sa yin na sde srid sus mdzad rung ha cang 'gal ba med pas rgyal khab phan tshun su dang 'brel las byed dgos med stabs rang cag 'byug pa nang 'bod kyi las don mdzad dgos ma gtogs rgya bod gtam lan 'jal rgyu dang yi ge yar mar gtong rigs don dag gal chen rgyal khab yar mar gyi las don mdzad ma dgos pas sde srid dang phyogs kyi spyi bla gzhung lhan rgyas bcas sus mdzad bzhugs rung 'gal ba med pa da ni sngar dang mi 'du ba'i rgyal khab yar mar gyi gleng rtsod mang stabs rgyal lab su la'ang yi ge gtong dgos dang / gtam lan rgyab dgos rigs rang cag rdzong 543
