lag so sos thud krenar med par mdzad dgos ma tshad sde srid de sngon lam ltar bzhag nas rang cag nang 'bod kyi mdzad dgos rigs dang bla ma dge 'dun pa'i sde spyong sngon sredal ma nyams par sde srid rang gnas sku da pa'i khar da nas bzung zhabs spying rin po che'i bstan srid la phan rlabs che ba ma tshad bstan pa yar rgyas yodang ba'i thabs rten gyis rang cag 'grag pa'i rgyal khab 'di nang dgra la nge ma rgyu dang gnyen la 'phyar rgyu rme sa rtse sku zhabs rin po che de yin pa de la phyo gling rgyal lab stobs dang mnga' thang dgung dang mnyam pa rgyal khab kun la dbang ba'i stobs chen po de yis 'de lta bu'i go gnas phul rjes go gnas 'di phyi gling rgyal khab mnga' 'og lngar sa heb dang go gnas 'du ba yin 'dug lngar sa heb de rang re'i skad las yin na rgyal po'i mtshan yin rang cag rgyal phran gcig la go gnas 'di lta bu byung ba'i skabs rang res rgyal drodan tshang mas yin rung go sa phul nas rgyal khab su la'ang gtam lan yig lan se gas sngar yang ཿtshes rtse sku zhabs rin po tshe nas mdzad pa yin zhing da nas phar ji srid nam gnas bar rang re 'byug pa'i rgyal nge mtshan gsol bzhag na che sa rtse skru zhabs kyi sku brgyud dang sku nye sku 'khor yod rigs la phan pa ma tshad zhabs grang rin po che'i bstan srid la gnod 'gal byed mi rtsa gtan nas mi 'ong bas rgya khral dang snyo rdzongs 'di'i sa gzhi yod rigs rnams kyang bstan pa dar rgyas su med rung ma chag pa zhig cadang bas de min lha mas las rang la bzhag na chodas rtse sku zhabs sku tshe zhabs pad brtan bzhugs bar snyo rdzongs nang 'bod sa 'jam dus bde yong nges dang sku tshe mthar phyin pa'i rjes su gang 'ong mi shes de bas gser gzhung gis bstode nas go sa phul bzhag pa'i thog rang cag rgyal drodan spyi tshogs nas 544

rmongs pa'i dbang du ma bzhugs par 'phral rang phyo gling rgyal khab chen por ngo so thon pa dang mthug la rang cag bde ba thob pa chodas rtse sku zhabs rin po che rgyal po'i mtshan bzhag na chadang gi rgyal brgyud ma 〈snang par gser gzhung nas 〈snags ram gang byed ma gtogs gnod 'gal rtsa steng nas mi yong / de lugs kyi gong sa sku zhabs dang / bla ma dge 'dun bcas kyis phran nas zhu ba de thugs la mnga' ste babs gzigs gnang nas thugs thag bcad de mdzad gnang / 'phral rang rgyal khab gzhan la ngom chodag pa dang mthug bstan srid la phan snyam nas zhu ba phul sku da pas rgyal po'i thig tshad spung pos rgyab pa ma yin te da lta rang cag dpon g.yog gnyis ngo bo ma yal bar bla ma dge 'dun dang gzhung lhan rgyas phyogs kyi spyi bla ma da rigs srin bal gyi na bza' bzhes bzhugs pa ltar lhag chad rtsa gtan nas mi phe ga rang cag dpon g.yog gnyis ni rdo rje lta bu'i sku ma yin pas mthug snyo rdzo ngas 'dir phan pa mi yong ngam bsams te zhus pa ma gtogs da lta ཿwas rtse sku zhabs rin po che la go sa yar 'phar dgos bsams te zhu ba yin na zhabs drang rin po che'i bka' srung yod rigs dpang btsugs yod pas rgyal khab che sa nas bstod na mtho ba'i dpe bzhin rang cag nang 'bod kyang pos bstod na mtho mi tshugs rgya gar rgyal phran tshang ma'i dgas la gser gzhung nas go spo 'di lta thu byung ba yin zer rgya gar gyi rgyal phran tshang ma ha las 'das pa byung yod kyang da lta rang dbang yod dus mdzad na gang mdzad 'ong rang dbang med na mdzod pa shin tu dka' yin kyang mkhyen dgongs der mtho bas gang la gang mkhas kyi bka' gre sa thog babs gzigs mdzad dgos chosi 'i zab bzhes su rol ci par sku gsung thugs mkhyezhe mkhyen lags/ zhes sgrib bral ye shes spyan gyis gzigs

'bebs tsam la gus phun has dung nas me rta zla 7 tshes 10 la phyag bcas phul/ 1906rgyal po'i mtshan gse la rung bzhugs gnas de gar bzhugs rung 'gal ba med pa sku zhabs rin po che'i thugs dang bsnyun nas bzhugs rgyu yin pa'i zab bzhes zhu/skye/ rgyan rdo rjes zhu yig phul ba bzhin rgyal yongs mos mthun gyis gan rgya phul te brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal por mnga' gsol nas chab srid bkyings tshul// de ltar nyas grang 6/ rgyan rdo rjes 'byug rgyal khab la 'phral phugs su phan thabs bsam 'char zhu yig sdil ba las de nas 'grag gi dpon lag 'bangs mi ser dge 'dun grwa tshang yongs rdzogs nas kyang blo gros 'di ni shin hu rigs shing 'thad par dgongs nas kun kyang 'dod mos mthun par o rgyan dbang phyug rgyal po gnang dgos pa ma zad sras brgyud rim pas kyang brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po mdzad rgyu la gan rgya gsham gsal 'di bzhin phul 'dug/ 546

zhes pa'i gan rgya se se 'i rtags byir can 'gyur med mtha' btsan du phyal nas spyi lo 1907 rab byung 15 sa sprel lo zla 11 tshe sa 13 la spungs thang bde chen pho brang du lha mi srid lde'atshogs pa'i dbus su gser khri mthon por mnga' gsol ba'i skabs/ dbyin ji'i gzhung gi sku tshab wa'i ṭa sanyeb/ me jar ri nig kem sol sa heb/ /ban nyisi lob/ badzar wal la su snyi dhar ji had dan khā na/ skad sgyur 'bras rdzongs pa ra'i ba dur blo bzang che sa ldan bcas dpon g.yog 'a4 tsam byon nas bkra shis mnga' gse la mdzad/ wa'i ṭa sa nyeb dang skyo/ rgyan dbang phyug gnyis sprun mched lta bu'i brtse gdung gnang zhing thugs ha cang ma4na stabs 6rdzo pas ka li ka tar rgyal tshab mu lug lar zhus te rgya gzhis khral de sngar ste/nga phrag lnga bcu tham pa yin pa de 'o/ga ldab spar te lo rer rub stong phrag brgya tham pa re 'thul rgyur bzos gnang 'dug spyi lo 1910rab byung 15 lcags khyi lor dbyin ji'i skru tshab cal se bhal sa nyeb cadangs nas sngar shing cung lar bzhag pa'i chings yig bce sa 'khu/ra gyis chings yig gsar pa bzhag /de nas tshe rgyan dbang phyug gi thugs la has drung ma rgyan rdo rje 'di nyid 'byug rgyal khab dang rngo sa la phyag phyod 'gran zla bral ba 'khyodar ba yin pas lnga nga la go gnas 'di las lhag pa zhig gnang dasku sa 'dug kyang / rang re'i rgyal lab la lhan rgyas lasalhag pa mi 'dug cing / lhan rgyas bzhi'i gras las gong gzim de rang la bcar 30sa de bskos dgos yin zhing / rang la bcar 30sa 'ong yin pas gong gzim gyi go gnas de khong la gnang dgos 'dug ces dgongs te rab byung 15 lcags phag spyi lo 191nya la has dung ma rgyan rdo rje la bka' shog 'di ltar gnang 'dug/has grang shes bya'i 'od snang rgyas pa la/ don 'bras de ni khyod kyi thed kyang 548

sngar da tshun bar phyi 'byug rgyal khab gnyis kyi legs lam gang che bgyis pa ma zad/lhag par lto lung par chodas rje 'byug pa 'di'i bstan pa'i mtha' don la lhag bsam rnam dag gi sgo nas gang dug ci yong dang / yang sgos 'did zhabs la'ang phyag phyod zhabs tog gang bas dug pa byas zhus pa'i rjes yin stabs/ dal lar skurdzo gnas thob thang sogs de bas min pa zhig rang gnang rung ba zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang rang cag rgyal lab la dpag pa'i de las brgal te 'gro sa mi 'dug gshis de bsnyun gong sa'i gzim dpon de bzhin khyod bskos yod pa 'dir zhabs kyi thed kyang sbug bzhugs mo'i khyad ma mdzad par ༷ /dzad tshar yin/ mdzad pa dang cadag las bcar 31sa de gzim dpon yin pa'i khar phyogs phyogs su mi 'dzom sar ni khyod rang 'gro dgos pas 'gro ba dang tog bdag 'gan zhig med na mi rung bas der brten gzim dpon de khyod rang nas 'gan khur blang dgos dang / dar bzed cad sogs kyang tshos grangs gza' skar 'dir zhabs nas bsgrigs te gnang yod pa'i khar/ 'dir zhabs nas khyod la da res gnang chas legs mtshon du zong sna nyer gcig ma'i tshan dang / thag ras dos gcig phang khebs phyam brgyad ma gos 1 ka phang therdzos nya nga 'grag gnyis pa sgam mar 'thus rub khal ga༄/ma rta 'thus rub khal bcu tham pa/ sku|sa sil shing yo'i ka bur gos gcig lung ser ma gcig sha sbyar 'thus 'bu dkar ༷/ga gcig kheb sang myal bal ma 1 gru rtsi'i bkab zan bcas gnang yod pa'i thugs nges mdzod/ rten la dmar gtsos zong sna lnga tshan bcas zla 3 tshes 11 la phyal/ da nas bzung khyod rang gi thu tsha mi brgyud rim par tog go gnas de ltar 'byung ba'i smon 'debs bcas gnang yod/ces pa 'di bka' sprodag ngo ma'i 'du bshus lhad med yin/549

spyi lo 1911rab byung 15lcags phag la ka tar yod pa'i phyi gling rgyal tshab kyis sku mgron du gdan zhu ltar gong sa o rgyan dbang phyug dang gzim dpon o rgyan rdo rje dpon g.yog rnams rallir gyon nas gyi gling pa dang mjal 'phrad gnang ste mthun lam sngar las kyang gong 'phel je brtan mdzad pa las/ rgyal blon skyod rgyan mtshan can 'di gnyis kyi skabs nas 'dzam gling rgyal khab chen po rnams dang 'du mnyam 'byug rgyal khab ces 'dzam bu'i gling na ming dang gtam thon pa yin/ de nas gong gzim o rgyan rdo rjes rang re'i rgyal lab kyi mi rnams da sngar phyi rgya'i skad yig slob srol med par tha na rang 'gro sa'i lam tsam 'dri rgyu'i skad za la 'thung la tsam ma shes par lkug pa lta thu yin 'dug par brten/ da nas dug zhan thams cad rang mgo thon thabs dang gzhung don sgrub pa la phyo rgya'i skad yig nges par shes dgos shin hu gal che bas rang re'i rgyal khab nang gyi rgya'i skad yig sle ba grwa gsar 'dzugs gnang na shin hu legs par tshesgong tshul zhus pa las/ skutsheng sa ten rgyan dbang //ga gis shar phyogs nas thu tsha bcu bdun dang has nas bcu bdun bcas ka spungs su rgya yig sle ba par btang ba de rnams la 'gro song dang mthun kyen rogs ram 'go 'dren thams cad gong gzim skye'o rgyan 〈sna rjes 'gan blangs byas nas bslab bcug de bzhin du gyam thang du sras 'jigs med dbang khu/ga dpe na gaskusnag bcu bzhi la dpag bsam la nas sku tshab nor bu dang 'bras rdzongs pa phan tog gnyis slob dpon bsgos nas nyin du'i skad yig slob spyong gnang bcug par mdzad/ de nas gong sa skyod rgyan dbang phyug gis sngar gyi gtsug lag khang dang dgon sde rnying pa rnams nyams gasku dang / skru gsung thugs rte namang po gsar bzhengs mdzad/ gser khang rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang tshul khrims don 550

ldan dang dge bshes skyod rgyan/ dge bshes nyi ma rdo rje/ dge bshes dpal 'byor/dgo bshes smin grag sogs kyis che sa rtse grwa tshang du mtshan nyid dang 'chad nyan gyi bstan pa spel/ lha sar rjo shākya rnam gnyis kri mdun du zla ba re bzhin gyi tshes bco lnga dang gnam sgang la stong mche da phyal mi btang bar mdzad/ lams rdzogs chen dgon pa dang / dpal spungs/ zur mang / 'dzi sgar sogs kyi chodas sde la yo byad bsnyen bkur sogs phyal bar mdzad/ skru rjes dang byams lha khang se gas la nya stong brgyud gsum se gas dus bzang rnams su stong mchod dang / dgon sde grwa tshang rnams la bsnyen bkur shar nub kyi 'bangs mi ser rnams la sngerdzon sre la gyi dpya sril rnams las gang yang phab chag gnang ste byams brtses bskyungs bar mdzad/de bzhin gong gzim ma rgyan rdo rjes kyang 'byug gzhung gi gdan sa dbyar gyi bzhugs gnas bkra shis ceras rjesang dang / dgun gyi bzhugs gnas spungs thang bde chen po brang rnam gnyis grwa tshang chen por gser dngul gyi thum pa se gas mchede chas/rgyu dngul snyad med kyis brdungs pa'i tshogs dung / khro zangs sogs thab chas bzang gos kyi bla bre 'phan rgyal mtshan phye 'phyar skusnags mchode rdzas/ dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur sogs gang yang phul bar mdzad/ de nas gong gzim skyod rgyan rdo rjes rgyal po mtshe rgyan dbang phyug la/ has dung rta mgrin dngos tshib dang / tshe dbang /a lo rdo rje'i thu phrug bcas lte ba bcad sar khrod pa sgogs te rang yul du sdod chodag pa'i bsal cha legs par zhus te sngar bzhin thugs snang dag pa'i skabs/ a 'o/ rdo rje gro mor spongs pa'i rjes su bu phrug dang has dung pa rta mgrin dngos grub ltos bcas 'byug la thon nas skye'o rgyan dbang phyug gi phyag dbang bcar a/ma steng kha'i gzhi la 551

ba bzhin dar khyab btang ba'i phyir/ srungs thang dge 'dun gyi gral nas zhus dag pa bstan pa rin chen/ a co pa sangs/ krong gsar grwa tshang nas rin chen rdo rje/ padma tshe ring / skal bzang / rigs bzang rnams mdo lams rdzogs chen sri sidha'i slob grwa chen por gzhung chen bcu gsum sogs mdo rgyud rig gnas da nga bcas pa sle ba spyong byed par spyi lo 1917 rab byung 16 me sgrul lor ma hā paṇa ḍi ta gzhan phan chodas kyi snang ba serdzogs kyi zhabs dung du brdzangs/ rgyal ba dmi pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i gsung rin chen gter mjod kyi dkar chag brgya bcu grag gi rgyab lnga nas/ dpal ldan 'byug pa'i bstan srid 'degs pa'i sgos kyi glang po/ nor 'dzin bde dge'i khrims kyis chos bzhin skyong ba'i mi bdag dam pa/ krong sar dpon slob e rgyan dbang phyug mchog nas/ thog mar kun gzigs 'jam mgon padma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa'am/ mtshan gzhan 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsang chen bstan pa'i dpal du bka' babs rin po che bdun gyi shing rta gsar du 'dren par mdzad pa rnams kyis gcesas glogs bam bcu phrag gcig la lngas lhag pa'i sku na dang / spar shing brgya phrag sum cu gtong ba'i phyag yangs por brkyangs te/ thog ma'i rten 'brel rmad du byung ba'i sgo 'phar phyes/ zhes gsal/ dnghagrub dbang rtogs ldan ro/kya sri nas bal yul 'phags pa shing kun mchode rten nyams gso zhu ba'i skabs/ gtong phod kyi sgo phye ste bal yul du btang gnang bar mdzod 'dug pa ni/ bsod snarmis dang stobs dpal mtshungs zla med cing gtong 'a10 kaskusnag si hu 2snas kyi rgya mtshos mdzad pa shākya shī'i rnam thar me tog phreng ba ldeb grangs don gcig gi rgyab yig phreng bzhi pa rinas//555

ba nam mkha' mdzod rkya sgo 'phar yangs por 'byed pa mi dbang snyo 'grag krong sar chodas kyi rgyal po skyo/ rgyan dbang phyug mcho ga nas/ sku tshab dge bshes shes rab rdo rje ched phebs dang 'brel bar phyo sgor khri phrag bzhi'i zhal 'debs gnang ba dang / shes dang / lto dzogrog rgyal pos snga phyir sgor kyang khri phrag bdun lhag gtsos/ zhes gsal/chab srid mnga' thang brtan cing nad mug 'khrugs rtsod zhi phyir sku rjes thang du khang brtsegs mchod rten gcig dang rdo zam du gcig bzhengs/ de ltar sman rdzongs 'byug rgyal khab 'dir nyas drang pa skyorsha rgyan rdo rjes bsam 'char zhu yig phul ba la gzhung gi dpon lag lhan rgyas rnams kyis kyang gsan te 61 rgyan dbang phyug brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po dang por mnga' gsol zhing / rgyal po ma rgyan dbang phyug gis kyang sku rgyan rdo rje la thugs brtse bla na med pas therdzog mar dpag bsam kri/ tshab ba〉tshes/ 'phral phyags gnyis su bde ba dang spyid pa byung ba 'di nyid ma rgyan rdo rjes nan gyis byus bkod byas pa las dṛṣṭang ba'i legs sku 'i rten du dpag bsam sku tshab rang 'jags la nyas dung pa'i go gnas gnang / 1906 la chodas rtse dpon slob o rgyan dbang phyug dang has grang pa dkar ji o rgyan rdo rje dpon g.yog 'khor bcas gyi gling gzhung gis sku mgron du gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar ka li ka tar byon te phyo gling rgyal po'i sras jor ci dang lcam me ri bcas mjal 'phrad mdzad de mthun lam gong 'phel du gyur/ has dung pa gong gzim bskos te rgyal khab kyi bstan chus mdzad sgo gang yang gsung gros gnang nas gzhung gi phyag las mdzad gnang ba las/ phyo nang gi dgra'i dmag 'khrugs nyer 'tsho ming tsam yang med par mnga' 'bangs byams pas chodas bzhin bskyungs nas 'ar11 yang ldeb grangs don bzhi'i mdun phreng drug pa nas/556

chotshes rje dpal ldan 'byug pa'i 'u/gas gnyis kyi bstan pa ma nyams par rgyal khab rang dbang rang btsan 'di tsam yod pa chos rgyal o rgyan dbang phyug dang chos blon o rgyan rdo rje rnam gnyis kshi bka' drin bo na las byung ba yin pa ni blo gzu bor gnas pa rnams kyis brtags pas shes/ phyog ༄/ bzhugs gnas kyang kun bzang cesas gling la'on pa dang / skru rjes/ byams pa lha lang / phrin las rab brtan rnams su thugs dam dge spyor la bce na te bzhugs pa'i skabs shig nas skru la mkhris pa'i snyung gzhi thebs te gzhung dge 'dun grwa tshang du sku rim gnang rgyu dang / gal srid snyung gzhi ma gdangs na sku sprur bum thang sku rjes su bying chodag pa dang / zhe dgu'i sku tshigs bar gyi dgongs rdzogs bsgrub rgyu'i gnyer tshang dang zong dos ti rub gos dang bcas zhu yig phul bar btang gnang ba bzhin snyung gzhi rje sdug hu song nas gong gzim sprodag gsungs ka sprungs su bka' 31ga dang bang mi ched mngags gnang yang sa dbyus ring stabs sku nga gzim slobs ma byung ngam gong gzim zhes gsungs nas thugs phreng bzhin spyi lo 19'ju rab byung 15 zad pa me stag lo zla 7 chos 13 la phrin las rab brtan du lha sras 'jigs med dbang phyug gi skru pang du dbu bzhag bzhin zhi bar gshegs se / /sku ma gshegs pa'i gong du rnam pa kun tu lha sras 'jigs med dbang phyug la gong gzim skyod rgyan rdo rje dang bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi mi brgyud la nga rang tshos dus dang rnam pa kun hu gang dug dug byed dgos pa yin no zhes yang yang gsungs par mdzad pa'i yab kshi bka' bzhin/ yab gshegs rjes sprur ma byings gong du gong gzim bsod nams stobs rgyas dang 'bras rdzongs chodas rgyal sras mo rā ni che sa dbyings dbang mo gnyis kyi sras sa lug lo pa 'jigs med dpal ldan rdo rje dgung lo brgyad 557

spu lo 19'a6 me stag lo la has drung pa bkab ni dmar po gnyis skal ma'i go gnas gnang zhing / gong gzim bsod nams stobs rgyas la rgyal po 'jigs med dbang phyug gis thugs nas sku mched kyi brtse gdung dang / zhal nas pho rgan ma gong gzim zhes gsungs kyi yod pa ni gzim sgar pa rgan rigs kun gyis ma shes pa med do/ /de ltar chos rgyal o rgyan dbang phyug 'di yis sman rdzongs lha mi che dgu mang pos bkur ba'i brgyud 'dzin gī rgyal po'i chab srid dgya brnyes nas khri thog lo nyi shu rgyal srid bskyangs pa yin no/ / 558

su phul zhes gsungs 'dug zhabs dung rin po che snyo rdzongs 'dir gyon pa nas blon po dang 'du ba las mgon bya rog gdong can gyis 'bral med du sdong grogs mdzad de phrin las sgrub pa yin pa ni/ spyi lo 1617 la thog mar sde srid gtsang pa phran tshogs rnam rgyal gyi dmag dpung spa spo phyogs su cadangs pa na las mgon bya rog gdong can gyis dmag dpon la gu nas bsgral te rgyal la thob 'dug / de'i rjes su spang ri zam par gsung che ga gnang ba'i skabs shig phyag rol yun shin hu ring ba brdungs gnang bar mdzad/ gsung ཿtsheg grol ba na las mgon bya rog gdong can gyis mi gcig 'khrid tshe nga nas 'cham gnang nas 'cham stabs dang bsres nas bsgral se nga gsungs/de nas nyin la shas kyi rjes su dbo na mgar sa'i khyetshogs nas dge lugs pa'i dmag dpon gcig gi mgo lag khyer 'ongs 'dug/de'i rjes su spyi lo 1668 tsam la bod nas dmag dgang chen po 'ongs nas bod 'byug g.yul 'khrugs chen po bkye ba'i dus su/ bum thang bya dkar rdzong gi dgo na khang nang marga na po'i cerdzo ga gnang ba na me mda' rdzas mdel btsugs nas spa g.yab rab gsal nas tshad dpag bzhag pa'i thad/ pha gi ༄snab rgyal rjedang zer sa der bod kyi dmag sgar yod pa la las mgon bya rog gdong can gyi spyan 'dren skabs dar dpe na gyis dmigs rnam rtse gcig pas me mda' rgyab pa na the da kyi dmag dpon chen po'i dpral bar phog ste bsad pa de yang las mgon bya rog gdong can gyi mthus bsgral ba yin pa se gas sngon sde srid gtsang pa dang / rjes su dge lugs pa dang se ga po'i dmag ci tsam cadangs kyang rnam pa kun du dpal ldan 'grag pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba de ni las mgon bya rog gdong can gyi mthu rtsal gyis yin par nges so 560

byu rog dbu zhwa srol gtod de mdzad mi de ni yi dam bde mchodag gi grub thob bla ma byung chub bcu na 'tshis yin la/ dus nam mdzad pa yin zhe na/ dus rabs 19pa'i nang gtsang dben dgon nas lto rdzongs 'dir gyon dus 'jigs med rnam rgyal dang sngon gyi las smon gyi mthu btsan pos mchodad yon du 'brel ba la/ thubs rje byung chub brtson 'grus de nyid kyis/ snyo rdzongs 'di nyid sngon nas las mgon bya rog gdong can gyis bsrungs shing bkyibs pa'i gdul zhing yin pas/ skru phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'byu thugs phyag mtshan gasnge/ma las/ sku phyag rgya las masku na bya ro/ga ga〈snang can gyi dathu zhwa bzos gnang ste gzungs gzhug dang rab gnas tshad ldan mdzad de byin gyis brlabs te gnang ba dang / de yang mgon po byang bdud dang las mgon bya rog gdong can thugs rgyud ngo bo gcig pa yin pas las mgon byu rog gdong can gyi dbu zhu dang / mgon po byang bdud kyi rten 'dzugs btsugs te gse la la rgyun ma chad par 'bul rgyu'i srol btod par mdzad pa yin no/ / bya rog dbu zhwa de bzhes pa las rten 'brel la nye ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/kyibs rje byang chub bce na 'grus kyis las mgon bya rog gdong can gyi skru phyag rgya bya rog dbu zhwa gyin gyis brlabs te gnang ba bzhes pa nas tshur/ dgra lha de gnyis la brten nas 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyis spyi lo 1865 la 'dzam bu'i gling na stobs shugs 'gran zla bral ba phyo gling pa dang gdung bsam bde ba thang la dmag rgyab pa'i skabs su'ang lhi gling pa las rgyal la thob pa dang / de'i rjes su 'dir 'grag rgyal khab tu yang rang 'dod phyags bcug mi ser brdab gsig btang ba'i dpon lag nang 'khrugs rgyun ma chad par hre nga mi thams cad rtsa med du 'joms te dgra'i phyogs 36 1

thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba de nyid las mgon bya rog gdong can gyis srung skyob sdong grogs lus dang grib bzhin 'bral med 'grogs te mdzad pa las byung ba yin/bo nga sa 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi skabs su/ bya ro/ga dbu zhwa bzhes pa las mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba phar zhog de'i sras 'byug rgyal dang po ma rgyan dbang phyug nas bzung brgyud 'dzin rgyal po rim gyon da lta'i bar phas kyi rgol ba thams cad zil gyis mnan nas ste/bas 'khyodar mnga' thang dar zhing rgyas te/ rgyal khab rang dbang rang btsan la chab 'bangs mi ser rnams kyang bde spyod kyi nyi ma shar te sdod rgyu byung ba yin la/ las mgon bya rog gdong can dang mgon po byung bdud ngo bo gcig yin pa ni kyibs rje rdo rje 'chang mkhyen brtse rin po ches zhal bkod gnang ste bde chen chos gling lta khang nang mgon po byang bdud bris pa de bya rog gi gdong yin pa'i phyir ro/ / zhes pa 'di yang dbu zhwa la bya rog gi mgo bkal te bzos pa ya mtshan gang yin nam snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir bris pacad/ /562

brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po gnyis pa 'jigs med dbang phyug gis bstan srid bskyangs pa/༄nyu/ / brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po gnyis pa 'jigs med dbang phyug ni/ yab sman ngas rgyal khab 'dir bka' drin mnyam med chodas kyi rgyal po ma rgyan dbang phyug la snam rin chen padmo gshegs mi nas sras mo a zhe dpal sgron dang g.yang 'dzom gnyis ma gtogs sras med par zur nas lcam dnge sa grub dpal smad serdzogs la shas bzhes kyang sras ma byung bar thugs gdung nas bzhugs pa'i dus dur pa'i gdung bka' mdo rgyud la mkhas pa'i sde sgod 'dzin pa che na po skye 'chi la rang dbang thob pa'i dge bshes spri na dug gis/ kur stod khol ma phyug po'i bu mo brtson 'grus lha mo btsun mo bzhes da gos par zhus pa bzhin dgung 'o/ zhe gnyis bzhes pa spyi 'o/ 1903 rab byung 15 chu mo thos lor lha ri gzim thug khyab bdag 'jigs med dpa' nyo dang chu bzang nam mtha' klong yangs kyi thugs sras mi rje rang gi dbu bla sbas yul rin po che kro zhabs srin las macesag gis tshe sgrub tshad ldan zhig bsgrubs pa'i tshe ril de/ gza' skar dus chos bzang po la bce na 'grus snya mos skye/ rgyan dbang phyug la phrul tshe bka' spos pa tshe ri nga chos ldan zer mi des/ 'bro ba'i mgon po'i zhal nas legs pa'i phyogs su rten 'brel bzang nge sgrogs/ / phran sum tshogs pa rang gis byed pas cerag / ces gsungs ge bzhin/ bkra shis brtags brgyad dang nyin mo bde legs kyi ri mo sa mtshan pa'i ke ra mdzod lag hu bzung nas/ / rgyal mchog khyod ni srong btsan sgam po yin/ / blon po nga ni mgar ba stong btsan yin/ / a rtse 'di ni rgya bza'i sprul pa yin/ / sku tshe 563

yun du brtan pa'i rten 'brel yod/ / ces zhus te rten 'brel gyi dge mtshan bzang po'i mtshams spyor bcas phul ba las btsun mor bzhes pa na/ dge bshes smin dug gis thugs gdung mi dgos sras myur du 'khrungs cadang zhes gsungs te mi ring par dge bshes smin dug 'o rang gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus te zhing khams gzhan du phebs pa'i tshul bstan 'dug/de nas shing sprul spyi lo 1905 la lha sras 'jigs med dbang phyug sku 'khrungs de ni dge bshes smin dug 'o rang sku tsho 'phos te bsam bzhin du chos kyi rgyal po'i lha sras su 'khrungs pa yin par bshad/ yab kyis dgung 'o/ chung dus nas 'bri klog gi yon tan dang lhag par sku tshab nor thu dang 'bras rdzongs pa phan tog nas nyin di'i skad yig slob spyong gnang bcug par mdzad/ dgung lo 14 sa rta spyi lo 1918 la chos 'bor rab brtan rtse'i mgron gnyer gyi go sa gnang nas yab kyi sku mdun du 'bral ba med par 'cham sgar pa'i sgrig rgyug ste mgyon po phyag dbang bcar zhu la sku gas pa ཿrdzos rje dpal ldan ltarabyug pa'i sgrig lam rnam gzhag la bying ba legs par mdzad bcug ste mi ring bar yab dben par gnas gsar du bcags pa'i kun bzang ceras gling du byon nas thugs dam la bston te bzhugs/ dgung lo 18 chu khyi spu lo 19de' zla 4tshos la yum a zhe brtson 'grus lha mo yun ring bsnyungs nas sman bcos kyis ma phan par sku tshe ma brtan par gshegs/ yab ceras rgyal chen po dang bcas pas sku rjes dang byams lha khang sogs su stong mchod khri phrag gis gtsos pa'i dgongs rdzogs rgya chen po bsgrubs par mdzad/dgung grangs 19 spyi lo 1923 chu phag zla 8 tshes la sngon yongs 'dzin ngag gi 564

dbang phyug gi gdan sa chodas 'khor rab brtan rtse'i dpon slob kyi khri la mnga' gsol mdzad de shar phyogs 'khor 'o/ rtsibs brgyad kyi mnga' bdag tu bzhugs pa'i skabs rgyal lcam yum lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje'i gdung dang yab gnyos kyi gdung dug 30sa 'jam dbyangs las 'grangs pa phran tshogs ཿtshes lha na lha lcam du bzhes nas bkra shis mnga' gsol gyi dga' ston rgyas par mdzad/ yum brtson 'grus lha mo'i sngar spyangs mdzad de 'bangs mi ser rnams la gnang rgyun gyis yid tshims par mdzad/ dgung grangs 'a'adru lo 19'jurab byung 15zad pa me stag lo la yab chodas rgyal chen po yang snyung gzhis zin nas sman dpyad zhabs brtan sku rim ji tsam bsgrubs rung cung zad kyang ma phan par rang zla 7 tshes 13 dang spyi zla 8 tshes 'anya la zhi bar gshegs/ de nas lha sar jo shāka rnam gnyis sku mdun du stong mchod kyis gtsos bod dathus gtsang lams gsum gyi che sa lugs ris med kyi dartse na sde grwa tshang lag dang / bla sprul skyes chen dam pa bzhugs so cog la bsngo smon dgongs rdzogs bsgrub rgyu bang mi chos 'bor gnas bskor ba dang chu smad sgo mang padma la ngo gnyog ched mngags kyis phul bar btang gnang zhing / snyo rdzongs 'dir yang dgon sde grwa tshang bla slob yod rigs rnams la bsnyen bkur rgya noms dang / mnga' cadag gi 'bangs mi ser rnams la'ang gnang spyin gzabs rgyas bcas dgongs rdzogs rgya chen po bsgrubs gnang bar rmed/ de sngar spyi lo 19'a' rab byung 15 chu khyi la yum brtson 'grus lha mo sku gshegs pa'i skabs/ yab ces rgyan dbang 〈snag pa/ma gshegs mi la thugs brtse ma bzod par gu ru'i sku rjes lha khang dang byams lha khang du stong mchodad khri gcig 'thul rgyur thugs dam bcas nas dpal ri'i gzhi 'dzin sras me a zhe dpal sgron nas dkar 565

nas mar chum sogs gnyer tshang 'gro sgo rnams thogs med gtong chodag yod pa'i thugs re gtad par/ a zhe des tshags su ma tshud pa na dbang gling nas byedas rtse'i maX na bgros skyorsha rgyan the rjes da res thugs gdung spyan nas spyan chab bab pa'i skabs stong mchod kshi gnyer tshang gang yang dbang gling nas bzhes chog yod pas stong mchod ma tshad gzhan yang 'aX 〈snan rigs 'di nas bzhes par zhu/ zhes zhus te gnyer tshang 'gro sgo zugs med zhabs phyod zhus par brten/ de sngar dgongs phogs yin pa la de nas bzung mgron bgres 6/ rgyan rdo rje thugs gtad dgongs gtad gyur nas bo pa dza/gas the na te yod pa'i skabs/ zam srung pa rnam rgyal 31gas mi ngan 'gas dkrugs shing byas pa la brten nas rgyal sras 'jigs med dbang phyug dang cerdzos rtse'i mgron bgres te/ rgyan rdo rje thugs nang ma gshin par ma da pa'i skabs/ rgyal sras 'jigs mong dbang phyug gi bongs nas ka srongs gong gzim bsod nams stobs rgyas dang dbyin ji'i gzhung nas yab kyi sprur ma byings gong 'byug rgyal gnyis pa'i gser khrir mnga' gsol phyir zla nya' tshes 17 la thum thang nas 'grag gzhung du chibs baspyod gnang nas zla dang po'i tshes gnyis la spungs thang du gser sbrengs rgyas pas bsu ba bca sa te phyags phebs/ dge /'dun grwa tshang la phyag mjal bka/'a 'gyur dang bsta ga 'gyur/ ba men/ rgyu nag gos rnying spus legs gyi 'cham gos sum cu so lnga za 'og gi per dgu bcas phul gnang / yab kyi dgongs rdzogs su spungs thang du dbu rtse'i rgyu pibs gser zangs las gsar du bzhings rgyu'i las 'go btsugs par mdzad/de nas ñtsa lo )9ku' 7 rab byung 16 me yos zla dang po'i chos 11 dgung grangs nyer sasu ma pa zhabs da nga snye'ajigs med rdo rje rje ma lan sgo sri zhi rnam rgyal gyis dbu 566

gtsos pa'i 'dus sde rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang / dbyin gzhung skru tshab sgang tog sa heb eg em bha'i le/ me jar lcanas/ sheg ṭar re nyam/ leb )nan sumase sher/ 'bras rdzongs rgyal po'i sku tshab ka ji sogs dang gdan sa srongs thang rdzong dang / dbang 'dus pho brang / them phyag bkra shis ཿtshes rdzong gdan sa gsum gyis gtsos pa'i rdzong dpon rnams dang phyogs kyi spya bla chos 'khor rab brtan rtse dang / spa spo rin chen srongs/ dar dkar bkra shis yang rtse gsum sogs lha mi srid sde tshogs pa'i dbus su yab mes gong ma'i gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por tsan dan bkod pa'i rgyal khab kyi skye dgu'i bdag po chodas kyi rgyal po chen por mnga' gsol bar mdzad/ dbyin gzhung sku tshab nas rtags ma ( si yo'i i ) legs dar dang bcas pa dang / de bzhin gzhungagi da pon lag che chung dang mnga' 'bangs mi ser dug zhan thams cad kyis khri ston gyi 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa phyal ba 'byedar/ sngar yab rje'i dus nas phyo 'byug gzhung gnyis mthun lam gang legs skyodad pa de bzhin chings yig don tshan 10 ma da pa las 'gal med mdzad cing mdza' brtse'i 'brel pa sngar las dam zab hu gyur pa sogs dbyin gzhung la bka' drin che ba'i bstod bsngags gral dbus su sku bzhengs te legs sbyar thogs pa med pa gsungs/gser btul ma zho brgya dang lnga bcus skrangs rdzong lha khang yod rigs nang bzhugs pa'i sku rten rnams la zhal gser phrul/ dathu rtse'i rgya phibs kyang zangs sgron dmar las gsar du bsgrubs nas gser rta la chig rnyasnang nyis brgya tham pas legs par grub ste phul nas rab gnas byas/ gser btul ma terdzo la dug brgya tsam gyis dgon sde grwa tshang lag gi sku rten rnams la zhal gser phul/ gser khri mnga' gserdzol 567

dang ཿtshes mthun gyi mdzad sgo rnams legs par tshib nas/ rgyal blon 'khor bcas rnams slar sum thang du phebs te zla 7 tshes 15 la rdzogs che na mkhan po thub bstan snyan grags dang / ban chen mkhan po sku gas phyogs gzhan gyi bla ma rnams dang 'dus sde dang rab sde'i bla ma mkhan po dge 'dun mang po gdan dungs te yab kyi sprur byings par mjordod/spyi lo 19'a8 zla 5 tshes 'a rab byung 16 sa pho 'byug lo zla 3 tshes 13 la/ gza' skar 'phyod spyor dge ba'i nyin chos rtse'i rgyas spang gzim chung du lha sras 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug sku bltams/ lha sras 'khrungs pa'i dgyes ston dkon mche ga la mchod pa dang chab 'bangs mi ser sku ngas la gnang spyin dpag med stsal/ mtha' dbus phyogs mtshams kun nas lha sras rin po cher bkra shis bde legs khri ston 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas mnga' thang dgung du sgyur ba'i legs tshogs rten 'brel bsgrigs/spyi lo 19'tsho rab byung 16 sa sgrul la sngar dung dkar pa rnam rgyal gyi bzhugs gnas te la zer ba der dgun gyi bzhugs gnas kun dga' rab brtan gyi rdzong gsar du bzhengs/ lugs gnyis gī bka' khrims bzang po'i srol gyis mnga' 'bangs rnams byams pas skyong bzhin du bzhugs pa na slar yang spyi lo 1931 rabatsung 16lcags lug la ngabyin gzhung nas sku tshab ched mngags kyis rtags ma ke si a'i i 'bul gnang mdzad/— de sngar maputren gnyer bgres pa dang thugs snang ma malngan par bzhugs pa la/de nas masan bgres kyi yum chodas sgron gyis rgyal lcam phun tshogs chodas sgron gyi sring mo 568

padma bde chen kyi spyod sdug kyang mi rje nyid rang gis gzigs gnang dgos shing / de bzhin dbang gling gzhi 'dzin padma bde chen labarten pa'i dbang 'dus chodas gling gi pha gzhis kyang mi rje nyid rang gis bdag 'dzin mdzad gnang dgos 'byung nges pas phran rmos zhu de na thugs la mnga' bar zhu/ zhes zhus pa las spye mtshe 193'a rabakhu/nga 16 chu sprel la rgyal lcam skru gzhon a zhe padma bde chen khab hu bzhes te ceras rtse'i mgron bgres o rgyan rdo rje dang thugs snang gtsang mar gyur te dbang 'dus chodas gling gi rdzong phyag tu bzhes/ khams nas dze gar mcherag sprul rin po che byon pa na spyin bdag dang zhu bskul mdzad gnang ste dkyil che ga rdo rje 'phreng ba sogs kyi dbang lung khrid gsum sogs chodas 'bor rab brtan rtser mi rje mnga' bdag rin po che rang nyid rgya la lcam lga chogs chodas sgron chodas rtse'i 'dus sde'i bla slob bcas pa la chodas kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i phyir sngar yab rje dam pa'i phyag srol bzhin du rme sa rtse'i grwa tshang nas 'brang la pa padma/ thum thang chu smad gzhu ri pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan 'aX ga sgar pa tshe ring / shar phyogs g.yung dung pa rdo rje bcas 'ong bzhi mdo khams zur mang du brtan mkhas gī yon tan ldan pa mkhan pe macerag gsal gyi grang du gzhung chen bcu gas/ma se gas mde sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa la 6was bsam byed par btang gnang bar mdzad/rgyal khab srung spyob kyi don du thugs bzhed gnang ste rgya gar dkrogs mda' shel pa'i lag mda' 〈snang phrag gcig gsar grub mdzad gnang /spyi lo 1933 rab byung 16 chu bya la sman rdzongs rgyal khab kyi bstan spye'i sku rim dang 'brel chos 'khor rab brtan rtse'i rdzong nang du de sngar 'jigs byed kyi sku 569

med par brten 'jigs byed lha khang gsar pa bzhengs par mdzad/ sku mched dug sgo sa rdo rje skru gshegs nas dgongs rdzogs rgya chen po sgrub gnang bar mdzad/ spyi lo 1934 rab byung 16 shing sprel la gong sa 'jigs med dbang phyug rgyal lcam phran tshogs chodas sgron bcas lhan rgyas dbyin gzhung gi sku mgron du ka li ka tar gdan 'dren zhus te gyon nas mu lug lar dang mjal 'phrad mdzad nas thugs dgyes spro dang mthun lam sngar las gong 'phel du gyur/ ka li ka ta nas slar gyon lam ka sprungs dang sgang tog brgyud de nyas rdzong du gyon/ gong gzim bsod nams stobs rgyas yab yum rnams kyis phebs bsu brnyan bkur rgyas par zhus te thugs spro tshad med byung zheng mnyes par mdzad/der gong gzim bse da nams stobs rgyas kyis mnga' 'bangs mi ser rnams kyi dpya khral rigs phab chag gnang bar zhus pa bzhin thugs byams brtse'i gzigs pa chen pos phab chag gtan 'bebs thog mar has rdzong mnga' cadag nas 'go btsugs gnang ste rim par rin spungs rdzong / thim rdzong / gsang zab rdzong rnams su bzhugs nas thim phya khul gyi rdzong dang dgon sde lag tshang mar gzigs zhib mdzad de dbang 'dus pho brang rdzong du byon nas rim bzhin chos 'khor rab rtan rtser phyag phebs so/ /spyi lo 1937 rab byung 16 me glang la rgyal lcam phran tshogs cerdzos sgron gyi bzhugasaganas chu stod dom mkhar snag tshang du dbyar gyi bzhugs gnas bkra shis ceras gling rdzong gsar bzhengs gnang / dbang 'dus che sa gling du rgyal lcam sku gzhon pa padma bde chen la sras mo a lke cerdzos spyod 'khrungs/ sngon rgyal ba le ras grags pa dbang phyug gi gdan sa de'i rjes su kun mkhyen klong chen rab byams kyi gdan sa thar pa gling 570

med par brten 'jigs byed lha khang gsar pa bzhengs par mdzad/ sku mched dug sgo sa rdo rje skru gshegs nas dgongs rdzogs rgya chen po sgrub gnang bar mdzad/ spyi lo 1934 rab byung 16 shing sprel la gong sa 'jigs med dbang phyug rgyal lcam phran tshogs chodas sgron bcas lhan rgyas dbyin gzhung gi sku mgron du ka li ka tar gdan 'dren zhus te gyon nas mu lug lar dang mjal 'phrad mdzad nas thugs dgyes spro dang mthun lam sngar las gong 'phel du gyur/ ka li ka ta nas slar gyon lam ka sprungs dang sgang tog brgyud de nyas rdzong du gyon/ gong gzim bsod nams stobs rgyas yab yum rnams kyis phebs bsu brnyan bkur rgyas par zhus te thugs spro tshad med byung zheng mnyes par mdzad/der gong gzim bse da nams stobs rgyas kyis mnga' 'bangs mi ser rnams kyi dpya khral rigs phab chag gnang bar zhus pa bzhin thugs byams brtse'i gzigs pa chen pos phab chag gtan 'bebs thog mar has rdzong mnga' cadag nas 'go btsugs gnang ste rim par rin spungs rdzong / thim rdzong / gsang zab rdzong rnams su bzhugs nas thim phya khul gyi rdzong dang dgon sde lag tshang mar gzigs zhib mdzad de dbang 'dus pho brang rdzong du byon nas rim bzhin chos 'khor rab rtan rtser phyag phebs so/ /spyi lo 1937 rab byung 16 me glang la rgyal lcam phran tshogs cerdzos sgron gyi bzhugasaganas chu stod dom mkhar snag tshang du dbyar gyi bzhugs gnas bkra shis ceras gling rdzong gsar bzhengs gnang / dbang 'dus che sa gling du rgyal lcam sku gzhon pa padma bde chen la sras mo a lke cerdzos spyod 'khrungs/ sngon rgyal ba le ras grags pa dbang phyug gi gdan sa de'i rjes su kun mkhyen klong chen rab byams kyi gdan sa thar pa gling 570

du dge bshes bstan pa rin chen gyis bshad grwa dang / chu smad nyi ma lung du rdo ring sprul skus bshad grwa gsar pa btsugs/ nyi ma lung gi bshad grwa'i spyin bdag chu smad pye nga pa yin na yang rdo ring sprul skus mnga' bdag rgyal po rang nyid la zhus pa bzhin nang gi sku rten dang ldeb ris sogs 'jigs med dbang phyug rang gis 'jim bzo'i slob dpon dngos grub/ dam chodas sogs 'jim bzo lnga dang / lha bris pa'i slob dpon kun bzang / ta'u ta'u sogs lha bris pa bdun btang gnang ste tshang ma mi rje rang nas mdzad/ nang gi gzungs zhugs dang mche da chas rol mo dung mcherd rdzas rgyal mtshan 'phan phye 'a thur se gas rgyal lcam phran cesags cheras rje na gyis gnang bar mdzad de las mthug bsdus te bla ma yang dge bshes padma bskos gnang nas zla dang po'i nang zhing sgrub btsugs rgyu'i yo byad dang / zla bzhi pa'i nang smyung gnas kyi yo byad/ rtag par phyo dro'i thun mjug bzang spyod ma chad par gtang rgyu'i yo byad ma dngul spyor 'jags mdzad gnang zhing thur pa'i sgrub chen btsugs te mi rje rang nyid yang yang gyon pa dang / bla mas chodas thun gnang gi yod med dang grwa pas slob spyong byed kyi yod med lta bar 'phral 'phral bshad grwa gnyis gar gtang gi sku1da/spyi 'o/ 1939 rab byung 16 sa ma sa la 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa langs nas dbyin gzhung dang mashun lam dam zab kyi gnang pa brten mi ser nas thab khral dngul bsdus pa'i khar gzhung nas bsnan te ༷ gas ram gyi tshul du gnang / spyi lo 194'a rab byung 16 chu rta la spungs thang bde chen pho brang dge 'dun 'dus tshogs rgya mtsho dang gzhan yang phyogs phyogs kyi dgon sde grwa tshang gi bla slob grwa pa se gas 'khor slob 'dus pa sum ste/nga lnga brgya tsam la rje byams mgon ngag dbang phrin las kyis 571

dpal ldan 'grag pa'i snu sa skor gyi smin spol zab khrid gnang ba'i bstan pa'i spyin bdag mdzad/ spyi lo nya943 rab byung 16 chu lug la dbang 'dus chodas gling du lha sras rnam rgyal dbang phyug 'khrungs/ spu lo 1944 rab byung 16 shing sprel la sras mo a zhe bde rgyud dbyangs 'dzom 'chings/ spyi lo 1945 rab byung 16 shing bya la lha sras 'jigasamed rdo rje dbang phyug mchodag ce sa 'khor rab brtan rtse'i masan gnyer gyi go gnas la mnga' gse la gnang / sngon yab rje'i skabs emi kul has dang thum thang du ma gtogs med par rgyal lab yar rgyas thon thabs dang mi ser la shes sku na thob pa ha cang dka' bar gzigs te has dang spa spo dbang 'dus pho brang sum thang shar khyodags bkra shis sgang sku(gas rnams snge/ yisi kul lag mang nge yang bsresags gnang bar mdzad/ rgya gzhi'i sa khral da sngar 'ordzo rer chig 'thum re yin pa mi rje 'jigs med dbang phyug 'di'i skabs nas 'o/ga ldab 'phar te rub nyis 'thum re 'thob rgyu bzos/spyi lo 1947 rab byung 16 me phag la rgya gar gzhung rang bang thob pa'i rjes su rgya 'grag chings yig gsar pa bzo rgyu'i dgo ngas bzhed kyis 'grag gzhung rgyal blon spyi'i sku tshab gong gzim bsod nams stobs rgyas dang / dbyangs slob o rgyan lhun grub/ gong sa'i gzim nang mkha' 'gro/ rin sprungs gzim dpon rta mgrin dpal 'byor/ has dung pa 'jigs med dpal ldan rdo rje bcas lgi lo 1948 rab byung 16 sa byi lo zla 3 pa'i nang rgyal sa di lir blon chen paṇa ṭi ta zhes ru dang phyi 'brel las khungs la rang re'i rgyal lab kyi bde sdug bka' smadal zhu bar btang gnang 572

ba'i skabs kyi brjod tshig la/sngon phyi gling pa rnams rig pa dang stobs shugs gang bas rgyas pa'i skabs dbang gtsongs mgo bskor 'phrul thabs kyis rgya gar dbang du bsdus pa'i dus su rang cag 'grug gi rgya gzhi thams cad kyang 'phyogs te sa cha rnams kyi bral yang ming tsa3/ zhig ma gtogs 1snad ma btub/ snga rjes bar gsum bde sdug rgyu kyen ji ltar bshad rung sa khral yang 'phar tshul re min pa ma sprod kyang rgyal lab tshe chung mgo dang brag lta bu thug ste blo pham ngang la sdod rgyu las bya thabs ma byung / da char phyo gling pa rnams rang yul du log ste rgya gar la rang dbang rang btsan thob pa ma zad/ rgya gzhung nas rang cag shar phyogs kyi rgyal khab thams cad la rang mgo rang thon thub pa'i rogs ram gnang rgyu skusgogs gsungs bzhin 'dug pa ni phran rnams dga' spyo dpag med thob yod/ rang re'i rgya gzhi phyo gling pas 'phyog bzhag pa rnams nas yul grong dang ja zhing sku1da pa rnams rang 'jags bzhag nas nags tshal gyi sa cha rnams phyir log gnang rgyu zhes dang / de ltar ma byung tshe sa khral yar 'phar dgos rgyu zhus par rgya gar blon chen pan 3 ta zhe he ru dang phyo 'brel las khungs nas rgya gzhung gi tshogs 'du lhan rgyas thog la bsnyun gros ma rgyab par sa cha spyod rgyu dang / sa khral yar 'phar skor gyi gtam lan spyod mi shes zer nas/ rang cag don tshan gyi yi ge len bzhag ste/ rgya gzhung macesag nas 'grag gzhung dang 〈snags bshes mthun lam gang legs bya rgyu yin zhes yig thog hu spyod nas sku tshab rnams phyir log/de rjes sa glang lor chings don thag bcad bzos chog pa'i dbang bya gnang ste 573

'byug gzhung sku tshab rnams dang blon chen paṇa ḍi ta zhe ha ru maḥtsheg nas mthun lam gyi dgongs pa rgya cher bzhed de rgya gzhung kri tshab 'bras spyi ha ri rā yal nas sa nyi rgyab chog pa'i dbang bya gnang ste spyi lo 1949 rang lo rab byung 16 sa glang zla 6 tshes 15nyin rdor gling twa bhar nar gyi ko khrir rgya 'byug chings yig bzos don/gdung bsam dhe wang gi ri nas nags tshal sa cha me li sum cu serdzo gnyis gru bzhi phyir log sprod rgyu/ deng skabs dngul la rin thang chung bas sa khral sngon ma'i thog 'bum gsum yar 'phar bzos te lo rer ti rub 'bum lnga re len rgyu dang / phyi'i rgyal khab nas 'grag rgyal nge dang 'byug gzhung la dacerdzos chas rigs 6dzang khral ma phog par rgya gzhung nas tshong lam gtang rgyu/ 'phrul 'khor gyi rigs kyang gang dgos nyo che ga pa ma zad/ 'byug pa'i sa mtshams dang nye char gyi ja zhing ka mān nang gi 'gro lam yang khral dang bkag cha med par btang cerag pa/ khrims 'gal byed pa'i mi rigs rgyal khab gnyis phyogs nas rtsis len rtsis spyodad bya cesag pa/ rgya gzhung la bka' slob re zhu rgyu ma gtogs rang re'i rgyal khab nang 'khod rang dbang rang btsan du rgya gzhung nas phyogs gtogs gang yang gnang rgyu med pa'i chings yig bzos/ lo der sku mched kro gzhon garma phrin las lhun grub kur stod du bzhugs pa bsnyungs te sman bcos sku rim sku gas kyis phan thub ma mchis par sku gshegs te skru sprur sum thang du gdan dungs te dmi pa zhwa dmar pa'i gdan sa thang khris su spur byings te dgongs rdzogs rgya chen po bsgrubs gnang bar mdzad/spyi lo 1949 rab byung 16 sa glang lo la spa spo dpon slob tshe ring dpal 'byor sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs rgyas par bsgrubs gnang / dbang 'dus chodas gling 574

du sras mo chung ba a zhe padma che sa sgron 'khyungs/ lcags stag spu lo 1950 la lha sras 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug spa spo dpon slob khri la rin mings spyi blar mnga' gsol bar 3yi/da/ spyi lo 1951 rab byung 15 lcags yos la ka sprungs su gong gzim bsod nams stobs rgyas dang ra ṇi chodas dbyings dbang mo'i sras mo chung ba rigs rus yon tan sogs kyis phyug pa skal bzang ceras rje na rgyal lcam du bkra shis mnga' gse la mdzad gnang ba sogs chodas rgyal 'jigs med dbang phyug 'di'i ring la che sa dang srid kyi lugs gnyis sngar las dar zhing rgyas thabs dang mi ser rnams bde spyid dang ldan thabs chad na thugs la dasgo ngas par mdzad pa yin/de yang sngon thog nas mi ser la la zur pa zhes rgyu sgungs kyi khral gang yang ma sgog par bka' 31ga khra mas bcad de sdod mkhan yod pa dang / yul spongs phal che bar dud tshang mi rabs chad song rung de'i khral yul/ grong de la phog ste dmang gis 'jal dgos pa'i sredal yod pa de rnams khral med zur pa rnams rabs chad pa'i rtsa stong gi khral tshab la btsugs gnang zhing khral phog rnams kyi rigs la yab rje sku nga ma'i bka' khra chen mo nas phab chag mdzad/ rdzong gzhi sku sku 'i rtswa sril dang shing sril gnyer tshang 'a〈sna dasku sa kyi rigs thams cad slar yang phab chag mdzad de bcad rgya dam don gnang / mi ser nas sngar srol rta rgod ma yod rigs nas rti'u mo skyes na rang bdag dang / pho skyes na gzhung la phul dgos pa de'ang slad phyin chad phyal ma dgos ge'i yangs chag gnang ba ma tshad/ mi ser mi khrod nyung ba rnams la dos 'u lag skyel rgyu'i don rta re gsol ras gnang ba sogs mi ser rnams la byams skyong tshad med kyi 575

du sras mo chung ba a zhe padma che sa sgron 'khyungs/ lcags stag spu lo 1950 la lha sras 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug spa spo dpon slob khri la rin mings spyi blar mnga' gsol bar 3yi/da/ spyi lo 1951 rab byung 15 lcags yos la ka sprungs su gong gzim bsod nams stobs rgyas dang ra ṇi chodas dbyings dbang mo'i sras mo chung ba rigs rus yon tan sogs kyis phyug pa skal bzang ceras rje na rgyal lcam du bkra shis mnga' gse la mdzad gnang ba sogs chodas rgyal 'jigs med dbang phyug 'di'i ring la che sa dang srid kyi lugs gnyis sngar las dar zhing rgyas thabs dang mi ser rnams bde spyid dang ldan thabs chad na thugs la dasgo ngas par mdzad pa yin/de yang sngon thog nas mi ser la la zur pa zhes rgyu sgungs kyi khral gang yang ma sgog par bka' 31ga khra mas bcad de sdod mkhan yod pa dang / yul spongs phal che bar dud tshang mi rabs chad song rung de'i khral yul/ grong de la phog ste dmang gis 'jal dgos pa'i sredal yod pa de rnams khral med zur pa rnams rabs chad pa'i rtsa stong gi khral tshab la btsugs gnang zhing khral phog rnams kyi rigs la yab rje sku nga ma'i bka' khra chen mo nas phab chag mdzad/ rdzong gzhi sku sku 'i rtswa sril dang shing sril gnyer tshang 'a〈sna dasku sa kyi rigs thams cad slar yang phab chag mdzad de bcad rgya dam don gnang / mi ser nas sngar srol rta rgod ma yod rigs nas rti'u mo skyes na rang bdag dang / pho skyes na gzhung la phul dgos pa de'ang slad phyin chad phyal ma dgos ge'i yangs chag gnang ba ma tshad/ mi ser mi khrod nyung ba rnams la dos 'u lag skyel rgyu'i don rta re gsol ras gnang ba sogs mi ser rnams la byams skyong tshad med kyi 575

thugs rje mnga' ba yin/ mi bsad kyi stong sngar snurmes rje 'byug pa'i khrims lugs mi bsad lag dmar pa lag zin 'edi na gasku na gshin mnyam sbugs chu la bskyur ba dang /lag dmar pa lag zin ma byung tsho mi bsad pa'i nyes chad la/ sde srid la thog mar dgongs skor zhu rten zong gsum tshan gcig dang mtshan 'thus ma ṭam nyi shu lnga/ lhan rgyas chogs sar zhu rten zong thub gcig sa gnas kyi bdag po la zhu rten zong thub gcig mgro na gserdzo par yig rten cadang thub gcig me btang phul chag ma ṭam nyi shā lnga/ de nas stong dngos gzhir sde srid la phul chas ma ṭam khal chen phyed dang gnyis/phyag mjal zong thub gcig gzim sgar pa'i lam 'jug khal chen phyed dang gnyis /so so'i sa gnas kyi bdag por yang de mtshungs/ lhan thog khal chen phyed dang gnyis/bod kyi lam 'jug nyi dza/ bco lnga/ zhu rten gsum tshan gcig phyag mjal thub gcigaphyogs soso'i mgron gnyer la yang de dang mtshungs/ gong gzim la nyi shu phyed dang brgyad/ zhu rten thub gcig phyogs so so'i gzim dpon la yang de dang mtshungs/mgron gse par nyi dza/ gsum dang rtsa bcerdzo lnga/ zhu rten thub gcig phyag mjal thub gcig phyogs so so'i mgron gnyer gzim dpon la yang de dang mtshungs/ dung par nyi shu phyed dang brgyad/ shi mkhan gyi yul mi la'ang dge ba bsgrub rgyur dge stong nyi shu bce lnga zhu rten phyag mjal dang bcas bsnge mas khal chen bcu gnyis nyi dza/ bcu tham pa 'bro dgos yod pa dang gzhan yang khrims 'gal byed mi rnams kyi nyes chad che chung thams cad las mgyon gnyer gzim dpon sogs dang / nyes chad de'i yul gyi rdzong bdag bcas la sngar sredal dpya shag 'bul dgos pa rnams kyang spyod len bya mi chotsheg pa dang / nyes chad gzhung gi de rang phyal bas 'thus pa'i bka' 31ga gnang /576

thugs rje mnga' ba yin/ mi bsad kyi stong sngar snurmes rje 'byug pa'i khrims lugs mi bsad lag dmar pa lag zin 'edi na gasku na gshin mnyam sbugs chu la bskyur ba dang /lag dmar pa lag zin ma byung tsho mi bsad pa'i nyes chad la/ sde srid la thog mar dgongs skor zhu rten zong gsum tshan gcig dang mtshan 'thus ma ṭam nyi shu lnga/ lhan rgyas chogs sar zhu rten zong thub gcig sa gnas kyi bdag po la zhu rten zong thub gcig mgro na gserdzo par yig rten cadang thub gcig me btang phul chag ma ṭam nyi shā lnga/ de nas stong dngos gzhir sde srid la phul chas ma ṭam khal chen phyed dang gnyis/phyag mjal zong thub gcig gzim sgar pa'i lam 'jug khal chen phyed dang gnyis /so so'i sa gnas kyi bdag por yang de mtshungs/ lhan thog khal chen phyed dang gnyis/bod kyi lam 'jug nyi dza/ bco lnga/ zhu rten gsum tshan gcig phyag mjal thub gcigaphyogs soso'i mgron gnyer la yang de dang mtshungs/ gong gzim la nyi shu phyed dang brgyad/ zhu rten thub gcig phyogs so so'i gzim dpon la yang de dang mtshungs/mgron gse par nyi dza/ gsum dang rtsa bcerdzo lnga/ zhu rten thub gcig phyag mjal thub gcig phyogs so so'i mgron gnyer gzim dpon la yang de dang mtshungs/ dung par nyi shu phyed dang brgyad/ shi mkhan gyi yul mi la'ang dge ba bsgrub rgyur dge stong nyi shu bce lnga zhu rten phyag mjal dang bcas bsnge mas khal chen bcu gnyis nyi dza/ bcu tham pa 'bro dgos yod pa dang gzhan yang khrims 'gal byed mi rnams kyi nyes chad che chung thams cad las mgyon gnyer gzim dpon sogs dang / nyes chad de'i yul gyi rdzong bdag bcas la sngar sredal dpya shag 'bul dgos pa rnams kyang spyod len bya mi chotsheg pa dang / nyes chad gzhung gi de rang phyal bas 'thus pa'i bka' 31ga gnang /576

sngar nas gzhung dang dpon lag rnams kyi dos skyel lngar las rnams mi ser rnams kyi bral yin pa la gla rngan spyod sku la med kyang / rgyal po 'di'i sku thog nas gla ri na gnang rgyu mdzad/dus skabs der bkra shis sgang rdzong dpon rdo phag la bskos pas bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs ldan rdzong gsar pa legs par bzhengs/ lhun rtse'i rdzong dpon kun bzang rnam rgyal/ gzhal sgang rdzong dpon phrin las rnam rgyal/ gzhong sgar rdzong dpon kun bzang dbang 'dus/ chodas 'bor rab brtan rtse'i sku tshab mgyon gnyer gyang tshi/ke bang 'dus pho brang rdzong tshab mgron gnyer shar padma dbang 'dus/ mings thang bde ba chen po'i rdzong tshab mgar sa'i rdzong dpon a thang pa tshogs li/ sprungs rdzong gzim da pon bstod pa rgyal mtshan/ spungs rdzong gnyer chen sha ra sgang rgyab pa mkha' 'gro/khrim phya bkra shis gle sa rdzong sku tshab rug khris bstan 'dzin/ rim gzim gyo cung / rim sum̐ gnyer chen dga' seng pa kun dga'/ dar dkar bkra shis yangs rtse'i sku tshab na lon pa rdor legs/ spa spo rin chen spungs pa'i gdan rdzong sku tshab gnyer bgres tshe ri nga rdo rje nas bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs dasku na lag la mchod rdzas se gas rgya cher snyi tsal/ rin gzim rta mgrin dpal 'byor nas rin sprungs rdzong nang gsang chen chodas 'khor/ stag tshang dpal phyag skyer chu'i lha khang sku gas la nyams gaskusgo rgya cher zhus/rin srongs gnyer chen thum thang gtam zhing rgya gar/ 'byug rgyal :snang da〈snan ka wang sangs rgyas/ has grang pa 'jigs med dpal ldan rdo rje/ kyibs khra dpon slob snag cung / gong sa'i chibs zhon pa mgron gasku pa shal rnga srid rgyal/ gzim nang spa spo rgya gar bkra shis/ bod lha sar sku tshab lo phyag pa has stod pa nor thu dang / rgya gar la 577

sngar nas gzhung dang dpon lag rnams kyi dos skyel lngar las rnams mi ser rnams kyi bral yin pa la gla rngan spyod sku la med kyang / rgyal po 'di'i sku thog nas gla ri na gnang rgyu mdzad/dus skabs der bkra shis sgang rdzong dpon rdo phag la bskos pas bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs ldan rdzong gsar pa legs par bzhengs/ lhun rtse'i rdzong dpon kun bzang rnam rgyal/ gzhal sgang rdzong dpon phrin las rnam rgyal/ gzhong sgar rdzong dpon kun bzang dbang 'dus/ chodas 'bor rab brtan rtse'i sku tshab mgyon gnyer gyang tshi/ke bang 'dus pho brang rdzong tshab mgron gnyer shar padma dbang 'dus/ mings thang bde ba chen po'i rdzong tshab mgar sa'i rdzong dpon a thang pa tshogs li/ sprungs rdzong gzim da pon bstod pa rgyal mtshan/ spungs rdzong gnyer chen sha ra sgang rgyab pa mkha' 'gro/khrim phya bkra shis gle sa rdzong sku tshab rug khris bstan 'dzin/ rim gzim gyo cung / rim sum̐ gnyer chen dga' seng pa kun dga'/ dar dkar bkra shis yangs rtse'i sku tshab na lon pa rdor legs/ spa spo rin chen spungs pa'i gdan rdzong sku tshab gnyer bgres tshe ri nga rdo rje nas bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs dasku na lag la mchod rdzas se gas rgya cher snyi tsal/ rin gzim rta mgrin dpal 'byor nas rin sprungs rdzong nang gsang chen chodas 'khor/ stag tshang dpal phyag skyer chu'i lha khang sku gas la nyams gaskusgo rgya cher zhus/rin srongs gnyer chen thum thang gtam zhing rgya gar/ 'byug rgyal :snang da〈snan ka wang sangs rgyas/ has grang pa 'jigs med dpal ldan rdo rje/ kyibs khra dpon slob snag cung / gong sa'i chibs zhon pa mgron gasku pa shal rnga srid rgyal/ gzim nang spa spo rgya gar bkra shis/ bod lha sar sku tshab lo phyag pa has stod pa nor thu dang / rgya gar la 577

sku tshab gong gzim bsod nams stobs rgyas/ spa spo dpon slob tshe ring dpal 'byor serdzogs bsko sa te dpal ldan 'grag pa'i gdan sa rnams mi nyams shing chab 'bangs mi ser gyi spyod sdug rnams lta ba'i gdan 'dzin rnams bskos te yul tshan so sor grang 'khor dang rgad po spyi dpon las tshan bcas lugs gnyis kyi bka' khrims dam 〈snar bsdams/sle ba grwa lag nas thu tsha me 〉ga pā si thon pa phal cher dung tsho dang / slab grwa'i hre ba dpon nags tshal gakrerdzog sku gas byings nas rgyal khab nang gzhan la re mi dgos pa'i thabs shes mdzad/ bu tsha phal cher rgya gar shi 'ordzong se gas la rgyal khab srung skyob kyi den la dmag spyong slob par btang nas dmag mi'i slob dpon bzos/ sa mtshams rnams su cerdzom kun gyi 'jigs spyodab tu sa srung dmag mir bzhag pa dang / dpag bsam la nas yar mi ser la phan phyir tshong lam gsar pa bag sa pa skusgogs mdzad pa bkying bzhin bzhugs pa na dbang 'dus snu sa gling gi pho brang mdun gyi lha dar dum gsum du chag pa dang / tshos bzhi'i nyin dgung zla ba'i rwa rtser skar ma mdangs can shar ba dang / mang sde'i chu nas sngar med pa'i sems can ma 'du ba thon pa dang /mang sde'i chu bo mdog 'gyur ba dang / srungs thang rdzong chung gi rten gtso bo ston pa'i sku las khrag babs pa dang / kun dga' rab brtan du phyag mda' gnang sar bzhugs pa'i tshe dag gur gyi shing chag pa sku gas mtshan ma ngan pa du ma shar ba de thams cad ཿtshes rgyal 'jigs med dbang phyug sku tshe mi brtan pa'i rtags su shar zhing byung ba yin 'dug pas snyung gzhi yang cher med pa nas spya lo 195'a rabasgyung 16pa'i chu 'byug zla dang po'i tshes gnam sgang la kun dga' rab brtan du snurmes rje dpal 578

ldan 'byug pa'i chab srid ཿwas bzhin du lo nyi shu tsa dug gi bar legs par bskyangs te spyod pa'i nyi ma dgung du nub pa bzhin sku zhi bar gshegs pa yin no/ /'byug brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po gsum pa 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug gis chab srid bkyings tshul ni/༄༄ / / brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po gsum pa 'jigs med rdo rje dbang sgyus byu /ba gong sa/ 'jigs med rnam rgyal nas rim par brgyud pa'i 'jigs med dbang phyug zheng /yum dug sgo sa 'jam dbyangs dang /ma zhe bde mchodag gi sras mo phran tshogs chodas sgron gyi sras su spyi lo 19'do dang rab byung 1 6 pa'i sa 'byug zla ba 3 pa'i tshes 13 la chodas 'khor da ba brtan rtse'i rgyas spang gi gzim cung du sku 'khrungs/ lha sras 'khrungs pa'i dga' ston rgyas par dzod cing legs dar phyal ba mang du 'gyor/ dgung lo bdun brgyad tsam nas nang snu sa kyi yongs 'dzin dge bshes a jo pa sangs dang / dbyin yig gi slob dpon gā bu bkra shis las phyo nang gi skad yi be 'bri klog sogs slob spyong mdzad skabs thugs rig 'gran zla dang bral ba mnga' bar grags/ sku na gshodan dus nas yab kyi sku mdun du 'cham sgar pa'i sgrigs rgyugs te cerdzos rje dpal ldan 'byug pa'i ring 'a/gas gtsang ma sgrig lam rnam gzhag la bying ba mdzad bcug spyi 'o1 1945 me bya dgung grangs bco brgyad la ཿwas 'bor rab brtan rtse re mgron gnyer gyi go gnas bzhes/ de na 4 ing lan du slob spyong mdzad par gyon/ spu lo 1950579

lcags stag dgung grangs nyi sde/ tsa gsum la spa spyod dpon hre ba go gnas bzhes/ 'grug rgyal lab 'di'i nang ceras srid lugs gnyis ga'i bstan pa'i don la zhabs tog 'byor ba'i ming dang gtam thon pa tshe sa rgyal ma rgyan dbang phyug dang chodas blon 61 rgyan rdo rje gnyis yin pa shes ldan kun gyis mkhyen gsal bzhin yin pas/ 'khu/nga 'a//ra slad ma'i char yang cheras rje dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bstan pa'i la rgyar dgongs te cheras rgyal brgyud 'dzin lha sras 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug mchodag la chodas blon brgyud 'dzin gong gzim bsod nams stobs rgyas dang rā ni chos dbyings dbang mo'i sras mo chung ba skal bzang mas sgron spyi lo 1951 rab byung 16 pa'i lcags mo yos lor 'grag spa gro rin sprungs rdzong du gza' skar rten 'brel dus spyor dge ba'i nyin sman rdzongs rgyal lab kyi lha mi srid sde tshogs pa'i dbus su lha lcam chen mor bkra shis mnga' gsol gyi mdzad sgo la/ rgyal yum phran tshogs ceras rje na gyis thum thang thar pa gling nas ceras brag bla ma rin chen rdo rje dpon slob rnams ched du gdan dungs te gyon nas cog mtha' bar gsum du rten 'brel legs tshe gas phran sum phyogs pa'i lha nas bkra shis mnga' gsol legs par mdzad bsgrubs pa nas/ mi ring bar spa hro dpon slob 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug phyo rgyal du byon/ spyi lo 195'a chu 'byug zla ba dang po'i tshos 30la kun dga' rab brtan du yab 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug sku la snyung gzhi cher med par zhi bar gshegs te phyo rgyal nas rings stabs su kun dga' rab brtan du gyon/ lha lung gsung sprul ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ chos brag bla ma rin chen rdo rje/ rdo rje slob dpon yo na tan brtson 'grus/ krong gsar gnas partan/ nyi ma lung bla ma sogs dgon sde grwa tshang gi 580

bla slob grwa pa tshang ma sos te smin gling rdor sems sgrub chen sogs gsung chodag lag mang po btsugs shing / de bzhin gzhung dgo 'dun grwa tshang gi gtsos pa'i rab sde/sgrub sde/ ri khrod/ dgon pa yo ngas la dgongs rdzogs sgrub rgyu snga rjes lan bzhi re gnang ba ma zad/ mnga' 'bangs mi ser rnams la gnang spyin red bre sum khri bzhi stong lhag tsam gnang / dge 'dun dmang lar gser ljang brdungs kyi maṇa khel/masnu da ting / gos chen gyi 'cham gos/ sgam zhwa/ ber/ yol li sogs dang / gsol bam rgya tsham grangs mang thul/ de bzhin rgya bod du yang dgong sa rdzogs sgrub rgyu rgyacher phyal/ de lo zla 3 pa'i nang yang mes gong sa 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyi sras mo dbang gling ma yum che sa sgron yang skru gshegs pa zla 5 pa'i tshes 'dzi la sku rjes su gu ru'i sku mdun sprungs thang grwa tsha nga nas/ rje mkhan po bsam gtan rgya mchos dbu gtsos pa'i dge 'dun dmang byon nas sngar bying dus mnyam du byas te bla hre ba dge 'dun rnam sa la bsnyen bkur dang / mnga' 'bangs rnams la gnang spyin dpag hu med pa stsal/ de nas zla 8 pa'i chos 19she gza' skar phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin spungs thang bde ba chen po'i pho brang du dpal ldan 'byug pa chos gī rgyal po zhabs grang ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi ma chen rin po che'i sku mdu3 du mkhan slob dge 'dun dpon lag spyi tshogs dbus su phran sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel bzang po bsgrigs nas/ macerag gsum lha dang dung srong bden tshig grub pa'i tshogs kyis yab mes chodas rgyal gong ma'i gser gyi khri la 'byug brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po gsum pa 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug mnga' gse la bar mdzad/slar yang zla 9 pa'i chos tsho la dpal ldan 'byug pa'i gdan sa 'byug spa spo 58/

rin sprungs rdzong du gza' skar rten 'brel grub spyor dge zhing phran sum tshogs padzigin mor/ bdag cag gi ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i snang brnyan rten gsum dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang / bla ma mkhan slob dge 'dun 'dus pa rnams kyis dbu gtsos pa'i gdan sa phan tshun yas mas kyi rdzong dpon dang snyi bla rnam gsum sogs dpon 'bangs lha mi spu tshogs 'dus pa'i dbus ga tsan dan bkod pa' rgyal khab kyi skye dgu'i mnga' bdag tu chodas kyi rgyal po 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug dang rgyal yum skal bzang chos ston yab yum lhan rgyas chodas rgyal gong ma rim gyon gyi gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por mnga' gsol ba'i skabs der/ khri ston rten 'brel legs mtshon gyi 'bul ba tshan grangs rgya chen po phul ba dang chabs gcig cerdzos rgyal yab yum sman rdzongs rgyal khab 'di'i bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon dam par zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan bzhugs su chab 'bangs lha sdi //da sde mgrin gcig hu gsol ba 'debs pa'i legs bshad 'di ltar phyal/ tsho/ bde legs su gyur cig na mo thud dha dharma saṅga ya /sangs rgyas chodas dang dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ / yi dam bcom ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha/ / 'khor tshogs dpa' bo dang ni she ki ma/ / dpal ldan rgyud sde'i lha cesags ma 'u/sa pa/ / rtag hu gus pas bakhrisag gi rgyan du macesad/ / dpal maserdzon ma hā kā la lcam dul tshogs/ / sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan sngar dam blangs pa'i/ / chodas rje 'byugapa'i che sa spyong margya chen rnams/ / shis par stsol la legs tshogs spel du gsol/ / 'olags sku / / de ring skabs su babs pa la/ legs pa'i phyogs su rten 'brel bzang pe bsgrigs/ / phran sum rtsomogs pa rang gis spyad pas rmedzig / ces gsungs pa ltar 31'a dgo slong gnyer bgres tshe ring rdo spre dang / dgo bshes sgra slob rnam rgyal gyi deb nas bshus pa/582

dpal ldan 'grag pa'i ཿtshes srid dang rgyal srid zung 'brel gyi rgyal po gsum pa 'di nyid rang lugs khri 'don bkra shes mnga' gsol gyi dngos gzhi sngon gyo na rgyal po gong ma rnams kyi khri 'the na lam sku1la ji bzhin nyams med rten 'brel bkra rshagis phran sra/ma tshogs pa ni/ spungs thang bde chen pho brang gi gser khri mngon par mtho ba'i steng du/ spyi lo 195'arab byung 16 pa'i chu byug zla brgyad tshes 19 dge ba'i nyin mnga' gsol mdzad yib pa yin kyang / slar yang rgyal khab mthun lam gyi ༷ gas bshes rnam pa rten 'brel la phebs pa'i ston chen du rgyal po yab yum steng zhal lhan rgyas kyi bkra shis mnga' gse la de ring yin pa las/ 'dir yang dge ba'i mtshan mar dmigs shing rang bzhin gshis kyi 'ga' zhig 'bul ba la/ de ring gza' skar dang rten 'brel 'acad sbyaXr nyi ma bcas gnam sa bar snang gi lams kun thams cad bzang zhing legs pa'i bkra shis dpal gyi nyi ma la zhing 'di'i grwa tshang gi gtso bo rje mkhan chen bsam gtan rgya mtsho/ rdo rje slob dpon rig 'dzin/ dbyungs kyi slob dpon bsod nams rdo rje/ sgra'i slob dpon bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal/ mtshan nyid slob dpon rdo rje se gas malan sle ba rnam pas gtsos dge 'dun 'phags tshogs rig 'dzin 'dus sdi rgya mcho dang / gzhung mgron gso pa sri rgyal/ bod 'grul pa nor su/ gong sa'i gzim snang rgya gar/ dbang mgyon padma dbang 'dus/ has dung 'jigs med da /la ldan rdo rje/dar rdzong rdo legs/ rin spungs rdzong tshab skal bzang zla ba/ spungs gzim rgyal mtshan/rim gzim jo cung / chodas gzim don grub/ rin gzim rta mgrin dpal 'byor bcas kyis gtsos pa'i phyogs spyi'i bla dpon dang / nang blon che phu/ 'go mi las tshan dang /mi ser bcas dpal ldan 'byug pa'i rgyal lab hu 'bod pa'i skye bo mcherag dman 583

thams cad kyis blo sems chig sgril thog nas/ sngon gyon 'grag gi rgyal po rim gyon gyi gdung brgyud/ lha dang bla mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sras maḥtsheg 'jigs med rdo rje dbang sgyug ces mtshan gyi snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs thams cad du grags pa 'di nyid rgyal khab 'di'i gtsug rgyan nor bu'i tog la dmigs te legs smon gyis mtshams spyor zhing gzhom gzhig bral ba'i gser khri chen po'i steng du gdung brgyud 'dzin pa'i rgyal po gsum pa chodas srid dang / rgyal srid zung du dbang bsgyur ba'i mnga' bdag rin po cher mnga' gasku/la bgyis pa dang / lha dang mnyam pa'i zab rgyas rten 'brel phun su ma tshogs pa legs/ pang bsgribs pa'i naga' ston chen ོ/'i dus 'dir/ ji skad du/mkha' la lha gnas mang na yang / / cadad gsal nyi zla lta bu med/ / ces dang / nor bu rin chen rtag martserd na/ / bkra shis pa da nga don chen 'gyur/ / ces gsungs pa ltar 'jig rten na skye bo mang ste gang 'dul chos dbang bsam pa'i bye brag dang mthun par mi ser bde zhing spyod pa dar rgyas gong 'phel sogs bkra shis pa ra bsgyur bkod mdzad nus pa'i rgyal po shin tu dkon pa'i phyir/ snyo rdzongs 'dir 'bod pa'i bdag sogs blon 'bangs mchodag dman bcan pa rnams ni ring mo'i dus nas bzung ste gdung brgyud pyi rgyal po 'di nyid kyi yab mes rnam pa rim gyon nor bu rin po che lhar gtsug tu mace da cing bston pas/ da tshun bkra shis pa dang legs tshogs gong 'phelabyung ba lags shing / de'i phyir na bdag cag gong 'bod bla dpon 'bangs 'khor sku ngas nas dam tshig dpang btsugs kyis zhabs tog bsnyen bkur zhu rgyu'i zhu ba dang /gsol ba snying 'ong nas 'debs bzhin pa'i ngang nas rgyal po 'di nyid gser khrir mnga' gsol brgyas pa'i ston chen gyi sku mgron la/ rgya gzhung rgyal khab chen po mchodag 584

'byug pa'i bstan pa rgyas pa dang / / bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i bzhed don kun grub cing / / bkra shis dpal gyis phyogs bcur khyab par 31ga / ces pa'i legs bshad dang bcas gser rlu mnga' gsol 'thul ba lags se / / 'di yan chad da / slong tshe ring rdo rje dang dge bshes rnam rgyal gyi rgyal rabs deb nang gi legs bshad do/ /spyi lo 194 3 rab byung 16 chu sprul la sngon gyi rgyal sa thim phyar bde chen chos gling gi pho brang bzhengs 'go btsugs/ de 'o/ra ka grongs su rkyel lcam skal bzang chodas sgron gyi yab gong gzim bsku da nams stobs rgyas sku rim se gas kyis ma phan par sku zhi bar gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzog rgya chen po bsgrubs par mdzad/ lo de la sras mo a zhe bsod nams chodas sgron sku 'khrungs/ spu lo 1954 rab byung 16 shing rta la sras slo a zhe bde chen dbang mo 'khrungs/ dgung grangs nyi shu tsa brgyad spyi 'o/ 1955 rab byung 16 pa'i shing lug zla dgu pa'i tshos 'do la lha sras 'jigs med seṅge dbang phyug bde chen chodas gling gi pho brang du sku bltams/ 'khyungs ston rgyas par mdzad cing dpon lag dgon sde grwa tshang bla slob rnams dang / chab 'bangs yongs nas khri ston legs dar gyi 'thul ba mang du phyal ba 'byor/ de nas gzhi dpal ldan 'byug pa'i rtsa khrims ltar la 'dzam gling gzhan gyi khrims dang bsnyun te 'gyur bcos bya dgos pa rnams blon chen 'jib/sa med rdo rje dang bka' spos thog nas bskyur bstos mdzad de khrims yig rnams gsar du mdzad/ rab byung zhu6 me sprel 1956 la spungs thang pho chu nas chu rud thon te rdzong chung lha khang gyi tsa ba nas pho chus grog gsar pa sped de mo chur 'dres te sku nga / g.yas gasku na gyi zam pa gnyis ka khyer/ khang khyim dang zhing sa mi 586

dbang mo 'khrungs/'byug rgyal lab 'dir sngon chad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dam pa'i snu sa la 'chad nyan dar rgyas byung 'dug kyang da ni dam pa'i ceras nyams rang nyams 'dugadam pa'i cheras la 'chad nyan gyi hre'ub grwa zhig btsugs gnang zhes rgyal lcam skal bzang ce sa sgron gyis/ mi dbang mnga' bdag rgyal po la zhus te mnga' bdag rgyal pos blon chen 'jigs med rdo rje dang / rgyal po'i maspon gnyer phrin las/ grwa tshang gi bla slob rnams la nga rang tsho nang pa'i chosdo kyi skor nas 'bri klog yon tan gzhi ma nas bzung ste dag yig rig gnas gzhung sde snod gsum gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi la sku gas pa mdo sngags kyi snu sa gang yang 'chad nyan yod pa'i slob grwa zhig btsugs dgos 'dug pas de ba'in 'phral du btsugs thabs gyis zhes bka' gnang ba bzhin dre na chen 'jigs med rdo rje nas slob grwa rnams la mthun kyen dngul phogs sogs gzhung nas mdzad rgyu dang / rgyal mgron phrin las kyis slob grwa rnams la nges par dgos mabo'i phyag dpe dag yig ngag sgron tsa ba 'grel pa/ sum rtags tsa ba 'grel pa 'grel chen/bshes spyings tsa ba 'grel pa/ snyan ngag tsa ba 'grel pa/ spyod 'jug tsa ba 'grel pasogs phyag dpe'i rigs tshang ma tshar grangs gnyis brgya re dang byang shing sogs nyer ma'o tshang ma grabs 'grigs mdzad/ grwa tshang nas sgu sgob bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal dpon gasku ga gsum ka srungs su —slob ga'i mkhan po bla ma mkhas pa zhig zhu bar gyon pa bzhin du kyibs rje dil mgo mkhyen rtse rin po ches gsan te spyi lo 1961 lcags glang zla dang pa'i tshes 'dzi la ka srungs nas chibs baspyode gnang ste thim phyar phyags phebs mi te zla 'a pa'i nang dbang 'dus rtser blo gsal gzhon nu brgya tsa gcig gi grangs slob 589

grwa btsugs gnang ba shin hu skal ba bzang zhing thugs rje dang bka' drin macerag tu che bar gyur/ de la cog mar zla ba re la mi rer dngul phogs rub 30 re gnang yod/zla ba brgyad pa'i nang dbang 'dus rtser sa gnas gu dog par brten gsang zab chodas rdzong du sgos te 'chad nyan byed bzhin pa dang gong 'phel song bzhin pa yin lags/lo der chos rgyal 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug dang blon chen 'jigs med dpal ldan rdo rje rgyal blon gnyis kyis rang re'i 'byug rgyal lab 'di nyid ktos srid dang rgyal srid gnyis ga'i thad nas yar rgyas btang ba'i thugs bzhid kyis phyi'i rgyal lab gzhan dang mthun lam gyi 'brel ba gnang zhing / lhag par khyim mtshes rgyal khab rgya gar gzhung mcherag dang mthun lam dam zab kyi 'brel ba shin hu che bar mdzad gnang ba'i bka' drin las rim gyis rgyal khab gzhan dang 'du mnyam 'aspo ba'i lam/long ba mig 'thob pa dang 'du ba'i shes bya'i yon tan 'thob rgyu'i shes rig las khungs/ shing dang sa rdo sogs da sngar 'phyo brlag chud zos su gyur pa rnams 'phro brlag dang chud zos su mi 'gro ba gzhung la 'bab khungs bzo ba'i nags tshal las khungs/ sa zhing las lo3 1ga rtsi thog bza' bca'i rigs la sku gas pa rang gi rgyal khab hu sngar yod pa rnams thon skyed log ldab 'tsho rgyu'i thabs shes dang / sngar med pa rnams gsar pa rgyal lab gzhan nas se na dang ljang gya la sku gas pa khyer blo ngajig te btsugs pas bza' btsa'i dpal 'byor longs spyod sngar las log ldab kyis ma tshad par gong du spel ba'i so nam las khungs/ de bzhin sgo nor las khungs/ gso ba las khungs/ la sogs pa de dang de 'du ba'i las khungs lag mang po yod pa'i gong 'phel las khungs yang gnam lo 'di la 'o/ lnga'i 'char gzhi dang po btsugs gnang bar 590

ma dzad do/ /chu stag ñtsa lo 196'a la bkra shis chos/ rdzong de yang legs par bltas dus shing cha rnams rul ba dang zam pa sku1gas kyi rkyeXn zhugs 'dug pas nges par nyams gso zhu dgos par 'dug brten rdzong gsar bzhengs kyi las 'go btsugs gnang /de 'e1ra bkra shis ཿtshes rdzong gi 'jigs byed sku nas khrag babs pa'i mtshan ma ngan pa zhig byung / 'o/ de'i zla ba dgu pa bcu pa'i nang rta wang du rgya mi dang rgya gar dmag 'khrugs langs pa'i zhor la chu rnyogs na nya mi bde ba'i dpe bzhin rang re'i rgyal khab 'dir yang mi bde ba mang po byung nas/ gzhung gi grwa tshang rnams su dus mcherd 'thum sde btsugs rgyu yode pa ma gtogs dmigs bsal gzhung nas phe gas gnang ste ma ṇi dung sgyur bton mkhan dang badzra gu ru dung sgyur 'don rgyu sngar srol mi 'dug kyang mi dbang mnga' bdag rgyal po 'di'i skabs 'e1 la shas kyi sngon nas dmigs bsal ma ṇi dung sgyur 'don mkhan btsugs yod pa de rnams kyi byin mthu dang / rang re dpal ldan 'byug pa'i lta chodas skyong srung mas sru nga skyob mel tsho mi g.yel ba'i thugs rje dang /rje 'bangs spyi mthun gyi bsod nams kyi mthus de tsam gyi ngang du rang btsan ma nyams shing zhi 'jam dang ldan par gyur to/ /rab byung 16 chu yos spyi lo 1963 lo 'di'i zla 1 tshes 'a3 la mnga' bdag rin po che'i sku la glo thur du snyun gyis thebs te shar sgo sgo nang gi sgom chen grwa tshang du bka' 'a//ra tshar grangs 50 bklags pa se gas gzhan yang grwa tshang dge na sde lag yongs nas sku rim bsgrubs pa dang / sman bcos bzang po la brten/ nyi ma gza' sgu gcan las thar ba bzhin rim gyis snyun gzhi gdangs pa ni sman rdzongs rgyal khab kyi 591

skye dgu'i spyi dpal du 'gyur/ snga lor rta wang du rgya dkar nag 'a zings 'khrugs byung skabs gsang zab slob grwa yang re zhig 'thor/ skyabs rje mkhyen rtse rin po che rgya gar du gyon/ der sku mched mnyan pa rin po che dang sras mo chung ba gshegs kyen gyis slar gyon ma thub par brten/ gsang zab sle ba grwa'i dbu 'dzin du blon chen 'jigs med rdo rjes 'khan su li nas rin po che rgyal dbang nyi ma gdan dungs te yos lo zla 3pa'i nang hre ba grwa slar btsugs gnang / de nas skabs shig na blon chen 'jigs med rdo rje gyon te sle ba grwa rnams la tshe sa la bston 'gyus nan tan byed dgos par gsung bshad legs par gnang ste khyod rnams dngul phogs sub 30 res mi langs par cadang rang la ma na tan bying ba la phogs gzhung nas yod pa nga rang tsho 'grag gzhung ma gtogs gzhan med/ yin rung khyod rnams la rub 10 re yar gseng 'thob rgyur mnga' bdag rgyal po la ngas dgongs skor zhus te byed cadang zhes gsungs pa bzhin zhus pa la rgyal pos kyang gnang ste de nas tshur mi rer rub 40 re thob yod pa yin 05ba/05/spyi lo 1964 rab byung 16 pa'i shing 'grag lor mnga' bdag rgyal po snga lo nas skru la snyung gzhi dug po thebs pa'i stabs kyis phyi rgyal su'i dzar lan du sman bcos la gyon te der sman khang du bzhugs pa'i skabs/ 'dir zla ba 'a pa'i chos 'aril blonachen 'jigs med rdo rje phran— tshogs gling gi mgron khyim nang du glo thur du ku bsad brgyab te bkrongs 'dug blon chen bkrongs pa'i gnas tshul zhu yig su'i dzar lan ter phul ba zhabs su 'byor ba'i mod la mnga' bdag rin po che nyid rings stabs kyis 'a bral myur du gyon te bde chen snu sa gling du phebs te dbye ba zhib dpyad mdzad 592

pa'i don 'bras kun la go brda 'phrod phyir kun gsal nas khyab spel gnang ba'i yi go'i nang gsal ba ni 'di ltar/zla ba gnyis pa'i nang blon chen 'jigs med rdo rje nyid sgang tog sa nyeb gsar pa a'u snor si bsam rtser thon pa'i skabs 'o dang 'phrad phyir ka li ka ta nas bsam rtser gyon te de ga'i bya sgo thams cad byas nas thim phyar phyo rgyal nas mnga' bdag rin po che 'byon rgyu'i phebs bsu'i grabs sgrig gi brtag zhib la 'gyon rtsis kyis phran gling masan khang du 'byor te der bzhugs skabs sgo sgrig gi skar khung nas dkrogs mda' rgyab ste glo thur du bkrongs pa las/ de 'phral phun gling gi rmase dri o dang / dug po'i mi rigs sogs dang rgya gar gzhung gi rgya khyi bcas pa rnams kyis lag rngamar pa rjes 'ded bgyis te zhag gsum la/ spel dpon nyas pa nor thu rgyal mtshan dang nge'i mnyam rogs la shas kyis lag dmar pa bzung 'dug lag dmar pa ni dgra 'dul dmag sgar gyi dmag mi 'khan khri sa pa ca gad 'jam dpal zer ba nge yin par 'jam dpal kho rang gis lag dmar pa nga rang yin zhes la bzed 'dug blon chen ku gsad rgyab dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dris tsho/ dgra 'dul dmag sgar nas kur stod pa khyab bdag rnam rgyal bha dur dang / sde bdag kur stod 'am gur pa sangs rgyas rdo rje nas btang ba yin zhes brjod 'dug pa ma tshad/ khyab bdag nas 'jam dpal dang mdo legs la re rer nang sug rub stong phrag re spyod cing blon chen bkrongs pa'i skabs su sus kyang ma tshor ba byas te gsang thabs bya dgos dang / gal srid gzhan gyis shes tshe khyab bdag gi ming ye nas ma ston zer lab 'dug ces dang /yang de'i skabs su zhabs rang nyid snga lor sku lus la snyung gzhi dug po bas 593

ngo sor gyur pa'i nyes bya 'khris pa dang / sangs rgyas rdo rje'i thad khyab bdag gi bkod bya nyan te las byed pa so sor bkod bya btang ba dang / lag cha spyod pa/ bya ba'i thabs shes ston pa sogs kyi gte bor gyur pa'i nyes bya 'khris/ mdo legs ni blon chen bkrongs pa'i skabs med sung sngon tsa gad 'jam dpal dang mtshungs par bas blangs grub pa dang nang sug len pa bcas kyi nyes bya 'khris gas gong gsal mi bzhi po de ni dpal ldan ཿtshes rje 'byug pa'i khrims yig chen po las gzhung la ngo log pa'i grangs su tshud pa ltar/ khrims gzhung tsa) 1 3 pa phog pa bzhin/ mdo legs ma gtogs pa'i gzhan gsum po ni so so'i lus steng du gzhung khrims zhes dug po'i dmag sgar du gnang ste nyes pa srog thog tu btang grub par/ zhes dang mdo legs kyi thad ngo log pa la grogs ram byas pa tsam yang gzhung khrims phe ga gyur gsal 'dug kyang cho sdothe nga la bzhag rgyu'i gsal zhus 'byor ba bzhin/ mdo legs ni nag btso gyur te tshe btson la bzhag yod/ ces shing 'byug zla 5 pa'i tshes 19 la gnang ba'i dbye ba zhib dpyad mdzad grub pa'i kun gsal nas khyab spel gyi yi ge'i nang gsal ba rnams las gal che tshig ris rnams ngo badza/sa byas pa yin/dbye ba zhib dpyad 'dir zhib dpyad bya yul gzhung gi phyag las gnang mi'i 'ongs su ma gtogs pa'i mi gzhan yang med dam snyam pa lags mod 'dir zur tsam yang 'bod mi 'dug go/ lo 'di'i dgun dmag srid stang khris skyod rgyan dang khrims bdag dpal 'gyor bcas sna pal bal yul du bros byol du song ba las mnga' bdag rin po che nyid kyi sku mched gzhon pa rgyal sras rnam rgyal dbang phyug maḥtsheg rin sprungs spyi bla dang 'brel 595

drag po'i gtso 'dzin gyi go gnas gnang / de nas mi rje mnga' bdag rin po che nyid 3tshes rgyal srong btsan sgam pos bzhengs pa'i spa hro skyer chur mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag lang 'gangs can du ston pas chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen la stong mchod 'thul phyir dgung zhag bdun phrag cig bzhugs pa'i ched du dpon g.yog nyung tsam bcas shing sgrul zla lnga pa'i tshos nyer dgu la gyon nas bzhugs pa'i zla 6 pa'i tshes 3spyi lo 1965 zla 7 pa'i tshes 31 gi mtshan mo chu stod dgu la mnga' bdag rin po che lha khang gi phyo rol hu chab gsang gi dbu gur nang phebs pa'i mod la/ mun dkyil nas mi ngan dgra bo zhig gis ya nga bag tsha med par ku gsad bya phyir lag bam 'phangs —'dug kyang lab bam gyi phor thung dkrum pa'i sgu chung zhig mnga' bdag rin po che'i snyan du gsan pa dang / nges par ku gsad yin pa'i thugs dun sad de phyag zhus te yode pa'i sku srung 'go legs la 'phral du 'jus re byas te ga dzi bzhi lnga tsam gyi sar sku bzur thub tsam la lag bam gas song ba dang / de'i thog yang mnga' bdag rin po che'i steng du dkrogs mda' rgyab byung ba la/ mnga' bdag rin po ches kyang mi ngan dgra so'i phyogs su pesi tol thengs gnyis gnang 'dug de ltar/ mi ngan dgra pos ga dzi brgyad dgu tsam gyi sa nas mtshon cha stobs dza/gas can gcig rjes gnyis 'phangs rung dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje dang mnga' bdag rin po che rang gi sku bsod dbang thang gi mthu dang / 'bangs mi sor rnams kyi snyi mthun bsod nams rlung rta'i mthus sku'i ba spu tsam la'ang gshod ma thub pa ni shin hu po mtshar zhing ya mtshan pa'i gnas su gyur to/ /de la mdza' mthun can gyi rgyal khab rnams kyang ma31na cha yul ba la blo pham tshad 596

med byung zhing ba spru tsam yang g.yo ma nus pa la rngo mtshar zhing snying nas dga' mgu rangs pa'i legs ston gyi zhu yig mang po'ang 'byor yod/ spogs bshes rgya gar gzhung nas kun po dgra bo'i lam rjes gcod pa'i khyi bzhi sna 'khrid bcas btang gnang byung ba des bam gyi gzhu lcags la rdzi dris bcad de rim gyis sku se nga ba'i mthar dgra bo de gzhung gi thugs dogs kyis rdzong du 'dzin bzung yod par khyi bzhi pos der song zhing dgra bo'i lag par 'jus te dbang rdzong cha 'og rud pa shar spru nyid kun po dgra bor ngo spyod byung bas rgya gzhung mchodag la thugs rje che zhus/ mnga' bdag rin po che'i zhal nas/ ngas rgyal srid kyi phyag las bstar ba nas bzung dpal ldan 'grag pa'i bstan pa gong du spel 'dun dang mnga' 'bangs rnams bde bar bkod rgyu'i bsam spyor 'o na byas par brten/ mi dmang nas kyang nga la la tsam min pa'i gus bkur 'gyur ba med cing nged rje 'bangs gnyis dam tshig gtsang zhing ngas su la yang ngan pa phra mo tsam yang ma byas mod kyang / deng skabs dgra bo kun pos nga'i tshi srog 'phyog par btsams pakha'i bya ba ngan pa de ltar byas pa tshe nga la btub na nga la ma btub pa med ces gasra/ngas sku /snga lo chu yos la sman rdzongs skye dgu'i gtsug nor mnga' bdag rin po cher glo bur du snyung gzhi dug po byung ba dang / shing 'byug lor blon chen 'jigs med rdo rje la blo bur du rku bsad khu/nga ba las zhar la rgyal khab la mi bde ba sna cerags khu/nga ba dang / lhag par shing sgrul lor mnga' 'bangs yongs kyi spyi nor mnga' bdag rin po che macerdzog la dug mtshon phul mi byung ba sku gas rgyal khams la mi bde ba dus ngan skud mar byung ba sogs gang yin nam zhes rgyal lcam skab bzang chodas ston gyis 597

gsungs pa na/ sku mdun na gnas pa'i dge phrin las rgyal mtshan gyis snge na yab mes rnams kyi skabs bstan spyi'i sku rim sgrub chen btsugs pa dang gtsug lag lang dang sku gsung thugs rten bzhings pa sogs kyis 'gal kyen bar chad bzlog gi yod pa yin na yang re zhig gi skabs de rnams gang yang sgrub rgyu lus sku nga bas yin par 'dug ces ceras dang mthun pa'i gsung spos legs par zhus shing macerd skusnan bar du mtshams spyor legs par byas te dbu bla kyibs rje dil mgo mkhyen brtse rin po che gdan dungs te spa spo skyer chur bstan spyi'i sku rim sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs spyi 'dus dpal chen 'dus pa'i sgrub chen shing sprul lo lha babs dus chen dang bsnyun nas go btsugs te lo ltar ma chad par gnang dang gnang bzhin pa dang / skyer chu jo bo'i g.yon phyogs su gu ru snang srid zil gnon thog tshad ma'i lha lang bzhengs gnang bar mdzad pa yin/de nas mnga' bdag rin po che'i zhabs nas/ rang re'i rgyal lab tu bstan srid kyi bya ba gal chen la bka' spos gnang sa lha mi srid sde'i tshogs khang yin na'ang /tshogs 'du ni spya mi rnams phyogs mtha' nas 'dzom dgos stabs lo gcig la thengs gnyis las 'tshogs mi thub/ deng skabs 'dzam gling dus kyi 'pho 'gyur dang bstun rang re'i rgyal lab la'ang bya ba gnad don gal chen glo bur du byung na/ mnga' bdag rin po che'i bka' gros bstun sa lha mi srid sde 'i chogs rkya snying bcud tshogs sde zhig nam rgyun mnga' bdag rgyal po'i zhabs sar dgos gal che ba'i dgongs bzhed ltar/dge 'dun grwa tshang gi 'thus mi/ rab sde'i 'thus mi/ dpon lag gi 'thus mi/ shar phyogs mi ser 'thus mi/ kto mtshams mi ser gyi 'thus mi/ nub phyogs mi ser gyi 598
