'thus mi skusnags nam rgyun 'tshogs te bka' spos gnang rgyur/ blo gros tshogs sde zhes pa/ spyi lo 1965 rab byung 16 shing sgrul zla dug pa'i tshes bzhi dus chen nyin nas 'go btsugs gnang bar mdzad/sngar yab mes gong ma rnams kyi skabs phyo nang gi yon tan slob spyong byed sa yod mod kyang slob grwa ha cang chung ba yin stabs rang re'i rgyal lab kshi gzhon nu pho mo rnams shes sku(na rgyal lab gzhan dang 'du mnyam bgasna tsu/'i thugs bzhed kyis ltem phyag lung bstan zam pa'i nye 'khor du dbyangs can thug zer ba'i slob grwa che ba zhig btsugs gnang bar mdzad/ de bzhin du sngon yab rje 'jigs med dbang phyug gi skabs nas sman khang chung ngu re ye da kyang mi ser la phan thogs che ba'i sman lang chen po med pa dang / lhag par mdze nad sman lang med pa gsar du bzo ba'i dgongs bzhed kyis 'byug gzhung thim phya rdzong gi mnga' 'og khris ma'i nang spyod dar gong mar mdzo nad gso ba'i sman lang dang drung 'tsho rnams sdod khyim bcas lo 'di la legs par bsgrubs te batshungags gnang bar mdzad/spyi lo 1966 rab byung 16 pa'i me rta lo la yab mes chos rgyal gong ma rnamasalas lhag par chodas rgyal 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug mchodag gis sngon sde srid drug pa ngag dbang tshe ring gis bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur gser bris ma rim thug bkra shis snu sa rdzong me rkyen gyis 'jig pa'i tsho bton tshugs pa'i bka' 'gyur po ti 58 sngar nas da lta'i bar la skong bzhengs mkhan ma byung ba de gar lus pa rje mkhan po 'jam dbyangs ye shes seng gos zhu bskul mdzad pa bzhin/ de'i 'phros ma tshang ba rnams 31ga nag la gser bris gyis gsar du thams cad la tshang bar bzhengs pa'i dgongs 599

bzhed kyis 'grag shar phyogs bkra shis sgang grwa tshang / kur stod lhun rtse'i grwa tshang /bum thang thar pa gling grwa tshang dang nyi ma lung grwa tshang / byang chub che sa gling grwa tshang /༷ nga gsar grwa tshang skutshegs nas yi ge 'bri me rnams bkug ste bdag cag gi ste/na pa thub pa'i dbang po'i bka' dri ma med pa bod du 'gyur ro cog mthing shog la rin chen dang pos 'bri ba'i bya ba las kyi 'bod lo'i 'go btsugs gnang ste/ spyi lo 1967me lug 'o la bka' 'gyur gser te la gcig ste/nga chig brgya gsum gser zhun gyis legs par bzhings grub nas/ gong sa chodas kyi rgyal po 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug masnu ga gi zhabs nas de bzhin da dung po ti nyis brgya lhag pa'i bstan 'gyur yang gser zhun mas bzhengs par dasku ngas te bal 5/la nas grang gser btul mi hre ba ston pa ched du sos te gser to la bzhi stong zhe bzhi 4 04 4btul nas/ song bzhin grwa tshang lag sku da rigs dang de bzhin che sa pa yi ge 'bri shes mi shar nub kyi phyogs kun nas bkug ste yig bris pa lnga bcu tsam gyis bzhengs pa'i bya ba las kyi 'aterdzor lo'i 'go btsugs par mdzad/ rgyal dbang /mi pa sku phreng nya' di byang chub rdo rje dang zhwa dmar dpal chen snu sa kyi don grub yab sras sde srid bcu pa mi pham dbang po'i skabs the da 'byug dmag 'khrugs skabs su chings bsgrigs te bde bar babo da de mchod yon gyi 'brel ba dang / sku 'phreng 15 pa mkha' khyab rdo rje'i skabs gong sa o rgyan dbang phyug 'byug rgyal dang po dang mchodad yon gyi 'brel che ba dang / sku phreng 16pa rig pa'i rdo rje'i skabs yab cerdzos rgyal 'jigs med dbang //ga 'byug rgyal gnyis pa dang mchodad yon gyi 'brel ba dam zab la brten spyo lo 1967 rab byung 16 me lug lo 'dir rgyal dbang garma pa bcu dug pa rig pa'i rdo rje yid bzhin nor bu mchog sman 600

rdzongs rgyal khab kshi bstan 'gro'i do na la gdan 'dren zhus te dbang chosgos gsan nas thugs snang gshin pas thum thang bkra shis snurmes gling gi rdzong gzhis phul gnang ba sku gas kyis thugs shin tu mnyes par mdzad/rang re'i rgyal khab 'dir bstan srid kyi phyag las sngar las rlabs che bar brten bka'i mdun na 'don rgyal khab nang gi srid rtsis kyi la lo sgyur ba spyid sdug blon po gtam zhing rgya gar/de bzhin dngul rtsis blon po che sa rgyal/ bstan rgyas blon po rgyal sras rnam rgyal dbang phyug gyi 'brel blon po zla ba tshe ring / zhabs tog blon po sangs rgyas dpal 'byor/ rgya gzhung sku tshab blon po padma dbang sgyus rnams lhan rgyas kyi go gnas can dang / de 'og lhan rgyas 'o/ga ma'i go gnas can dang / de 'og gnyis skal ma'i go gnas can/ de 'og rab 'byams gong 'og gi go gnas can sogs che sa rje dpal ldan 'grag pa'i ring lugs la nang gi go gnas kyi rim pa phyi'i na bza' bkab zhe'i la dog gis mtshon pa ni/ lhan rgyas rnams li dbang / lhan rgyas 'og ma rnams dmar ser/ gnyis skal ma rnams da mar po/ 'thus dpon rnams sngon po/ rab 'byams dang grang pa rnams dkar dmar/ dkyus ma rnams dkar po ste la dog mi 'du ba dang / bkab lugs mi 'du ba'i dbye ba rnams sngon gyi lugs sredal ma nyams pa'i go gnas can gzhung gi phyag las gnang mi dpon lag rnams gsar bskos gnang / rig gnas chung ba re sa gar gyi gras su gtogs pa 'cham dang glu gzhas kyi rigs rnams kyang mi nyams pa'i phyir de'i spyi khyab bskos bzhag mdzad/ che sa rje dpal ldan 'byug pa rang dbang rang btsan rgyal lab gzhung tsa ba gsum ji srid nam gnas bar srung skyob sde tshan dug po'i las khungs yang mnga' bdag rgyal po'i sku srung 6(11

sde tshan/ bstan srung dmag mi'i sde tshan/ khrims srung 'gag pa'i sde tshan rnams kyang sngar las sde lag mang pe ra spel zhing / dpal ye shes masgo na the 'i phyag mtshan ral gri dang las kyi mgon po'i phyag mtshan gri gug dang thod khrag gis mtshan pa'i dpral rgyan dang / las mgon bya rog gdong can gyi dbu zhwa dang padma 'khor los mtshan pa'i dug po'i chas kyi go gnas kyi rtags dang / drag po'i 'ongs su gtogs shi nga bgo la zhi ba'i chas gyon pa'i skabs dkon macerag gsum sku gas rten gsum dang go gnas can yul gong ma la gus 'dud mtshon byed bkab de'i tshab gnya' ras li dbang / dmar ser/ dmar po/ sngon po/ dkar po sogs so sor mi chos dang 4yo zhing lha chos dang mi 'gal ba'i srol gsar du gtod cing go gnas so sor bskos bzhag mdzad/spyi lo 1968 rab byung nyadi sa sprel la spa khro dang rim phya sprungs thang gtsang chu sogs nas chu rud thon te mi ser gyi sa zhing 'or ga sogs rud kyis bdas te rgyud sdug phog pa rnams la byams skretshong tshad med pa'i sgo nas sdug bsngal bsal bar mdzad/gzhung gi dngul rtsis las khungs mnga' bdag rin po che rang dang 'du ba zhig gis na 'than gzab gzab mdzad dgos rkya 'dug dgongs te sras mo che ba a zhe bsod nams chos sgron dbang phyug lcags khyi spyi lo 1970 rab byung 16 la dngul rtsis rgyal tshab tu bskos bzhag rme dzad gnang / de bzhin du spyi lo 1971 rab byung 15 lcags phag lo la sras mo bde chen dbang phyug gong 'phel rgyal tshab hu bsgos bzhag mdzad gnang /'byug rgyal lab 'di da snga yan cherd du phyi'i rgyal lab rnams kyis rngo ma shes pa mtha' mar lus pa 'di da res rgyal po 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug gis thugs mkhyen rab thabs shes zab mo'i 'phrul gyis spyi lo 1971 rab byung 15 lcags phag lo 'di la nub 6(12

phyogs a mi ri ga'i sa gnas ni'u ma ga tu 'dzam gling rgyal tshogs nang 'dzul tshugs pa las sman tredzengs 'grag rgyal lab 'di yang 'dzom gling rgyal lab tshang mas 'grag rgyal khab ces ngos 'dzin gsal por cha 'jog bgyis te rang dbang rang btsan bskal pa ma ste/nga bar brtan par gyur pa'i rtags mtshan gsal por 'a//ra med brtan par bkod gnang bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin nam yang 'khor thabs bral ba yin no/ /lo 'char 'grag rgyal lab kyi skad rdzong la 'di nyid rgya gar du sam skri ta dang nyin du'i skad bzhin shes bya gong ma chos skad ma bkag par rang sor bzhag ste slob spyong byed dgos pa'i thog shes bya 'og ma rdzong kha'i deb gsar pa bzos te slob grwa lag la slob ston byed dgos par slob dpon bstan 'dzin 'od zer la bka' gnang ba bzhin/gong 'phel shes rig las khungs rtsom sgrig lang nas padma tsho dbang gis cerdzos skad la sum rtags don gsal snying po dang rdzong la la rdzong kha'i sgra bshad deb gsar pa btsams/ mdor na 'drug rgyal gsum pa mnga' bdag rin po che 'di nyid gser brir bzhugs ring la mi ser rnams kyis gzhung la 'jal dasku sa pa tsu/ khral gyi rigs tshang ma 'jal me dgo sa par bka' drin bskyungs grub pa ma tshad/ sbungs khral 'dri lag nam rgyun nyis rgyab gal che ba'i skabs ༄ mi ga༄6ma rgyab ba'i rgyab tsu/ga dartse sa pa sku1gas tshang ma dgongs yangs gnang ste mi ser rnams bde bar bkod/ lhag par du 'bangs mi se ra shar nub snyo mtshams gyi yul lag so sor nad pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir sman lang gsar du btsugs pa che chung bsdoms btsugs pa yode pa dang / nad pa la shas rgya gar sman gyis ma phan par nang pa'i sman gyis phan gyi 'dug par brten nang pa'i min khang yang la shas btsugs yod/ mnga' cadag gi 'bangs mi ser rnams blo 603

spos kyi mig thob cing shes rig yar skyed kyi ched du yul phyogs thams cad du yon tan slob spyong byed sa'i slob grwa che chung sdom btsugs gnang bar mdzad/ rgyal sa rim phu nas phran tshogs gling / spa hro shar phyogs bkra shis sgang / rim phya nas bum thang /bum thang nas dge legs ga sum thang nas mong sgar sku gas su ga ri lam bzos tshib ste mi ser rnams bde bar bkod/ thim phu/ spa khro/ mings thang / dbang 'dus pho brang serdzogs su glog me dang chu'i ka li yang btsugs grub pa sku gas rdzogs ldan gyi bskal pa gsar du chos pa la 'gran par bzos/mdor na phyo la 'dzam gling rgyal lab ye ngas kyis 'grag rgyal lab ces ngo shes pa bzos/ nang la rgyu sbungs kyi bral 'u lag tshang ma dgosnangs yangs gnang ba ma tshad/'o lnga lnga'i 'char gzhi can gyi gong 'phel las 'khungs lag mang po btsugs te yar rgyas gong 'phel chen po btang nas 'bangs mi ser rgyud pa'i nyi ma shar nas bde bar bkod pa yin lags sku / /spyi lo 197'a rab byung 16 chu byi lo zla tshis la lha sras 'jigs med seng ge dbang phyug dgung grangs 18 thog yab 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug gis shin tu byams pa dang brtse ba'i thugs bzod med kyi ngang nas thim phya bde chen chos gling pho brang du krong gsar dpon slob kyi go gnas/ don la rang nyid kyi rgyal tshab lta thur khri mnga' gsol bar mdzad/ de nas zla bzhi pa'i nang krong gsar rdzong nang du dpon slob kyi rten 'brel mdzad par yab sras 'bor bcas snyan cig tu gyon te de gar rten 'brel gyi mdzad sgo rnams 'chugs med du legs par mdzad grub nas rgyas spang du bzhugs pa na/ sman rdzongs la bzhi'i rgyal lab kyi 'bangs mi ser rnams bsod nams dman par gyur te ( (4

mnga' bdag 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug mchog gi sku la snyun gyis thebs par gyur te snga lo nas bum thang sku rjes su yab mes 61 rgyan dbang phyug gis bzhings pa'i gu ru lha lang gi rgya dgangs dang mnyam pa dkyil 'khor slob dpon bya mdangs la bka' bkod gnang ste bzang gos la dog sna tshogs las gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi mthong grol 'tshoms 'dub kyis gsar du legs par bskrun pa 'di nyid bsnams te 'byon rtsis mdzad pa lags rung byon ma tshugs par khrus spang nas slar rim phur gyon/ de nas 'di gar skru rim rnams sgrub bzhin par snyung gzhi gdangs su re bas spyi zla drug pa'i nang sman dpyad kyi ched phyi rgyal kyis phi ri ga'i sman khang chen por phyag zhu mi rgyal yum phran tshogs chodas sgron dang / rgyal sras krong gsar dpon stob 'jigs med seng go dbang phyug gis dbu gtsos blon po la shas dang bcas pas gdan dungs te gyon/ a phi ri ga'i sa gnas sna'i ro khri'i sman lang du phebs te sman bcos ji tsam/ phul kyang snyung gzhi gdangs skyed med par brten/ rgyal sras krong gsar dpon slob 'jigs med seng ge dbang phyug la shin hu thugs brtse bas zhal ta bzang po legs par gsungs pa ni/spyi lo 197'a la 'byug rgyal 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug zhing gshegs te ring min gyi dus shig la thim phyar rgyal yum sku bgres phran tshogs ཿtshes sgron maḥtsheg nas zhabs tog blon po sangs rgyas dpal 'byor la gsungs gsal/ dbyungs spyid nas mo'i thu tsha cho rgyal po'i sras sros ngo ma yin pa dang de'i thob go gnas sogs dgos tshul brjod kyi yod tshod 'dug pas der brten zhing gshegs rang gis ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshig don rnams yi ger 'khod rgyur gal che nges 'dug cing khyod kyis yi 605

gor bris zhes ga46ngas pa bzhin bris pa ni/mnga' bdag 'byug rgyal 'jigs med the rje dbang khu/ga rin 〈sna che'i zhal nas kre nga sar rgyas spang du bzhugs dus nas gsungs pa dang / lhag par sman dpyad kyi ched du a phi ri ga'i sa gnas sna'i ro khrir gyon te spu lo 1972 zla 7 chos 'a1 la de'i ro khri'i za khang du ji ltar gsungs pa'i gsung don/gsung spos 'di rnams gsungs skabs rgyal po'i sku mdun du sku da mi /nya rgyal yum phran tshogs ce sa sgron/'a chos rtse dpon slob 'jigs med seng go dbang phyugalnga phyi blon zla ba tsho ring /rtse zhabs sdudan sangs rgyas dpal 'khyodar/pa dbyangs spyod/6 rgyal gzim sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin/1) nga'i mi tshe 'di la dbyangs spyod dang mnyam du sdod pa de ni/ lam 'dzol nyi ma'i snga phyi dang byus 'dzol bskal pa'i 'go mthug ces pa ltar dza/gas chen rang 'dzol sku nga zhing / de yang sngon ma ni lo na gzhon pa'i stabs kyis zhag re gnyis tsam sdod 3/ra ba'i thar tshod bzung ma thub pa'i bar thu gzhi gcig min gnyis min bzhi 3 tsam tshud sku nga ba las phar phrad kyang rgyab ma shes pa zhig tu se nga ye da/ skal bzang dbang phyug gi thad bden pa thams cad mo rang yin/ nga rang dang mnyam du bkra shis mnga' gsol byas pa'i rgyal lcam ngo ma mo rang yin par brten/ mo rang las thon pa'i su thu mo rnams kyang rgyar po'i sras sros (sunyi ngo ma yin/ dbyangs spyid kyi thad 606

a rogs dga' rogs tsam ma gtogs btsun mo rngo ma min pa las/ de las thon pa'i bu su mo rnams ni rgyal po'i sras sros ngo ma'i gras su mi tshud cing 'brang zhes brtsi rgyu yin/'a) dbyangs spyod kyi thu tsha rnams la ni gzhung gasku ga dang go sa gtan nas sprod mi dgos shing / go sa spyod na khyod rang la stabs ma bde ba byung 'ong bas 'ong rnams 'grag gi mi ser gzhan dang 'du ba byas te bzhag pas 'thus zhes gasnge/ngas//3) rgyu'i thad bo rang tsho la mang po gnang yod pas spyod sdug mi phog pa 'ong /skyed sdug re phog na khyod kyis blta ste byin pas song zhes gsungs/4) gal srid nga'i sku tshe ma brtan pa 'du byung song na/ lo dag cig gi don las lo nga phyo khar bzhag de gi rgyab las khyod rang gis blta ste byed/ de ltar gsungs dgos pa de 'jigs med khyod rang gi don la gsungs pa yin zhes gsungs yod/ mi ring bar sman rdzongs skye dgu'i gtsug nor mnga' bdag 'jigs med rdo rje dbang //ga macerag rgyal rabs gsum pa'i khri la 'o nyi dza/ tham pa rgyal srid ceras bzhin du bskyangs te dgung grangs bzhi bcu zhe lnga (45) spyi lo197'a rab byung 16 pa'i chu byi lo zla 6 pa'i tshes 10 rjes ma'i nyin sku zhi bar gshegs so/ /de nas sku gdung rin po che rang gi rgyal khab hu gnam tshi brgyud de gdan dungs te tshos nya' khyi snga dro nyang shi ma rar phebs pa na khyim mchos/ rgya gar gzhung gi dmag mi'i bsu ba mya ngan gyi rnam 'gyur skyo shas kyis gdung ba bcad blag bral bas bsus te phran tshogs gling lha lang du gdan dungs/ rgyal lcam skal bzang chodas sgron gyis skyabs rje bdud 'joms rin po che 'jigs bral ye shes rdo rje ched du gdan dungs pa bzhin 607

gyon te 'pho ba dang bsngo smon zab mo gnang bar mngo da/ de nas gdan dungs te rgyal sa thim phur phebs pa nas rje mkhan khro phrin las lhun grub/ rgyal dbang gami pa/ dil mgon mkhyen brtse rin po che la se gas pa'i bla sprul skyes chen dam pa rnams dang /spungs thang dge 'dun grwa tshang / rta mgo'i sgrub sde/ rab sde lag 0 thar pa gling dang dar rgyas chodas gling dgon pa sogs nas dge slong zhal grangs 500 lhag tsam gyis smin gling rdor sems kyi sgrub chen dang / gar gling zhi khro ngan song spyong ba rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sogs kyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i dgongs rdzogs rgya chen po bsgrubs shing /rgya gar rdo rje gdan se gas dang bal yul macerd rten rnam gsum sogs kyi gnas chen lag rnams snge/ macesad 'bul dang / kyibs martse na ta la'i bla mas dbus rgya gar du bzhugs pa'i daserdzon sde grwa tshang lag gi slo sprul mkhan blosab 'dus cerags rnams la dasgo ngas rdzogs sgrub rgyu rgya cher phul/ jo dar khri phrag 'phyar ba la sermegs pa mnga' 'bangs maḥtsheg dman 'bring gsu/ma thams cad kyis la tsam min pa'i snying nas gces shing phangs pa'i mya ngan dang du ཿla bzod blag med pa'i sems kyis spyi sgos cha nas dgo ngas rdzogs rgya chen po bsgrubs dang sgrub bzhin pa'i skabs rnams su/ khyim mtshes rgyal khab chen po rgya gar gyi srid blon yin lhar gan lha/ lhang la de sha 'i srid blon/ nai pal gyi rgyal sras/ 'bras sbyodangs cerdzos rgyal gyi sras mo skusnags sku mgron yang drugs gse dang snyan dar phul bar mang po gyon/ zhing gshegs dam pa rang gi thugs bzhed ltar spur bying bum thang sku rjes gnas khyad par can du byed rgyu'i sbur lang bkod pa phran sum tshogs pa brtsigs te spyi lo 197'a rab byung 16 chu byi zla 9 pa'i tshes 13 pa sku spur gdan dungs te dbang 'dus pho brang dang / de nas krong gsar lngas spang dang /608

de nas bum thang sku rjes su zhag shas kyi bar dgongs rdzogs bsgrubs shing tshogs rte 'khor phul/ de nas sbur khang du gdan zhus te chos 'a' lha babs dus chen nyin sprungs thang nas rje mkhan po phrin las lhun yib kyis dbus dge 'dun grwa tshang dmang / rgyal dbang garma pa ston 'bor/ kyibs rje dil mgo mkhyen brtse rin po che/ chodas brag bla bgres rin chen rdo rje sogs kyi gsung chog gnang ste spur sbyang skabs sku rjes su yang / khyim mtshos rgyal bab chen po rgya gar gzhung gi srid blon chen po yin lhar gan bee sogs phyi rgyapa nas mgyon po yang mang po byon/ bla sprul mkhan slob 9sa dus pa rgya ma tsho'i tshogs kyis gar skangs/ dge 'dan la bsnyen bkar dang mnga' 'bangs mi nga)ma (pe ra dngaser rnams la gnang zhin rgya cher stsal/ sku gdung las ring bsrel yang gyon/ de nas tshes 30 gnam sgang pa spur thapa bshags te zla bcu pa'i tshes nya la bum thang nas rgyal sras krong gsar dpon slob 'jigs med seng ge dbang phyug dang / rgyal yum skru bgres phran chogs chodas sgron rgyal lcam skal bzang snu sa sgron ma yum padma bde chen sku gas sku 'bor tshang ma slar rgyal sa thim phyar phyags phebs skusna 609

'byug brgyud 'dzin che sa kyi rgyal po khri rabs bzhi pas chab srid skyong tshul ni/ ༄༄ / / brgyud 'dzin snu sa kyo rgyal po khri rabs bzhi pa dpal mi dbang mnga' bdag 'jigs med seng ge dbang phyug mchodag ni/ gter ston rig 'dzin chen po 'byug sgu rdo rje la gu ru padma 'byung gnas sku dngos su ston te tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis/ thu snying lams ma chung da rung nyon/ / lha sbas yul rong gsum rgyu ba'i nags/ / nyams chags 'dzin 'o grosnang ming 'dzin nang / / gnas de ru skye ba'i shing lug pa/ bzhin dmul ba'i 'dzum dkar so legs pa/ / khri 'phang du brtan na 'o/ bcu gnyis/ / bgegs med kyi bstan pa cher rgyas shing / lar sems can gyi bde spyod lan gcig gda'/ / zhes gsal bar 'u/nga bstan pa bzhin/ yab 'byug btsu/da 'dzin gyi rgyal rabs ga༄/ma pa 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug dang / yum rgyal lcam skal bzang ཿsgos sgron gyi sras su/de yang lung bstan nas sngon dus kyi ming 'o grong zhes pa dkar spe gdan sa rta mchog chodas dbyings pho brang gi gzhol 'dabs/ bstan srung jag pa me len chen pos srung zhing skyong ba'i yul rdzongs rim phya'i nang gses deng sang bde chen chos gling pho brang du spyi lo 19755 dang rab byung 16 pa'i shing mo lug lo la gnas dang lo khams dang bcas pa lung bstan dang mthun par bde bar sku 'khyungs/ de nas bla hre ba dpon lag rnams dang chab 'bangs sku1ngas kyis bkra shis bde legs kyis 'bul ba bcas 'khrungs ston rgyas par mdzad/ sku na chung ngu'i dus nas thugs rig shin tu bkra ba mnga' ba bzhin 'dzam bu'i gling gi skad yig la slob spyong rang gi rgyal lab dang /610

'byug brgyud 'dzin che sa kyi rgyal po khri rabs bzhi pas chab srid skyong tshul ni/ ༄༄ / / brgyud 'dzin snu sa kyo rgyal po khri rabs bzhi pa dpal mi dbang mnga' bdag 'jigs med seng ge dbang phyug mchodag ni/ gter ston rig 'dzin chen po 'byug sgu rdo rje la gu ru padma 'byung gnas sku dngos su ston te tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis/ thu snying lams ma chung da rung nyon/ / lha sbas yul rong gsum rgyu ba'i nags/ / nyams chags 'dzin 'o grosnang ming 'dzin nang / / gnas de ru skye ba'i shing lug pa/ bzhin dmul ba'i 'dzum dkar so legs pa/ / khri 'phang du brtan na 'o/ bcu gnyis/ / bgegs med kyi bstan pa cher rgyas shing / lar sems can gyi bde spyod lan gcig gda'/ / zhes gsal bar 'u/nga bstan pa bzhin/ yab 'byug btsu/da 'dzin gyi rgyal rabs ga༄/ma pa 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug dang / yum rgyal lcam skal bzang ཿsgos sgron gyi sras su/de yang lung bstan nas sngon dus kyi ming 'o grong zhes pa dkar spe gdan sa rta mchog chodas dbyings pho brang gi gzhol 'dabs/ bstan srung jag pa me len chen pos srung zhing skyong ba'i yul rdzongs rim phya'i nang gses deng sang bde chen chos gling pho brang du spyi lo 19755 dang rab byung 16 pa'i shing mo lug lo la gnas dang lo khams dang bcas pa lung bstan dang mthun par bde bar sku 'khyungs/ de nas bla hre ba dpon lag rnams dang chab 'bangs sku1ngas kyis bkra shis bde legs kyis 'bul ba bcas 'khrungs ston rgyas par mdzad/ sku na chung ngu'i dus nas thugs rig shin tu bkra ba mnga' ba bzhin 'dzam bu'i gling gi skad yig la slob spyong rang gi rgyal lab dang /610

phyi'i rgyal lab rnams su khyetshon te legs par gnang nas thung/sa su chud par mdzad/gter ston 'grag sgra rdo rje la gu ru rin po ches lung bstan gyi 'phro/ dam sri gi la bags lcags the 'grag / dpal 'byug par gshodzed pa'i gzhu bkang nas/ / mda' rnon gyis dgo bcom rgyal srid la/ / 'thon ran pa'i dus tshod lcags pho rta/ / de mgo mnan bzlog thabs nag po'i mdos/ / dgra sri dang bskul ba'i che ga dang / / byad bzlog pa'i che ra ga yang du bya/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lcags pho 'grag 'o/ ma zhig gis dpal ldan 'byug pa'i bstan pa la gnod pa'i bsam spyor ngan pa'i gzhu bkang nas/bar du gcod pa'i mda' rnon po byad la dang phur la'i thabs 'phrul gyis/ dpal ldan 'grag pa'i dge lesas kyi dpal bcom par gyur pa cetsheng nges pa yin pas rgyal srid la 'thon ran pa'i dus tshod der lcags pho rta lo mas / bla ma dang yi dam chos ljong na mgon lcam dul rnams la thubs zhus te/ bsam spyor ngan pa'i gnod ri tshe rde yis mi tshugs par bar gcod kyi mgo mnan pa'i bzlog thabs nag po ma mgon g.yul mdos dang / dgra sri dang mgon po lcam dul gsol mchodad dang thugs rgyud bskul ba'i chod ga dang / byad thur bzlog pa'i tshe ga yang nas yang du 'bad par bya'o/ / zhes shing lug lo pa la/ lcags pho 'byug lo mas bar gcod yod pa de/ lcags pho rta lo mas bar gcod bzlog thabs bya dgos par gsungs pa de nyid/ yum sras dang rgyal sku ngas spyi ma thun gyi bsod nams kyis dus las ma sku la bar bstan spyi'i sku rim rnams dus thog tu gnad smin tshags su tshud pas/ thog mar dgung lo bcu dug skabs bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal ba dang / de bzhin dgung lo bsdo bdun bco brgyad skabs bar chad kyi ga yupa chen po pas rnam par rgyal nas/ yab rgyal po 'jigs med ldo rje dbang 6/1

phyug mchodag gis shin tu thugs byams pa dang brtse ba chen pos rang nyid zhabs mi brtan par mngon par mkhyen pa lta bu'i sgo nas/ don du rang gi rgyal tshab dang yongs grags su dpal ldan 'byug pa'i gdan sa snga 3/sa cheras 'khor rab brtan rtse'i dpon slob kyi khrir spyi lo 197'a chu pho byi ba'i lo zla gsum pa'i tshos bzang po la khyim mtshos rgya gar gyi rgyal lab chen po nas sku ma〈snan sermegs dang / rang re'i rgyal khab nas mi dbang mnga' bdag 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug dang rje mkhan po phrin las lhun grub kyis dag gtsos pa'i bla slob dge 'dun 'dus tshogs dang lha mi che dgu'i dbus su rgyal sa bkra shis ceras rdzong du mnga' gaskusnal rgyas par mdzad de/ 'cham dang yul phyogs so so'i bro gzhas sogs dang / mda' rtsed zlos gar skyu tsal gyi ltad mo sogs snga na med pa'i dga' ston rgyas par mdzad/ de nas sum thang sku rjes su bzang gos la dog sna tshogs las grub pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi mthong spol chen po gsar du bzhengs pa de bsnams te yab sras lhan cig tu gdan sa ceras 'khor rab brtan rtser khri 'don mdzad par gyon/ der dpal ldan 'grag pa'i sngar srol gyi sgrig lam chodas gsum dang mthun par ser phreng chen po bcas chibs gral rgyas par rtsar te rdzong gi shar sgo chen po nas nang du gyon pa'i tsho/ dgra lha chen po mgon po byang bdud kyi rten rdzogs chibs pa rta nag rting dkar rdzong gi rdo gcal dkyil du slebs ma thag rta skad thengs gsum 'tsher ba'i rten 'brel gyi la lte ngo mtshar ba yang byung / de nas gdan sa chodas 'khor rab brtan rtser yab rje mnga' bdag rgyal po 'jigs me da rdo rje dbang phyug dang 'dus sde'i dgya 'dzin bla ma gnas brtan zhi dug gi dpon lag chodas srid lugs/ gnyis kyi la 'o/ sgyur ba'i dbus su shar 'bor 'o/ rtsibs brgyad kyi mnga' bdag 612

tu khri mnga' gsol te dga' ston rgyas par mdzad/ de nas yab sras lhan cig tu mthong grol chen po sum thang sku rjes su gangan dungs te gyon rtsis pa/ yab rje dam pa'i sku la snga nas thebs pa'i snyun gyis bsnyungs te sku rjes su gyon ma thub pa/ra chodas 'khor rab brtan rtse nas slar thim phur gyon/ de nas yang snyun rje sdug hu song nas phyo rgyal zhe ro phir sman bcos kyi ched du rgyal yum phran tshogs chodas sgron dang gyel sras chodas rtse dpon slob 'jigs med seng ge dbang phyug dang blon po sangs rgyas dpal 'byor blon po zla ba tshe ring dbyangs spyid bcas kyis phyag zhus te spu lo 197'a byi lo zla lnga pa'i nang gyon te/ zhe ro phi'i sman lang du sman bstos dang / 'dir sku rim ji tsam bsgrubs kyang snyun gdangs skyed ma byung bar spyi lo 197'a gyi lo zla 6 pa'i tshos 10 la zhabs pad ma brtan par sku zhi bar gshegs te re zhig lha rdzongs 'dir spyod pa'i nyi ma dgung du nub par gyur to/ / de nas zhe ro phi nas sku sprur gnam tshi'i nang gdan dungs te tshos nya' la nyang shi ma rar phebasanyin phebs sur rgyal lcam skal bzang ceras spyo dan/rā ni snu sa dbyings dbang mo/ sras mo a zhi bde chen dbang mo/ sras mo padma lha sgron dang skal bzang dbang mo/ bka'i blon po dang zhi dug gi dpon lag rnams/ dge 'dun grwa tshang nas rdo rje hre ba dpon gyis dbus zhal grangs bcu phrag lhag bcas mi spangs stong phug hu nye bas nyang shi ma ra'i gnam yi bab thang du phebs bsur bcar/hang shi ma ra'i gnam tshi thang nas phran 6pags gling bar du lam gyi g.yas gasku na nas rgya gar gzhung gi dmas mi 'e nga phrag lhag pa rnams kyis mya ngan gyi rnam 'arda/ra mthe nga ba tsam gyis mig nas mchi ma dku zhing spyo —1/sa/ dbang med du skye ba'i bsu ba bcas sku sprur phran tshogs gling lha khang nang du gdan zhus te/ rgyal lcam skal bzang che sa sgron 613

gyis zhing gshegs dam pa la thugs brtse chen pos skyabs rje bdud 'joms rin po che mchog rdo rje gling nas ched du gdan dungs te byon nas 'pho ba dang bsngo smon zab mos sa lam gyi mtshams spyor mdzad/ tshes 13 la sku spur phran tshogs gling nas gdan springs te thim phyar gtan bzhugs kyi pho brang du rgyal sras bstan rgyas tā na po rnam rgyal dbang phyug dang sras mo a zhe bsod nams chos sgron dkyil 'khor slob dpon bya mdangs dpon g.yog rnams kyis spur khang gi bkod pa yid du mchis pa legs pa ra bsgrubs pa der bzhugs su gaskusnal ba nas/ khyodags bzhi nas macerd rdzas kyi bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pas brgyan te phul/ tshes bcu bzhi la mi rje rgyal sras bstan 〈snan rnam rgya la dbang phyug mche ga gis gtsos pa'i bka'i mdun na 'don dang zhi dug gi dpon lag mos mthun gyis rgyal sras cho sa rtse dpon sgob 'jigs med song ge dbang phyug nyid rgyal tshab tu gser khrir mnga' gasku la bar mdzad/ khyim mchos rgya gar gzhung gi blon chen yin dar gan lha dang / nai pa li rgyal sras dang / gzhan yang phyi'i rgyal lab rnams nas kyang thugs gso dang snyan dar 'bul tshan mang du 'byor/ rje mkhan rin po che nyi zer sprul sku phrin las lhun tshib kyis dbus dge 'dun grwa tshang / skyabs rje dil mgo mkhyen brtse rin po che 'gyur med theg maḥthog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / gnas snang dpa' bo rin po che/ rgyal dbang ga pa rig pa'i rdo rje ston 'khor rnams dang /rta mgo'i sgrub sde bla slob dang / gzhan yang phyogs phyogs kyi mgon sde'i grwa tshang rnams kyis rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub chen dang / gar gling zhi khro/ ngan song spyong ba mi 'grigs pa sogs kyi dkyil 'bor zhal phye nas snu ga lag mang po dang / jo dar khri phrag 'phyar ba dang / rgya bal du bzhugs pa'i bla sprul rnams la bsngo smon zab mo 614

/kyibs zhu'i 'bul tshan dang / gnas chen lag la stong maḥtshed 'bul ba sogs dgongs rdzogs blos mi 'khyud par bsgrubs par mdzad/ zla dgu pa'i tshes 13 la glu spur rim phya nas bum thang du gdan drangs te rgyal tshab chodas rtse dpon slob 'jigs med seng ge dbang phyug rgyal yum rgyal lcam sras spos blon po dpon lag 'khor bcas thab btegs te dgung zhag dbang 'dus pho brang du bzhugs/ tshes 14 la che sa 'khor rab brtan rtse'i rgyas spang du bzhugs/ tshos 15 la a zhe che sa spyod nas skur 1nga la dang rgyal tsa ru gsol ja gsol ba bcas phebs bsus zhus te dbang 'dus chodas gling gi rdzong nang du gdan dungs te gse la ja 'bras bsil bcas drangs/ de nas rim pas byams lha khang du rdzo po'i sku mdun du mchod mjal bcas sku rjes su gu ru'i sgrub thug mtshan brgyad lha lang du sku spur gdan dungs te bzhugs su bcug pa la mchode 'bul dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor te rgyal ba lha las babs pa'i dus chen gyi nyin snga ma chos nyer gcig la/ gror khang bkod pa'i khyad par gyis mdzos pa'i nang du gdan dungs /spungs thang nas rje mkhan po dang dgo 'dun dmang gyon/ rgyal ba gami pa ston 'khoradang mkhyen brtse rin po che ཿtshes brag bla bgres/ che sa rtse'i gnas brtan gyis dbus rab sde dmang / de bzhin dbang 'dus pho brang grwa tshang dmang / rin spungs grwa tshang dmang / bkra shis sgang grwa tshang dmang / lhun rtse'i grwa tshang dmang / grar pa gling / nyi ma lu nga grwa tshang sogs dgon sde grwa tshang yod rigs kyi bla slob 'dus tshogs rnams gyon nas tshos 'a' la spur lang gi shar snyo nub byang gi phyogs bzhi nas gsung chodag lag bzhi bcas kyis/ tsan dan dkar dmar dang byir byung gi sgos kyis spur sbyang ba'i skabs rgya gar gzhung gi ble na chen yin dar gan lha mchodag dang phyogs gzhan nas mthun 615

lam mdza' brtses sku mgron mang du gyon/ rje blon 'bangs 'khor tshang ma mya ngan gyi gdung ba tshad med pas spur byings te gter chen padma gling pa'i sras mkhas grub kun dga' dbang phyug gi gdung brgyud 'khrul med yin pa'i rten 'brel gyi nus mthus nam gshis bzang zhing ring bsrel yang mang du byon/ gnam sgang la rdo zam du spur thal byings te zla 10 pa'i tshos nya la sku rjes nas gyon/ tshes 3 pa thim phya bkra shis ཿtshes rdzong du phebs/ de nas bka'i mdun na 'don chen po rgyal sras rnam rgyal dbang phyug gyis dathu gtsos pa'i chos srid kyi la lo gyen du 'degs pa'i blon po rnams ding dpon lag chab 'bangs mi ser gyi mthus mi mi chen sku sa la dbang ba kun 3snas mthun gyis brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po'i rgyal tshab〉 〉 sngar nas mnga' gsol ba ltar/ bdun zur glang lo ma tshos pa'i snga rol zla 10 smin dug zla ba'i chos lnga la gdan sa spungs thang bde ba chen po'i pho brang du mthu chen chos kshi rgyal po zhabs dung gi sku gdung rin po che'i sku mdun nas snu sa srid kyi 'khor los sgyur bar mnga' gsol ba'i sna lnga'i legs dar bzhes te rgyal tshab kyi khri thog tu bzhugs/ de nas bdun zur gyi 'o/ 'das pa'i stag 'o/ stag gi zla ba'i tshos lnga la sngon gu rtsa rin po ches rgyal po khri srong lde btsan la mnga' dbang rin po che'i dbang bskur zhing mnga' gsol ba ltar/ bkra shis ceras rdzong gi gser khri'i steng du gu ru rin po che dang gnyis su med pa'i kyibs rje dil mgo 3/khyen brtse rin po che mchodag nas mnga' dbang rin po che'i dbang bskur legs par gsan par mdzad/de nas spyi lo 1974 rab byung 16 pa'i kun dga' zhes pa shing pho stag lo sa ga zla ba'i chos bco lnga la gdan sa chen po bkra shis chodas rdzong gi pho brang chen por sman rdzongs tsan dan bkod pa'i rgyal lab kto lha mi srid sde 'tshogs pa'i dbus su gdong 616

lngas btegs pa'i gser khri chen por brgyud 'dzin cesas kyi rgyal po bzhi par phra'i ni sum tshogs pa'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye ba'i dga' ston chen pos mnga' gsol ba la/ rgya gar gzhung gi srid 'dzin mchob/ dang / bhang la de sha'i srid 'dzin/ sna pā la'i rgyal sras/ 'bras rdzongs chodas rgyal dang / hā la'i bla ma'i sku tshab/ 'dzam gling spyi tshogs btsan srung lhan 31gas kyi gtan 'jags rgyal lab lnga'i sku tshab/ rgya nag gyi/ ru su/pha ran si/ phyo gling / a mi ri ka lnga la sku gas pa gzhan yang phyi'i rgyal lab chen po mang po nas mthun lam dam zab kyi sgo nas gyon pa'i sku masan rnams dang / rje mkhan chen gyis gtsos pa'i 'dus sde'i tshogs dang / phyogs gyi rab sde lag dang dgon sde'i bla slob tshogs dang / rgyal dbang kurma pa/ kyibs rje dil mgo mkhyen brtse rin po che sku snags rgyal sras rig pa 'dzin pa 'i tshogs dang bcas pas bkra shis mnga' gasku la bar mdzad/de nas chab 'bangs bde bar skyong zhing chodas srid dang rgyal srid lugs gnyis kshi mdzad pa'i sgo phyogs thams cad nas tsan dan bkod pa'i rdzongs 'dir sngon chad gyon pa'i sde srid khri rabs rnams dang / brgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal po yab mes gong ma thams cad las phul du byung ba'i rgyal srid bskyangs dang skyong bzhin par rin chen rnam gsum gyi thugs rje dang chab 'bangs skye 'gro spyi mthun gyi bseng nams las zhabs pad brtan mus nas/ da gakhrod 'byung 'gyur gyi char yang sman rdzongs skye dgu'i spyi nor dam par zhabs pad rdo rje'i chos bdun gyi ngo bor brtan cing chos srid lugs gnyis kyi mdzad bzang mar po'i zla ba dang / dbyar gyi dpal yon ltar rgyas bzhin pa ni/617

deb 'di'i gzhi bcol sa'i rnam thar dpe cha rnams kyi mtshan tho bzhugs/1 grub thob dngos grub kyi gter ma srong btsan ma ṇi bka' 'gyam/'a gter bton o rgyan bzang po'i gter ma rgyal po sin lha rā dza'i rnam thar/ —ri mnga' bdag mon mo 'khyil gyi gter ma rta mgrin dpa' bo gnyig pa'i man ngag gnam lcags me'i 'khor lo/4 padma gling pa'i gter gyon klong gsal cha lag mkhan pa rdzongs kyi lam yig cirngags bcad ma/5 mkhan pa tre ngas kyi gnas yig tshig lhug ma/dze sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter ma padma thang yig gser phreng ma/7 byar gyi ban dhe wa gin dus bris pa'i rgyal rigs 'byung khungs gsal ba'i sgron me/8 rgyal dbang lnga pa blo bzang rgya mtsho'i rnam thar du kyi la'i gos bzang sa pa/9 la rag lha ma chung gi sgrub gnas glu ngaga' ra ba'i bla ma dmi phrin las kyi rnam masde/ra/ 10 gter ston gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi gter byung chen mo/11 la rag gtos kyi brgyud pa gyon tshul mdor bsdus yi ge dbu med nyi hong dpe mdzod kyi ma phyo/1'a 'bri gung spyodab pa'i rnam thar shes rab 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa ṅge rje rin chen 'bar ba zhes bya ba/618

13 kun mkhyen padma dkar po'i gsung gdan sa chen po ra lung khyad par 'phags pa cung zad brjod pa po mtshar gyi gtam zhes bya ba/14 'o/ ras pa grags pa dbang phyug gi rnam thar/15 kun mkhyen padma dkar pos mdzad pa gtsang pa rgya ras kyi rnam thar ngo mtshar dad pa'i rlabs phreng /16 'byug sgom zhig po'i rnam thar thugs rje'i chu rgyun ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyi gter ma/17 gnas rnying gi gdung rabs skyes su dam pa rnams kyi rna ma par thar pa/18 'bar ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang rang gis btsams pa'i rnam mgur/19 ltag tshang 'o/ tsā bas btsam su pa'i rgya bod yig tshang rmelas pa dga' gyed/'khri 'jam dbyungs kun dga' seng ge'i rnam thar yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng ba bsam snye/la la ce sa //ra ba/'a1 grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i rnam thar sde dgo spar ma/'a' ka61ga pa sprul sku bsod rnams rgyal mtshan rang gis brtsams pa'i rnam thar dri med yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng ba/'a3 mkhas dbang dge 'dun rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i ceras 'byung blo gsar rna rgyan/'gye sangs rgyas gnyis pa padma 'byung gnas kyi rnam thar yid kyi mun sel/'apa sa kyi'i gdung rab ri 'gro mdon ceras rgyal 'phags pa'i skabs/'a6 'byug pa kun legs kyi rnam thar rang gis mdzad pa ha le ho le/619

ra7 rgyal dbang chodas rje kun dga' dpal 'byor gyi rnam thar po mtshar bdud rtsi'i thigs pa a ba 66ti pa rin chen rnam rgyal gyis bgyis pa/'do ngag dbang chos rgyal gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar 'od brgya pa padma dkar pos mdzad pa/'a9 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan rgya mtshos mdzad pa zhabs dung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi rnam thar chodas kyi sprin chen po'i dbyangs/30 rgyal dbang lnga pas mdzad pa byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i rnam thar rngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mcho/31 gsang sngags rgya macengs btsams pa ngag dbang bsam gtan gyi rnam thar/31 hā ra nā thas bdag nyid kyi rnam thar nges par brjod pa'i deb gter shin tu zhib mo ma bcos lhug pa'i rtogs brjod/33 grub masnu ga rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpal ldan bla ma pad dkar gyi rnam thar ngag dbang blo gsal byung chub rdo rjes btsams pa/34 mkhan khri drug pa ngag dbang lhun grub kyis mdzad pa rgyal sras bstan 'dzin rab rgyas kyi rnam thar 'dod pa'i re skong dpag bsam yongs 'du'i snye ma /35 mkhan khri bcu pa bstan 'dzin ཿthos rgyal gyis mdzad pa lto'i ཿtshes 'byung 'jam mgon smon mtha'i phreng ba/36 dpag pasam nga/bang po'i rnam thar skal bzang kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/37 gong sa lnga pa'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang pod ka pa/38 mkhan khri bzhi pa dam ceras pad dkar gyi rnam thar thugs rje'i chen po'i dri 620

bsung ga na pa nyis mdzad pa/ 39 hū ral grang grang gi rnam thar mdo tsam gleng ba rin po che'i do shal/40 nyi ma shar phyogs lo rgyus gsal ba'i me long ban rnye wa gin dus bris pa/41 ngag dbang dpal ldan bzang pos mdzad pa mkhan khri gnyis pa bsod nams 'od zer rnam thar snyan tshig (radod 'jo'i 'khri shing /4'a rgyal dbang lnga pas mdzad pa lam 'bras bla ma rtse btsun ngag gi dbang phyug gi rtogs brjod shel dkar phreng ba/43 bsed nams mcherag grub kyi rnam thar rgyal dbang lnga pas mdzad pa dakhyod ldan yid dbang 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/44 paṇa chen blo ba zang lha sa kyi rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar rang gis mdzad pa nor bu'i phreng ba/45 rgyal dbang lnga pas rgya bod hor se ga gi mche ga dman bar pa rnams la phrin yig snyan ngag tu bkod pa'i chab sgo ga rab snyan rgyud mangs/46 rgyal dbang lnga pa'i rnam thar du kā la'i gos bzang pod la pa/47 kun bzang ras chen gyi rnam thar legs bshad rgya mtshe 'i sdes mdzad pa skal bzang ngal bso/48 bal po'i bla ma sangs rgyas nor bus bris pa sgor la dang 'brug pa maḥtshed yon 'brel ba'i gtam rgyud/49 sgang steng sprul sku bstan 'dzin legs pa'i don grub kyi rnam tha ci bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i rngo mtshar nor bu'i mchod sdong /621

50 mkhan khri dgu pa rishākya rin chen gyis mdzad pa ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar thams cad mkhyen pa'i rol mo/51 rgyal sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa dam byungs pad dkar gyi rnam thar yon tan nor bu'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor/5'a shākya rin chen gyis mdzad pa grags pa rgya mtsho'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad byung /53 rgyal sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi rtogs brdzod dpag bsam sku pos 'du'i snyi ma shākya rin chen gyis mdzad pa/54 bstan 'dzin cerdzos rgyal gyis mdzadi pa ngag dbang lhun grub kyi rnam thar/55 gsung sprul khyodags las rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa ye shes da ngo sa grub kyi rtogs brjod bee tshorya'i mchod sdong /ji tu nga ga dbang pad dkar gyi rtogs brjod shākya bstan 'dzin gyis mdzad pa spring dza srong dgyes pa'i hphu dbyangs gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng /57 mi dbang bsod 'ams stobs rgyas kyi rtogs brjod 'jig rten kun hu dga' ba'i gtam/58 mi pham dbang po'i rtogs brjod shākya rin chen gyis mdzad pa dbyangs can tsu/da mangs/59 yon tan mtha' ji kyus kyis mdzad pa bstan 'dzin chodas rgyal gyi rtogs brjod sgyu ma chen po'i gar stabs/60 shākya rin chen gyis mdzad pa ngag dbang 'byug pa'i rnam thar rig 'dzin zlos gar/622

nams rgya mtsho mngon par spel ba'i zu ba/7'a 'jam dbyangs pad dkang bstan 'dzin gyi gsung skal bzang thar pa'i lam ston/73 'dzam gling dga' tshal lam bse da nams dga' tshal bzhengs tshul kun da'i pon ོ//khu/4 spungs thang du sangs rgyas stong bzhengs tshul gyi dkar chag bseng nams rab bkatheg04/75 gdan sa spungs thang du gser gdung chen smad bzhengs tshul gyi gtam dam pa'i chodas kyi dbyangs/76 rje yon tan rgya mtshos mdzad pa bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gyi rnam thar skal bzang 'dod 'jo'i 'khri shing /77 rje shes rab seng ge'i rnam thar thegs rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa dpag bsam sku ngas 'du'i 'khri shing /78 grang dkar bla ma ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho'i rnam thar byang chen spyod pa'i me long / 79 zhabs grang 'jigs med grags pas mdzad pa rje 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar grub rigs bzhad pa'i sgu dbyungs /80 rje shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar rang gis mdzad pa bden gnyis grub pa'i shing rta/81 zhabs dung 'jigs med grags pa'i rnam thar byang chub nor bus mdzad pa 624

jo gas ldan dga' char rgyun pa'i snu sa kyi sprin chen po'i dbyangs/rda' thugs sprul 'jigs med rnor bu'i rnam thar rang gis mdzad pa/da3 byang chub brtson 'grus pyi rtogs brjod gzhan phan rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rngo mtshar nor bu'i snying po/84 yon tan rgyal mtshan gyi rtogs brjod bstan 'dzin lhun grub kyis mdzad pa skal bzang rna ba'i bcud len/85 e sha li e shen gyis bris pa'i ki ltab/86 gter ston padma gling pa'i rnam thar rang gis mdzad pa 'od zer kun mdzos/87 pad gling sras kun dga' dbang ༷/ga gi bka' 'bum zhal gas/ngas ma/88 rje bstan 'dzin lhun grub kyi gtam rang gis bris pa blo gsal kun dga' skyed pa'i rol mcho/ ci da rtsis dpon zhu sgab dbang phyug bde ldan gyis sbyar ba sod kyi srid don rgyal rabs zla ba 'bum phug 'char ba'i rdzing bu/90 thugs sprupa 'jigs med che sa rgyal rang gis mdzad pa tshangs sras lha mo dgyes pa'i rgyud mangs/ 91 kaḥthog si hu chodas kyi rgya mtshos mdzod pa tshib dbang shākya sri'i rnam thar pe tog phreng ba/9'a thugs sprul 'jigs med grags pas mdzad pa rje bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gyi rnam thar 'ja ma da papa gzhad pa'i sgu dbyangs/625
